reviews.author: ahoora d
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real – Extremely Disappointing Experience
reviews.text:
I would never recommend this hotel. We booked what was advertised as an all-inclusive package, but it was far from it. Food was only available at very limited times and in specific locations, leaving us with no real options throughout the day. The staff was unhelpful and in many cases outright rude. Service by the pool was nonexistent—no one ever checked on guests, and when we asked for help, most employees didn’t seem to know anything.

On top of that, there were no basic amenities such as a shop for essentials or even an emergency convenience store within the hotel. For a resort of this size and price, this was shocking. My husband and I travel four times a year for quick getaways, and this was by far the worst experience we’ve had anywhere.

We expected a relaxing, stress-free stay, but instead we dealt with poor service, lack of food options, and no sense of hospitality. This was our first and last visit to Paradisus Palma real

reviews.author: Trent K
reviews.title: Punta Canna on Steroids
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort.  Grounds are immaculately maintained.

Great views of the ocean from our private patio.  Beach was magnificent.  Great night life. Very good restaurants.

Our Reserve room on the Adult side was magnificent. Concierge service was excellent.  

The resort exceeded our expectations.

Truly a 5 star resort.

reviews.author: loraguirre
reviews.title: Hotel moderno, renovado con habitaciones itaciones amplias y modernas, piscinas espacios comunes muy agradables caferías
reviews.text: Hotel moderno, renovado con amplias habitaciones, modernas, espacios comunes comunes muy agradables, cafeterías y restaurante temáticos muy buenos con un personal magnífico, ama les y dispuestos con los clientes. Buen buffet, primera línea de playa . De repetir

reviews.author: Daniel A
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia, inolvidable, espectacular. Fuimos de Luna de Miel y fue un momento maravilloso. La atención fue espectacular, de todos sus trabajadores, principalmente de Eriol, nuestro concierge, quien fue muy amable, educado y atento con nosotros. Nos ayudó muchísimo, nos entregó sorpresas muy gratas y también su alegría hacía que cada día fuera alegre. También destacamos al personal de The Reserve, quienes fueron muy amables. atentos, principalmente a Marcos del Bar de la piscina, a Gustavo y a Juan del restaurante Santé, y a Celia de los restaurantes temáticos. Nos encantó la experiencia en Santé, la comida deliciosa y todo limpio. Las habitaciones espectaculares, hermosas, limpias, ordenadas, bien aromatizadas, la infraestructura nueva y elegante. Fue una experiencia inolvidable, unas vacaciones y Luna de Miel de lujo. Muy agradecidos y volveríamos felices!!!!!!!!! Totalmente recomendado!!!!!

reviews.author: Ashley R
reviews.title: THE BEST VACATION YET
reviews.text: This was the most amazing vacation I’ve ever been on. The staff was amazing ESPECIALLY Freilyn, Anderson, Joanna and Fernando. They took care of us and entertained us the entire week. We will definitely be coming back!!!

reviews.author: Lynda K
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Leaving tomorrow after a week in paradise.myself and two of my girlfriends stayed in a junior master suite just steps from the beach.  Beautiful room with plenty of room for the three of us. Service was excellent and always with a smile great food and top shelf liquor for drinks. Did a day trip to Saona island with Seaside Punta Cana….so beautiful… planning on bringing my kids and granddaughters here next June

reviews.author: ingrambalde
reviews.title: El precio no compensa
reviews.text: Muy caro para lo poco que ofrece. Personal mayormente desatento, poco entretenimiento, ofrecían servicios a la habitación que no estaban disponibles

reviews.author: Sandra G
reviews.title: FANTASTIC
reviews.text: I visited Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana with a friend and we had the time of our lives.  We are planning to return early next year.

reviews.author: alaiaoptimyz
reviews.title: Very disappointing for price per night
reviews.text: Will not come back as other 5 star hotel are cheaper with better rooms, serive . 24hr bar and better entertainment. No gift shop and atm was broken entire stay. Inconvenience of having to leave hotel everyday for locations food and necessities

reviews.author: Kobi C
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time staying at the resort. Everything was great - the rooms, the pools, the food, but especially the service.

reviews.author: wright62020
reviews.title: Horrible staff and room service
reviews.text: My phone never worked in my room to order room service and I asked 4 times to get it fixed. Never received an update. The language barrier is rough. They talk about you in their native language.

reviews.author: Stella S
reviews.title: Great vacay with friends, made better by our amazing concierge Erolie!
reviews.text: We had an amazing quick vacation with all of our closest friends, and it was a perfect resort!  There was so much for everyone to do during the day - and we all got to enjoy 'family' dinners together at all of their fantastic restaurants. Our personal concierge, Erolie, took incredible care of us and made the trip extra special.

reviews.author: Shane D
reviews.title: September Honeymoon
reviews.text: The Reserve was great as it is at every Paradisus we’ve stayed at. Raphael made our stay as easy as possible, was always waiting for us at the beach with towels and made sure our drinks were never empty!

reviews.author: thenotorioussus
reviews.title: Phenomenal Stay at Paradisus – Thanks to Bacilio!
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Paradisus Resort was nothing short of phenomenal — and a huge part of that was thanks to our amazing concierge, Bacilio.

From the moment we arrived, Bacilio made us feel welcome and completely taken care of. He was attentive, incredibly helpful, and went above and beyond to make our trip effortless and enjoyable. Whether it was planning dinner reservations, booking excursions, or simply making sure we had everything we needed, Bacilio handled it all with such ease and professionalism.

We also decided to upgrade to the Reserve side of the resort, and it was absolutely worth it — the exclusive amenities, quieter atmosphere, and elevated service took the entire experience to another level.

He truly made our lives simple so we could focus on relaxing and enjoying every moment. It's rare to come across someone so dedicated and detail-oriented — it felt like he anticipated our needs before we even had to ask.

The resort itself was beautiful, the food was fantastic, and the atmosphere was perfect, but it was the exceptional service — especially from Bacilio — that made this trip unforgettable.

Highly recommend Paradisus, and if you're lucky enough to have Bacilio as your concierge, you’re in for a truly stress-free and memorable vacation!

reviews.author: AnaGG
reviews.title: Increíble
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia increíble de esas que se guardan en el corazón. Patricia del equipo de Concierge fue increíble , todo el equipo de camareros un amor , y he de destacar la pasión y alegría que trasmite Fernando de animación . No he visto a nadie con tanta pasión por su trabajo ni esa alegría que se contagia desde hace mucho. Se le ve muy apasionado y comprometido por su trabajo. Volvería y repetiría sin dudarlo.

reviews.author: trannguyenpat
reviews.title: Very relaxing experience
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, super friendly and helpful staffs. Extremely chill  atmosphere . Will definitely use these hotels again in the future at different countries.

reviews.author: Maria Elena E
reviews.title: Estadía en familia
reviews.text:
He visitado este hotel varias veces pero hacía como 4 años que no iba esta vez fué un viaje familiar con hijos nueras y nietos...fué una estadía que fué de menos a más gracias a la intervención de Eduardo Gerente de Relaciones Públicas que atendió nuestros requerimientos y nos solucionó cualquier inconveniente. 
Debo destacar la amable atención de nuestro concierge Basilio quien nos visitaba al menos 3 veces al día para informarnos novedades y nos enviaba diariamente el programa de actividades para los niños y los adultos...siempre atento gentil y con una amable sonrisa...tb debemos mencionar a Junior del restaurante  de carnes MINA y del desayuno quien nos hizo la estadía muy agradable con su sonrisa y su modo tan cariñoso de atendernos...el resto del personal algunos de ellos hasta poco émpaticos.
Las habitaciones 5014-5016-5018 y 9122 que reservamos con salida a una extensa piscina fueron 100 ptos muy modernas y muy bién ubicadas para un real y verdadero descanso.
Sin embargo creo que estaríamos al debe en cuanto a la calidad de la comida...exceptuando el restaurante de carnes y el mexicano que sí debo decir tienen una carta muy poco variada ...lo que si hace falta en general en todo el servicio de comidas es mejorar la variedad y calidad de los postres no son del nivel de un hotel  5 estrellas que ostenta premios al igual que las piñas coladas.
Otra cosa que encontramos INSÓLITO es que no había ninguna tiendita donde comprar NADA ni siquiera un bloqueador solar...la disculpa fué qué la estaban remodelando lo que no me pareció lógico pues deberían haberla trasladado a cualquier otro de los tantos espacios que posee este hotel.
En RESUMEN...la oferta de hoteles de buen nivel en Pta Cana es tan grande que creo que si no mejoran estos puntos comenzarán a perder clientes a pesar de tener habitaciones de excelencia.

reviews.author: Zack S
reviews.title: Hands down best concierge service
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real was a great resort. Good food (the Dominican restaurant Flora was the best), solid nightly entertainment, and a grand feel. But what will make it stand out in memory is the OUTSTANDING service from our personal concierge Yinesca. All the staff were wonderful, always warm and friendly. Always greeting us with a smile. But this young woman is a stand out. I cannot say enough about her. She was the epitome of professionalism and was still able to make us feel like family. Yinesca helped make dinner reservations and made sure anything we needed at our room was taken care of like any concierge would. But, she took time out of her already busy schedule to just talk and actually communicate to get to know us. She surprised us by going outside of her work hours and off the resort to assist us when we couldn’t find what we needed at the resort store. She came in early on our last day to see us off and make sure everything went smoothly. We literally couldn’t have hoped for a better concierge experience. As someone who owns his own businesses and knows the value of people skills, I can confidently say her people skills are stellar and the Paradisus Palma Real is extremely fortunate to have Yinesca.

reviews.author: Andrea Zellers
reviews.title: Eriol was great!
reviews.text: Resort was nice, but I’m off season.  Our concierge Eriol was so helpful and helped make our stay so wonderful.  He was the best!!

reviews.author: Jam_Travel_Regular
reviews.title: Lovely rooms and grounds .  Food is wanting
reviews.text: Stayed for conference.  The room was big and comfortable. The free room service was great to have although one night they said issue with the kitchen and would not do it.   Adequate amount of pools and easy to book excursions from the hotel.  First thing in the morning has to be to reserve a restaurant as gh4 main buffet food trends from bland to inedible.

reviews.author: Odyssey225017
reviews.title: Love this hotel
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived we were treated beyond our expectations, the hotel has breath taking views, the food and ambiance in all restaurants are amazing and to top it all we had Yaleidi Sims as our concierge, she went above and beyond to make it unforgettable. Without a doubt the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa is one of my favorite places to visit. Thank you for an amazing week and see you next year.

reviews.author: ZAR100
reviews.title: Excellent All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text: My friend and I were really impressed with this resort.  Our junior sweet with garden view was a 5-minute walk to the pool, beach and all the restaurants, so convenient!  It was nice to have to take a cart to either get from our room to the restaurants and lobby or vice-versa.  The junior suite was absolutely amazing, especially the unique and modern bath and separate shower. The room resort was spotless and our concierge, Leandro, was a 5-star concierge ! He checked in with us every single day, made sure we had everything we needed requested, and had reserved our first two days of restaurants for our convenience. He would respond to our requests within minutes! He really made us feel special!

reviews.author: hbukovchik
reviews.title: A perfect vacation to celebrate my moms birthday with our butler Emmanuel!
reviews.text:
We just came home from our trip yesterday and already want to go back. We have been to this resort many times but this experience was the best. My mom and I took our trip to celebrate her 79th birthday. Emmanuel was our “butler” (not sure what to call someone who is at your service 24/7). He greeted us as soon as we arrived and assisted us daily with whatever we needed. Although the resort store was not in business at this time  (for whatever the reason) Emmanuel went above and beyond to make sure I had some personal items I forgot at home. He did so on his own time and it was much appreciated. 
On the day we celebrated my mom’s birthday  we returned from the pool to see that the room was decorated with balloons, chocolate covered strawberrie and champagne , and rose petals. At dinner the servers surprised my mom with a beautiful, delicious cake and sang to her. She was so happy. 
This was the perfect time to visit Punta Cana. I already had a great base tan from summer and the sun intensified it perfectly. The ocean water and pools were like bath water. I walked right in which I’m normally not able to do. The service on the beach was also top notch. Every morning the beach crew helped us secure a spot in the front row so we had no obstruction to the ocean. We were delivered a light snack and as many drinks as we wanted. 
Our swim out room in the all adults  Reserve section was a perfect location to the beach and restaurants. The food was good. Although the shows at night we not as elaborate as what we are used to to at other resorts, it was a nice way to end the night. 
Overall I give our experience a 10. I give Emmanuel an 10+. I wish I remembered all the names of everyone who helped make our vacation wonderful. We are sad to be home and would go back tomorrow if we could.

reviews.author: Septiembre2025
reviews.title: El personal más amable del mundo
reviews.text: Bellísimo lugar, pero su más destacada cuidas es su personal: el más amable y con la sonrisa más sincera y contagiosa.

reviews.author: Gabriel G
reviews.title: Amazing time at the Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Just came back from a week at the Palma Real - 4 couples in our group. We had such an amazing time at this resort. I have been going to Melia resorts for the past 8 or so years and the experience has been consistent.

The Palma Real is a beautiful resort on the Bavaro beach in Punta Cana. The grounds are maintained so beautifully by the staff who work tirelessly to make sure everything is perfect each day. Our group had some folks with dietary restrictions and there were always options for all of us. And all of the food was just amazing - especially all the fish options (raw an cooked)!!

But the big difference was the staff. Our concierge, Alam, over at the Reserve was always there to help with our daily requests. Be it reservations, drinks or other items for our rooms, Alam took care of things right away.

And a huge shout out to the Reserve Beach staff ... Pedro, Gilberto, Martin and Yudery. This crew was on point every day. Pedro especially!! Each day, our chairs, beds and palapas were setup early in the am with a bucket of ice cold water and soda. And, the drinks in our hands when we needed them. For something different, try some fresh squeezed orange with vodka. Not too sweet and so yummy!

One other point about the beach. Many beaches in the Caribbean suffer from too much seaweed. At this resort, they maintain a net a good distance from the shore that keep most of it away which was so nice!!

Melia has never disappointed me and the Reserve option has always been worth it.

reviews.author: Luna Z
reviews.title: Resort maravilhoso
reviews.text: Resort é maravilhoso, todos os restaurantes com refeicoes incriveis, serviço de quarto impecavel. Nosso concierge Emmanuel, sempre prestativo nos ajudando.

reviews.author: Julian C
reviews.title: Professionalle
reviews.text: Increible el bar, muy amable la gente, los tragos excelentes, buena fiesta , buenos tragos los barman y meseras extraordinario servicio buena calidad de los productos

reviews.author: Jeffrey M
reviews.title: Everything was great.
reviews.text: Everything was great.  We were at the Adults Only section (Reserve) and Alam Molina was our concierge.  He was fantastic, attentive, and addressed all our requests.  The resort has been updated since our last visit many years ago.  The gardens and pathways were spectacular.  Beach was super clean (of seaweed, etc.) and the staff at the beach (Martin and Pedro) were always ahead of us with beds, chairs, towels, drinks, etc.  Really felt like a VIP.  Rooms were nicely done, only complaints are that we were on a 3rd floor unit with no elevators (and bad knees), and shower in room did not have any place to put things down on.  A/C worked great and bed was super comfortable.  Dining (service and food) was either good or great, depending on the restaurant.  I do prefer the Melia resorts in Cancun and Play del Carmen for dining service and food choices, but this was pretty good.  Shout out to Luis in the Asian restaurant as the best waiter this week.

reviews.author: stormlong32
reviews.title: Honeymoon Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent resort. Very peaceful, delicious food, very well maintained, beautiful scenery, swim up bar, clean rooms, could not be more happy for a honeymoon with my wife.

reviews.author: Ricardo G
reviews.title: Gran hotel para unas fantásticas vacaciones
reviews.text: La estancia en el hotel fue fantástica. La atención de Yinesca, nuestra conserje de habitación, fue muy buena. Siempre disponible y haciendo nuestra estancia más placentera. Un diez para ella y para Pedro en el servicio de playa.

reviews.title: Amazing staff thank you Carolina and Yineska

I had an amazing stay at Paradisus Palma Real, and I want to give a special thanks to Carolina, the manager, and especially to Yineska, our concierge.

Thanks to her and the wonderful team, we enjoyed a stress-free and memorable experience. I highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real and especially the exceptional service from Carolina and Yineska.

Special shout out to Freida, my spelling might be off, he was in charge of the nightly entertainment and we were out in the courtyard every night being entertained, laughing, and dancing. reviews.author: jorgefernandez563
reviews.title: El que se va y vuelve, vuelve y se va!
reviews.text: Un hermoso lugar, con personal excelente y paraiso para descansar. Quiero regresar. Lo recomiendo y quiero regresar con más familiares.

reviews.author: jesusvillaseca
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Excelentes habitaciones, cómodas, amplias y con buen equipamiento. Buenas alternativas de restaurantes internacionales y locales, con  una amplia variedad de vinos y bebidas. Buen equipamiento y muy lindas playas. Personal muy amable y preocupado.

reviews.author: Jordan B
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, our room was gorgeous. Emmanuel was the best. He took great care of us. Booked all of our dinner reservations and even had a few surprises for us in our room.

reviews.author: Montse B
reviews.title: Primera pero no última vez en Punta Cana
reviews.text: El hotel está genial ,tanto las instalaciones como el personal son excelentes y lo tiene todo muy cerca, y lo que no está cerca te facilitan el acceso

reviews.author: swaldman111
reviews.title: Service excellent, Food blah…
reviews.text:
We spent one week at the Reserve section of resort.  Service at the resort was very good.  Our concierge Christian was the best!  He took care of everything we needed and went above and beyond for my entire family . Whatever request you might have, they do their best to deliver.   I can’t remember everyone’s names, but every single person we interacted with at Sante were amazing. Barnella, Amanda, Melaqui, Kelvin, Franklin, and I know I’m missing others were great.  They really work hard to make sure guests are happy.  Resort is clean, rooms very comfortable.   It’s a shame that the standards for cuisine fell way below our standards.  

A big part of our vacations are for great food. We are not big drinkers, so I can’t comment on drinks.  Food was 2 stars at best.  We did not go to Flora or the buffet.  It did not look like the uneven have a chef.  More like a cook preparing premade meals.  The desserts look like they were massed produced at Costco , pastries is morning were store bought and stale.   So if food is important factor I wouldn’t come back.  A shame cause the people working here are great.

reviews.author: Inspire66193939130
reviews.title: Family of 6
reviews.text: We stayed as a family at the Paradisus Palma Real August/September.  We did have a few Hick-up like our drain in the reserve shower was stopped up, it took 30 mins to get hot water up to our 2nd floor room, and it was  hard to get some of the reserve mini bar options. But our concierge Yaleidi Sims quickly found a solution to our problems. She had us  moved to the room above our Daughter's family, on the family side. It worked out so much better. No more walking the 3 miles a day back and forth between rooms. And the room layout did seem nicer on the family side.  Yaleidi went beyond  to make our special occasions noticed and worked hard decorating and surprisingly each person in our party.  That I feel like was beyond what she had to do. She is a genuinely nice person and made it a point to contact our party at the start of  meals and each morning with the resort activities of the day. My daughter and her cousin did attend a few of those. I don't think we would have enjoyed our stay near as much had Yaleidi not been there.  If I had to leave a couple suggestions to improve the resort, it would be revamping the menu at Blue Agava. It was our least favorite menu. Maybe add refried beans and rice to the menu, some torillas, and a couple seasoned taco options. Good Mexican food is actually easy to mass cook for a lot of people. And think the reserve side needs more work. I didnt think the amenities of the reserve side warranted the price. So much so I think next time I will stay on the family side if we come back. The next thing I want to say is since the resort has changed. There needs to be some clarification on what is available for the family side on the website. Is there a concierge available for an extra charge on that side, are the nakia suites still available etc. We even contacted to resort prebooking  and couldnt get the first question answered. As it stands it's not a good resort for children. Most people I've read in Facebook groups mention this is the least family friendly resort. And if it's going to an all Adults resort go on and switch completely over.  Had our grandson's not been 1 yr old , he wouldn't have had a very good time. That being said, he did really like the kids zone and my daughter and son in law were impressed with the care he recieved there.

reviews.author: fabiola c
reviews.title: Gracias Juan
reviews.text: El servicio del Capitán Juan Alcántara, ha sido espectacular en toda mi estancia, considero que su trato, amabilidad y servicio resalta en comparación a los demás.

reviews.author: Edwin C
reviews.title: Very happy staff who went above and beyond to meet our needs.
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time thanks to our butler Mr. Gustavo and his colleagues Pedro in the beach area, Marcos and Maricela’s in the pool area of the adult side. Also everyone in the Sante restaurant  were great.

reviews.title: Excelente

reviews.author: Isaura A
reviews.title: Excelente! Confortable.
reviews.text: El lugar, las vistas, las habitaciones. El servicio fue excelente; principalmente las personas de atención al cliente del Bar, Magda, muy atenta, amable y siempre dispuesta.

reviews.author: Al E
reviews.title: Sargazo y menor calidad que Paradisus Mexico
reviews.text: Pensé tener la misma satisfacción que los hoteles Paradisus en Mexico, pero la calidad es inferior. No limpian el Sargazo de la playa, y se está descomponiendo, por lo que no puedes entrar al mar, o siquiera estar en la playa, por el olor tan fuerte. El hotel tiene muy poca vegetación, por lo que el calor se intensifica, hay muy pocas palmeras, incluso cuando caminas por los pasillos sientes el calor del piso. En las albercas nada de sombra. Las bebidas y alimentos son más básicos que en Mexico. En la zona no hay actividades, tienes que ir a Isla Saona o Catalina, a 2 horas. No permiten usar las albercas de los otros hoteles, a pesar de pagar la membresía Circle, de las más costosas. Una mala experiencia. No recomiendo este hotel. Son mucho mejores los Paradisus de Mexico.

reviews.author: colegritz
reviews.title: Honeymoon Disappointment – Poor Value for $500–600/Night
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for my honeymoon, and unfortunately, it was one of the most disappointing resort experiences I’ve ever had—especially given the price point of $500–600 per night for an oceanfront room in the “Adult Reserve” section.

Service:
Despite tipping generously and being polite and respectful (I work in the service industry myself), the service was consistently poor. Requests were often met with indifference, and attention to detail was lacking. A good example: I asked for extra bread, and what was brought out was cold and literally stale.

Food & Drinks:
The food quality was abysmal for a resort in this price range. Most meals were cold, flavorless, or stale. Room service was no better—the food always arrived cold. The coffee was shockingly bad; they were unable to make basic coffee drinks properly. The only decent meal was at the steakhouse; every other dining experience was disappointing.

Rooms & Amenities:
For one of their nicest oceanfront rooms, the experience fell far short of expectations.

The A/C never properly cooled the room.

The mini-fridge barely worked, which is unacceptable in a tropical climate.

Room service food was cold and unappealing.

Even the recreational amenities were neglected: there was only one pool cue for the entire pool table, and it didn’t even have a felt tip.

Overall Value:
This was supposed to be a special trip—our honeymoon—and instead it was frustrating, uncomfortable, and disappointing. For the price, I expected at least reliable service, fresh food, and working amenities. Instead, it felt like the resort is cutting corners everywhere.

Bottom Line:
The resort’s location is beautiful, but everything else—from service, to food, to room comfort—was far below standard. If you’re considering this property, I strongly suggest looking elsewhere. There are better-managed resorts in Punta Cana that deliver far more for the same price.

reviews.author: Sandra D
reviews.title: Great time had by our entire group 🫶
reviews.text: We had a great time!  Our concierge specialist Christopher Rivera was on top of everything and had our reservations for dinner  scheduled each day and always let us know the activities on the resort. He would come by the pool area to make sure we were all having a good time and to see if we needed  anything.  He also made sure the staff at the pool always took care of us!  Which they did!  Angelo was amazing!!! Thank you Christopher!!!

reviews.author: Ivette P
reviews.title: Exceptional Stay with Amazing Staff
reviews.text: Excellent resort! The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, especially our concierge Christopher. He was always willing to help, even during his time off, and responded quickly to all our needs. I would highly recommend this location.

reviews.author: Emily G
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: Christopher was amazing! He was so attentive, friendly, and always ready to help with anything me and my group needed. His warm hospitality really made my stay special. Truly an excellent butler! And was always ready to help with anything our group needed. His warm hospitality really made my stay special. Truly an excellent butler!

reviews.author: ammcasadesign
reviews.title: ESPERIENZA MEMORABILE E ATMOSFERA RAFFINATA
reviews.text: ambiente elegante, piscina ,giardino tropicale,camere dotate di minbar luminose con arredi eleganti , staff cordiale e molto attento ad ogni richiesta

reviews.author: Micman55
reviews.title: Très satisfaite de cette hôtel
reviews.text: Nous avons été au Paradisus début septembre, une période basse alors l'hôtel était pas très occupé, c'était très tranquille, pour nous c'était vraiment parfait, on avait du service, pas besoin de réservé des chaises a la plage, on pouvais arrivé a n'importe quel heure de la journée on avais du choix... c'est l'avantage d'y aller en saison basse. la plage était nettoyer a tout les matins, il avait un peu d'algue mais rien pour nous empêcher de nous baigner, il a fait super beau et chaud. les chambres sont grandes et jolie, un style colonial, très confortable et propre, air climatisé fonctionnais très bien. le site est très vaste en largeur, tout est  pas trop loin, belle grandeur, j'étais dans la section adulte the reserve, très bon service de mon concierge qui parlait en plus en français. Pour les restaurants à la carte nous les avons tous adoré, le santé étais vraiment délicieux. Une petite critique, A mon avis un restaurant de plus ça serais mieux. Le buffet du matin et du midi une belle vérité et très bon. Le restaurant santé pour le déjeuner et diner on peux manger à la carte aussi, c'est très bon. Beaucoup de choix de piscine et de belle dimension. Un site tranquille, on a beaucoup apprécier! Le personnelle très gentil et souriant. Nous sommes très content d'avoir fait le choix d'aller au Paradisus Palma Real

reviews.author: Richalice99
reviews.title: Salvaged our honeymoon… thank you staff at palma!
reviews.text:
We had an unfortunate circumstance which forced us to move hotels from another, and we were moved to Paradisus Palma Real. 

To put it briefly… they saved our holiday (honeymoon)! They salvaged what was an eventful few days at the hotel prior to this one. 

Every staff member we walked past would say hello / good morning regardless of their job role. 

We had Antonio as a concierge who was fab, helping us book our restaurants and helping us in general. 

We didn’t leave our daughter at the kids club, but we done some activities with her - Alexandra was lovely and welcoming. 

We were in the deluxe block 3, and the lady (sorry, forgot her name) who served drinks by the swim up pools was so lovely. Always asking us / bringing us drinks and in general, a nice person. 

Reception staff were so helpful with our situation and gave us a really good impression. 

Even thought we had a dispute with the hotel chain themselves, we would return to this hotel as it was just fantastic. 

Pools / beach are amazing. 
I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Eric R
reviews.title: Amazing and unforgettable experience!
reviews.text: Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful place, but you will know that by just looking at the pictures online. What left us really impressed was the superb and incredibly nice staff and service all-around. The staff was so incredible that I even remember the names of the ones that provided us with the best service we have ever seen. Thank you very much Edisson, Broxni, Yanira, Rosanna, Yafreisy and Santos. You all truly made it an amazing experience. We will be back soon!!

reviews.author: Astrid Z
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia para vacacionar en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Una experiencia Maravillosa!!

Una  excelente atención por parte de todo el personal! Quiero agradecer al Sr Santos, Cristian , Joselo, Milton, que hicieron nuestros desayunos, comidas y cenas las más amenas con una atención espectacular siempre recibiéndonos con una sonrisa, motivándonos a regresar todo el tiempo, a Kelvin que fue nuestro mayordomo que siempre estuvo al pendiente de nosotros, a Carlos Ozuna y Cristopher que nos ayudaron y nos guiaron para hacer otra reserva  y nos asistieron de la forma más paciente y amable 🫶🏻 

Es un hotel en el cual se siente uno relajado y consentido por todo el entorno, el personal y la comida, sin duda planeo regresar y recomendarlo ampliamente! 
Muchas gracias 🙏🏻 😃

reviews.author: Rodolfo H
reviews.title: Muy buen resort pero no es PET friendly como anuncian
reviews.text:
El resort para personas muy bien.
Recepción con José es de lo mejor que he visto, el resto del personal bueno.
En el restaurante Flor Andrea fue excelente dando recomendaciones y siendo muy amable con nuestra mascota.
Para el cumpleaños de mi esposa José hizo un arreglo excelente ya que no podíamos visitar los restaurantes por tener perrita. Jorge y Alberto de banquetes Meliá hicieron de esa noche algo inolvidable. Juan en la Winery preparó una cena en la terraza que cerró nuestra visita con broche de oro. Todos los nombrados merecen ser reconocidos por atención muy superior incluso al estándar 
Nuestra decepción fue con la indicación de PET friendly. A pesar de haber estado indicado el peso  9Kg la mascota en la reservación el kit trajo una cama para perros de máximo 3 Kg de peso. La lata de comida cada día había qu reclamarla. Por US $ 90 por noche es un abuso. 
Volveríamos cuando podamos viajar sin mascota.

reviews.author: Tempora C
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Me encanto todo de este hotel. Es un hotel excelente para la familia, la comida es deliciosa y nos gusto todo. 

Excelente el servicio de Rosanna, Hilda y Yanira en el buffet. También en la noche un joven llamado luis Rodríguez nos atendió súper. 

Gracias a todos

reviews.author: Omil G
reviews.title: Perfect!!
reviews.text: Perfect!! Muy buena experiencia, excelente servicio al cliente, muy atentos y capacitados, gran variedad de restaurantes y la comida excelente. Las diferentes areas siempre limpias, varias piscinas y excelentes areas de recreacion.

reviews.author: Sunilda C
reviews.title: Nos encantó el hotel
reviews.text: Amamos este hotel, es súper cómodo y exclusivo. La comida es deliciosa y puedes descansar, bailar y comer rico. La atención de samaria en lobby bar fue muy buena. Así también de Luis en el restaurante Mina. Excelente servicio. El personal de maletas también fue muy amable y nos ayudó en todo

reviews.author: Sightsee62890085761
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Nos quedamos en ese hermoso complejo por el cumpleaños de mi primo, la verdad el trato fue espectacular partiendo desde el check in hasta los demás servicios, como la limpieza en las habitaciones servicio de minibar y room service siempre atentos, especialmente Joel Valerio. Nuestro concierge Emmanuel siempre atento a muestras solicitudes, nos facilita todos de vrd la experiencia no fuera la misma si su servicio, el el restaurante mina nos celebraron el cumpleaños el staff muy amable. De vrd vamos a regresar. Lo recomienda cualquiera.

reviews.author: Bethany L
reviews.title: Great honeymoon!
reviews.text: We just returned from a 5 night stay at the resort! We did not do the melia/circle rewards, and based on what i saw it wouldnt have made a difference. I did a lot of research before we booked our trip and everything was great! The food at the restaurants was really good, the menus aren't super big/have too many options but every meal was delicious. There are multiple bars in the evening and during the day, the buffet was good but I'm also not a picky eater, my husband wasn't as pleased. The beach club had great lunch options though so it was fine! There are a few activities at night and during the day, but not a whole evening of activities in one place (show style) if that makes sense. Going on excursions was easy and flawless with getting transportation and feeling safe off the resort. The room service and housekeeping were on point, not to mention the full bar that was restocked daily. We would definitely go back.

reviews.author: ANJ
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: We had a issue with our room but Carlos Noel saved the day! He was very helpful and made sure we were taken care of and our room fixed. He was very kind and saved our vacation! If you have any issues please ask for Carlos because he will do everything he can to help. The resort was absolutely beautiful btw

reviews.title: Perfecto!
reviews.text: Muy rico el hotel! Lo justo para descansar y pasarlo bien. El servicio muy bueno también. Nosotros tuvimos a Eriol de concierge y su preocupación y detalles realmente hacen la diferencia. Volveríamos 1.000 veces más con niños y solos. Ambiente para todos!

reviews.author: juliadsummey
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: My husband and I had the most wonderful time. The staff and our concierge were amazing!  We are very excited for our next trip to this resort!

reviews.author: Nomad774002
reviews.title: Ferien
reviews.text: Sehr gepflegte Hotelanlage und das personal ust sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Kann dieses hotel nur weiterempfehlen.

reviews.author: Jerrywestnewyork2024
reviews.title: Train your staff. With two people you can not run the entire resort.
reviews.text:
I would like to commend two staff members because without them I would have left the property upon arrival. 
Adriel Cabrera (concierge) and Mairelis (house keeping)
This two individuals went above and beyond their positions to help my wife and I. Thanks to them we were able to deal with all the problems that exist at the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text:
We first came here on an RCI trade and we loved it so much we bought in. I was skeptical about all inclusive resorts but never on e have I ever felt that there was ever any compromise on the facilities, the food, drink, service or entertainment. It is all outstanding and we are proud to bring friends and family here. The people are charming, friendly and professional. We feel particularly safe here and the other guests are also courteous and friendly.
This trip we have had 2 out of 2 great dining experiences. We loved the restaurant Sante- and Elvis, the sommelier helped us pick outstanding wines which he decanted at our table. The next night was at Flora and we really enjoyed the outstanding Dominican cuisine. Upon being seated they brought us appetizers- even before we ordered any. For mains we had short rib and a flavorful steak dish I can neither remember or pronounce. The short rib was the best I ever tasted. The steak was amazing as well- it had peppers, onions and chopped jalepeno with it. Our sommelier also decanted  our wine for us. They brought a tray full of desserts over after dinner. We weren’t rushed at all and after dinner we were so happy we called the manager, Eduardo over so we could tell him how satisfied we were with the food and the service that we received frim Francesca and her team!  Thanks Paradisius Palma Real! What an operation here!

reviews.author: laurie
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text:
The beach was beautiful and well maintained. There was always security around—we felt very safe. 
The service was exemplary. Our butler Zenobia was exceptional. Our days at the beach were steeped in luxury with the mindfulness and great courtesy and attentiveness by so many of their staff. Martin (a true treasure!) and Gilberto the bartender at the Reserve beach. There were obviously some staff still learning how to excel at anticipating guests needs but with these experts and the work of Andre (waiter for beach exp) Jean Carlos (beach club waiter/bartender) and YuisMairy (lovely champagne girl outside Malva) I know the others will get up to snuff in no time! 
The food at certain restaurants was quite delicious and well presented. The lobster and salmon were done very well. The reserve restaurant was lacking in service and taste. Room service breakfast was the best and always on time. 
Even with the cons this is a wonderful resort. We were already discussing returning next year!

reviews.author: Héctor Reynoso
reviews.title: Lo mejor del Caribe...lejos
reviews.text:
Hace 25 años que voy siempre a República Dominicana, y me alojo en los hoteles todo incluido de la cadena Melia.
En este cuarto de siglo, han construido nuevos hoteles, y este es el mejor de todos.
Garantía asegurada.
El All inclusive, es de los mejores del Caribe.
Con los años fuimos mejorando la membresía, actualmente pertenecemos a fundadores del hotel Circle, actualmente, Gran Cana, donde se cuida cada detalle.
En resumen, el Paraíso en su máximo nivel...

reviews.author: Francesco Crescimanno
reviews.title: Impecable visita al paraíso dominicano
reviews.text:
Hemos estado recientemente allí durante 9 noches y la experiencia ha sido magnífica. Desde el momento en el que llegas te reciben con una sonrisa y hacen todo lo posible por hacerte sentir bienvenido y mimado.

Destacamos la limpieza de la habitación, la calidad de la oferta de A&B (nos gustaron especialmente Blue Agave, Mascalzone y Mina), la calidez del servicio, las increíbles instalaciones de las que disponen…

A destacar el servicio ofrecido por los camareros Alex, Broxni y Milton (entre muchos), Vicmar en recepción y Nessatiel, quien se encargó de nuestras vacaciones cuidando cada detalle👏🏼☺️

Durante esta época, suele ser temporada baja y se notó bastante en el hotel, convirtiéndolo aún más en un oasis de paz y tranquilidad. A pesar de ser época ciclónica, tuvimos un tiempo soleado a diario.

Recomendaría una y otra vez este resort tanto para grupos de amigos, como parejas o familias, ya que se adaptan a todas las necesidades. ¡Esperamos volver a visitaros nuevamente muy pronto!

reviews.author: Celita Welsch
reviews.title: Inolvidable. un resort  perfecto
reviews.text:
Ya conocía este resort y con mi marido regresé. Me di cuenta de que la hermosa playa, el mar azul y tranquilo del Caribe, los numerosos restaurantes con tantas opciones, los vinos, las bebidas y la comodidad de los apartamentos, especialmente con vistas al mar, sin duda me harán volver por más.
El complejo cuenta con un servicio de transporte de ida y vuelta desde el aeropuerto de Punta Cana.
Somos bien recibidos por el gerente, que nos ayuda todos los días, hace reservas para algunos restaurantes, pero no en todos requieren reserva y todos son maravillosos. Me encantaron todos y la comida estaba muy bien presentada.
Para mí lo más importante es la gente que nos atiende, los camareros. Recordaré el cariño, la cortesía, que me impresionó mucho de muchos de ellos, mencionaré principalmente el Restaurante Sante, cuyo variado buffet sirve todas las comidas, estilo buffet con muchas variedades. Ellos son: Juan Domingo, Laura Batista, Alejandro González, Héctor Abreu Juan Alcántara, Misael, Yuleini, Yesica y Domingo. Nunca los olvidaré por su cortesía, cordialidad, sonrisas y aunque hay otros, los guardo en mi corazón.

reviews.author: clasch1971
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones - Sol a tope
reviews.text:
Hemos disfrutado el Paradisus Palma Real de inicio a fin, desde que llegamos nos han atendido muy bien, estamos en temporada baja pero todo ha funcionado sin inconvenientes. El clima excepcional, sol todos los dias y altas temperaturas, el agua de las piscinas y del mar a 32 grados celsius.
La comida variada en el desayuno, almuerzo y restaurantes de especialidad, solo mejorar el buffet de la noche que era pequeño y sin la variedad del almuerzo. Tambien desayunamos un par de dias en el restaurante de adultos en la Reserva, mas tranquilo y climatizado, muy bien. Mas pequeño pero personalizado, menos congestionado.
De los restaurantes los mejores en calidad el Italiano mascalzzone y el Mina de carnes. El teppanyaki entretenido por el show del chef. El mas debil no siendo malo, el mexicano. Tambien esta el dominicano flora solo adultos que tiene comida tipica muy buena.
Hicimos el taller de pizzas, muy entretenido. Tenias también actividades diarias en la piscina.
Los bares bien surtidos en marcas y de buena calidad. Especial reconocimiento a Julia del bar de las piscinas de las habitaciones y a Wanda del bar de la Reserva adultos. Siempre diligentes y con una alegría contagiosa. En la playa de adultos Gilberto y Pedro.
En general ha mejorado harto la atención del Palma Real (es nuestra 5ta visita), se preocupan de ti y muy atentos desde el check in hasta la salida.
No fue tema las reposeras ni las toallas ya que habian de sobra y siempre disponibles asi que nada de estar levantandose a las 6:00 para asegurar un lugar. El tener muchas pisicinas ayuda. 
Es un hotel tranquilo, elegante, ordenado, con sus jardines bien tenidos. Ideal para descansar en pareja o en familia ya que tienen espacios para todos. 
Felicitaciones a todo el personal y a la dirección que le han dado una especial orientación hacia los huéspedes.
La relacion precio calidad excelente, sobretodo para nosotros que somos melia rewards, buenas ofertas.
Con seguridad volveremos pronto.

reviews.author: Franklin R
reviews.title: El Restaurante Mina es el mejor de Palma Real
reviews.text:
Wander es un camarero espectacular que celebro mi cumpleaños y muy buena persona 

El restaurante Mina es un lugar Maravilloso el menú infantil me encantó  y  a mis padres las carnes

Alfonso Reyes cumpleañero 10 años

Fabulous room  Garden Suites however RCI screwed up my payment process and ended up paying over 700US with no help from customer service.spent every freaking day trying to get this resolved and no help .5 of 7 days sitting in their lounge waiting to hear who would take the blame for screw up..played pass the ball all week
DO NOT USE Company recommended for transportation from Hotel..called to inform of problem with flight, they left us stranded at the airport , said to use another company and we would be reimbursed then baled on that SO $60 US wasted

Excelente hotel. Acomodações, atendimento, pessoal, entretenimento, gastronomia, todos
Itens nota 10. Um dos melhores hotéis que já conheci. Recomendo com toda certeza. A preocupação com o bem estar, assistência e disponibilidade do pessoal é simplesmente perfeita.

reviews.author: Roam21896023343
reviews.title: Meilleur resort à vie 🙂
reviews.text: Un séjour des plus merveilleux, site nature d’une belle grandeur avec des gens très souriants et serviable. Nous avons apprécié tous les restaurants ainsi que le buffet. Notre majordome Eriol a rendu notre séjour encore plus agréable, il était à notre écoute et il s’est occupé de nous tout au long de la semaine. Un gros merci à toute l’équipe et à Eriol.

reviews.author: valmorinkelly
reviews.title: Séjour incroyable
reviews.text: Un service parfait du début à la fin. Un accompagnement adapté. Décoration choisi avec goût. Propreté impeccable. De nombreuses activités proposées

reviews.author: monica P
reviews.title: Recomiendo el restaurants Italiano por todo su attention y servicio gracias
reviews.text: El servicio excellente Wilmina  muy agents con today amabilidad  y Milton siempre  excellent y pendiente en todo muy satisfactory con la attention de ellos agradezco todo y siempre ellos estan pendientes al clients,  y preguntando si todo esta bien si se necesita de algo y  me gusta muy elegance todo muy rica la comida y todo lo que esta en el menu asi que recomiendo este elegance lugar para tener una Cena rica e inolvidable  con todos del servicio

reviews.author: miltonmborja
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Great hotel and facilities, they just need to get their act together in the check in process so that when you arrive at the room, its not steaming hot and you need to contact the hotel so they can “turn on” the Air Conditioner remotely, in addition in 2 instances after check in both Housekeeping and Facilities came into the room unannounced. Unacceptable.

reviews.author: Emiliano N
reviews.title: Does not meet expectations
reviews.text:
Dear Mr. Juan Carlos Lloret
Resident Manager
Paradisus Palma Real.

My name is Emiliano Navarro, I stayed at the property you manage from September 3rd to 8th. It is a property with Caribbean characteristics and impressive natural charm. I was impressed from the first moment and I did not stop praising the service of the staff because I felt exhausted by so much kindness and good vibes... but as the days went by the inconveniences began and it was sad for me how the effort of the staff in dealing with the client is tarnished by situations beyond their control and this should not happen.
I imagine that you were aware that there would be a wedding on Saturday the 7th and that more than 150 people would arrive at the property on different days.
I am going to list several issues that I hope you keep in mind.
1- I requested room service after 10pm on 3 occasions and they served me chicken with fries and hamburgers with fries and they only had coke to drink. The third time I did not complete the order because I thought it was disrespectful.
2- There were losses of belongings in a room. The person's name is Mario Rodriguez Del Rey. The pertinent inquiries were made and everything was as it was.
3- Problems with the Heineken beer supplies. I spent the last 5 days with a bucket going around all the bars because it is the beer I drink and there was none. One night at the ginger bar at 10:30pm there was no beer. They needed to put a place to cool down that closes the alcohol service at 1:00am. (When I'm on vacation I drink beer from the moment I open my eyes, it's not a matter of time)
So, with this bucket we shared several friends and I tell you, I'm not interested in the other variety they offer because it's not to my taste, and the beer dispensed at the Bar near the White Bridge, not to mention, but we made the effort to avoid the inconveniences but everything increased then it was the turn of the Chivas Regal 12 year old whiskey, also The Macallan, then this got out of hand to me to the point that I went up to complain to the office and I told the guys what was happening that everyone knew, but they don't have a way to solve it, but on top of that I told them, tomorrow Saturday with the wedding please I hope you can have everything necessary and the incredible happened we paid for one or two hours of extension of the party and you have programmed the A/C until 1:00 am therefore at 2:00 we were dying of heat and another complaint was made... this goes beyond everything and to give the final touch they began to remove the decorations and the tables even with us inside and The belongings were placed on the chairs as we were dancing. I had the idea that the first table where this incident happened had a defect and that was why they had moved it, but then it was the turn of the next table, and I said to myself, wow, they are crazy to finish. We ordered drinks and went out to the dance floor. When we came back, everything had been removed. You can be proactive, but they went too far. So, to sum it up, they ruined a good stay.
I don't consider this a criticism, but with the category that you have, this can't happen! I felt taken advantage of and I wonder if in my case with the brown bracelet I went through this. Regular customers, what can they expect? I thank you for your time, thank you very much!

reviews.author: tmilien1987
reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text:
It was a trip with my girlfriend.
We plan on going back! Mr. Louizaire took good care of me. Thank you

reviews.author: Luisa P
reviews.title: Asombroso hotel y muy seguro
reviews.text: Felicitaciones a Dionys de seguridad que fue fabuloso muy buena su honradez y ganas de devolverme mis lentes. Además pase un gran tiempo en el hotel. Tuve unas cenas increíbles. Gracias por toda la experiencia. Las instalaciones inigualables.

reviews.author: mcelasco
reviews.title: Imperdible en Punta Cana
reviews.text: Sea por vacaciones o por trabajo, el Paradissus es “único”. Excelente gastronomía y esmerada atención de su gente. El “plus” lo da la posibilidad que un conserje personal atienda tus requerimientos. En ese caso si tu conserje es Eriol… él se encargará que todo sea perfecto.

reviews.author: Iraia L
reviews.title: Paraiso
reviews.text: El hotel es precioso, bien cuidado, la atención muy buena, en especial la de nuestro concierge Emmanuel, que en todo momento nos ha ayudado y ha resuelto cualquier cosa que haya podido surgir. Mucha variedad de restaurantes y piscinas, eso nos ha gustado mucho.

reviews.author: Voyage24856020280
reviews.title: Dominican Paradise
reviews.text: We made our first trip to the Dominican Republic and it was well worth the trip to stay at the Real ! The staff was top notch and the resort was the best! We could’ve just been happy with the planned activities at the resort and staying on the beach but the excursions we purchased while at the hotel were the best. We really suggest the zip line and dolphin swimming!! The staff was always very kind and beyond helpful. If you can request Christian Gonzalez for your concierge I would definitely do so he went above and beyond as far as helping us plan everything and making it a wonderful stay. Our favorite main man at the front , Jose , was the best ! The room was more than expected and anything we needed it was provided quickly and always with a smile! Definitely worth a stay at this resort!!

reviews.author: viart22
reviews.title: 30th Anniversary
reviews.text: Our overall experience was great. The atmosphere, staff and ambience were very beautiful. Our concierge, Obiso Antonio Sina was very involved in our stay. I would and have definitely recommend Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. The one thing that I didn't really like at all was the sales pitch by management to purchase what I would call a "timeshare" while we were trying to enjoy our trip and scheduling an appointment to do so.

reviews.author: Marucho M
reviews.title: Paradisus siempre paradisiaco
reviews.text:
A través de los años hemos visto la evolución del hotel Paradisus, muy emocionado de estar nuevamente en sus instalaciones. La propiedad esta muy bien cuidada, limpia, impecablemente decorada y con olores que transportan y relajan. El servicio de comida bueno pero pudiera estar mejor, aunque tengo que puntualizar que me refiero solamente al buffet, tuvimos una cena en uno de los restaurantes y la misma fue fenomenal. Las bebidas buenas con buena calidad. Super recomendado. 

Recomiendo ir por más de tres noches para poder disfrutar toda la experiencia, puede ser en pareja o con la familia. 

Tengo que reconocer que el servicio es excepcional por todo el personal y es algo espero puedan seguir cultivando y creciendo. Las atenciones no tienen desperdició siempre con una sonrisa y con ganas de ayudar a que la experiencia sea más placentera.

reviews.author: SkAgan
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: From the time we arrived Eroul took great care of us. We had wonderful service and food. The resort was amazing and absolutely beautiful. I can’t say enough about the staff. Gerardo Eusebio Made the best omelets , Edito and Alexander made the best coffee, Luis,Vanessa and Wilmer kept the cool drinks coming no matter if we were beaching it, poolside or at the Kanna. It was just unbelievable the care and love with great service.

reviews.author: Piotrek S
reviews.title: Week vacay
reviews.text: Good drinks, and the service is great. Everyone is very friendly and lively and always say hello. They always help you find what you need. The different places to eat are always a nice way to adventure out of your comfort zone and experience something new.

reviews.author: Lynn B
reviews.title: My first visit to a Melia resort.
reviews.text:
I am sitting here in the Reserve lounge waiting in my ride to airport. The best thing about this resort was Harry, my butler. I would say one of the best I have ever had. I had many conversations with him. A true gentleman. 
The food is hit or miss. If you are used to Secrets etc you must book Reserve and eat at Sante or you will be disappointed.Some things I liked, some I didn’t . They need to watch food temps a bit more closely. Someone could get sick. I received excellent service from the restaurants , never a problem. The Reserve bar had great drinks. Jason shout out ., I think he spells it differently. He kept me in alcohol the whole stay! 
Gustavo at Samte was an excellent server! His really was attentive and knew how I like my coffee! The little things count. I did not receive any bad service from any of the people here. The only issues were other guests but I won’t get into that here. 
Yes, I would come back but Reserve is the way to go here.

reviews.author: Marietta
reviews.title: Horrible food, miserable staff and be careful at check in.
reviews.text:
First of all, the facility is beautiful and that’s it! We booked a 2 bedroom master suite but gave us two connecting rooms. We complained and was moved the next day to another regular rooms, at this point i can’t pack and repack my 4kids. Lots of reviews about not giving u the right room of what u paid for.
I’m a party of 6, we need space.

Food: it’s a 2star, not great at all. My kids won’t even eat the pizza! They were very slow the last few days so they only opened 2 restaurants which is always no availability for 6 people 

Staff:Horrible, except for some waiters at the buffet and main  pool. 90% of the staff were just miserable. I mean they won’t greet you GM, I say GM to everyone and they are shocked. lol.  I blame management, no proper training.  The staff doesn’t even know if they have watermark!( we asked 6 people)

Check in:

Pls be careful with this hotel. We paid in full but forgot the credit card we used, the concierge said will charge the stay and will give credit  as soon as u check out. We check out and it’s been 3 days and no credit back in our credit card.  There are a lot of reviews about this. I’ve emailed them and called numerous times. every single person that picked up the phone has no clue what I’m talking about. I’ve emailed twice and no response.  The concierge was not clear , I would have not given my credit card if they have to charge $4200 again! 

Just stay away from Melia hotels

reviews.author: Nathalie E
reviews.title: Staff amazing, but resort needs improvement
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the service, the room (Master suite deluxe), the live entertainment at night, and the restaurants for dinner were great (food, service and decor). The hotel also has a lovely convenient layout, with everything next to each other and you almost always have a view of the beach from the outdoors. The beds are comfortable and housekeeping did a great job. We enjoyed the drinks and smoothies offered across the hotel.  The staff at the main buffet, restaurants, coffee and snack bar were great with us and the kids. They worked really hard and always gave us a smile and took care of us very well. We appreciated that the shore’s seaweed on the beach was cleaned every morning. We also liked the range of activities offered: there’s a full activity schedule for day and night for the three 3 age groups (children, teens, adults). We found the resort to be extremely stroller friendly.

A huge shoutout to breakfast buffet staff, they were amazing, kind, fast, hard working, and always put a smile on the kids and our faces! Ricki from the buffet was my absolutely favourite!!!! He always went above and beyond to make our experience great - he made our trip 10x better with his great service!!

If I could make a few important recommendations for improvement: 

1) The check-in process, It took 5+ hours to check us in, and during the process they kept telling us the room would be ready soon. We stayed in the lobby during the whole duration because they kept calling us over and telling us the room would be ready in another 20-30 minutes. They did this at least 10 times. The manager came out and continued this charade of “another 20 more minutes”. It was a very frustrating experience. When they finally had a room available, it was a downgrade from what we had paid for (they wanted to give us a 2 bedroom master suite instead of 2 master suites!).  Then they tried to offer us 1 king bed instead of two double beds but we were 4 people in a room. It was a pretty bad experience, we stayed in the lobby, sweating, with kids and babies until 6 PM.
2) The buffet food was a safety hazzard. The food was not at the right temperature (everything was room temperature, even the cheese and yogurts). The counters of the buffet need to be upgraded with the appropriate pans and set-up to keep food warm / cold. I found the layout of the food to be really weird, all the food at different heights on different size bowls and trays, and covered in sauces. To be safe, I stuck to mainly eating the freshly grilled foods and the fruits, and luckily the restaurants were fantastic for dinner. 
3) Reduce cockroaches in rooms. On our 5th day we encountered many cockroaches in the hallway and then suddenly in our room. We reported it to house keeping and they came to fumigate. 

Overall, this is a great hotel but we would like to see these points fixed to consider coming back.

reviews.author: Danielle E
reviews.title: Great service staff but buffet and front desk need help
reviews.text:
Just got back from one week at the Paradisus. Here is my review… 

Check in was a disaster. They made us wait 5 hours in the lobby because they couldn’t accommodate what we had booked. We kept getting “ we need 20 more minutes” or “ let me go in the back and check” and they wouldn’t come out for an hour. Really disappointing and extremely unacceptable for a resort of this “calibre” especially difficult since travelling with young children. They should have at least told us to go enjoy the pool/beach instead of making us wait. 
We were also not the only ones that this happened too because there were very angry travellers at the front desk as well. 

We finally got our rooms. The rooms are a very nice size. The issue was the air conditioning wasn’t working in the living room area, our room was not fully set up with things ex: soap towels  ( I guess that’s why they made us wait) and the worst part is the cockroaches we had. They did come and spray but really freaked us out. It took them a full 5 days for them to fix the ac… the day before leaving. 

Our cleaning lady was so nice. She tried her best to please us and the boys filling up our drinks and snacks was great too.

The beach is beautiful but was rough with the red and orange flags up everyday. They really try and keep it clean and tons of chairs and places to sit. 
 The Pools are great too. Good entertainment at the main pool and the smaller pools on the circle side ( which we were on) are the perfect size. Lots of service all around.  Always towels available. 

Main buffet 

Main buffet had  tons of options but the biggest problem was, like mentioned in previous posts, the food temperature was way off. The hot food was room temp and the cold food was sweating. When we arrived the buffet was ok the first few nights but as the resort got quite they close the main buffet and make you go to the small one on the adults only side. This buffet was absolutely disgusting. In both buffets no air conditioning so it’s not a pleasant seating area either. The buffets are beautiful visually but they need to get more organized and really fix the food temperature problem. 
The restaurant 
We had no problem booking them and one night we just asked and they let us in 

The Italian restaurant is very goods
The steak house is great. 
The Mexican is Ok but Editho is awesome so if you go there ask for him 
The Japanese is fun too. 
We are not allowed in flora because of the kids. 

My biggest suggestion is book a restaurant for every night if you can and tip well if you want to get in a second time without reservations. 

Snack bars 
One good snack bar. The staff is great.  Down side is you can’t take anything to go so you can’t eat at your chairs by the pool which sometimes you just want to lay by the pool and snack. 

Lobby coffee bar 
Great coffee good smoothies

Shout out to      

Édito Mexican 
Melvin door
Raider Italian 
Jean snack bar 
Edison buffet 
Wander steakhouse 
Felix Mexican 
Luis snack bar 
Gladys massage 

Biggest shout out is to Ricki! He was our waiter most of the time at the main buffet for breakfast and he was incredible !!! Look out for him he will take care of you!
 
Don’t forget to TIP. These workers work really hard and tipping really goes appreciated 

Overall this hotel has beautiful grounds, nice pools and tons of seating but the check in experience and the buffets are the downfall.

reviews.author: arochaernesto16
reviews.title: Me gustó lo recomiendo 100% el personal muy profesional tienen buenos trabajadores y sobre todo el señor Luis y Salomón
reviews.text: Me encantaría volver en un futuro espero que mis comentarios le sea de mucha ayuda bello paisaje increíble su clima graias

reviews.author: Donna S
reviews.title: Focused on Timeshare way too much!
reviews.text: I would like to start off with a positive before I get into the negative.  The property is lovely and the wait staff, bartenders, and maids were top notch.  My problem came when we checked in.  We were a party of 14 and the hotel cancelled one of our reservations and said the person was a no show. They spoke to several different people without resolution until they told us that they would need to book an upgraded room because the room reserved was no longer available.  So I ended up paying double for the room.  My travel agent contacted the hotel to inquire and was given the run around.  We were also supposed to get spa credit and when we went to check out the amount was not applied to our bill.  When I inquired the front desk stated that I should have received a voucher a the time of check in and there was nothing that they could do about it now.  Since we were not sitting for the timeshare presentations (absolutely refused) it seemed like the customer service we received from the front desk was horrible.  The only response we received was that it was our travel agents fault and not the fault of the hotel.  This is the 2nd and last stay I will have at this brand (Melia) as the one in Cabo hawked us to attend the timeshare presentation every day and once we went and refused their gifts we never saw our concierge again.

reviews.author: Berbino L
reviews.title: Best Time of Our Lives!
reviews.text: The best restaurant experience ever! I Me and my brother met Rafael and Rafael; they made our hibachi experience like no other! I would tell and encourage everyone to come to Paradisus to enjoy this amazing place. The staff here is amazing! Come see for yourself!

reviews.author: albertoare39
reviews.title: Buen hotel mal atendido
reviews.text: Tienes que estar todo el día discutiendo y preocupándote de todo. Pésima comunicación entre los trabajadores de este. Venden una membresía que es totalmente falsa ( soy socio). Nada recomendable este hotel

reviews.author: Carlos senna
reviews.title: O resort é muito bom. Acomodações 10 Refeições 10 Atendimento 10 Atrações noturnas  8 Eu indico, pois conheço outros em
reviews.text:
Nós hospedamos no resort por 1 semana. A experiência foi muito boa. Comida de boa qualidade, quartos amplos e novos com limpeza excelente. Freezer sempre abastecido em relação ao laser, ótimas piscinas e bares. Comida de boa qualidade, bons restaurantes, com excelente atendimento
Senti falta das atrações noturnas, poderiam melhorar as atrações para os hóspedes.
No geral é excelente.

reviews.author: MARTHA IRENE E
reviews.title: Cuidado con la camarista Melani del Bloque 6, piso 3 Hab 15
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia inicio muy bien me recibió un ángel de nombre ADrian de pueblo lindo , hizo lo imposible por colocarme junto a las amigas con las que andaba.

Dificultad para reservar restaurantes y la chica de reservas no muy sociable específicamente la joven que me asistió en el turno de la mañana del sábado 31 sept , parecía que pedía un favor y al final me negó la reserva.

Señore pagando mi hospedaje para disfrutar y descansar. 

El señor que ,domingo 1sept ,en buffer hace parrillada , molesto y agotado se quejaba de preparar las carnes y no quería hacerla hasta que lo preparo obligado por su supervisor que vio la fila de personas demandando el servicio. 

Un supervisor peleaba feo con los camareros encima de todos y el camarero avergonzado bajaba la mirada , me quito las ganas de comer ver el pobre hombre siendo regañado  feo públicamente.
y para poner la cereza al pastel en bloque 6 Hab 6315 encuentro la hab bloqueada a las 12 en punto como es la regla y por mis culpa , pudo de manera amable a dos empleadas que estaban haciendo supervisión de las camaristas y sin siquiera detenerse ni explicar u orientar , remitió al lobby.
Desesperada con altas temperatura y en un tercer piso sin ascensor buscó asistencia en otra joven que limpiaba piso tres hab 6310 y cuando se disponía ayudar para abrir han y poder sacar las maletas , la señora se percata y evita sea asistida .

Fue muy feo momento en medio del calor y si era una regla no era la forma , quedé muy indignada del trato indiferente , frío y mal intencionado de la señora de nombre Melani y su compañera supervisora q le acompañaba.

Muy linda instalaciones y muy atentas las camareras todas del buffet 
El maletero fue la atención hecha persona y ni se diga del señor del parqueo que nos recibió.

Creo que debe orientar al personal y educar sobre atención al usuario aunque seamos Doninicano.

reviews.author: Gisela C
reviews.title: Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our dinner at Mascalzone Restaurant. The service was efficient and very professional. Rieder was very corteus and very helpful. We had Veil lasagna and it was delicious. In general the staff made possible that our dinner was memorable. Thank you Rieder for your attention to the details. 
Baltimore, Maryland.

reviews.author: Arlin V
reviews.title: Excelente servicio brindado por el señor Eriol muy amable y atención de parte de él para nuestra familia la pasamos geni
reviews.text: Muy buen servicio del hotel y atención principalmente por el señor Eriol muy buenas atenciones brindada para mi familia de parte de Eriol y las  instalaciones y la comida muy deliciosa la pasamos muy bien disfrutamos bastante cada restaurante que visitamos

reviews.author: ondina
reviews.title: Mi experiencia 😵‍💫
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en el Congreso de Cardio Metabólica de la Sociedad de Medicina Interna de la República Dominicana , la llegada una experiencia agradable , muchísimas gracias Adrián ( un chico amable y preocupado por complacer el cliente en la recepción con el verdadero sentido de atención al cliente  👏👏)  por ser la primera impresión del hotel🙌🙌
La comida normal pero de manera general buena , la locación es muy bonita , el hotel no tiene ascensor y es un poco lejos el área de los restaurantes y el centro de actividad del bloque que ocupamos #6  , imagínate subir 3 planta escalón por escalón con la maleta en mano 😵‍💫😵‍💫.
 Algo que nos llamó la atención la discusión de los empleados y el jefe o supervisor  en el área del bufet general (sábado en la tarde )  , de repente estaban con una ocupación mayor de lo usual tomando tiempo extra de trabajo pero eso no implica que como usuarios oigamos el disgusto de los empleados,  seamos mal tratados como huésped  y las reclamaciones del supervisor😵‍💫. 
Las amenidades buenas  : los chicos que tocan saxo geniales , el grupo que toca muy bueno , los tragos buenos, los chicos de los bares y camareros buenos  ; pero ojalá no te toque quedarte en el bloque 6 y que te atienda una camarista en el arreglo de tu habitación de nombre madeline , pienso que probablemente extranjera , porque creo hablaba creole con una compañera , que poco tacto que maltrato a los huéspedes del hotel que poca atención al cliente , la gotita que rebosa la copa, su actitud en la tarde de hoy  y como una persona puede contribuir más de manera negativa con tu experiencia en el hotel . 
Creo que deben de dar un mejor entrenamiento de cómo tratar los clientes y entender que por nosotros su hotel funciona y  vive …… y como nosotros los usuarios somos su mejor promoción. 
 Si me preguntaras si vuelvo ?? …. te diría que no , y si tienes la opción de algo más por el mismo precio tal vez te convenga experimentar otro lugar ….. es una pena que una locación tan bella le falte atención al cliente , calidez, humanismo, cortesía y amabilidad . 
Recordar que hay muchos hoteles que ofrecen lo mismo por el mismo precio con locaciones bellísimas también , pero es el trato al huésped lo que hace la diferencia 🙏🙏

reviews.author: Elizabeth S
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Muy buenas atenciones. El restaurante Tokimeku (asiático) muy bueno, sobretodo lo cocinado por el chef Kelvin, además todo lo equipo muy atento para que estemos a gusto, una buena opción para la cena

reviews.author: Escape693709
reviews.title: Restaurante Mina
reviews.text: Vinimos al resto Mina, excelente el servicio de Kelvin y Ana, calidas y serviciales personas. La carne riquísima , pedimos diferentes cortes y todos estaban muy bien, volveremos y recomendamos el lugar. Arrancamos muy bien nuestras vacaciones en el hotel!

reviews.author: Adhara D
reviews.title: Outstanding experience
reviews.text: Excellent service, great food quality, very clean. Room service was on point, we had food and beverages replenish every day in the morning, and clean towels. The staff was very friendly and serviceable

reviews.author: BU24_7
reviews.title: Dominican Paradise
reviews.text:
This hotel is absolutely gorgeous! No detail in decor or comfort was overlooked. It was impeccably maintained and we were amazed by the meticulous grounds and how well they enhanced the natural beauty. 
Our concierge, Christian, was fantastic. He met every request and anticipated every need. Dinner reservations, daily activities, minibar requests, towels, transportation…he saw to it that we didn’t lift a finger, a phone or have a worry in the world. He met us each day at least twice to make sure we were well taken care of. 
Our second Melía stay and our first trip to the DR did not disappoint! We’ll be back!!!

reviews.author: Todd W
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: The resort is new and includes all the amenities. We were visiting during the low season, so they seemed to rotate the restaurants that were open using a smaller staff. But that still allowed us to experience all of their excellent food. Christian, our concierge, took wonderful care of us!

reviews.author: Keish S
reviews.title: Happy Memories
reviews.text: My family vacation started out negatively, until this wonderful amazing employee Stephanie came into our lives and completely transformed our vacation into happy memories, laughter, and joy. Thank you for turning our experience into something so special and unforgettable!!!

reviews.author: Jeinerys B
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente servicio, muy atentos los entregadores Juan guerrero y skerling, me encantó el gym muy buenas máquinas. Me gusto el paradise gym, desde que vuelva, vengo de una vez para acá sin pensarlo dos veces.

reviews.author: rogertoronto88
reviews.title: Very professional five star service
reviews.text: Grade a hotel by how they solve issues when they occur. We had unexpected medical issues and Stephanie at this hotel went over and beyond our expectations to ensure our stay was an excellent experience. She saved our vacation and really cared about how we were doing. She checked in with us every day and made sure we were enjoying this beautiful hotel. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Yolanda B

reviews.author: Kayla J

reviews.author: jmac386
reviews.title: Service at Paradisius Palma Real is great.

reviews.author: joaoalmeida2023
reviews.title: Excellent overall service quality.
reviews.text:
I would like to highlight the friendliness of the entire staff, the quality and variety of the food at the buffets and in all the restaurants, especially Mina, where the meat is of high quality and grilled to perfection.
The rooms are very well preserved, as is the entire resort, with no signs of wear due to the maintenance they carry out regularly.
The cleanliness of all areas of the resort, as well as the rooms, also deserves a very positive mention.

reviews.author: joannc887
reviews.title: Could not ask for more!!
reviews.text: Everything about this hotel was great. We stayed at the Reserve section of the resort which was adult only.  The beach and pool accommodations were a step up - lounge beds vs. lounge chairs - and access to adult only restaurants.  The place was gorgeous, the rooms were immaculate, the drinks were plentiful and the food was good.  Our concierge, Eriol, was the best!!  He made sure everything was perfect for us.  He contacted us every day to assist with reservations, etc.  My sister and I took our mother for her 87th birthday.  Well, Eriol had surprised us with balloons and champagne in our room on her birthday and had alerted the restaurant at dinner and they had a special Happy Birthday cake for her.  The restaurant personnel were all so very pleasant and helpful.  I will definitely return!!

reviews.author: Christine R
reviews.title: Relaxing get away
reviews.text: Traveled with another couple. Rooms were comfortable, food was great. Our concierge Francisco was excellent. He was very attentive and made sure our needs were completely met. Would recommend this resort.
