reviews.author: Ángel A
reviews.title: “Great Property for an Incentive Trip”
reviews.text:
What a great property to host an inventive trip. My team was on the resort for 7 full days and nights overseeing our incentive event. The entire Resort staff provided 5 Star Service. We experienced Royal Treatment and the attitude of, “we will never so no” The Resort is stunning with all the outlets available with food, bars, casino and even a night club. Wow! What more would anyone want. I want to personally acknowledge the following employees.

Security - Joventino and the entire Security team. I’ve worked with plenty of security teams Globally and I have admit, this team is by the BEST! Trained professionals. Also, recognition for Eduardo the overnight lead!! Great Job and his communication to me and my team. 

Conference Services - Samuel. What a Star!! Samuel was all over our program and never ever let us down. We would see him up and about around 7a.m. and departing late at night after every scheduled event!! 

Housekeeping - Great service! Always smiling and providing our rooms with service. However, I would invest in signage saying Caution - Wet Floor slippery when wet. When mopping was done, it felt like one was in an Ice Rink. 

Rooms - Room decore is outdated, room doors need major renovations as every door seems to not lock properly. Electronic key system outdated. Not sure if safelok or the bing system is being used. But, whichever system is in place needs a major update. Key cards would deactivate periodically causing major timely issues of having the keys re-activated. 

Overall - It’s a great destination and property.

reviews.author: ewong410
reviews.title: Best Home Away From Home Vacation
reviews.text: I have nothing but wonderful things to say about this resort, this year was my 15th time in 11 years.  Every time I leave as soon as I get home I'm already looking to book next year's vacation.  My children weren't even born when I started going and they're 8 now and there's no where they would rather be.  Every year it's the same answer.   From the guys at the beach:  Santos, Jairo, Luis, Ramon and I'm sure I'm forgetting a couple but these guys make you feel like you're a part of the family I truly have a very special place in my heart for this hotel and the people.  The kids zone an amazing place for kids with truly wonderful people.  Katy, Natali, & the rest of the girls make this place so special and comforting.  Raynol Tomayo, Marionell Ramirez, Germania from  towels, Emilio Palacios from Royal Service, Ilario, Anthony from Family concierge at The reserve, Luis from the Gaby Grill and everyone else that make this place so special to me.  Your hotel deserves every wonderful review it gets.  You have very special & hard working people there and it's such a great place to call home.

reviews.author: Raizor
reviews.title: SÚPER VACACIONES
reviews.text:
El Family Concierge es ideal para las parejas con niños y no tan niños, tiene el Kids Club en esa área, a los mas pequeños le suministran productos Jhonson para el cuidado personal (shampoo, baño de espuma y repelente de mosquitos) y protector solar 50, a los mas grandes nos reciben con una botella de espumante y frutas tropicales, la nevera dotada de leche, jugo de frutas, bebida achocolatada todos de larga duración, refrescos y snack.
Nosotros fuimos 3 adultos y 1 adolescente, Yarol nuestro Concierge, se encargó de nosotros en todo momento y consintió a todos los miembros de la familia hasta el final de nuestra estancia.Fue maravilloso.
Alrededor de la piscina está el restaurante Gaby Club, localizado en el área de Family Concierge,  el personal es muy atento y gentil, tiene un buffet muy bueno, con variedad para todos los gustos, desde salmón, pescados, carne prime, langostinos, langosta, comida típica dominicana, todo muy bien presentado y de muy buena calidad, también hay un restaurante informal  Hydro Grill,donde se comen hamburguesas, hot dog, pizzas y ensaladas, acompañado de unas deliciosas papas fritas y atendido por el siempre amable Luis.
Las camas balinesas alrededor de la piscina son estupendas, cómodas e ideal para cubrirte del sol y dormir una siesta, los meseros que atienden en esa piscina siempre pendientes de satisfacer tus necesidades.
Durante el día hay actividades en las  piscinas y en la playa, así como en la noche te puedes tomar un trago y bailar con el equipo de entretenimiento que están dispuestos a enseñarte si no sabes... Mi favorito fue el divertido José Vicente respetuoso y con talento para integrar a las personas. 
Igual mención se merece Santos del área de Family Concierge, que en la playa te ayuda desde arreglar tu cama para tomar sol hasta suministrarte de agua y tragos.
NO DUDO EN RECOMENDAR ESTE HOTEL, ES FABULOSO.

reviews.author: dvalera07
reviews.title: Memorable Experience
reviews.text:
This was my first time staying at this hotel but I must say that I was very pleased with my experience. The hotel is beautiful and is a great destination for families. They have a kids zone and a baby zone which has many activities to keep the little ones entertained but they also have a good choice of entertainment for the adults.  The entire hotel is surrounded by beautiful greenery and I was amazed by how beautiful and well manicured their gardens are, a true joy to see! 

The Family Concierge:
My husband and I, stayed in the Reserve and our  family concierge Sandra Villanueva was phenomenal. She facilitated all of our activities in the resort from restaurant reservations, excursions, beach and pool cabana reservations and any special request that we had during our stay. I felt like she would do anything possible to make sure that we were stress free and enjoying our vacation. 

The food: 
I must say that the food at this hotel is excellent. They have many different cuisines to choose from and the quality in all of the restaurants is superb. We specially liked the food in Gabby Club buffet as we felt that the they have a better selection of gourmet food than The Gabby beach buffet. Sandra made reservations for us to have a romantic dinner at Passion and the food was exceptional. We had the seven course dinner and our server, Martin made sure that everything was perfect from the moment that we arrived to the moment that we walked out. 

The pool: 
Since the pool was literally a couple of steps from our room. This is where we spent a lot of our time. The reserve pool is pretty big, has lounge/shade areas inside of the pool and has a swim up bar. The entire pool team was excellent including the water aerobics guys but  one specific pool attendant, Jhonathan Medina was AMAZING. He was super attentive and professional. He will cater to your every need and will make you feel like royalty. People like Jhonathan are the reason that guest will keep coming back to this hotel. 

The Reserve at Paradisus is an excellent choice if you want to relax, receive the best and most friendliest service and have the best quality food and drinks. We will be back next year.

reviews.author: Parvin V
reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text:
As an experienced travel agent who has familiarized myself with many Caribbean all-inclusives, I would rate this resort a 0-star.

Beginning with the lack of hospitality at check-in, and waiting 4-5 hours for our room, not only did we not feel welcomed but the people with family and the elderly didn't get their rooms quickly upon arrival. We requested multiple times in advance in email to be upgraded to better rooms but no one acknowledged it.

Its a beautiful resort but lots of walking, and there are no snackbars around besides the bars which weren't 24/7. It would take lots of time (like an hour) to go to your room, change, and go to the buffet (there was only one) to eat.

The food in the buffet was nothing special, and the a la carte restaurant reservations took few hours if you were lucky enough to get one. Once there, you had to wait 2-3 hours to get your food that you will just end up at the buffet tired and hungry.

Refrigerators in the rooms was never full unless you asked them. I had to ask for soap in my room. No small hand towels. The shower head was broken and would always fall.

There wasn't any entertainment besides one or two nights at the resort. 

I don't recommend this resort to anyone (which was overpriced to begin with) for a good vacation. I didn't really feel that we were on vacation. Their marketing is very misleading. 

PS the sunwings representative was never present and the bus to leave to the airport for our flight was a disaster.

reviews.author: dhoffman556
reviews.title: Left Something to be Desired
reviews.text: We stayed in the older portion of the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  It was well maintained, and the staff was friendly, but no one seemed to know what was going on.  The guests were often left on their own to figure out how things work.  It seemed like some of the members of the staff were genuinely sincere, while others were primarily interested in hustling the visitors instead of providing great service.  It had a beautiful setting and grounds, but we couldn't help commenting how great it would be if someone like Disney got hold of it!  We traveled in February and learned that the wind blows constantly that time of year, which dampened our experience somewhat.

reviews.author: mlockman
reviews.title: excellent place for families with kids under 14.
reviews.text: Guest to staff ratio was almost ridiculously high. Top shelf alcohol and 4 star restaurants in addition to the excellent buffet. Be sure to add 45 minutes in travel time to anything the locals tell you with regard to how long it takes to get there.

reviews.author: Lawanda H
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: Do not waste money and pay extra to stay at the reserve if you’re looking to have a good time. Having a concierge means nothing if they are not responsive. I was asked could I walk to the main lobby instead of being taken by the shuttle because it was a short distance. I paid like the rest of the guest and if I wanted to ride 20 feet that was my perogative. For people who do not speak Spanish and may not fit the colonized picture scheme staff still need to have respect for all and service their guest the same.

reviews.author: CandeSol
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones!!
reviews.text: Quiero compartir lo fantástico de este hotel, que me hizo sentir como en casa. Viajé con mi hija de 3 años y mi marido. La habitación, los restaurantes, todas sus instalaciones: piscinas, gimnasio, tiendas; increíbles. Quiero destacar al personal de este maravilloso lugar de descanso. Desde Luis Santana que fue nuestro family concierge hasta el último. Son todos tan amables, cálidos, siempre con una sonrisa. También las chicas del Kids Zone, son fantásticas, muy concentradas en cuidar a nuestros hijos. Realmente, me voy feliz y seguramente regrese. Se los recomiendo a todas las familias, este hotel es súper completo, entretenimiento, unas playas increíbles. Gracias Paradisíaco Punta Cana.

reviews.author: flaviaemareclo
reviews.title: Razoável
reviews.text: Correu tudo bem, mas nada de extraordiário. A qualidade das bebidas e das comidas deixou a desejar, poderia ser melhor. A praia tem muitas algas e vendedores que não param de importunar as pessoas para vender de tudo, é muito chato. Basta pisar na praia que já vem dois ou tres vendeores oferecer coisas e te importunar. Isso foi muito desgradável.

reviews.author: NobelMatos
reviews.title: Mucha decepción!!
reviews.text: Estuve visitando este hotel, despues de casi 3 años y la verdad es que me sorprendio lo que habia decaido el mismo vs la vez anterior que lo visite. Lo que más me llamo la atención fue el mal servicio al cliente de sus empleados durante las horas de almuerzo del buffet. Malas respuestas ante solicitudes que le hacia en buena forma y mucha lentitud para atenderme. La calidad de la comida estuvo pésima y poco variada. Todos los días era lo mismo siempre en las 3 opciones. El hotel se notaba muerto, sin ambiente, sino fue porque había un grupo grande de una empresa que siempre  se veia vacio y sin vida. Escuche muchas quejas de ese grupo en relación a las habitaciones, decian que no estaban adecuadas para su necesidades. Aparentemente no se dimensionaron bien para el tamaño del grupo. Quisiera volver algún día, pero antes averiguaré si las cosas han mejorado, porque de seguir así no vuelvo.

reviews.author: cmatostwentythree
reviews.title: Beautiful establishment...but it lacks hospitality and are in major need of staff training
reviews.text: i visited this establishment for the a wedding on the weekend of August 18, 2018. It all started when my sister and I arrived,  getting to our room was a mission.  No one could tell us where our room was, all we kept hearing was "it's over there."  No one offered to walk us since it was obvious that we have been walking around in a circle ( we also did mention it). We were not briefed on the different restaurants. We asked other questions, and no one had an answer. I overheard another guest asking what time did the pool close and the bartender pretty said you can stay as long as you want.  The pool closed at 6pm. I thought that perhaps the issue with the service was due to a language barrier, but speaking in the native language did not make a difference. On our last night, I made a reservation for my sister's birthday. We were recommended a restaurant - Brisas , because we were told that this was a seafood restaurant. When we arrived, we discovered it was a sushi and sashimi restaurant, not a seafood restaurant.  This was upsetting, and the ONLY hotel staff that made accommodations for us was Emill, a great bartender who assisted us twice. We explained the situation to other staff and they were not trying make the night better for us.  I also wanted a birthday cake for that night, went to guest services to put in the order, and they failed on that also. While in the pool, they had staff get in the pool with their uniforms to clean the pool.  I couldn't believe that they would want staff walking around in soaking wet clothes. Why not have staff wear appropriate water gear to clean the pool, instead of getting in a pool wearing a polo shirt and shorts.  This was my first resort experience and I must say I would not recommend this place to anyone.  It is unfortunate that this place is aesthetically pleasing, but it lacks tremendously in service.  I'm glad the wedding turned out beautiful, but everything else four thumbs down.  I hope this review helps others, and definitely the resort.

reviews.author: artisw758
reviews.title: Great family vacation spot!
reviews.text:
Our first trip to the Dominican Republic we stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and we were not disappointed! Once we got checked in we met our family concierge, Antoni.   From that point on, Antoni and the rest of the staff at the Reserve made us feel at home and did everything possible to make she we relaxed and enjoyed ourselves.   I highly recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a nice, clean resort for to relax and have fun with the family.

The Paradisus is a HUGE resort but the Reserve is situated away from the main portion of the resort (including the beach) but it has it own pools, buffet and pool grill.   When we were looking to book our trip, we were deciding whether or not to spend a little extra for the upgrade to the Reserve.  If you find yourself in  the same spot, spend the extra money (if you can ) and go for the upgrade to the Reserve - the accommodations, food and alcohol are better.  Don't worry, if you like going to the beach or you want to explore the resort, there are trams stops throughout the resort.  The trams will take where ever you need to go on the resort.

The staff - I can't say enough about them. After the first day I noticed something- every time we came a cross a staff member, wether it was Antoni, Pascal or Sonia (managers), Frankie (one of our waiters), hospitality staff, maintenance staff - they always greeted us as "family" and treated us as family.  These are hard working people that made sure we enjoyed our stay. I cannot praise them enough!

The room - we are a family of three and decided to get the one bedroom master suite.  This came with a pull-out bed in the living room for our daughter (15 year old) and it worked out fine.  The room was clean, spacious and very comfortable. The bed and bedding was clean and comfortable.  The room included a 2 person whirlpool bathtub which we enjoyed a few times.  The room was perfect for us!  They use 110 volt outlets so those of us from the U.S. are good to go -just bring a desktop charger with you (a usb charger that can charge several devices at once).  This way if everyone in you family has a phone, tablet or portable gaming device that reeds to charge at night can - there are only a handful of outlets in the room.

The food - the food was high quality at the Galbi Club - the buffet and bar at the Reserve.   There was always fresh food here for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  There are other restaurants on the resort, Italian, Latin Fusion, a steakhouse, Japanese grill to name a few.  If you don't feel like going to one of these, stick to the buffet - they have a variety of fresh food to choose from.  the dinner choice seemed to change nightly. Like I mentioned earlier, the Reserve is an upgrade at the resort.  This includes the food.  One morning we went to the spa and decided to catch the buffet near the beach (in the main area of the resort) an noticed the food was different.  iIt was good food but the food at the Reserve buffet was MUCH better.  What I liked is there is a grill next to the pool so if you or the kids get hungry while playing at the pool you have have a hot dog, hamburger or salad at the tables located next to the pool.

The drinks - yes this is an all-inclusive resort and you can eat and drink as much as you can handle.  I liked the Reserve because you could have just about any international name brand alcohol you want.  I spent most of my days at the Reserve sitting in the pool with a drink in my hand and enjoyed every minute of it.  There are two pools at the Reserve and the main pool has a swim up bar if you can't wait for the pools staff to come around and check on you.

Overall I HIGHLY recommend this resort to anyone who is traveling to the DR and looking for a very good resort to relax with the family.  NOTE - there is a Paradisus Punta Cana and a Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.  They are about 20 minutes (driving) apart and owned by the same company.They both have the Reserve and Royal Service (adults only) upgrades.  The Punta Cana is a little older than the Palma Real (one was built in the mid 1990's and the other was built in the late 2000's) but they are similar in design and identical in service.  You can't go wrong with either one - they are 5 star resorts.

I will be going back to the Reserve when I return to the DR.

reviews.author: Adam K
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with mediocre service
reviews.text:
Overall the resort was beautiful. Spectacular views. You could see the ocean walking in and see if from almost anywhere in the resort. The resort was also well maintained and very clean. We did the royal service as it was our honeymoon and liked the fact that you could have an adults only area and many amenities with this. Our butler Argenis was amazing. He helped with anything we needed and went above and beyond. Unfortunately besides him the service was mediocre. The only other people I can say gave great service was Fernando and Mario at the swim up bar by the pool and Martin who was at the royal service bar. If it weren't for them our experience wouldn't have been so great. The service at breakfast and lunch was terrible and dinner service just ok. I had to flag someone down just to get a drink. Kuddos to Argenis, Fernando, Mario and Martin! They were amazing. As far as royal service, was it worth it? Maybe. It was worth it as far as having someone like Argenis help us out and being able to get a bed on the beach reserved by Martin. The different pillows and having essential oils was a cool touch as well however there were some things about royal service that were just ok and could be improved. 1. Although there was an adult only pool it was secluded. Just because we want adult only doesnt mean we don't want to have fun. Adult only was literally just a small separate pool. The music was at the main pool as well as the swim up bar and all the fun. I want to enjoy the swim up bar and music and the fun activities so we just ended up going over to the main pool vs. using the separate adult only area.  The other thing that could be improved is the alcohol choice for royal service. We had to go to specific bars to get better alcohol and even then found out it wasn't included. We felt for royal service it should be. Additionally I've never been to an all inclusive resort where stuff isn't included. There is a wine bar but it's not included and you have top alcohol but it's not included. What is the point of all inclusive then? Additionally, royal service gets a separate lobby to check in with extra amenities and alcohol. We walked there to get a drink and they have all the top alcohol but when I asked what they had that I could mix the grey goose vodka with all I got was sprite or coke. I asked if they could do vodka lemonade or vodka cranberry and they said no. I guess I'm not sure the point then in having this alcohol there. Unless you just want a jack and coke it wasn't worth it. 
-Dinner's were ok. We liked Bana, Rare and Passion. Palazzo which is part of royal service as well was just ok. There was lack of seasoning throughout all restaurants. I think the only one that was spot on was Passion which you have to pay extra for. Additionally when we ate a passion I didn't want to have to pay extra for wine as the resort has plenty of house wines. I was shocked when I asked for the house cabernet and was told I couldn't have the house wine in this restaurant. I was left to then spend $14 per glass of wine and had no choice. I was puzzled as the resort has wine that is included as I'm paying for an all inclusive resort yet I couldn't get that wine in this restaurant so not only am I paying extra for the meal but I am now paying extra for drinks. Did I mention we are "royal service?" That doesn't matter. The dinner food overall however was ok. We were not a fan however of breakfast or the lunch options. Honestly, our room service we order was better than what we ate for breakfast or lunch. There needs to be more options with better seasoning. If you are looking for a resort with beautiful views but are ok with average food and service you'll love it. I guess the saying is true, you get what you pay for!

reviews.author: Pablo Garcia
reviews.title: Excelente hotel familiar
reviews.text: Lo que más destaca del hotel es la amabilidad de las personas que trabajan allí. Fuimos con unos amigos y los niños, tienen una zona especial para ellos al lado de la piscina infantil, cómoda y vigilada. La comida es espectacular, incluso la del buffet, y merece la pena reservar restaurante por la noche, dejarse asesorar. Las habitaciones son amplias y cómodas. Lo único que pediría son ofertas para poder ir los fines de semana desde la capital.

reviews.author: jxr20
reviews.title: Amazing wedding and honeymoon
reviews.text: We booked our wedding here and had an amazing time!  Patricia was our romance coordinator (wedding planner) and made planning our special day super easy and stress free.  Our guests had a great time and we were upgraded to a VIP room, royal service, which gives you access to an adults only pool, restaurant and your own personal Butler and other amenities.  Overall we were extremely satisfied and highly recommend this resort and our romance coordinator Patrícia!

reviews.author: Kelly B
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
We did so much research before picking the resort for our honeymoon and paradisus hands down is the best resort on the island. However, if you are not planning on splurging and getting royal service you may be disappointed. 
The perks of royal service made our honeymoon that much greater. Our butler Ariel is to thank for making our trip unforgettable, always making sure we were happy and having a good time. 
He was there to answer questions, reserve cabanas, and set up dinner reservations/spa appointments every day. A few days during the week he would even set up snacks in our room and on our last night set up a romantic bubble bath.
All of the staff is amazing here, they are all so friendly and hardworking! I know it’s is an all inclusive resort but please don’t forget to tip- even if it’s a large one at the end of your stay.
Don’t forget to say hi to Wanda at the royal service pool bar, she makes a mean coco loco 😉

reviews.author: Sebastian A
reviews.title: La mejor de las atenciones
reviews.text: Excelente atención al grupo familiar que fuimos. Excelente trato humano. Impecable servicio, nos han hecho sentir mejor que en casa desde Wisly nuestro encargado hasta Felipe en la playa, pasando por Santos al desayuno y las personas de recepción Orlando, Heidi y otros. Excelente! Deben vivirlo!

reviews.author: Dirk H
reviews.title: Great Golf and Spa Resort
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is a great place to wind down and relax. We stayed at the Suites and had private pool access. The facilities of different restaurants are great, and you have the choice of dinning every evening of the week a different cuisine. The adjoined golf course is great. I also suggest to make the effort to play Punta Cana. The hotel is happy to arrange golf for you and shuttle service can be arranged. All up, we had a great experience at this Resort and love to come back. Staff is very friendly, funny and attentive.  Thanks to George our concierge, he was fantastic.

reviews.author: Francisco I
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Maravilloso
reviews.text:
Tremendo resort, muy buen resort
Todo bien excelente el Royal Service y nuestro conserje Alberto. Restaurantes, bares y todo el servicio entregado estuvo a la altura 100% recomendado y esperamos volver pronto

reviews.author: Pampa Y La Vía
reviews.title: Un lugar de la cpnchadelalora
reviews.text: La verdad es que me sorprendió ver tan tan belleza junta en un mismo Lugar, lo recomiendo 1000% tienen que ir... Un saludo enorme a Salid, lucas, aimir y José que hicieron que nuestra estadía sea perfecta siempre dispuestos ayudarnos y a acercarse para dar una mano antes de pedirla... Gracias Totales.

reviews.author: ScottFischerAFC
reviews.title: WORLD CLASS DESTINATION FOR A BUSINESS TRIP
reviews.text:
If your team demands the very best, then this is the place to go in the DR. We selected the Paradisus Palma Real as the site for our 2018 Annual Meeting after visiting all of the high end properties in Punta Cana. We wanted a WOW experience for our team and found that...and more...at this property. The rooms are beautiful, the food is well above average for the region, and the amenities are outstanding. We were warned that the service would be slow but we found it to be much better than other islands we have visited. But what really makes this property special is the people. There are always issues when you plan a trip for a large group, but what really matters is how the staff at the property handles the situation and the steps they take to recover and make things right. This is not a huge resort, but they have the horsepower and local resources like you would find at top properties in the states. 

If you are considering the DR, you need to understand that this is not one of the islands that cater specifically to Americans. You will find people from all over the world visiting the area. It's not dangerous or difficult to navigate, but make sure you make friends with the hotel staff before you decide you want to go out and explore. They are proud of their country and will tell you where to go and what to do. The DR is not necessarily what I would consider a "Caribbean destination" but it does feel very tropical with lot's of energy and plenty of things to do. 

After a full week at the resort with our group, I can honestly say that we only had one big problem with the property. At some point either before we arrived or while we were on island, a television was broken in one of our group member rooms. It was never really determined how it happened or who was at fault, but I was so impressed with everything else over the week I agreed to cover the cost. It was unfortunate, however, that their guest services manager was rude, dismissive, and clearly not aware that he could have permanently tarnished our perception of this outstanding property and their parent company, Melia. I trust the leadership will take appropriate action because he is clearly a bad egg. 

The meeting facilities and conference services are among the best I have ever experienced. Nothing seems to be too big or too small and if you have the budget, it felt as if they were always there to say "...yes - we can do it. Now what's the question?". 

A BIG thank you to Adriane, Alain and Suleyka (the best CSM EVER) for making me look like a hero. I forgive all of you if you said bad things about me behind my back during the week! I only wanted the best for my team and the three of you stepped up and made it happen! Our entire company is truly grateful! We will be back!

reviews.author: Nima S
reviews.title: Worse service I have ever seen for a 5 star
reviews.text:
Went there September 4th-One hour wait for check ins, my bed was wet the first night, no hot water for the shower the entire week, water wouldn’t drain in the shower, asked for towels took longer then an hour, no smiles from staff. Buffet had the same food lunch and dinner everyday all day, pizza was good. One night I went to the bar @ 2:05 needed a drink but the bartender said can’t serve you cause bar closes at 2, hospitality nightmare. 
I know this is not in their control but the ocean looked like a swap from seaweed.
Save yourself money and go to Chic Punta Cana and get the vacation of your life.

reviews.author: Ernesto M
reviews.title: Placer
reviews.text:
Muy buena las instalaciones y el personal que te ayudan en todo momento.
Especial atención en la playa  atendidos por Felipe quien es muy eficiente en su trabajo
Además en el restaurante Gaby la atencio de Victor Mateo y en el bar Sunise la alegria de  la camarera Yesenia

reviews.author: Arshia G
reviews.title: Would not recommend it
reviews.text:
This is place was terrible... it took us 3 hours to check into our rooms, the mattresses were dirty, fridge were never stocked and upon ordering drinks for the fridge, they would only bring max 4 beers and waters at a time.... food was terrible, the service was slow, the majority of the staff were unfriendly... the oceanfront was covered in seaweed. The only positive aspect of this hotel was the cleanliness of the lobby and pool areas. 

Amongst our group, a few people had items stollen from their room. 

Do not come here.

reviews.author: lasvegassmiths
reviews.title: Graduation trip
reviews.text:
We booked for a 7 day trip to celebrate our daughters graduation.  The resort was great. We uodraded to the royale services and our Butler was Argenis. I would recommend requesting Argenis is using the royale services. When we arrived he had already arranged for our restaraunt reservations for the first night, and took care of each night there after. My wife’s birthday was also during our stay and Argenis arranged for a very nice cake to help celebrate her day. The selection of restaraunts were very good and the food was great!  The filet at the royale service restaraunt was the BEST!  The only disappointment was with the service (or lack there of) at the cabanas on the beach. Argenis made sure to arrange for a couple of cabanas when we arrived and we were all excited to spend time on the sand with some cold drinks. But the lack of service made us abandon the beach and hang at the pool instead.  The beach was also overtaken with seaweed and the only place to access the sea was next door at the other resort. 
If you’re looking for an above average resort with great places to eat, this is it. If you want to use the royale services make sure to request Argenis!!

reviews.author: nimahomayouni
reviews.title: WORST RESORT IN PUNTA CANA! DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME!
reviews.text:
We came to this resort with high expectations, my wife and I booked the Royal Service Ocean front. We came for my brother's wedding. We came with over 100 guests, and was expecting a high end experience, but instead came to the resort from hell. 
Let me point out all the issues:
1. Our room had a wet mattress, the door handle was broken, the ocean front smelt like someone forgot to flush the toilet in a public washroom. The safe did not work. Our luggage took over 2 hours to get to our room, the room smelt like mold, the fridge was never filled up.
2. The staff, oh my goodness, I have never encountered such rude and cheap behavior from the staff. Every two seconds all they would ask for, TIP, TIP, TIP. Well I love tipping, but you need to give me service for a tip, not just keep asking. It was so annoying. I was going crazy.
3. The wedding, we booked the beach terrace, which was close to Gabi Beach, but that same night, there were two other big parties, where our dj had to put the music to full blast, but it was still not loud enough to hear, as the other two parties were putting their music to full blast. The buffet at the wedding was worse than a 1 star restaurant. I didn't touch anything, and if fact the food in the whole resort was so bad, I actually lost 9 pounds when I came back to Canada.
4. The excursion team, who would book our excursions, were the most unfriendly cheap people. They kept trying to overcharge us for our excursions. That's when I decided to book directly with the company, instead of using these middle men to book with. Once again, all they would ask for was TIP TIP TIP. Oh my goodness!!
5. The bars would actually hide bottles and say they were out of the bottle. Especially with Black Label. They would say they are out, when I can clearly see from the mirror behind them, that there were bottles under them. LIARS!!
6. The Manager Domingo, worst hotel manager ever! I will be contacting Melia Head office for this. He is a complete Liar! Need I say more!
7. No one at this place spoke English! All they knew how to say was TIP TIP TIP. Well how about you give me my royal service I was promised, and sure I will tip.
8.My family was so embarrassed for our 100 guests, and all we were doing was calming them down.
9. I have never gotten into so many fights with staff in my life.

I will never ever ever ever book any Melia resort again! All they care about is money in their pockets, and treat guests like garbage! 

Not to mention having to calm down my brother, mother and father ever two minutes.
After over 6 months of research to find the right place for my brother to get married, we stumbled upon what we thought would be the best place for a destination wedding. But instead I felt Hell would be more luxury than this place!

DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE!! I URGE EVERYONE THINKING OF GOING HERE, YOU ARE IN FOR A SPECIAL TREAT!!!

reviews.author: Arash
reviews.title: Terrible place ! Stay away - not a 5 star resort...
reviews.text:
The good: The grounds are nice and maintained well. The bad: everything else! 

Bad experience started with checking. We had to wait hours. Half the day was wasted. They are very unorganized and inefficient at taking people in. 

The beach is unusable. There is seaweed all over the beach and in the water. It smells disgusting, you cannot even go near the water. You could even smell it inside the resort! We went to other beaches outside of the resort and they did not have this problem.....

The rooms are dated. Some of the rooms smelled. Some were wet. Beds are terrible. Definitely not 5 star worthy. Also the bathroom and shower has glass doors so you can see others inside from the room.

The food was a joke. Same crap every day. Restaurants were even worst. Be prepared to eat garbage all week. They would not give us reservations for restaurants even though they were not busy, we walked in on a couple of them and they had many tables and seats empty, just didn't want to serve their customers! 

Service could not be any worst. The staff are all angry, rude, most don't even speak basic English. Even for a big tipper the service was just unacceptable. 

Excursions - the activities desk inside the actual resort scammed our group and refused to provide any refund. We did some excursions outside of the resort and those went well.

We also had a wedding and some group events that were ruined with poor planning, there was a corporate group that interfered with ours.  

There is construction going on in parts of the resort, including the front entrance. We could hear construction in the room at times. 

The exchange rate at the desk was ridiculous. They charged a 30% fee. What a joke!

The Casino which is a just small room with 2 tables is 100% rigged. Specially the black jack table. We caught the dealers CHEATING multiple times, which resulted in a fight and us leaving the Casino and never returning. 

Multiple people got ear infections from the poor water.

The whole place was pretty much dead and we still received poor service and quality. Don't want to imagine how much worst it is during busier times. 

Stay away this place is not worth the money they are charging. Seriously.

reviews.author: Sam B
reviews.title: Worst Experience Of A Hotel Ever
reviews.text: Worst resort experience I've ever had in my life. To start they gave me the wrong room twice they wanted me to initially sleep on a rolling bed for a week then they gave me a double room which smelled like paint after a night of sleeping in that and hours of going back and forth they gave us the royal service room. There is nothing special about that room at all couldn't order fresh juices didn't bring me liquor at night and to top it all off a lot of us got sick from the late night hamburgers that we ordered I guess they left it out all day and fed it to us. Apart from that they only had one buffet which was the same food over and over and the quality was far from decent and all the restraints were booked and the food wasn't even good when you got there. The service was horrible they just look at you and smile and not even ask what the problem is or try to help they just want more money from you and walk away. if you want a cab to go somewhere Make sure not to use them they will charge you 10 times the price that it actually cost overalll there is nothing positive that I can say about this resort except it looks nice but that docent cut it for a quick summary for you guys. FOOOD BAD SERVICE BAD DRINKS BAD SCAMMERS ALOT OF wouldn't reccomend people to go here save yourself the time and look for anotherr resort in Dominican. only thing that made it bearable was the 100 friends that came out for the wedding the rest was garbage.

reviews.author: Soheil A
reviews.title: Horrible Place, Do not go
reviews.text: From the moment we got there to the moment we left it was nothing but disappointment after disappointment.  First of when we got there it took them about 4 hours for them to get us a room, ok sure it happens, but it kept getting worse, the beds were moist, the place was a mess and had to get room service to come clean up immediately.  The staff and management was absolutely horrible, rude and inattentive. All the arrangements for the wedding were flawed with no remorse from the staff.  They purposely would turn up their music when we were having our wedding party which was planned waaaaay in advanced and yet we were blamed for it all and management told us we had to keep it down not the other party that just popped up out of no where.  I'm 100% sure the staff was making fun of us in Spanish as we had some people in our party who spoke spanish and hey I also understand some Spanish insults myself.  The casino, wow now that another story, the rules of blackjack seemed to change on a daily basis and everywhere I went i was harassed by some guy trying to sell me necklaces or rings and would not take No as an answer. Food was horrible, either over cooked or under cooked and extremely slow service, I could finish my whole meal before I could get a drink. All the excursions were scams and we were constantly being lied to, for example they would tell us speed boating for 2 hours but it was actually snorkelling for an hour and speed boating for 20 minutes, which most of the boats broke down in the middle of the water and barely got to drive them. It seemed like everyone was just lying to us to get an extra dollar out of us, we booked a yacht party and they tried to give us another broken down boat that wouldn't even fit our 57 people and had to challenge them for about 30 minutes before they gave us the yacht we had initially paid for.  Ive been to many resorts all around the world including this which was my third time in Punta Cana and i can tell you if it wasn't for the group of people I was with, I would have cut my vacation short and left by the third day and this was the worst resort I have ever been to...PPFFFT 5 stars, yea right

reviews.author: kyliez2001
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: The people here were great and really got to know them since not many people here like Reynaldo, yesica, Fidel, Maria, and Alejandro. I would come back here just to see the staff here again. Our family had a great experience

reviews.author: Brince M
reviews.title: Anniversario de casados
reviews.text:
Mi esposa y yo decidimos celebrar nuestro aniversario en este hotel debido al magnifico servicio brindado por el staff y  su belleza no podemos dejar de mencionar el autentico servicio que nos brindó la gerente del royal service Sra.Glenys Martinez quien a la verdad fue de gran ayuda para que nuestra estancia fuera estupenda, por su atención Y colaboración para que la mínima solicitud de nuestra parte fuera cubierta para asegurar nuestra comodidad, mil gracias muevamente para ella,también al supervisor de RS jose quien nos recibió muy cordialmente y se aseguro de que nuestra habitación fuera entregada lo mas express posible, a su personal de la recepción en especial a la concierge ingrid quien nos brindo un check in impecable y como no mencionar a este Querido amigo Enrique Ruiz gracia del departamento de reservaciónes quien fue el intermediario entre nosotros y el hotel, este cuidó cada detalle expresado de mi parte al momento de hacer la reserva ya que
 Mi esposa está embarazada por lo que requerí planta baja y estos fue realizado, Es un excelente hoy hotel y cuenta con una propiedad hermosa, playa con muy buena locación y confort, el personal del palazzo Muy atento y eficiente, un abrazo desde aquí por su excelente servicio y atención a Miguel el waiter del palazzo,pronto estaremos de vuelta!!

reviews.author: Miranda H
reviews.title: Loved our royal service visit!
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, we had perfect weather, food and drink were amazing! We were grateful for the Royal Service! Argenis took great care of us, left surprises in our room almost every day, and always got us the best restaurants for dinner!

reviews.author: Gabrielle D
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text: I had the privilege of staying on the Royal side of the resort and it was amazing. My Butler Argenis was very professional, prompt, and very knowledgeable about the resort. He helped me whenever I needed help and never had a problem doing so. The food was great, and the atmosphere was even better. Do look at the reviews book your stay and upgrade to royal. The rooms are spacious and you have private amenities!

reviews.author: Lyman B
reviews.title: Best vacation ever😎
reviews.text: I must say I can’t say enough good things about this resort. Everybody is very helpful and friendly and the place is clean and in tiptop shape. All of the activities they have were very fun as well as visiting different restaurants. One of my favorite and most memorable activities was the zip line and Polaris to the ocean where the Atlantic and Caribbean meet.  I highly recommend this resort for anybody looking for an incredible getaway vacation this all inclusive will make you feel like royalty. I had the pleasure of meeting Kerlyn who is in charge of guest services he’s a great guy. I also had the pleasure of meeting Annabel who is very nice and had the privilege of meeting their great manager Janet . Again there’s not enough kind words I can say about this lovely resort and staff everybody is so friendly and the place is top-notch from start to finish. Book your trip now it’s something you won’t regret one thing I should let you know is  the seaweed season is from May to November so if you want prettier beaches go when it’s not seaweed season. make sure you stay at this lovely resort you will not regret it.

reviews.author: oshea1018
reviews.title: Great Week at a Great Resort
reviews.text: My wife and I had a great week at the Paradisus. Weather was great and Martin & Luis did a great job making us feel like royalty at the Royal Service pool. The highlight of the week was our butler Nicholas. We have been to Paradisus resorts 8 times and he was the best so far. I would strongly recommend him to any future guests.

reviews.author: Escape742662
reviews.title: Baecation
reviews.text: Re: Everything exceeded my expectations. Reserve at Paradisus is the only resort I'll ever stay at in D.R. Everyone there was hospitable. They really made you feel rich and important. It was all inclusive and I enjoyed every single minute of the trip. They cared about your well being and safety. I hate that the pool closes so early though. It should close at 9 and not 7. Either way, I loved my stay. The Paradisus Suite was amazing.

reviews.author: smira2018
reviews.title: Punta cana
reviews.text: Punta cana trip : hotel was nice but it was lacking in service for the the restaurants. The staff for food and beverage need to be trained better. Checkin and front desk and management were good and professional

reviews.author: Odyssey600603
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio
reviews.text: Recibimos un servicio excelente de Fidel en el restaurant Misu. Agradable, atento y con formidables atenciones al cliente. Fuimos un grupo de 10 personas y aun cuando nos retrasamos se acuerdo a la hora de la reserva para cenar, el trato de Fidel fue cordial y receptivo. Excelente experiencia

reviews.author: Juan Manuel G
reviews.title: Buen trato
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en este hotel la última desde finales de agosto hasta el 6 de setiembre, unos 9 días. La impresión general y la experiencia han sido positivas y realmente salvo que nadie nos informó acerca de las posibilidades de uso del crédito de 900 dólares que nos habían dicho en la central de reservas que teníamos, y de algunas deficiencias en cuanto a la reposición de toallas en la habitación, que se produjeron en 3 de las nueve noches, todo lo demás ha sido bueno. Merece especial mención la paciencia y buena atención del personal del servicio de atención al cliente, personas como Carolina, Antonio, Jimmy y Domingo, son capaces de sacarte de apuros y echarte una mano, en especial Domingo que parece que esté en todas partes y pueda proyectar su actividad sobre las cosas más diversas.
En cuanto a comida, nada que decir, aunque algunos restaurantes estaban cerrados, supongo que por la temporada, no tuvimos problemas con eso dado el número y variedad de sitios disponibles, además contando con Martín, otra de las personas que parece que lo dirija todo, que nos preparó un agradable cena en el bar de tapas de Berasategui, en el que pueden servirte lo que desees que te preparen en alguno de los restaurantes (sin cargo adicional salvo la langosta que, por cierto, era de buen tamaño y de un precio razonable). El sumiller de este sitio sabe lo que se trae entre manos y aunque los vinos tienen unos precios excesivos para nosotros, al estar acostumbrados a la cultura del vino y ser más accesible en España, es una persona que sabe encontrarte lo que más te convenga.
El servicio de transporte, recogida de equipajes, etc., está bien atendido y con la amabilidad característica del personal, en especial Dominga.
Los buffets son variados y buenos, aunque no siempre la carne y el pescado los hacen al momento, si bien te atienden si quieres algo al punto que más te guste y te lo preparan sobre la marcha.
El tema de la algas en la playa es algo que afecta a todos los hoteles que dan a ella y que es simple producto del mar, hacen lo que pueden y de hecho todos los días las recogen con una máquina para que no haya demasiada cantidad.
La piscina bien, aunque a veces la utilizan, al menos en parte, para eventos variados.
En todo caso, la estancia fue satisfactoria.

reviews.author: Antonio M
reviews.title: Paradissus 5 day stay aug /2018
reviews.text: Royal services inefficient ,frustating, misleading and deceiving.Advertised as 5 stars resort is far from it.Food quality and choices substandard for 5 stars; getting reservations for the restaurants a challenge,drinks included only three beers budweisser,corona and stella,no Presidente in bottle,only one scotch,included wine undrinkable, we booked 12 rooms ; two rooms tv didnt work ,one room sofa bed broken and water leakage in shower light ;one room safe broken ty and had to complaint twice about music from discotheque being to loud at 3am;one room had to call security twice for loud noise.The one thousand credit for use in the resort is worthless , a gimmick to make you use paid services.

reviews.author: deimutta23
reviews.title: A bit less than what you‘d expect
reviews.text: Best part of this place is the well kept gardens. Make sure to book „Family Concierge“! Food could offer more variety at all meals (you‘ll get bored if you stay more than a week). Shows at night are quite nice.

reviews.author: Marcootz
reviews.title: Absolutely Trash, Do Not Recommend
reviews.text: This place is trash, DO NOT believe all those 5 star reviews,  I have been to Dominican and surrounding countries many, many times before, and have never experienced a resort like this before.  In short the Paradisus Punta Cana is extremely overpriced provides horrible service and garbage quality/selection of food.  Specifically this whole resort is setup to hustle you out of every dollar, everything is extremely overpriced here, the staff are very unfriendly, miserable or just rude to you, buffet food is all just recycled crap day after day after day with no variety, restaurants are even worse, the excursions are extremely overpriced and just horrible experiences (broken equipment or lie about amt of time or what/where they take you).  The room was older but tolerable however they didn't get that right until the third try, so about the only thing i actually did like were the aesthetics/layout of the place but the experience was so bad it completely takes away from that.  I don't like to complain, but the way we were treated and experience I had over the course of the week there it has to be said, even if i turn 1 person away from this place I've done my part.  If your dead set on going to Dominican try the Hard rock, i have stayed there before and it was much better, otherwise go to Mexico and save yourself the disappointment

reviews.author: ktkhyati88
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: Me and my husband had a great stay at the reserve parsdisus in Feb this year. It was our first year wedding anniversary and  Mellisa Rodriguez our concierge had organized an amazing surprise for us and made it memorable for us. They had 24 hr room service available as well. Had good food. Great seatings by the beach. Clean rooms. Would highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Al M
reviews.title: Royal Service Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
This was our second trip but first in the Royal Service and was WELL worth it.  From our butler Ariel, the royal service bartender Wanda, the pool concierge Martin, and the waiter at Pallazio Gustavo, they really make this a trip to remember.  We will definitely return and will always book royal service in the future.  

Lastly, my wife’s birthday was one day and they REALLY made a special night for her.  From a birthday cake to setting up the room very special with Flowers, Champagne, chocolate cover strawberries, to a special message in the hot tub!!!

Thank you too all who made this trip excellent.

reviews.author: Ali T
reviews.title: Resort is nice but Service  and food was terrible
reviews.text:
Booking directly from their website was a nightmare. They offer ‘discounts’ and promo codes that really end up being the exact same price as from any other provider or travel agent. They show the price in CAD but charge in USD so you end up paying more. When I called the call centre to ask why i was charged in usd they said it would have been cheaper to call in the reservation and to start a ticket with customer service. 5 days now and no reply. 

Check in was a nightmare. They asked for my credit card that I booked with. I didn’t have it. Rather than finding a solution they kept stating their policy. I offered to pay with a another card and they got so excited but wanted my first purchase refunded before I didn’t that and Said that would take a week and done by head office. 
I had upgraded to royal service but it was anything but at check in. In fact I was treated as peasant and a thief at check in. 
And the room wasn’t ready for 1 hour. Seems like that’s the norm they clean the room when you check in not prior. 

Room was ok, it was clean. No views. 
There are no elevators for anyone that has problems with stairs. 

Food was substandard. Cold and dry. Making reservations was difficult and restaurant hosts don’t make you feel welcomes nor are they helpful. Twice they made us feel uncomfortable or rushed us. Once they asked to go to the bar and wait for 10-15 mins and we ordered drinks and before the drinks arrived they said the table was ready. Once time the host kept looking at her watch when we were greeting friends at the door of the restaurant. Very unprofessional. 
The steakhouse rare was a disappointment. We were willing to pay the extra $75 for the tomahawk steak but asked to see the cut prior to ordering and they pretended not to understand English then after 5 mins they said they don’t have anymore. The best item on the Menu was the mushrooms. Each steak was a different temperature and cooked differently. 

Pallazzo is a nice peaceful place to eat for Royal service guests but again we arrived for breakfast and they said there is only 15 mins left to eat. They stood their while we looked at the menu in order to rush us. Food was substandard. 

Many of the service staff don’t speak English and you feel that they don’t want to be there or serve you. I’m always one to tip but I don’t feel they appreciate it. Asking for  bottled of water makes one feel like it’s a crime. One bartender hid the Johnnie walker black label even though for Royal service it’s included. 

The wedding venue was incredible. The decor and ambiance was superb. Beautiful backdrop with the pool on one side and ocean on the other. Service was good, bartenders super nice and never left your glass empty. Food was buffet and cold. Some of the stations didn’t have heat lamps or flames turned on. 

Overall the resort is nice. They public areas are renovated and updated. The rooms have the old decor. The beach has nice sand and plenty of space for tons of chairs and day beds. The water was murky and filled with seaweed. You cannot see the ocean bottom. 

Service needs upgrading. The ocean needs treatment so it can be used. It has potential to be a fantastic resort with some work.

reviews.author: Frank J
reviews.title: Paradisus palma real crap
reviews.text:
Arrived on Sept 6. Waited an hour for check in, and got to room was a mess waited another 2 hours for them to clean the room. Went to restaurants waited an hour just to be served. The service was horrible in the buffet looked like they didn't even want to be there. One chef was always angry with guest. The beach was never cleaned of the sea weed on it, yet all the resorts we cleaned. Not enough staff to cater to everyone. Yet one bartender "Fernando" and always had a smile on his face and took care of all 95 of us. We thank you Fernando at the walk up pool bar.

I would never come to this resort ever again.

reviews.author: Darice D
reviews.title: Guest Relations
reviews.text:
Wander Roa was one individual who helped to make our stay at the Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve Resort  a very enjoyable,warm, and friendly experience. Throughout our seven day stay he was always willing and able to satisfy our needs. It was not only evident that Wander worked hard to meet my daughter's and my needs at the resort but, he treated all vacationers in the same manner with the same willingness, warmth and zealousness 
He never complained and was always accommodating! :)

Also, I was  very pleased that he remembered my daughter's 15th birthday during our stay at the resort!  He sang Happy Birthday when my daughter and I first approached the pool area in the "Reserve" I was touched because this small act demonstrated how he came to know us during our stay there .

I can not say enough great things about Wander Roa except that he played a big role in making my daughter and my vacation a very pleasant and memorable one!!!:)

reviews.author: anushabala
reviews.title: Fantastic First All Inclusive Experience
reviews.text: First all-inclusive trip and my experience was wonderful.  Staff at the resort was amazing, I can’t say enough about how wonderful they truly are; friendly, attentive and accommodating.  Food was delicious, fresh, flavorful and as a lacto-vegetarian I had tons of options.  Moreover, resort was clean and well kept.  Would highly recommend the resort.  Best part, they served real Nutella 😉

reviews.author: Whitney D
reviews.title: My bartenders where Freakin Amazing
reviews.text: From the time I touched the resort my hands were never empty! Found 3 great bartenders Lillian, Luis, Jacinto bomb.com. Thanks for being great, all I can say is mamajuana gets you to the next level of being drunk.... you won’t reme how you got to your room lol.

reviews.author: Cecilia S
reviews.title: RESTAURANTE OLIO, malo malo
reviews.text:
Hoy cenamos en el restaurante  Olió, primera vez que cenamos acá y lamentablemente debo decir que fue todo malo. 
La reserva la teníamos a las 20:30, nos hicieron pasar a la mesa a las 21 hrs. Nadie nos indicó que la entrada era buffet y debíamos ir por ella, nos trajeron nuestros platos a las 21:40, fueron 4 platos y todos regular a malo. 
Mi pato en particular milanesa con una ensalada de hojas verdes y no se que mas... Bueno la milanesa regular y venia 1 hoja de lechuga sin aliño. 
A los demás acompañantes que habían pedidos pastas les ofrecieron queso parmesano cuando estaban terminando sus platos. 
La verdad todo muy mal!!! Para no volver.

reviews.author: Les S
reviews.title: Things I wish I knew
reviews.text:
Overall, we had a really nice weekend. I only give
4 stars when they earn it - this resort did. I will
start off with the good, then get into specific tips
for those who are visiting

Good - Family Concierge was a great value. Our guy (Omar)
was friendly and on top of his game - did everything we needed
and did it well. The coolest part is every day we had a cabana
reserved (Most places you pay $200+/day - this is included). 
It was awesome having a place for our stuff .. plus
my wife doesn't like getting too much sun. The resort was
in good condition. The staff at kids camp was great. Overall,
the staff were fun and accommodating

Tips (as their website is a bit soft on details): 
1 - arrival - Getting off the plane, if you have not reserved transportation
it's a bit overwhelming. People are grabbing your bags, trying to get you
into their taxi. Tip - strike the 1st fair deal. $35 US is the normal price each way,
we paid $40 (as we were a group of 6). For that, make sure you get
a nice vehicle with good air conditioning.  Be sure they know you are
going to THE RESERVE ... as there are several Paradisus. Most of
the guys cutting the deals speak English... The ride is about 20 minutes

2. Bring US $$. No need to exchange, everyone takes dollars. Bring
plenty of singles and fives for tips. There is an ATM at the hotel, but
you'll get larger Peso bills. 50 peso = $1 ... The smallest I saw was 200 peso
($4).. this is excessive for most tips, so just plan ahead and bring dollars.
Make sure you have the dollars on hand for ride to/from airport

3. Tipping - I don't know if we did it right, but here is what we did.
For our concierge, we gave him $20/day. This may have been excessive,
probably $10/day would have been fine - but he really did a great job
and we were two rooms. When someone went out of their way
(the guy at the beach cabana got my wife a decent bottle of tequila) - 
I would give them a $10. Great service at dinner = $10. AVG service,
I did not tip. Rarely tipped at the buffet. The guy
at the snack shop, I gave him $10 for the week. Other than that, $1-$2
for the bartenders. Again, I may have been a bit excessive, but I
was happy to give for those making a good vacation .. and keep in
mind in the DR, the staff is paid a fraction of American minimum wage. 

3. Food - make ALL your reservations early. This is where I needed to
take a bit more control. We didn't get into all the restaurants we wanted,
as Omar was only booking us 1 night at a time. The Steak, Hibachi and
Latin Fusion/Sushi are the 3 toughest reservations. The Steak place (the Grill)
was closed on Saturday. So start off by asking what nights the restaurants
you want is closed, then make your reservations for your entire stay

4. Time for reservations. Each night, there is an activity. The shows are not
bad - an acrobat, a dancing drum show. Saturday night there is a beach party
(no show, no food - just drinking on the beach) ... When you checkin, they
will give you the schedule for the week. If you want to see a show, plan
your dinner reservations accordingly. Most shows start at 8.30

5. The buffet is ok, but it gets repetitive. definitely make dinner reservations
every night. Yes - there are up-cost for order some things in most restaurants,
and 1 restaurant is a pay-restaurant. We were only there for a long weekend,
and the free restaurants were fine and I had no need to order the pay-items

6. Vento - HORRIBLE. Incredibly slow. When we couldn't get into the
Grill, we agreed to go here. Bad choice - Omar recommended we should
go with Fuego(Latin Fusion/Sushi) for a 2nd night - I should have listened
to him. If you go to Vento, plan on it taking up your whole night. The food
was pretty good. My wife had really good steak - I would recommend that
if you go. It's just the hostess and waiters that are slow and not interested
in the guest

7. Checkout. They do NOT give you a GUEST FOLIO under your door. 
AND they will not let you leave until you checkout. (I didn't realize,
but my wife ordered a couple top-shelf shots) ... Wish I knew, now you
know. Even if you don't owe anything, go to checkout and get a pass
or they won't let you leave

8. Drinks - most of the drinks are ok. If you have a special favorite
(my wife likes tequila, 1800 or Don Julio or better) ... bring a bottle
with you. They do sell some top-shelf (like Absolute) in the gift shop,
but tequila isn't among it. If I brought a $30 bottle with us, it would
have made the trip a little better. Normal Caribbean mixed drinks are
in plenty supply and taste good. The beer is local, but very not bad.

9. Decide to have a good time. Know if you ask for something
that is a outside the norm, it will be difficult and take them time.
(I paid $200 for my daughter's birthday party, which was nice. It took
3 people and an hour to be able to charge my credit card. ) Just expect
that. If you get to the buffet near closing time, one person will tell you to sit 
somewhere, then someone will tell you that area is closed. Don't let it 
bother you - accept it as the way it is, and don't let small things
(that you are now prepared for) to ruin even a little part of your vacation. 

10. Sorry to end on a bad note, but be aware that the $1000 credit
is a scam. OK, first off, it's a coupon book with discounts off the spa,
casino and their pay restaurant. I can't tell you exacts, because
only the time share person can give it to you. I tried to get it twice
(they don't just give it to you on checkin) - both times they were
not available (and I was not going to waste my good vacation time
on chasing this). I'm not sure what the coupons were for specifically ..
if we were there for a full week, I would have chased it harder. It's
a shame for the hotel - maybe they could have incentivised me
to take them up on some of their offers. I did some research on their time share - 
seemed like the CIRCLE is not a great deal  - but better than ....

Bonus - sitting at the beach, you will get offered all kinds of stuff.
They can't come to your cabana unless you invite them ... kinda like
Dracula. We were suckered into a pitch "do you want to see the
new hotel next door? 20 minutes, and you can have lunch." We were
tired of our buffet, so they got us. It was pretty much a kidnapping,
bringing us to their time share presentation. It's called Royal Holiday.
Quick talking - mostly selling you on the idea of vacation =good ... but
they are loose with the details. When I searched their name, they
are all over ripoff report. The sales person said they were associated
with the cruise line = lie. If he was speaking, he was not telling the truth.
After 20 minutes, I pushed our way out - 
the guy who kidnapped us was gone, no free lunch. They actually
have nothing to do with the resort. If they ask you to take a ride,
JUST SAY NO

OK, so that's everything. Hope it helps. Send me a question if you want.
If this was helpful, click the thumbs up.

Les & Yulie ...

PS - I just realized - I didn't say anything about the layout. This resort is
not on the beach. You have to take a stretch golf cart. They run every
15 minutes or so ... wasn't a problem for us. I wish I had a map, but
it worked out

PPS - one last - there is an umbrella in your closet. Bring it with you at
night. You'll be glad you did, at least half the time

reviews.author: nesha w
reviews.title: Best holiday ever
reviews.text:
We arrived on the 22nd August 2018 and upgraded to the family concierge . Augustine was our concierge and was amazing , he organised all our trips and dinner reservations, he was so helpful and nothing was to much trouble , if we come back next year we will request him again . 
The food was amazing and in particular we loved  MIZU the Teppanyaki restaurant ( we went twice ) the steak house was also particularly good . Dominic was always on hand at breakfast time and very helpful and attentive . Angel in Aqua restaurant was one of the friendliest servers and had our next drink waiting , he is also very good with children. All the staff were amazing , very friendly and very attentive . The hotel itself is immaculately clean and our room was cleaned to a high standard . There are so many spots to pick on where to sit for the day . Bavaro is one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen ( apart from the seaweed which can’t be helped ) we went to murcao beach for te day and it was stunning . Overall one of the best holidays we have ever had , we want to come back in 2019 !!

reviews.author: OxC
reviews.title: Оценка 0
reviews.text:
Отдыхали с семьей в прошлом октябре. Из плюсов: хорошая уборка и игровая для детей. Дальше одни минусы:

- сам резерв не стоит своих денег: старые номера, далеко от пляжа, еда в буфете такая же как и в обычном.

- русскоговорящая сотрудница Виолетта сказала члену нашей семьи сколько дать на чай бэлбою (ее слова « дай на чай папу долларов») Во-первых в ее указаниях никто не нуждался, а во вторых, это уровень хостела, а не пятерки. А также при разговоре, с другими русскими туристами, выяснилось, что Виолетта не всем объясняла как забронировать рестораны которые входят в стоимость, но необходим резерв. 

- пляж был с огроменный кучами водорослей, которые никто не чистил вообще.

- Кульминацией был разговор с замом генерального мэнеджера по-поводу дрели во время обеда в буфете резерва. Женщина вела себя непрофессионально, не могла толком объяснить почему нельзя остановить ремонтные работы во время обеда. Абсолютно неадекватное поведение, которое не соответствует занимаемой должности.

Ко всему прочему хочу добавить, что сами цены на резерв меняются часто при это на сайте указывается что «осталось 2 номера» и т. д. Мы забронировали номера за несколько месяцев по спец цене и наличие номеров было лимитировано. Через какое-то время эти же номера стоили в 3 раза дешевле и тоже с надписью «спец предложение, осталось 2 номера». 
Менеджеры отеля пытались откровенно втюхать какие-то программы мелиии. 
Как резюме: непрофессионая работа менеджмента, непонятная система ценника на номер.

reviews.author: Krystal E
reviews.title: The wedding of my dreams
reviews.text: To all the brides out there trying to figure out which destination resort to choose, look no further! Not only did the Paradisus Palma Real give me a wedding beyond my imagination, it gave my group of family and friends a much needed getaway from reality! Everyone loved the resort- from the phenomenal food and drinks (especially Edison’s basil vodka smash) to the beautiful pools and jetted tubs in all the rooms. The romance department made dinner reservations for the group a breeze and for those who wanted a romantic dinner for 2 that was an option too. The wedding planning was super easy (which was exactly the reason I chose a destination wedding). Mariangel kept me on track with everything and made the wedding day seemless. On the day of the wedding the ladies at the salon made us feel like queens. I’ve never felt more beautiful in my entire life! Oh and I can’t say enough about the wedding CAKE! The vanilla cake with strawberry filling was honestly the best cake I’ve ever had in my entire life! Lastly, but most importantly: the photography!! NoviaMia photography exceeded all our expectations! We chose the gold package with 2 photographers and had a sneak peek of photos within HOURS of the wedding! I can’t wait to see the rest. I’m confident they were able to capture every part of our special day. We honestly couldn’t be happier with our wedding and overall stay at Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Vladily H
reviews.title: Hermoso lugar
reviews.text: Definitivamente es un lugar esta muy elegante las personas son súper simpáticas , muestran mucha empatía con sus clientes  , me encanta de verda muy buena atención y servicio Raynol Tamayo es una de las personas que hizo que nuestra estadía fuera una maravilla gracias gracias a los chicos de bares súper atento la comida muy buena sin duda regreso a este hermoso lugar🌴

reviews.author: Géneh H
reviews.title: Magnífico lugar
reviews.text: El hotel es muy bonito las personas son muy amable este es mi primeras vacaciones en este lugar y pensamos venir, la playa no está la mejor pero se entiende por el clima pero es un lugar agradable la comida es muy buena nuestro restaurante favorito es el grill por el tipo de langosta y churrasco muy bueno, el personal de actividades, barrender son súper incluyendo los demás gracias Raynol Tamayo por ser amable y brindaron alegria y buena estancia gracias Oscar Santana y francisco mateo, antinio j Rodríguez son muy amables gracias chicos nos vemos el próximo año

reviews.author: Martha C
reviews.title: Family concierge
reviews.text: Disfrutamos mucho nuestra visita, excelentes atenciones de nuestra Family Concierge Sandra, quien nos atendió esmeradamente cubriendonos de atenciones sobre todo a los niños, todo de una calidad inigualable, todos nos atendieron muy amablemente.... volveremos!!!!

reviews.author: Jodi P
reviews.title: Beautiful, epitome of hospitality!
reviews.text:
The property is very well kept and very beautiful.  The staff is amazing - very professional, courteous, and service minded.
A previous review mentioned the rooms are "like a box of chocolates, you never know what you're going to get" - and I think that is the most accurate description possible. They are in various stages of remodels, so although the same layout exists in each room, you might have slightly different furnishings or a small maintenance issue.  Regardless, any issue you face will quickly be rectified by the EXTREMELY friendly and courteous staff!  We had a few minor issues that were all immediately taken care of.  
The maid service was great, turndown service was great - but little touches were different with the different staff members each day.
We had a very large group that was well taken care of by Alain and Suleyka and many others.  Luis, Nixon, Emely and many more were wonderful!
The only slightly disappointing facet of our stay was the food.  It was average fare for an all-inclusive, and the dining hours were off - no snack bar, coffee bar or anything like that to grab a quick bite during hours the buffet was closed.  There was always at least one restaurant open, but sometimes you just need a pastry and coffee, or a bag of chips!
Overall, it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Jjslavin88
reviews.title: Great place to vacation
reviews.text: Spent a week here with my girlfriend and it was everything I had hoped it would be. The royal service was absolutely worth it. Our butler Matiel took great care of us all week and always checked in with us to see if we needed anything. The resort is beautiful, and very well kept. The staff is very accommodating and polite. The Mediterranean and Hibachi restaurants were our favorites for dinner, and the Mexican restaurant was a great spot for lunch. Also have to give a shout out to La Palapa, the salmon they serve at dinner might be the best I have ever had. I would love to return one day and will recommend the Paradisus to others.

reviews.author: Silvia A
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real (Melia) - Vacaciones familiares
reviews.text: Han sido unas vacaciones inolvidables, las instalaciones de en sueño y el personal de lo más amable. Nos gustaría destacar a Fernando Gonzalez (beach concierge) y Obeidy Rodriguez por un trato tan excepcional, desde luego hicieron que nuestras vacaciones fueran agradables y de lo más divertidas. Ravel Maldonado, Junior, Cleudy (Abenue Bar) & Yasenia Farías también fueron muy atentos en todo momento. ¡Hasta las próximas vacaciones!

reviews.author: cece
reviews.title: Professional Relaxation at Paradisus
reviews.text: First I want to say the resort is beautiful and if you have the Royal Service, you are truly treated like royalty. My personal butler Carlos Hinostroza was amazing, he made sure that all our accommodations and expections were met day and night, from breakfast to dinner reservations, transportation off the resort, pool service and even to check out. Carlos truly made my vacation memorable and beyond my expectations!!!’

reviews.author: Chantalsdolls
reviews.title: Paradise at the RESERVE  in Paradisus-Melia
reviews.text:
WOW!!!!!! Incredible VACATION!!!!! Luxury at it's finest!!!! 
We spent the best week of our lives here!!!! And it has absolutely gone too fast! 
We have had the most beautiful, fun, and relaxing experience ever with FIRST CLASS IMENITIES!!! However, what has made this vacation even more perfect was of course being with our best friends...and the people who have made it so perfect including Manuel Torres, in Aqua and in Mizu, treating us like royalty every single visit to his restaurants, and Eudy at the bar along with Anabelis, Friman, and Yerry. All were so courteous and professional and always smiling and so perfect!!! Thank you all for a wonderful and unforgettable memory!!!  Also, Manual Santana that drove us on the golf cart was awesome and so were Orlando and Heddi in the Reserve downstairs at our room. We had the absolute time of our lives!!!!!!

reviews.author: addieshort
reviews.title: Professional Relaxation Getaway with the family
reviews.text: We had a great time.  Even though we were at an event for adults, we were happily surprised that they had activities for kids, so our son did not need to be around all of the adults unless we wanted him to be.  The beach and beach activities were very accessible.  A special thanks to Nixon who informed us of the circus.  My son really enjoyed seeing that.  Room service was good, but we could not keep enough towels around to keep the floors dry - very humid and it rained a lot.

reviews.author: Sarmo
reviews.title: Eight visit , still great , But......
reviews.text:
this is our 8th visit and had a great time with some of our friend. this resort is still growing , every time we are there they are doing some improvement . having said that this also cause some dilemma!! So here we go with the review 

check in was okay  since they were working on the entrance, it was done at lower level ,  bell staff although they see you they just walk around as if you are invisible. after we told them we are Royal Service  we became visible. the check in was great  our butler ALBERTO  was AMAZING , and made sure  we are taking care of,  bottle of Champagne in the room  with fruits, hot tub with rose pedals, cheese tray , Cabana around the pool  with restaurant reservation and  also include to cover for the short come of other people and department .  main issue was with the newly renovated rooms  which the TV and safe   was   not working and remote control had a mind of its own ( who ever programed it, did not read the instruction ) and took a  day to get fixed. wash sink splashed water all over the place when you turned it on !!! and few other issues that seemed no one did checked to make sure  they are in a working condition.  luggage  came very late and when they came the  check in tags that bell staff put in when they arrived  it seemed to be a nightmare to get that glue and sticky papers off !!! very annoying , poor Alberto has to come in with steamer and  scrub it for 30 min or so. 
Rooms--- rooms were clean  with exception of the mentioned problems. there was also no continuity either , one night turn down , one night not  may be towels may be not , and please don't ask if there are two person In the room , for two wash towel , you only get one !!!!
 restaurants:
the Palazzo restaurant ---  diner there twice service was great food was amazing . Jean Carlos and Jose were great 
Rare restaurant --- very poor service and for the steakhouse the ribeye (5-7  person in our party ordered ) was like chewing on the rubber no taste ,  So glad there was a nice buffet next door to go to !!:(
venti --- great food and service specially after the night before at Rare , Danny was great, great food service etc.
Nao--  breakfast and lunch buffet was great love the variety , and quality of the food as well as presentation . Staff , Davidson, Juan,  Maria  and many more were great and accommodating .
