 staff at the royal club designated pool were great luis, gerinaldo, lee  made sure we are well taken care of . Please note there are only 7 cabanas around the pool  so don't expect just because you are in royal services you can get one every day !! please  share 
spa--- was great ( at preserve) 
the only other annoying thing was a presence of a loud group (total relaxation )   which  took over the pools and had an obnoxious loud music for many hours and it was so annoying 
Entertainment ---- usually they used to have some themed shows which they did not have it while we were there. but the entertainment group did a nice job at night  at Gabi beach bar area .

reviews.author: Passport166451
reviews.title: Personal de animación y de la piscina de Royal service excelente
reviews.text:
Estuve Alojada con 4 amigas y el personal que nos atendía en el bar de la piscina del Royal service fue excelente. Un trato super amable, alegres y siempre pendientes de lo que necesitábamos. Muchas gracias a Luisito y Pedrito!! 
El personal de animación del hotel, super divertido. Gracias a los chicos que nos hicieron bailar en las noches!! El jefe de este servicio super amable y los otros chicos también!

reviews.author: Chantalsdolls
reviews.title: I Had The Time of My life!!!!
reviews.text: This is absolutely the best resort we have ever visited! It has been  a week of constant fun, enjoyment, music, laughter and quite honestly the best resort ever!!! Nixon, Boni, Luis Bautista Rafael (wachi) Raphael, Alexandro, Dark Chocolate, Friman in Aqua and Manuel have made it the best time ever! We will absolutely be returning next year!!! So much to do here! The Michael Jackson show and Queen concert were amazing! Took a catamaran to the private island, snorkeled, and really enjoyed this amazing trip! The restaurants are first class and 5 start dining and the service is without a doubt the best and most respectful! Book your trip today! You will thank me! Wow! What a place! LOVE IT!!!!

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: The Cat in the Hat
reviews.text: The front desk staff were professional to a degree. Some were very pushy and didn't seem to understand that folks would split their room bill and spa services. There was a mildew smell on alot of the pillows in the rooms on the couches and on the bed. Emil in the bar between Rare and the Hibatchi restaurant had a great personality and was an excellent bartender. Davidson was a great waiter and was very attentive during my breakfast at the buffet spot. It took a long while for someone to address one of my friends issue with her room due to the moldy/sewage smell that hit you once you hit the door. There was a random cat that walked the halls of the facility while I was there. Aqua restaurant was awesome.

reviews.author: Shakinta J
reviews.title: A wonderful vacation (long one)
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently returned from a 9 day, 8 night vacation to this resort with my sister and brother in law, and their spouses. (3 rooms total).  It was a great couples' vacation.  A bit of background.  This is our (husband and I) third trip to Punta Cana.  We've stayed at the Hard Rock, the Paradisus Palma Real, and now Paradisus Punta Cana.

1.  Check in.  We knew from experience that not all the rooms would be ready when we arrived.  No big deal.  We were all greeted warmly and presented with their Welcome Drink, which was very good.  One of the rooms was ready within ten minutes of our arrival.  The other two were getting turned.  Since our rooms were side by side, we simply took a cart with the luggage to the one room intending to transfer the luggage to the remaining rooms after they were finished turning the others over.  We didn't have to worry with that because upon our arrival, all rooms were done.  

2.  Rooms.  We purchased the Luxury Junior Suite.  The room looked as it did on the website.  They were ALL clean rooms.  Bed was VERY comfortable.  The air conditioning was wonderful.  We had no complaints.  Bottled water was available along with beverages in the mini fridge. 

3.  Food.  I enjoyed the food.  It was yummy and plentiful, but the variety was a bit limited in the buffet areas.  Reservations were a bit time consuming to navigate initially.  That being said...it was still yummy.  My favorite restaurant was Mole (Mexican) for the chicken fajitas, fried cheese (I'm a cheese girl), and the tres leches. I also REALLY enjoyed the Winery and the customer service was outstanding. Just read below.

4.  Staff.  Everyone was wonderful and very kind.  Special thanks and shout outs to Claritzel Otanez and Griselda for tag teaming our group for concierge.  They were awesome.  Claritizel made sure to accommodate one of my brother in love's love of "steak and lobster" and he was very grateful and appreciative.  Griselda was able to help modify reservation times so we would be able to attend some of the shows. 
Thanks to Anneurys, our great time share guide, who had us laughing and showed us a great time even though we were already time shared up and weren't interested in purchasing again.  Not forceful.  Very polite and a wonderful gentleman.

Also, a HUGE shout out to the staff in the Winery.  One of our party asked if the cold lobster on the cold bar could be grilled.  He expected it couldn't, but didn't think it would hurt to ask.  Our server went and talked to the cook and came back with a beautiful plate of grilled lobster that had our relative grinning from ear to ear.  On the same evening, his wife asked if there was cocktail sauce for a seafood item.  There wasn't.  She was fine with that, but the server went above and beyond to go back to the cook  and ask if there was sauce.  When the chef confirmed there wasn't any, he MADE cocktail sauce Dominican style for her.  They didn't have to do that and it was highly appreciated!

5.  Resort.  Loved it.  The layout was convenient to our building location.  The beach was less than a two minute walk from our doorsteps.  We were near the restaurants and about a five minute walk to the pool.  We enjoyed the free activities available to us including the water aerobics, painting on the beach, dance lessons, foam party, and so much more.  Know if you are on the The Reserve side, you'll probably appreciate a tram to get to the Gabi Beach side.  The walk isn't that bad, but the humidity can make it a bit uncomfortable if you're affected by such things.

6.  Entertainment.  The shows were nice.  We really enjoyed the Micheal Jackson show and the way the dancers engaged with the audience.  My sister and brother in love spoke well of the Lion King also.  We missed the Dominican experience and Cirque because of a conflicting reservation, but saw some of the artistry's talent in the lobby later that evening.  Beautiful and I recommend you go.  Shows are at 8:30 p.m.

The entertainment staff at the pools and on the beaches were also fun.  My husband joined in volleyball, water cycling, and Aqua Zumba, while I loved the foam party and dancing on the beach.    

The beach itself seemed to have something going on most evenings, and though it ended a bit early, that was perfect for my nightly beach strolls and visit to the beach or resort bar.

7.  Beach.  The beach was lovely.  Water was blue.  Sand was clean and clear.  Yes, there was seaweed, as with every resort along the shore.  But Paradisus Punta Cana did a good job of removing it.  We watched the removal using the machines in the morning and it was a quick and efficient job they did.  There was never a problem finding a shady spot, even for a group of 4-6 to lounge together.  You could order a drink there, but it's quicker to get your own and bring with you.  We didn't mind and preferred to lounge or play as we desired.

8.  Spa.  My husband and I booked a massage using credits received when we booked.  The credits allowed a discount of spa services and we selected the 50 minutes deep tissue massage in a couples' room.  The massage was really nice.  I was wonderfully relaxed.  The masseuses were very talented.  I recommended them to others in our group and they went later in the week.  All said the same.  Thank you to Rosa and Maria very, very much.

The other stuff.  

Mosquitoes.  They are still horrible.  HORRIBLE.  I didn't have the problem at Hard Rock, but both Paradisus resorts found me besieged by them.  I did bring travel cans of Off this time and that helped.  I told my SIL about Sawyer's and that helped more.  I came back with quite a few bites and with Zika concerns being so prevalent, I'll be getting tested just as a precaution.  And to someone who thinks I'm exaggerating.  While I was getting a massage, one was under the hole in the massage table.  It landed on my lip and I couldn't do anything about it at all because my hands were by my side.  It had free range to bite at will before a towel was moved to prevent access.  Did I mention I'm allergic?My husband joked at the huge bump for a while lol.

Excursions.  Everyone in the group had great excursion opportunities.  The brothers and sisters in law went on a ATV ride.  One set went parasailing.  Several of us went to the Seaquarium for walking on the ocean floor and snorkeling.  There are plenty of opportunities for excursions.  Talk to your concierge for assistance, but don't be afraid to scout some other deals.  

Reservations.  This resort requires reservations to the restaurants.  Make them sooner than later with your concierge and have an idea of what you want to try.  We were there 8 days and I still missed out on a restaurant I really wanted to try. 

Gratuity.  While it is not required, please do so.  The staff go above and beyond and we really didn't mind showing our appreciation for their service.  From the cocktail sauce episode to creating a special drink when I was a bit down, they were all awesome and none in our group minded thanking them through gratuity.

Overall, it was a great trip and I would have no problem coming back.   I definitely recommend.

reviews.author: virginie OFTHEDOOR
reviews.title: Le luxe à Punta cana
reviews.text: Cet hôtel est gigantesque !!!! patio géant, piscine géante, restaurants nombreux et splendides. la plage est très entretenues. les chambres sont grandes avec possibilité de communicantes pour les familles nombreuses.

reviews.author: Felicia C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real w/butler Juan Carlos
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my stay here. I was here with a large travel group. The staff was fairly attentive. The property is gorgeous. 

Food was really good at Rare and Olio. Speaking of Rare, I want to give our server Abraham a shout out. He was very accommodating. Although I had Royal Service, I’d say skip Palazzo. The buffet was better. Sorry. It was. Jean Carlos was an excellent server. The other place to skip is Mizu. Not much of a show. Food was okay. If you’ve been to any basic Japanese hibachi type restaurant in the US you get a show. Stick with that. And the good stuff didn’t come back out to the buffet until the group left. 

Yes, there was the seaweed on the beach issue. I didn’t spend a lot of time there anyway. However, this resort wasn’t slick! They didn’t clean up the beach until after our group left. Not cool. Not everyone left on Monday please understand that.

Had a blast at the swim up bar. Gustavo, Lee, Mario and Jonathan took really good care of us each day. 

Last and certainly not least my butler Juan Carlos! Mi persona favorita en Palmas Real. He took really good care of me. He was prompt in responding to any question, concern or request. Even watching him interact with others in my travel group he was patient and was happy to help.  I enjoyed the treats he left on my room. Whatever I needed he handled it from cabana bed to restaurant reservations to drawing brand to lavender scented pillows. Also, Juan Carlos took the time to check in with me not just through What’s App but made a point to talk with me face to face. I read lots of good things about him in trip advisor and was excited to find out he would be my butler. All of it is true. Juan Carlos knows how to do his job well.

reviews.author: msm19812018
reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Beautiful property. My only issue is I expected top shelf liquor to be available for royal service members at all bars all restaurants to be open everyday but they were at least four closedExcellent butler service from  Alberto Vargas & Carlos Hinostroza

reviews.author: BieniowskiNJ
reviews.title: A Wedding in Paradise
reviews.text: Where do I begin....I already had spent time in Paradisus Palma Real back in 2016.  When my fiance and I got engaged, he knew right away that he wanted our wedding to be at this beautiful resort.  I was in touch with Mariangel Sanchez for a little over 11 months.  I was full of nerves at the idea that I physically wasn't going to be planning my wedding.  Mariangel put all the nerves and fears at ease.  She was always wonderful to deal with and helped with every question I had.  Our arrival to Paradisus was August 7th and I couldn't wait to meet her.  I wanted to put a face to the name and person that I had the pleasure to deal with for such a long time.  The meeting went went well and I was reassured that everything was going to be perfect.  She made all of our dinner reservations and was always there with any request or concerns.  Thursday, August 9th came (the day before the BIG DAY) and Mariangel was no where to be found.  I approached another coordinator by the name of Patricia and she told me that Mariange was not in the resort for the day and that she personally be taking care of our All white BBQ Beach party.  I didn't think anything of it.  At the BBQ I was then approached by the manager of the romance department and was told that Mariangel would not be back for a few days due to some health concerns and that Patricia would now be in charge of our wedding day preparations.  I was a little nervous about it because I hadn't dealt with Patricia.  August 10th and the big day was finally here.  I couldn't have asked for a better day.  Everything turned out GREAT.  The decor, food, party, cake, EVERYTHING.....was just perfect.  If I could do it all again, i would! I highly recommend the Romance team at this resort because without them I wouldn't of had such a wonderful experience.....Thank you ladies for all the hard work you do to make such a beautiful experience out of everything.

reviews.author: Arnaud T
reviews.title: Superbes vacances
reviews.text: Nous étions 2 familles pour un séjour de 2 semaines et avons passé d'excellentes vacances. Le complexe est très beau avec des jardins magnifiques et très bien entretenus, la plage est également très belle même si les sargasses gâchent un peu le paysage et la baignade et présentent un réel problème pour cette partie de la côte. Les restaurants sont nombreux et très bons avec une nourriture variée qui permet de ne pas se lasser. A la Réserve, les chambres sont très belles, grandes, et l'endroit est privilégié par rapport au reste du complexe. J'y ai fêté ma soirée d'anniversaire qui restera un moment inoubliable ! Merci à Sandra, très professionnelle, de s'être occupée de nous, à Yaritza Rodriguez, Benjamin, Julio Aponte, Emilia Contrera qui nous ont servis, chouchoutés, toujours avec le sourire et dans l'échange. Merci également à Dely Cuevas pour l'entretien de la chambre. Bref, vraiment rien à dire à part être difficile et exigeant.

reviews.author: javierdejv
reviews.title: Fantastica experiencia
reviews.text:
Fantastico hotel, buenas instalaciones, un entorno natural cuidado y muy bonito y un personal super amable y profesional.
La habitacion era grande, con espacios separados, jacuzzi y terraza. La ducha es lo unico mejorable.
La comida del buffet y los restaurantes muy rica. Mejorable el servicio en alguno de ellos y la flexibilidad de horarios al reservar.
Las pisicnas, la zona de playas, el Kids zone (y sus actividades), las actividades de adultos y el gimnasio realmente bien.

reviews.author: janella s
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostroza was my Butler and he was excellent. Greeted us when we arrived and checked on us everyday. He made reservations everyday and booked our cabana with fruits was a special touch. So glad we used him

reviews.author: Henry L. R. H
reviews.title: Que grata experiencia
reviews.text: Me encantó la estadía, las condiciones de area común y de las privadas es excelente. La atención del personal magnífica, los restaurantes estan dotados de comida deliciosa y en perfecto estado. Y lo mejor, están comprometidos con el medio ambiente, usando productos reciclables en cada ocacion posible.

reviews.author: Flyer263482
reviews.title: Long Overdue Review
reviews.text: This review is long overdue. My husband and I were there for two weeks in the beginning of May. I wrote a review right after coming back, it did not load. We recently came back from Paradisus La Perla in Mexico. The difference in the two was so great that I had to make sure to come back and redo my review for The Reserve. We had a wonderful time at The Reserve. Our room was nice but a little outdated. The property was gorgeous! The walk to the beach was a pleasant 10 minute walk. The beach was beautiful. We spent most days at the pool though. Wander and Jose were awesome. They made sure we never lacked for anything around the pool. Luis was the chef at the pool restaurant. He was the most awesome person on our trip. Every day he fixed us a seafood salad for lunch and even delivered it to our chairs. I really miss those wonderful lunches. The pool entertainment staff was great - Naomy, Eduardo, and Angel. One negative, which isn’t really a negative is most of the restaurants are outdoors so it can be rather warm to eat. Overall this was one of the best vacations we have had in recent years

reviews.author: Gladys G
reviews.title: No nos gustó tanto como las veces anteriores
reviews.text:
Debo contar que es política del Hotel según nos dijeron por seguridad del cliente,  que había que llevar la tarjeta de crédito con la cual se había cancelado la estadía, mi esposo llevo otras , pero no esa, por lo que nos hicieron cancelar de nuevo, a pesar que les dijimos  que era nuestra tercera estadía en Royal Service y nos dimos cuenta que  ellos no  tienen fidelización del cliente y  les da lo mismo perder clientes por cuanto siempre el Hotel está lleno.  Por lo que entrando al Hotel ya nuestra experiencia fue mala, así es que como consejo no se olviden de llevar la tarjeta.  En general debo decir que lo pasamos bien, pero habían muchas instalaciones que están deterioradas, , a las habitaciones no se les ha hecho ninguna mejora, el colchón de la cama muy bueno, pero la cama en el respaldo sonaba cuando te recostabas sobre él, tb la ducha a la salida de la playa, salía apenas un chorrito, el baño que se ocupa en la piscina varias veces estaba tapado. También hubo un día que no arreglaron nuestra habitación , por lo que al llegar de la playa tuvimos que pedir las toallas.
La comida en el Palazzo y en los restaurantes que fuimos estaba buena, excepto, muy mala en el Restaurante Fuego, donde mi esposo y yo pedimos un arroz chaufa de marisco, el cual casi estaba incomible, por lo que nos paramos y terminamos comiendo en el Buffet.
Me imagino que se dejaron estar porque están construyendo otra etapa del hotel denominada Cirqle.
Lo bueno que siguen contando con el capital humano que hace que todo lo malo se olvide. nuestros mas sinceros agradecimientos a nuestro mayordomo Armando quien se preocupó de hacernos las reservas en los Restaurantes y que todo lo que le pedimos lo hiciera con mucho gusto. A Pedro y Rafael en la piscina donde nos tenían las tumbonas con sus toallas y nos servían unos ricos tragos, en el restaurante Palazzo, mención especial a Miguel, pero la atención de Felix, Gustavo y José también era de lo mejor, en el Bar Gerinaldo quien también se esmeraba en la atención , lo mismo que Olga. y en el retaurante Rare, Esteban.
La animación en general muy buena, 
Nos encanta Punta Cana, pero ya no volveremos a hoteles de la cadena Melia

reviews.author: ceciaco1981
reviews.title: Para meditar y descansar bueno...para divertirse con amigos no es el lugar
reviews.text: El concepto del hotel se orienta a un sector de invitados que solo quieren silencio y descanso. Para grupo de parejas de amigos sin hijos no tiene mucho que ofrecer. Por lo tanto no encontré completamente lo que buscaba

reviews.author: TravelingDiva044
reviews.title: 1st Time @ Paradisus
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus was nice and it was a beautiful resort. I had the room with the butler service and butler Carlos was da bomb. What i didnt like was the food selections and no food service pool side is the reason I gave it 4 stars. The resturant that has the steakhouse (Rare) and Japanese with the bar in the middle was the best place to drinks from. Emil and Emmanuel was wonderful wwith their personalities and mixing drinks the way I like it. Most of the other drinks taste like cough syrup.😂🤣😎 Overall, nice resturant but they need to work on the food selection and offer food pool side.

reviews.author: Jarvisjag
reviews.title: Professional relaxation 2018
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostroza was awesome, he was very helpful on our Anniversary trip to Punta Cana. He set our reservations daily and had treat in our room nightly...Paradises Palma Real resort is a great place to stay for love and relaxing.

reviews.author: Jamie G
reviews.title: Professional Relaxation Punta Cana 2018
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostroza was an awesome butler at the resort where we stayed, Paradisus Palma Real.  He was very helpful with anything that we needed.  He provided us with a number to contact him directly.  He left us nightly goodies such as wine and other things.  On our last night, he prepared the hot tub with flower petals and bubbles.  Great experience.  The only issue was that the ATM was not operable most of the time.  We needed more cash to tip the helpful staff.

reviews.author: bjmiller000
reviews.title: 3rd time at Paradisus, 1st time in DR.
reviews.text: We booked our vacation with the assistance of TripGuy Travel and were very happy with their suggestions. We stayed in a Royal Service Ocean Front room which was beautiful and came with a whirlpool tub big enough for 2. Our butlers were Yohelvis and Alvaro, who were great. Request them if you can! They took care of all the restaurant reservations and anything we wanted they got it for us. Yohelvis set us up to go parasailing and found me some nice cigars too. He even surprised us with a bath drawn with rose petals and plates of chocolate dipped strawberries a few times. We spent most of every day at the beach where Carlos set up our favourite palapa and brought us drinks.  The seaweed was bad some days but other days it wasn't bad at all. We swam every day. There seem to be two groups of beach vendors. The guys walking selling cigars, sunglasses and souvenirs were fine. You say no thank you and they move on. The other guys stand on the edge of the water and yell at you to go to their store down the beach. They don't take no for an answer and even chased my wife down the beach. Those guys need to go away. Service at all the bars was great, especially the Royal Service pool bartender (I'm sorry we forgot his name!) Make sure to try a shot of Mama Juana, the unofficial libation of DR. We found the food to be just OK. The selection was great at the buffets but the quality of the food was hit or miss. Our favourite restaurant was Aqua on the Reserve side. I wish we would have tried the buffets on that side. The Reserve also had some fun activities such as cigar rolling, wine pairing, and a cocktail making class. Look in the activities booklet for times and locations, it seems like these activities are often overlooked as we were the only people at the wine pairing. Overall, a very pleasant stay. We went on this trip with the intent to relax and unwind and Paradisus Palma Real accomplished this.

reviews.author: graciela653
reviews.title: desepcion
reviews.text: conociendo el paradisus de cuba y esperando quizas que en punta cana fuera mejor, fue terrible la desepcion. comensando con la habitacion que fue el equivalente a un hotel 2 estrellas, sobre todo el baño terrible, una bañera vieja con cortina de plastico que ademas era larga y se pisaba al bañarse con el riesgo de caerse, con el agravante que la misma se inundaba, los ceramicos del mismo rotos, el bidet flojo y algo de tan mal gusto como un espejo sobre el inodoro, increible que uno sobre todo si es hombre verse haciendo pis .Los ventanales no cerrban tuvimos que llamar 2 veces para que los arreglaran, al igual para que repusieran lamparas quemadas.La ubicacion de la habitacion  pesima para llegar a la playa 400 mts, para desayunar 600mts al igual que la piscina, y llegar al loby sobre todo en la noche mision imposible ya que estaba a unos 900mts y muy mal iluminado.En cuanto a la gastronomia muy mala y los restaurants especiales de tematicos no tienen nada, solo puedo rescatar el Japones.Lo que mas me gusto fue tan solo un dia fiesta de espuma en la piscina, y lo que menos me gusto fue todo el resto.Obviamente jamas volvere.

reviews.author: mauribep
reviews.title: Vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Es la segunda vez en el Hotel, en general es bueno, laas áreas comunes son muy bonitas.Las habitaciones son amplias y cómodas, pero ya están un poco deterioradas y requieren remodelación.La zona de la piscina y playa no tiene suficiente espacio con sillas para la cantidad de huéspedes, mucha parte es reservada para otras categorías.La zona de niños queda en una zona donde los huéspedes no  pueden estar, no es funcional dejar los niños lejos y no  poder esperarlos afuera tomando algo o disfrutando el hotel.Los bares los cierran temprano No me gusto que nos buscaran para ofrecernos el programa Circle, a parte que nos quitaron tiempo de descanso y tranquilidad escuchando charlas, lo que ofrecen no es cierto.

reviews.author: Fabiano P
reviews.title: wonderful
reviews.text: Perfect hotel, cleanliness, staff and restaurants, everything amazing, note 1000.employees Carlos and Reginaldo do Palma Real Service all adult are spectacular. Top officials, not forgetting tamebme of Butler Jeuri, great person and an excellent professional

reviews.author: John C
reviews.title: An amazing first experience in the Dominican.
reviews.text:
Our family had never been to a resort before and we are glad this was our first one. The food was amazing. A large variety at the Gabi and different each day.  We thoroughly enjoyed the food at the H2O Grill. 
 The pool was so relaxing. A perfect temperature and very large. We spent most of our time in it. The workers were all very friendly and helpful when needed. Our family concierge Stephanía took care of our dinner reservations and reserving cabanas at the pool. She even drew a going away bath for our son. Very helpful and highly recommended. The cleaning service was thorough and even came twice a day sometimes, ensuring we had towels and turning down our beds. All in all a very pleasurable experience and we will definitely be going back. Thanks to all the staff at The Reserve for a very memorable holiday.

reviews.author: seun4best91
reviews.title: One of our best holidays ever
reviews.text:
Great family vacation. Best part was having a wonderful family Concierge;the Amazing Leìdy who made our holiday one to remember, she went the extra mile to ensure we had everything we needed....I must say we were spoilt.

To all staff at Kids Zone,you were all fantastic; especially Mr Jack, such a wonderful young man; so funny full of life.

To all the staff's at the Restaurants, kitchen and bars, You were all amazing, always excited to cater for our needs. We get up so late in the morning at times due to late nights but we never missed breakfast. A call to the kitchen and you're sorted.

We all missed the daily chocolate and cookie treats in our room..lol. Thanks to the ever so loving Domestic workers.

Kids cried their eyes out on their last day. We all had a great time and would love to go back.

Thank you all

reviews.author: Nadja A
reviews.title: O Sargaço quase atrapalhou
reviews.text: Fomos em uma época que o sargaço estava formando montanhas. Não aproveitamos o mar. A praia do hotel não é boa. Mas as piscinas sim. Funcionária Marta do restaurante nota 1000! Falta recreação infantil.

reviews.author: Ashjo45
reviews.title: Friendly Service
reviews.text: I visited he Paradisus Palma Resort and I think the best thing about the service is the staff.  Nixon, Felix, and Daniel in particular were very friendly and accommodating.  I really appreciate it. It made my trip even more enjoyable! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jose Luis F
reviews.title: 24 hours perfect stay
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of staying at this hotel for a short business dinner meeting.
Couldnt be more perfect
I stayed at Royal Service section, just the perfect example of how exquisit luxury service has to be.
Great private check in at an awesome luxury lounge.
My buttler scorted me to my suite, clean, big, luxury suite with beautiful views to the beach
All kind of details were placed to welcome me.
7pm dinner at the Winery Restaurant. Oh my God. That Restaurant is Amazing! Service, ambiance, food and wine. 
Just 24 hours at Paradisis Palma Real that made me feel like ome week holiday perfect stay 
Definetely this is a real luxury hotel to stay. Dont need more than 24 hours to realyze it is
Gracias Paradisus Palma Real!!

reviews.author: Lance M
reviews.title: Amazing vacations
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostroza my butler was amazing, Je answered my calls immediately day and night.  He did everything I asked him and gave good advice.  If I come back I want him to be my butler again.  He also make sure I knew where to go for the things I was looking for.   I really hope I can come again soon!

reviews.author: alexandraalberti
reviews.title: Always a great family vacation!
reviews.text:
My family and I have been traveling to the Dominican Republic for 5+ yrs. and every year the staff at the Palma Real finds a way to make it better than the last. Special thanks to a few staff members,

Chef Cano & Santo Avila - thank you for making us a authentic Dominican lunch. It was absolutely delicious!!!  I can't wait to come back to the food and great people next year already.

Jhonny Acevedo - thank you for your hospitality at dinner! You were so friendly, accommodating and knowledgeable about the resort which is very important especially since we were traveling with a big group & a 2 year old ! :) 

Angela Mercedes - thank you for always making sure our family was taken care of at breakfast! It's hard to seat 7 people during the morning rush at the buffet but you made it work everyday and were very kind. 

If you haven't stayed at this resort before you should give it a try. The Reserve and Royal Service makes it even more luxurious. If you are a beach person the seaweed issue has got worse over the years but the pools, water sports, nightlife, spa, staff etc. all makes up for it!

reviews.author: maggles411
reviews.title: Revisit May 2017
reviews.text:
Made a return visit May 2017 with same family members.  Had a great time again, but will note differences.  Big one was the changeover of the grill next to the pool used to do burgers and such as well as some pick your own items.  the fried chicken was wonderful!  It has been changed to a sit down restaurant and the menu was just ok.  could still get a burger but they were massed cooked and held warm whereas before you could get one cooked to order.  Also you could grab a plate and take it to the pool.

pool bartender and staff were excellent as usual.  Shout outs to Yesenia,  and the gang! I waited so long to write this review so I can't remember all of the names (I'll update later if I remember), but will attach pics if I can.  Also Raoul (I hope I remembered his name correctly), who I don't have a picture of, who took care of us at the cabana.    They were the best and took great care of my family.  Hope to see you again next year!

As far as the resort, I wish there were more options to eat during the day to just grab a meal, burger or fried chicken.   The buffet needs more selections of hot food and better waiter service.  I also hope they expanded the casino, it was smaller this trip than last time but they were working on the area next to it.

Travelled May 2017 but drop down only goes back to Oct.

reviews.author: Missshay16
reviews.title: Review of Stay
reviews.text: Carlos Hinostrosa has been most helpful during my stay! He has checked with me daily to ensure I am enjoying my stay and to see if there’s anything that I needed. He helped me book dinner reservations and poolside beds. I have truly enjoyed Carlos during my stay. He has helped make this a wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: carlos c
reviews.title: Terrible!!! Do not book here!
reviews.text:
Not sure where to start, several irregularities with this resort. But in summary: Terrible customer service, lack of empathy, and POOR Management!

The resort grounds are beautiful. However, the rooms are dated.

There was a party of 30 guests, I booked a two connected suites for my family in order to have my children close to us. They booked them on a different room, far apart; when we questioned the front desk, they did not care and said there was none available. When asked for a manager they finally admitted they had them available but an extra charge. 

They will not accommodate us, even after showing paperwork reflecting the two connected rooms were booked originally.
The front desk manager did not care at all!
Our first experience on lunch time at the buffet, hostess were rude, food was very mediocre and there was a mouse in the bathroom!!!
Cheese and food was kept at a low temperature.

6 people out of 30 got sick and one ended up in the hospital (Food poisoning).

The Resort has a medical office that do not carry the basic emergency items, no IV, no pedialyte, etc. Their business model, pay $275.00 for a visit, they cannot treat you but will refer you to a hospital. They did not care that people got sick because of their food, $2,000 spent after spending a day on the hospital.

PLEASE DO NOT BOOK HERE!!!!!

reviews.author: Maya M
reviews.title: Enjoyable stay for our family!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful family vacation at the Reserve.  Our group consisted of my partner, my mom, and my 8-year old son.  We had two adjoining Master Suites which were conveniently located to the Gabi Club restaurant and the pool.  We had an excellent family concierge (Yarol) who went above and beyond and was very helpful with booking dinner reservations, keeping us abreast of the daily resort activities, drawing my son 2 amazing bubble baths, and reserving a pool cabana for us each day.  He was helpful in answering all of our questions.  One low point was that my mom got a touch of travelers stomach as she is a new traveler to the Caribbean.  Another area for improvement was that it seemed that the housekeepers or service people were constantly knocking on the door for one thing or another.  One night just as I was falling asleep, they came with chocolates - which was nice, but unnecessary.  So put out your "do not disturb" sign if you want to be left alone.  Overall the food was delicious and the resort grounds were very beautiful.  We also enjoyed the beach and swimming in the ocean.  There was seaweed, but it really wasn't a big deal.  I would love to return again in the future.

reviews.author: dtg713
reviews.title: Nixon-Pool Entertainment
reviews.text: Vacation with friends. Resort was beautiful. Nixon was great. He was always there to get people involved for the entertainment around the pool and during the evening. Had a lot of laughs. Enjoyed my vacation.

reviews.author: Marieden S
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text:
Durante nuestra estadía desde el 29 de julio hasta el 5 de agosto fue maravillosa. Nuestro mayordomo Anthony (habitaciones 1437 y 1438) fue atento y servicial al igual q el resto de los empleados como nuestra camarera Evelyn. Estamos muy agradecidos y satisfechos con las atenciones recibidas. 
Familia Sánchez Valentín

reviews.author: Karel C
reviews.title: Amazing as always
reviews.text: This was our 4th time visiting this resort, and it was fantastic as always, Great food, service, and beautiful grounds is why we always come back. This time our waiter, Deluin, made our stay extra special. Cannot wait to return here for another week of paradise and relaxation.

reviews.author: CMSH001
reviews.title: Amazing people, room needs attention
reviews.text:
First I would like to tell you that this is my Favorite place!  The grounds are beautiful
and I love the Dominican people.  Every morning we were greeted by Davidson with hot coffee at Naos.  When heading to the beach, Reynoldo and Nixon greeted us and shared stories about their families and their country.  Bani brought us refreshments on the beach.  Davidson again helped us at lunch.  The pool bar was crowded, but Lee and Mario were able to take care of us.  In the evening, after dinner, Jonathan and Celinee at Gabi Beach were the Best.  And we also need to Thank Edison at the Lobby Bar.  Many thanks to all of you for making this a wonderful vacation.  Lots of honest hugs and warm wishes for our family from our beautiful Dominican friends.

The beach was full of seaweed the first few days of our visit.  One of the local gentlemen said April through August there is a lot of seaweed and  by September it is gone.  I was amazed when we got to the beach August 30...Very little seaweed!!! It had carpeted the beach and the water was so full we couldn't even get in the day before.  August 31 was the same...beautiful water with almost no seaweed!

Now, the room we were staying in needed serious service.  The shower pan filled with water and drained very slowly. That was fixed the first day.  The day  before we left, the room above us was filled and when the people took a shower it dripped down through the ceiling of our shower and down the back wall of the water closet (UGG!) a HUGE puddle in the water closet that took two bath towels to soak up.  We reported the issue, and when we got back to the room nothing had been done.  The next day, before check out I used a translation site to explain the issue.  I hope it gets fixed correctly before the room is filled again.

reviews.author: Chely M
reviews.title: Excellent Family Vacation!  Will be returning for sure :)
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus  Palma Real from August 24th-30th.  I went on a family vacation with my mother, sister, brother in law, niece and nephew.  My family and I were extremely pleased with our visit.  The property is absolutely gorgeous and well maintained.  The service was phenomenal and the staff was very welcoming and accommodating.  A very special shout out to staff Shaky Shaky, Ronald Banquete and Matos (pool bartender).  Shaky Shaky is part of the entertainment team.  He made sure the guest enjoyed themselves every day with his catchy phrases (hola hola coca cola) and entertained the guest at night with his dance moves.  Ronald Banquete was our favorite waiter during our visit.  He treated us like family and made sure we were well taken care of.  He was our waiter at the Dominican night beach dinner. He was very attentive and made our night very fun.  Matos (don't remember his first name) is the pool bartender.  He was very pleasant and makes the best pina coladas. Overall we were very pleased with the staff at this hotel but the staff I mentioned above went above and beyond to make our stay extra special.  We hope to see them at our next visit.  The buffet food is very good and they have a variety of foods to chose from.  Make sure you go early for the freshest selections.  We were very pleased with all the restaurants we dined at.  I would definitely recommend to dine at the steak house and Fuego.

reviews.author: Bea
reviews.title: GRACIAS, GRACIAS y Mil veces GRACIAS
reviews.text:
Llegamos al hotel por casualidad. Tuvimos una mala experiencia en el hotel que habíamos reservado y decidimos venir la mañana siguiente a la llegaba a la isla a visitar las instalaciones para poder cambiarnos de hotel. 
Nos recibieron muy amablemente y Marcus nos enseñó todo el hotel e incluso la habitación en la cual íbamos a alojarnos. Nada más entrar le indicamos que no hacía falta que nos enseñase más que íbamos a ir a buscar las maletas al otro hotel y cambiarnos a este de inmediato. Y así fue, a las 12 am ya estábamos instalados. 
Se han portado excelente con nosotros estábamos de luna de miel y han tenido muchos detalles con nosotros ( adjunto algunas fotos) 
Queríamos hacer un mención especial a 3 personas que nos han tratado como si fuéramos de su familia.
El primero de ellos, el director del hotel el Sr Sanchez, gracias por haber hecho posible que nuestra luna de miel acabase como un sueño. 
Después, al Sr Guede y al Sr Deaño por su atención y amabilidad. ( viva galicia) 
Recomiendo no al 100%, sino al 1000% este hotel. 
Si estáis buscando tranquilidad, buena comida, instalaciones inmejorables y amabilidad y hospitalidad no lo dudéis ni un minuto. 
Es cierto que no es un hotel barato pero sin duda lo que te ofrecen merece la pena ese extra coste.  
Cuando estás de vacaciones buscas que sea especial y este hotel lo es.
Todos los trabajadores son increíblemente amables y respetuosos con los clientes. 
También hay que nombrar a sus animadores como por ejemplo, a José Capuchino y Naomí que hacen que las actividades del hotel tengan un toque especial ( siempre llevan una sonrisa en la cara) 
Gracias de nuevo a todo el staff del hotel sois increíbles

reviews.author: Gordo M
reviews.title: Cena familiar en la playa
reviews.text:
Fuimos con mi familia toda esta semana después del Huracán Maria y el esfuerzo que hizo el hotel porque la pasemos bien fue increíble! Hasta nos hicieron una cena privada en Playa para mi familia, que vivimos una experiencia única éramos 18! Y teníamos un chef y a los genio de Porfirio, kendri, andry Edward y el nuestro barman preferido Rikelvin!!! Que nos agasajó con los tragos!!!!
Y muchas gracias a Elaine!!! La jefa!

reviews.author: sarabaraCanada
reviews.title: Great resort for families with young children
reviews.text:
We just came back from a wonderful family vacation at Reserve/Paradisus – this is a perfect 5 star resort for families with toddlers – cannot recommend for couples or families with older children. We loved the service we received especially from Kids club, pool drinks servers, waiters, bartenders, cleaning staff,  mini bar manager, bell service etc.  A special call out to Jonathan the pool waiter and Philippe the bellman– they went out of their way for us.  I will say that some of the other patrons complained about the service.. we are picky and really did feel we had great service.
Here are more details
Check in – smooth & fast.  No upgrades were offered, I did ask for an upgrade to a bigger room and they did give it to us at a negotiated price.
Room -1 bedroom master– VERY large (approx. 900 sqft) and perfect layout for a family.  Very clean. Comfortable bed. Sofabed only good for young children.  Mini bar service was great.  Shower needed to be refurbished, it was terrible.. ceiling, fixture etc.  (rm 2362)
We did not upgrade to family concierge and glad we didn’t because the resort was not busy and the benefits with cabana reservations etc would not have been necessary, If we go back during busy season we would consider this upgrade.
Food – The food was the biggest weakness for this resort.  The food was fresh and we did not get sick but the food is incredible boring with little seasoning… especially for dinner.   We tried all the options for dining and everything tasted similar.  We really hope they can improve this.
They need a chef to come in and re-create menu items.  Breakfast was good with lots of options. Best Restaurant The Grill and Vento. The Italian restaurant was disappointing.  All restaurants will give you a meal for your child
Service – as mentioned very good overall.. but other guests didn’t’ feel the same
Kids club – fantastic but because we were there during slow season – not a lot of kids to play with. I felt comfortable leaving my 3 year old there for a couple of hours.
Wifi – strong signal throughout resort but it would not allow me to connect to my work server and other websites.. I had to use roaming just to check work email… I never figured out why
Beach – great sunbeds, water was a bit rough every day… 10 minute walk from hotel
Pool – pool was very clean, big and perfect temp.. all rooms are close to pool
Time Share sales – aka Circle… they will try to make you think they are going to give you a tour etc.. but read the nametag.. if it says circle then they are trying to sign you up for a presentation.
Entertainment – we saw lion king and cirque.. they were ok but were more like a highschool production it terms of quality. There was no other live entertainment or any other nighttime activity.. ok for us since we had 3 year old.
Landscapes – the grounds were wonderful and very well maintained, we loved walking as much as we could.
We will be back!

reviews.author: Svetlana S
reviews.title: Schönes Hotel
reviews.text:
Eine sehr schöne Hotel Anlage mit ein paar Abstriche. Im großen und ganzen wir hatten einen schönen Urlaub. Die Hotel Anlage hat einen wunderschönen Garten, schönen Strand, viele Restaurants und coole Bars. Gute Unterhaltung am Abend und 
sehr nettes Personal. Besonders vielen Dank möchten wir sagen an Ramon Ramirez der immer sehr lustig war und herzlich um uns gekümmert hat, Willi und Benita die beste Cocktail gemacht haben. 
Einzige was nicht gut funktioniert hat, wir haben nie Informationen über Tagesablauf bekommen, das ging hier nur durch die Mundpropaganda.

reviews.author: heads4
reviews.title: Beautiful!!!!
reviews.text: loved my stay at the Paradisus Palma Real! We stayed at the Royal Club and Jose Salvador was AMAZING. Extremely attentive and knowledgeable. He helped us arrange a tour during our stay where we learned a great deal about the history of DR. We even had the opportunity to visit a local cocoa bean farm. When we were not out and about, Wanda and Pedro kept us comfy and boozy poolside. Though we had some trouble picking our favorite restaurant, there were some standout staff. Abraham at Rare, Anthony at Vento, Fatima, Miguel and Richard (the last three at Palazzo). My only complaint was a brief incident with a hostess at Vento. She was very rude to us when we came in with a misunderstanding of the dress code. She seemed to be less than warm with other guests as well. What a shame. A small hiccup in an otherwise perfect stay!

reviews.author: tbarinovaa
reviews.title: Perfect Honeymoon Stay
reviews.text: We stayed at The Reserve for our honeymoon and we loved it! The room was perfect, the staff was amazing! Very respectful of the "we're sleeping" sign and not doing room service until we were awake and out of the room. They always asked us how we are doing and if there is anything we need. Surprising us with random chocolates throughout the day, or chocolate covered strawberries. We came 2 days before Hurricane Irma and the staff was incredible, supplying us with extra towels, bottled water and shampoos and constantly keeping us updated on changes, closures and precautions during the hurricane. They all kept a positive atmosphere. It was awesome. Our package also gave us access to the Paradisus side for pool and restaurants, so it was worth it! We definitely plan to come back the next chance we get! Recommend it for sure!

reviews.author: gleni2005
reviews.title: Summer Vacation 2017
reviews.text: The place looks amazing, the gardens, everything was exceptional. My family and I really liked the food and all of the people that work there. We want to say a very special thank from the Monegro family to Elaine who was our concierge. She was very attentive, professional and courteous. Thank you!

reviews.author: Q2797VUjosea
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
We vacationed at Punta Cana in September before and during the hurricane. 
Our vacation was excellent!!! Location is the best! beautiful beach with upgrade beach amenities comfortable Bali beds on the beach and at the pools 
Very nice rooms, we decided to upgraded to Royal Service and loved it. Our Butler Omar was fantastic 
Champagne ,rose petals and fresh fruit in our room as we were celebrating our 5th wedding anniversary  the staff were always heartfelt and some of the friendliest people In the world. 
The Resturants were great. Different varieties for dinner services. Room services was fast and great as well. We did tip extra as we felt the staff did a great Job 
Beach parties were a blast. We did spa treatments as well enjoyed that very much. Spa area is small but very inviting with it own pool as well. 
If we had to be stuck in a hurricane this would be the place. We always felt safe and generators kept going. The staff went above and beyond at the front desk and with the bar and Buffett service during and after the storm. 
We are already planning to return with friend and family for our next visit. 

The only thing that did get bothersome were the people selling things on the beach.

reviews.author: Jose Manuel T
reviews.title: No vale la pena
reviews.text: Estuvimos 9 días con el servicio family concierge. Luego de haber visitado varias cadenas en punta cana y otros lugares, no me parece que el servicios que contratamos estuvo a la altura de las circunstancias. La comida con poca variedad, te moris deshidratado antes de que alguien te traiga la bebida, 100 mozos para diez mesas y nadie te atiende, muy pobre la organización. La habitación no fue gran cosa en función del precio. El hotel lejos de la playa y te pasas tú vacaciones esperando el trencito. Los shows medio pelo. La atención (a excepción de santos, y la conserje Stefany Ruiz) muy mala. Comunicación descoordinada todo el tiempo todo el mundo te informa algo distinto. La zona de chicos muy básica y con pocas actividades. La pileta de chicos dos toboganes viejos y nada más. La playa sucia llena de algas que jamás nadie limpio. La gerente de family conciergee, cada cosa que reclamamos nos dió respuestas negativas y tuvo una actitud que demostraba que le molestaban nuestras inquietudes. Pagamos el servicio más caro y a todo el mundo que iba al Paradisus y lo terminaban pasando a the reserve que sale el triple, super injusto para quien contrato The reserve. Por desgracia nos tocó el huracán María y por 4 días   estuvo el 90 por ciento del hotel inutilizado, e inundado, no vimos mucha proactividad   en limpiar las piletas y la playa dsp de los  destrozos, y la atención durante la crisis fue lamentable, nadie sabía que tenía que hacer. No vale  la pena. Mejor Iberostar o Barceló y más económico.

reviews.author: Karisa B
reviews.title: Hotel sensacional para família!
reviews.text:
Fomos eu, meu marido e meu filho de 1 ano e 1 mês. Ficamos 7 dias hospedados nesse maravilhoso hotel.

No check in, ganhamos um upgrade de quarto. O quarto em que ficamos era excelente, muito confortável e muito espaçoso! 

Os funcionários do hotel eram muito gentis e solícitos.

O ponto fraco e que deixa a desejar muito é o atendimento do bar, principalmente, do bar da piscina. A gente pedia mil vezes as bebidas e às vezes ainda não éramos atendidos. Já vi que outros hóspedes fizeram esse mesmo tipo de reclamação. Mesmo dando gorjeta, não fomos atendidos na devida forma de um hotel all inclusive.

Essa parte "The Reserve" é mais reservada mesmo. Achei os restaurantes e as comidas bem melhores no The Reserve do que no Paradisus.

O bom também é que, na praia, para os hóspedes do The Reserve há vários gazebos disponíveis, meu bebê sempre tirava uma soneca neles.

Infelizmente, por estar numa área tropical, há muitos insetos. No nosso quarto tinha uma barata. Fizemos a reclamação, eles limparam melhor o quarto e nos disponibilizaram um veneno em spray. Até deram a possibilidade de a gente trocar de quarto, mas não era necessário. Recomendo levar repelente.

O hotel em todos os lugares era muito limpo.

A comida muito boa! Meu filho não passou nenhuma necessidade. Todos os dias deixavam várias garrafas de água mineral no nosso quarto.

Na hora do check out, não tivemos nenhuma surpresa indesejada. Tudo foi como o combinado!

Eu super recomendo esse hotel para quem estiver viajando com crianças. A parte da brinquedoteca, piscinas e do playground é muito boa, meu filho adorou!

Enfim, hotel sensacional recomendado para famílias!

reviews.author: Operez988
reviews.title: Perez Wedding
reviews.text: What an amazing place! This is one of the best resorts in this part of the island!!! The staff here is phenomenal staring with Angelo Mercedes who always makes our stay here amazing. And all the staff including Carlos Rosario Martin Tineo all Management and our lovely bar tender Wanda Correa Thank You All for your hard work and an amazing stay!!!!

reviews.author: Tamara_gt87
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real, el autentico Paraíso.
reviews.text:
Nuestra experiencia en Paradisus Palma Real ha sido excelente, nos hemos sentido como en casa. Cabe destacar la comida, la limpieza y la belleza del hotel. Queremos hacer una mención especial a los profesionales con quienes tuvimos el gusto de coincidir durante nuestra estancia, ya que ellos son, sin lugar a dudas, lo que lo hace único.  

 Jenny de Naos, fue de las primeras personas que conocimos y nos recibió amablemente en nuestra primera cena aquel domingo en Naos, siempre tan cariñosa y sonriente. 
Esteban de Fuego (con quien además coincidimos en las comidas servidas en el refugio), siempre con una sonrisa y muy atento. 
Juan Suárez de Naos, nos recibió en la primera comida en Naos y nos facilitó nuestra estancia.
Richard Ortiz de Palazzo, gracias a él y al equipo de Palazzo disfrutamos de una cena maravillosa. 
Willian de Naos, gracias a quien disfrutamos de dulces desayunos. 
Génesis, nuestra concierge, nos hizo una estancia muy cómoda y nos asesoró en todo momento. 
Luis de Swim Bar, siempre tan eficaz, eficiente, amable y siempre con una sonrisa, hizo que nuestras días de piscina fueran aún más agradables. 
Pedro, cocinero de Bana, quien nos hizo disfrutar de un auténtico show cooking de calidad y con sentido del humor. 
José M, a quien conocimos en Red Lounge y con quien coincidimos en muchas otras ocasiones, entre ellas en el refugio, siempre atento y mostrando su disponibilidad ante cualquier duda.
Alfonsina de recepción de Naos, por su saber estar y su amabilidad cada mañana. 
Santo de la piscina, por estar siempre atento y reconocer nuestras necesidades sin decirle nada.
Dauris Guzmán de Room Service, a quien conocimos durante la primera comida en el refugio, siempre amable y educado. 
Andy de la Cruz de Gabi Beach, por su educación y cortesía.
Kaury Castro de Gabi Beach, con quien pudimos disfrutar de ricos cafés al atardecer, amenizando nuestras tardes con su dulzura.
Osvaldo de animación, siempre sacando una sonrisa a los huéspedes.
Osvaldo Acosta de Palazzo, por su atención en la última cena que disfrutamos en Palazzo.
Juan Mejía de Naos, coincidimos con él en Bana y tuvimos el placer de volver a encontrarlo en los desayunos en Naos, atento y educado.
Emely Moran de recepción, por resolver todas nuestras dudas rápidamente y exponernos la gran variedad de posibilidades. 
Andrés Contreras de Otium, por su amabilidad y accesibilidad al explicarnos todas las excursiones.
Richard y Pedro Rosario de YHY Gym, por su cercanía y profesionalidad.

Gracias a todos ellos por hacer más confortable aún nuestra estancia y, sobretodo, gracias por sus sonrisas, su apoyo y su gran respuesta ante los días en que se estuvo en alerta por el Huracán María. 
Seguramente nos dejamos a grandes profesionales sin mencionar aquí, pero no tuvimos ocasión de tratar con todos, por ello pedimos disculpas.

reviews.author: Thomas Z
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Exzellente, Juan Bariera at the Sunrise Bar! Good Coctails, especially Pina colada! Socrate exzellente manillen.
Cocoloco, Caipirinha, Whisky Sour, Beer and many more...
Beautiful beach, sun and fun. Palms and coconuts.

reviews.author: claragedockery
reviews.title: Great Service, Drinks and the BEST STAFF
reviews.text:
I upgraded to the Royal Service for the better location, Private area on the beach, Private Pool for Royal and the Butler service.  Our butler was DANNY. THE BEST!  Ask for him.  
Even with Hurricane Maria the staff and the service was WONDERFUL.

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Amazing and gorgeous!
reviews.text: Don't listen to all of the negative reviews.  I was just here 9/14 - 9/18 and it was amazing.  The resort is clean, staff was friendly, the food was great!  It is hard to get a reservation at the restaurants, you have to reserve the day before, but the buffet is always available and it is really good.  The pool is very clean and you can see them cleaning it if you get up early enough.  Our room was spotless and the mini bar was always stocked with what we asked for.  Some things do need some cosmetic work but it isn't anything major.  It is not a party type of resort, it is more for couples looking for a romantic getaway.  We went for a friend's wedding and they did a great job with the ceremony.  Also, I tried to ship some things home and FedEx was giving me problems and guest services is still working with me to get it resolved (and I'm not even a guest anymore).

reviews.author: lorezamp
reviews.title: Volvería con amigos
reviews.text: Vivimos en familia el viernes 15 de septiembre y nos vamos mañana 26. Los primeros.4 días excelentes luego nos tocó dos.días de.encierro por el huracán maria y ahí nos dimos cuenta que el hotel.no cuenta con equipo de evacuación adecuado bi criterio de unificación de información para brindar a los clientes . Lo.positivo  habitaciones de la.reserva son amplias lujosas  y super limpias, los restaurantes temático.tienen excelente atención, la.playa tiene canasta.y reposeras que.no he visto.en otros hoteles y  la.atención de la gente de la.playa  Ramón Ramírez ,santos frias y Benita Mercedes es excelente y a destacar. Lo negativo  La atención del gaby beach y del gaby club es mala y la.comida reiterativa falta mejorar mucho ese aspecto, no hay mariscos, no hay variedad ni cantidad. Los.dueños del.lugar deberían proveer que cuando.suceden esas tormentas gigantes estas.personas.tiene.familia.y no.obligarlos a trabajar mil.horas seguidas eso. Inhumano y lleva a mala atención. La piscina de los niños le.faltaría.mucho más juegos podrían mejorarla ampliamente. Los shows dejan que desear en comparación con otras cadenas. Otro aspecto positivo es el animador jose alias capuchino es un amor se persona.

reviews.author: ezekev
reviews.title: Personal de playa
reviews.text: Excelente atención en la playa y me animo a decir nombres, Benita, Santos, Ramos y Carlos. Unos genios. Por otro lado el huracan desorganizo un poco y la gente del hotel estaba mal humorada y se peleaba entre ellas entendible. Por otro lado, la comida del buffet cero mariscos por un hotel 5 estrellas, en otras cadenas todo el tiempo hay langostinos, camarones y por lo menos una vez por semana langosta, el resto, bien.

reviews.author: LaTanya M
reviews.title: I would totally go again
reviews.text:
This was my first solo trip and I completely loved this place. I wouldn't change a thing even with the hurricane. they took very good care of us. I enjoyed everything from the views from my room to the service. everyone is very friendly. I would definitely go back
 My butler, Kelvin Fernandez, was super super nice and helpful and gave great suggestions on excursions and wine . And he went above and beyond to make my birthday special.

reviews.author: Thofrichter
reviews.title: Beautiful place to rest
reviews.text:
We arrived on saturday and were greeted by smiles and friendly faces everywhere. Since we stayed in the family concierge section we were taken over there to check in. This is where we met our concierge Luis. He was amazing and truly loves his job. He made us feel special the whole trip. Check in took all of 10 minutes and Luis explained everything to us. The room was very nice as well and as expected. Luis made sure to make us dinner reservations and explained the whole resort and amenities to us. He also made sure we had a cabana reserved every day for us. At the pool we were met by more wonderful people Mr Wonderful ( Wonder ) , Jonathen and Naomi were all great fun and took great care of us. Everyone was super helpful. 

So why only 4 stars ? 
The food was very bland everywhere. Gabi beach, Gabi, The grill, Aqua etc. None was that great. The buffet was probably our favorite because there was fresh fruit and deli meats available. But the rest of the food was below average. 

There was almost no activities. It was super quiet everywhere and there was very little going on.The last resort we stayed at had activities by the pool, etc. Even the beach party we went to had nothing going on.  

The kids zone was a little disappointing. Grouping in the 5-9 year old with baby care was disappointing. My kids were not even allowed to go plan in the back yard since there was no one to go out with them . We picked them after an hour and they did not want to go back for the rest of the trip. 

All in all I would definitely come back. The folks were great and super friendly. I do wish they had some more activities around the resort. 
Unfortunately our trip was cut short because of Hurricane Maria and we managed to get an earlier flight out before the storm hit. I do wish that we could have gotten a credit or something for the 2.5 days we had to miss because of leaving early, but the resort would not offer anything. I understand not getting a refund, but was hoping we could have worked out a credit for a future stay.  That was a little disappointing.

reviews.author: Morgan B
reviews.title: Great trip, amazing place to stay!
reviews.text: Amazing place to stay, one of the best all inclusive resorts that we've ever stayed at. Royal Service is definitely worth it. The food was good and we had the best service from Jose Salvador, Wanda and Rafael. Jose and Rafael made sure we were set up with great beach chairs and cabanas everyday, Wanda made us delicious drinks every day. Jose made sure we had great dinner reservations every night and took special care of my mom on her birthday delivering a birthday cake and champagne to the room. We have been to Punta Cana before but this was our favorite place and we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: pablopalopoli
reviews.title: Gran atención de Frankely Morrobe. Te vamos a extrañar !
reviews.text:
Realmente después de haber venido en 5 oportunidades a La Reserva del Paradisus Punta Cana puedo decir sin lugar a dudas que, estas vacaciones familiares en donde éramos 14 personas, no habrían sido igual sin nuestro querido Frankely del Gaby de la Reserva.
Del hotel que se puede decir es un lugar increíble, beneficiado por la naturaleza, que realmente, y después de haber venido tanto, ha desmejorado bastante en la atención y variedad de comida pero sin nuestro querido Frankely hubiera sido otra cosa. 
Este hombre es literalmente fantástico y se merece lo mejor! Hizo que mis hijos y sobrinos se acuesten a diario pensando en encontrárselo a la mañana siguiente en el desayuno. Siempre con una sonrisa, siempre con un apretón de manos, sabiendo el nombre de todos y teniendo un sentimiento genuino de aprecio. No fue una semana común para nadie en el hotel, ni para los huéspedes ni los empleados; tuvimos al huracán Maria aquí y este hombre a diferencia de muchos de sus compañeros hizo de la sonrisa y ganas de atender y contener un culto. A diferencia de muchos otros que usaban la excusa del huracán para tener un destrato este hombre lo unico que tenía eran palabras de contención y abrazos a nuestros hijos. Hasta se ha tomado el trabajo de festejar y hacer el mismo, sin ayuda de nadie, la torta de cumpleaños de mi sobrina para darle una sorpresa. Hasta pregunto que le podía comprar de regalo.... 
Sin dudas estas vacaciones hubieran sido otra cosa sin nuestro querido Frankely. Ojalá que otros huéspedes lo puedan disfrutar tanto como nosotros. Y ojalá alguien de este hotel y en especial su gerente general  se de cuenta del valor y potencial que tiene porque realmente hace que uno se sienta tan a gusto que, a pesar del hotel y des tratos que pudimos haber sufrido, quiera volver a encontrárselo. 
Gracias Frankely por todo y ojalá que nunca pierdas esas ganas y sonrisa que sin dudas serán las que te hagan progresar!!!!
Abrazo inmenso
Adrian, Silvia, Alejandro, Pablo, Celi, Tobias, Juana, Tai y Alfonso Palopoli y Lucas, Romina, Josefina, Emília, Francisca Ruiz Shur

reviews.author: Juan_Ormachea
reviews.title: Hotel e serviços 5 estrelas... mesmo com furacão Maria!
reviews.text:
Minha esposa e eu chegamos no Paradisus Palma Real no dia 19/09, quase 48h antes do furacão Maria atingir indiretamente a República Dominicana.

O hotel tem classificação 5 estrelas e não é à toa... montaram um esquema preventivo, haja a vista a previsão do "Huracán Maria" passar próximo à Punta Cana, mas ainda sim pelo mar.

Todos os hóspedes foram acolhidos no refúgio totalmente estruturado para passarmos muito, se necessário fosse. Tínhamos comida, água, banheiros, atendimento médico e psicológico.

A todo momento alguém da equipe vinha checar se precisávamos de algo... muito bem preparados.

O hotel passa agora por recuperação, uma vez que os fortes ventos acabaram destruindo algumas árvores e estruturas mais sensíveis... ainda sim, pudemos desfrutar tranquilamente de todo o hotel 2 dias depois do ocorrido.

Recomendo muito este hotel... de olhos fechados!

reviews.author: Scott O
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, food just OK
reviews.text:
Stayed here for four days in September with my fiancée. For the most part, everything was great. We did the Royal Service, which I highly recommend for adults traveling without children. The Royal Service area is very close to the beach and main pool (unlike the Reserve, which is set pretty far back off the beach and requires you to take a golf cart to the main areas). The best part of the Royal Service is the private pool and bar area. Your concierge can reserve a palapa every day for you by the pool, and the guys at the bar are very attentive and make outstanding drinks. Martin, Lee, and Carlos at the Sunset Bar were fantastic, as was our concierge Jose.  My fiancée also had an excellent massage with Ratib at the Oriental Garden Spa. 

The main drawback was the quality of the food, primarily at dinner. The breakfast and lunch were good (especially at Palazzo, the Royal Service-only restaurant) but dinner was largely subpar. You have to make reservations at each restaurant in advance, but no menus are available so you just have to guess at which ones you'll like. The only dinner that was pretty good was the hibachi joint at the Reserve. The rest were uninspired at best, inedible at worst (Aqua at the Reserve). That said, maybe mediocre food is par for the course at all-inclusives. This was our first, and we were pretty underwhelmed. 

Speaking of par for the course, I thought it was pretty disingenuous to advertise this place as a "Golf Resort" with "unlimited golf". The country club where they'll make tee times for you appears to be only loosely associated with the resort, if at all, and it costs $70 (USD) per person per round. So yeah, it's "unlimited golf" in the sense that anything is unlimited as long as you're willing/able to pay for it.  My fiancée and I played nine holes in the afternoon at $30 per person, and I decided not to go back for a full 18 the next day. The course (three different 9-hole tracks) is about the level of a decent muni back in the states, but priced like a country club. Don't waste your time or money lugging your clubs to the DR for this place unless you really need an excuse to escape the family or something. 

All that said, it was a relaxing stay at a very nice resort. The facilities and rooms were clean and comfortable, service was excellent, and the drinks were delicious. If you don't care too much about food, I highly recommend the Royal Service option.

reviews.author: Hernan Antonio L
reviews.title: Nuestro 20 años de casados
reviews.text:
El hotel muy bueno. Somos socios del Club, pero tuvimos un mayordomo desastroso. Alberto Mercedes no estuvo nunca con nosotros y cuando nos recomendo algo fue erroneo....cata de vino cancelada, reserva de tumbonas en playa sin confirmar, servicio de frigobar que nosotros mismos tuvimos que pedir, etc etc 
Total abandono de nuestro mayordomo y sin informacion.

reviews.author: rshevs2017
reviews.title: Stayed during Hurricane Maria
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel during hurricane Maria. We opted for the Royal service which came with a personal butler. Our butler was Francis Newton. Great guy. Perfect for us newlyweds because he was funny and friendly. He made sure every need was fulfilled. Our fridge was stocked with the beer I liked and he brought us the pillows we liked sprayed with lavender oil. During the hurricane he called us several times to see if there was anything we needed which was very comforting. I give this resort 4/5 stars only because we needed reservations for dinner. I don't want time to tell me when I should eat when I'm on vacation. Aside from that it was a great expierence and Francis deserves a raise!

reviews.author: Katya123885
reviews.title: Superb team and majestically beautiful place
reviews.text:
I'm writing this review sitting in my hotel room on the fourth day of my stay because I simply have to share how grateful I am to the whole team of Paradisus Palma Real and how much I admire their wonderful work. 

2 days ago hurricane Maria hit the island. It was my first hurricane experience ever and as I was wondering whether or not I´m a very courageous person for not feeling afraid or panicked in the face of what the TV called ¨the storm of the century¨, I noticed no other guest seemed to experience any kind of trouble at all. Of course, we couldn´t all be that brave. Especially if we thought we were exposed to danger. 

So the answer was elsewhere. I was sitting on a table in the enormous saloon that was our shelter and I contemplated both the guests and the staff. There was a special corner for kids´ activities, non-stop water, and food supply, massage chairs, charging points for our phones and laptops and beds for everyone. But it was not just the physical surroundings and the equipment. 

It was the natural calm energy that all of the staff created. They were constantly smiling, very attentive, always ready to help, joking and making people laugh like this was the most normal of situations. There were people from all departments working together and staying all night with the guests. I was in awe with how they managed to attribute such an ordinary character to such an extraordinary event. 

And yes, I know, locals might be used to it. Of course, they are. But we the guests are not, and if the staff succeeded at projecting their confidence on us and made us feel comfortable and safe, I believe they deserve a huge recognition. 

A sincere¨Thank you¨ to the whole team! Now that the storm is gone, let´s enjoy this beautiful paradise :)

reviews.author: leobiuryg
reviews.title: Feels like paradise
reviews.text: This hotel is great, services are great, Drinks are made nicely, Rooms are clean and well maintained, YAROL RIJO was exceptional he help me and my family feel so at home and pampered, he made sure our experience in this hotel was great, so if he helps you you are going to be in great hands.

reviews.author: zaraguais
reviews.title: El auténtico paraiso
reviews.text:
Otro año que he vuelto a este hotel y pienso seguir repitiendo mientras las cosas sigan así. Los jardines son un paraíso, bien cuidados y preciosos.
La habitación, estupenda, enorme (más grande que muchos apartamentos) y no le faltan detalles. No se oye ruido de aire acondicionado. Bien climatizada y bien insonorizada, cama comodísima y ropa (toallas y sábanas) de muy buena calidad. Minibar surtido y repuesto cada día, aunque algunos productos del año pasado eran de mayor calidad. Por ejemplo, las galletas el año pasado eran oreo y las cervezas eran botellines, mientras que este año las cervezas eran de lata y las galletas no estaban tan buenas.
La comida, como siempre, excelente. Muy bien presentada, con mucha variedad.
El servicio, más que amable. Siempre atentos y con una sonrisa. Muchas veces comimos en el bufet del Neos porque estaba más cerca de la playa y era un poquito más fresco. Se echa de menos algún restaurante abierto al mediodía con aire acondicionado o non ventiladores más efectivos. 
Las cenas espectaculares. En especial la del "Grill" y la del "Vento" (comida muy elaborada y de gran calidad). El espectáculo del restaurante japonés también fue divertido. La peor cena, la del "Mole" (mejicano) porque nos atacaron los mosquitos y aunque nos ofrecieron un repelente, fue tarde pues ya nos habían dejado las piernas como coladores. Me quedé con las ganas de volver al "Fuego" pero este año estaba cerrado.
Las piscinas muy limpias y agradables. En la que está en la Reserva, a veces había demasiados niños ruidosos. Aunque no entiendo porqué ya que ellos disponen de una piscina exclusiva para niños. En la del Paradisus había a veces mucha juerga con gente que imponía su propia música y esto resultaba algo molesto. Pero en general, muy bien.
Lo mejor, el bar de la playa de La Reserva. Benita Mercedes es especial, siempre amable y dispuesta. Ramón Ramirez, encantador, con su "Vamos a hacerlo, mi gente bella" animando a todo el mundo y atento a todo lo que pudieses necesitar. Y Jonathan Tiburcio es el mejor barman. Me preparó el mejor Gin Tónic de mi vida. 
Respecto a los animadores, destacar la labor de Luis Florian, Naomi y Chanel. Divertidos, dispuestos a hacerte pasar siempre un buen rato. Alexandre Pouriet baila el merengue, de miedo y siempre está atento. Capuchino es muy gracioso, aunque se le veía menos. Los de las actividades de agua geniales (no recuerdo sus nombres) y los del taller de pintura con espray muy buenos. Nos gustaron mucho todas las actividades. La más aburrida fue la del miércoles, día dominicano (te enseñan a hacer puros) pero seguramente porque ya la habíamos conocido de otros años. 
En recepción amabilisimos y los del servicio de mantenimiento, muy eficaces y rápidos. El primer día advertimos que la ducha tenía poca presión de agua y esa misma noche la cambiaron completamente. 
El servicio de transporte dentro del hotel funcionaba perfectamente. Alguna noche se retrasaban un poco, pero era muy agradable ir paseando. Si te veían caminando te recogían fuera de las paradas e incluso, a veces, te esperaban. 
Lo único a destacar un poco negativo es que los espectáculos nocturnos empiezan demasiado pronto. A las 8,30. A veces, aunque vayas a cenar a las 7, no llegas a verlos.

reviews.author: Mrs. Britt
reviews.title: Stayed through Hurricane Irma
reviews.text:
Visited The Paradisus Palma Real Sept 1-8th 2017 as it was our 1yr wedding anniversary.  We were married there Sept 1st 2016 and decided to go back.  Our room appeared lovely at 1st glance. However, the sofa smelled of mildew and was not refreshed daily and the curtains and other accessories should be updated.  We were told AFTER a complaint that the smell was because of our room being close to the beach.  This is understandable (maybe) but it seems that the front desk staff needs some type of compassion/sensitivity training because you'll get lots of blank stares while expressing dissatisfaction.  Most of the staff in the restaurants were ok but a few of the Guest Services employees are not fluent with English.  Most times the language barrier is extremely difficult.  Things get lost in translation quite often.  It does appear that lots of the employees are unhappy so it reflects in the way the guests are treated.

While there, we had to evacuate our room for safety and stay in the resort shelter.  Management did an EXCELLENT job of keeping us informed, fed, safe, hydrated and calm!  They were WELL prepared so kudos to the management team!!  The only suggestion I'd have is for them to have cots to rest on instead of beach chairs without padding or cushions.  We were instructed ahead of time to not bring bedding but all they provided was 1 thin sheet and it was VERY cold. I was uncomfortable but my husband suffered more because he isn't average height at 6'9". 

On the day of our check out time, our flight was delayed 3 times because of the hurricane and we didn't have the option of staying 1 night extra in case the flight was cancelled. I asked to speak to management but was not allowed.  I was sent to Guest Services and she kept repeating the same thing over & over until I got frustrated and walked away. 

We were happy to see a familiar face in the bar near the casino.  The most familiar and fun person was the guy who worked at this bar but for the life of me I cannot remember his name(I should have written this review sooner). It may be Juan but I'm not sure.  Also our concierge was Franklin and he was very helpful!

We got married here but don't intend to return for a while.  If we do decide to return, we hope there will be upgrades that line up with the prices they charge.

reviews.author: Astrid M
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: Excellent place, huge pool everything so beautiful and romantic for couples. Food was ehhh...I recommend you eat from the Aqua and Meso restaurant which you have to make reservations once you get there. The room service was ok nice room but the cleaning lady did not do a great job at cleaning it and our last night there she forgot to close the door after cleaning and left it open smh. We stayed in room 1201 which was close to the restaurants and the lobby. We visited The reserve Paradisus which is for couples is pretty nice too a lot more romantic and a little bit more modern. I loved Paradisus overall would def recommend it to anybody !
