reviews.author: 342evelynt
reviews.title: Great family memories created!
reviews.text: This was a family vacation and we all agree that everything about the resort was exceptional, and I don't give praise lightly. It was clean, stylish, with excellent service in both bar where we had lunch and restaurant where we had dinner. Food was beyond good and great value for money and service in all places, and staff was very attentive and efficient. We were very pleased with our stay, and although short and sweet this time, I hope to be back for a longer visit in the future.

reviews.author: Jonathan V
reviews.title: Nuestra estadía de 6 dias
reviews.text: Para comenzar queremos felicitar al hotel ya que nuestra estadía fue más que fantástica en este hotel, la infraestructura muy buena y el personal muy amable y siempre predispuesto a ayudarte! Se me vienen los nombres de claudia Garcia  del equipo de concierge que nos ayudó en todas las actividades que tuvimos, a Amelia de gabi club que desde el primer día nos atendió con mucha amabilidad y una gran sonrisa, a Germanía y a "Capuccino" del equipo de animación. Desde el check in nos hicieron sentir en casa y bien atendidos! Nuestras reservas en Bana y Fuego estuvieron muy bien, pero si tuviéramos que recomendar a ojos cerrados lo haríamos con Fuego! Como puntos de mejora creo que el servicio de transporte debe mejorar, casi perdemos una reserva por esperar los carritos que demoraban mucho a nuestro parecer. Así como el de recojo de maletas, tuvimos unos inconvenientes en nuestro check out. La música de la discoteca  debe ser más variada y el servicio de snack en la piscina the reserve podrían ser un pocos más amables. Definitivamente se merecen como puntuación excelente ya que dejando de lado algunos inconvenientes, en general el servicio de concierge, bar, room Service, transporte, comida y playa son excelentes!

reviews.author: barbfox61
reviews.title: Overall a great experience BUT...
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradiso Palm Real this past August and the facility is just that Paradise.  Although the resort  was crowded,  you would never know...  The pool was spacious,  we always had lounge chair at the beach,  just got up a bit early to make sure we had a primo spot!

The food was delicious, service at the restaurants for the most part great,  the people wonderful.  Here is where the but comes in......

Housekeeping was frustrating,  although we were three people in a room we seem to never have enough towels or sheets for the pull out couch.  Trying to find room service to get these things is a task.

Getting a reservation for dinner when you wanted is IMPOSSIBLE,  (even with a generous tip.).  On the two occasions where we were squeezed in at a reasonable hour,  the restaurant was empty.  Literally one couple.  That was so frustrating taking into account we tried to make all our reservations the first day there and this took over an hour.  How could every restaurant be full every night 6 nights in a row?. The buffet on the other hand always had tables and was delicious.

If you like cocktails,  even when you ask for something straight up,  it was like drinking water.  Stick to wine.......Except if you are at the pool bar,  tip the bartender and you will have better luck.

Apparently we were not the only guests who have had the same comments.  We did read this on trip advisor prior to going and after speaking with people we had met at the resort.

Even with the frustrating room service and the chore of making restaurant reservations,  I would absolutely go back and would recommend.  You just have to do some careful planning for towels and sheet and have a big lunch!

reviews.author: MrsLeeah
reviews.title: Amazing Destination Wedding Site
reviews.text:
My new husband and I got married at the Paradisus Palma Real in July 2017.  The whole experience was easy, (relatively) stress-free, and completely enjoyable.

Noelia Jimenez was our wedding planner and she went above and beyond to make sure that all details were attended to and our guests were happy.  She made sure that everything went smoothly, even as the forecast predicted rain.  Noelia moved the reception indoors just hours before and brought all of my personal touches along. Guests actually enjoyed being indoors more because there was air conditioning.

With 30 guests along for the ride, we had a combination of vegans, pescatarians, those who don't eat pork, and generally picky eaters.  Each guest ate well at the Paradisus Palma Real and we didn't receive a single complaint about food.  Noelia even arranged for one of our vegan guests to have a personal chef during her stay.  Everyone from the bar tenders to the wait-staff were super friendly and accommodating.  They even accommodated the requests for "To-Go" plates!  Each guest had a fabulous time and no one was ready to leave.

The only issue we had was upon check-in.  We arrived late at night and our upgraded room had been given away.  We had to spend one night in a room that was sub-par, but Randy Santos (the reservations manager) made sure that the following morning, we received the room upgrade with complimentary Royal Service butler.  We spent the remainder of our week there in luxury.
  
Thank you Noelia (our wedding planner), Wanda (our favorite bar tender), Faustino (our butler), and the whole staff at the Paradisus Palma Real.  We will never forget the amazing wedding we had there.  Memories were made, friendships were strengthened, and we began our adventure as a married couple on the highest note.  We are forever grateful!

reviews.author: pammydd2017
reviews.title: Great vacation - Royal Service is a must
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus from 9/8-12. Thank God the hurricane missed this part of the island. We had Royal Service which we felt was worth the extra money. Our butler, Argenis Romero, was fantastic. He took care of all our restaurant and cabana reservations as well as some great surprises in our room such as wine and champagne with cheese and fruit trays each day. The staff at the Palazzo RS including Fatima Diaz, Junior Joaquin, Richard Ortiz, Miguel Jimenez, Osvaldo Acosta and Felix Garcia were amazing. Best service ever and always with a smile. We enjoyed our breakfast every morning. Great selection. We also enjoyed dinner at Rave and Vento (the coconut pudding is to die for). Room service was also great. We really enjoyed the Royal Service pool (no kids were allowed in the RS area). Very relaxing. A few things that could be improved: took us 1 hr to get our luggage upon arrival, the pool bar staff was not very attentive (no one walking around asking if we needed a drink), and food was not served at the pool or beach. We did call the hotel before we came to check on status because of hurricane and asked about airport transportation. They told us to get a taxi. When we got to the hotel, we were told if we had called they would have set it up. They need to make sure their staff is trained appropriately. Overall a great stay. Everyone was courteous. We would definitely recommend Royal Service upgrade.

reviews.author: Llaridy S
reviews.title: Ame este hotel
reviews.text: Durante mi estadía en paradisus fue maravilloso, vine unos días a relajarme sola y todos me trataron como una reina, disfrute bastante el vento por la comida y todos muy lindos en restaurantes, la playa y la piscina inmensa , bella y cómoda. Quiero felicitar al equipo de guest service Domingo beltre, Carolina Franco, Tracy, Marielys, Stephanie , liliana de Leon y Yeisy que me brindando un servicio de altura y que sin duda volveré todas las veces, todos muy dispuestos a ayudar en todo, my sorrientes, me sentí como en casa. Este hotel desde el jardinero hasta el gerente te hacen sentir especial.

reviews.author: Markospose
reviews.title: Sueño cumplido
reviews.text:
Acabamos de llegar de este inolvidable Resort en el que hemos pasado 10 días maravillosos.
Al llegar echamos de menos un cocktail de bienvenida y una mejor atención en el check-in, circunstancias que quedaron largamente compensadas durante la estadía.
El servicio del hotel es lo que te hace sentirte como en un verdadero paraíso terrenal, el trato con el personal es encantador, son personas amables, cordiales, cercanas y muy profesionales.
Agradecemos mucho la atención recibida, destacamos: en el Lobby bar: a Antonio Ramírez,  que nos ofreció su casa en un momento muy delicado (llegada del huracán Irma); a Malvin, persona que destaca por su enorme corazón, sólo comparable con los ricos cocktails que prepara. En el restaurante Palazzo: al chef Alexis Francisco, que además de cocinar divinamente durante toda la estancia, nos ofreció una despedida culinaria de Estrella Michelin; a Miguel Jiménez, camarero simpático y atento en todo momento de quién aprendimos muchas cosas de la República Dominicana; a Richard Ortiz, atento a la solución de cualquier percance o necesidad del cliente. En el bar Avenue, destacar a su personal, encantadores, que buenos ratos. En animación, a Lucky Luke (Uau!!) y a Happy Boy, simpáticos a rabiar, con ellos se aprenden todos los pasos de merengue, salsa y bachata del Caribe. Mención a los chicos del Pub Rare. Por último, agradecer enormemente a Vladimir de Guest Service, todas las atenciones recibidas, es un excelente profesional.
Las instalaciones son magnificas, dispones de una enorme piscina, con bar acuático, varios restaurantes de diversos tipos de cocina, todos incluidos excepto tres: el Passion que es de pago (80 dólares persona), el Fuego (30 dólares, salvo que seas miembro de Meliá Rewards ) y el Palazzo (exclusivo para Royal Service), un maravilloso Spa (el circuito termal es gratis para miembros de Meliá Rewards), deportes acuáticos no motorizados (aunque el Catamarán, si no lo sabes usar, tienes que pagar 35 dólares de curso), canchas de tenis, etc... En el sector de playa de Royal Service existe un bar de zumos naturales. 
En la plaza central está el bar Avenue que ameniza las tardes-noches con música caribeña, entre otros estilos, hasta las 23:00 más o menos, luego para los más marchosos puedes continuar en el Red Lounge con música actual y un gran DJ que abre hasta las 2:00 AM. Las copas de última hora en el pub Rare, que está hasta las 5:00 AM.
Recomendamos antes de ir, si no lo eres, hacerte miembro del programa Melia Rewards, ya que accedes a mas servicios gratis.
La comida es extraordinaria, grandísima calidad en los buffets y los restaurantes a la carta, en los que no existe límite para pedir platos. La única pega es el vino y champagne incluidos, marca Revelle, la odiamos..... por fortuna, van a cambiarlo.
Las habitaciones son grandes, y destacaría su limpieza, con dos servicios diarios en los que te reponen todo, eso si, como son del año 2005 necesitarían una pequeña reforma.
En el lado negativo, aunque ajeno al hotel, pulula por allí un personaje llamado Juan Carlos, que vende excursiones. NO LAS CONTRATEIS con el, las ofrece como premium y son malísimas, te sientes estafado.
Tuvimos la mala suerte de que en nuestro segundo día vivimos la amenaza del huracán Irma, en ese momento fue cuando nos dimos cuenta de la enorme calidad humana de todo el equipo del Palma Real, desde la directiva hasta el último empleado. Estuvieron con nosotros en todo momento, adoptando todas las medidas de seguridad necesarias para la protección de los huéspedes y tratando de ofrecer el mayor confort posible dadas las circunstancias. Nuestro mayor agradecimiento y felicitaciones. Chapeau!!.
Finalmente, queremos hacer mención de la gran labor que está haciendo el señor Lati Naimi, Hotel Manager del Paradisus Palma Real, un profesional cercano para el cual el cliente es lo primero.
Si estas buscando un Paraíso en Punta Cana, esta es tu elección, desde luego, nosotros volveremos!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Doris D
reviews.title: lindo lindo
reviews.text:
es muy lindo si q te relaja  todo el complejo es muy tranquilo y el personal muy servicial es mejor ser los primeros en el bufete si no se aglomera horas puntas de comidas.
las habitaciones son muy acogedoras.

reviews.author: Fran G
reviews.title: The exelent place
reviews.text: The day September 3 arrives at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and for reasons of Hurricane Irma was prolonging travel through Sept. 15 as the AA airline canceled me 4 times the passage until I had to fly with Jetblue to FFL, the emplomania Paradisus behaved excellent with my family and me at all times, the girls of the reception I have no words to thank you so much patience and dedication to us, the Restaurant and Bar kindest could not be, sometimes going on and veered to back to tip him because it was so much kindness and try one feel good that you drew from his pocket without your wanting money because you did not know how retibuir so kindly towards my 1 year and a half or speak, Day Care girls were super nice, the director of it is that even the boys there there was no way to thank you so much dedication and hard .Realmente if a hotel in Punta Cana you can rely go will be this hotel, even I made me chicken soup chef del Vento for my daughter who did not eat for example seafood if it was the soup I had at the time they told me give me 15 minutos.Creanme no better attention out there who was always a friendly greeting and you need Sr at all times.

reviews.author: kristineg686
reviews.title: Nice to visit, wouldn't go back
reviews.text:
Overall, we had an enjoyable time.  Of the three families that traveled together, we are all in agreement that “It was nice but we wouldn’t go here again”.  

On the plus side, The pool had plenty of room all the time.  The drinks were great with great variety and not watered down in the least.  The wait staff was always friendly.  There was wait staff at the pool and on the beach that were on top of every order and provided to your every need.   There were daily activities for adults by the pool such as yoga, zumba, dance parties and for the kids such as kayaking in the pool, a water maze and inflatable jungle gym.   

The buffett was phenomenal!  You could not want for a greater variety of food!  They addressed a wide variety of nationalities, there was rapid turn over and they always had deserts galore.  

The suites were cleaned twice a day and when turn down service was performed, it was done well with a mint on each pillow.  The excursions were at an extra cost but the Pirate excursion included children free and was incredibly entertaining with petting sting rays, swimming with sand sharks, a lunch and then a jousting show on the ride home.  Definitely a must!!  

Now for the negatives:  
We made reservations for 3 families traveling together almost one year in advance with requests to be next to each other.  We were put on opposite ends of the resort and needed to beg and plead to be placed on different floors in the same building.  
 
Turn down service as mentioned before, when done was great.  However, it was done 4/6 nights and 2 of those we were in our room in our pajamas when the knock was at the door at 9:30PM.   The room is nice with a soaking tub and shower, but dated.  The shower head is low!!!  At 5’6”, I needed to bend my knees to get under it.   The toilet had poor flush.  It was clogged when we arrived and the situation was never fully remedied.  We had a partial flush for the majority of our trip.  

Out by the pool, there are no towel bins thus people leave their towels on the chairs and it appears as if they are taken.  Then they remain unoccupied for the entirety of the day.   The trash receptacles were present but far and few between thus people tend to leave trash under chairs.  Staff worked very hard to keep on top of this.   The lavatory facilities are scant and  the one by the pool is a single stall. Thus, as you swim in the pool that is HUMUNGOUS, you can’t help but think of the sewage that is accompanying you as well.   The pool has some tile missing on the chairs built in the pool and we all suffered some cuts.  

The outdoor showers were only partially functioning.   On the beach there was a lot of seaweed in the late afternoons (this is no fault of the resorts).  The resort ran a tractor every morning to remove the seaweed as best able.  However, every time we went to the water, we were accosted by individuals selling excursions, parasailing, banana boats and braids!

There is no hand book or explanation of what the resort has to offer and where to find it thus, it becomes dumb luck.  There was entertainment scheduled every night, however, they occurred willie nillie.   The one show started an hour earlier than advertised, a second never occurred as we all stood outside the theater with overtired kids that were allowed to stay up late to see it, the third never occurred at all.  Staff could never provide a straight answer and communication between staff was lacking at best.  

There were special restaurants that you were required to make reservations for.  If you get in, the food is absolutely amazing!  However, These reservations needed to be made 4 days in advance and required negotiations, begging and pleading to get in.  Once there for a 6 or 7 PM dinner, there was only 3 other tables occupied.

reviews.author: V Gomes
reviews.title: CONGRATS!!!!
reviews.text:
Excelente lugar! Hospitalidade sem palavras. 
Se querem um lugar perfeito pra ficar?! É este!!!! Sem duvidas.
Agradeço e parabenizo meu amigo (às vezes chamado de garçom) Jonatan Medina. Que foi sempre muito atencioso e prestativo - comigo e com minha família.

reviews.author: marceloK5653AP
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: Utilizamos o Royal Service. Fomos muito bem atendidos pelo mordomo Ariel Benzo sempre prestativo e bastante eficiente. Destacamos ainda o atencioso staff dos bares da piscina e da praia exclusivas do RS: Carlos Rosario, Hebreo, Lee Valdez e Martin Tineo. Foi uma experiencia unica!

reviews.author: sydneyt18
reviews.title: Destination wedding!
reviews.text:
After researching tons of different resorts for our destination wedding my husband and I decided to go with Paradisus Palma Real and I'm so glad we did! We didn't have a chance to actually go to the resort before our wedding (which I have to admit made me a bit nervous) but everything turned out absolutely perfect! Wedding planning was an absolute breeze thanks to the amazing Romance department and our wedding coordinator, Mariangel Sanchez. She was always super responsive to all my questions, I couldn't have asked for a better coordinator! 

We arrived at the resort 4 days before our ceremony and were able to meet Mariangel, and set up a time to meet with the rest of the Romance team to finalize all of our wedding details. Each night of our 10 day stay Mariangel had dinner reservations set up for us and all 50 of our wedding guests (although we weren't able to all be together because of our group size, but Mariangel always tried to get as many people as possible at one restaurant). She was seriously the best and always checked up on us to make sure we were happy and had everything we needed. Also, my husband and I opted to make our own welcome bags which we put together once we got there and Mariangel made sure all of our guests received theirs among arrival. 

Our wedding day was an absolute dream and far exceeded my expectations. It honestly could not have been more perfect!!! I got my hair and makeup done there at the Yhi Spa, they did a great job at achieving the look I was going for for our beach wedding and reception and everything held up )even in the humidity). We used their officiant who gave a lovely message considering we had never met him :). Our decorations turned out amazing, the DJ played a great selection of music at the reception- we didn't give him much direction just told him to play fun/party music. He did a great job of reading the crowd and kept the party going, everyone was on the dance floor the entire time. We used Tropic One studio (the resorts photographer) and they did a great job capturing candid moments throughout the evening, I am absolutely in love with all of our photos! We were able to view our photos 4 days after our wedding and they put everything on a USB drive for us to take home with us. 

Also, have to give a shout out to our groups' favorite bartenders Andy (aka Superman) and Solange (my spelling is probably way off) at the Gabi Beach Bar for always providing the best service and drinks! 

From beginning to end our 10 day stay at Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely amazing. After staying that long I thought we would be ready to get back home, but we had such a hard time leaving and even considered extending our trip for another week. We are already planning on going back for our 5 year anniversary :) If your considering having your wedding here and you want an easy planning process, beautiful location and amazing staff- do yourself a favor and do it here!

reviews.author: Siomaracruz
reviews.title: XVII Encuentro de la JAD en PPC.
reviews.text: Esta no esta la primera vez que tenemos el honor de tener nuestra XVIII Encuentro de la JAD en este hotel y tener como Coordinadora a Asia Mateo quien nos estuvo dando seguimiento el a;o pasado y este a;o igual UN SUPER SERVICIO Y SEGUIMIENTO POR ELLA. Tambien bien gracias  a Alexander, Angelica, Moises, Grace, Rocio, Raul Vittini, Adriana de la Recepcion, Brito y Morillo, Francisco y andri  de Banquetes  el Camarero del Restaurante The Grill que es de Neiba con un super servicio que nos dio la noche de ayer y todo el resto del equipo. Mi gente de JSAV a Maria Olga que siempre estuvo con nosotros en cada momento, Andres y el resto de los chicos.

reviews.author: Wendy R
reviews.title: Encuentro de la JaD en RD
reviews.text: Gracias a todos los chicos por su asistencia y sobre todo la colaboración de nuestra coordinadora Asia Mateo quien nos estuvo apoyando con todo junto con el Sr. vittini, Angélica, Alexander, Rocío,Moisés, Rafael, Gustavo el chef y su equipo; Grace, un chico de Neiba que trabaja en THE grill. Gracias por todo y espero verlos el año próximo.

reviews.author: Rafael S
reviews.title: La mejor convención de la JAD
reviews.text: La mejor convención de la JAD gracias a la colaboración de Asia Mateo y todo su equipo de convenciones y banquetes. Es la segunda vez que repetimos este hotel como la misma actividad.  Nos veremos el año que viene.

reviews.author: Rosario A
reviews.title: Encuentro JAD
reviews.text: Agradesco la asistencia de Asia Mateo quien se desempeño como nuestra coordinadora en el XVIII Encuentro de la JAD en Paradisus Punta cana. Tambien a quienes nos soportaron para esto fuera todo un éxito como Angelica, Vittini, Moises, Gustavo, Francisco, Rafael, Gustavo el chef y Rocio.. Gracias por todo chicos!

reviews.author: Mariano R
reviews.title: Sencillamente espectacular
reviews.text: El hotel tiene todo lo que uno busca para pasar unas excelentes vacaciones en la playa. Está decorado con muy buen gusto, muebles, objetos, cuadros, lámparas, todo es lindisimo. Las piletas muy bien mantenidas y con gran capacidad de reposeras, palapas, sombra y sol. Capítulo aparte la comida, los bufetes de desayuno y almuerzo son impecables y los restaurantes con reserva para la noche uno mejor que otro. El personal es muy atento y servicial y las actividades para niños y adultos variadas. A quien no le gusta participar tampoco sufre ya que nadie obliga y solo se utilizan pequeños sectores de la pileta o de la playa. El orden y limpieza es continuo. Las habitaciones son amplias, con un gran baño compartimentado y con buena ropa blanca. El servicio de habitación es 2 veces al día con lo cual siempre hay toallas limpias y secas en caso de necesidad. La playa está pegada al sector de la pileta, tiene guardavidas y seguridad propia, meseros que ofrecen bebidas del bar y gran capacidad de camastros, palapas y reposeras variadas. El kids zone queda un poco alejado pero te acercan en carros de golf así como a las canchas de tenis. Sin duda fue un gran acierto haber elegido Paradisus Palma Real donde volveremos sin dudarlo.

reviews.author: 806hugo
reviews.title: Vacaciones con amigos
reviews.text: El hotel es lo máximo, el servicio la gastronomia y el personal muy atento.  Destaco la atencion de Elvido , mesero del restaurante  ipanema. Tambien  Pedro pool  consierge en acompañarnos desde la llegada al hotel. Seguramente volvere por terceea vez

reviews.author: Constanza Nuñez
reviews.title: Con huracán incluido
reviews.text:
Este hotel es espectacular, buenas instalaciones, la comida es rica, el personal súper atento, ideal para ir con niños.
Pero lo que quiero destacar es la seguridad. Nos tocó el huracán Irma mientras estábamos hospedados ahí, y la verdad es que el hotel se preocupó de todos los detalles para que nos sintiéramos seguros, la verdad no nos dimos ni cuenta de lo que pasó, gracias al refugio y al plan de contingencia que manejaron.
Agradezco a toda su gente por la preocupación y calidez de su atención.
Súper recomendado!

reviews.author: Christine H
reviews.title: Must see hotel with caring staff
reviews.text: As our stay comes to an end, I have to say that Palma Real is now my favorite Paradisus. Jose Salvador, our butler at the Royal Service, was helpful and gracious during our entire stay. He and Pedro, who works at the pool at Royal Service, were definitely amazing and made our stay extra special. Shout out to Wanda for the amazing drinks. Also, Fatima and Richard at Pallazo, Anthony at Vento, and Abraham really went above and beyond for our dining experience. I can't recommend Palma Real enough.

reviews.author: jchormazabal
reviews.title: Playa piscina y relax

reviews.author: Máximo Costamagna
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente hotel y muy bueno el nivel de comida y bebida. La verdad que las playas son paradisiacas y las piletas en excelente estado. Un poquito flojo el personal que sirve en los restoranes. Felicitar a Andrés(el mayordomo que nos toco) que estuvo pendiente de que tengamos unas excelentes vacaciones.

reviews.author: Martha G
reviews.title: Férias
reviews.text: Maravilhoso resort, surpresa com tudo acomodações super confortáveis e equipe de atendimento muito educados, carismáticos e competentes em tornar as atividades alegres e prazerosas

reviews.author: JJN
reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text:
I´m so happy to have chosen The Hotel Paradisus Palma Real at my place for my holidays.
I went with my lovely wife, we both are living in NYC but she was born in DR.

The hotel is totally stunning, really awesone, everything is high level, the gardens, the perimeter of the Resort, the lounges, the restaurants, the rooms, the beach, bar, etc…
