Cheers.

reviews.author: Dayle R
reviews.title: Great vacations
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana with my family. We stayed this time at the Family Consierge building and it was magnificent, our consierge was Yarol  Rijo and definitely we would like to come back for for the way we got treated. Always nice and had everyday a little gift for the kids and they make us feel like at home .
Jonathan Medina from the pool at the Reserve was also kind and helpful and always trying to accommodate our needs when ever we were there. No way that we could have ask for more . Kids zone was definitely the favorite place for the kids, they had a blast

reviews.author: aiestrada68
reviews.title: Hurricane Irma- But Great Vacation
reviews.text:
Hurricane Irma hit the Dominican Republic during our vacation, but I would like to compliment the management team along with "ALL" the workers of the resort. The entire staff was prepared and handled the situation extremely well, which helped reduce the worry for us during this trying time. Great Job!!!

Jhonatan Medina, and Wandel did a fantastic job during our stay making sure we were always taken care of throughout our stay. Very friendly and accommodating, so thank you very much for making our vacation an "Awesome Experience".

reviews.author: Cowac
reviews.title: 5 Stars in Paradise!
reviews.text:
My wife, two children (ages 4 and 9) and I stayed in a family concierge suite near the end of August.  Our family concierge, Sofia Paternina, was absolutely fantastic!  As a matter of fact, we can't say enough nice things about her.  She helped take care of setting up everything (food reservations, cabana reservations, golf reservations/transfers, transfers back to the airport, etc) and was always available for assistance, information or advice.  On certain days throughout our stay, Sofia would leave special treats for our children.  One day it was a pair of robes and slippers with coloring books, crayons, children's soap, toothpaste and tooth brushes, another day it was a bubble bath full of balloons.  You never knew what you would find when you came back from the beach or pool in the afternoon.  Our suite was on the 2nd floor and overlooked the pool.  The pool opened around 9 or 10am and closed around 7pm, so noise was never an issue.  The suite had one room with a small kitchen area, dining table, and living room area with fold out couch and a TV.  A second room was the bedroom with a king size bed and TV.  Both rooms opened to a balcony overlooking the pool.  The bathroom consisted of two rooms.  One large room with a jacuzzi tub, two sinks and closet.  The second slightly smaller room had a shower, toilet and sink.  Overall, the suite was very spacious and we were never in each other's way.  Each night there was a turn down service and along with chocolates on the pillows, our kids were left a treat consisting of a plate of cookies and a couple of cartons of milk.  The mini bar (which was at no cost) was stocked once a day and held soda, beer, water, milk, juice and snacks. There was always plenty of bottled water available in the room but if you need more, just ask and they will bring it (as you will need it to brush your teeth).  The room also had a good size safe to store our valuables.  Although, while we were here everything seemed safe/secure and we were able to relax without having to worry.  There was free wi-fi throughout the resort and to many areas of the beach too, just be sure to get the password when you check in.
Arrival to the hotel and check in was simple.  After we arrived, our luggage was tagged and we were taken to our Reserve building via golf cart.  Each Reserve building has it's own lobby and set of concierges.  The check in area was set up well with a desk and chairs as well as couches.  Our family sat on the couches which allowed our kids to watch cartoons as we handled the necessary details.  There were also cookies and snacks available in this area too.  We were each given nice (not cheap looking) bracelets to wear for our stay and 4  plastic towel cards (the size of a credit card). The towel cards are exchanged for fresh pool or beach towels in the morning and when you return them at night you are given cards for the next day.  Having arrived late in the day and not knowing about the towel system, we went into the pool around 5:30pm and were unable to get towels until the next morning.  So, we drip dried back to our room.  The Reserve has a large pool which is about 5 feet deep in it's deepest section and a kids pools with small slides where toddlers of all ages can touch the bottom with no problem.  Reserve guests can also go to the main resort and use that pool, but we never did.  It seemed busier at the main resort pool.  Reserve guests were also given their own section of the beach which was never really busy and had it's own servers.  Travel to and from the Reserve to the main resort was done by golf cart shuttles and took about 5 minutes.  We never really waited longer than 5 minutes for a shuttle either.  There were nightly shows, which Sofia gave us information on each morning and they were all child friendly.  On nights there were no shows (2 nights out of 7), there was a beach party that started a little later.  The entertainment was pretty good for an island resort and we enjoyed it.  There were plenty of activities (painting, stretching, paddleboard yoga, dancing, etc) to do by the pool as well.  A schedule is provided when you arrive along with information on the kids club, teen club, shows and more.   I can't say enough good things about the resort.  Everything was clean, organized and excellent.  The staff were very friendly, helpful and made sure our stay was fantastic.  Cabana reservations were handled by Sofia each day.  All we had to do was let her know the day before if we would prefer the beach or the pool for the next day and she'd take care of the rest.  The next morning, all you had to do was be at the pool or the beach by 10AM and the cabana was yours.  If you're not there by 10AM, they can be taken by folks without reservations.  
A few staff should be recognized for their efforts.  By the pool, Emilio Valdez and Wander Rua really took the time to interact with us and make sure our drinks were always full.  These two gentlemen were excellent at their jobs!  Luis Pena at the Hydro Bar (located next to the Reserve pool) made our lunch each day.  After the first lunch here, we were hooked!  Hydro's offerings were limited to burgers, hot dogs, pizza, quesadillas and salads, but all was delicious!  There was also an ice cream dispenser and cones on the counter for anyone who wanted soft serve.  At the beach, Luis provided towels, brought us to our cabana and kept the drinks flowing too.  And, Daniel, who was our server at Fuego, was not only and excellent server, he interacted well with our children and made the experience fun even though we were in one of the more proper restaurants.  At the end of the trip, we really felt that we were treated like family by these staff (especially Sofia!) throughout the week and they are one of the many reasons we would come back to the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana if we return to the Dominican Republic.  
The only negative I could see is a negative you get at many island resorts.  The beach has a number of people walking by trying to sell you something (excursions, hats, sunglasses, handmade jewelry, photos with a monkey...yes, a monkey... or a parrot, etc.  They wouldn't walk into the areas of the chairs and approach you, but they would walk back and forth advertising their particular product.  Not a huge negative, but just something to be aware of.  It's not as closed to as bad as arriving through the Punta Cana airport with everyone trying to sell you a ride even though you've already booked one, but it could be annoying to some.  They weren't difficult to avoid if you didn't want to buy anything.
Thanks to Sofia, I'd give this place 6 stars if I could.  Very enjoyable and relaxing family vacation!!

reviews.author: Maria H
reviews.title: Good Hotel with excellent Staff but definitely not 5-Stars
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus from August 27th through September 3rd.  The hotel's common areas are beautiful.  We paid for Royal Service so the check-in process was painless and our room was ready when we arrived.  The staff at the Royal Service Lounge was very polite and professional.  Our butler Francis Newton was absolutely outstanding.  He truly made a positive difference during our stay. He checked-in on us everyday, made our reservations and took care of any issues or requests.  He is professional, polite and efficient, a true asset to Paradisus.  We also want to recognize Martin Tineo, the pool butler.  He's amazing!  Such a positive attitude, we never had to ask him for anything.  After the first day, he knew all our likes.  Thank you Francis and Martin!  
The staff at the buffet were so amazing!  These employees work very hard and everyone we came in contact with was polite and happily took care of any requests although they were very busy.
The hotel however needs to address a some things.  The reservation process for the restaurants does not work.  It's almost impossible to get a reservation between 7:30 to 9:00 pm in any of the restaurants.  Even days ahead of time.  In all honesty, I don't think they are even worth the trouble since the menus are extremely limited.  We had dinner at the steak house and the experience was horrible.  Not enough staff, the waiter took forever to take our order, the orders were brought incomplete, the salads were awful, most of the steaks were tough and we ended up leaving without having dessert.  We tried Oleo and did not like the menu selections.  We also ate at the Peruvian restaurant.  Much better experience, the waiter was excellent, brought us several appetizers and brought our entrees just as we requested them.  The management also needs to address staff training on food handling and invest in better refrigeration/storage areas for food.  They should also offer hand sanitizer to guests in the buffet.  Both my husband and I were sick for an entire week from something we ate, starting the day before we left the hotel.  We were so sick we had to go to the doctor.
The rooms in the Royal Service area need to be remodeled.  Our room smelled musty, some of the furniture needed repair or replacement, needed painting and overall looked worn. Not what I expected from this hotel, specially in the Royal Service area.
We enjoyed our stay despite the issues I describe above, mostly because of the hard-working staff.  We finally decided to just have dinner at the buffet which was much easier than dealing with reservations and issues at the restaurants.  However, that back-fired when we got extremely ill.  I am not sure if I would return to the Paradisus Palma Real in light of the fact that the negatives outweigh the positives for us, at least at the current time.

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Buen entrenador de gimnasio
reviews.text:
El gimnasio muy completo y el entrenador uno de los mejores miembros del hotel atento y muy majo. Siempre estaba intentando hacernos mejorar y preocupándose por qué tuviéramos agua y toallas.
Una buena forma de hacer ejercicio en el paraiso

reviews.author: Laura Lopez
reviews.title: 30th Birthday Celebration & Wedding Planning
reviews.text:
We had an incredible time at the Paradisus Palma Real last week. Our butler, Alvaro and Noelia Jimenez from the Romance team made our trip an amazing experience. After looking at a few resorts for a destination wedding, we decided to go with Paradisus Palma Real (and put down a deposit) because of Alvaro, Noelia and the rest of the staff's attentiveness, care, professionalism and vibrant personalities. 

There is something for everyone to enjoy at the Paradisus. Plenty of activities for singles/couples and welcoming for families with children of all ages. We booked the Royal Service room which included a beautiful spacious room with amazing views. The butler service was worth it. The Paradisus team gives you a cell phone where you can call your butler with requests, reservation help and pretty much anything. Alvaro never missed our calls and promptly handle all of our requests. His service was extended by everyone at the resort, especially Martin and the rest of the staff/bartenders at the Sunset Bar by the Reserve Pool. Another advantage of the Royal Service room is that you have the option to be in a more secluded adults only area or with the rest of the guests. We never had any issues reserving a pool or beach palapa. 

The Paradisus Palma Real has a luxurious feel and is very quiet/relaxing - which can be a pro/con for some. As a frequent Punta Cana visitor and resort-goer, I do appreciate a little more entertainment. Whether it be appearances by Diablo Cojuelos or live musicians, even light merengue background music - anything that brings the culture of the country to the property. There was a Dominican night which was nice - but other than that - everything was pretty laid back.  Some of the guest brought portable speakers and played music at a reasonable sound level. Their music coupled with the friendliness of the Paradisus staff and guests is what truly set the scene by the pool/beach. 

Other things to note: In response to the other comments, there was a lot of seaweed by the beach, but that's mother nature for you. This time of year is usually Sargassum season. In terms of food, all of the meals were great - Rare was was my least favorite and Fuego was delicious - you can get vouchers for lobsers. Alvaro and the staff at Vento surprised me with singing, a birthday cake and champagne. Andres Perez also took very good care of us.

Irma: Paradisus communicated extensively with us as they monitored Hurricane Irma. They worked around the clock to board up the property and provide a safe location for all guests. We were able to leave the morning that the storm arrived and experienced breakfast in one the ballrooms and they had the service down to a science. We felt safe with their handling of the storm warnings and appreciated the fact that they didn't interupt our experience at the pool or beach. They let us enjoy the property until it was time to reconvene in the Conference area for safety.

Tips: Bring small bills for tipping. A smile and an "Hola!" goes a long way. 

In summary, we really enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Palma and look forward to returning for our wedding. It's a beautiful resort and has something for everyone to enjoy.

reviews.author: Gee D
reviews.title: Hurricane Irma
reviews.text:
Had a great time thanks to Victor and Eduardo with water aerobics and yoga . They provided us with an awesome time . We laughed so much it was great. This made the trip seem so much better since we basically had nothing to do because of the hurricane scheduled to come all was canceled or closed . 
We were only able to use the Gabi restaurant buffet due to storm preparing etc. however the food was good . 
The service was some what lacking but no major complaints. 
Junior one of the servers was the best most pleasant person at the establishment . 

We only lost power for about 2 minutes and had an issue with our air conditioning unit which took about an hour or more to fix but it was fixed . 
Again lots of the same issues I had im sure had it not been because of the hurricane disruptions etc it would've never happened. Would visit again and hope to take full advantage of the other restaurants being that We were cheated this time around .

reviews.author: VeroLM81
reviews.title: Espectacular!
reviews.text:
El hotel es divino! Los empleados super atentos y amables. El lugar es impresionante! Todo el hotel es una reserva ecológica gigante con miles de ejemplares de arboles y plantas, huerta, etc.
Tuvimos la suerte de que nos hicieron un upgrade del Paradisus Punta Cana a la parte de "The Reserve". Viajabamos con tres niños pequeños, había piscina para niños, el kids club impresionante, con actividades todo el día y hasta fiestas de disfraces!! Vale la pena la diferencia de precio.
Todos los restaurantes del hotel son buenísimos, la playa, las piscinas, las habitaciones, gimnasio, en realidad: TODO!!
Volveríamos sin dudarlo!!

reviews.author: Silvia Sita
reviews.title: Um verdadeiro paraíso
reviews.text: Tivemos uma semana de excelente diversão! O atendimento foi  impecável, pois a equipa estava sempre muito bem disposta e simpática! Agradecemos a Laura, Angel e ao Cheke-Cheke pela simpatia que sempre nos doaram! Aprendemos alguns toques de salsa com os mesmos, o nosso muito obrigada! O hotel é lindo, mas fica um pouco aquém quando ao entretenimento de noite! Esperamos voltar um dia!

reviews.author: Mio J
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text:
Short and sweet - amazing time, very relaxing. 
Party of 6; 4 adults 2 children; Me, hubby, my mom, my sister, my 9 and 1 year old. 
2 rooms; master suite & Junior Suite

All the restaurants within the Palma Real complex - you have to make reservations to - were all amazing- the food was delicious-no complaints. Will provide a review at a later date with names of restaurants. 

A staff member by the name of Shaky-Shaky was very entertaining and made us feel very welcomed, he's part of the entertainment at the hotel and is very professional. Dances very well- i danced bachata with him. Thank you Shaky-Shaky. 

We met a waiter named Ronald in the buffet area also amazing service, we met him the first day we arrived and he treated us amazingly, also made us feel very welcomed. We  attended a beach dinner and he was there and made us feel very welcomed. Thank you Ronald. 

To the bartender at the swim-up bar- i don't remember his name- he was also amazing. 

Overall, the staff was very helpful, whenever we needed something more than willing to help. 

The hotel is well maintained and clean. Variety of food at the buffet and various restaurants offer delicious meals.

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Paradisus Stands Up To Hurricane - And Wins!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful property with stunning views and well appointed public spaces. The decor is very tasteful and follows a traditional-classical approach, which is much warmer and inviting than other hotels. The room was everything as advertised - spacious, in excellent condition and great views. We had selected an Ocean View room with Royal Service and we felt like royalty.

We arrived the day before Hurricane Irma passed within 95 miles of Paradisus. We were VERY concerned, as you can imagine, facing down a Category 5 hurricane with 185 mph winds. The staff were excellent. They were well prepared and very transparent about what was coming and how they would handle it. For safety, all guests were brought to a large, sturdy concrete ball room that was well setup with cots for everyone, a kid zone, back massages, endless box lunches and drinks, and an info center. Staff circulated constantly checking in on everyone and providing updated information. Paradisus weathered Hurricane Irma with minimal damage.

I was so very impressed how quickly the staff worked together to restore all the services that had been shut down in advance of the hurricanne. All the restaurants, bars, shops, pools, and beach were up and running within 2 days.

Some recent reviewers were not impressed with the staff. ALL of the staff we encountered under both life threatening AND relaxed situations were professional and focused on meeting our needs. All wore a smile and expressed genuine interest in doing whatever they could to make our stay enjoyable - both before, during, and after the Hurricane.

The DR is a great place to relax and vacation and Paradisus is, by far, one of the best, world-class resorts we have stayed in!

reviews.author: Jorge M M V
reviews.title: Felices y románticas vacaciones!!
reviews.text:
Estuvimos la ultima semana de agosto...
Nos encantó el resort, muy buenas y muy agradables todas las instalaciones... buena variedad de restaurantes y muy satisfechos con la calidad de la comida!!
El personal siempre muy atento y servicial, en especial en la playa, donde contamos con las atenciones de Daniel del Carmen, un camarero excepcional, ademas de hacer bien su trabajo es una persona muy agradable y simpática, siempre preocupado por q estuviéramos a gusto.
Así mismo, utilizamos los servicios  de Romance, donde nos atendió Julissa Santos, quien logró organizarnos una experiencia de compromiso matrimonial que no olvidaremos... son unos profesionales en esta area.

Esperamos volver muchas veces!!!

reviews.author: rarroyo74
reviews.title: Vacaciones en familia
reviews.text:
El pasado mes de Agosto estuve en este increíble hotel con gran parte de la familia, es servicio fue excelente, la atención de cada uno de los miembros del hotel fue increíble, lo cual nos hizo pasar unos días muy buenos.
Especial agradecimiento a Asia Mateo quien hizo nuestra estadía un placer.

reviews.author: lizeth M
reviews.title: Luna de miel
reviews.text: Este hotel es excelente la comida es muy buena y el servicio es realmente bueno. Tienen variedad de lugares y restaurantes tambien muchas acti vida des.  Agradecemos a pedro el es pool concierge fue muy amable igual que perez. Que es room service

reviews.author: jose luis f
reviews.title: Tornado irma
reviews.text: Por el miedo al tornado nos pasaron a the reserve , es maravilloso , desde el cuarto tipo departamento , el lugar , como un hotel mejor más chico dentro el paradisus, siempre muy bien atendidos, tranquilizando a todos poniendo buena onda a un momento que a muchos los ponían nerviosos, gracias especial a Angi de recepción que nos soluciono también el check up Hasta pronto

reviews.author: Mayra R
reviews.title: Summer vacation
reviews.text: I love this resort, we been here twice and we will be back, great employees specially Alexander Pouriet and concierge Hilario , great team love the food and drinks also , i love the shows, the Casino and the beach

reviews.author: mariag0816
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: Best vacation ever. The entertainment staff best ever always kept you busy...my favorite Alexander Pouriet. The rest of the hotel staff very friendly.  I was there during hurricane Irma and they did everything to keep us informed and had safety plan in place.  I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Swim47025
reviews.title: Magnificent!!
reviews.text: What an Amazing resort, if I could give more than 5 stars, I would! Our room (Royal Service) and Huge king size bed were awesome. From the moment we stepped onto Paradisus Palma Real property, we were treated as Royalty. All the staff were very friendly, especially, at the Sunset Bar...Wanda was Superb! Our Pool concierge, Pedro and Rafael..Awesome! Our Butler, Ariel Benzo...is Superb, Awesome and Magnificent!!! I can NOT say enough great things about everyone, especially, Ariel. They made our trip the Best.!! We will definitely tell all of our friends and family and we are already planning our next trip to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Mabcbravo
reviews.title: Nice Hotel but lacks on service
reviews.text:
I have been going to Punta Cana for 7 years. I have stayed at the Excellence and Ibero Star Grand Bavaro. These two hotels were far better than the Paradisus Palma Real
The food wasn't great, we've had a better food at the other restaurants at the grand Bavaro. Lobster is priced extra, at the Grand Bavaro, you could eat lobster for breakfast lunch and dinner. the buffet would "run out of shrimp" and wait 15 minutes for a plain cheese pizza
Don't expect to sit in front of the beach because you will never find a spot/cabana available... you need to have a concierge to get a beach bed or a good cabana at the beach front. So if you go to the beach you probably wont find where to sit. someone actually suggested to wake up at 7 am to place a towel on the beach chairs to save our spot. obviously we never made it
We stayed at "the reserve" which is supposed to be the higher end hotel, but honestly it is not worth the extra money, you are very far from the beach (around 15 min) and the food buffet is not really that much better 
The last thing I'll say is that the service is not great, staff have attitudes and they're not helpful as you would expect. we were waiting for a table and most of them were dirty, i asked 3 different guys to clean them and no one even stopped, i went to the hostess and she said (with a huge attitude) they were just too busy, so a bunch of families and us were kept on waiting. There were tables, they were just dirty.
I would say that the hotel infrastructure is phenomenal. Very modern rooms, restaurants and pools. I love the fact the hotel is green (they don't use straws anymore)

reviews.author: Marycel H
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel con puntos a mejorar
reviews.text:
El hotel es bello: desde la decoración hasta las instalaciones. También la calidad de la comida. Es un lugar ideal para ir en familia con niños. Es un entorno que combina la calidad, la arquitectura y la naturaleza. El Spa es hermoso y tiene servicio de calidad. 
Pero deberían mejorar: la limpieza de las habitaciones, el personal se pelea a los gritos y una mañana nos despertaron. También la comunicación es pésima: por ejemplo descubrimos que teníamos un lugar en la playa exclusivo "The Reserve" de casualidad. Las actividades íbamos adivinando los lugares donde se hacían porque la grilla que nos entregaron no siempre coincidía con las actividades. Los espectáculos eran un tanto pobres también.

reviews.author: Stay725632
reviews.title: Wasted my money !!
reviews.text:
Pros :
Garden grounds are nice.

Cons:
Towel hut -- Angel should be fired!
Lack of service .
Staff grouchy 
* I give up this place is not worth the energy to leave a review so stay away !!!!
I will never go back there !!!

reviews.author: Maria Angeles F
reviews.title: Muy bueno con reservas
reviews.text:
Hotel grande con muy buena playa. Como siempre hay bastante diferencia entre la zona estándar con el servicio real.  En el servicio real nunca hay problemas con nada todo es amabilidad, excelente servicio y atención impecable. En la zona familiar para nuestra sorpresa había personal que no era tan profesional como lo esperado con toques de prepotencia inesperado. Tenemos que reconocer la amabilidad simpatía, eficacia y absoluta profesionalidad deFátima del restaurante Palazzo. Gracias al chef Rafael del mismo restaurante por hacernos una estupenda y suculenta paella.
Gracias a Rafael (de la playa) por estar pendiente de nosotros, traernos todo lo que nos gustaba sin pedírselo. Increíble su atención. 
Y sobre todo nuestras infinitas gracias, nuestro reconocimiento a su trabajo, impecable profesional y admirable persona, competente, paciente, diligente: MIGUEL ABREU. Miguel nunca le olvidaremos. Nos ayudó muchísimo en un episodio delicado y tuvimos su apoyo en todo momento. Mil gracias Miguel. Que bueno que existan personas en el mundo como Vd.
Nos tuvimos que trasladar unos días al Reserve, en las habitaciones que dan al mar. Realmente hay muchísima diferencia con el Servicio Real. La habitación era nueva y enorme pero no entendemos como una zona nueva puede tener unos muebles de tan pésima calidad que las puertas se medio caían y no cerraban al igual que los cajones.
Tenía una vista al mar preciosa lastima que había una televisión estratégicamente puesta en medio de la vista al mar que te impedía verla en su plenitud, realmente un lince quien se le ocurrió la idea de poner en este sitio la televisión. Por lo demás tenía una gran terraza con jacuzzi.
Como comentaba antes había algún personaje digno de mención negativa como por ejemplo la Srta. Estrella. Me cogio el teléfono varías veces cuando estábamos en esta habitación. De esta Srta. quiero decir que era una impresentable, incapaz de atender correctamente cualquier petición, pregunta, etc. Por favor estaría bien que tomarán medidas con este tipo de personal que te hacen pasar un rato desagradable. Repito Srta. Estrella: impresentable.
Recomiendo este Resort pero ante todo el Royal Service, merece la pena.

reviews.author: HV1111
reviews.title: Amazing family trip in paradise
reviews.text:
Spent a week at The Reserve with my extended family. It was absolutely amazing and largely due to the wonderful help of Asia Mateo, who helped organize our stay and made it an unforgettable experience. The hotel was beautiful, the rooms were great (except the AC was always too cold) jacuzzi and all, the beach, the pool, and the bars were also wonderful. Don't forget to book your palapa if you want a guaranteed spot at the beach. 
The restaurants (except Passion which was an extraordinary culinary experience) were a disappointment, but the buffets were amazing (the Reserve one particularly, especially on the nights they do traditional Dominican food)! I don't think I've been to a hotel or resort where the staff were as friendly or helpful as they were here (shoutout to ASIA MATEO again!). 
Make sure you get a cocoloco cocktail at least once a day and don't forget to wear high spf sunscreen between 10:30am-2pm!! 
Would return in a heartbeat. Thanks Asia Mateo!!

reviews.author: MartinV12358
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Pasamos una semana en el reserve at pardisus punta cana a comienzos de Agosto, y que maravilla! La comida muy buena, las instalaciones limpias, todo muy bien organizado. Muchisimas gracias en particular a Asia Mateo, que se ocupo de que nuestro grupo tuviera todo lo necesario y que los eventos que teniamos planeado en familia se dieran sin incidente.

reviews.author: MiguelPalma320
reviews.title: Impresionantes jardines y atención personalizada
reviews.text: Nos hospedamos en este hotel desde el pasado 12 hasta el 19 de Agosto 201. Nuestra habitación estaba ubicada en el edificio principal muy cerca de los restaurantes y de la playa. Agradecemos enormemente las atenciones prestadas por Estrella García (Guest Services) así como Domingo Beltré (Guest Service Manager) por todas sus atenciones durante nuestra estancia. Fue un placer alojarnos en este hotel y volveremos seguro. El hotel está ubicado en una playa maravillosa. Destacamos la calidad de la comida y recomendamos acceder al Yhi Spa. Accedimos al hotel "The Reserve" dentro del mismo complejo y lo recomendamos para aquellas personas que quieran tener habitaciones con una decoración más actual. Los jardines de "The Reserve" son alucinantes y dispone de camas balinesas cercanas a las piscina que proporcionan intimidad y relax.

reviews.author: vkoka
reviews.title: God Bless the Paradisus Palma Real!
reviews.text:
Its always nice to come back to the place where you know what to expect! But this time Paradisus even did better! First of all, everybody is friendly and professional.
Lets just name a few. Shorty and Happy boy at Reserve are the best. Kids Club is amazing and makes your kids go wild and let you enjoy your vacation. Yoga and aerobic classes are superb and very entertaining Migel was great.. Angel was our concierge and he is the man with plenty of attention and patience who wants you feel special. The food is unbelievable. Fresh, delicious and very tasty with plenty of choices at the buffet. Restaurant Vento was our favorite. Dishes that even for us from
NYC makes say WOW. You feel safe, you feel special and you feel like a Royalty. I wish everybody visit Palma Real at least once to experience the Magic. God Bless and
please be safe after Irma! Special thanks to Sandra Blum. See you soon and miss you 
already!

reviews.author: Melgbs
reviews.title: Reunion Familiar
reviews.text: Hicimos una mega reunión familiar de 70 personas y quería agradecer en especial a Asia Mateo y al hotel por organizar unas vacaciones increíbles para toda nuestra familia. La pasamos buenísimo, repetiremos!!!!

reviews.author: Eduardo944
reviews.title: Todo maravilloso...!!
reviews.text: El hotel cuenta con una propuesta gastronomica de primera linea. Las playas maravillosas ,  el servicio es muy bueno y siempre dispuesto a ayudar ante cualquier requerimiento. El servicio de Family conserje es muy conveniente para todas las actividades.

reviews.author: shruti p
reviews.title: Best family vacation , beautiful resort , amazing hospitatilty
reviews.text:
We booked Costco all-inclusive vacation for 4 days in the resort and it was the most relaxing vacation I have ever done. We stayed at the Reserve which had a separate pool as well as kids pool which were awesome. There were some cool events going in the pool with music and dance. There was a kids zone and complimentary baby sitting and play area for all ages for kids. They would even have lunch and dinner for kids. The rooms were great and they will bring us a tray of fresh fruits everyday in our room. The room had fridge with juices and drinks filled up. We asked for a microwave and they provided us. We also had Jacuzzi and private garden with cabana.
The buffet was great and will always have fresh fruits. Since we were vegetarian , sometimes if there was nothing except fruits , the chef would make us vegetarian pasta on special request. The snack bar near the pool also had some vegetarian sandwich options. We were assigned a person who would make our dinner , spa and beach reservations. All you had to do is order and things will be there for you. The spa was awesome although at additional charge for massage. The Jacuzzi and sauna were complimentary. The main resort was great too and had several restaurants for us to try. There was a bigger buffet at main resorts with all different kinds of cuisines. There was Indian cuisine too which will always have some vegetarian options. The only thing it was difficult to find seating space during lunch if some conference is going around , it was super crowded. There were beautiful cabanas built all around the resort in the reserve area and the beach area and you can sit and enjoy the beauty and relax.

reviews.author: florianmayer80428042
reviews.title: Our vacation
reviews.text: Jhonathan Medina is probably the most friendly staff around the hotel! He is always kind and he mixes the best cocktails ever🤙🏼always helpful und nice, he is one of the best barkeepers I have met so far. Hoping to see him again when having our next vacation here in punta cana!

reviews.author: alkel2017
reviews.title: Family trip to Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for 7 days with my husband and our three children ages 19 to 23.   The resort is beautiful, the food and drinks really good.  Normally at all inclusive I need to make my own drinks but not here.  As for wine, the house wine is ok and the prices to buy premium wine with dinner are ridiculous so suggest you bring your own if you like decent wine  Highly recommend the Avenue bar with Martha - she will make you the best mango drinks or mojitos.  Also sit in Davidson's section for great service at buffet.   
The beach is great, could always find a shaded chair and terrific service. The pool on the other hand was next to impossible to find a shaded chair - all reserved before 900 AM. 
The resort is more suited to either an older generation or families with young kids as the night life for young adults is limited.   
The coupons advertised with the room are useless with the prices or conditions attached.  
The golf course was in great shape - we did a couple of early morning rounds.   The best excursion is the Discovery Package booked online through Viator - catamaran tour and dune buggy.   The catamaran tour was especially fun with Carlos, Pedro, Emily and Alex as fantastic hosts.

reviews.author: Juan D
reviews.title: Amazing beyond expectations
reviews.text:
This was an amazing experience. My familly (58 people) and I enjoyed every moment of it. The quality of the service was impecable, and the attention we received was beyond personalized. 

ASIA MATEO who took care of us like no one else made our stay priceless, from organizing the whole agenda for 58 people to doing personal favors to members of the family, she went above and beyond her duties to make this experience unfforgetable. She deserves special recognition. 

The other person who went beyond his duties was CHEF MIGUEL DEAÑO, who always, seriously always, had a smile on his face and genuinly wanted to make our stay special. He even cooked a special Dominican meal just for us, or rather on our request. This meal was the best we had by the way.

So yes, excellent staff, amazing place and unforgetable experience.

reviews.author: drb2016
reviews.title: 4days. Mostly excellent
reviews.text:
Room in Royal Service was superb with partial ocean view. Room service was OK. Bathroom adds were sloppy ...soap, shampoo etc not replaced well.
Palazzo restiuarant superb. Steer clear of Rare, the steak house.  Terrible food.  Main dining area was excellent food.
Beach excellent although seasonal seaweed was a pain.
Staff uniformly excellent and attentive.
I would say this is a can't miss place to stay.
Don't opt for the Reserve...Too far away. Too noisy.

reviews.author: Jonny2609
reviews.title: A Welcome Surprise
reviews.text:
After last travelling to Dominican Republic over 20 years ago I did not have great expectations, however, the hotel had good reviews and importantly to us now, a kids club :-)
IN the end we wish we could have stayed at least a week longer. The staff were very accommodating and not too pushy, many thanks to our concierge Olga Almonte who managed our restaurant and other reservations. To allow ourselves a little freedom in the evenings we asked if a babysitter could be found for the evenings, the lady, Positana, was fantastic and became an immediate hit with our 3yr old daughter. The rate was very reasonable so she came every night for three or so hours giving us some time to wonder along the beach in the evenings after dinner, something that we just could not get enough of!
The restaurants were all of a good quality but Passion aside, the buffet in the Reserve was consistently the best. It may sound odd but the choice was fantastic, sushi, sahimi, elegant salads, cerviche etc. all beatifully presented with cooked to order lobster, fillet steaks and fish alongside other dishes such as duck, pork ribs and so on. We had lunch there every day and an early lunch with our daughter where we would eat light before heading out later to the other restaurants on our own. Having a typically fussy 3yr the buffet choice was a god send, there was always something to tempt her :-)
The Kids Club was a hit, very welcoming and friendly personnel making it easy to leave our daughter for a few hours without a guilt trip... she always enjoyed herself and they looked after everyone very well including time in the children's pool area. Different activities were always on offer and it was a safe respite during the hotter parts of the day.
The Reserve is centered around a pool which was fantastic and there was always place to lie down whether you wanted shade or the sun, however, we preferred to head down to the beach. The walk was nice and only about 7 minutes but the resort laid on golf cart style transportation if you wanted. The Reserve has its own sectioned off part of the beach with plenty of loungers and service from the bar, we never had any problems with people from the beach and the hotel staff advertising the spa etc were never pushy.
The room itself was perfect, our daughter had a pull out sofa bed which was probably kingsize, and our separate room had a simply vast bed. There was a great jacuzzi tub area and separate shower, wc etc. so we never felt overcrowded. Housekeeping was great and the mini bar was always kept full with extra bottled water provided every day.
Overall we just couldn´t fault our holiday and wished it could have continued for another 10 days or so. We always like to try new places but if we returned to Dominican Republic we wouldn´t hesitate to return to this resort.

reviews.author: Reagan M
reviews.title: Third time=wedding trip!!
reviews.text:
I wrote a review back in June, but it looks like it didn't make it up??  Doing again.
This resort has everything you could ever want and more!!  Our first trip was in Feb. 2011.  Then we came back to plan some of our wedding in Feb. 2017 and our wedding is this Nov. and we can hardly wait to see everyone who has been so kind to us.  Simon at the Gabi Club was so much fun!  He really got the good vibes going in the evening and though he was busy, he made time for small talk during the day!  Ramol, Melvin and Emilio were also ready with a smile and wave when they came by. At the beach a very kind lady who served us drinks also helped me with some nasty bug bites, by putting lime juice on them for me.  Junior and a bunch of other waiters were so friendly and we never went without water or anything else we needed.  
Now about this resort!!!  This resort is a very good size, with an easy layout that you can find your way around after the first couple nights, if you travel about during the day.  The tram buses are very frequent so you won't have to wait long, and the drivers are also very friendly and helpful.  They will tell you when you've arrived at your room number if you let them know where you want to go. 
The grounds are sooo well developed, and there are always grounds keepers out doing tasks you would never think of, but it gives you more of an appreciation for the beauty when you see what hard and detailed work goes into this beautiful resort.  Say ola, and they will smile!!  Of course they appreciate the recognition! 
With so many neat pathways, and little walkways to discover and explore, even a little mangrove walk you'll have so much fun in the beautiful nature that Dominican has to offer. 
When we came back after 6 years, we were delighted to see the new Gabi Beach area!!  They put the work into this resort, which makes it easy to enjoy.

We'll see you all very soon, our Dominican Friends!
Reagan & James

reviews.author: Mrs O
reviews.title: Great stay overall
reviews.text:
This was a wonderful experience. Like everything else, there are areas that could be slightly improved but overall, we shall definitely be back. So lets start:

General
•	Everyone speaks Spanish! For me who doesn’t speak any Spanish, it was difficult communicating our needs but use google translator and you’ll be fine. 

Check in
•	After our long flight, I was just ready to get into the room. I felt that check in was a little long. They needed to make copies of our passports (not sure why) and it felt like we were receiving a lot of information when we were tired and unable to retain it. 

Room
•	The room was big and fantastic. It had plenty of space for our family of 3. The walls are a little thin and we had another family next door that was rather loud. We only had to tolerate them for one night though so we were ok

Dining
•	All restaurants on the property except 2 are included in the all-inclusive offer. The best restaurants were Fuego and Naos for dinner. Gaba club and Gaba beach were ok. Avoid Vento and Hydro Grill (food & service at those two restaurants wasn’t great). We didn’t get to try the other restaurants. 

Activities
•	My 12-year-old son really enjoyed the teen club activities. The only negative was that we tried to have him rent a bike and the guy at the bike station gave us a hard time about that (bizarre).
•	My 4-year-old daughter tried the kids club and she seemed to do ok if I stayed with her. She preferred not to stay unless I was right there. The kids seemed to be having fun and their caregivers seemed engaged. 
•	Fantastic pools
•	The beach was a hit or miss. The amount of seaweed at times was disappointing. It was a 3-minute golf cart ride from our room to get to the beach. However, there were times the golf carts took too long to come around.

Family concierge
•	This was without doubt the better part of the trip. Our family concierge Jhordan was fantastic. He always made sure our needs were met and always wanted to make sure we were aware of available activities. 

Overall, great vacation. It was rather humid so we may go back between Jan – June next time. Our swimming with the dolphin excursion was fantastic. We had an issue getting this set up and the manager at the resort was not very helpful. Trying to work directly with the Otium representative on site on getting this set up was FRUSTRATING! The parasailing with the guys at the beach sucked. Avoid it at all costs and do it with a more reputable group!! If you have kids, there’s so much for them to do so try to get them engaged with the different clubs from day 1 so that they are comfortable by the 2nd or 3rd day. Hope this helps!

reviews.author: guille2656
reviews.title: Hermosas vacaciones en familia
reviews.text: Estuvimos 9 noches en el hotel y debo reconocer que lo pasamos barbaro, la infraestructura del hotel muy linda, amplia recepcion,lindas y amplias habitaciones,muchos restaurantes y muy buenos,muy linda zona para niños y muy bien atendida,un spa de lujo (SHI Spa),lindas playas aunque el agua con algas pero los empleados del  hotel las sacaba todos los dias. Todo muy lindo pero quiero detenerme en la calidez del personal, creo que ahi esta lo mejor del hotel ( es una opinion personal), yo alojado junto a mi familia en una habitacion Junior Suite ( creo que es la mas barata) me atendieron de maravillas! Voy a ser injusto y nombrar solo algunas personas de las que trabajan en el hotel Carlos Ortiz,Daniel del Carmen,Patricia Sewecte,Juan Suarez,Nicolas Severino,Liza Hernandez,Andy de la Cruz,Liliande,Juan Mejia,Lucia Diaz,Robinson Andujar,Felix de la Cruz,Jesus Robles,Yahaira Mega,Salvedor Rodriguez,SHAKY SHAKY y LOOKY LOOKY ( Parrafo aparte para estos dos pibes barbaros siempre alegres y dibertidos haciendo divertir a todo el hotel...shaky shaky tenes que mejor un poco al boleibol   jajajaja) , Juan Guerrero ( Este señor es un encargado con todas las letras, anda todo el dia detras de los problemas para solucionarlos ) Por eso y por muchas cosas mas Gracias totales! Espero verlos pronto , si vas a Punta Cana y tenes dudas anda a este hotel no te vas a arrepentir.

reviews.author: jjjad128103012
reviews.title: Great stay! Wheelchair use and laundry ability
reviews.text:
Beautiful all-inclusive resort!  Very comfortable rooms!  Great stay!  However, you know all of this from all the other reviews.  

Dress code:  All guests dressed differently.  Some were dressed up and others were casually dressed.  All were permitted into every restaurant that we were in so don't worry if you only bring casual clothes.

Wheelchair availability:  I hoped that they would have one on their premises so that I would not have to bring one from home.  I emailed them prior to leaving and they responded yes, they could supply us with one.  This was so helpful!  It was in our room the night we checked in and they allowed us to keep it our whole stay.  Not all areas are wheelchair accessible.  Luckily our handicapped person could walk some on their own.  We also wanted first floor rooms since there are no elevators.  I also emailed about this prior to arriving so that I did not have to worry.

Laundry room use:  They have 2 washing machines and 2 dryer machines (both free) in Building 42.  It is a small room on the ground floor that was very much appreciated by me so that I could do laundry.  I never had to wait to use it (in the mornings).  Next time I will bring my own detergent and dryer sheets.

Staff:  All the staff were amazing.  

Special shout out to JOSE ADAMES (our very polite, kind, interesting, helpful, courteous, hard-working concierge) who made our stay so much better and went out of his way to make sure everything was fantastic for our group.

Second special recognition to one of our waiters, LUIS BAEZ, at the Gabi Beach buffet restaurant.  He was friendly, funny, courteous, and so fast--our water was always filled, drinks always replaced, and finished plates disappeared so quickly.  He made our meals so much better--we even chose to come back to eat here instead of one of coveted dinner reservations because Luis was working.

Again, this was a great place and I am very happy that we chose The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Anneymomo
reviews.title: Great family vacation
reviews.text: We stayed in this resort for 6 days for family vacation. With our second grader girl, we wanted to stay in a family friendly resort yet quiet enough to relax. The reserve is located rather inside of the resort, but we had a complete access to the main resort area (except for Royal service, which is only for adults).  It was a little cumbersome that we needed to take a trolley to go to the beach or restaurants at the main resort area, but later we figured out it was not too far at all to walk :) We loved the family concierge system; our family concierge, Elaine, was always available in person or by phone (we were provided with a cell phone directly connected to her). She kept spoiling and treating our daughter like a princess. We did a half-day excursion and also used a spa - she arranged spa services right away, and also rearranged our dinner to fit our return from the excursion. With her, our stay was so smooth and relaxing. A few downsides are - our room was the one which can be connected to the next room. We heard all the noises through the adjunct door :( Also, the resort is not smoke-free, and so it is hard to keep kids away from smoke.

reviews.author: Diego G
reviews.title: Y que más se puede pedir?????????
reviews.text: Realmente impresionante, un gran hotel donde el gusto, la gastronomía y la animación se merecen un diez. Su buffet es el más impresionante que he visto jamás, con una gran calidad y variedad, es realmente apetitoso....de hecho te hace dudar de ir a los temáticos que igualmente son impresionantes. sus programas de animación son de una excelencia y profesionalidad que jamás había visto

reviews.author: Maria F
reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text:
Awesome people. Stayed at the Reserve. Narciso at the pool. Junior at the bar. Frankely as a waiter and Luis Mendez at breakfast . Wonderful !!!!!! Service always 
 with a smile . Accommodating. Eager to please. Stayed with friends and family and it was the best bday ever. Rooms were clean! Staff made my room a balloon paradise for my son to enjoy my bday with me. I could not ask for more . Thank you!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Gabriel G
reviews.title: Amazing time at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Went to the Reserve in Mid-August with my fiance. The service was exceptional and the atmosphere was great. There were a decent amount of families at the Reserve, however we never felt like we were in a "kids resort". 

The food was very good at the restaurants. Junior was great with setting us up with our reservations and went above and beyond to make sure everything went smoothly. 

Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Marilyn S
reviews.title: Las mejores vacasiones en Punta Cana
reviews.text: El hotel estaba super bueno, muy buena atencion, las instalaciones muy buenas, lo que mas nos gusto fue la atencion, queremos darle las gracias a nuestro mayordomo Armando Minier por todas sus atenciones. tambie a los muchachos del restaurant Pallazo del royar senvices Junior Joaquin, Felix, Miguel, Osvaldo, Fatima, a nuetros Cheff  Alexis y Rafael, en el area de la playa a Martin y Wanda que siempre nos sirvieron con una sonrisa a la muchacha que prepara los jugos en la playa muy amable. Nos parecio excelente las habitaciones muy comodas, las piscinas igual. En el area regreativa darle las gracias a Cheky cheky  siempre animandonos con sus actividades.

reviews.author: tobyw4713
reviews.title: MOST UNBELIEVABLE VACATION EVER!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: I go on vacation a few times a year, yet never was I THIS sad for a vacation to end. Staying at the Paradisus Palma Real was the best experience ever!! It was PERFECTION!!! I went with my mother, 4 year old son, sisters, and a friend and this vacation was incredible for each one of us, not matter our age! This hotel is sooo family friendly!!! The days were packed with non stop activities from morning, until night!!! There's a kids' zone with amazing slides and activities for young children!! There are also loads of activities for adults as well. There were painting classes, zumba lessons, aqua aerobics, candle making, paddle boarding, amazing shows, a moonwalk, and face painting just to name a few. And all of it was inclusive!! But what made our vacation most memorable was their most fabulous staff!!!!! As soon as the head chef, GONZALO, heard about our kosher diet, he made sure we were well taken care of! He appointed Amazing ESTRELLA GARCIA, from guest services, who was literally the BEST, to spoil us and send anything we could possibly need to our room!! She called us each and every day, before we had a chance to call her, to see if there was anything we might need. And let me tell you, she did not leave out a thing!!! She did everything with a smile as if we were doing her a favor. LOOKY LOOKY WOWWWWWW entertained us alllll day!!!! His enthusiasm, amazing dance moves, friendliness, and never ending SMILE made us wish each day would never end. He was sooooo entertaining and so full of life. How does he have soooo much energy??? You can tell his job is his life!! Angel Oh My Gosh, Olah Olah Coca Cola, and Shaky Shaky Ayayay's spunky characteristics also contributed to our fun stay and made us have a ball!! They all entertained us and made each and every day so exciting! My son has not stopped chanting all their names non stop!! As we walked down the hallways, staff members ran to open the doors for us! we were treated so royally! All our friends who heard about our trip can't wait to experience it for themselves! We have so many future plans of different places to cover, but we''ll have to put it all on hold, because PUNTA CANA is gonna have to be out next trip once again!! We cant imagine any vacation being better than our vacation here at the Paradisus!!!!!

reviews.author: pattyc1016
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: We enjoyed our family vacation to Punta Cana. From the time we got to the hotel from the check in service, the baggage handlers, our own Family Concierge, Sonia Paternina, she was awesome. Made us feel at home from the first day until the last. Always surprising us and the kids with surprises at our room. Balloons, coloring books, cupcakes for the kids and roses, champagne and wine for us for our anniversary. The room service waiter even left us a treat in our room chocolate covered strawberries with a bottle of wine .... just because. We will definitely be going back...

reviews.author: Jackie G
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text:
This was the best vacation, EVER!!
Our butlers, Angel and Carlos were magnificent. They were attentive to our every need. They made the best recommendations for restaurants and activities. 
Richard and team at Palazzo's were great!  Richard has the most positive and authentic demeanor of any employee at your establishment. He remembered our preferences from our 1st meal.  
Wanda and team at the Sunset Bar were great. She remembered our drink / snack preferences. The entire team remembered not only food but beach preferences as well. 
Lastly, the meals were great. However, the most memorable meal was the tasting menu at Passion. I have never had a food / service experience with sure precision and excellence as I had at Passion. 
Again, I enjoyed this vacation immensely.

reviews.author: Eric M
reviews.title: Overall good stay
reviews.text:
We stayed for 5 nights at the family concierge section. The pools and outside areas were beautiful and worked well for us (grandparents and two young children included). The humidity had done a number on the furniture both outside and inside the rooms so they need to be updated/replaced. The heat made the shallow kiddie pool very warm. Overall, the property is beautiful and a much closer walk to the beach than you are lead to believe. It is in the tropics after all so if you are not acclimated, you may complain about the walk. 
The check in process was very lengthy (30 minutes) and they took far more information about us than we expected, even copying our passports, etc. I didn't expect that we would sign more forms when we arrived after I already checked in online before we arrived in Punta Cana. Let this be a warning to you and don't expect it to be a smooth process. We were not offered a room upgrade and after asking, they were not accommodating even though it was the low season. Our family concierge was Jhordan Rosario was a great guy but didn't communicate very well to us on what to expect every evening for the children. We had to constantly ask him for things. He did deliver surprises for the children every evening after our first day and with that we were grateful. 
Our first evening at the Gabi Club we didn't get a good service at all. The servers had an attitude and when we asked for drinks they not accommodating. I had to go to bar to get a beer since no one brought one to us after I asked twice. It was a terrible first impression. Perhaps we didn't have reservations but the restaurant was 75% empty, and that was definitely NOT an excuse. The rest of the restaurant experience was fabulous and we have very good service ever since then. The food was good and plenty of options. They only offer the same red and white wines (from Spain) and beer (Presidente) in the inclusive option. 
The beach was nice but had plenty of seaweed washed ashore so that was a major turn off. The beach authorities don't do a good job of cleaning and picking these these up at all. There are hawkers up and down for parasailing and banana boat rides, so shop around and haggle low with the prices. Don't expect to feel safe with the way they handle the boat rides since we flipped over on the banana boat when we arrived back to the shore and no apologies offered. Be prepared to shell out 80 to 160 USD in cash although the more legit ones take credit card (and charge more). 
The airport experience was another unexpected one. After going through customs (smooth), getting the luggage was hassle because they check every single one using your receipt tag. Then airport taxi drivers and handlers man handles your luggage taking it expecting you to go with them and ride their taxis. JUST SAY NO. No one told us about this level of harassment. Even passing the last security, someone will stop you asking where you need to go even though  you already know where to go, Just politely say you have a ride service (HIGHLY RECOMMENDED), then off you go. 
Finally use bug spray. The staff was friendly and had a great smile in the end.

reviews.author: Carlos C
reviews.title: Absolutely Perfect!!
reviews.text: I'll be honest, I almost cancelled this trip due to a few bad reviews. I am SO GLAD I didn't!  The grounds are the BEST I have seen. The hotel, restaurants, bars, pools, room accommodations and service were FANTASTIC!  We use Melia exclusively for all of our vacations outside the US and this was the best so far. A big shout out to Carmen Arias with the reservation team. We had a small mishap that kept us from getting to Punta Cana on time. She quickly stepped in and took care of us. We will definitely come back to this wonderful hotel.

reviews.author: Angel T
reviews.title: Best Hotel out of the various Melia Hotel in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Great lobby welcome, excellent pools, restaurants and cuisine is very good. The Royal service ocean front rooms are worth the extra money but if not any room I have stayed in has been good. Some rooms are far from the lobby. 

This Hotel in my opinion is better located and has a more enjoyable feel to it than the Reserve at Paradisus. 

Do not confuse this Hotel with the Paradisus Punta Cana. Same company different hotels. Melia has like 6 different Hotels in the same section of Punta Cana.

reviews.author: michael g
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go!!
reviews.text: Let me start off by stating that this was one of our better vacations.  Our last vacation was at the Breathless Riviera Maya which had its issues and prior to that we were at the Now Jade at Riviera Maya which was awesome. The choice was between the Now Resorts, The Level or the Palma Real. I booked the Palma Real Reserve however upon check-in we were upgraded to the Royal Service section which was not in the reserve area. I was skeptical as first but was happy that they did. Our butler was Argenis and he was an amazing host. A true gentleman and there are not words to describe the level of service he provided us.  He had a nice set up in place for my wife with balloons and rose petals for her birthday that passed.  Also there was Wanda, Nicholas and the rest of the gang at the Sunset bar.  Those guys were awesome and funny as well. I wish I can remember all of their names. Wanda and the whole crew at that bar made us feel like guests at their homes rather than a typical tourist. The food at the steakhouse was excellent and the buffet was good however there was not much of a selection of typical Dominican dishes or desserts. As far as negatives I would have to say that the location of our room was a ways out.  We were on the 3rd floor and making that long walk after a long day of activities was not pleasant. The room was slightly dated but nothing to complain about.  The entertainment of the resort at night was average. The djs at night need to update their music selection and there was hardly any music playing at the resort during the day.  The constant selling of excursions by outside vendors was annoying. I would definitely come back for sure. Gracias Agenis, Wanda y etc. por todo!

reviews.author: B9361ADmonicac
reviews.title: Amazing resort and outstanding service
reviews.text: The gentlemen that helps throughout our entire stay was Julio Aponte. Great attitude and super attentive. He always made sure that the 3 of us were always comfortable. We are missing him all the way from Miami, FL

reviews.author: Jheyson C
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Estuve alojado en The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana de vacaciones en Agosto 2017. Tenía muy buenas espectativas del Hotel y realmente fue tal cual lo esperaba. El resort es muy grande, por lo que recomiendo se alojen como mínimo 1 semana. La habitación (One Bedroom Suite) es bastante amplia, cuenta con jacuzzi, sala de estar, terraza o balcon. Mini bar incluido con reposición diaria. El area The Reserve esta enfocado para familias con niños, por lo que si viajan en parejas es recomendable que se hospeden en el area de Royal Service (solo para adultos).

Con respecto a los restaurantes no alcance a visitarlos todos, estuve en Bana (Japones), Mole (Mexicano) y Fuego (Latin Fusión). De los cuales los 2 primeros super recomendados (Bana y Mole), el último me parece que puede mejorar la comida por tal les sugiero reserva alguna de las otras opciones de restaurantes. 

La atención en la playa The Reserve bastante buena, tienes meseros a disposición los cuales te colaboran con las bebidas que desees. Deportes nauticos no motirizados estan incluidos, les recomiendo el catamaran para el cual deben saber usarlo; y en caso de que no sepan pagan una clase inicial solo la primera vez (aprox 35 usd). La playa aunque es muy linda y de arena blanca, tiene bastantes algas, las cuales para mi opinión dañan un poco la belleza del lugar.

Realmente el sitio es un paraíso y sin duda lo recomiendo para cualquier persona.

reviews.author: Kelguzman
reviews.title: Opinión
reviews.text: La comida y la atención bien, pero las habitaciones tienen que remodelar, poner más variedades en el snack bar de la habitación, almohadas más confortables entres otros, es decir el precio está muy elevado para lo que te brindan

reviews.author: Mauricio C
reviews.title: Very nice hotel!!!
reviews.text:
Checkin - It´s a little bit confuse. It took time to do the checkin
Room - Awsome.Clean, big
Service - I´d like to thanks Gustavo Rivera to be our concierge facility. He help us along our stay.
Food - Excellent. Not to complain
Drink - I missed 2 things in this subject: no menu for drink. No natural Juice and Coconut water. 
Location - Good located. Bavaro beach
Beach - OK. Too many seaweed on the water.

reviews.author: ReviewsbyTC
reviews.title: Brilliant Family Time
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort to celebrate the first birthday of our niece. We spent 5 nights here and thoroughly enjoyed it. The rooms were huge and we had a 1 bedroom apartment. The bathroom are also big and spacious and the toiletries and good quality as well. We had an all inclusive package and we made the most of the restaurants which were included in the package. The buffet restaurant is great and offered a great variety. The other restaurants are equally good and food is fine. The bars on the swimming pool are huge and serve great drinks. The staff did a fabulous job and decorated the room for our niece's birthday. All in all a great place to stay,

reviews.author: Anton S
reviews.title: Идеальное место для отдыха
reviews.text:
Не в первый раз в Доминикане, поэтому хотелось не разочароваться после первого отеля: прекрасного Barcelo bavaro palace deluxe. 
Могу сказать что отель оставил прекрасные воспоминания о себе! 

Номер: The reserve garden view. отличный большой номер с джакузи и видом на сад. кухня+спальня+гардероб , джакузи и душевая кабина. в номере 2 тв. отличный wifi! в этом аспекте переплата за Reserve оправдана

рестораны и территория: территория фантастическая. огромный заповедник живой природы , плавают черепахи, гуляют фламинго. потрясающе. что касается ресторанов, их много, все очень хорошие. Для Reserve есть свой бассейн ресторан и бар. В Ресторане чуть более изысканные продукты и премиальное обслуживание, плюс сам ресторан выглядит круто. по напиткам нет разницы. Свой бассейн хорош тем что там нет муравейника, тихо и спокойно. 
Еды не очень много, но самое лучшее и нужное есть. мясо салаты раки кальмары креветки роллы и тд 

Пляж: он огромен и красив, много баров и инфраструктура, отличное обслуживание. для Reserve есть свой пляж, из плюсов опять же тишина и покой, получше лежаки, носят напитки. в остальном анаогично. опять же в наличии прекрасный wifi!

reviews.author: sadjaye1
reviews.title: First family vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I took our first family vacation here with our 1.5 year old daughter. We were looking for a place that was family friendly, and this more than that. The staff was extremely accommodating and friendly. We used the kid zone every day we were there. They have activities for little one as young as 1!  Food throughout the resort was really good with a lot of variety. The beach was a a 5 minute ride in a golf cart and was also very nice. Plenty of cabanas. My one complaint was that the only place to get beach towels was extremely far away from everything. There really should be a more central location for towels. The room itself was really spacious and comfortable. It did seem like some corners were cut with cleaning ( dirt in corners, leftover juice box in mini fridge, etc).  

Overall it was an amazing vacation with something to do for everyone. We will most likely be back and would highly recommend to anyone looking for a family getaway.

reviews.author: cesar M
reviews.title: Great Summer vacation!
reviews.text: From the time my family arrived in country, we were treated like VIP's. The staff at the Reserve went out of there way from day one. Director of Hotel Amparo Artiles coordinated our pickup and dropoff at airport. She also arranged our daily activities to keep our selves busy for our 8 day stay. Hotel Manager Martin arranged special breakfast for us and a romantic pool side dinner. Martin and the (2) concierge that were assigned to us Genaro Gill and Yessica Reyes saw to our every need. All of the hotel staff were professional and extremely friendly and courteous. The hotel itself was beautiful and clean. The grounds were beautifully manicured.  I would definitely return with my family, hopefully sooner rather then later.

reviews.author: Marquietta T
reviews.title: DIVA TRIP
reviews.text: I was there about two weeks ago and I had the best time.The hospitality there was great, especially our butlers Carlos and Angel who were spot on on telling us all the locations there and had great recommendations as well, also the restaurant Palazzo were our waiter Richard was outstanding and very fun and funny. The drinks at Sunset bar by Wanda was amazing. I definitely can't wait to go back there. So if you visit paradisus Palma real anytime soon please look or request these people because they are outstanding.

reviews.author: Kenneth C
reviews.title: Excellent resort but there are some things to keep in mind
reviews.text:
I've been to the Dominican republic three times along with having a friend that lives in Santo Domingo. My friend told me some key things that everyone should keep in mind when visiting the Dominican republic.
 -Most if not all locals know each other
 -when you want to leave the resort make sure you are in a vehicle or with another local (my friend is a local and tries not to walk around outside with the risk of less fortunate residents robbing/scamming you)   
 -when outside of the resort do not flash valuables
 -stay alert
 -Tipping and kindness go a long way because half of the staff does not receive tips.
   They will treat you like royalty. So always bring a couple of dollars with you to tip if you want to be treated like a king or queen. FYI if you tip there's a good chance other staff will find out and pamper you too.
 -Stay away from the tap water and the yogurt. Your stomach will not be happy.
 -During the beginning of your stay they will have a representative kiss up to your family in hopes of inviting you to breakfast at a different resort to sell you a "flexible time share"
 -There are other restaurants besides the buffet which are all excellent but require a reservation. The reservation system is not the best due to a delay in receiving our reservations and us receiving other guest's reservations.  
 -Over pack on sunscreen and bug spray. you will NEED it. Though it is sold at the resort, they inflate the prices a lot. 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
As for our stay I came here with my wife and son. We had a beautiful room that was a one bedroom suite. Everything in the room was excellent but there were a few minor cons.
 -The faucet sprays in an annoying manor.
 -Your fingers can easily get caught in the sliding closet doors if you're not careful. Hence my son getting his finger caught in there twice.
Overall the cons should be over looked due to everything else being flawless.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

reviews.author: J & K
reviews.title: Our 4th visit to the reserve in DR, this last time in punta cana!!!
reviews.text:
This is Our Honest Review from a married chef couple with 3 kids (12,4,2) from Nyc. We were Greeted by Willys Rodriguez the most calm, sweet, professional and helpful representative by far (after a huge flight delay and getting lost on how to get there).

I have to start by saying THANK YOU Silvio, Catalino, Chef Manuel, Chef Miguel and Chef Nalsiso without you guys our stay wouldn't be so Perfect. if something happen the fix it right away (communication is the key). we just came back from a long family vacation to remember. we have visited the reserve palma real but this resort is way much better because of their humble and honest hospitality from most of the staff, that being said we were so happy to meet the following;

BY THE POOL: *Raynol: very lovely, friendly and attentive making sure we join the activities to have fun *Alexander: he's just amazing, always making sure everything was on time and on point. *Naomy: my candle girl, her happiness shines bright *Luis: Best teammate for Raynol, friendly, funny and together they make all the guest enjoy the activities *Pastora: best facial ever, she have magical hands. *Picasso aka Emilio valdez since i asked him for a beer at the painting class (which was awesome and relaxing thanks to my husband) we connect to the best, he make our days by the pool better, excellent service and positive attitude.

THE RESERVE BEACH: dinky-dinky the best waiter we were only few times to enjoy the view, because our kids doesn't like much but it was peaceful and relaxing. also Jonathan by the Royal Service and his boss (he gave my hubby two coconuts on his bday without hesitate and that was a kind gesture)

KIDS ZONE: the girls were all amazing and lovable, our kids enjoy their time specially cesar with jack and cappuccino. they had a blast all the activities for kids are really cute.

BANA RESTAURANT: we went twice because of Chef Rafael (6 stars for you) he is respectful, super fun and simply the best. the way he cooks just let you wanting for more and his show OMG we (all) love it, waiters & hostess excellent. we even see rafael the last night in the train and he run to us to say good bye and give us a hug (awww) that made us so happy. 

VENTO: everything was super delicious (went twice too) severina invent a chinola sangria upon my request and let me tell you that it was just how i wanted it, we asked for more. thanks flaca, liz, the hostess and the other tall flaca we were happy with the service.

The GRILL: we went twice i can honestly say the best crew for bday celebration and our waiter Darling was wonderful lots of knowledge and also really sweet with our kids, hostess ruth very sweet and happy.

AQUA: pizza and carpaccio were our favorites, but pasta needs to be al dente.

FAMILY CONCIERGE: Thanks to Stephanny for the outstanding communication/ accommodation before arriving and also the warm welcoming, she assigned us Sandra we were not happy at all (she did what she was supposed to do, but she wasn't honest in a few points kind of hypocrite and also we have to be on top of her when is supposed to be the opposite. at her leave august 28 she didn't even say good bye to us after tipping her in the morning at the kids zone, neither introduce the new concierge Elaine).

On the bright side Elaine: she was Wonderful, Caring, Professional, Sweet and Willing to make us feel extra special (good morning msg, making sure breakfast was perfect, cava just because with strawberries to say have a great day!!, greeting us and our kids with kindness all the time and taking care of last minute reservations) Elaine is Really a Concierge and we would we trilled to have her the next time. we also meet yarold, jordan and martin they are always willing to help even with a call to the cart, happy Concierges and i love to see that.

YHI SPA: Pastora made the arrangement for our complimentary massage with two gems: Rosa & Yocasta and all our stress went away, Paula receive us with cordiality we change and enjoy. they offer pineapple tea and aloe water a must try. next time we will indulge more.

I have to keep talking about the people who made our stay unforgettable because the things we value are food and service.the bartenders were also Fantastic and you can see everybody is working so hard to make your stay memorable.

GABI CLUB: Catalino i thank you every day to please us like royalty, without you and the chefs our meals wouldn't be the same. the servers were great always greeting and remembering our needs, special thanks to: Anyolina, Maria, Severina, Sija la flaca, all the waiters were awesome too and also our lovely Maria from room service (she's was above and beyond making sure our breakfast was perfect every morning in the room) and last but not least Rafael delivering at night and the morning lovely guy too (sorry i don't remember his name but he was fantastic).

My Only Complaint goes to Catalino’s boss (don't know his name) and the new girl his training for captain (wrong decision) ‘Jessica’ <--this person is very rude and disrespectful and also roll her eyes on me (you can tell her lack of experience and devotion for service) I express to him (catalinos boss spaniard guy) a situation that happened and he started to defend her and i was like really? and he just behave like he doesn't care about what i said. we are in the industry too and manners are the 1st step.we did not let that bad attitude from jessica ruin our last two days because i can honestly say we had a Blast!! 

My Favorite Parte My husband #36 Bday Celebration: wow, wow, wow we couldn't be more happy and spoiled!! Catalino, Silvio, Chef Miguel and all the staff involved was everything i wanted and a little more. Bday Dinner was Marvelous (the best ribeye and gambas ever) chocolate cake was amazing. Imperfectly Perfection at its best, can't guarantee to be back soon but unit next time Punta Cana!! 

Kind Regards,

Jose, Karla, Cesar, Alonso & Adeline 
          (The Lizardo Family)
