reviews.author: Alexandra_ELNEW
reviews.title: Family time at Paradise
reviews.text:
We decided to book here because i had just came back from Paradisus in Playa del Carmen and loved the service there.

I am tempted to rate the hotel a three star rating because of better experience at other all inclusives. If i had not traveled to better resorts then i would think this is a four star rating. This property has some great areas and some that need major work.   

 The service here is good but not the same as their location in Mexico. I sent three messages via email and was not responded to. Only when i reached out to the Reserve were we able to get a few cold answers. As a Beneficiary (sis works for the company) i thought perhaps service would be stepped up, i was disappointed in that regard as we did not receive an acknowledgement. Working in the hotel industry i expect more, and other locations i have reached out to (not Melia), have really stepped up their game. This place missed that connection. A greetings from a manager, a note saying welcome to the hotel, here is a complimentary fruit (anything). Here's a two dollar bottle of liquor but nothing. 

The cab ride from the airport was 30 US dollars and was no more than 20 minutes. Upon our early arrival our room was not ready, we arrived at around noon, (yes they had been informed of our ETA. They did offer a hospitality room where you can change and shower and store your bags, I thought this was a nice touch, but thought that they must be used to people arriving and the rooms not ready. 

We went to have lunch and then enjoy the resort while we waited. And boy did we wait. Our room was not ready until almost 5pm. The agent that checked us in Milton was very nice and was able to upgrade us to a one bedroom suite. I found out from another guest where i needed to go to make dinner reservations. I head there as this was the first time i was staying in a resort where you had to make reservations for Dinner. As i sat with Esteryln i felt like i was begging for time slots, i did not feel welcomed at all. 

That first night they did not have anything open but we had managed to already make friends with Johnny at the buffet who told us that he could accommodate us at Rare that night. The food was good, although they have a lot of add on's that you can pay for such as lobster and other meat cuts.I was disappointed that it wasn't included in the price since this place wasn't cheap. Johnny was very attentive and my daughter ordered two pasta plates and they did not hesitate. 

I did notice that you got better treatment from the staff once they knew you were tippers, i don't blame them, but i felt that some of the staff did wait around for that mandatory tip. From the guys at the buffet to the wait staff at the beach. 

I do want to talk about the room service menu. A hotel this size should be ashamed to charge 5 dollars for every time you order from their tired menu. I have been to over 10 all inclusive resorts and this is the first time a see there is a charge. Which i don't understand. I am already tipping the guy between 5-10 dollars for bringing me my food. i have attached the late night snack menu, its completely awful, for a family that does not eat anything pork it is even more limited as everything is pre-made and they cant remove the pork option. We would order at least 2 times a day, and after the second day we had ran out of options. The person who puts this together should think about the fact that people on vacation want to eat snacks, they want to have food that goes with liquor. 

The room was very spacious and the bed was very comfortable. The shower was great. Every night when we left the room for dinner we would call for turn down service and extra towels. We have no complaints about the housekeeping. 

Our mini bar was stocked more consistent once they realized we liked snacks and liked club soda. One day they called and asked if we needed anything and a few minutes later the minibar guy came with about 10 different snacks for my ten year old daughter. Chocolate milk, cookies, chips, nuts, juices, pringles, oreos. That was a nice touch. 

The pool area: Everyday people go and place their items  and beach towels to reserve a spot. I notice that for hours many of these chairs go unattended. I later noticed people coming, talking to a pool waiter and him walking them to a chair and that they were tipping them. Management should make sure that this does not happen, again this is because they are wanting tips. Management should go around and collect the towels that are left unattended from chairs. That is why the towel hut makes it such a problem to give you one extra towel. Everyday it took me 5-10 minutes just to give my room number and get towels. They are limited and the attendees seem to be bothered to do their job. Isn't this the reason i wear a bracelet? to show i am staying here? Why do i need to wait for you to spell my name and look over the list to make sure i didn't ask for more than the allotted towel. The attendees just sit on the table laughing and talking to each other and roll their eyes when you come up to ask for a towel. 

We made friends with the life guard and he saved us a spot, but of course at a price...a tip. The drinks waiter was very nice and kept coming and refilling our cups. I would however recommend they switch their paper cups to plastic cups. During lunch hour they come around with Pizza pies, which i have to say is much better than the room service one, and absolutely delicious, it was always super nice and hot. I always enjoyed when the music was played. 

I wanted to use this vacation to wake up early and continue my workout routine. On my second day i signed up on the app for their spinning class. I realized that i forgot my sneaker at home, they had no options for alternates for me, which i want to point out that at hotels of this caliber they should have loaners. I had to use my daughters shoes. As i showed up 15 minutes early to the 8am class the instructor said i needed to sign up, i showed him that i did on the app and he said ive worked here for 3 years and i have never seen that app. I was annoyed. I was able to get in the class though cause some people didn't show up. Its very sad to say that most of the spinning bikes are rusty and broken. The instructor did't even have a good working bike cause he lent his out to someone. The instructor was great and had potential if he had given the right tools. It sad because they have the space, willing participants, but the machines are broken and useless. 

I had read that their was a place near the hotel called Capitan Cook where you could get delicious lobster and fish. My husband and daughter headed out the beach to the left and walked for 40 minutes, and finally arrived at a small hut with no sign. But let me tell you, it was well worth the walk. I highly recommend it. We had four alcoholic beverages, two appetizers and one huge platter consisting of two lobsters, two fish, calamari, large prawns and shrimp, salad, fried potatoes. We paid 170 with tip. The cab ride back was 10 dollars. 

We also had a dolphin excursion included for two with our room reservation. I want to point out that you must book this the first 24 hours of arriving. The tour agents, want to make pretend they are too busy for you and they want you to miss your tour so that you have to pay them again. Do not be fooled, make sure to print your voucher and book it immediately. We did enjoy the tour and got to even snorkle with sharks and manatees. We left early in the morning and were back by 12;30pm. Some word of advice, do not bring any valuables, or bring a lock. They make you take everything of value off and leave it in the locker that is not attended. They wanted me to take off my engagement ring cause it scratches the dolphins. I did not feel safe leaving anything. The dolphin pictures are pricey, expect to spend $75 for a CD of about 50 pictures for 2 people. 

On another day we booked with a lady that walks the beach from the acuatic scuba center. She was nice and not pushy. Zaya i think is her name. We booked the why not party boat, with snorkling. We had such a great time. They had dancing and drinks and were a lively bunch. I highly recommend it as it was very family oriented. 

This resort had nighly shows (Queen show was very good!!) and had music at the bar in the main court yard. We had lots of fun people watching. Every night we would visit the amazing Starky at the vento/passion bar , he had all types of tricks for drinks, and goes out of his way to make you yummy drinks. This guy was what gave this hotel that 4 star. 

We enjoyed the habachi food but it was so unbearably hot and humid we skipped dessert. The food at Fuego was also good for both lunch and dinner, on our last day a guest told us you could order a seafood platter that was not advertised bummer! We did not like the food from Olio and would suggest you skip it. The service was lacking and the waiter desperately tried to push us to purchase a bottle of wine. 

On one night we decided to skip the adult only dinner and eat at Naos, what a pleasant surprise, they had lobster tails, and you could eat it at your hearts desire. Our waiter Rafael Castillo quickly got us a bottle of white wine and made sure we had our plates cleaned and was very attentive. 

Over all we had a great time, we made the best of everything and enjoyed the beautiful property. The service needs to be tweaked here and there. We did not see management walking around like other resorts and i think that's where the disconnect was. On a side note, i had two of my hats stolen but i do not know if it was from the room or the beach, just watch your belongings. Make sure to use the safe. Bring lots of singles if you want an improved service, as money talks.

reviews.author: Julian F
reviews.title: Concierge and Kids Zone - Perfect!
reviews.text:
Everything about our stay was so easy!  For me, that’s paramount for a successful vacation.  From the moment we arrived, my daughter and I felt at home and all of our needs were anticipated.  We stayed at The Reserve, and had a Family Concierge (we had a 1BR).  Jhordan, our concierge, met with me the first day to help me pick out our dinner reservations, explain how to reserve palapas at the beach and pool, and discuss the details of the special birthday surprise he planned for my daughter’s 6th birthday (which was the second day we were there).  He and another staff member decorated our door and suite with balloons, cards, and streamers.  He had a chocolate and strawberry cake delivered (her favorite!), and ran a huge bubble bath with balloons in it.  

Continuing my daughter’s awesome birthday experience, Martina and the rest of the staff at the Kid’s Zone were amazing (every single person at the Kids Zone was engaging, friendly, and energetic)!  Upon hearing that it was my daughter’s birthday, they put together a fantastic birthday party for her, with just a few hours’ notice.  Cake, singing, dancing, a personalized photo banner – couple with the five-star treatment from Jhordan, my daughter said, “This is the BEST BIRTHDAY EVER!”  Not sure how we’ll possibly top this!  More generally, I felt safe and comfortable leaving my daughter at the Kids Zone for extended periods of time (any time I showed up to get her, she looked sad and begged to stay!).  The Kids Zone has a schedule of activities, and when we sat down to look through it and pick out the events that my daughter was really interested in, we had almost the whole list circled!  Pizza making, cookie baking, art, swimming, pajama party, pirate day, and tons more.  I brought a set of walkie talkies that we use while camping, so that my daughter could get in touch with me if she needed anything.  She used it only once, to say, “Hi Mommy, you’re not coming to get me now are you?  Ok, good, love you!”  I don’t think I’ll ever be able to take another vacation with a Kids Club like this!  

Everyone we encountered spoke very good English (much better than the Spanish I attempted, but they were very good humored about my mangling of their language!).  The food was mostly good, but nothing in particular stands out; I like spicy foods, and with a big resort like this, they tend to cook toward the very, VERY mild end of the spectrum.  The buffet was perfect for breakfast, we usually ate by the pool for lunch, and we tried out a few different restaurants for dinner.

Overall, we had a fantastic trip and are very likely to stay here again!

reviews.author: mmvpp
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Resort in DR
reviews.text:
I stayed here from Aug 31 to Sept 7 in both the main resort as well as the Reserve.  I will only put the highlights of the main resort here and my experience at the Reserve under the Reserve review. 
The resort was pretty empty, probably about 40% occupancy. Things are always great without the crowd.  So this review might not be accurate for you if you plan to stay during busy season.

AIRPORT - immigration was quick.  We purchased the tourist cards online so we didn't need to purchase there but I saw the tourist card line wasn't long anyway.  There are airport staff at the luggage carousel who can help with your bags. You can either say No Thanks to them and do it yourself.  I just let them help and gave $1 per bag for tips. 

TAXI - I just took a taxi there, quick and easy, no wait.  They would show you the fare which is $30.  The airport and the transportation there seemed to be pretty organized. 

CHECKIN - Since the resort was not busy, the checkin was a breeze.  I did the online checkin prior to arrival which seemed to speed up the process since they already had all my info.

ROOM - The room was clean.  Welcome fruits and chocolates. Sofa bed already rolled out for the kids. 

FOOD - the food was great, very nice buffet at the main section, plenty of seafood.  no complaints.  I also tried Bana (Teppanyaki), Fuego (Latin) and Agave (Mex). They were all great.

SERVICE - All very nice people. I didn't meet any bad ones.  They don't expect people to tip. Of course you are free to tip if you are very satisfied with their service.

RESTAURANT RESERVATIONS - Some of my reservations were as late as 8:30pm since we were told they were all booked up (how could that even be possible with the resort nearly empty???).  We just went to the restaurants around 7pm and had no problem getting in and as you might expect, empty restaurants. 
The management really needs to look into the reservation process.  There is only one rep at the lobby doing the reservations and as you can imagine, it could take 10-15 mins to serve just one guest since each guest would need to book multiple nights and for some reasons the rep had to make calls to the restaurants for inquiry.  It looked like they were not all computerized. I could imagine how frustrating it could be during busy time.

MOSQUITOES - There were none in the main resort section.  I guess they did a good job spraying.  I sat outside for dinner couple times without any bites.

EXCURSIONS -  We did Horseback Riding, Dolphin swim and Saona Island.
Horseback Riding was fun but even with bug spray, I still got a lot of bites because the horse attracted a lot of them.  I would recommend long pants and sleeves.
Saona is a beautiful place but I think it is overrated.  It is not a place for snorkeling.  You would only find a few fish here and there.
Dolphin swim by Dolphin Discovery was fun. It is a very well-run place. Of course the photos are totally absolutely extremely expensive BUT you can always negotiate!!! Don't just buy with their prices.

SHOWS - Great shows.  Michael Jackson show, Lion King, Circus and dancing shows.

POOLS - there is a main pool by the beach, a tiny baby pool and another pool for Family Concierge and Reserve members. Besides the baby pool, the other 2 pools are quite deep (1.45 m).  There isn't much shallow area.  My kids can swim, so not really an issue but for people with kids who cannot swim, it might be a turn off.  There is a kids pool area at the Reserve section which is more suitable for kids.  Non-Reserve guests can use the kids club but I am not sure if they can use the kids pool though.

KIDS CLUB - a lot of activities e.g. rock climbing, painting, etc. and nice staff.

BEACH - nice beach with super fine sand. Yes, there is seaweed but this is nature.  We didn't get a chance to try any water sports there.  Since the resort was not busy, we had no problem finding seats at the beach.

WIFI - WiFi was great and available everywhere in the resort and is included.  

TV - there are New York CBS/NBC/ABC channels as well as a couple of kids channels in English.

RESORT CREDITS - it is a joke. I didn't use any.

MISC. - Do not expect people to speak English.  You are at a foreign country.  Most taxi drivers and ground staff simply don't speak any English. Only people at front desk know English.  Restaurant servers only speak simple English.  Hand signs and a smile always work!

Overall, very nice resort, beautiful ground and decent food. Very friendly staff.

reviews.author: mjjackson2
reviews.title: September 20, 2016
reviews.text: I can't say enough about how much we enjoyed this resort!!!  It was absolutely beautiful!!!  We did not want to leave.  We added the Royal Service once we arrived, but in opinion, you only need it during the peak season.  We went in September so the resort wasn't as crowded and we were able to get bali beds on the beach and my husband and I like being around other people so being on the private beach with hardly anyone there wasn't a big requirement for us.  If you love and absolutely have to have privacy, then I would definitely say to add the Royal Service.  Also, I did read that it would be cheaper to add it once we got there, but that wasn't the case for us. I wish we had added when I actually booked the trip.  We did like having the extra peek of having a private butler to cater to our every need.  He was absolutely awesome!!!  His name was Alexander Gusman and he made sure that we had everything that we needed and even ran us a very romantic bath two nights while we were at dinner, with the flowers and roses as an added touch.  He also made sure that we had dinner reservations at the restaurants we requested.  Being Royal Service guest, we also had access to The Palazzo restaurant.  The hostess there named Zenoria Nova was absolutely the sweetest!!!  I actually really miss seeing her face greeting us every morning for breakfast.  My only hiccup with the resort as a whole was the food.  On a scale of 1-10, I give it a 6.  The food could have been better.  Our favorite restaurant as far as taste was Bana, the hibachi restaurant.  The food there was incredible!  My husband and I are planning to go back because we enjoyed the overall experience so much!!!  I highly recommend this resort.  Just be careful of the scammers and those trying to sell things along the beach.

reviews.author: Lixamaya
reviews.title: Conseerge y personal e instalaciones
reviews.text:
Agradezco las maravillosas atenciones de nuestro conserge Yarol quien hizo de nuestra estadía en el hotel un verdadero paraíso, con su amabilidad y disponibilidad para resolver todas nuestras inquietudes.

Las habitaciones super reconfortables, me sentí como en casa con sus amplios espacios y la atención en la recepecióny en todo los restaurantes, excelente.

Gracias por hacer de nuestras vacaciones un verdadero descanso y confort.

reviews.author: atlblack5
reviews.title: DR at its best
reviews.text: First time here and it was great.  The staff was excellent.  Tomas at the Gabi Resturant was always there for us and kept the mimosas coming.   Very clean resort, great staff and beautiful beaches.   Leonardo and Luis at the swim up bar were excellent also.  Plan your trip, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jeff P
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: Wow!!  This resort is amazing all around.  Everything is very clean and well kept.  Our room was on the first floor just off of the main lobby which was a perfect location to all of the amenities, mere steps away from the pool.  We had a junior suite, garden view with a king bed.  Hint: tip the maid daily as well as leaving a tip in the mini fridge pays off for some extras, a small price to pay to make someones day and having extra beer, water and pop for mixers. Restaurants: The main buffet was excellent for breakfast and lunch each day.  Ferder was excellent and always had a table ready for us as we approached.  He also remembered our drinks by the second day and had them served by the time we returned with our food.  As for dinner, we visited several of the restaurants and all of them were excellent with the exception of Rare, stay clear unless you like your steak rare as any more cooking didn't seem to be an option even when ordered medium or even medium well.  Blue Agave, mexican restaurant, has the best shrimp burrito and order the chocolate cake in a coffee cup dessert, to die for.  Bana, teppanyaki style, was amazing all types of meat, veggies and fried rice you can handle, our favorite by far.  Olio, Italian style, has excellent pasta dishes and hand made from scratch pizzas.  The pool bar was our main hangout from late morning into the afternoon and sometimes until dark.  Rudy German and Louis make several fresh fruit and rum inspired cocktails that will keep you daydreaming of this vacation.  Gustavo is another pool bartender that is on top of his game and will keep you refreshed.  All three of them were lots of fun to hand out with for the week.  Tip: bring your own insulated mug for the drinks.  The beach is simply tranquil, lots of available chairs with umbrellas and very clean.  I could go on and on but hands down this resort has it all and then some, something for everyone all day and all night.  We will likely be back again on another vacation and would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking to vacation in DR.

reviews.author: Ana Paula G
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text: Lugar maravilhoso, restaurantes excelentes, serviço de primeira com pessoas treinadas e de bem com a vida. Nosso concierge Jarow foi muito gentil e prestativo. A piscina é uma delícia. Um lugar perfeito para tirar férias do mundo com a família.

reviews.author: CrisLauxen
reviews.title: Inesquecível
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso, melhor do que esperávamos! O atendimento é incrível, tudo em um só lugar! Super recomendo! O atendimento no quarto é espetacular, sempre com algumas surpresas a mais, inclusive com alguns drinks que o Sr. Alexis Angomas nos ensina.

reviews.author: Valentina S
reviews.title: Excelente

reviews.author: Jessica L
reviews.title: Geeat vacation
reviews.text: Thanks raynold tamayo and melvin concepcion. I came to Dominican Republic on a Bachelorette party with 9 girls. Our stay so far is amazing. These two gentleman are the best. Very helpful respectful and would recommend them to anyone traveling to the Dominican Republic Punta Cana and staying at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Agustina C
reviews.title: Mini vacaciones =)
reviews.text: Decidimos una escapada de 6 días de último momento y los hoteles que nos habían recomendado familiares y amigos no tenían disponibilidad. Afortunadamente, por los comentarios de otros viajeros, nos decidimos por el Paradisus Palma Real y fue una hermosa sorpresa. Reservamos una suite junior de lujo con vista al jardín y era preciosa, tenía todo lo que se puede necesitar y estaba impecable. Destaco tres cosas que nos encantaron: la calidez y amabilidad de todo el personal, la calidad y variedad de comida y por último la modernidad y comodidad de las instalaciones y espacios comunes. Tiene restaurants de todo tipo y riquísimos, hay dos que son con cargo adicional pero hay cosas tan buenas en los otros que no creímos necesario ir. Resalto especialmente la atención de Felix quien nos atendió en el restaurant Olio y de Osvaldo Shaky Shaky de entretenimiento, que nos alegro todos los días y noches. Volveremos!

reviews.author: Charles B
reviews.title: Excellent service and lovely accommodations.
reviews.text: Our first time at an all-inclusive resort and I believe we are hooked. It all started with our concierge Ariel Tejada, who made it his mission to assure that we had the time of our lives. We did...He showed us to our room and we loved it...we took it. He then introduced  us to our 'butler', Patricia,, who could not have been kinder or more helpful...The level of service and attention to detail cannot be overstated. It was a thoroughly relaxing vacation due mostly to the combined efforts of Ariel and Patricia who  catered to us and insured an unforgettable trip. The food also was very good. And the service staff is more than happy to make whatever changes you might need regarding menu options and particular preferences. All in all, a great vacation and we WILL be back.

reviews.author: Amanda F
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Raynol tamayo was nothing but helpful and catered to every need we had. Accommodating a big group is not always easy, but Raynol made it look effortless. All of the staff at Paridisus were always willing to help and assist in any way we needed.

reviews.author: geisyma

They are attentive to the details, and make extra efforts to make our stay here unforgettable!!! KEEP UP THE GREAT SERVICE!!! :) 
Hugo & Geisy

Los restaurantes son muy limpias y bien decoradas.
Nouriture es excelente y bien presentado.

reviews.author: frances b
reviews.title: Remarkable Service by Staff
reviews.text: I'm in room 2203 and wanted to give a special Shout-Out to Alexis Angomas.  Took care of day-to-day needs in our Master Garden Suite.  Alexis went above and beyond my expectations from resort staff. Kept us well stocked with amenities, and was always asking for ways to make our stay more pleasant.  When we return (and we will!) I hope Alexis will be there to take care for us again!

reviews.author: le123456223
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Fantastic location, friendly staff, awesome beach front property. The guys at the bar inside the pool are the best!!! If you have little ones with a stroller, make sure you get a room with elevator access.

reviews.author: KyleHR
reviews.title: Upgrade to Royal Service and ask for Argenis!
reviews.text: Pay the extra money and upgrade to the Royal Service and request Argenis for your butler, you will not be disappointed! Every time we called him for help, he responded right away and was very informed. When we had questions about even the smallest things, he was amazingly polite and treated us with the up most respect. Being on our honey moon, he would leave surprises in our room every night to make sure we had the best time we could have! He helped with booking reservations, activities, and anything else we needed in the room. He would even come meet us wherever we were instead of talking over the phone. He would ask where we were so we could have face to face service. Please, if you can, request Argenis for your trip and I promise you, you will have the time of your life like we did!

reviews.author: kristimano
reviews.title: The most incredible experience ever!
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a perfect beach vacation look no further!
This was my first time ever traveling internationally but I will definitely be back! My fiancé and I came here to celebrate our engagement and we came at the perfect time! There was not too many people and the resort is huge! There are so many great staff ready to help and get you anything you could want! There is so much to do and it is steps from the beach! When we arrived we did not have Royal Service but chose to upgrade upon check in and boy are we so glad we did! We were lucky enough to have Argenis as our butler and he did nothing but put a smile on our faces every single day! He left us a surprises in our room every day and made our experience so pleasurable! Him among other staff would call every day to check up on us and see if we needed anything! Absolutely amazing! He introduced us to Carlos who also works at the resort and gave us a premiere view and a private cabana at the beach every day! Wanda the bartender is also amazing! She was our bartender at the royal service pool and is by far the best!! 
Dinner reservations were made for us at the beginning by argenis and he also gave us some recommendations on good places to eat! This experience was truly a memorable one! We will be back! Thank you to everyone for making us feel like family!!

reviews.author: Michael A
reviews.title: Argenis is AMAZING
reviews.text: Me and my soon to be wife arrived a couple days ago and were assigned to Argenis as our Royal Service butler. He hasn't disappointed one bit. Champagne in our room every night. Don't have to worry about getting a reservation or cabana. And has gone above and beyond in making our experience extra special. He's gotta be the best butler on site! Ask for him!

reviews.author: Ramiro M
reviews.title: Paradise...
reviews.text:
Been here 3 days of our 5 day trip and can say we are having a great time. The resort is really beautiful. Weather is warm and humid but the ocean breeze definitely helps. Came with a group of friends to celebrate a milestone birthday. The staff is great, everyone is really friendly and accommodating. They are all willing to do whatever to make your stay more comfortable. The rooms are nicely decorated and are cleaned daily. Food is good, buffet opens for breakfast and lunch has a good selection to appease even the pickiest eater. Is the food fantastic?  I don't think so, but what is made fresh to order is definitely better than the other items. The fruit is great, definitely eat the locally grown stuff that you can't get at home. 
The restaurants on site that we have as dinner options are good, Fuego has a limited selection and the portions are small but it's definitely enough. Blue Agave was nothing to write home about. Rare steakhouse was great. But I'm a meat and potatoes kind of guy, so I may be partial to this one. Good portions and very tasty food. Trying the Italian place tonight, Olio. So we'll see. 
Definitely need to give a shout out to the staff who have stood out to us on this trip: Alexis Angomas, the mini bar guy, has been great. Mini bar gets stocked only once a day but he makes sure you have what you need. Super outgoing and accommodating.
Leo the pool bar bartender has been outstanding. He's dealt with all our shenanigans and craziness and has also kept us highly entertained. Good sport and super funny. When he sees us out and about, he comes right up to us and gives us a hug. 
Then you have the dance instructors: Loki Loki, Shaky Shaky, Shorty and Shanty, they are hysterical and super fun! They can teach anyone how to dance and it helps that they have great moves. All have super outgoing personalities and a great demeanor. 
Will update later with the remainder of our trip. This place is definitely a place you should see. The definition of paradise.

reviews.author: GW39
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: One of the best hotels I've visited for a holiday. The staff are attentive and I would like to say a big thanks for making me feel welcome to: Looky Looky, Shaky Shaky, Francis, Wander and the staff at the spa. The holiday superseded my expectations. Loved my Paradisus Junior suite. Good food also.

reviews.author: Molica M
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Exelente actividades la shorty es loMaximo mi vacasiones fueron felices gracias a ella muy divertido el equipo de actividades si regresaria regresaria por el servicio y la atencion de todos gracias de verdad la pase super feliz

reviews.author: ChoppyBadger
reviews.title: Work program saved by an INCREDIBLE Convention Services Manager
reviews.text: I was part of a team that operated a corporate incentive program & we had challenges at the property in getting things done. I believe our program would have failed if not for our CSM Niela EUGENIO.  She really went above and beyond and made sure that every single detail that we were concerned about was taken care of.  From a beach party that was rained out - she saved the day by surprising us with a video wall in the ballroom that made you feel like you were outside.  I would only come back to this property if you guaranteed me that I'd be able to work with Niela again.  AMAZING job, Niela!!!

reviews.author: cjn555
reviews.title: Guest
reviews.text:
Silverio Heredia is an excellent waiter at the Olio Italian Restaurant. Friendly, professional, and exceptional service. Many thanks for a number of very enjoyable and delicious dining experiences. 
Excellent food throughout the Paradisus Motel. Not one bad meal. The daily buffet was incredible with and endless amount of choices.  Thumbs up to this motel it has it all. Beautiful beach, incredible pool, unbelievable entertainment. They know how to treat theirs guests. Excellente!!!!

reviews.author: Travelguru1316
reviews.title: Most amazing stay!!
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite resorts I've ever been to. Very high class feel, very clean, very friendly people, beautiful beach, and great food! The room was great, clean, and the beds were comfy. The food was phenomenal. Always had a wide variety of things to eat. Would definitely go here again! We had a great vacation!

reviews.author: jvankuren
reviews.title: WeddingMoon
reviews.text: Upon arrival, the first sight is absolutely stunning.  You get a view of the brilliant multicolored blue ocean through an equally stunning plaza, complete with enormous pools, shops, and restaurants. If you book using Royal Service (which we highly recommend) you are whisked away to a private reception area, where the only task you need to complete is drinking your welcome mimosa. Our Butler then took us directly to our room, and gave us a cellphone to contact him at any time.  For the entire 7 day stay, we were treated to dinner reservations at their exclusive restaurants, and an unparalleled level of service through special treats our Butler arranged throughout the stay.  A few other special mentions here....Raquel Vega arranged our marriage on this trip, and did a fantastic job.  We also need to recognize Francisco Santos, our Butler, who was more like angel granting blessings and pleasant surprises the entire trip.  If you have not gathered our opinion yet, we LOVED our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: trinitygirls
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The property is absolutely breathtaking. The entertainment was awesome. We looked forward to the show each night. Shorty was awesome in the Lion King as Leona and such a nice person. Shaky shaky was just like a family member. Betty Boop at towel spot was extremely nice. Great job Guys. You made our trip more memorable!!!

reviews.author: Vladimir C
reviews.title: Mister
reviews.text: Activity guys are excellence and every body is been greate special kooky looky ,shaky shaky ,shorty shanty ,didi ,Angel ,gasolina ,ramon,rafy...thanks for make me my vacation excellente all of you are wonderful people .,,and the beach was perfect the show and the waiter.

reviews.author: halvlah
reviews.title: Luna de miel
reviews.text: He estado en este hotel una semana durante la luna de miel, y me ha gustado mucho. Es un lugar genial para relajarse. La comida en el buffet general y en los restaurantes que he probado está bastante bien, salvo el restaurante Olio que no me ha gustado. El personal es muy amable. Las habitaciones son amplias y las camas cómodas, aunque son un poco antiguas.

reviews.author: dimilopi
reviews.title: Más que excelente
reviews.text: Nos hospedamos en la reserva un pequeño paraíso dentro del gran hotel Palma Real, excelentes habitaciones, aseo impecable, servicio permanente en la habitación, destacamos la atención de Irving quien hizo la reservas en nuestros restaurantes y se encargó de que cada detalle fuera perfecto, la comida de alto nivel, la atención en las piscinas y muchísimas actividades donde destacamos a Miguel Francisco y Carlos peña además de Snoopy que siempre estuvieron atentos a brindar la mejor atención. Excelentes espectáculos para disfrutar en familia, recomendaríamos el hotel ampliamente y por supuesto que volveríamos allí punta cana un paraíso

reviews.author: Adrienne P
reviews.title: Vacacio
reviews.text: Activities were excellent! Lots to do each day, friendly service and loads of fun! Shorty, Shaky-Shaky, Chanty, Betty Boo, Coco Loco, and Looky-Looky were are a wonderful team!! We look forward to coming back again soon!😀😄🌺

reviews.author: msouffront
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel para Cumbres y Reuniones
reviews.text: Coordine una Cumbre de Gobernadores del Bancos Centrales en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real, y todo salio perfecto, el trabajo realizado por nuestra coordinadora de grupos Niela Eugenio fue mas que excelente, siempre estuvo atenta a nuestras necesidades, desde los preparativos previos hasta nuestra llegada al Hotel.  Todo transcurrio tal como se planeo gracias a la excelente disposicion de su personal y sobretodo de Niela Eugenio.

reviews.author: 765hectorf
reviews.title: staying at Palma Real Paradisus

Excellent place to relax and have a good time, the butler assigned to us was Elvis 
and we couldn't have asked for any other better human being to take of us.
I highly recommend him. 
Room =Excellent

reviews.author: lubbygeeksterr
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The Reserve is such a great resort. The staff is friendly, the scenery is amazing, and overall the ambience and atmosphere is calm and relaxing. The resort exceeded my expectations and made sure that my fiance and I were accommodated and satisfied. I liked that being guests at the Reserve meant that we could also have access to Paradisus' restaurants and of course, the beach. The multiple options gave me and my fiance plenty of things to do and places to explore. Special thanks to Sandy Gil, our concierge, who made sure that we had dinner reservations each night with no problems. Overall, the Reserve is great and I highly reccomend it to anyone traveling to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: PaoES
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable!
reviews.text: A inicios de año tuve la oportunidad de viajar a Punta Cana con un grupo de amigos y nos hospedamos aquí. Personalmente, creo que a sido uno de mis mejore viajes. Las instalaciones de lujo, la atención y el servicio de l@s chic@s que trabajan ahí también al 100%. Recuerdo mucho a Niela, Calín y David, quienes hicieron que nuestra estancia sea casi perfecta. Se los recomiendo!! y espero volver pronto! :)

reviews.author: Alberto E
reviews.title: Vacaciones 2015
reviews.text: Una de las mejores experiencias vividas, una perfecta atencion a nuestro grupo de amigos de parte del staff de grupos y convenciones, la estadia super relajante y las instalaciones permiten que uno la pase de maravilla... gracias

reviews.author: Norrie B
reviews.title: The best vacation
reviews.text: Best time on vacation this year.  Wonderful people. They are very accommodating and made sure we were happy 24/7. Feel very thankful this place was chosen for my grandson's destination wedding!!!   Love it.  Luis Florian, Melvin Concepcion , Pedro Mota

reviews.author: Makenzie H
reviews.title: The best vacation
reviews.text: Great resort. We stayed here for my brothers wedding. The resort provided everything we needed for the wedding to run smoothly. People are very friendly. Rooms are clean and well-stocked with snacks and drinks daily. We also liked that it was not too crowded. We loved our stay here! Luis florian and melvin concepcion were our favorites, we had so much fun!

reviews.author: Shannon C-O
reviews.title: We LOVE this resort
reviews.text:
We got married here in 2012 and they do an amazing job with weddings and receptions.  Just amazing! Miglina in the Romance Department is incredible.  

We went back with our son in May of 2016 and again in Sept of 2016. Cannot say enough great things about the resort. The grounds are immaculate, beach is beautiful (and resort has huge section of beach), the Reserve is amazing for families.  

The Reserve rooms are spacious and perfect if you have kids. We stayed in the oceanfront Royal Service for our wedding and those rooms are right on the beach and wonderful for a couple.  Some friends of mine stayed in standard rooms and they were very happy.  The options in The Reserve if you have kids are great though, as you have separate sitting area (or room for kids) we put our sons crib in the bedroom with us, so we could use sitting area to hang out when he went to sleep before us.  Would probably book a master suite if we had more than one kid or our son was older to have more room.

The staff are out of this world!  So accommodating, sweet and warm.  Yirda Sano in the ServiExpress was amazing and helped us with all of our dinner reservations and babysitting arrangements.  She went above and beyond for us and even met us in our lobby to say goodbye when we were leaving. Juan at the main lobby bar was fantastic also and we miss his espresso-tinis! 

The Reserve section of the beach is great with cabanas and bar right there. We just have the best time there and will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Lushly
reviews.title: Marvelous vacation!
reviews.text:
We would like to thank to everyone who took their time to pamper us, showing us around and making us feel like royalty. We stayed at the Royal Service area and everything was perfect. Our butler Jose Salvador, was always looking after us with suggestions for great dining reservations, prepared us a bubble bath and making sure all was ok with our stay, from the beginning to the very end, thank you Jose.

Carlos our pool concierge and Wanda from the pool bar were always smiling and we spent such a great time talking to them and to other guests in the pool. We all were like a big family. 

We highly recommend to go to Fuego, either lunch or dinner, by far was our favorite restaurant, we were there for at least four times and Luis V, captain of Fuego was always happy to assist and serving such delicious dishes, like the black ceviche, salmon and soup.

We also enjoyed very much Aqua by the Reserve, we thought we had the best lamb in Fuego, but the lamb in Aqua was unique! Palazzo was a great choice for breakfast, in both places we were always greeted with a big smile and willing to make our life perfect, my fault I don't remember all their names.

The night entertainment was fun and we loved to have a few drinks by Gabi beach bar, that was great! 

We were amazed with the number of weddings taking place, it was crazy to see all these beautiful brides almost every night.

We cannot wait to plan and return in the near future, hopefully it will not take us long to go back!

reviews.author: SAS23
reviews.title: Company President's Club Trip - Attention to detail and atmosphere were amazing
reviews.text:
In 2014 I starting planning my company's President's Club incentive trip to take place the the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort in March 2015. It was my first time planning an international trip for over 100 people. I was very nervous. Then I spoke with and virtually met Niela Eugenio, the Convention Services Manager at the property. She was the easiest person to work with. Very attentive to detail and cared about my event as if it was her own. She even threw in her own touches and customized our all-inclusive bands to be the color of our company. Her and I hit it off right away when we met on site and she was there throughout the whole trip to make sure every detail was achieved and that my guests and I were all happy and enjoying ourselves. Even in areas outside of her responsibility (such as our excursions), she made sure our needs were exceeded. Because of her hospitality and professionalism, and the amazing staff at the Paradisus Palma Real, I planned our next trip at their sister location in Playa del Carmen, Mexico. I cannot say enough good things about Melia's properties. I would highly recommend to anyone travelling whether alone or with a huge group.

Cheers, 

Sara

reviews.author: Jose_Campos_8
reviews.title: Cumpleaños en el Paraiso
reviews.text: Mis amigos y yo estuvimos en el hotel celebrando 2 de nuestros cumpleaños y decidimos hacer una pequeña fiesta en la playa con cena buffet, rentamos un equipo de música y luces. Puedo decir que fue un cumpleaños diferente y de los mejores que hemos tenido. Niela Eugenio nos ayudo con la planificación de la fiesta, es muy atenta y dedicada. Nuestro capitán Sandy fue excelente!...  El hotel es increíble, la comida y el servicio. Esperamos regresar a fines de año con la familia.

reviews.author: Teneika
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: I spent time at both resorts, Paradisus and The Reserve. I will say the service is impeccable. The pools at the resort were amazing and the service at the bar was excellent. For the Royal Service I had Juan Cruz as my bartender and he made the best drinks and had great jokes. Whatever you wanted or needed he had it. For the bar at the main pool, I only went to Gabriel Castillo because he ensured that our drinks were to our liking. I asked many bartender if they would cut fruit up and make a daiquiri or smoothie style drink and always got a bland "we don't have that fruit" response. I went one day and asked Gabriel in hope of getting this drink and with no hesitation he said he could do it! We had our drinks and loved them, we had him making that drink for other after they seen ours! Truly amazing bartenders and customer service. When Gabriel came to the roya service bar/pool it was never a need to visit the other pool.

reviews.author: Toby K
reviews.title: September Vacation
reviews.text:
Staff was outstanding , very friendly, helpfull, attentive , always ready to help, either with a conversation or with directions in case you get lost, bartenders are always ready!!! 100 % recommended . Definitely the best resort we've visited so far. 
luis florian,melvin concepcion,Naomi,Ramon ramires,benita melcedes,santo friaz,Gabriel castillo,jairon minier best staff ! Muchos Gracias Chicos!

reviews.author: giovisweett
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Fuimos en un viaje familiar para celebrar nuestro aniversario de bodas y la estadía fue extraordinaria. El Hotel es hermoso y cuenta con todo lo que se necesita para disfrutar del viaje. La Srta. Niela fue nuestra coordinaria e hizo una labor excelente, nos asesoró muy bien con las reservas de los restaurantes y actividades; junto con el Sr. David y demás trabajadores  nos ayudaron mucho, son un excelente grupo.

reviews.author: cjn555
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Activities, Shorty, Betty Boop, Shaky Shaky, Shanty, Looky Looky, Gasolina, Caramello, Leo, Yuby, didi. Wow! What canI say??? These great people were so friendly and fun. We definitely recommend the "classes" during the day at the pool. They are not like real classes but just fun activities where you can learn a few things about the DR culture. I think they work all day and night because they were with us in the morning, all day at the pool and even dancing at night! We like bed these people all look forward to seeing them next year!!!

reviews.author: avalon5555
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Activities Shaky Shaky, Chaney, Betty Boop, Shorty, Coco Loco, Looky Looky, all made this vacation the best ever! The resort was great but what really made the vacation great were the people. All are so friendly, inviting, courteous and genuinely good, caring people. They want you to enjoy yourself and will do everything with a smile to make that happen!  Thank you to all for making our Second Honeymoon fantastic.  We will be back next year

reviews.author: Stev L
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: By far , best resort I been @ Dominican Republic .. Was part of the Royal Service reservation which I was treated with the highest respect. Great beach, great pool , also great service all around .. will be definitely coming back soon ...

reviews.author: Pritesh L
reviews.title: Wonderful holiday
reviews.text:
Everyone was great here. Great service and entertainment. Royal Service was good value. Private pool and premium drinks.

Night Entertainment was good fun, Melvin Concepcion was excellent! 

Bar staff all great too! Martin at Passion was very nice! And Patricia our butler was excellent!

reviews.author: SH921
reviews.title: Can't Wait To Return!
reviews.text: I have visited many places, but this was one of the best vacations that I have ever taken.  Paradisus Palma Real is gorgeous and everyone I encountered from the time that I arrived until I left was friendly.  I had a Royal Service oceanfront suite and the view from it was breathtaking.  Even though the room could use some updating, this did not impact my stay.  It was cleaned several times a day and the towels and sheets were changed daily.  My butler, Angel, always had a smile and was always ready and willing to provide assistance with anything that I needed.  He would check with me to make sure I was having an excellent time.  The resort has several restaurants, but I ate most of my meals at Palazzo.  Not only was the food good there, Oscar, Zenovia, JHoneidy, Edizon, Jesus, and Rafael provided excellent service.  Wanda, the bartender at the Royal Service pool bar, is definitely the person to see for drinks!  She always provided service with a smile.  I went to this resort for fun, rest and relaxation and that is exactly what I got plus more.  The atmosphere at this resort is so friendly and accommodating that you cannot help but feel special.  I enjoyed this place so much that I am already planning to go there again next year.

reviews.author: machtspass
reviews.title: Amazing wedding at an amazing property!
reviews.text: My wife's cousins daughter had a destination wedding at this property last week. We had never been to the Dominican Republic before. We always vacation in Mexico. We were blown away by this resort. The personal attention we were given by all of the staff will keep us returning. The food was excellent, the pool bartender Luis was so accommodating we have never had such excellent service! The wedding ceremony and reception was off the charts! Can't wait to return .

reviews.author: wadeh24
reviews.title: Great people
reviews.text:
Antonia and Angelita from the lobby bar were great.  We also had a great experience with Wandy Castio and Juan Sudrez.  

Kids club was in the reserve area, but easy to access.  Club didn't open until 9:00, so we would have preferred if it had opened earlier.

reviews.author: Naquanza A
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Fabulosos todos pero en especial el equipo de actividades la shorty es lo Maximo shaky shaky,  betty boop ,chanty en mi proxima vaciones.regresaria por ellos son los mejores de verdad les digo me encanto .ese equipo nadie como ellos  con tantas diversion. para nosotros gracias al los chicos de actividades!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: barbieoconnor
reviews.title: muy lindo lugar
reviews.text:
fuimos para fines de noviembre donde no es una época con mucho calor, el hotel es realmente increíble estábamos en una parte que solo se aceptan adultos, la comida es de muy buena calidad, la atención del personal también.
La habitación nos toco con vista a los jardines y son muy lindos.

reviews.author: j4y87
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Me and my wife had the most amazing time, people are great the country is great and most importantly the service is fantastic. I would definitely recommend this place.

The butler Luis Sanchez was incredibly good always there when I needed him he is a great asset to the resort.

Wanda the bar tender always friendly always with a smile, always makes my favourite cocktails. She keeps the royal services standards

reviews.author: Vagner A
reviews.title: Atendimento excelente
reviews.text: Um lugar encantador; atendimento excelente dos profissionais do Lobby Bar ANTONIO & ANGELITA; muitos atenciosos e carismáticos. ...Lua de mel perfeita... recomendo para quem busca um ótimo lugar para momentos inesquecíveis...

reviews.author: Jesenia G
reviews.title: Great service!!!
reviews.text: Upgrade to the reserve side which was amazing view of the pool and the hotel is very clean.  The kid zone was great sinc I have a two year old toddler girl and they made you feel comfortable leaving your child.  If there was any issue they would find you anywhere you were.  My wedding " planner" Anabel was very attentive and executed everything to be perfect.   I'm actually looking at another vacation soon and only considering staying at the Meliá hotels and their properties.

reviews.author: Angela María C
reviews.title: The People: the best!
reviews.text:
This hotel is unforgettable. The people, the service, the food, the amenities. We had a great week. The rooms are very comfortable and well decorated. All the employees are very nice, well trained, every minute making sure you are having a good time.
The pool, the beach, the restaurants are incredible. 
There was this boy who calls himself "Happy Boy" who made my night.  There is one Dominican Night at the resort with music, food, and dancing the Caribbean rhythms. He taught me how to dance Bachata, and was a great staff member!! Congrats Happy Boy, you were great!

reviews.author: Jennifer P
reviews.title: Best resort
reviews.text: Excellent service! The staff is amazing. Food is excellent as well as the cleanliness. La shorty from activitiea treated us very well! She attended to us nicely. The rooms were beautiful. Best resort I've been too.

reviews.author: joemac1969
reviews.title: One week at Palma Real
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to Punta Cana. Two years ago it was to get married with family and friends in tow. This time it was just the two of us. 

There are more restaurant choices now and the food as always was great . The new buffet opened our second day and the choices are just too overwhelming but delicious. We paid the extra money to do the Chef's Tasting at Passion. We included the wine for an extra $40/person. It was well worth it. A special shout out to Luis Rubio, Telitza the Hostess, and Domingo the Sommelier.

We will be back!

If you want a special time, tip the bartenders and waiters. They make a minimal hourly wage and because it is an all-inclusive, many people do no tip. When you do, you will get special attention.

Luis and Gustavo at the swim up bar are fantastic. Junior will take care of you if you decide to go to the beach. Wandy was just great at the buffet. These people made our stay a really special time.

reviews.author: Ana P
reviews.title: Best 50th Sister Birthdays
reviews.text:
La habitación fue perfecta para nosotros, dimensiones, distribución, equipamiento, decoración, iluminacion, ubicación.
Tammy Vasquez es muy profesional como concierge, como persona sencilla y amigable, se percibe confiable.
Luis Amarante el mejor mayordomo, amable, sencillo, respetuoso, con mucha disposición.
Altagracia la recamarera, solicita, limpia, detallista, ordenada.
Ademas, todos honestos y muy a la altura y conocedores de su puesto.

reviews.author: alvarosado
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones Familia Rosado del Campo
reviews.text:
Nuestras estancia en el Hotel the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana solo puede calificarse como excelente.
 En nuestro caso repetíamos en el hotel, con un verano de por medio sin ir, y nos hemos encontrado un hotel mejorado en todos sus servicios.
Quiero dar las gracias al General Manager D.Rodrigo Silveyra y a el Director del The Reserve D.Adrián Alonso por el maravilloso trato dispensado a mi familia y por el maravilloso equipo que han conformado en todos los ámbito del hotel. Nada hubiera sido igual sin su liderazgo. 
Quisiera destacar a algunos de los miembros con los que mas contacto tuvimos, siendo seguro injusto con otros excelentes trabajadores que, dándonos un trato estupendo, no pude recordar todos sus nombres, a los que les pido disculpas. 
Gracias a Yarol nuestro family concier, excelente trabajador, que colmó de atenciones a nuestros cuatro hijos y que atendió todas nuestras peticiones dando cumplida atención a todas y cada una de ellas. A Diosmeri que le sustituyó en la semana que tenía libre de la misma forma excelente. 
A Pedro barman del Gaby The Reserve, que con sus compañeros, nos atendió siempre con una sonrisa y cariño y de manera muy profesional. A los dos Jefes de Sala del Gabi Club, Zeus y Amelia (creo recordar) que atendían todos nuestras demandas y caprichos (en especial de mis cuatro hijos) de manera perfecta. 
A Miguel Responsable de los restaurantes temáticos del Hotel Paradisus, que ha conseguido que cada restaurante sea una experiencia culinaria, en especial el Grill, El Fuego, EL Aqua, Mole, Bana, Vento, donde Yaritza nos atendió con profesionalidad y simpatía.
Al chef Gabriele, Italiano de pro del que disfrutamos tanto de su maravillosa cocina como de nuestras animadas charlas diarias, que nos colmo de atenciones y comidas especiales en nuestras tres semanas de estancia y culpable de que hayamos vuelto con tres kilos de más.
Nuestros amigos de la playa, Luis, Ramón, José Luis y en especial Santos que coincidió los 21 días con nosotros que se deshacía en atenciones con nuestra familia, teniendo siempre preparada una palpa de 10, así como Geraldine que nos preparaba estupendos combinados y que entretuvo tanto a mis peques.
A los chicos de calidad, empezando por el Jefe de departamento Silvio, a Gloria, de family concier Luis Ortiz, todos ellos estuvieron pendientes cada día para que nuestra estancia fuera perfecta y lo consiguieron.
 A los chicos del Kids Zone, que atendieron a nuestros hijos Inés, Iñigo, Jimena y Gadea, con un cariño y atención que colmó todas sus expectativas, haciendo su estancia muy divertida, en especial nuestro agradecimiento a Martina, Katy, Jack, Miguel, Virginia y Francina.
A los chicos de la animación, Melvin, Luis (Sexy Will Smith), Noeimi, Raynold, que nos animaron en todo momento y con los que pasamos ratos muy divertidos. 
A todos ellos y al resto de personal, al que por desgracia no puedo nombrar de manera individual gracias por estas maravillosas vacaciones.
Nos vemos, si Dios quiere, el año que viene. Un fuerte abrazo.
Álvaro Rosado y Myriam del Campo.

reviews.author: Terri D
reviews.title: My 2nd Home
reviews.text: We visited the Reserve again and didn't want to go home.  As always, the food and drinks are great, and the rooms are really spacious. I would however suggest that they clean the furniture, as it is looking a bit worn.  The staff are some of the most friendliest people you will ever meet.  Special thanks to Jose Reinoso, Emilio Valdez, Wander Roq and Antony Cid Octavio, who always went above and beyond!  We will definitely be back again next year.

reviews.author: CorazoncitoA
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text: Las instalación son bonitas,  amplias habitaciones,  el servicio en general excelente, principalmente Melvin Concepción que nos atendió en area de la playa y nos sentimos en familia con el. Ya que es un persona que como ha estado su trabajo con todos ,  gracias por tu atenciones.

reviews.author: Wagner Leandro C
reviews.title: Piscina
reviews.text: Estou passando férias e estou gostando muito do resort , principalmente da piscina e do atendimento da mesma feito por jensy rijos e Gabriel ( bar molhado ) . Piscina muito bonita e limpa e cerveja gelada

reviews.author: Juan P
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente hotel en especial actividades!!! La playa y las instalaciones son espectaculares. La atención y servicio de los empleados es estupenda. Wanda es una excelente bar tender y la shorty de actividades es lo máximo en el baile!

reviews.author: Virginia C
reviews.title: Elogio
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso , piscina top , bar molhado com otimo atendimento principalmente pelos atendentes jensy rijo gabriel castillo e  com certeza indico para todos , nao posso de deixar de elogiar a cerveja gelada

reviews.author: Aneudis T
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Recomiendo este hotel en especial actividades la shorty.. por su excelente atención y actuación en todas los shows en especial la noche del sábado, además las actividades deportivas. Como voleibol y aerobicos, etc.

reviews.author: Kelvin V
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Actividades es lo mejor, exelente chicos en especial la shorty la mejor vailarina y simpatica.
Respetuosa, amable, educada y sobretodo alegre. 

La excelencia del hotel  es el equipo de vaile me encantan.
Complacido en todo.

reviews.author: jenken453
reviews.title: Greatest place on earth!
reviews.text: This was our favorite vacation we have ever taken.  The staff were incredible. They were very friendly and accommodating. The food was also incredible. We brought our girls and every one was nice and helpful. The grounds were clean and the beach was well taken care of. We will definitely visit again in the future. We fell in love with the staff. Especially looky looky, caramello and shaky shaky!!  They provided entertainment every night that we really enjoyed.   Love this place.

reviews.author: Luis B
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Es el mejor hotel del mundo lo recomiendo ,en especial ,actividades exelente chicos muy buen  servicio regresaria .por ellos la shorty,,shaky shaky,,Betty boop .como ellos nadie,,,,,el Baile de ellos. Los juegos. De Playa gracias por todo...........

reviews.author: Alexandra Isabe... P
reviews.title: Actividad Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Que maravilla!!... estoy encantada.
Regresaría al hotel  por los chicos de actividades; excelentes chicos, la shorty, ,shaky shaky, Betty boop... exelente son lo máximo nadie como ellos.
LES FELICITO ... SIGAN ASÍ !!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Christina V
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Excellent service, great staff who goes above and beyond to make your vacation unforgettable! Yessenia Martinez is the best waitress ever! So friendly and always made sure I had a drink! Everyone was so nice and helpful. Loved my stay here

reviews.author: Eva B
reviews.title: Amazing honeymoon❤️❤️❤️
reviews.text:
We just got back last night from our honeymoon in Paradisus Palma Real and all we can say is that this place is amazingly beautiful, clean, very welcoming people and not to mention amazing service!!! We had the master suite room and it was perfect!!! Twice or three times a day they clean our room and changed our sheets daily!!! The people are very nice and welcoming and everybody seem to want to serve you no matter what. We enjoyed the endless exquisite buffet at Naos, may it be breakfast, lunch or dinner!!! The Food was always good!! Juan Suarez gave us an above and beyond service each and everytime we go to dine there. Even though we were not able to give him a tip on  our first and second visit as we forgot to bring money, but still he continue to give us an excellent service. Always with a smile and welcoming!! Claribel at Naos was also very good!
Jhunior took care of us everytime we are at the beach. Clara at the guest services was always with a smile and very willing ro help us at anything we need and inquired. She did an execllent job!! Gustavo and Luis at the main pool bar always made us the best drinks!! 
All in all, we had an amazing time and we will sure come back to celebrate our anniversary!! This place is one of the best resorts we have ever been!!! No doubt it is a five star resort!! They have all the amenities you need and if you will not enjoy in this place, I am sure something is wrong with you!!

reviews.author: Neil D
reviews.title: Will Come Again!
reviews.text:
We have stayed in multiple all-inclusives, and this was one of the best. The buffet food was ok, but speciality restaurants were very nice. Just wish they had a better wine selection offered, and maybe more vegetarian options. The daily evening entertainment was good, including a Michael Jackson special. Most other resorts, the evening entertainment was almost an afterthought. Not here. After dinner dancing at the beach bar was great for our kids (12 and 16 yrs old) with the employees making an effort to get the hotel guests involved in the fun. Thoroughly enjoyable every night.
Special recognition to Samuel Caleano at the Steak restaurant, and Emmanuel & Reinado at the Toji bar for making excellent Caipirinhas.

reviews.author: Jenny Carolina C
reviews.title: Excelente!!!!
reviews.text: La comida excelente el ambiente igual, las habitaciones y restaurantes muy buenos, las atenciones del personal exquisitas, debo resaltar que recibimos las mejores atenciones de la mano de Jose luis de los santos (trinki trinki) pool consierge!! Logro que nuestra estadia en el hotel fuera lo maximo! Definitivamente tienen que visitar este hotel

reviews.author: charles R
reviews.title: Excellent service you have to visit
reviews.text:
I have to say that this resort has it all. You must visit. 

Starting from its services all the way to the food, drinks pools, beaches and their rooms are excellent. All inclusive.

I would like to mention everyone who gave us a nice welcome but I would like to commend Mr. Juan de dios who was always checking and greeting, providing a better stayed all the way.

In addition, Dionisio one of many great chefs they have he was wonderful and went out of his way to please us. Everyone is just fantastic.

If you just check it out you will come back. We are planning to go back as soon as we can.

Regards and enjoy your vacation where ever it maybe. Bless you.
