visitamos el hotel frecuentemente porque somos socios y nos llevaron a conocer las habitaciones que son espectaculares .
hemos visitado el restaurante muchas veces y es muy comodo y tienen buena atencion , comida buena y excelente hambiente

reviews.author: ELISA M
reviews.title: Uno de los mejores viajes para hacer en familia .
reviews.text: Un viaje perfecto para venir en familia . La atención de la gente no puede ser mejor, amables , cariñosos , atentos . Hemos venido con 5 niños de edades entre 14 y 6 años y todos han disfrutado a su manera . En clases de tenis, en las colchonetas, en el kids zone, en los talleres en la piscina , y comiendo en todos los restaurantes que hay que no se cual ha sido mejor.  Gracias a todo el equipo de la reserve por hacer este viaje inolvidable: a Melvin Concepcion por sus bailes y sus atenciones , a Rodrigo el director,  a Miguel Genes lo bien que nos ha tratado y a tantos y tantos: Luis , Doralis, Ramón, Santos, José Luis , Anthoni y demás.   Gracias y más gracias . Volveremos si Dios quiere .

reviews.author: Ralph V
reviews.title: Royal Service is Royal Shaft
reviews.text:
The letter below was sent to the resort  and upper management at Meliá, the owners of this property  and their response was too bad so sad. 

To Whom It May Concern
I am writing to share with you about our experience at your resort Paradius Palma Real in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  

First I would like to begin by saying that our trip was mainly to celebrate our one year anniversary and to be able to relax and  recharge our batteries from our hectic day to day life.  Upon on arrival to the resort we were taken to the royal guest service check in area. We were greeted by a lady who gave us the cell phone for our butler and an envelope with resort  credit vouchers.  Vouchers were simple (see attached sample) and No further explanation was provided with the vouchers.  Angelo our butler picked us up and took us to our room.  Upon our arrival in the room we noticed that the room was hot but he assured us it would get cooler.  Angelo asked if we would like to store our valuables in the safe and he would take us on a tour of the property.  We attempted to use the safe but it was not working so he called for someone to fix it. 30 minutes and  three workers later the safe was fixed. Room was still a stifling 80 degrees.  We went on our tour came back approximately 25 minutes later and the room was still extremely hot. Angelo dropped us off called for someone to come and look at the AC.  A worker came looked at it and said "Angelo didn't know how to use the AC" he pushed a couple of buttons and left.  We sat there and waited for the AC to cool off, one hour later still  at 81 degrees.  At this point we asked to have our room changed. We were moved to the first  floor.  I'd like to point out that prior to us arriving the room had been decorated with rose petals, which meant that someone from the hotel staff had spent time in the room and should have noticed that the AC was not working.  The second room we were placed had a humidity problem so we asked for a humidifier to be placed in the room.  This didn't help and the reality is that the room was never cold.  I also like to point out that for a five star resort I have never seen such poor quality in bath towels.  Towels were so rough that using them after sun bathing was very painful.  I find it funny that the resorts puts effort into asking what type of pillow you want (not that we got them) and even the scent you want on your pillows but doesn't put any effort into purchasing quality towels for the guest. 
Prior to arriving the hotel we were asked for our interests and we had indicated dun buggy and horse back riding. Angelo our butler recommended we see Salvador at Olympus tour coincidentally the same tour company our travel agent used to book our trip.  We met with Salvador and he recommended two tours. He showed us pictures of the tour and read off from the back of the receipt what we needed to bring on the tours (e.g., water shoes, camera, sunscreen, money).  At no point did he mention we should bring disposable cloth.  The dun buggy tour was a disaster. The tour guide advised to keep our mouth covered at all time as we would be exposed to "cow poop, donkey poop, dog poop, all kind of poop".  It had rained the night before and God knows what the mud was made off.  Mud seeped from the floor into the Polaris dun buggy covering all of our belonging in mud including us. We were covered in mud from head to toe from the start of the tour through the end.  We were told we would visit a cave and beach but at no point did they tell us that the tour included stopping at a shop in the middle of nowhere to hear someone trying to sell us "natural" tea, chocolate, oregano, oil, vanilla, etc.  Tour was scheduled to last 3 hours, we were picked up at 740 am and did not arrive back to the hotel until 130pm.  My $60 tommy Bahamas t-shirt and baseball cap was ruined and my wife's nylon Longchamp bag was covered in mud amongst everything else we had with us. On our way back the open aired bus had rolled up plastic shades as it started to rain you would have thought that the driver would have pulled over to bring them down but no he drove the entire time while we got soaked.  Upon on arrival at the hotel we went to see Salvador to tell him about our experience. He gave us a hard time and advised us that we should have 
Known better. He even went as far as to say if we didn't like  the tour we should have taken a taxicab back.  I was flabbergasted, I could not believe that this was his recommendation when he knew perfectly well we were in the middle of no where.  I requested a refund and canceled the horseback riding tour we had scheduled. Salvador would not refund our money until I mentioned that my comments on trip advisor would not reflect positively on this experience, then he agreed to a refund if I would sign a waiver indications I would not right anything negative.  At this point I requested to speak with the hotel manager.  A gentleman named Domingo met with me listened to what had occurred since our arrival and offered to launder our cloth (which by the way didn't work, my shirt was ruined) and take us to the spa as a consolation for the stress we had incurred.  He stated that "we would be taken care of that our bill would be almost nothing" he personally took us to the spa spoke with the manager and asked her to take care of us.  At the end of a wonderful spa experience we were given a bill for $425.00 US dollar. At this point we were a bit perplexed as to "what being taken care of and paying almost nothing" meant.  We were asked if we had Royal service vouchers and we said yes but had not brought them with us.  We returned the next day to hand in our $50 voucher per treatment which was not applied to our final bill until we checked out and had to complain about it. 
We also attempted to use the vouchers at the gift shop not sure how they worked only to be told by the staff they were not valid.  After speaking with a store manager who looked at the vouchers again she advised us that we needed to spend $100 and then They could apply the $10 voucher.  Nowhere on the voucher did it states how the vouchers were to be applied or how much we had to spend.  If you recall at the beginning of this letter I mentioned vouchers were just handed to us.  Only to learn upon check out that the "official" vouchers were not available when we checked and copies had been given to us with no explanation.  

Anytime we stepped out of "Royal service" area, service deteriorated.  The Restuarant that serviced the breakfast buffet was short staff and you could barely get anyone to serve you in a timely manner.  On two occasions that we ate there we had to get up and find wait staff in order to get coffee or napkins.  We attempted to use the catamaran three times on three different days which meant we spoke with the staff coordinating these services three times and finally was able to secure one and upon getting into the water was told we needed lessons and had to pay for them AND book them separately.  Do you think they could have asked or mentioned this any of the times we  met with them so that our time would not have been wasted.  Needless to say we never rode the catamaran. 
We made Gabriela the Royal Service manager and Domingo the Guest Service Manager aware of all of our situations.  I also made attempt to speak with the general manager and was told I could not speak directly to the GM that all concerns had to go through Domingo.  At this point I felt I was in some type of dictatorship were I was being restricted.  Completely understand Its a different country from the US but good customer service is good customer service regardless of where you are and especially if I paid for ROYAL SERVICE.  

On our last day as we checked out we discovered that our spa treatment still were $425 no vouchers applied and no " being taken care of by Domingo".  And we refused to pay the bill because we explained that we were owed a credit our luggage would not be released.  At this point we just wanted to go home. So I was left with no choice but to pay. 

Please take a moment and put yourself in our shoes. We just wanted to relax recharge and celebrate our one year anniversary. However we left stressed and disappointed.  I am requesting a full refund to be able to redo my anniversary trip due to your lack of responsiveness, the fact that you promised Royal treatment which we didn't receive and poor customer service. 

Ralph Viera

reviews.author: Tara746
reviews.title: Honeymoon visit
reviews.text: My new husband and I absolutely love this place. We do not want to go home. Our butler Carlos Hinostroza went above and beyond for us. We by far had the best butler because he had special things done for us without us asking. He made a bath in our jaccuzzi tub with champagne and rose petals. It was perfect for us. We also had amazing service at Palazzo. The hostess, Zenovia was always welcoming. The bar tender in Palazzo, Edizon took care of us immensely! He gave my husband and I a special drink to help us with our belly aches and it worked! Everyone went above and beyond for us! Last but definitely not least,  Wanda the royal service pool bar tender. She was so inviting and friendly. She made us her "Wanda Special" and it was phenomenal! We love everyone here and hate to go! This is the only place to be! Thanks to everyone that made our honeymoon special. Below is the view from our room! Gorgeous!!!!

reviews.author: Marco S
reviews.title: Cumpleaños de Ramon Ruiz
reviews.text: Las instalaciones son preciosas , las habitaciones amplias , la comida muy buena y variada, las atenciones de todo el personal excelente en especial Melvin Concepción que nos hizo un ambiente extraordinario con su simpatía y orientación de las actividades de todo el día también Yokaina, Marionel, Pedro Mota , Luis Florian, Ramón Santana , Benita  en el bar de la reserva , gracias a todos .

reviews.author: Nena R
reviews.title: Cumpleaños de Ramón
reviews.text: Este hotel es excelente para todo tipo de personas, es muy familiar, son muy lindas las instalaciones, la playa, la piscina, los restaurantes, las actividades junto con Melvin Concepcion , Luis Flori an, Pedro Mota, yokaina, Jose, Ramon Santana, Elvi el que nos recibió, el concierge Yarol, Isidra, Marionel, Juan el del Bar, Rafael el chef, Rafael Contreras, el bartender mátanos, que nos mostró con se baila el Merengue, la bachata y la salsa, aprendimos bastante con el.  Los shows son maravilloso y los atenciones de todos la experiencia más inolvidable de todas.

reviews.author: Sunnyjules1
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip with dear friends
reviews.text:
We just returned from an anniversary trip with our dear friends and it was amazing! We stayed for 5 nights and booked through Costco. The trip was seamless. The resort was beautiful and clean. The restaurants were pretty good for the most part. Loved Olio (Italian) and Bana (hibachi). Rare lived up to its name (rare steaks). It was the only meal that was a bust. The Buffett was great for breakfast and lunch everyday. Ferder was an amazing server. Upon checking in we were told to book all our meals for dinner right away. Most reservation times were either 6 or 9:30. We followed the 6 pm reservation for the first 2 nights, but then discovered we could go later and had no problems getting in when we wanted. It starts to get dark around 6:30 ish so you don't want to miss out on pool or ocean time.

For the hotel rooms, we had a garden room suite and it was clean. We loved the location because we were near the pool, restaurants and beach. (Ground level on back side of pool near lobby). We spent a good part of each day in the pool bar area. We cannot say enough about the amazing service we had from Luis, Gustavo and Rudy! In the afternoons we would run down to the ocean. Access to chairs was easy and had many beach chair options. I attribute this to the time of year, not the busy season. I also need to give a shout out to Gasolina from the beach/entertainment staff. He and many others made sure we were having a great time all day. Visit the beach towel cabana and you'll see the schedule of the day activities. They range from water activities to dance lessons, cigar making or wine tasting. There is something for everyone! 

My biggest suggestion is to bring lots of tip money and you'll be taken care of. We noticed several Americans tipped. The staff works hard every day to make sure you're experience is the best. We felt they should be recognized for their hard work and service orientation. We didn't have royal or reserve service and didn't need it. During off season you wouldn't need to pay extra as most people who had it said they wouldn't do it again. The casino was happy to take our donations. Very small casino and very tight payouts (if any). The staff there was pushy and often looked irritated they had to work.

Overall, our group agreed we would definitely return to this resort in the future. 
We recommend booking thru Costco for the best deal.

reviews.author: Halie W
reviews.title: Paradises Palma Real Royal Service
reviews.text: The royal service made all the difference in the world for us on our trip. We had access to the private beach side, pool, bar, water ritual area, best restaurants, and all the top shelf alcohol you could ask for. Our butler Argenis made it the trip of a lifetime by making everything seamless. The excursions and restaurants he recommended were always great. We highly recommend asking for Argenis. Speaking to other couples who had other butlers we seemed to always be one step ahead in service.

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.title: Honeymoon with Royal Service
reviews.text: I wanted to take a moment and thank our royal service butler Argenis for an amazing experience. He made the experience smooth by having everything from our reservations to our excursions set up without hassle. Champagne in our room with an amazing jacuzzi set up along with flower pedals after a day on the beach was amazing! Argenis was down to earth and 100 percent about us having the experience WE wanted. Can't say enough about the Royal service experience with Argenis and the hospitality of the staff at Paradisus Palma Real. We will plan on being back with our two girls and another couples trip!

reviews.author: Steve G
reviews.title: Excellent AI in the DR!
reviews.text:
We have been to All-Inclusives before, and typically they are not our first choice--lots of drunken partiers and mediocre food has been our experience.  We were looking to take our daughter's family including a 2 and six year old, and landed on the Paradissus Palma Real as a reasonable priced option for a group of 6 in two rooms and that seemed to be more of a family focused AI.  We were very pleased to find that to be true, and had a great time here!

First, we went in late September in the off season (just got back) and the resort seemed to be less than 50% occupied.  As a result, we did not experience any of the service issues mentioned by many of the other reviewers.  Also, we had no problems making room reservations at all, and we did not have any Royal Service or Reserve status.  In fact, you could probably walk in and get seated in most of the restaurants from what we experienced.

We reserved two one bedroom master suites--the rooms were very nice, perhaps a little dated, but still very nice.  We were on the second floor and there were no elevators, so folks need to be aware of that and request ground floor if going up stairs will bother you.
The building we were in was about a 10 minute walk to the beach/pools and restaurants, and you can catch a shuttle that runs if you don't want to walk.  You can also go to the reserve pool and Kids Zone which is about 10 minutes the other direction--the pool is better set up for kids there.  

We used the Kids Zone for 3 days--they were great with our grandchildren and the kids absolutely loved it.  They had lots of planned activities, and won them over immediately.  And no charge for the Camp!

The food was very good for an all-inclusive.  The buffet was huge and lots of selections of many types of cuisine.  We ate all our breakfasts and lunches here, and half our dinners. Miguel was excellent as a server.  Our experiences at Bana, the hibachi restaurant and Rare, the steak restaurant, were also very good.

We had excellent service from all areas of the resort, from the front desk to the restaurants to the Kid Zone, to Housekeeping.  No issues of bad attitudes or indifferent service.  In fact, everyone had smiles on their faces and seemed to go out of their way to take care of us.  I will mention that we did tip for most things, even though it is not necessary, the employees really appreciate it and bend over backwards to take care of you as a result.

The grounds were well kept, the pools were clean and impressive, and there were not a lot of drunken folks while we were there, but that could be due to being off season.

The only caveat I will mention is in regard to the beach itself.  Lots of great white sand, but there seems to be a lot of seaweed in the water at all times and that washes up on the sand constantly.  They attempt to rake it up, but it returns in an hour or so.  It makes it difficult to walk the beach, and somewhat disconcerting when going into the water.  If you are a beach purist and are looking for crystal clear turquoise water, you will probably be disappointed, as the water is cloudy and has floating seaweed.  Maybe no worse than many North American Atlantic beaches, but not like what you see in Cancun, Grand Cayman, St, Johns, BVI, etc.  If you are a pool person, or are OK with Atlantic Ocean beaches that have a lot of seaweed, no problem.  We got used to it over 6 days, but have stayed at many Caribbean resorts that had much more of a pristine beach setting.  Someone told me that this is not just a Paradissus issue, it is a Bavaro beach issue as the entire beach is impacted with seaweed now.  It did not used to have a seaweed problem, but has had one for the last year or two.  Yes, the other reviewers were right about all the beach vendors constantly walking the beach selling parasailing, banana boat rides, shopping excursions, etc.  They can be bothersome, but they seem to have a law or agreement that they stay within 20 ft of the waterline and do not wander up to the beach chairs.  But they do accost you when you go towards the water or walk the beach.

No rain all six days we were there except for 10 minutes the morning we were leaving, and that was in September in the high rainy season/Hurricane season, so perhaps we were lucky!

Overall, I would rate the property a 4 due to the beach issues mentioned above, and since we are beach people, that impacted us.  Other than that, it was an excellent trip and location, and improved our feelings about All-Inclusives.

reviews.author: Karolajna B
reviews.title: Mediocre en su categoria premium
reviews.text:
Siendo que es un hotel dentro de la categoría PREMIUM, debo calificarlo como MEDIOCRE. Explico porque:

1. En vez de cerrar el hotel durante el periodo de mantencion en temporada baja (como lo hacen otros resorts), esta haciendo trabajos mientras tienen mucha gente hospedando y la calidad de la estadía sufre muchísimos. Nos ha tocado que cerraron el buffet principal y han adaptado uno de los restaurantes tematicos para que cumpliera esta función. En resultado: no había variedad de comida, no habían mesas para sentar a toda gente, el lugar se ha hecho muy incomodo para toda la gente que pasaba por ahi. 

2. La variedad de comida EN GENERAL bien pobre. Cos escasos mariscos y pescados (no como uno espera de esta categoría de hoteles). Casi todo comida tipo ¨junk food - mucha pizza, mucha pasta y arroces, pero poca comida de calidad. 

3. La atención menos que mediocre. Los camareros de los restaurantes temáticos no saben nada, traen platos sin saber lo que traen y a quien, no saben explicar que es lo que contienen los platos. El tiempo de espera para PEDIR - al menos media hora y luego otra hora para recibir el plato. Les recuerdo que estamos hablando de temporada baja. 

4. En todos los bares el alcohol es muy básico, para no decir que inaceptable en algunos lugares. Ejemplo, uno de los bares de la playa/piscina sirve solo "genérico" - alcohol sin siquiera una etiqueta. Para obtener una copa con alcohol de marca global uno debe indicar específicamente que es lo que quiere, sino recibe el "genérico¨. De nuevo, no es o que uno espera del hotel 5* PREMIUM. Los alcoholes mejores SE PAGA aparte, y no un precio menor. 

5. El servicio concierge... quería dejar sin comentario. Pero que les sirva a todos, lo voy a describir: 

Pedi un dia al concierge el servicio Jaccuzzi - a la hora pedida debe estar preparado un baño en la habitacion, con espuma y pétalos de rosa, debería estar decorada la pieza con los pétalos y también traen una botella de champaña, un poco de fruta fresca y frutillas de chocolate. El costo de este servicio - 55 USD (impensable también en este nivel de hoteles - tengo experiencia). Quería sorprender a mi pareja en el día de nuestro aniversario y acorde los detalles y el mensaje con cual le iban a dar la bienvenida en la pieza. A lo hora que supuestamente todo tenia que estar listo, entramos a la pieza y lo único que he visto era el champan con frutillas y fruta. Ni vi los pétalos, ni el jaccuzzi preparado, ni el mensaje, ni nada. Me he enojado y fui a conversar con el cosierge. Había otro de turno. No tenia ni datos de la reserva del servicio, ni sabia nada. Tenia que comunicarse con otras personas... Al final, el servicio mal realizado y no cobrado (al menos esto). 

6. Los trabajadores del hotel con mala actitud y contestando feo o haciendo comentarios raros. Un trabajador de la piscina se negó ayudarme sacar la bicicleta aquatica porque "no quería mojarse". 

7. Clases de Yoga que no pude tomar - cuando ya llegue al lugar de las clases de yoga (alejado muchisimo de las habitaciones) no había absolutamente nadie. Fui al SPA al lado y pregunte si alguien podría ayudarme y decir si las clases se harán o no. Se contactaron con la recepcion. Después de 10 min llego el instructor, se dio cuenta que estaba sola y me dijo que no va a hacerme clases, porque se requiere de un mínimo de 3 personas. 

8. Un lugar un poco aburrido, sin música en la playa o la piscina. 

9. RECOMIENDO MUCHISIMO MAS EL IBEROSTAR GRAND BAVARO-  dentro de la misma categoría premium. A ese no le falta nada!

reviews.author: Max
reviews.title: Increible hotel excelente servicio family concierge
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado unas vacaciones de lujo en este magnifico resort desde el 15 de septiembre al 23 de septiembre, junto a mi esposa, 2 hijos de 2 y 5 anos y mis suegros. Contratamos el servicio family concierge, donde tuvimos una atención inmejorable por parte de YAROL, quien se preocupo de muchos detalles, reservas, regalos para los niños y siempre con la mejor disposición ante nuestras necesidades. Sin duda un gran concierge y recomiendo de todas maneras el servicio. Ya había tenido una buena experiencia en la Esmeralda Playa del Carmen con family concierge, pero Yarol lo supero, fue excelente.
El sector the reserve es muy lindo, infraestructura nueva, todo muy limpio y en orden, vale la pena darse un gusto. La atención de todos muy cordial siempre preocupados de si estas bien. Las habitaciones son nuevas con la calidad de los Paradisus
Los restaurantes a la carta debo destacar el VENTO, sonde recibimos un trato muy amigable de todo el equipo que trabajo durante nuestra estadía, de verdad es para felicitar a todos. Muy buena comida. Quiero destacar a Yaritza que fue muy amorosa con nuestros hijos, al igual que todos en realidad pero no recuerdo sus nombres. El Vento estuvo fusionado con el Gabi beach por remodelación de este ultimo, entonces en realidad felicito al equipo de ambos restaurantes.
También gracias al equipo de el FUEGO, quienes nos atendieron de maravilla y comimos una carne extraordinaria, la cual me imagino porque se fusiono con el The Grill que estaba en remodelación.
La playa del hotel es excelente, hay que ir en carritos o caminar si quieres, estos pasan bien seguido, el sector de la playa family concierge tiene unas reposares de muy buena calidad la cual puedes reservar si quieres. Hay un bar donde también felicito a sus trabajadores, creo estaba Ramon y otros chicos todos muy buena onda. El wifi llega hasta la orila de la playa
También destaco los chicos del kids zone que son muy simpáticos con los niños, los felicito y gracias por su ayuda. Lo único que falta es algún juego mas entretenido en la piscina de niños, algún barco u otra cosa se los dejo como consejo.
Por ultimo a los muchachos del gym también gracias.
Felicitaciones al equipo the reserve, sin duda el mejor hotel de el caribe en que he estado, realmente 5 estrellas. Creo iremos por el Palma Real el próximo ano!!

reviews.author: Mancini
reviews.title: Hotel Top - Exceto pelos ratos no restaurante Vento :(
reviews.text:
O hotel é simplesmente maravilhoso. Pena que durante um jantar no restaurante Vento tivemos o desprazer de presenciar dois ratos andando pelo chão. Detalhe que esse restaurante Vento é "anexo" ao Passion que é do chef Martin (7 estrelas Michellin). Eu nem ia postar esse comentário pq tirando isso foi tudo excelente, mas depois que alguns funcionários nos contaram que eles já sabiam que existe uma espécie de "toca" dos ratos na parede, e que nada fizeram antes, aí fiquei inconformado. 
Uma coisa é fato, depois do ocorrido eles fecharam o restaurante e começaram uma reforma (ponto positivo)

Outra pena é o mar em frente ao Hotel com muitas algas, prejudicando um pouco o visual. Em alguns países os hotéis tem serviço de limpeza dessas algas. PArece que de dois anos pra cá piorou muito. Andando 400 metros do hotel o mar já é mais bonito.

reviews.author: antónio f
reviews.title: Guardado no coração!
reviews.text:
Punta cana de si só é indiscritivel e este hotel é mesmo o Parsiso. 
A harmonia deste espaço transporta-nos para um lugar magico.
As pessoas são simpáticas e amáveis e os quartos incriveis.
Ficariamis aqui o resto da vida se fosse possivel.

reviews.author: machellelenae
reviews.title: Friends wedding
reviews.text: Arrived on a Monday and the hotel was not very busy. Beautiful resort friendly staff, clean rooms, turn down service each night. Our stay was for 7 days and did not have a disappointing day. Swim up bar at pool had great staff!! Juan Gabriel Polanco (pretty eyes) is amazing! He was always smiling and helpful even when helping an elderly family member with a chair that she could get in and out of easily. He didn't hesitate to grab her a chair and help her up and into the chair.  Juan definitely made our friends wedding week amazing! Thanks for the amazing stay it left our large group wanting to go back soon!!

reviews.author: Paola Andrea F
reviews.title: El mejor lugar para que tus clientes vivan experiencias Inolvidables!!
reviews.text:
Hace unos idas estuvimos realizando un evento para uno de los clientes mas importantes de la Agencia. y recibimos todo el apoyo y profesionalismo de todo el equipo del hotel, todo esto encabezado por Massiel Jimenez quien fue nuestro apoyo en todo el proceso del evento que resulto siendo un exito!! 
Gracias Massiel y todo tu equipo por ayudarnos a cumplir nuestro objetivo que era un cliente feliz :)

reviews.author: Dixie O
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Felipe Morla & Yesenil Farias are in my opinion the greatest staff at this hotel. We looked forward to waking up early daily to enjoy their wonderful hospitality.These to made our stay pleasant even when the sun was down.

reviews.author: AnaPrada
reviews.title: INOLVIDABLE!!!
reviews.text:
Hicimos una reunión por 4 días con 300 personas!! Todo fue perfecto !! el evento un éxito!!! el servicio impecable, siempre tuvimos manos que nos ayudaron en TODO, logística, alimentos , habitaciones, camareros etc .
Su líder Massiel Jimenez, increíble , siempre dispuesta ayudar, solo nos queda decir GRACIAS por cada uno de los detalles, gracias por su paciencia y por su dedicación.

Sin duda volvería hacer otro evento allí !!!!

reviews.author: Anthony R
reviews.title: One of the best vacations I have ever had! A wonderful experience!
reviews.text: The Reserve is an excellent choice for couples looking to get away and have a romantic and relaxing experience. The resort grounds are beautifully manicured, the restaurants were amazing, and the staff was absolutely the best.

reviews.author: lizbeth
reviews.title: traveled on 09/2015- This review is long over due!
reviews.text: One of the best vacations I've had! My husband and I stayed for a week and it was such a great time. We met some amazing people including Anthony and Leandro who work at the restaurant and serve at the bar. Such friendly and pleasant people! they made us feel so welcomed and comfortable we felt like we've known them for years =) everyone did an excellent job at just making the ambiance warm and inviting. I loved the scenery especially at night with the lighting surrounding the plants gave it a very romantic touch. We enjoyed the food and entertainment (kind of wished that the hotel played more of its island music). I would love to go back soon, Jean Paul (or maybe Pierre, sorry its been over a year =/) was our gracious host who showed us around and familiarized us with the services the hotel offers. It's worth every penny! Highly recommend =)

reviews.author: ChanGun
reviews.title: Will definitely be back!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Having never before been to DR, we decided to take a family trip (10 of us) for a week at the Palma. Let me just say that I'm still unsure what we did to "deserve" this #incredible experience. Although a fantasy when compared to the reality of other parts of the Dominican, this has been one of the best #vacations we've ever taken. It was our first all-inclusive trip and did not disappoint on any level. Sometimes with a larger group things can get dicey when making plans as certain people like to do one thing, while others prefer to do something entirely different. ALL of us had plenty to do based on whatever whim or desire crept up. 
As you all know, the staff of a venue can make or break the reputation of a place and the overall feel. Let me emphatically shout from the rooftops tha the people here are beautiful, #warm, and graciously #attentive. And while some may claim that they are "just performing their working duties," it is clear that there is a real sense of pride motivating them. We got a chance to speak with many on several occasions and it makes our gratitude for all that they do even more significant. We've been treated with such care and not once did we feel unwelcome in their home. That is a gift, and one not to be overlooked or understated. The #smiles are contagious.
Among those that really took this vacation to another level were the following:

Laura- Great personality, a sweetheart and all around fun loving gal. She kept us informed of entertainment happening each day and really contributed to the good times we had. Often she encouraged our dancing as well as participation in other activities and we were happier for it.
Gasolina- I seriously want whatever this guy has as far as where he gets his energy from. We had a great time with him from impromptu dance classes as well as those scheduled. He brought the party with him wherever he went and so obviously has a passion for what he does. Find him when you're here- you won't be sorry!
Luis- Get this: Every day this kind gentleman prepared drinks for three of our party that went down to the #pool #bar earlier than the rest of us. Once he learned what they liked, as soon as he saw them and they shared greetings he would get those drinks ready and bring them over. EVER DAY. Without a thought. You want to talk about #VIP service? Luis is THE MAN.
Rafi, Maria and Miguel- Often the waitstaff gets overlooked, especially when you're in and out of buffets and restaurants throughout your trip. These three were fun, kind, considerate and so very attentive to our needs before we could even thinks to ask much of the time. Waiting tables can become monotonous after a while, but these three (as I'm certain most everyone) made coming for a meal a welcomed treat. My favourite memory was Miguel dancing as he came to the table. And everyone being so patient and #gracious as I practiced the Spanish I haven't often used since school days. There were also two gentleman behind the dessert counter at Naos, whose names I did not catch, during the lunch and evening meals. Very helpful and very kind.

The #food here is outstanding. No matter what at your taste, you have options. From #Italian to #Mexican, #steakhouse to #Hibachi, to an amazing #buffet. You will never be short on food, even if you have food allergies or other restrictions. It was easy to eat healthy here as well as cheat when wanted. Naos (buffet) was a staple for most breakfasts and lunches for us due to the variety or tasty treats. Personally, I think you'll find the best pizza here at lunch; Even better than at Olio. We also ate at Rare, which was terrifically delicious, and Aqua which was very good.

As for #activities, the pool and beach were so utterly relaxing that there isn't much more to comment on other than however you want to enjoy these spaces, there are more varieties of ways to do so than you can imagine; From #pool #lounges and #huts to soak in the shade under, to #private style #cabanas, to beach boxes with beds within, beds in the sun, #beach chairs both under little huts as well as out in the sun depending on what you want. They have quite literally thought of everything. We also took a really fun #painting class one afternoon which wound up serving as another souvenir for us to take home, and there was live #entertainment nightly in the #theater. And if you want to #dance, you can pretty much find dancing happening somewhere at any time. And if you can't, just look for Laura and Gasolina and they'll hook you up on the spot!

If you want to be treated with kindness, care and feel like royalty, come here. One thing is for sure, once we save up again we'll definitely be back. We've so enjoyed the memories made as a family here as well as all of the people we had the privilege of meeting.

reviews.author: Daniel N
reviews.title: Und wieder im Paradies
reviews.text:
Wir sind wieder im Pardies.
The Reserve mit Ocean front view.
Ein Traum...
Man hat hier keine Wünsche offen und falls doch werden diese erfüllt.
Die Melia Kette ist einer der besten diesee Welt .  Sowohl Ibiza als auch hier in der Dominikanische Republik - ein Traum.
Hier kann man die Seele baumeln lassen und sich den Annehmlichkeiten, die das Hitel zu bieten hat, genießen!
Mein Dank an die Sunset bar mit Wanda, Francisco, Carlos - ihr verschönert unsere Zeit am Pool!
Danke an Juan Suarez die perfekte Bedienung beim Frühstück etc. 
Unseren Dank an Faustino , dee überall wae und sich drum gekümmert hat, dass es uns gut geht.
Danke an Juan De Dios - der uns sie besten kulinarischen Tips gab.
Besonderen Dank an das Team von Passion ! Selten so gut gegessen.
Dank an Junior und alle anderen Mitarbeiter von Passion! Danke!
Ich kann nur sagn - bis bald - wir sind bald wieder da!!! 
Sylvia & Daniel

reviews.author: Marylinda C
reviews.title: Lindas vacaciones!!!
reviews.text:
100% recomendable!!!😊

reviews.author: angelicavillarroel

reviews.text:
Tuvimos un evento para 300 personas con uno de los clientes más importantes de la agencia.

reviews.author: Dolores Ríos

reviews.text:
Dahiana alias chorty, Caramelo.yGasolina.

reviews.author: Dotty P
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Hotel divino, mexe com seus sentidos pq onde vc anda um aroma maravilhoso lhe acompanha, desde a chegada na recepção aos banheiros. ..quero esse cheirinho na minha casa... Comida ótima, bebidas e drinks muito bem feitos. A equipe fantástica, sempre alegres, sorridente e bem dispostos, fazem o possível para lhe atender bem... Queria agradecer ao  Rafi que nos atendeu todas e aos monitores: Gasolina que tem uma energia cotagiante e ao Caramelo que é super simpático.

reviews.author: Andrew H
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Paradisus had been amazing it is truly paradise everyone is so friendly and treat you well! Luis Sanchez our butler has been spectacular, definitely recommend everyone to come here, it's definitely hard to go back to reality after this

reviews.author: julieta5656
reviews.title: Punta cana paradisus palma real muy buenos empleados, nos hicieron pasar muy bien
reviews.text: Gasolina,leo,caramelo,looky looky,caridad,didi,yohanna,dahiana,Laura.. son los mejores, nuestras vacaciones fueron mejor gracias a ellos. Disfrutamos mucho nuestra estadía, y la pasamos muy bien, muchas gracias

reviews.author: lindsaywsg
reviews.title: Great all inclusive resort
reviews.text: It is our first time visiting DR and this resort has not disappointed.  It is beautiful and clean and the employees are helpful, fun and polite.  Every morning someone offers to get our towels for us.  Luis at the pool bar brings my husband his drink before he even asks for it.  The highlight of this trip for me was the spa where Risma gave me the best massage ever!  There is always something to do if you want, though usually I choose to just sit and relax.  The entertainment staff is fun without being intrusive.  Shanty always made a special effort to check in and let us know what was going to be happening or just chat.  If there is one negative it would be that not every restaurant is great.   Our favorite was the steakhouse, Rare.  We would definitely come back.

reviews.author: bea_escobar8
reviews.title: Buenísimas vacaciones
reviews.text: Hola soy Bea Escobar y quería comentar que la pase muy bien en estas vacaciones. Me voy con un especial cariño por caramelo, gasolina, Shaky Shaky, Angelo, Argenis del equipo de entretención y no pude estar mejor atendida por Obeidy, Felipe, Raúl y Rabel en la playa.

reviews.author: Paulina R
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones!!
reviews.text:
Nos vamos demasiado felices por nuestra estadía en el hotel. Esta es la cuarta vez y siempre quedamos encantados. 
La gente que ahí trabaja es muy gentil y con una muy buena disposición. 
Quiero enviar saludos y agradecimientos especiales a Raúl Jiménez, Obeidy y Felipe Morla de la piscina y playa. A Víctor (bartender Fuego) y Emanuelle (bar tender Gabi). A Gasolina, Caramelo, Argenis, Angelo, Dahiana y por supuesto Shaky Shaky!! Todos ellos nos animaron día a día sobretodo en mejorar nuestros bailes. 
Y una mención muy especial para nuestro querido Gabi (Gabriel Dalusma) quien nos atendió de maravillas. 
Un abrazo a todos y gracias por estas vacaciones!!
Paulina Robertson (familia Escobar)

reviews.author: Nadia972
reviews.title: decevant
reviews.text: Nous avons passé deux jours avec nos deux petites filles, et nous avons été déçus car rapport qualité prix il est loin d un grand hotel. Il est tres grand et le système de shuttle n'est pas du tout organise, donc lorsque nous allions mange le soir avec nais petites filles nous attendions parfois 15 20minutes pour une navette et très souvent elles ne venaient pas nous devions marcher avec nos puces endormies. Le service est très moyen le personnel vous annonce au départ qu'ils seront la pour vous mais si vous ne donnez pas de gros pourboires vous n aurez aucune attention ou aide durant le séjour. La literie est moyenne et aucune activité correcte est prévue pour les enfants avec un club enfant pas très professionnel. Seul point agréable les restaurants buffet très variés et très bon et le parc tropical ainsi que les piscines très beaux.

reviews.author: caitycait5678
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I'm just taking the time on my vacation, to let paradisus Palma real golf resort that Fernando Geronimo is absolutely hands down the best. We called the room service and in minutes he was here with in seconds. Not only his friendly personality and his outstanding service he was willing to go up and beyond for our requests. I highly recommend him to all the guest at paradisus Palma real golf resort.

reviews.author: jasonmerlep
reviews.title: Outstanding trip for an anniversary in a royal service room
reviews.text:
This is an above average resort.  The resort is located beach front.  It has three sister resorts that are adjacent and a shopping center as well.  It is an amazing experience if you upgrade to a royal service room,  The royal service area is adults only.  In the royal service area you will get private beach and pool areas that have bali beds, a concierge, access to an exclusive restaurant, exclusive check in/out area and more.  
We enjoyed the service of our concierge, Miguel.  He took care of the details of reserving the bali bed and dinner reservations, prepared a romantic bubble bath and so much more so we didn't have to worry about any of the details and just let him know what we wanted.
We tried Passion, the restaurant with the up charge.  We are so grateful to the supervisor, Juan Carlos that helped us navigate so menu issues due to some dietary restrictions and rescuing a situation that in the end had us really satisfied that we dined there. 
Palazzo restaurant in the royal service area was amazing.  One highlight was the food, delicious and well presented.   Even better was the staff in particular, Zenovia the hostess was always giving such warm and friendly greetings.  Also, Marino, bartender made the best drinks.  He customized the drinks to our liking and always had something new to try.
This was our first trip to the resort and we went celebrating an anniversary.  We were there in the off season and really enjoyed it not being busy.  I am not sure that we would have enjoyed it as much if not in the off season or not in the royal service room.

reviews.author: Ana Teresa F
reviews.title: Un lugar para relajarse y disfrutar
reviews.text: Las habitaciones son amplias, tiene variedad de restaurantes, la playa hermosa, un spa completo con excelentes instalaciones y la atención fue amable siempre. Tuve problemas con el jacuzzi dentro de la habitación pero lograron solucionarlo sin inconveniente.

reviews.author: Brooke S
reviews.title: Great hotel for an incentive program.
reviews.text: I recently hosted an incentive program for 100 people at the resort and it was fantastic.  We utilized Royal Service & The Reserve for our guest rooms which are ocean view rooms, which I think is key.  The service levels were fantastic, especially from Niela Eugeio who was in charge of taking care of our group.  She didn't miss a beat with the details of the program, decor, entertainment, guest room needs, and she was always available on property to help out.  Not to mention she has a great attention to detail.  ALSO, the restaurants at the hotel were great, good food and beverage options and great service.  I would love to bring another group to this property.

reviews.author: kikoescobar
reviews.title: Magnificas Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Se.los recomiwnto y agradecemos a tod el.personal del hotel por su cariño y preocupacion. La comida excelente. Los tragos del restaurante Fuego...preparados Victor...lo mejor del lugar.
Los muchachos de la Piscina del area socios...Raul y compañia...muy atentos a todo lo que haga falta.
Nuestro amigo y concierge...Gabriel...muy afectuoso ....
En fin...para descansar en familia y lograr un verdero descanso...este es el lugar.

reviews.author: ams122779
reviews.title: Wonderful Corporate Event
reviews.text:
I recently planned a work incentive trip at the Paradisus.  I live in the U.S. (Iowa) and had never been to a Paradisus resort.  I had been to the Dominican several times and wanted to try out a new place.  I had to reley on the events team and do all the planning over email.  The event planner I worked with was Niela Eugenio.  She was amazing to work with.  She helped coordinate everything for our event and I didn't have to worry about a thing.  She was extremely responsive via email and was there on site if we had any questions at all.  I would highly recommend this resort for any couples looking for a romantic get a way or even for a company event!

The beach was also one of the best beaches I have ever visited!

reviews.author: Serei P
reviews.title: Best resort I've ever stayed at!!
reviews.text: Gorgeous resort from the entrance all the way to the beach! So many delicious restaurants and beautiful bars to choose from. Top notched service all around! So many areas to relax but also love the nightlife at Gabi Beach; the employees are so much fun getting everyone to dance! I wish my stay lasted longer!

reviews.author: Jorge V
reviews.title: Buenas vacaciones
reviews.text: Raynold tamayo Una buena persona increible cada vez que venimos en familia con el se pasa exelente pura buena vibra y buen guia ademas jsjs un buen bailarin esta en todas partes con buena dispocicion 👍👍👍👍👌✌👆☝👐

reviews.author: Gabriel M
reviews.title: Honeymoon Lit
reviews.text: The moment we stepped foot in Paradisus we were treated with the utmost care. The resort is beautiful and well cared for. The staff is friendly and they make sure you're well taken care of every minute. The bartenders are especially Bladimir and Jensyn are friendly. Santo Polanco took care of us whenever we sat by the poolside and took our drink orders and made great conversation. I definitely recommend this place if you're looking for a great and relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: KGD33280514
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text: Attended a wedding. Room, food, weather, everything was perfect. Buffet was amazing. Always activities to kerp busy when not lounging in the pool or by the beach. Pool is large enough for adults and children to enjoy.

reviews.author: Michael L

reviews.author: Alejandro J

reviews.author: fernandosanguini

reviews.text: Amei conhecer o Resort!Foi tudo maravilhoso!O local é maravilhoso,a comida é divina e toda a equipe é fantástica,sempre dispostos a encantar os clientes desde os garçons,barmans,cozinheiros,porteiros e arrumadeiras.Nossos agradecimentos especiais as monitores :gasolina e chekx cheks,super animados e pondo todo mundo para bailar e a camareira Rancel Valdez super atenciosa.esse lugar é o verdadeiro paraíso

reviews.author: Andrea F
reviews.title: Honeymoon!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve while we were there. Luis our butler was wonderful and took care of everything. Whatsapp allows you to talk and communicate to home without all the fees and your Butler services. Angel in the lobby was great getting us checked in and Victoria at the Yhi Spa was amazing!

reviews.author: Bruna M
reviews.title: Cumpre a promessa
reviews.text: Hospedei com a minha família e um casal de amigos e a experiência foi ótima, boa comida, bebida, quartos impecáveis e conforto excepcional o único inconveniente para não ter dado a nota máxima foi a apatia das cuidadoras no kids zone, não tive coragem de deixar meu bebê de quase dois anos lá, nas duas oportunidades que visitei as colaboradoras totalmente descomprometidas e não interagiam com os bebês q ali estavam, a gota d'Água foi quando meu  filho foi usar o toalete e estava entupido e nenhuma delas sequer sabia, descaso total e não combina com a proposta do hotel. Também faltava porções na praia e uma piscina mais próxima do mar, no mais perfeito!

reviews.author: Marcel Ribeiro de Lima
reviews.title: Ótimo resort
reviews.text:
Pontos positivos:
Muito limpo e organizado.
Linda arquitetura.
Bela praia e mar, msm com algas de manhã, já que o trator limpa toda a areia, que é branca e fina.
Bons restaurantes e boa variedade de comida, todas bem feitas.
Funcionários cordiais.
Tivemos Family Concierge, que inicialmente deixou a desejar, mas foi substituída pela Elaine, que foi muito bem e nos ajudou.
Belas piscinas e com bar.
Transfer grátis para o Shopping, mas o preço é semelhante ao do Brasil, porém, tem lojas que não temos e vale visitar.
Boa variedade de bebidas, com chopp local "Presidente" e Budweiser nos quartos, tudo incluído.

Pontos a melhorar:
Kids Zone muito bem instalado e com muitos brinquedos, mas as monitoras não interagem com as crianças, apenas cuidam.
Não servem porção de alimento na praia, apenas bebida.
Não tem piscina de frente para o mar, embora haja uma próxima.

Em resumo, vale muito a pena vir, recomendo.

reviews.title: lua de mel
reviews.text:
lua de mel 5 estrelas, tudo fantastico...
bladimir heredia, santo polanco, jensy rijo, estelita , marcelo sem duvida os melhores parabens a todos pelo atendimento.... Tudo fantastico parabens, unico que não nos agradou foi a limpeza do quarto! mais uma vez obrigado adorámos... 
ate para o ano 😉

reviews.author: kelly w
reviews.title: The Amazing Lobby Bar Experience!!!
reviews.text: Antonio & Angelita at the Lobby Bar were simply AMAZING!!!  I am allergic to alcohol....yes allergic...so they made me specialty fruit drink and smoothies that were simply AMAZING!  Their service was top notch and they were the sweetest people you could ever meet in the DR.  They made my stay, as well as my nieces, perfecto!!!  Antonio even helped me find a plug by the lobby bar so that I could do my homework! Their service was so great that they should really be managers training others.  The Lobby Bar will be unforgettable!!

reviews.author: Q3939HTjosephl
reviews.title: Went with girlfriend for a friend's wedding
reviews.text: Went with girlfriend for a friends wedding.  Venue was very clean, atmosphere was very nice and relaxing.  It was september, so vacation crowd was gone and it felt like we had the beach and pool to ourselves.  They did move the buffet from the usual larger venue to a smaller restaurant, which i felt limited the food selection.

reviews.author: Andres C
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones !
reviews.text: Estuvimos 12 días. Dos adultos y dos niñas de 6 y 2 años. La playa y las piscinas impecables. El staff muy amistoso. La habitación (3707) necesita un revamping los televisores son de museo. Wi Fi funciona muy bien. Todo muy limpio, un agrado. Estrella García- nuestra anfitriona- insuperable en su amistad y buena onda para resolvernos cualquier problema. Recomendamos esta experiencia a cualquier familia que busque vacaciones de verdad con buena comida y en un ambiente perfectamente seguro para sus niños. Volveremos de todas maneras. Tal vez hay un exceso de embarcaciones motorizadas en la playa y uno busca paz y silencio y quisiera ver veleros y kayaks en lugar de lanchas remolcando paracaídas pero la buena onda del Hotel compensa todo eso.

reviews.author: karin m
reviews.title: Honeymoon trip
reviews.text: Our honeymoon was absolutely amazing here. The staff was wonderful, and most of them spoke English well. The resort was stunning and gorgeous. There were activities everyday as well as several wonderful restaurants to pick from. The food was wonderful. From check in to check out the staff was attentive and friendly. Our favorite waiter (Juan Suarez) went out of his way to help us and to make sure we had everything we needed. He was very very nice and remembered our names all week. We had a couples massage here as well and the Oriental Garden staff was wonderful. It was very relaxing. We will most definitely be coming back here to stay!

reviews.author: Sergio Luiz M
reviews.title: Excelente opção
reviews.text: Levamos um grupo de incentivo e nos hospedamos com serviço Royal. Os quartos são melhores localizados, todos mais próximos a praia com serviços de mordomo. Usar esse tipo de serviço e poder desfrutar das áreas reservadas de praia, piscinas, restaurantes, faz com que a experiencia para um grupo pequeno e exclusivo seja melhor em todos os sentidos. Creio que o serviço de mordomo poderia ser um pouco melhor e com mais atenção aos hospedes. Talvez um pouco mais de treinamento a equipe ajudaria. E tambem melhorar o restaurante exclusivo deste serviço. Talvez um ambiente mais claro, com mais luz e mais espeço também seria mais adequado pela diferença que se paga para o 'serviço Royal'.

   Grande abraço, Eduardo e Mariana

reviews.author: vernonf313

The front desk staff needs some retraining in hospitality and empathy to guests. The rest of the hotel staff were friendly and accommodating throughout our stay. The hotel is beautiful and family friendly. The beach is gorgeous as well.

reviews.author: clarissah733

reviews.text: the Palma Real Hotel is really beautiful and the beach is breathtaking. the service at the restaurants was wonderful and the buffet restaurant had food choices for everyone. the spa was also great, with very relaxing treatments and very helpful staff.

reviews.author: 382dianan

The friendliness, service and attention provided by the staff is outstanding. What makes the difference is excellent quality service and our family experienced that on this trip. Francisco Estrella --> The pool area

5. Shaky shaky is awesome

reviews.author: Eddyson M
reviews.title: Fin de semana jevi y loka
reviews.text: El hotel muy chevere con una hermosa vista y hermosa playa con la gran ayuda de eduard mendez que gracias a sus atenciones se nos hiso mas facil conocer y perseguir las cosas del hotel muy chevere y lindo el hotel

reviews.author: Lenin K
reviews.title: Vacaciones inolvidables
reviews.text: Es nuestra primera ves en el paradisus palma real. Desde que llegamos fue todo perfecto nos recivieron en el royal service nos presentaron a nuestro mayordomos eduard mendez nos ayudo en todo en el hotel nos encantó la comida del Rare y del tenpayaki. los chicos de la picina y la playa son muy atentos. Eduard siempre estaba cada ves que los llamábamos y su amigo jeury de royal service fue muy amable. En cunclucion el hotel muy limpio y todo muy lindo.

reviews.author: anjaderover
reviews.title: Super onvergetelijke vakantie
reviews.text: Zijn net terug van een heerlijke vakantie in de reserve paradisus in punta cana. Deze vakantie was onvergetelijk. Dit is echt een heerlijk hotel, Hele mooie kamers, waanzinnig strand , mooie zwembadenen super schoon. Het eten was overheerlijk en waanzinnig veel keus, met verschillende restaurants. De service van het personeel kon niet beter, ze waren vriendelijk en zeer behulpzaam, niks was ze teveel. Iedere avond gezellige en leuk vertier, theater, live muziek, dj's, er was altijd iets te doen voor jong en oud. Zeker een aanrader, wij gaan zeker nog een keer terug.

reviews.author: Willy R
reviews.title: Sol y playa
reviews.text: En lo general pasamos unas vacacines inolvidable con  el equipo de el hotel,muy amable con sonrrisa todo el tiempo la energia que tienen los chicos de animacion,luis florian,melvin concepcion, josue camilo ramon esteban frias jesus de la cruz la pasamos excelente muy buen equipo de trabajo

reviews.author: G_Zsofia
reviews.title: Amazing holiday
reviews.text:
We spent a fantastic week at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. This hotel offers a fantastic value for the price.

It was my birthday and we were upgraded to Royal Service. Therefore we stayed in a large luxury room very close to the ocean, had our minibar refilled with food & beverages every day, had a private butler (many many thanks to Maria for making my birthday unforgettable!), access to private beach area and Royal Service Lounge with premium drinks.
The food and the service in each and every restaurant was beyond amazing. 

The hotel staff was very professional, attentive, friendly. We loved everything about this Resort and will definitely come back!

reviews.author: midoribenitez
reviews.title: Es un Paraiso!
reviews.text: Estuve de vacaciones en paradisus palma real y es un verdadero paraiso, excelente atenciones y muy buen servicio mi pareja y yo la pasamos de maravilla. El servicio en la habitación es muy bueno y todos son muy atentos.

reviews.author: Webert S
reviews.title: Ótima experiência! Férias fantásticas!
reviews.text:
Me hospedei no hotel Paradisus Palma Real em Punta Cana. Escolhi ficar num apartamento de vista para o mar com uma tarifa chamada Real Service. Além dessa existem os quartos "The Reserve" ( que oferecem alguns serviços especiais para famílias com crianças) e os quartos normais.
A categoria "Royal Service" atende apenas adultos e possui diversos "mimos". Entre eles, ter acesso a quase todos os restaurantes do complexo com exceção ao Passion que é assinado por um chefe espanhol que possui 7 estrelas Michelan espalhadas por restaurantes na Espanha. Fui em quase todos os restaurantes que o serviço dá acesso, exceto um especializado em comida mexicana. Basicamente se a reserva for de uma semana da para conhecer a todos. De maneira geral são bons porém o Rare (especializado em carnes) e o Aqua (especializado em comida mediterrânea - este fica na área chamada The Reserve, porém possui o mesmo conceito de outro que estava fechado para reforma).
Os outros diferenciais estão relacionados à categoria de bebida que são servidas, áreas exclusivas e ao serviço de mordomo. Com relação às bebidas, a cerveja é a mesma em todas as categorias porém o Rum (bebida da ilha sendo que alguns incluídos nesse pacote são muito bons), tequila, conhaque e whisky possuem categoria superiores. Na hora de pedir algum coquetel se não for pedido nada ele é preparado com a bebida da categoria inferior, portanto não esqueça de pedir para utilizar a bebida de sua preferência.
Falando um pouco sobre os espaços privados, existe uma piscina e uma área na praia. Ambas possuem um bar dedicado e cadeiras especiais. 
O serviço de mordomo deixa sua estadia ainda mais agradável e torna a experiência ainda mais única. Fui direcionado ao Armando Minier. Ele se encarregou de fazer todas as reservas nos restaurantes e nas cabanas em volta da piscina assim como deixava preparado a banheira para quando chegássemos da praia.
Ele é muito prestativo e atencioso, recomendo que na hora da reserva peçam pra que ele seja indicado para cuidar de vocês.

reviews.author: BarcelonaCuda
reviews.title: Royal Week
reviews.text: Fabulous week at the Paradisus in Punta Cana . We upgraded to the Royal Service and it was wonderful. Our butler Amando  took care of everything for us . He made our dinner reservations , set up our pool cabana and had wine, strawberries and a jacuzzi for us in our room . Our room was great and the restaurants were wonderful .

reviews.author: DEB L A
reviews.title: Great Entertainers and great staff at the reserve!
reviews.text:
We joined the wine tasting by connoisseur Gustavo Ramirez & Raynold Tamayo. Luis  Florian and Melvin Concepcion joined later on & entertained the group. 
The wine tasting was very educational. Raynold, Luis, & Melvin were warm, friendly, & hospitable.  We had a great time!

reviews.author: Paul T
reviews.title: beautiful resort..
reviews.text:
We thought the resort look gorgeous upon arrival. the staff was friendly Andrianna was very nice and showed us around the resort.  our room look very nice granite floors and counters throughout..the furniture was in dining area looked worn and had a mildewish smell throughout. bring a glade plug in or candle..that will slove that issue. the bulidings dont face the ocean so no views there. there is the reserve that offers that possibility if its important. most of your time is not spent in the room anyways. 
The dining experience was good in my opinion..6 different restaurants to schedule dinner in and i ate a 4.and the experience was great. the food is seasoned differently than what i am used to but overall i was pleased.there is a buffet always available and offered a good variety of options.
The staff made the whole trip for me.at the beach bar Ravel,julio and yensia made my trip awesome good conversation and juilo made me a special drink for a upset stomach and worked instantly...5 stars.
enteratainment was available nightly. Dianah was awesome at Gabi beach bar,she got me and wife dancing. nice shows at the Cinema .
the beach views where nice and clean.the downer was the seaweed in the water that came ashore and was represent in the water at many times made it a 4 star..the waters otherwise look great.
all in all i would could back to this resort again..this was not the peak season so the resort was not crowed which was fine with me..it made the service even better.
I will return again

reviews.author: zaraguais
reviews.title: Bonito...el paraíso
reviews.text:
Personal súper amable. En especial LUIS Florian y Melvin Conepcion. Muy divertidos, siempre atentos y dispuestos 
Ahora algunos restaurantes cerrados por obras...pero de todos, El Vento, el mejor
Las habitaciones amplias, limpias  y muy cómodas

reviews.author: nancyellenm2016
reviews.title: Family/friend holiday
reviews.text: My stay at Paradisus Palma real!  Food was amazing your chef Nicholas cooked us amazing food every night and accommodated one of our parties food allergies.  The night life was one of the best I've had while on vacation music ombiance great! Pool so relaxing beach area would be much better if free of seeweed.

reviews.author: Newdélia A
reviews.title: Piscina maravilhosa
reviews.text:
Fomos de férias em setembro agora com casal de amigos e 4 crianças.
O hotel é lindo, arquitetura maravilhosa, os quartos mais antigos, mas com hidromassagem e cama muito boa. A piscina é simplesmente fantástica, com bar..o atendimento é ótimo. 
Infelizmente para crianças o Hotel deixa muito a desejar, a área kids fica no The reserve e bem longe da melhor parte do Hotel e da praia. Levamos nossas crianças até lá, mas eles nem se interessaram em fica...achei isso péssimo, e nada viável.

Não optamos pelo The reserve, e não sentimos falta nenhuma, o serviço normal atendeu nossas expectativas. 
O restaurante principal é grande e farto, mas sempre as mesmas opções, acabamos enjoando...a melhor refeição é com certeza o café da manhã. Entre os restaurantes a la carte o destaque vai unica  e exclusivamente para o Italiano, comida deliciosa e atendimento impecável, em destaque para o garçon Wily, que adora brasileiros.
A praia é ótima, nessa época tinhas muitas algas, mas a água é boa, morninha e linda.
Enfim ferias maravilhosas!!! 
Só deixo aqui minha insatisfação pela falta de recreadores para as crianças na área da piscina principal do Paradisus e área da praia.
Passeio imperdível pelo visual lindo: Isla Saona, cansativo mas vale muito a pena.
Dolphin Discovery: Muito bom e caro e no fim uma foto custa 40 dólares ...um roubo, exploração, não compramos.

reviews.author: Veralucia L
reviews.title: Un verdadero Paraíso
reviews.text:
Estuve en un pequeño viaje por trabajo, puedo decir que es un hotel estupendo y servicio impecable, la gente súper cálida ...calidad de comida excelente tanto el fuego,palazzo y naos (buffet) para la cena vayan a Aqua excelente ambiente, si quieren un poco d fiesta y su agenda les permite red lounge es la opción 🙃 agradecimiento especial a María Gil de servicio real ,carmen Paulino ,y Fernando .
Agradezco todo los detalles recibidos
Volveré pero más tiempo

reviews.author: mdhebe
reviews.title: Great time, great resort!
reviews.text:
The reserve Paradisus Punta Cana provides such a wonderful experience. The variety and quality of each dinner restaurant always gave us something to look forward to throughout the day. The property is absolutely beautiful, very well maintained, and you really feel like you are in a paradise! 

There are numerous pool activities to keep you busy if you are interested, but the peacefulness around the pool is always respected.

Overall an amazing experience.

Some of the reserve's associates that added real value to our experience on our trip:

Yanit-Melisa: Very welcoming, accommodating, and always with a smile on her face. She even left us a few awesome surprises in our room ;)

Entertainers: some of the entertainers were funny, great to chat with, and ran some great activities: Luis, Melvin, Ray, and Wander.

reviews.author: RossMcVey
reviews.title: Good & relaxing family holiday.
reviews.text:
Stayed as a family of 4 (2 children 3 & 5) and thoroughly enjoyed the stay.  As a family we generally do not like large hotel complexes, but found the reserve a nice mix with the feel of a smaller hotel and having your own pool, restaurants, etc, but with the facilities of a larger complex.  The kids zone is excellent and gives a large variety of things for the kids - including evening activities so that the parents can have dinner on their own!

Went with the family concierge service and felt that this just made the holiday the bit more special, with our concierge (Elizabeth Penge)  being very good always being on hand to help out with restaurant booking, cabana bookings and always doing things for the children - they especially enjoyed coming back to the room to see a bubble bath with minion's balloons.

All the staff were very friendly, choice and variety of food was very good and the reserve private beach a lovely place to be.  Rooms are large and very nice (although ours was on the ground floor overlooking the road where the buggies drove so could get noisy if you wanted to sit on the balcony). 

Would echo the comments on the Melia Club presentation, long sales pitch before they will give you a price on a 25 year commitment to holiday with the same company which (in our case) would not have saved us any money - would avoid and enjoy the rest of your time in the hotel.

reviews.author: JonahG1085
reviews.title: Cockroach and Blood found in 2 different rooms
reviews.text:
After being recommended by family and friend to visit the Paradisus Real Resort, I was extremely DISAPPOINTED in the Service, Cleanliness, Food offered by the resort. 

My fiancé and I arrived at 2:30pm to find that not ready and the gentlemen who was checking in told us the room would be ready in "5 minutes", which in reality mean at least 30min to locals. Upon checking into our room, we encountered 2 cockroaches, Stained Towels, Stained Carpets, Stained Windows, half empty mini bar and clogged toilet. I contacted management immediately who at first didn't seem to believe that I had found a cockroach but left it there for them to see. Out check in took 2 hours.

After being switched to another room, we found what looked to be blood stains on our sheets and once again contacted management. At this point we asked kindly that we didn't feel comfortable staying at the hotel after everything we had encountered in that short amount of time. The manager offered to change our sheets and once he did, the ones he replaced the blood stained once was ALSO dirty. I couldn't believe that it happened not once or twice, but 3 times.

We tried asking to be let out of our night but were forced to stay or LOSE our MONEY.

The food was extremely POOR quality which caused my fiancé and I to eat outside of the resort.

This place is a complete steal. STAY AWAY

reviews.author: Beach_Chic01
reviews.title: Beautiful & Relaxing Trip with a few flaws
reviews.text:
I've been going to Punta Cana for the last 12 years and this was one of my most relaxing trips so far...except for a few hiccups.  My husband and I along with our 6 year old daughter stayed here from August 10th-17th.  Upon arrival we were greeted warmly and we were given an upgrade to a Family Concierge room and our Family Concierge, Sandra introduced herself. The room was not ready since we arrived 1 hour prior to check-in but we were able to have lunch at the buffet and then our room was ready. 

While it was a gorgeous room, with a dining area and living room, balcony with a view to the pool, it had a very strong smell of cigarette smoke.  We thought the smell would leave, and the turn down service lady sprayed something everywhere to help but that was only a temporary fix. The next day we noticed that the entire living room and dining area still had a very strong smell.  Thank God we didn't let our daughter sleep in the living room sofa bed.  We informed our the reception desk and they found us another room and were moved the following day.  

Another flaw was the wait for a cart to go to the beach....PLEASE NOTE: THIS RESORT DOES NOT HAVE BEACH FRONT ROOMS OR AN OCEAN VIEW.
For me, this was very important and I should have done my research before booking.  We had to wait for a cart every day to go to the beach and then back to our room.  One night we waited over 20 minutes (during peak dinner time hours) just to go to dinner at the main resort, Paradisus Punta Cana (which actually has beach front rooms).  For the price you pay at this resort, this is unexpected. 

One other flaw was the limited buffet at both the reserve and at the main resort. Both buffets had the smallest assortment I've ever seen in Punta Cana. I've stayed at the Melia Caribe Tropical, Gran Bahia Principe, and Barcelo Bavaro Palace Deluxe and they all have amazing buffets and variety.  This was definitely lacking at The Reserve.  And being American with Dominican parents, both my husband and I at least expected them to have traditional Dominican rice and beans, which they only have on Wednesdays for Dominican night.

Also, The Reserve pool is very quiet and doesn't play background music at all times.  For some excitement and music, we ended up going to the Paradisus Punta Cana main pool.

On a positive note: the Kids Zone is great and our daughter actually stayed for a few hours on a couple of days, and she's never done that before at any resort. They have an hourly/weekly schedule of activities for the kids and I felt safe leaving here there for a little while.  

Sad to say, but I wouldn't return here due to the unexpected flaws. I enjoyed my vacation because I couldn't let these things ruin it, but truly wished that it could have been perfect.

reviews.text: Cumplió con todas nuestras expectativas.Estamos planificando volver el año próximo.Un punto negativo, al final de nuestra estadía, se instaló en el Resort  Meliaá, al lado del nuestro un grupo de gente, que nos enteramos para esta fecha y por una semana lo contratan todo el año. reviews.text: This review is specifically for the activities mentioned above. I took part in both activities with several others and really enjoyed them. Eduardo was patient and encouraging and ensured we all had lots of fun. Great way to build up an appetite before lunch!

reviews.author: Marc P
reviews.title: My wedding at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My now wife and I had stayed at this resort previously and separately and when we decided to do a destination wedding in Punta Cana in early September this year she suggested this resort.  Not until May when we went to do a walk through did I realize I had stayed her before.  For anyone looking to do a destination wedding in Punta Cana look no further...the onsite Romance Coordinators and staff was phenomenal and every little detail worked out as planned.  The setting between the beach, gazebos, lighting will also be hard to beat anywhere else in Punta Cana.  As far as the hotel itself, they are and have been doing renovations to the guest rooms and they are all very spacious.  We upgraded to the Presidential Suite and it was quite an experience.  The food for an all-inclusive resort is also above average and if you want to treat yourself I highly suggest to pay the fee for Passion Restaurant!  Overall it's the staff who make the visit and resort what it is as they're so friendly and accommodating.  Highly recommend the Paradius Palma Real if you are looking for a little slice of Paradise in Punta Cana

reviews.author: DimArh
reviews.title: Место, где Вам всегда рады
reviews.text: Всё великолепно, ко многим восторженным отзывам мне особо добавить нечего, кроме благодарности персоналу отеля - всем без исключения - за прекрасно проведённый отдых. reviews.author: 488ally
reviews.title: True Paradise
reviews.text: I had the most amazing time at this resort. Everyone was so friendly and happy. The grounds were immaculate and absolutely gorgeous. I think we spent the majority of our vacation in the pool at the swim up bar. We had so much fun meeting new people and the bartender Leandro Sanchez was absolutely the best bartender at the resort. I will definitely be back at this resort, hopefully in the near future.

reviews.author: jamie384
