reviews.text: I was able to stay at the Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana last week and had an amazing experience. The staff made it so much more memorable! Naomi Campbell (Germainia) & Luis were so entertaining and made the activities all the more fun! Hermes Martinez at the Gabi CLub was a great bartender & Leandro Sanchez rocked the pool bar. We spend a large majority of the week there having Leandro made us the best drinks and provide great entertainment! I cannot wait to visit the Reserve again! Best week ever - I recommend this over and over!

reviews.author: B R
reviews.title: Nice place to visit, but beware of a few things
reviews.text:
For our first trip to Punta Cana, we stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  (Note: the "Reserve" refers to a part of the Paradisus set aside for Melia Resort Members, but can be available for general bookings, especially in the off-season). 

Pros:  Large rooms, wonderful staff, nice grounds, OK-Good food (with excellent fruit at all times), nice workout facility, good wi-fi
Cons:  Half-mile from the beach, big-push to become a Melia Resort Member, strange restaurant reservation system (covered well by other reviewers) 

Overall we had a wonderful time, but we must mention several specifics, some of which are downers: 

Offer of "$1,500 Credit for Resort Activities" if you stay 7 days or more.  This verbage is misleading.  The $1,500 comprises coupons for: 
1. $300 for an upgraded room within 24-hours from when you arrive
2. $50 off massage, and some other 50-80 minute services, for up to 3 services at the Spa (we did this and loved it) 
3. $20 off wine bottles that are priced at $100 or more (Note:  We bought $45-$60 bottles, so we did not use these)
4. Coupons for eating at their restaurant, which is not included in the all-inclusive, to offset some of that cost (We did not use them) 
4. Coupons for purchases at a shopping center that is 30 min(?) away from the resort (we did not use these)

Push to Join Melia:  This is similar to a time-share-type presentation with the classic car-salesmen type approach and information doled out very slowly.  To get to the price takes 2-3 hours.  (Do not believe 90 minutes.)  The deal requires pre-purchase of 20-50 years of Membership (at $25K-$55K) plus an annual fee of $1,000-$1,300 (at least at the start).   Very tiresome.  They imply that you cannot get the $1,500 in coupons without going through it but do not believe that.  

Reward program for staff. The Melia rewards staff for being mentioned on sites like Trip Advisor, so they will request that.  And here are a few that really stood out for their excellence: Leandro Sanchez at the swim-up bar; Luis at the Reserve's buffet restaurant; and Mikey-Mike, the representative that handled our logistics.  

Music and some of the entertainment.  It all has European (don't expect Caribbean music in the background).  

Finally, we had a wonderful time and would recommend it.  However, I doubt given everything that we would go back, but would try another resort after already spending a week at the Reserve.

reviews.author: Sherry H
reviews.title: #Experince
reviews.text: Thanks Yanet for making are last night one of the best! #service was amazing all weekend..great relaxing atmosphere...spacious suites, with access to 11 restaurants, great beach..latin night was amazing.

reviews.author: A9538CMrobt
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We were very pleased with our Butler....Francisco and would request him again on any future trips.  We would suggest room upgrades (without addtional cost) as the oceanview room we requested sat VACANT the entire stay of our vacation

reviews.author: DrMike2014
reviews.title: A Second Helping...
reviews.text:
We recently returned to Punta Cana and the Paradisus Palma Real for a second time. That is unusual for us as we like to try new places.
This time we brought the rest of the family. I'll give you the pros and cons then I'll go into more detail.
Pros: Royal service, beautiful grounds, attentive and friendly staff, spa (hydrotherapy).
Cons: Turtle grass/seaweed on beach in front of hotel, crowded, not much to do at night other than drink.
I think the royal service is definitely the way to go. It allows you access to certain restaurants that are less crowded, a personal butler, and unlimited access to the hydrotherapy spa. You also have your own semi private beach and private swimming pools.
The staff is very friendly and we were always well taken care of. Everything from prime location on the beach, top shelf drinks, cold water whenever, and a Butler with an uncanny ability to find us wherever we were on the property.
The beach is very nice and beautiful with palm trees and white sand. In front of the hotel however there is a lot of turtle grass that washes up on the beach (although they clean the beach every morning) but it stains the water a greenish color and it floats around your legs while in the water. If you go down the beach a way to the right, it is clear of the grass and better for swimming.
It was definitely more crowded in August  than in February when we visited last time. Another advantage of Royal service helps shelter you from the crowds if you want to. You still have access to all the same areas as everyone else.
At night there was not a lot to do and my Kids (21 and 18) were bored after dinner. 
The Reserve is more oriented towards families, but is not on or very near the beach-you have a ten minute walk or take a golf-cart shuttle. 
At night the music trended towards loud Latin dance music which if you don't like can grow old very quickly.
Another thing about Punta Cana-the snorkeling/diving is not very good there and most "snorkeling excursions" turn out to be booze cruises with very loud music and bad drinks. The local area appears to be pretty safe and the Resorts are all behind gated walls.
All in all, I like the DR; its close to Atlanta, relatively easy to get into/out of, a little on the expensive side (Costco Travel can save you some $), and a relaxing place to hang out for awhile.

reviews.author: Anabela R
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: Estuve una semana en el paraiso. Este hotel lo tiene todo! La comida es muy buena y variada. Las instalaciones del hotel, bellisimas. La playa, espectacular! pero lo mejor de todo son sus empleados, siempre atentos y amables. En el bar del lobby, Jose se excedio en atenciones y simpatia, sin dejar de nombrar a Popeye, del grupo de animaciin y baile, siempre energico y simpatico, nos puso a bailar todos los dias en el Gaby Beach. Volvere.....

reviews.author: julio A
reviews.title: Vacacines
reviews.text:
Mi esposa rosa y yo julio cesar Abreu 
Estuvimos haces 2 semanas por allá 
Y la pasamos como príncipes 
Para nosotros fue una aventura muy hermosa haber estado ahí en ese hermosos hoteles el personal muy atentos los k nos recibieron ,los del comidas tanto en el dasasuno ,luch,cena y los jóvenes de actividades son los mejores de todos los hoteles de del área .nosotros se lo recomendamos a todos . Creemos que se merecen más de 5 estrellas.gracias por todos a todos
Muy amable.

reviews.author: Ken H
reviews.title: Wonderful stay overall
reviews.text:
We did the family concierge. Def worth it. You basically get a personal assistant throughout your stay. He made our dinner res's , pool cabana holds, beach hut reserves , whatever we needed.  The food is great.  I've heard mixed reviews about all inclusive food, but not here.  Excellent. 
Also, the reserve is attached to the main hotel, so their are two pools, both have swim up bars.  Unlimited drinks. And the staff is great.  Friendly. Wonderful to my kids who wanted Shirley Temples all day.  I would recommend bringing a stack of singles because the tipping is not required, but the modest gesture goes a long way.
Nightlife was surprisingly awesome.  At night, they have different parts of the resort offer entertainment. (Beach party, Dominican Night, theater, etc).  
There is also a beach just for Reserve stayers. There is a tram that drives around the resort all day so it can take you back and forth to your building to the beach.  
I really don't have anything negative to review.  
One thing I will say is that it seemed like if you wanted something it was Ok to just ask for it.  They welcome tourism and the country thrives on it.  It was an amazing vacation.

reviews.author: 686edwarda
reviews.title: August 2016 Trip
reviews.text: Very good experience this summer.  I would recommend it to anyone visiting Punta Cana.  I was there for a wedding.  Presentation and service for the wedding was excellent.  Not likely to return to the same resort within the next 2 years.  Would like to visit somewhere else.

reviews.author: Lyne R
reviews.title: magnifique semaine au Paradisus
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une magnifique semaine au Paradisus. La beauté de ce site
est incroyable. La végétation qui est présente partout où on se promène de toute beauté. La nourriture est excellente, chambre très propre. Nous tenons à remercier Juan Carlos et Franklin pour les délicates attention à notre égard. Que dire du magnifique sourire et service de Louisa oni. C est notre 2ieme voyage au Paradisus et nous recommendons cet hôtel. Lyne et Jean Montréal

reviews.author: Elena D
reviews.title: An excellent hotel where you can have lots of fun
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, and excellent beach and lots of all inclusive restaurants the pools is very large with a very nice bar inside, the rooms are large with a jacuzzi. Since this is an all inclusive hotel most of the restaurants are included along with beer, hard liquor and sodas.

reviews.author: Michelle R
reviews.title: Wonderful Honeymoon Experience!
reviews.text: We were upgraded to the Royal Service, and we were amazed at the benefits that came with that!  We had our own butler for the week, who we could contact anytime with a cell phone they gave us. Every day our butler (Fermin...he was the best!) would leave us fresh fruit, champagne, chocolate covered strawberries etc in our room.  Our room was located in an adults only building and it was the closest to the beach.  The adults only area included our own pool and bar.  We even had our own private area on the beach, and we didn't have to get up early to save seats or a cabana...we just let our butler know what we wanted.  He also booked our dinner reservations and excursions for us.  The food and drinks were great, and everything was beautiful.  It would have been a great experience either way, but getting upgraded to the Royal Service made it a once in a lifetime experience that we will never forget!

reviews.author: JNVRGS
reviews.title: Great Resort with amazing staff.
reviews.text:
We stayed at Palma Real for 8 days in late August. Upon arriving to the resort you are welcomed by this incredible view of the ocean thru the lobby. The resort itself is beautiful. The rooms could use a bit of updating. The staff across the board is friendly and attentive. We checked in via the VIP-Lounge. We were greeted by Alberto who was excellent at noting down our requests and doing his best to accommodate.  Our room was facing the private pool next to the Fuego restaurant. We spent most of our time by the private pool and not the main pool since it was so close to our room. The service by the private pool was excellent. Kenya at sunrise bar did a great job mixing drinks for us and Felipe & Raul always made sure we had towels and a nice cold drink at all times. The restaurants we dined in were Fuego, Rare, Bana and market grill. They were all very good. Our favorite was Fuego thanks to the amazing food provided by chef Eulin and the great service from Carlos.      
Room service was good as well. We do have a few complaints about our stay. For whatever reason housekeeping did not restock our in room coffee a couple of times. That forced us to have to order room service just for coffee. Another issue is that the minibar is nothing to look forward to. 2 waters, 2 sodas and 2 beers. No snacks or crackers, nothing else. The 2 beers offered were Budweiser. Being that my wife and I are both from the Dominican Republic we found it extremely disappointing that the resort would not offer Presidente as the beer of choice. Not even upon request they were able to facilitate that for us. We had visited this resort about 11 years ago and it is no longer what it was back then. Back then we rated this place a 5 star resort easily. Overall we enjoyed our stay and loved the service and staff by the pool and restaurants.

reviews.author: magnus_olason
reviews.title: Relaxing days
reviews.text: I really liked the hotel and the facilities. The room was clean and big with a good bed. I wasn't to thrilled about the open WC concept though. Apart from two or three exceptions I found the restaurants somewhat lacking in quality of their food. My favourite place was the pool bar where the staff was very helpful and happy.

reviews.author: John D
reviews.title: Great Resort, No Music
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this resort in August with my family and my girlfriend and have to say the place was great. The food, the pool, the ocean, all great. The staff was great and the casino loved to take my donations.

I enjoyed all the events they had set up, especially the paddle board class with Elvis. He was a great instructor and kept the pool alive and fun.

However, the one bad part about the resort is the fact they do not allow music. We asked the staff if they can play music and they said managment does not allow them to play music. We then asked managment why they can't play music and they said the owners did not like music being played. We were hoping we would hear some Dominican music or something of the sort, we weren't looking to listen for lil jon to tell us to get low or anything like that. Music is a huge part, the pool was quiet and awkward and it was hard to get into a party mode (which is why most people go on vacation, to have fun). 

So if you are going for a place to relax and read a book and your one of those, by all means, book this place right now. However if you are going for a fun experience with friends, family, or a significant other, look somewhere else because if you can't make  your own fun, this place is a snoozer.

reviews.author: yosvel86
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Unas vacaciones inolvidables, la limpieza,la comida, el servicio todo es espectacular quisiera agradecerle al señor del mini bar por su gran servicio su nombre es Daniel Martínez se los recomiendo a él y a todo el personal del hotel en verdad son muy hospitalarios

reviews.author: Peterpott
reviews.title: Great Stay!!
reviews.text:
I just returned from my vacation in this great hotel. I must say I am not a customer who likes all inclusive, but I have to admit that they have exceeded my expectations.
the rooms, all suites are large and well equipped , the food and service at gabi club buffet and Vento are just great. We also liked the Grill. 

The beach was amazing and The beach concierges go beyond to satisficed your needs.

I want to make a special mention to Mr. Adrian Alonso , Manager at The Reserve, who put the cherry on the cake with his personal follow up of our stay.
He is a very young hotel manager but a great professional
thank you and your team for making our holiday unforgetable.

Hope see you soon again.

reviews.author: natalidiaz22
reviews.title: El mejor hotel de punta cana
reviews.text: Ya dos veces fuimos a este hotel y el mes q viene estamos visitando de nuevo este maravilloso hotel, que ya sentimos como propio, el trato de los empleados es increible nos hacen sentir como en casa, es imposible ir a punta cana y no pasar por este hotel... Quiero agradecer a Yaritza Rodriguez por su atencion cada dia y cada noche en el bufet, siempre con una sonrisa y esa manera tan dulce y amable en su trato... El hotel es hermoso, resalto la calidad de las comidas y bebidas, la limpieza impecable en todos los sectores del hotel, la piscina y la hermosa playa que disfrutamos en las comodas camas q alli se encuentran.. No tengo ninguna critica, hermoso hotel

reviews.author: anagarcia0196
reviews.title: Maravillosas vacaciones
reviews.text: Muy buen hotel servicio perfecto los muchachos muy atentos el bar de la piscina ,bufet para q contar la animación gasolina q nunca para nos hizo sentir como en casa también caramelo ,sexy boy,Laura todos maravillosos son lo máximo y servicio excelente gracias muchachos por su servicio solo hay q poner más merengue y bachata estamos en Dominicana .

reviews.author: Monica B
reviews.title: Excelente!!!
reviews.text: Retornamos à Punta Cana e desta vez optamos pelo Paradisus Palma Real. O Hotel é excelente! O complexo é grande e possui muitas áreas de lazer. O Wifi é de qualidade. A arquitetura do Hotel é antiga e clássica, mas a decoração é opulenta. Percebe-se que alguns ambientes estão sendo renovados e as áreas externas estão sempre muito limpas e bem cuidadas (inicialmente fomos alocados em um quarto no térreo e o ambiente era escuro, úmido e cheirava mofo, após reclamarmos fomos prontamente deslocados para um quarto no 3 andar, o quarto era claro e arejado - recomendo evitarem os quartos no térreo). Possui uma academia razoável. Há um spa que possui uma área de sauna e piscinas termais, que pode ser utilizada inclusive pelos hóspedes que não optaram pelo serviço Royal Service ou The Reserve. Os restaurantes que servem jantar são variados e de qualidade. Há um buffet que serve o café da manhã e almoço bem variado. Os bares servem drinques com bebidas de qualidade. Os funcionários são todos muito prestativos e educados. Merece destaque o nosso concierge Juan Castillo, sempre muito solícito e cordial, atendendo a todos os nossos pedidos e reservas de restaurantes. A praia é um espetáculo à parte, com sua cor verde esmeralda. No período em que fomos o Hotel não estava cheio, o que certamente nos privilegiou com um atendimento mais individual.

reviews.author: Luiz S
reviews.title: A very special place to stay in.
reviews.text:
My wife and I went there to celebrate our 14th wedding anniversary and Paradisus (all inclusive) helped us to have a wonderful time!
The rooms we stayed at were a bit far from the main building but it was in an area beautifully surrounded by gardens and very quiet. 
Our comfortable and huge room had a varanda a living room and a great restroom with a double jacuzzi (as far as I know, all rooms there have Jacuzzis). Sometimes we were gifted with some chocolates on our bed. 
The overall hotel's installations are beatifully ornated and well maintained which added to the romance we were living there.
Many excellent restaurant for you to book a table and even when you couldn't make a reservation you are still able to get a table if you wait for while you have drink at the bar. The Passion restaurant is not included but it is really worth trying the Tasting Menu, as we did.
The buffet for lunch is able to satisfy any taste and it is hard not to be confused with so many options to choose.
The beach by the hotel is clean, with warm water, and a variety of chairs and double coaches for you to get suntunned or just relax. There's  WiFi in case you wish to listen to your favorite musics, cause the music that plays by the pools is too far away to be heard. You must get early to the beach to get some chairs for you before people put their towels on every chair. I saw the lifeguard reserve sone chairs in exchange of tips... The place is excellent for a jogging by the beach or simply going for a walk while the sun sets...
I hope we are able to come back someday and finally have our Dinner Under the Stars for I have to cancel it because of the rain.
Pros - The room, the environment, the installations, the beach and the food.
Cons - 1) when it rained heavily, there was some dripping in the corridors that leads to the room and some rain pools that made it impossible to get to the room by shortest way. 2) I think they really should hire some brasilians to help people have more fun, cause the guys were not very fun and the musics sometime were not good. 3) The room service were quite confused, wether  by taking too long to clean the room or by not delivering in time what I requested.

reviews.author: Alberto M
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text: Las instalaciones son presiosas, la playa es hermosa, la comida es muy buena. Las zonas verdes son muy frezcas. Todo el personal es muy profesional y muy atento, Melvin Concepcion y Luis Florian en actividades nos dieron excelente atencion y servicio. Recomendado para regresar

reviews.author: Eddie N
reviews.title: Nunez Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Family of four visited Paradisus Palma Real August 31st to September 8th 2016. Let me start by just saying WOW! This hotel is amazing from the minute you walk in. The grounds are amazing, pools, gardening, beach, restaurants, lobby, everything looks amazingly well decorated. 

We were upgraded to the master suite and the room was large for us four. 

Our concierge was AC, he was fantastic, humble man who would always greet us every morning and he made sure we had all our activities booked daily. He remember me by name and answered any questions we had. 

AC invited us to a VIP breakfast where we got the opportunity to learn more about the Melia vacation club. Although I didn't sign up for it, we had the pleasure of meeting Paola who also went to John Jay college with me back in 2005. She was great in her presentation and if the pricing made more sense for our travels I would of signed up. 

Food in the hotel is incredible. Every Time I visit a all inclusive especially in Dominican Republic I go with the right expectations especially the buffets. At Palma Real however the food was consistent and delicious. None of the restaurants we tried disappointed us. My favorite was Rare, Gabi Club, and the Hibachi by the Reserve. 

Kids club took tremendous care of my two kids. I really want to thank Juan Carlos. My son called him My Brother. He did such a great impact that my son went looking for him on our last day to say thank you and provide him a gift (tip). Both of my kids wanted to visit the kids club daily and be part of their activities. 

Entertainment team was outstanding. The performances  each night are wonderful. The lion king almost resembled the NY Broadway show. The team worked hard each day from 9 am to almost midnight to ensure the guest where entertained all throughout the resort. Shaky Shaky was the first to greet me on day 1 and made sure to always give me a shout out when he saw me. Betty Boop always made sure she had my towels ready for the pool and well situated. Gasolina is one man of a show lol. He has so much energy and he puts so much effort into his dancing. I wish I could learn to move like him lol.  Shorty (Diahana) spent a lot of time with my family always making sure we were part of the activities and to ensure we were having a good time at the resort. She even took time to dance with my kids and play volley ball with them. Diahana even helped me with my hangover one night by recommending a Bloody Mary which I drank but hated! LOL. 

There is so much more I can write about this resort, however i would recommend everyone to visit so you can experience the wonders of this place.

We the Nunez family would like to thank the entire resort for making this vacation a memorable one. We look forward to visiting you again in 2017 and will recommend friends and family to your resort.

reviews.author: a r
reviews.title: Great TIme
reviews.text:
We went here for our anniversary. Things were very romantic and relaxing. The food was great. A couple of the a la carte restaurant made the food look good but lacked taste. The buffets were the best with choice of fresh mango, pineapple, star fruit, etc. The were many healthy choices. Activities and shows happen every day, all day. It's just up to you what you want to do.

My concierge Erica took care of our needs, the bartenders at Gabi Club kept us laughing and Yaritza who was also at Gabi Club made us the most comfortable. Never rushed us and was a total sweetheart.

reviews.author: Siomaracruz
reviews.title: Súper Excelente
reviews.text: Un gran hotel con buenos salones de conferencias. Un personal calificado que te brinda servicios rápido y atentos. Las habitaciones y comidas excelentes.  Excelente siempre dispuestos y te ofrecen sugerencias para mejorar tu evento no te dejan solo

reviews.author: Javier E
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en agosto 2016 para nuestra luna de miel. La estancia fue inolvidable. Las instalaciones son maravillosas mas de lo que uno se puede imaginar por la fotos, pero aun mejor es el personal.
Nos gustaría destacar la amabilidad, simpatía y profesionalidad de 3 personas en concreto que fueron las que nos hicieron pasar una estancia inolvidable. 
Mayordomo Elvis: un chaval superprofesional que nos estuvo cuidando toda la estancia y nos regalo momentos maravillosos con sus detalles. 
Wanda Correa: camarera del bar de la piscina. Simpática, profesional, divertida y nos hizo pasar momentos muy divertidos.
Marino: El mejor barman que hemos conocido nunca. Tambien muy profesional y con un don especial para saber lo que le gusta a cada persona y acertar con sus cócteles.
En definitiva el mejor sitio que se puede escoger para pasar tu luna de miel.

reviews.author: Jeannie T
reviews.title: Another memorable trip to the Paradisus
reviews.text: My husband and I and our 2 children returned for our second time to the Paradisus Palma Real. We aslo have visisted the Paradisus Esmeralda in the past. Our first time at Palma Real we celebrated my sons birthday, but this past August 2016 we were celebrating our sixteenth wedding anniversary. Upon arrival, Maria Richardson, had our room upgraded and we could not be more grateful, it really made the trip. We also upgraded our bands to the concierge service, as I find it worth it to have someone make dining reservations and beds reserved at the pool and beach. We were assigned Claudy, who turned out to be the best concierge we ever had at a resort. She was sweet, attentive, and made everything perfect for us. She even sent up special treats for my children. The food, the service,  and the room were all absolutely wonderful. We also enjoyed massages at the spa, where my husband also said he received his best massage- which says a lot as we stay at many high end resorts. We also had a private beach dinner and it was amazing as well. We had a unforgettable vacation and look forward to returning many times in the future.

reviews.author: Q5821FCmariah
reviews.title: Best place in Punta Cana!
reviews.text: If you are looking for relaxing, enjoyable, kid friendly and a wide variety of food.  This is the place!  Amazing staff and the most sincere and genuine people I have ever met!  Coming back again! This is paradise!

reviews.author: CarmenSuarezBermejo
reviews.title: Fantasticas vacaciones en familia!!
reviews.text:
La mejor experiencia del hotel, no es su fastastica playa o bonitas piscinas, su cuidado entorno, ni la calidad de la comida, son las personas que trabajan en el mismo, totalmente volcadas en hacer de tu visita algo inolvidable. Hotel totalmente recomendable para cualquier ocasión y en especial si viajas con niños. Habitaciones limpias y amplias con bonitas vistas a la playa o a unos impecables jardines tropicales.
Impecables instalaciones. Si lo visitas, no pierdas la oportunidad de tomar un cóctel preparado por Víctor en el rte. Fuego a media mañana o por la noche ver cómo lo prepara Miguel Germán en la barra del rte. Rare, mientras te entretiene con algún truco de magia. Totalmente recomendables para comer o cenar, los restaurantes Rare(carnes), Aqua(mediterránea), Fuego(ceviche de camarón, capuchino de langosta), el Olio (italiana) o el Palazzo, preguntando y dejándose guiar por las especialidades de chef. 
Se merece mención aparte el club infantil, magnifico trabajo de toda la gente que allí trabaja, y multitud de actividades diferentes a lo largo de día mezclando la diversión y el respecto a su entorno. Enhorabuena!!. Quisiera dar nuestro agradecimiento por estas vacaciones a Domingo y Vladimir de atención al cliente, coordinadores Juan de Dios y Ricardo, a los chef Rafael Villaman y De la Cruz (Fuego), Alexis del Palazzo, a los responsables Wander (Aqua) y Franklin (Olio), barman Miguel Germán y Victor, mozos Jesus Evangelista ( Naos) y Felipe ( playa) y a el personal del Kids Club Francisca, Ines, Nico, Yesmely, Samanta, Luis, Guillermina, Yan y Alexandra. Gracias!!

reviews.author: Kirssy L
reviews.title: The most kind and fabulous service at Royal Service
reviews.text: This hotel is fabulous. The restaurants, the beach, the people are very kind and when you chose Royal Service you get a king treatment. About the food you have all the options you can imagin from any place of the world, Japanases, Peruvian, chinese, dominican, italian, mediterranean,mexican, american.Premium drinks. I go to rest and write my book, the silent all around the room is fantastic, We too celebrate my mother birthday. they treat her like the most important person in the room at the dinner, something I really appreciate and give thanks. I am coming back the next year!

reviews.author: Rafael T
reviews.title: Fuego restaurante
reviews.text: Me tendió un chico Michel Almando muy muy amable, la comida excelente, la atención una maravilla. Todo perfecto!!! Me encanto el hotel merece cada una de las estrellas las habitaciones perefectas recepción tambien todo muy bien.

reviews.author: jmm1989
reviews.title: Honeymoon Visit
reviews.text: We stayed at The Reserve in Punta Cana and could not have experienced better service! We had excellent housekeeping services daily by Rosario, a personal concierge that did anything and everything we could have ever asked named Gustavo, and the best service by Angel for our romantic dinner provided by Gustavo! Gustavo has truly made our stay a memorable one! We could not be any more pleased with our stay at The Reserve!

reviews.author: MarcioZanini
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text: O hotel cumpre as expectativas para um resort 5 estrelas com regime all inclusive. Possui um piscinas grandes, sempre limpas, uma boa academia, além de spa e bares espalhados pelo complexo. Os restaurantes servem refeições saborosas e bem preparadas, incluindo o buffet. A maioria dos funcionários é gentil e sempre prestativos com raras excessões, sendo uma delas o funcionário da recepção chamado Fausto Almond que em mais de uma ocasião foi ríspido e de má vontade.

reviews.author: Dani B
reviews.title: Experiência incrível!
reviews.text:
Experiência incrível

Uma semana de hospedam no Paradisus Palma Real. O hotel faz jus às cinco estrelas.  
Wifi de excelente qualidade, áreas amplas e limpas. 
Refeições com ampla variedade de opções. Café da manhã farto e abundante. 
Diversos restaurantes disponíveis, todos reservados via telefone para o jantar, não tivemos nenhum problema com reservas! 

Funcionários atenciosos e corteses, especialmente Wandy Castillo e Keilim Perez, com sorrisos e rápidos na prestação de serviços. Com exceção de Fausto Almonte na recepção do lobby principal, que nas duas vezes que foi solicitado agiu com indiferença e destrato conosco. 

Quarto amplo, bem iluminado. Cama e travesseiros de qualidade superior. 

Piscinas e bares de excelente qualidade! 

Recomendo!

reviews.author: Maria Paz C
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Tercera vez que visitamos Palma Real y cada vez la experiencia es mejor. Un agrado habernos encontrado por segundo año consecutivo con el cariño y la atención de Raúl Jimenez, quien cada día nos ofreció su mejor sonrisa, disposición, alegría y esfuerzos por hacer que nuestra estadía sea inolvidable.

reviews.author: austinmorrison6
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Great stay for our honeymoon!! Martin took great care of us at the pool and beach for the Royal Service. Sammy (Samuel Rodriguez), our butler, was amazing as well!!!! Perfect service! Palazzo was my favorite place to eat.. Lobster fettuccine!

reviews.author: Sam R
reviews.title: Honeymoon!
reviews.text: Chose Paradisus for our honeymoon spot after reading many great reviews and we couldn't be happier with our experience. Excellent service by our Royal Service butler, Samuel Rodriguez (Sammy), and our beach concierge, Martin. Gonna miss the beautiful beaches, delicious drinks, and awesome entertaining shows each night. Sad to leave!

reviews.author: celenne h
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: Our first time coming here with Club Melia. We had such an amazing time! We had the best butler ever, Junior Segura made everything 100X better! He went above and beyond for us! Mary Rosa ( atencion a socios),Eddie, Pascual (maleteros) were also great! And of course we are thinking to come back again...!!!! Please come and visit them! Ask for Junior! 👏🏼👌🏼

reviews.author: Leticia M
reviews.title: Hotel de ensueño , un paraiso .
reviews.text:
El hotel es espectacular , me quedé encantada con la decoración. Tiene cuidado cada detalle, Cada rincón de, cada lámpara ,cada mobiliario , los restaurantes , los aseos , las habitaciones , las piscinas .....
El servicio también es muy bueno ,tienes una persona específica para ti (mayordomo) que te ayuda en todo lo que necesites, y eso es un gran acierto , sobre todo cuando llegas y vas un poco perdido.La gente del servicio muy agradable , sobre todo los chicos del bar de la piscina y los de los restaurantes. Los únicos que me resultaron menos amables son los de la recepción , no se porque,  pero deberían intentar ser más atentos con los clientes y más simpáticos , como todo el servicio del hotel.
La comida también esta buenísima , más selecta que en otros hoteles de este tipo , y los restaurantes a la carta muy buenos y variados .
Es un sueño estar en este hotel ,hasta tienes una persona k te prepara todas las noches la habitación para dormir   
Las únicas quejas que podría tener de este hotel , y que me chocaron muchísimo , son unos trasformadores grandísimos que están al lado de las habitaciones y que hacen un ruido infernal día y noche , de hecho nos pusieron la habitación justo al lado y no quisimos ni entrar , eso si, nos la cambiaron al momento , pero aún lejos se seguía oyendo día y noche .(espero que sea algo provisional) Es un problema grave k le veo a este grandioso hotel.
Otra de las mis quejas y las compartimos casi todas las personas que estábamos en el hotel esos días , es la música , la música no es adecuado para un hotel en el Caribe , vale que intentan mantener su estilo chill out, pero cuando tú vas a República Dominicana te apetece escuchar su música , bachata , merengues... Es una cosa k opinamos todos,  de hecho en la piscina los clientes se llevaban altavoces y ponían esa música . 
Le daría mucha más alegría al hotel y los empleados estarían mucho más alegres .
Respecto a las animaciones de la noche , la verdad es que como son a las 8 , nosotros estábamos casi siempre cenando . Pero lo poco que ví, muy pobre y vulgar para este tipo de hotel . 
Las animaciones de día , estaban bien , yoga y fitness en la piscina , spinning dentro del agua , aeróbicos , clases de baile , y algunas más originales como clases de hacer velas , cócteles, sushi ...

A pesar de todas mis opiniones , volvería a este hotel y lo recomiendo , por que es inigualable e impresionante.

reviews.author: GODFATHER
reviews.title: Рай в который хочется вернуться
reviews.text: Свой выбор остановили именно на этом отеле сети Melia по рекомендации наших друзей! Отдыхали с супругой 10 дней в этом шикарнейшем отеле выбрали сразу Royal Service 18+ , к нам был приставлен butler (консьерж) Ariel Benzo и выдали телефон для связи сним! Это очень добрый человек который бронировал все рестораны для нас и занимал лежаки на пляже или у бассейна, делал романтические украшения номера и ванны, приносил все что его просили и делал приятные сюрпризы от себя, за что ему огромное спасибо! На территории отеля для Royal Service есть рестораны а-ля карт: Мясной Rare,Итальянский Palazzo,Восточный и один ресторан где готовит шеф повар обладатель мишленовских звезд Passion! Мы чаще всего посещали Итальянский ресторан Palazzo, в этом ресторане просто изумительно готовят и очень добрый персонал хочу отметить метродателя Zenovia также бармена Marino делал любые коктейли даже просто смешивая по любимым для вас ингредиентам если вы забыли или не знаете названия, особое внимание официанту Oscar Polanco это наивеселый человек он душа ресторана просто замечательный человек и профессионал своего дела!!  Территория отеля убирается 24 часа в сутки также в отеле нет насекомых! Пляжи чистые и убраны от водорослей, возле бассейнов всегда чистые полотенца, средства для загара и репиленты, все бесплатно! На территории отеля днем работают бары где можете выбрать любые коктейли от смузи до крепких алкогольных (алкоголь как местный так и дорогой иностранный все бесплатно никаких доплат) делают все быстро и не было такого чтоб мы долго ждали и бармены запоминают вас и могут по памяти делать коктейли которые вы чаще всего заказываете! Номера шикарные чистые не убитые, все целенькое. В ванной только дорогая парфюмерия фирмы  Thierry Mugler не каждый отель может похвастать этим!!! В номерах убирают дважды в день, утром и вечером подготавливают номер ко сну и кладут шоколадки. Т.к мы молодожены, нам еще сделали призент от отеля красиво украсили ванную, поставили клубнику в шоколаде и хорошее шампанское в ведёрке около джакузи. Хорошие вкусные завтраки и обеды. На обед ели стейки. Каждый вечер новая развлекательная программа в 20.30 после неё каждый вечер дискотеки! В общем этот отель одно из самых крутых мест курорта Баваро ни даром в данном отеле отдыхает сам Президент Республики Доминикана. Это был супер отдых мы обязательно ещё вернёмся в этот отель!!!

reviews.author: TravelTime
reviews.title: Had a good time BUT...
reviews.text: I have a very mixed review to offer for the Reserve. Some parts were great, some not so great. Lets start with the room. We had a one bedroom master suite. The room was very big and well decorated however the room was incredibly musty/moldy. I am extremely sensitive to mold so I was uncomfortable in the room. I asked other hotel guests if they also had musty rooms and all concurred that yes they were musty so we did not bother asking to switch rooms. I do understand that this is a tropical/humid location but for someone who is sensitive to mold this hotel would not be a good choice for you. The bed and the couch were both hard and uncomfortable. The shower was nice, had good pressure. The tub was huge and very nice. The balcony was nice as well.  We also had some issues getting items we needed in the room. We had called (more than once) before our trip to ensure that we would have a crib waiting for us upon arrival in our hotel room. There was no crib and we had to call three times to get one brought to us. The crib mattress was very hard and there was not a fitted sheet on the mattress but rather a large flat sheet wrapped around the mattress. I suggest bringing your own pack and play sheet if possible. Also the crib was very small and my son moves around a lot when he sleeps so he kept hitting his head and waking up crying. There was also no hair dryer in the room and it again took 3 calls to get one, hours later. Next, the restaurants... we LOVED every one of the restaurants we made a reservation for, the food was delicious. We especially loved Vento. The buffets were ok. The food was basic for a buffet not great but not bad either. We had great service everyday from Anthony at the buffet. The beach was ABSOLUTELY beautiful! White sand beaches with crystal clear blue water. Fantastic service at the beach from Emilio. We did not mind the cart ride down to the beach at all. One tip would be to get on/off the cart at either at the Reserve lobby or at Gabi beach for the best chance of quickly getting a ride. The kids club was nicely appointed and all the staff was friendly and inviting. We found the floor mats to be dirty. Even though you had to take your shoes off when in the baby room the colorful floor mat looked soiled. My son got impetigo (which is a staph infection of the skin) while we were at the Reserve. He came down with the rash the day before we left and i brought him right to the doctor upon return home. Our doctor explained to us it is very contagious so I immediately emailed the Reserve management to let them know that he had probably picked it up in the baby room and even if he didn't he was playing in there so the room should be throughly cleaned in order to prevent the spread to future guests. The response from the Reserve was defensive that he did not get it there. We have no idea if the room was cleaned after we made the hotel aware. The pools were all nice, warm and our son loved the slides at the kiddie pool. Overall the highlights for us were the beach and the restaurants and the staff  but the room would keep us from returning again.

reviews.author: NewJerseySky
reviews.title: Fun family vacation!
reviews.text:
Our family went to Punta Cana in August with one teenager and a 20 year old. We booked 2 rooms. They were spacious and clean. Our room was better than our kids because theirs had a moist smell to it. We found the food to delicious and fresh. Even the buffet had a great selection of fresh fish, meats and chicken for lunch and dinner. 

The entertainment was absolutely amazing. The entertainers were cordial and fun. Gasolina, Caramelo, and the rest of the team had everyone dancing until 11 pm. After 11 pm, you could choose to go to the disco/club but I was not happy with the scene there. It was crowded with young adults who abused the alcohol, so we went once and left.  

The water sports and activities included were great too, but book them early since they fill out quick. The catamarans, kayaks, and paddle boards book fast. 

One problem I see with this place is that the person who takes care of you, inevitably will try to convince you to sit for an hour presentation for a Melia time share. They lure you in with a special breakfast, but what you don't know is that a salesperson will sit with you through it and ruin the "special" feel of the breakfast, which by the way, you could get by yourself at the buffet. So save yourself a morning of your hard earned vacation and say no to the talk. That free vacation they are offering you isn't free anyway.

reviews.author: Sam F
reviews.title: Mis mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: My stay at paradisus was incredible, all thanks to the great staff! Especially at the beach bars. Had an incredible 4 days being spoiled at h2o by Jose de los Santos, Benita Mercedes and Josue camillo!! Do not mis out on the great time you can have with them!!

reviews.author: Fernando M
reviews.title: Lo mejor la gente
reviews.text: Desde la direcccion Rodrigo, Adrian y Silvio. Suiguiendo por los responsable de bares como Jesus de la Cruz, suiguiendo con cocineros como Ramon Simbert, Melvin Brizon y los animadores Naomi y Luis ademas de metres y camareros como Juana de Bar del lobby principal en definitiva una gozada super recomendable.

reviews.author: Renat T
reviews.title: Horrible from Start to Finish
reviews.text:
We booked the Royal Service and were treated like peasants. 
I am the type of traveler that is usually willing to look past certain imperfections when traveling, nothing is ever perfect, but my experience at this hotel has been terrible. A lot of this has to do with the staff and their training, and possibly for the entire hotel thinking that losing one customer is not a big deal. A waiter should acknowledge customer's presence in a timely manner and not have to be called over multiple times before finally taking an order (it shouldn't take 1 hour just to place an order), a waiter needs to do a better job communicating with guests regarding their needs it shouldn't take an hour just for the order to be placed and another hour before your food is finally brought out to you, and perhaps teach your waiters to smile and be courteous, this is the service industry. WiFi only worked a one third of the time. Why advertise these amenities if they don't work. The staff is taught to apologize 10 times, but no action is taken to actually resolve the problem. The rooms are dirty we had to have them re-cleaned when checking in not just one room but two... The food is atrocious in every restaurant outside of the one restaurant that is for a fee. Beach Butlers are ill mannered - overly rude, for the extra money that you pay for royal service you would expect it - apparently not at this property...
 I will never stay at the Paradisus Palma Real ever again, nor will I recommend it to anyone. This may have turned me off from coming back to Dominican Republic ever again. And P.S Front Desk Management just doesn't care...

reviews.author: Jay D
reviews.title: The reserve
reviews.text: Muy bien las atenciones de los chicos principalmente julio Alcántara me encanta el cuidado que tiene con la limpieza en la playa sin dejar atrás a benita Josue José Luis y todos en el hotel gracias espero volver pronto

reviews.author: Stelita
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel, real Paradise!
reviews.text:
The suite is large, beautiful, elegant and the bathroom is like a dream coming true! Restaurants and food are excellent. Swimming pools, the beach , the hotel as a whole is perfect. Now let's evaluate the service: all employees are competent, friendly and helpful, beginning with the reception (where a few tried to speak Portuguese), the concierges in my building (I was at 1387). The cleaning at the room was perfect (Jina Vilorio, Desiree Rodriguez, Gladis Jimenez). The bellboys extremely nice (Daniel Sales, Hidelky Devers), the guys at the big pool (Naomi, the princess and the other guy who spoke Portuguese, among the others who were also very nice). The guys at the Gabi Club Bar - Whifi and all the others serving there. Santa, our server at Aqua restaurant, so smiley, helpful and talkative. Let's talk about Passion restaurant! 11 courses, each one better than the other! The whole team of servers were fantastic - Pablo, Isidro, Danny, Manuel, Martin, Wanda, Sonia, Cheila).
Room for improvement - the wine, White wine was really bland, Rosé was a little better. They were always served very cold, which is nice.
But 2 things really disappointed me -
1- the transfer was not provided as advertised. When we made the reservation, it said it was included. When I tried to make the reservation, I was told that it was not anymore part of the package! But my son and his wife managed to get it as they booked a few weeks before I did. It happened the same with my son's in laws who had to book and pay for the transfer with me.
2- the so-called USD 1,000 resort credits. In reality, they are discount coupons and I used only USD 50 at Passion restaurant as the dinner there costs USD 100, wine not included. If you want to have a massage at the Spa, full price is USD 100 and the discount coupon is USD 50; To have a better wine, you have a USD 20 coupon discount, only applied to wines over USD 100. They also give USD 500 in coupons to be used at the Palma Real Shopping Center and they can be used for purchases over USD 100 in each store.
Other than that, everything else is perfect.

reviews.author: Mare M
reviews.title: The reserve paradisus puntacana
reviews.text: La estamos pasando increíble, punta cana es un paraíso, han sido unas vacaciones fabulosas, además de que el servicio por parte de Benita mercedes, José luis de los santos, Josué Camilo y julio Alcántara ha sido de diez, siempre estuvieron pendientes de lo que solicitábamos.

reviews.author: LauraMontesinos
reviews.title: Mis mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Hemos estado 5 días en The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana y la hemos pasado increíble, el hotel es muy bonito y el servicio en la playa ha sido increíble...muchas gracias a Benita Mercedes, José L De Los Santos, Josue Camilo y Julio Alcantara por todas sus atenciones

reviews.author: Gloria S
reviews.title: Vacaciones en el Paraiso
reviews.text: Las instalaciones son espectaculares, con una vista desde el lobby espectacular y una atención privilegiada. El personal marca la diferencia, con su educación y atención. Particularmente nuestro mayordomo el Sr. Gabriel Dalusma, el Sr. Rodriguez (primo) con una atención excepcional tanto en la playa como en la piscina de socios y el grupo de recreadores aseguran la diversión (shaky-Mac, caramelo, gasolina, etc)

reviews.author: NJResident2016
reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text:
My family and I (12 people) decided to go to Paradisus Palma Real for our annual summer vacation, many friends highly recommended this all inclusive resort, but at the end of 4 nights and 3 days stay we left with mixed feelings. 

The housekeeping and kitchen crews were amazing!!! But unfortunately some folks at the reception were not as professional. 

When we arrived 1 of our 4 rooms was not ready until 1.5 hrs later than agreed, and we were promised a late check out due to the inconvenience, but a gentleman at the reception told us an hour before regular check out, that he couldn't honored the late check out because the room was reserved for another party and we had to leave room. We finally received our late check out after a meeting with the resort General Manager.

The food is very good and the restaurants are clean and well maintained, but the restaurants are located around a small square area that could makes you feel restricted and overcrowded at peak times.

The prices for Spa services are on the high end in comparison to other resorts or similar facilities in the area (other resorts are located close by).

Again mixed feelings!!!

reviews.author: Alejandra F
reviews.title: EXCELLENT
reviews.text: My hysband and i went here for our anniversary. I dont even know where to begin. The service from check-in to check - out was outstanding. Every one was so friendly and welcoming. From housekeeling to waiters and bartenders were great to the point they knew us by our name. We spent most of out time in the pool bar area and leanarso,yacksmiry and hermes were open to serving us and and mingling  thru out the day. We highly recommend your stay at the reserve and we ourselves look forward to returning for a family vacation.

reviews.author: Alexandra87
reviews.title: Sin queja alguna! Recomendado ciegamente!!
reviews.text: Primera vez que visitó a RD específicamente Punta Cana y debo decir que quede encantada tanto por la belleza de sus playas, como por la amabilidad de su gente, me hicieron sentir de lo mejor, habitacion impecable, la comida variada, la playa limpia, bella. Quiero felicitar a todos los chicos, tanto del restaurant, piscina, del área de playa a todooooosssss. A el señor Mayki que desde que llegamos nos hizo sentir como los únicos. Sigan así que pronto volveré con mi familia. Ah y aprovechen los tour que salen desde el hotel que son fenomenales.

reviews.author: anyinson-ceballo
reviews.title: The reserve
reviews.text: The reserve Es uno de los mejores hoteles en república dominicana  donde puedwn disfrutar de la hermosa playa. Piscinas  mul buenas atenciones y sobretodo es un lugar donde en verdad pueden descansar y disfrutar de unas buenas vacaciones

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Service - "The Best of The Best"
reviews.text:
I travel quite often for business and leisure. This was a leisure trip. Made some great friends while here including Benita Mercedes who is a FANTASTIC bartender at the beach bar, Jose L. De Lo Santo who never let me drink go empty, Julio Alcantara who waited on us hand and foot and Josue Camilo who fulfilled my wishes with beachside Dominican specialties including fried fish and tostones beachside - definitely "THE SQUAD"

Great job guys - Keep up the great work !!!

reviews.author: Katerina G
reviews.title: Not a bad place, but not in line with TripAdvisor reviews
reviews.text:
I would like to start with positive impressions.

This hotel has 2 huge advantages - the beach and nice suites. The beach is amazing, clean, spacious with nice lounge beds and plenty of towels. We stayed at the Reserve section of the Paradisus and the suites are actually very nice, clean, spacious and the air conditioner works very well.

The buildings are widely spread across the resort and you need a 5 min ride to get to the beach. Going to the beach was not a problem, but coming back was an issue. We had to wait every day for 35 min for the bus to get back to our room. Walking was not an option as it was extremely hot, We were told by other guests in the last 2 days of our stay that if we walk to the Paradisus beach, the bus services is better. The point is, we paid much more to stay on the private beach and why do we need to walk somewhere else to get a bus ride? 

Another big issue is that all buffets are an open space environment with no air conditioner. The birds and flies are happy to share your meal with you.

The main lobby of the Reserve is very poorly decorated with some old furniture. I think it was donated to the Reserve by Salvation Army store, The resort reminds me of a funeral home, very dark, gloomy, no lights, no music,

There is not much in terms of entertainment, No live music, or a band playing at night,. Where is the Dominican spirit with their upbeat music and dance? None of that at the Reserve. No piano bar, or anything that suppose to be available at 5 star resort.

Service is a mix as well at the Reserve, In general, people work hard and trying to help.. During our dinner at Bana, we got 3 very dirty glasses with white wine, when we pointed out to the glasses, we got clean glasses with wine , but no apologies were received, Not a  sign of a 5 star resort.

We have been to Bavaro Princess resort before, next door to Paradisus. The Reserve will cost you a double of Bavaro Princess, but it is very similar in quality. So you pay double at the Reserve for the same quality,

In summary, it is OK resort, but not as near as it was rated on this website, Much worse.

I would like to acknowledge Anthony who worked at the Reserve main buffet for his excellent service.

reviews.author: tara s
reviews.title: Fantastic All Inclusive
reviews.text:
We read a ton of the reviews on TA before booking.  Truths - Punta Cana has a ton of sea grass that accumulates onshore and is raked each morning (I witnessed this on my morning walks). If sea grass bothers you go to another island. Another reviewer mentioned, this is not a 5 star hotel resort. Of course not, if you can afford that (I looked them up, we are talking about $2,000-$25,000 per night depending on the location and generally they are not all inclusive). I am not downgrading my review based on this fact given ~99% of the population can't afford such luxuries.  Heck those of us who can afford to stay here are extremely blessed.  

While I am not a Melia member, I have to say this company is wonderful. The grounds were beautiful (clean), the staff amazing (extremely well trained). I am not sure there is a better place to stay in the DR unless you are looking for a smaller more intimate resort. 

We stayed 5 nights. September is a fantastic month to visit, it is not crowded at all. We upgraded to Royal Service when we arrived and never had an issue with our dinner reservations. We had many conversations with those who did not upgrade and had issues with dinner reservations only (this was during slow season), so I think the key is to upgrade if this is something you don't want to be a hassle throughout your stay. There are incentives upon arrival for you if you chose to hold off on upgrading, although I would not take the chance during high season to do this. Several people on our van back to the airport mentioned that they would return and would opt for the Royal Service their second time around. 

Tipping- I googled the tipping topic during our stay and found the best suggestion. Give 1/4 of the tip at the beginning and tell the person you take care of me I will take care of you at the end of our stay. Made it nice not to carry cash with us every day.  

Restaurants
We looked at the menus, which are outside each restaurant before deciding where to eat. We ate at Aqua, Fuego and Palazzo. 

Aqua: We love seafood and this had the best over all menu suited to our taste. We ended up eating there twice. In case the menu doesn't change...the Grilled Octopus Salad, Red Snapper, Turbot, Filet and Chocolate Souffle were wonderful. Skip the Falafel and Salmon.  Arrive early or stay a little later, the bar outside the restaurant has unique drinks. Also, walking to the left of the restrooms is another cool bar area. 

Fuego: We didn't enjoy much of anything we ordered here. Another couple mentioned lunch was great, but we never ventured back.

Palazzo: It was just OK. We had many breakfasts and a couple of lunches to escape the kiddos at the larger buffet. 

The day prior to our departure there was a coffee bar opening. So bummed this didn't open sooner, they had sandwiches, deserts and were soon to have gelato. Such a cute little extra to have available. 

The best beach man EVER-Martin and our Butler Eduard was so kind.  Thank you for taking care of us each day. We seriously needed down time and you made sure we didn't have to make any efforts during our stay. Honestly every single one of the staff members were working their tails off while having the best spirits. 

Shopping: The two places down the beach one in either direction are meh, typical island souvenirs. There are vendors who are on site Mon/Fri. Pierre Andre sells gorgeous coral bracelets, make sure to pay him a visit they are stunning. The Palma Shops, felt like shopping in the US at twice the price, but there are a couple of nicer shops that we don't have in the US. If you want to buy Ron Barceló Rum, it is 50% cheaper at the mall than Duty Free. Also note, upon arrival as you exit customs you will pass through duty free. There are several other duty free shops when you leave the airport. Note, we normally have direct US - Destination flights, this was a first layover flight when returning to the US. If you buy in duty free and you have a layover in the US you will be required to put your liquid items in your suitcase after customs and prior to checking your bag to your final destination. 

My only wish for Melia: Please incorporate local food into menus. The only option was Mexican, you are a Spanish chain, it would be nice to have a Tapas option or some sort of Caribbean cuisine.

reviews.author: Adel T
reviews.title: Just amazing, absolutely wonderful!
reviews.text:
What can I say about this place...except that besides the beautiful decor, the delicious food and lovely scenery, the staff is what truly what gives this venue its identity. As all inclusives go, you will find everything you need and more at this resort. But the warm smiles, the genuiness, the pleasant and classy demeanors of the staff is what will make you come back for more.

I am in the service industry myself and these guys were nothing short of stellar!
I had the pleasure of having Juan Matas (front desk), Eduardo Ardanza (front desk), Wandy Castillo (Server @ Naos), and the lovely Amalia Chivite in guest services help to make me feel right at home. They were all absolutely amazing in their roles and always were willing to help with a genuine and warm smile. 

I wish I had more adjectives to describe these wonderful people as this trip was made special by them. It's especially meaningful to me because my mother had just finished a grueling 8 session chemo treatment that took it's toll on us all.

It's important for the management of this fine hotel to know what amazing staff they have here, that will continue to make people feel special while having repeat business.

Thank you to the entire team at Paradisus for a much needed relaxing and engaging getaway, with special thanks to the people mentioned above.

-Adel

reviews.author: gitana0507
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: in the Royal Service with Butler Alexander Guzman thanks to the wonderful service we have a very confortable.Ya'm thinking back with some friends here from Miami to know how wonderful Paradisus Palma Real hotel ROYAL SERVICE.GRACIAS all team guys who could give us better service

reviews.author: dorlan78
reviews.title: Do not hesitate, Negative reviews are suspect
reviews.text:
We spent seven days at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. Best vacation we've ever taken. This is by far the best all inclusive on DR and probably a top three to five in the Caribbean. Upon arriving we were informed about the numerous options within the resort. Guests are immediately designated by wristbands. Reserve, regular or royal service. 

The reserve section is within the confines of the resort but only for 'reserve guests'. It includes a few extra pools, bars, restaurants, a private beach area and an entire separate spa and main clubhouse section. The only con I can see of this is the separate clubhouse section is that it is a five minute golf cart ride from the main building on the resort (where basically everything happens). The reserve section comes with a concierge who you can call at any time for restaurant reservations, cabana reservations, to help schedule excursions, or just for basic needs.  Additionally, there are a select few liquors you must be 'reserve' to have for free (Grey Goose, Black Label,  ect). If you are not staying in the reserve these higher shelf liquors are not included in the all inclusive. 

Staying in the regular section just means you cannot go into the reserve or royal service sections. It also means the top shelf liquors noted above are NOT in the all inclusive and you must pay extra for them. You will also not have a conceirge. 

The royal service section  is somewhat like the reserve but it is roped off to BOTH the regular and reserve guests. It includes a royal service butler that supposedly does more than the reserve concierge but I'm not sure how that is possible. To me,  this seems like overkill considering you have access to 99% of the resort as a reserve guest and access to all top shelf amenities, restaurants and beach areas. 

We felt the reserve was an amazing experience. Literally everyone in the resort will bend over backwards for you. The chefs will even make you food not included on menus. There is someone leaving you a gift or dropping in to see what you need every second. We can honestly say that everyone was happily willing to go above and beyond. This is without question the nicest resort in Punta Cana. The food is good and the amenities are just stunning.  Anyone who posts a negative review or picks at the amenities, staff or experience honestly is either unrealistic, not on the same planet as 99% of the world,  or is just downright grumpy. Another huge bonus is no hidden up charges for unincluded items. Everything not included is clearly marked. Honestly, if you go with reserve,  almost everything is included.  The only remote con I can see to this entire experience was the small beer selection (Bud or Presidente). That's it. Literally. It is pricey,  but you will be waited on like a king/queen and be in one of the most stunning all inclusive Carribean resorts in the world. 

When you go, make sure you find Edwin at the reserve beach. He was simply incredible.  He did everything from hand squeeze fruit drinks at request to going off and finding fresh coconuts in the morning to drink out of. He went way above and beyond and truly enjoyed his job.  Huge props to him. He's the best and we will come looking for him when we return. The staff of this resort truly compliments the beauty and amenities.  I promise you there is not an all inclusive that compares in DR. Just like 99% of the reviews say on here,  go and you will not be sorry.

reviews.author: UnlockXpress
reviews.title: Hotel inolvidable, bellísimo
reviews.text:
Desde la llegada la atención  fue de 5stars.
Fuimos por nuestro aniversario de bodas.

Harold front desk at The Reserve fue super amable. Nos dio un room muy cerca de todo en el área Royal Service.GRACIAS!!!!!!!
Franklin de Relaciones públicas muy amable y atento a algunas sugerencias que le dimos sobre el hotel.
La señorita de las reservas para las cenas, quien nos hizo el de la cena en la playa, recomendada por Argenis, excelente customer services. No recordamos su nombre pero gerencia sabrà por la fecha... 5stars para ella.

La tienda del hotel. Muy amables....hay una dependiente que le gustan las rancheras.....muy alegre pasa cantando....y las demás bien chevere también.

El representante de Costco encargado de los tours muy chevere. Muy amable.

Las señoras que arreglan los cuartos super nice. Muy trabajadoras, amables, respetuosas, estamos super agradecidos por su servicio.

El spa Oriental, una maravilla. Wow.....he visitado otros hasta en otros países., este ha sido el mejor.....mucho calor humano...se trabaja acá con cariño......María, Yandaira, y mi querida masajista Marcia....hicieron mi estancia espectacular...Recomiendo este Spa a ojos cerrados. Y las cabañas donde hacen los masajes ni se diga...super lindas....con agua en el fondo corriendo. 100 Stars para este Spa. 

Los restaurantes....super lindos...la comida....mi esposa y yo opinamos que es la mejor hasta ahora de Punta Cana. .... los chefs de Fuego, Blue Agabe, Stake House, espectaculares. La cena romántica Septiembre 1ro 2016 a las 730pm, por nuestra noche de aniversario fue hermosisima. Eduardo y compañero de la playa Olimpos nos atendieron super atentos .....y  la comida del chef wowww....más allà de nuestras expectativas. El Buffet  super...disfrutamos de un sancocho dominicano espectacular los meseros de allá super eficientes... muy amables.
Palazzo restaurante espectacular....comida, servicio al cliente, decoración, higiene, meseros....A++++++++++....lo recomiendo para todo desayuno, almuerzo 
(Cena nunca fuimos)
Passion restaurante...wowww.... maravillosooooo........ Desde el recibimiento,  la decoración, los meseros y chef y manager Luis Rubio Thomson, Héctor,  Rodny, Sergio.....este es definitivamente un restaurante que vale lo que cuesta. Felicidades..... y Obvio la comida querido chef excelente.... aunque físicamente no estuvo presente la receta la prepararon muyyyy... bien. Felicite por favor a su chef asistente. .... 7 Stars para él también. 
Ah... en el Buffet del Reserve fuimos el último día miércoles Septiembre 7 2016, el desayuno muy rico y la staff excelente desde el manager, mesero, el de los omeletts....
Muy acogedor allá.

Entretenimiento....los muchachos que tienen son muy alegres, Caramelo...la Chanti, ....Coco loco...Gasolina......y la otra nueva chica. Ellos excelestes... pero  en las noches  los shows, excepto Michel Jackson,(the Best one), deben trabajar más en calidad, los bailarines  muy buenos pero quien prepara los shows debe copiar y visitar la calidad de Bávaro Deluxe Palace. Ellos están muy bien en los shows, por ejemplo, Tropicana Show.
También República Dominicana es merengue,  salsa y bachata.....tienen que poner más de esta música......venimos a bailar..........
Los chicos si son lo máximo,  y muy respetuosos.... eso vale mucho 

Los cuartos del Royal área necesitan upgrades, los baños, el mini bar nevera, piensen que son parejas quienes más visitan acá,  ........sugerencia para que sean los mejores de Punta Cana.

Argenis mayordomo....lo máximo.....gerencia este chico tiene buenas cualidades para jefe....no lo pierdan como empleado...sabe de su trabajo.... 

Y por favor pongan transporte desde el lobby hasta la entrada para los empleados. Acá trabajan muyyyy duro para que tengan que caminar tanto, eso no nos gustó......su mayor asset son los empleados, sin ellos no serían lo que son, cuiden de ellos lo más que puedan, un muchacho empleado de ustedes nos dijo que ser líder es mejor que ser jefe.....y es verdad. Dios es bueno con todos sean imitadores ustedes de Dios.

Las instalaciones bellas, nos encantó el hotel , a pesar de los detalles mencionados anteriormente.. Si se merecen 5stars 

Gracias. Por. Tan . Agradable. Estadía.

reviews.title: Amazing Resort...fabulous holiday!!
reviews.text:
We have just returned from the reserve at paradisus punta Cana.  

The resort is huge!  But for families the reserve is perfect!  The kids club and kids pool are located in the reserve area.  We went for the family concierge and were assigned Nickel, he was great.  Arrival and check in was seamless and very efficient.  Nickel came to see us within 10 minutes of us arriving in our room...a 1 bedroom master suite which was huge and a great space for a family of 4.  Nickel had arranged for our restaurant reservations as I had emailed in advance, he booked our preferred cabana by the pool for our entire stay, arranged transfers for way home and sorted any minor requests we had, all in all a great service and a lovely concierge Nickel...thank you

The in room mini bar was always well stocked and once nickel new our requirements for milk etc it was always filled accordingly.  The room service was good too if a little slow.  One night we decided to stay in and order room service.  It arrived a little later then expected and was not hot but tasted fine just pizzas and fries so not a big deal!

The food in all restaurants we tried was good lots of choice and lots of fresh fish and meat cooked to order in the evenings.  My boys loved the ice cream bar!  Breakfast was good with eggs made to order in all and pancakes to order in naos.

Try all buffet restaurants as the food does vary.  Our favourite was Gabi Beach, the food choice was bigger and ambience was much more lively.

Of the a la cartes we loved Aqua the pizza was delicious and boys enjoyed their pasta.  We tried Bana and the grill.

The pool areas are well maintained and the staff can't do enough to help from blowing up pool toys to bringing drinks.

The whole resort is clean and the gardens are indeed as you see in the brochure....perfect and very well maintained.

The golf carts are frequent and take you from one end to the other.  We used it every day to go to the beach.  The beach is picture postcard beautiful and there was plenty of available palapas.  

All in all we would recommend this hotel to anyone with a young family.

reviews.author: syenh16

reviews.author: Orobo77
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service&Entertainment

reviews.author: John L

reviews.author: Snappy N
reviews.title: Mr Do

reviews.author: Bianca B
reviews.title: Férias perfeita para descansar!! Hotel MARAVILHOSO!!
reviews.text:
O Hotel é incrível, exatamente o que vemos nas fotos. 
Os funcionários são todos muito amáveis, me recordo do nome de alguns Naomi, Whifi , Carlos , Santa, Daniel ... é injusto citar apenas este nomes, porque todos são amáveis e simpáticos sem exceção.  
Os jardins são impecáveis , piscina sempre muito limpas e com água quentinha. 
O hotel tem 415mil m2 de área sendo que 1/4 é uma reserva, existem carrinhos de golf para o transporte , mas eu particularmente adorava andar a pê, pois os caminhos são lindos ,inclusive durante a noite, com a iluminação indireta nas árvores e alamedas, parece um sonho. 
O lobby do hotel Paradisus é lindo com lago, fontes e Flamingos !! 
Os restaurantes são excelentes, com sabores mais internacionais, os temperos são suaves, acredito que para atender ao paladar de todos. As sobremesas mas muito bonitas, mas para o meu paladar um pouquinho sem graça.
Os melhores restaurantes na minha opinião a la Carte : Passion, Aqua, Vento, The Grill. 
 Melhor buffet: Gabi Club - excelente serviço. 
Na piscina do The reserve tem o Hidro Grill: Snack grill, ótima comida e tem uma batatinha maravilhosa. Mas, uma sugestão de melhoria é que deveria ter opções como petiscos, tapas, sorvete, mini saladinhas e menos frituras. 
Bebidas inclusas no The Reserve :  whisky até 12 anos , vodka Absolut , licores, vinhos da Marca La Rebelle : Champanhe, branco ( muito doce , poderia ter mais de uma opção), rose ( muito bom ) e tinto. 
Praia: água quente, com uma marola gostosa do mar, área branca e fina e que não queima os pês. 
As cadeiras e camas balinesas são ótimas, da até para tirar um cochilo na praia. Ducha e banheiros disponíveis. 
O bar da Praia tem várias opções de sucos naturais, batidinhas e bebidas, faltou apenas um petisco. 
O Wi-fi do hotel é excelente em todos os locais, inclusive na praia.
Reclamações:
Quando efetuei a reserva, dizia que o translado do aeroporto estava incluso, mas apenas eu consegui bookar este serviço, meus pais e minha sogra demoraram para faze-lo e não conseguiram, ao entrar em contato com o hotel fui informada que o serviço tinha sido cancelado e que infelizmente não podiam fazer nada por mim. 
Outra reclamação é que o Meliã diz que ao reservar mais de 6 noites, você ganhará $1500 dólares de Resort Credits o que não é verdade, pois são Cupons de desconto em serviços, você não pode usa-los da forma que for melhor para você, sem contar que dos 1500 , 500 dólares são cupons de lojas do Shopping Palma Real.  Exemplo : na compra de vinhos de mais de 100 dólares você recebe 20 de desconto  no hotel.    “Aliás quase todos os cupons são validos para serviços acima de 100 dólares.”

Visão Geral:
Hotel maravilhoso, comida excelente, ótimo atendimento, praia Maravilhosa!

reviews.author: Britney W
reviews.title: Fantastic anniversary get away

reviews.title: Palma Real Average to say the least
reviews.text: Ascetic wise the Palma Real can't be beat, but let's be honest were not there to eat the structure! Many resorts in Punta Cana compete and say that they are the best in what they offer, this can be true for most and not for some. Palma Reals 1 pool, messy Buffett order and non answering room service line can old real quick. I have stayed and critiqued many PUJ resorts and Palma Real has been one of my least favorite thus far! With that being said if you are planning on dineing on concrete then the place is for you, if not for the money your better off staying at a better resort that caters to offering a higher end level of service.
