reviews.author: Kyle M.
reviews.title: Wonderful resort with a few flaws!
reviews.text:
My wife and 2 daughters (aged 4 and 2) just returned from an 8 day stay at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, and overall we had a wonderful time.  This was our first stay at this resort, but last year we stayed at the Reserve at the Palma Real.  At first glance the resorts are very similar, but there are some significant differences in the two that the Paradisus website doesn't fully explain.  Firstly, if you are planning a trip and are confused between the The Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana and the The Reserve at the Paradisus Palma Real, these are in fact two completely separate resorts that are nearly 3 miles apart from each other.  There is no shuttle that can take you from one to the other, they are completely independent from each other.  However, the layout of the 2 is similar in that at each one there is the Reserve side that is geared towards families that is away from the beach, and the "main" resort that is on the beach and has the majority of the restaurants.  The Reserve at the Palma Real and the Punta Cana are very similar, they have mostly the same restaurants, the rooms are a similar layout, they both have the kids zone, etc.  However, the Reserve at the Palma Real is rated a 5 star on most travel websites, and the Reserve at the Punta Cana is rated a 4.5 star.  My wife and I agreed with this completely, everything at the Palma Real is just a tad bit better.  The rooms were a little larger, it was newer, the Kids Zone was much, much better.  That's not to stay at the Reserve at the Punta Cana is not nice, because it absolutely is.  It's a beautiful resort, the staff was absolutely wonderful to my family, and all of the a la carte restaurants we ate at were very good.  Some of the features that we really missed from the Palma Real that were not present at the Punta Cana were the liquor bottles in the room, not having the hot tub on the outside balcony, and the breakfast and lunch buffet at the main resort was not nearly the size or variety of the Palma Real.  While the Reserve sides of the 2 resorts are very similar, the "main" resort at the Palma Real and the Punta Cana are completely different from each other.  The Palma Real lobby is completely open with large columns, and has a very Ancient Greek look and feel to it.  The Punta Cana has a more Asian look with darker tons, and much more vegetation around.  We really enjoyed the change, it made it feel like a completely different vacation from a year ago.  However, all of the vegetation and water features did attract mosquitos like crazy, so pack your bug spray.
We stayed in the One-Bedroom Master Suite and for the most part were very happy with the room.  A few of the furniture pieces were pretty worn, the hot tub had seen better days and the hide-a-bed was the squeakiest thing I have ever heard in my life.  But the room was massive, the bed was very comfortable, and the staff brought a full size crib into the room for our 2 year old.  I had read some reviews that stated you could not control the temperature of the room, but that is not true.  There was a thermostat in the room and it was very simple to adjust the room temperature.  There was also a nice minibar that was restocked every day with Coke, beer, milk, juice and snacks.  They are also very flexible with the minibar and will stock it with whatever items you ask for.  However, this resort does not give you the full liquor bottles in the room like the Palma Real which was a little bit of letdown, fortunately we had a very short walk to the bar.  Also, none of the rooms have the hot tubs on the patio like at the Palma Real which was very disappointing, it would have been really nice to have had that during the kids naps in the afternoon. 
The staff at the resort was also excellent.  They remembered our kids names, we never had to wait long for drinks, food, etc.  Room service came promptly, the room was cleaned at the same time every morning, and turn down service was done every evening.  We did have a few funny moments with the language barrier, but I would never knock someone or a resort for speaking their own language in their country.  But if you are coming here and do not speak any Spanish at all, I would at least try to learn a few of the basics such as thank you, good morning, hello, etc.  We thought that was part of the adventure and it had no negative impact on the trip at all.
The food and drinks at the resort were also excellent for the most part.  We ate the buffet for breakfast every day (I think this is the only option) and had the buffet for lunch nearly every day.  We had dinner at The Grill, Aqua, Vento twice, and Bana.  Mole was closed for remodeling, and we did not try Fuego.  We really enjoyed Bana and Vento, The Grill and Aqua had excellent food, but were outside so the heat and the mosquitos weren't awesome.  The end of August is the hottest time of the year in Punta Cana though, so it was partially our own fault.  The only bad meal we had was on our first night, we ordered the strip steaks from room service and they were pretty terrible.  
We didn't use the Kids Zone much this year at all, there wasn't tons of toys or things for our kids to do there, and our kids are a little on the young side for most of the organized activities.  They did have a dance party in the kids pool that our kids absolutely loved, and our 4 year old did the aero jumper at the main resort and had a blast.  One of the days they also brought out stand up paddleboards for everyone to use in the main pool and all of the adults and kids at the resort had a great time with that.
If you have already booked your trip and are nervous about it not being as nice as the Palma Real, don't worry....it is a beautiful resort with a great staff.  Everyone we talked to was really enjoying themselves and we had a great experience there.  However, if you are trying to decide between the Palma Real or the Punta Cana and the price is about the same, I would probably recommend going to the Palma Real.  It's newer, the rooms are a little bigger, and just has a few nice features that the other resort doesn't have.  If you have any questions about either resort please don't hesitate to ask, I would be more than happy to answer them.  Thanks for reading!

reviews.author: rgsTx
reviews.title: Nothing that a little service wouldn't fix...
reviews.text: Stayed here at the end of Aug 2016 ,to try a new resort, and was pleased with the resort -rooms,location,food,pools,beach all were first class-What needs to be addressed is SERVICE -If you do not ask someone at the restaurant or other areas they will not come up to you and take your drink order -I ate lunch and made sure I was visible & wanted to see if I was approached for a drink but it never happened -I ate my 15 minute lunch without any water...If the staff was better trained this would not happen -once this is addressed they will move top the T.A. ladder- A great resort with huge potential...

reviews.author: armalili

*****

reviews.author: Lorena J
reviews.title: Heaven in Paradise
reviews.text:

We traveled during their off season so the hotel was quiet but had some great entertainment. We stayed in the Junior Suite with a king size bed. The room was inviting and the bed was comfortable. The service was incredible, and so was the food. The Beaches and sand are to die for. One thing I appreciated was that the hotel was very kid friendly. A lot of families stayed in that hotel. 

Overall, me and my husband where absolutely impressed and would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: leuc2016
reviews.title: Euceda & Vargas 2016 Vacations
reviews.text: My family & friends stayed at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort and we all had an unforgettable vacations. The rooms were clean and ready every day. Our teenagers & my 5 yrs old son enjoyed the amazing beaches & gorgeous pool, specially the choreographies of Caramelo, Gasolina & Shaky Shaky. How to forget Luis, the bartender who prepared different kind of drinks, shakes &  the amazing Passion Fruit mojitos!!! Also, the staff who were in charge of our dinners reservations were just amazing, specially Sujey who made sure everything was fine and that we have enjoyed the restaurant. She also, took care of one of my son's birthday cake. There is one more person that I would like to mention; is Johnny (The Molleto) at Rare, this guy is just GREAT, we had a blast with him. Overall all employees were AMAZING!  We really enjoy our vacations.

reviews.author: JMS228
reviews.title: Bien pour Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Très grand hôtel à Punta Cana. Quasiment pas d'Européens contrairement aux hôtels voisins.
Les plus : la grande chambre, la belle plage avec ses transats et ses parasols, la qualité de la nourriture dans l'ensemble variée et très correcte au buffet + menu dégustation au restaurant gastronomique.
Les moins : c'est pas chic (ambiance parfois un peu trop "cantine", personnes dans la piscine avec boissons alcoolisées ou sur la plage avec poste radio) ; certains restos sans intérêt par rapport au buffet (voire pas bons).

Dans l'ensemble, très bien pour Punta Cana

reviews.author: Keila P
reviews.title: excellent vacation

we all love it here !!!

reviews.author: eroman1107
reviews.title: My best relaxing vacation
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort. The services through the stay was excellent. We liked very much the cleanliness of the room. We loved very much the quality and the variety of the food. 
All waiters were very pleasant and friendly in the restaurants and bars. 
The first day we arrived to the hotel we visited the buffet restaurant and we met Mr. Francisco Roman who took care of us and gave us a very nice welcome to the restaurant. He has very nice personality. Any time we visited the restaurant for breakfast or dinner Mr. Francisco and Mr. Gustavo Vasquez treated us always very friendly. We loved and enjoyed the shows at the Olympus theater. During this time we met very nice people such as Gasolina, Happy Boy and Shaky Shaky. All of them with great personality making sure we were feeling great at all times. They were great!

reviews.author: jsotomayor321
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Once again for our 5th year in a row, during the last week of June, our family stayed at the Reserve section of the hotel in a beautiful 2-bedroom Master Suite. This part of the hotel is more family oriented and truly more reserved and peaceful. 

We again were very happy to see and recognized many staff members from our previous visits. None stood out more than the Gabi Club Reserve and Vento Restaurant manager: Teurys Feliz Rubio, who always goes above and beyond to set up special and memorable family dinners. Chef Manuel E. Reynoso cooked us delicious fish, lobsters, shrimps and made sure we were taken care of. A special thanks to Aguilera, the pastry baker who made us many of our favorite cakes such as "Tres Leches". These individuals treated us better than family.

Rafael Rodriguez, Nelson & Ricardo trained us at the YHI Gym. They always motivate us to exercise every day throughout our stay. They took time to correct our posture and provided us with many useful workout tips.  

We missed bartender Juan Gomez, because he was out sick the week we visited, but we got to see our other favorite **Porfirio Casado** at Naos and Pedro at the Gabi Club Reserve pool. They made us special drinks, made sure we were never thirsty and always provided us with good friendly conversation.

I must also tell you about the excellent and friendly service provided by: 
- Gabi Club servers: Anthony Cid who sang for us (Deja tu stress) which always brought smiles to our faces, Emilio (pool server), Ramon (excellent pool cook) and Ronnelly P. who was always making sure that we were satisfied with our food. It is important to note that Ronnelly went out of his way during his time off to buy plantains outside of the hotel so that I could eat mangu/fried plantains (awesome service). There seem to be shortage the week we visited. 
- Another Gabi Club manager, Jose Lebron made us feel very special.
- Guest Services: Ambioris Marte, Asst. Mgr. and Silvo Lantigua made sure our needs were met and that we were enjoying our stay.  

All of these people made our family feel extremely welcomed. I have and will continue to recommend this hotel to friends and family. You will not be disappointed if you stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.

We will most certainly return again next year to this incredible resort. The outstanding, genuine, and attentive staff is one of the main reasons that we continue to enjoy and rate this hotel higher than all of the others. Thank you all once more for the wonderful memories and we can't wait to return!

See you soon,

The Sotomayor Family

reviews.author: DHDL97
reviews.title: Three times is a charm
reviews.text:
This was our third year in a row we stayed here.  We booked the Royal Service OceanFront room and had a spectacular view from the second floor.
This year we had to request certain amenities that in previous years had already been placed in the Royal Service room.  Either the room was not properly prepped or they were trying to save money.  The amenities were provided when requested.
We did experience delays in the evening with the turn down service.  As we showered after being on the beach all day, we expected clean towels in the evening.  There were nights, despite our requests for earlier service, when the turn down service was not provided until after 10 p.m.  Much too late.
The restaurants were at times a little slow on service.  The exception, in a good way, was Palazzo.  The service there was always exceptional, both breakfast and dinner.
We ate at Passion restaurant on our last evening, as we always had.  The tasting menu was good and the service was attentive, but we do think this year's menu choices were not as diverse as previous years.  We seemed to get a lot of soups, albeit tasty soups.
We decided to take an excursion to Santo Domingo.  We paid extra for a PRIVATE, 2 person, tour. We booked through the tour desk on site as arranged through our exceptional butler, Yohel Aracena.  The tour driver spoke no english and the tour guide was not fully conversant in english.  Thus this private tour was spent with long periods of either silence or listening to the driver and guide converse in spanish.  Instead of going directly to Santo Domingo, we were taken via back roads via Higuey to see places we had already seen and were not supposed to be on this tour.  Thus our time in Santo Domingo was rushed.  We never did see the boulevard of downtown Santo Domingo,  I would therefore caution anyone booking such a tour to get an english speaking guide who knows Santo Domingo.
As for the personnel at Paradisus, we enjoyed once again seeing our butler, Yohel.  We thought he could not top last year, but he figured out a way to surpass any expectations we had.  He is to be HIGHLY recommended.  On the beach, Francisco and Carlos always had a place for us reserved and prepared.  They took good care of us with smoothies, drinks, and water.  No cares at all.  Totally relaxing.
To conclude, we want to thank our butler Yohel for making our trip one to remember.  Royal service is worth every penny.

reviews.author: Tom C
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve Provides Lifetime Memories
reviews.text:
Going on a week or two vacation and saying you had a terrific time when you return is pretty typical.  Creating lasting memories is another thing.  And that is where the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana really stands out as the top vacation experience in the Dominican Republic.  

I held off writing this review for a reason.  I wanted to see how I felt about our stay at the Reserve months later.  So here I am three (3) months later to tell you, the memories of our vacation are just as strong and vivid as if they happened yesterday.  THAT is my idea of the experience of a lifetime!  Thank You everyone at the Reserve.

You can see for yourself the perfectly landscaped, green-conscious, environmentally focused grounds in photos on-line.  Whether at the Reserve’s web-site or here on Trip Advisor.  What you cannot see and experience until you are there are the amazing people who make the Reserve Experience #1 on the island.

Rodrigo Silveyra, the Resort’s General Manager, has managed to take a wonderful property with all the amenities you need and turned it into a spectacular destination for families, couples and singles alike.  His attention to detail and hands-on philosophy guarantees you will get top notch service everywhere.  Likewise, Adrian Alonso, the Reserve Hotel Manager, makes his presence felt each and every day.
Both gentlemen walk the entire property daily to solicit Guests’ comments and feedback on the workings of the Reserve.  You will not find this attention to detail except among the highest rated hotels and resorts of the world.
 
The Reserve difference starts as soon as you exit your vehicle and are greeted by Daniel and Eddy, two of the friendliest and accommodating Bell Captains you will ever find.  They are there to make your stay exceptional and that is exactly what they do.  Every single day.

Maiker (Mikey-Mikey) Ramirez, at Registration, will get you settled and to your room smoothly and in a very quick manner.  He knows you are there for vacation, not to do paperwork.  And he stays in touch throughout your entire stay to make sure all is well.

If you are really lucky, you will have Nicea Cortorreal as your Concierge for the time you are there.  Morning, noon or night, she makes sure every moment of your stay reflects the Reserve philosophy of meeting your every need, every day.  And if you are staying at the Reserve Family section, Diosmery Francisco, Concierge, will not only make your vacation relaxing and enjoyable knowing your children are safe, but your children’s vacation will be extra special as well.

The Hostess, Wait-staff and chefs at Gabby Restaurant and the Grille make all the difference in your stay.  Whether it is starting the day off with a hearty breakfast, taking a break for a lunchtime meal or ending the day with a romantic dinner, you can be sure these people are there to provide you with the highest level of customer service. 

Keeping this whole system flowing perfectly is Dhoralix Polanco, the Reserve Manager.  Her talent and ability to make her people feel special means you as a Guest experience the vacation of a lifetime through their attentiveness and passion for excellence.  Dhoralix is amazing!

And if you have questions about anything involving the business office, Yandra Sanchez is there to answer your questions and solve any issues that may arise.  All in the most professional and attentive manner possible.

The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana and their amazing staff.  Special, Unforgettable Memories.  Not just for a week or two.  But, for a Lifetime!

reviews.author: drdeniro15
reviews.title: Will be returning!!
reviews.text:
I have traveled to various all-inclusive resorts in the Dominican Republic, Bahamas, and Mexico with my wife. The quality of service, food, and amenities have all varied. This was my first all-inclusive resort vacation with my wife and 3-year-old son and I was very pleased how we were treated. In addition, we were also accompanied by two of our best friends and their two daughters (2 and 7). The employees greeted us with a smile every morning and addressed the kids by name. 
The food at the buffet (Gabi Club) was good to very good. The dining area as well as where the food is kept is very clean. The pools are very clean and the Kid Zone was very accommodating to our needs. We had reservations to Passion one evening and our dinner was going to extend passed the hours of the Kids Zone. The resort offers baby sitting service for $10 an hour for one child, $15 for two, or $20 for three, which is what we reserved. The young lady who watched the kids took them back to our rooms and waited for us to return. There were no problems. 
On a daily basis the rooms were cleaned, the refrigerator restocked, and a special gift was left for my son (extra chocolate, Doritos, milk etc.). 
I want to extend a special thank you to Fidelina Eusebio, Esmeralda Concepcion, and Nicia, who prepared a bubble bath for our son filled with balloons. 
Overall, it was a great vacation. I recommend tipping the employees on a daily basis.  Our concierge in our building was very accommodating. I recommend making reservations to the restaurants as soon as you arrive to the resort. They may be difficult to come by. I would certainly recommend The Grill, Ibana Wok, and Mole.

reviews.author: Art B
reviews.title: Best trip of our lives... so far
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Reserve in mid July of this year. I cannot recommend this property highly enough. As I am sure you have already read, there are three sections to the Paradisus property, and The Reserve is the middle level of service. It also happens to have the best rooms. Our room was a really nice one bedroom mini-suite, and it was everything we needed. The bed was comfortable, as was the living room area. The TV, though fairly unimportant to us on a vacation like this, carried a very nice selection of channels, including several in English. Some of the major American networks were even accounted for, with stations out of New York, Miami, and San Juan, Puerto Rico. 

Anyhow, here is the important stuff. The buffets are okay. It's not food that is going to blow your mind, but they do a good job of mixing it up. Grill options are available at every meal, and that is nice. But here's the real advice: Make restaurant reservations for EVERY NIGHT you are there. The food in the restaurants is excellent. 

The Reserve pool is a great place to relax, and if you are savvy, you can get a nice in-water shaded lounge. We spent a lot of time in the water reading, which was amazing. 

If you are more of a beach person, check out the private Reserve beach. The main beach (Gabi Beach) is nice, but you have to pay for shade. The private beaches are the way to go for sure. They are every bit as nice, but it is a lot easier to relax without worrying about a sunburn. 

The ocean is PERFECT for swimming. The waves were easy to navigate, and the temperature was in that sweet spot of refreshing and cool enough, without being cold. 

Sadly, snorkeling here is non-existent. There is no reef, so the water is cloudy with sand. In general, the DR is probably not where you want to go if snorkeling is your objective. 

One last thing: Yes, The Reserve is away from the beach. This is not in any way an issue.  Trams are running 24/7, and it was always easy to catch a ride to literally anywhere we wanted to go if we didn't feel like walking. 

Worth every penny we spent.

reviews.author: Vianney V
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Amazing Staff but needs some work in comparison to other Melia Resorts.
reviews.text: We normally stay at The Paradisus in Riviera Maya every year...but this year, we decided to change location.  It is my 2nd visit to the resort... I traveled with my brother who was staying at his Time Share on the "Reserve" side of the resort, i was staying in the "regular" hotel room/side. Luckily we were all travelling together and so,could take part of some amazing perks, that staying at The Reserve has--- such as,check-in was in a separate "lounge" not at the main desk-  That was my 1st dissapointment...when we stay in Paradisus La Esmeralda, i've always been treated as super VIP,with welcome mimosa or drink of choice...but not at Palma Real--they told me that my checkin was at the regular desk--and as a Melia member, was dissappointed that they would tell me in front of my entire family--i guess they felt bad and decided to check me in, in the lounge.  Our rooms were spacious and clean-but no ocean view rooms are available unless you're travelling without children  or rooms at the family concierge.  The rooms (my room was a 1 Bedroom Suite)are supposed to have "fully,stocked minibar"--well,that consisted of ONLY: 2 bottled waters,2 cokes, 2 sprites & 2 Budweisers"--shocking, in a ONE-BEDROOM Ste to only have 2 waters and ZERO snacks for my 8 year old son!  Even though there is a sign that says, "to be stocked daily" that never happened, until i wrote a note for them with some dollars,saying--pls leave some more water and snacks for my kid--they brought me 3 packs of oreo cookies and 2 bags of plantain chips...they never re-stocked my minibar again....and i was there 7 nights...dissappointing! In mexico,we get a fully stocked minibar and it is re-stocked daily,,,and EVERYDAY! Went to the Reception at least 5 times to get change...and they only give out change at 11:30AM- you will need to be at the desk by 11:20am(was told by every gst agent) because the change will be gone quickly!  Management....Please assign banks with enough change, to every gst  reception agent...it's a resort...i dont wear watches and do not need to worry about the time, if i need change...especially when i have my son in the pool and beach all day! On a positive note..i encountered some amazing Employees that were truly amazing and deserve amazing recognition: KENYA CHALAS (at the pool bar, by the Reserve) AMAZING SERVICE...EVERY DAY,,,ALL DAY...She would know what i wanted,would recommend some amazing drinks and always with the biggest smile!Thank you, kenya! i would return just for your service!  Eulin(Chef), Carlos fernandez (server), Cristian Castro at the "Fuego" restaurant were all INCREDIBLE! Amazing service...always super accommodating and extremely engaging! BRAVO,u guys...RESERVE,POOL STAFF:  RAUL, WAS AMAZING...thank you for taking care ofall of us everyday,,,you were always at our service, by the time we realized we needed anything, it was already there.  No matter how busy the pool/beach are were,we never felt that you were servicing anyone else,but us!Amazing service raul thank you.  Also, some great team members:  Felipe Morla by the reserve Pool, great service! Service at Bana was amazing...we really enjoyed it- food was amazing... Suzuki our chef was great,funny and very engaging with the entire audience. food at Fuego was superb...we went there almost everyday! Olio was really horrible- didnt like the "self serve" part of it inside, it was not good at all...main course was also mediocre and quite small portions.  Vento was ok-but not memorable... Kids menu there was not good, not a lot of options (did not have pizza nor chicken fingers) luckily,our server offered to bring us pizza for my son, from the other restaurant next door,which was really nice of him-thanks, Felipe!  Please have beach towels closer to the pool area (reserve) - had to walk to the beach area in the mornings for some towels. The Market buffet was pretty decent-great food all day- Lobby Bar area in the evenings, really enjoyable!  NO MOSQUITOS ON SITE--amazed by how people/news keep talking about Zika virus...i have to say...did NOT have to use my bug spray not even once!  Overall, a nice stay- some great employees willing to go above and beyond! Will definitely go back to Paradisus La Esmeralda next time and maybe try Palma Real in a couple of years.  Waiting for hotel survey, but never received one. Vianney (New York) Aug 18- Aug 25-#3202.
