reviews.author: AleMoya
reviews.title: Gran desilusión
reviews.text:
No es primera vez que venimos de vacaciones a Punta Cana, por lo que conocemos otros hoteles de la zona. Esta vez era distinto porque viajábamos por primera vez con nuestro hijo de 1 año. Por esta razón elegimos este hotel. Decía ser el mejor para unas vacaciones familiares. Lamentablemente no fue así. Primero comentar que la atención del personal en general es deficiente, no hay interés en ayudar o informar al cliente. Salvo algunas excepciones como Francisco en el desayuno buffet, Jhunior y Felix en la cena del buffet. Nos hicieron nuestra estadía mucho más grata. Nos ayudaron con el lavado de los biberones y calentar la comida de nuestro hijo. Por otra parte, las habitaciones están bastantes deterioradas y mal mantenidas. Encontramos todo tipo de fauna en ella: cucarachas, polillas, arañas y lagartijas!!!!! El televisor estaba dañado en su pantalla. El frigobar muy pobre. Las instalaciones del hotel destacan (área de piscina, bares y restaurantes), se nota que son nuevos. Lo malo es que nadie te explica nada. No pudimos conocer todos los restaurantes de reserva porque la persona de atención al cliente no hizo todas las reservas, incluso nos agendo una noche en un restaurante que no se necesita reserva (Blue Agave). Un chiste! 
Lamentablemente no podría recomendar este hotel ni tampoco volvería a hospedarme aquí.

reviews.author: nancypel
reviews.title: Beautiful family vacation!!🌴🌴
reviews.text:
The reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana was amazing! Everything was on point. We especially enjoyed the service and care we received on the beach. Ramon Ramirez, the concierge, was fantastic! He really made sure our stay was never lacking. This was our second visit at the Reserve and it was just as great as the first time. 
Would definitely go back. 🌴

reviews.author: Katherine B
reviews.title: 3rd Time Here and...
reviews.text:
still amazing. I was close to canceling my stay because I was worried about Zika. I am so glad I trusted the hotel and their care for their guests. I saw 1 mosquito near the Kids Zone, but that was all. I saw that the resort fumigated the grounds. We saw that other hotel guests were not as lucky and had mosquito bites all over their skin. 

Overall, I had an amazing experience. This is my third time at PPR and I cannot wait until our next stay. Here are our reservation details:

The Reserve, with Family Concierge Service. 
4 adults, 1 child under 2
August 10th - August 17th 

The Room
PPR upgraded my family to the Reserve at the beach. At first I was apprehensive because at night, I could hear commotion from the bar downstairs all the way to my room and was afraid my baby wouldn't sleep. But honestly, it was not bad at all. I barely heard any noise.
My original booking was for the Reserve, with no Family Concierge Service. But we were upgraded. I had read past reviews about families not wanting the upgrade because it was not near the Yhi Spa and the Kids Zone. The Reserve area near the beach had 0 mosquitoes. I think it's because it was windier near the beach. 
The Room itself was large and had an open floor concept, meaning, there are no closed off area for the living room, or the bathroom. I didn't quite like it for me and my family. I am still unsure on what I will do for next time. Regardless, it was not a deal breaker for me because the room was gorgeous, clean, and had a balcony with an outside Jacuzzi. If you are wondering whether to book Family Concierge or not for your family, do it. 

Service
The service was excellent and the staff was accommodating. Leidy was our family concierge personnel and she was awesome. I couldn't have asked for a better person to make our stay more pleasant and smooth. For example, she offered to babysit my child for an hour while my family and I went to Passion. She picked him up from the Kids Zone and brought him to the main hotel to me. Leidy booked our restaurants and reserved beach space for us. She exemplified what resort customer service should look like. Thank you, Leidy! You are the best! All the staff were fantastic as well but I remember that Analquis Molina was also very charming, customer service oriented, and downright pleasant. Thank you, Analquis!

Food
I did not get sick! The food was great, actually, really good and decent. But the highlight of my food experience was at Passion, one of the best restaurants in the world (in my opinion). It is worth the money and experience. It was romantic and the ultimate form of customer service you will ever experience. It's a high end, luxury-style dinner for those who appreciate food (yes foodies, this is for you) and the art and skills behind each culinary dish. The staff was soooo good. All of them were punctual, professional and cared about the food and wine. Many, many thanks to Sergio, Thompson, Julio Cesar, Junior, Domingo ( a fantastic sommelier), and Yelitza. 

Overall
I don't go to other resorts because I have been so pleased with the family friendliness of PPR. I cannot wait for my fourth trip here! If I had to pick my least favorite parts, it would be the room (but again, not a deal breaker), more drinks for the mini fridge (both alcohol and non-alcoholic) and more towels.

reviews.author: Kibbe714
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text:
We've been to All-Inclusives before and this Melia property is the best!
The lobby and grounds are so pretty! Our room was large with a huge jacuzzi. The food was very good and the staff modt accomodating as we travelled with an 80 year old who eas sometimes using a wheelchair. My massage at their spa, although costly, was a great massage. The masseuse was well trained. The bar was really rocking- Latin music and American. We loved getting out of the huge pool and walking on the sand briefly and jumping in the ocean! Simply wonderful!

reviews.author: Victor F
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort & Best Staff
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort at the Royal Service and this is by far one of the best we've ever stayed at.
Angel our butler was the most accommodating, pleasant and friendly.  He strived to make sure anything we needed was taken care of and always with a smile.  He even reached out to us to make sure we made it back home safe.  What a wonderful person.

The staff was great, but kudos to the entertainment staff.  I have a new level of respect for these people.  Gasolina, our favorite entertainer, so full of energy, friendly, charismatic he became our "adopted son" while we were there and made sure he came to say goodbye to papi and mami before leaving for his break.  
Diahiana, Cheky Cheky, Chanti and all the other entertainers, hats off to all of them as well.  They make this a very special place to spend your vacation.

Francisco and Felix 2 of our favorite waiters made every meal a very pleasant experience.

This is customer service at its best.  We've only been home for a week and can wait to go back.

Victor & MariaI

reviews.author: Yeison P
reviews.title: Vacaciones excelentes
reviews.text:
Es mi primeravezaqui en este hotel, de verdad que es magnifico, las instalaciónes son presiosas y excelentes servicios principalmente Melvin Concepción que nos ha hecho divertir con su ocurrencias y nos ha ayudades en diferentes cosas , tambien Santos Arache Bares, yokaina, ramon santana, naomi jose luis florian , jhordan , Junior Rosario, Jensy rijo,

Esperamos en las próximas vacaciones.

Gracis por todo.

reviews.author: Matias R
reviews.title: Can't Beat this Beach Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We were there for eight days and did not want to leave. Staff was always attentive, and we strongly recommend the Family Concierge option. Our 5-yr old twins loved the kids club and the staff there went out of their way to make them part of the family and keep them busy with educational activities (baking, arts and crafts, etc). The beach club is just about the best spot to relax and you can ask for a fresh coconut when the gardener is around. And you get good wifi at the beach too. Don't miss The Grill, Banna Wok and the appetizers at Fuego. The tennis club is fantastic and Domingo will take great care of you. You are also smack in the middle of a natural reserve...the entire staff was fantastic and we are forever grateful. And the management of Adrian and Rodrigo is solid. They care. So once again thank you Melia for always making us want to return to your hotels. 

Camila/Julian/Sylvia/Matias Ringel

reviews.author: PhilIsa818
reviews.title: Destination Wedding with over 100 guests
reviews.text: We had our destination wedding with 103 guests in Paradisus Punta Cana and is was simply put...PERFECT all around! You can't go wrong here. Definitely worth your money and best hospitality & client servicing hands down!

reviews.author: Alexandre H
reviews.title: Férias Inesquecíveis
reviews.text:
Estivemos no Resort no fim de agosto e início de setembro. O hotel é incrível, muito bonito e moderno. Esta em constante conservação. Com staff de primera, sempre muito cordiais! Optamos pelo Royal Service onde tivemos como mordomo o nosso agora amigo Sr. Armando Minier ! Muito prestativo, sempre pensava em tudo, antecipando-se as nossas necessidades. A cada dia nos agradava com uma surpresa em nosso quarto. Nos orientou sempre para nos  organizarmos da melhor maneira  quanto aos jantares nos diversos restaurantes do hotel! Recomendamos demais!
Enfim, férias Inesquecíveis!

reviews.author: Karin F
reviews.title: Una semana en el paraiso
reviews.text: Desde la llegada tuvimos el primer contacto con Carlos del Royal Service y la introducción a este magnífico mundo,a través de él fue impecable.La playa muy linda salvo la proliferación de algas en algunos días. el servicio de playa excelente.La habitación magnífica,todos los detalles muy cuidados a cargo de nuestro mayordomo   Armando Minier,impecable en todos detalles ,decoración del yacuzzi, frutas siempre disponibles,reservas de la cancha de tenis, dicho de paso muy bien atendida por los profesores,  ni hablar de la atención del restaurante Palazzo,con su excelente chef Rafael y los siempre dispuestos camareros. Solamente un detalle muy negativo,hoy, por suerte y por desgracia nuestro último día, se instaló un grupo que según dicen todos los años contratan para esta fecha, primera semana de septiembre, el complejo Mellia de al lado y toman la playa por asalto con música a todo volumen durante horas y dicen que va a ser por toda la semana, realmente muy desagradable para los que buscamos paz y mucha tranquilidad.Consejo no vengn para esta fecha y así se lo haré saber a nuestra agencia de viajes.

reviews.author: SeaBee1828
reviews.title: Great resort but staff needs more training
reviews.text:
We can't fault the resort itself, but some of the staff required more training to be able to handle unforseen situations, although they were friendly. 
We had a dinner booking which didn't exist on their system, a mixed up in rooms which required us to move to another room. These were all unnecessary.

reviews.author: robertjrueda
reviews.title: “Best Vacation Ever”
reviews.text: We just came back few days ago form the best vacation that we ever had, and was thanks to Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. This resort exceeded our expectations. The service was outstanding .All staff members were friendly. Every day, every single person we encountered, from front desk to restaurants to housekeeping to water activities was friendly and helpful.  The amenities in the room are very nice; you pay for what you get, great service. The entire experience was incredibly relaxing. We can’t wait to go back. We give the Paradisus Palma Real our highest rating and we will be back soon. We want to give an special thanks to Nicolas Nunez we miss you so much my friend, Vladimir Diaz, Galvin Navarro, Lee Valdez, Gerinaldo Ubiera, Cruz Reyes, they made us feels like a family in the resort. I don’t want to finish without thank other people that bring to much fun to the resort, Gasolina, Shaky Shaky, Coco Loco, Caramelo, we all in our heart. Thank you Melia, Thank you Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: sueknutson
reviews.title: A Great Experience
reviews.text:
Three women escaped to Punta Cana for a quick girls trip.  Our room was booked through booking.com (who completely failed on this one) and was for a three bed arrangement that is not even available at the Reserve Paradisus. Although this was a difficult start to our trip, the personnel that we encountered at the hotel were outstanding.  Yuri (Yurandy) assisted us at the front desk and went far above our expectations.  The reservation problem was clearly a problem created by Booking.com and not that of The Reserve, but he spent a lengthy amount of time and much effort to find us a wonderful room (upgraded) with 3 beds.  He assisted us with several other questions throughout our stay and was friendly, polite and a wonderful representative of the Melia Hotels. Our room was clean and housekeeping was good. Anything we asked for was readily brought to the room.  One day we forgot to lock our safe with money, passports, IPADs and jewelry in it.  It was locked when we returned with a note that we should call security.  Security came up to unlock and reset the safe and requested that we make sure all was accounted for while he waited. We were missing nothing.  Even the money we left for housekeeping that day was still on the table.  I found that to be very reassuring.   We had also booked the concierge service with our original room and our concierge was Elaine. She was also a great representative of the hotel.. She was very friendly, a great asset to our stay and well worth the money.  We were able to get restaurant reservations where and when we wanted them, a great spot reserved for us every day 
on the beach with 2 shaded daybeds and 3 lounge chairs, and all of our questions answered anytime from early morning until into the evening.  I would recommend asking for her. The website pictures are true to the resort and the beach is wonderful.  There are trams that run about every 20 minutes  (more often during the day and during prime season) and will take you to all of the different locations on the huge property at no additional charge.  There are also nice walking paths throughout  the well-maintained and lush tropical foliage.  There are a lot of choices for food and drink. We had meals at Gabi Beach, Gabi Club (both above average buffets), Mole (Mexican food) which was very good and at Vento (Mediterranean fusion) which was a really great meal. The bartenders we encountered were all very willing to make a drink to your specifications and continuously circulate to provide beach service also. We received a calendar of nightly entertainment when we arrived which listed the available yoga classes, craft classes, dance classes, and several shows.   The Beach Party at Gabi Beach bar was like a casual nightclub with some dancers, dancing and a few bottle service tables (extra charge).  It was fun and the lighting on the beach was worth going for just by itself.  The hotel, location, and beach were all great but the people and the service during our stay is what will make me remember the Reserve at Paradisus and Melia Hotels for future visits.  I would definitely recommend this place

reviews.author: _vbxc90
reviews.title: Royal Service is the Best!!
reviews.text: We stayed at another resort a couple of years ago with Royal Service and it cannot not compare to the Royal Service at Paradisus Palma Real. Our butler, Ariel ensured we received the very best the resort had to offer. He made frequent contact with us daily and surprised my wife with a special birthday treat and decorations in our room. I highly recommend to anyone who is planning a vacation here with Royal Service to ask that Ariel to be you butler.#Ourbutlerwasawesome. Moreover, our personnel beach waiter Rafael was on-point too! A hard working professional who added to the wonderful service by ensuring that a sofa lounge was reserved for us each day and making special smoothies in accordance to our desires.

reviews.author: Dino D
reviews.title: "Royal service with Carlos H. the butler"
reviews.text:
We stayed a week here and we had the best time. 
Our butler Carlos Hinostroza was incredible for the week,helping us with everything we needed. Special thanks for service to Wanda Correa, Miguel Jimenez, Junior Marte. 
Great Hotel,Great beach and even great food .I would go back again. 
If staying here, we highly recommend the Royal Service.

reviews.author: TessaPeru
reviews.title: Boring for teenagers and youg adults
reviews.text:
The hotel is great for couples.  For families with small children, there is a children´s club but not to close (it is located at the Reserve facilities). I went on a family trip and all kids up to 11 had a great time but there were no activities for the rest 12-19 years old.  It was kind of dull for them, especially if you compare with other hotels like Barcelo who have many activities for that age group.
Another thing that was very slow was room cleaning, they will make the rooms sometimes at 4pm or later.
It is an excellent hotel for couples since the restaurants are pretty good and have a good variety.  They even have a special area only for adults if you stay at that part of the hotel.  That are has a premium service.
I would recommend the hotel only for couples or families with small children who do not mind for them to stay at the kid´s club far from the beach.  Otherwise stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: MelWil2014
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Just returned and had a great time!  The weather was beautiful the entire time.  We had royal service.  Our butler, Carlos Hinostroza, was very helpful and accommodating.  He managed our dinner reservations, left us treats in our room and always made sure we had what we needed.  He also decorated our room on my birthday - it was a very nice surprise.  Pedro was super nice and very accommodating at the beach.  He made sure that we always had drinks and water.  The hotel layout was nice, our room was very clean and we enjoyed the food.  The gift shop was super expensive- I needed more sunscreen and after sun gel (got very burned on the first day) and it was $50.  I had no choice but to spend this amount on something that would have been $16 max.  Shaky Shaky and Shorty were super sweet and very entertaining.  The night life (club lounge) was okay.  Since its off season, there weren't a lot of people.  We would have loved to hear music at the pool and beach.  "Spa" music was playing at the pool which was relaxing but I would have preferred something different- the only time different music played at the pool was during Zumba/exercise.  Overall we had a great time and we would consider coming back to this resort.

reviews.author: Temmy28
reviews.title: Great resort, minor hiccups but I would visit again.
reviews.text:
Great grounds and layout,amazing beach with beautiful sands, excellent service and very attentive staff. I skipped the royal service and I didn't feel like I missed anything. I was able to make reservations for all the restaurants that I wanted (I was flexible with the times). 
Bars are good, busy but you get your drinks fast, top shelf liquor available upon request, tips is not expected but appreciated.
 Food in the buffet is good quality but small selection, need better variety, restaurants food is excellent except for Vento, it was really bad. 
Beach was clean and nice when we arrived but seaweed accumulated throughout the stay and they didn't clean it. 
Had a burnt light bulb in the bathroom, I asked for it to be changed only once but they didn't change it. 
Overall great resort and I would visit again if the price is right.

reviews.author: Дарья Р
reviews.title: Awesome vacations!
reviews.text:
Thank you very much for wonderful  vacation! Everything was awesome!  Delicious food, restaurants, comfortable and beautiful rooms, good service. I had a great time, it was so exciting and funny, thank you for daily activities. I  liked the water aerobics, stretching, Salsa lessons, Bachata, Zumba. Resort has very good shows in the evenings, especially with Michael Jackson and Queen band. I liked hot music and dancing in the Gabi beach bar. Thank you Coco Loco, Shaky Shaky, Lio, Gasolina, Caramelo. I love you guys, I'll miss you! 
Wi-Fi was working very good throughout  the territory of the hotel, even on the beach. I used Skype every day.

reviews.author: Risingsun1908
reviews.title: Great Girl's Birthday Getaway - Royal Service
reviews.text:
This is my second time staying at this resort. The service, activities and amenities are exceptional.

Before I arrived, the supervisor for the Royal Service Butlers, Apolinar Santana, corresponded with me and put my mind at ease about a few concerns that I had.

Once I arrived, I was assigned an awesome Royal Service butler, Carlos Hinostorza. Carlos knew in advance that I was celebrating my birthday and did everything such as decorating my room and my private poolside cabana with balloons, having champagne and chocolate covered strawberries waiting in my room after a  long day at the beach, to making sure that the servers at the restaurants had a beautiful birthday cake waiting for me to ensure that I was treated like a queen. He did not overlook one detail.

In addition to the service, the activities were great. Alberto and his team made sure that everyone had a blast  in the pool doing paddle board yoga and fitness. The music was lively and upbeat. Speaking of music my buddy Shakey Shakey turned it out teaching zumba to sizzling salsa beats. He also knew how to keep the crowd going after the various shows. I would also like to mention Coco Loco, Gasolina and Diahana who also kept the party going.

The beach is beautiful and the Royal Service pool/beach concierge Carlos bent over backwards to make sure we always had drinks and towels and whatever else we needed.

All in all this was a great birthday trip.

reviews.author: Olga Suarez
reviews.title: Fabuloso!
reviews.text: Estuvimos durante un fin de semana familiar y disfrutamos de excelentes atenciones, muy variadas opciones de restaurantes. Las habitaciones son hermosas y muy bien equipadas. La piscina es espectacular. Tambien la playa muy bonita. Recibimos increibles atenciones desde nuestra llegada, nos recibio Luz Franco con mucho agrado. Los restaurantes tematicos bellamente ambientados y la comida muy buena!  Nos encanto el que tenia el estilo Teppanyaki, con el chef Felix Mejia y nuestro camarero Jonathan.  Tambien el Olio, con Brenda Sanchez y Juan Sierra que se esmearon en que disfrutaramos un buen momento. Incluso el buffette muy variado y con muchas opciones frescas y cocinadas para ti!  Todos los empleados mostraron alto sentido de servicio, mucha amabilidad y simpatia. Gran variedad en bebidas y cocteles preparados a requerimiento con gran expertise. Areas al fresco para disfrutar del hermoso paisaje de la playa. Los jardines muy bien mantenidos.  El area de Kids Club queda en el Reserve, no en el mismo site, pero te llevan y traen con gusto,solo unos 3 minutos. Senti mucha tranquilidad,, buen gusto, excelente servicio. Me encantaria volver!

reviews.author: solsireesalcedo
reviews.title: Buenas vacaciones!
reviews.text: Me encanto bailar con las chicos y las chicas de recreación y las actividades en la piscina con shanty Dahiana, Shaky shaky, gasolina, coco loco. También me gusto la atención de los chicos del swin up bar Mario fue muy amable y también el restauran japonés es excelente. Muy bueno el buffette,las camitas  camitas de la playa . En general todo bueno

reviews.author: Nlockwood1993
reviews.title: Welcoming and friendly!
reviews.text:
Before I review the actual resort, I'll fill you in on some important background information. 

1. I originally booked this as our honeymoon through Costco. And this was our first time in the Dominican Republic (Not as important as the next bit)

2. There are TWO Paradisus resorts in Punta Cana. 2 of them!!! One is "Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort" the other is "Paradisus Punta Cana" each also has its own "Reserve" resort areas. So be sure of which one you book so as not to be confused.

3. (Take this one with a grain of salt) Each Hotel may have its own rules pertaining to pool and beach access at night, however, we were not able to use our pool or beach at night, which was a bummer because my wife and I like to swim at night. We were told that (especially at the all inclusive resorts) they shut the pools down in the evening because years back, the were stories of people getting drunk and passing out and eventually drowning. They said this was a law across all resorts put in place by the Dominican government.

Alas, my review of The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana...

Originally I booked my trip through Costco Travel as stated before. I believed I booked a room at Paradisus Palma Real, but being naive that there were two Paradisus resorts on the island, and wishing to upgrade slightly, I thought I upgraded to the reserve at the Palma Real, but instead booked it at Paradisus Punta Cana Reserve. So, based on the pictures of the Palma real, I was a little let down to find out this resort wasn't as "grand" as the Palma Real appeared to be. 

  All of that aside, the resort is gorgeous. Staff is professional and even with a slight language barrier, they went out of their way to help out whenever necessary. Our concierge, Tammy Vasquez, did an amazing job setting up our meal reservations, letting us know about activities, and best of all... She made up the jacuzzi and bed in our room with bubbles, candles, and fresh picked flowers. The bed was a decently comfortable king size. We had a mini bar, restocked daily, couches, dining table, and a bathroom with one vanity, toilet, and shower, and the other with a jacuzzi and double vanity attached to the bedroom with a double sliding elegant screen door. Also had dual air conditioner controls. All in all, a very comfortable home away from home.

Outside, there are plenty of palm trees. More than you can count. Among other bushes, greenery, and other flowers, were countless seating areas and decorations to enjoy surrounding a very large pool with a swim up bar... Which leads me to my next endorsement. Leandro Sanchez is the best bar tender at The Reserve. Always smiling, asking how our drinks are, and willing to make something new for us to try. He made the pool come alive. 

Everyone always asks about the food. Well, you can't complain about variety. Some things I was a little scared to try even though I am fairly adventurous. There is all sorts of different foods at the buffet. Fish, meats, fruits, vegetables, and everything in between. The Hydro grill at the pool had some pretty great food - some of the best we had here. As far as the reserved sit down restaurants, they were pretty decent with most items being either very delicious, or not very great, but that's to be expected when having a limited menu, and cooking for the masses. 

Overall, we had a great time in paradise and enjoyed plenty of relaxation and comforts a plenty. 

PS... If you do decide to do an excursion outside of the resort, I recommend the Side by Side VIP snorkel, lunch, and natural lagoon tour. All inclusive beer, cocktails, and drinks on the boat, and Lunch at the Westin hotel resort. Ask for "Shaggy" and "Scooby"!

reviews.author: Figwell
reviews.title: If you can't have a good time here, You need Medication.
reviews.text:
First and foremost, let me just say we needed a vacation. Raising teen aged kids, working two jobs, my Girlfriends business as well, as  a close family member passing, you could say we needed to get away. Prior too, during, and after booking I read about 75 reviews about this resort. Going in I knew a few things but ultimately we were beyond happy with our experience. I have read several reviews about the beach, restaurants, and some other experiences with the staff that were not pleasant. Let me just say now, our trip here was very very enjoyable. I will address the "myths" and truths later in the review with my Pros, and Cons as always. The grounds, Food and staff here are mesmerizing to say the least. Before I go further though, I do have video of this resort as well as our trip to Soanoa Island on my you tube channel at otisjfigwell. Ok the Cons and Pros based on our experience.
Cons: 1. For some reason getting washcloths must be taboo here with the culture. We asked for a couple our first night and received two. Our second night we asked for more and only got hand towels. We never had a problem with larger towels to shower with however.
2. This one is a bit funny but could be a big deal if traveling with kids. The toilet is in the back corner of the bathroom. Not a big deal right, well there is a shower door with etched glass for privacy. The bath is in a straight line and has doors to shut off the bath from the rest of the room. Still, kids seeing Dad doing his business could lead to therapy so plan accordingly. Since it was just the two of us it was no big deal.
3. You are advised not to drink the tap water. The ice is good though, and you have plenty of bottled water in the room. It can be a bit inconvenient  brushing your teeth with bottled water, still worth the trip.
These weren't really anything to ruin the trip at all. What I mentioned here was what we thought of as minor.
PRO's 1.The staff is incredible. Upon arrival we were directed straight to the V.I.P. check in once we gave them our RCI confirmation. Next Lenny got us checked in and made ALL our dinner reservations for the week. Luis showed us around the resort and answered all our questions. Nores JN and Kenia gave us excellent service at the Buffet and poolside bar. The dinner staff was beyond friendly and very inviting.
2. The food here is one of the myths some folks complained about. Upon arrival make your reservations or you will not get in. This is a big deal here, Sunday is when most folks arrive and the reservations fill. Again make the plans when you check in. We ate at Naos for breakfast and we where never disappointed. The food is never ending and international to say the least. Rare, Bana, Vento, and the Blue Agave Mexican grill were absolutely incredible.
3. The beach is another of the myths here that people did not like but to us it is a pro. There is some debris that washes up here ( kind of looks like pine needles) on the beach about 1.5 feet wide. Now being able to go right out and swim with a cabana right behind you is awesome to us. Some folks however were complaining about the debris on Trip advisor. The beaches were beautiful and full of life here to us. I do not consider this the resorts fault because the debris is because of the water sports that are going on for the benefit of the tourist. Still you could not ask for a more picturesque scene.
4. The flea market just down the beach is a great place to make a deal. These guys will approach you on the beach, but if you aren't interested  just tell them no. When you are ready though, you can negotiate with them and get some unique items. The prices here are way better than the resort.
5. Now I payed a lot more here for the All Inclusive than any other resort I have stayed at. Let me tell you now, IT WAS WORTH IT. How and why you ask, Simple the nightly shows. The Michael Jackson tribute show was Brilliant. Truly a Vegas style show with the price of admission. Don't miss the Stomp show either, these are truly great shows with your meal and drink plan.
6. The rooms here are comfortable and to us very romantic. The Spanish influence is alive and well through the architecture of the property. The pools are amazing with plenty of room. We never had a problem finding a comfortable place to sit. The grounds are lush with Caribbean landscapes and very well kept. the housekeeping staff does an amazing job especially, Angela who took special care of us.

Lastly of course I will shamelessly plug my youtube channel otisjfigwell for you to view the property. If you like  80's music  and want to see the property from our point of view then check it out. Also, here is a list of tips I recommend.
-Get your tourist card online, it's 10$ and saves time at immigration.
-If we had to go back PACK YOUR OWN wash cloths just to be safe.
-I can not stress enough to make your dinner reservations at check in.
-Otium is great for the transfer and cheaper than a cab. Also Highly recommend the Soanoa Island exscursion. It is about 98$ per person and well worth it. If you check out my youtube video you will see some footage of the  day trip.
-Get a Spanish to English app for your phone. It will help you out even though the majority of the staff speaks great english. The housekeeping staff is not quite as fluent but you will still have great service.
-Free WIFI
Happy traveling all..........

reviews.author: Leandro G
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text:
En este hotel la comida de los restaurantes es Muy buena, las atenciones son excelentes de todo el personal en especial la participación de Melvin concepción ,quien es una de que sabe hace como pasar bien los momentos que estubimos con el , también yokaina ,pimpo en sus clases de pintura, las habitaciones son muy lindas y espaciosas , los aqua spinning son fabulosos, y los tragos de los bares son muy buenos a mi gustó.

Este hotel no tiene nada que envidiar le a los demás.

reviews.author: Evelyn B
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation at The Reserve
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana at the end of June for one week. Estefania from the family concierge was incredibly helpful and so sweet and attentive to our family needs.  She went out of her way to ensure we had an enjoyable experience. She made all our reservations, booked our daily cabana and any other request we had.  We all truly miss her and can't wait to return.  Our suite was spacious and even had a Jacuzzi. All the special touches that Estefania added made for a memorable stay.

The Reserve side of the hotel was very relaxing.  My kids who are 12 and 8 loved the peacefulness and lounging in the cabanas! When they wanted more action they walked over to the main pool area.  

Overall it was a great trip, lots of food and drinks. Would definitely return, soon I hope.

reviews.author: hamlet455
reviews.title: The reserve
reviews.text: Extraordinario trato de parte del personal es lo que mas resalta además de las comodidades, el gabi Glue es de lo mejor  y la forma de presentar las comidas la calidad de la misma me gustaría que marquen la diferencia en las actividades nocturnas así como lo están haciendo en el servicio y las atenciones deben de buscar más opciones y hacer la diferencia muchas gracias por el trato muy buena experiencia me gustaría regresar  .................................................................................…;;....................................................................................................................................................................................................................,...,..............,.,.,.....,..,,...,,...,,

reviews.author: Tir1961
reviews.title: Favoloso
reviews.text:
Tutto eccellente un ringraziamento speciale  Carlos Hinostroza.
Spiaggia stupenda ristoranti e buffet ottimi personale sempre sorridente e disponibile.
Suite curate e pulite.
Vacanza favolosa giardini stupendi e curatissimi.

reviews.author: juanpablomg
reviews.title: La mejor opción para unas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Este año,como todos los años anteriores, ha sido una estadía maravillosa y de total relax en The Reserve,y seguiremos yendo si dios quiere y recomendando a nuestros amigos y familiares.
Queremos ,mi esposa y yo expresar nuestra gratitud por el trato y la cordialidad que siempre hemos recibido por parte de todo el personal,en especial por su dedicación y profesionalidad a Don Silvio Lantigua ( mil gracias,siempre).
 También a Amelia de Dios,Yesica de la cruz,Luis Vasquez,Celso Peralta,Jhoan Santiago y en especial a Raneli R.Polanco (el Fiera ),en Gaby Club,The Reserve.
Ramon Ramirez,Luis Santana,Santos Frias y Jairo Minier en Reserve Beach que te mimaran con sus estupendos cockteles y a Nelson B Hidalgo (GYM),todas estas personas, como todo el personal de Paradisus,hacen que nuestras vacaciones sean siempre inolvidables y es de justicia nombrarlos,como también  Don Adrián Alonso.
Por último mi gratitud siempre a Don Rodrigo Silveyra por  su gran labor en la dirección de Paradisus Punta Cana y a su equipo.........gracias y hasta el próximo año

reviews.author: nelsonhortareporta
reviews.title: Fue una semana, pero preferimos dos
reviews.text:
Fue por una semana, pero preferíamos 2, sin embargo las obligaciones en esa ciudad no nos dio para mas, pero lo disfrutamos al máximo. 

 Fuimos un grupo de 21 y llegamos a Punta Cana, específicamente Paradisus Reserva, de la compañía hotelera española Meliá, este es el segundo año que tomamos turísticamente ese “Resort”, creemos el mejor en Punta Cana, y ya hacemos planes para el próximo año. 
 Desde que llegas a la recepción, hasta su pastelero Jose Luis Aguilera que tuvo magnifica atenciones con nosotros, y tenemos que mencionar a sus empleados, Juan Carlos Peña, Danilo Castillo, Erika Trinidad, Teuris Pelez Rubio, Gabriela Martínez Acevedo, José Marmol, Yasksmiry Pache, Jhon Santiago, Pedro Amparo, Junior Rosario uno de los barteder mas complaciente y calificado sin menospreciar al Pinareño dominicano, no podemos dejar fuera a Celso Peralta y Ramón el Chef de la piscina y su ayudante Raneli les hacen pasar las mas estupendas vacaciones.

reviews.author: Paul T
reviews.title: Ужин за счет заведения...
reviews.text:
После моих многочисленных жалоб на пляж, волейбольные мячи, снятие сетки волейбольной, грязи в отеле, шум при уборке, при разговорах горничных, шум от тук-туков, висящие криво полки, не работающий душ, вонючую джакузи, заболевшую от долгого check-in ребенка и супруги, на связь вышел наконец то управляющий отеля, ответственный за Guest Service Genaro Gil (Хенаро Хил (8625 или 8609)). После моего последнего обращения к Guest Service Assistant Marlena Belliard (8625, 8603, +18294707857) и моей грустной истории о том, почему я должен платить за доктора для моей дочери $130, если причина это 5 часовое заселение, она рассказала своему шефу об этом, и на пороге на следующее утро стоял доктор и менеджер. Я ему рассказал все мои претензии, он изо всех сил объяснил мне о том, что если мне что либо нужно, то я могу к нему обращаться, и как он хочет подарить мне ужин романтический в качестве компенсации. 
В результате мы договорились с ним о позднем check-out (стоит это $150 с человека, итого $300),
исправлении всех замечаний, а на романтический ужин я не стал сразу соглашаться, сказал, что зависит от самочувствия моей семьи.
В последний день мы согласились и на ужин. Ужин у бассейна. The Reserve далеко от океана, ну да ладно. Составили меню. Нарядились. Пошли. Уединение и тишина была гарантирована, романтическая обстановка тоже, даже официанта нашли со знанием русского языка. Когда принесли горячее блюдо в виде двух хвостов лобстера и ризотто из черного риса я был на пике восхищения, потому как не понимаю зачем дают тело и клешни. И вот на самом интересно месте, я вытаскиваю длинный черный прочный волос. В этот момент ко мне подошел официант и спросил как мне лобстер. Я сказал вот посмотрите.... ДА, подумал я, расскажет от своему начальнику об этом или нет. Я не особо акцентировал внимание на этом, потому как и не такое находил в еде. Выпив шампанского и вина, посидев на лежаках и посмотрев на звезды мы пошли ближе к дому....

reviews.author: Sharnjeet B
reviews.title: The best vacation
reviews.text:
First time to Dominican Republic staying at the reserve Paradisus Punta Cana. Amazing service from all the staff, excellent entertainment from Josias (Obama.) - all friendly and good fun. 
Food is great, variety of entertainment, white sand beaches and blue sea.

reviews.author: Allissonguerra
reviews.title: Fantástico...
reviews.text:
Uma estadia sensacional...
Como estávamos comemorando 1 ano de casados tentamos o melhor...
Que é o serviço real nesse hotel...
E não nos arrependemos nem por um segundo...
É simplesmente fantástico...Com mordomo...várias atividades inclusas...como mergulho..snorkeling...caiaque...catamarã...
piscinais exclusivas... atividades durante o dia... spa ( circuito aquático ) para quem participa do serviço real...
Melhor experiência em resorts que já tivemos...
Recomendo como melhor resort em que já estivemos...

reviews.author: kpax5
reviews.title: An amazing piece of Paradise!!
reviews.text:
We visited for the first time in Sept. The resort is AMAZING!! The service is customer service at its BEST!! The restaurants are DELISH!! I must recommend to make reservations for your ENTIRE stay the day you arrive.
Marielys at Guest services is VERY informative...professional...pleasant... and MOST helpful!!! Pedro the BELLMAN is very kind... and will do whatever he can to make your stay a delightful one!! 
We did not get the "royal service" (85 dollars additional per person per night) as many suggested and we are glad that we didn't. We went in Sept so we didn't have to worry about being in an ADULTS only area.. Many of those guests could not get reservations in the restaurants we booked ourselves... Think twice before "paying into the concept". We booked the "luxurious" suite which included an upgrade and we were very pleased!!
Live nightly entertainment EVERY NIGHT!! Casino was fun... but don't expect to walk out with significant winnings!!
Mini Bar which is "refreshed" daily.... ONLY consists of beer...soda....and water..
24 hour room service is quick and quite good!! Morning breakfast buffet is amazing!
The property is pristine and beautiful... 20 minutes from the airport... We suggest that you arrange your "airport transfers" BEFORE YOU GO!!
We plan on going again next year!!!

reviews.author: lizaloo
reviews.title: Good all inclusive resort
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay here- we did royal service and even though it was a quiet time of year to go ( off season) it was worth it. We loved the adults only RS pool area and beach. Loved the huts and beds on beach. Seaweed wasn't too bad and water was warm.

 We liked the RS restaurant Palazzo. There were a number of restaurants to choose from, but we liked Palazzo best. Rare was Ok and another we chose was closed b/c Im sure its a slow time of year.  Food overall was ok , but its a all inclusive so we didn't expect much. The buffet had tons of choices and we liked all the fresh fruit, sushi and  they would cook a meat/chicken /fish right in front of you to your liking. Breakfast buffet was my favorite. Other then that it was hit or miss but there are so many choices you could find something. Drinks were good , you could pretty much get anything you wanted. Loved Gabi beach bar. We did tip quite a bit, bar, beach, waiters- the front desk can make change for you. Not sure if that made us get better service but Im sure it was appreciated. The staff was generally very friendly and helpful! 

We played tennis, they had tennis clinic every morning which was great. My husband played golf and I did afternoon at the Yhi spa which was wonderful!  It was a quiet time to travel which we loved so not sure what it would be like during the busy season. But there were lots of chairs by the pools, bali beds and lots of chairs on he beach. We found it very clean, staff was friendly for the most part. The main pool is HUGE with lots of places to hang out it in. 

Our room was great. As many have noted the bathroom is kind of open- and there is a partly frosted glass door for toilet and shower- not much privacy. We liked the Royal service and would def. go here again. It was a very relaxing , easy vacation!

reviews.author: bigpeel
reviews.title: Stolen wallet
reviews.text: This will be my third attempt at leaving a review. It keeps disappearing. In short, wallet was stolen and returned next day minus cash. Either from gift shop or room ( while we were sleeping!) wouldn't allow me to watch cameras. Was told I out wallet in pocket. Went directly to room where belongings were laid on dresser. Turn down service comes in late. Deadbolt your door. Our friends had smaller items taken from their room as well. Basically this review is much more abbreviated just because I'm tired of writing this story. Just go somewhere else. Vouchers are a joke. People are friendly, but who can you trust??

reviews.author: Melissa F
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Helpful People, but Lack of Entertainment
reviews.text:
We took a family vacation to this resort in July 2015 and bought the Royal Service Plan. Having the Royal Service proved to be very helpful and alleviated a lot of stressful situations (such as making reservations for dinner, claiming a chair on the beach in the morning, etc.) 

Our butter, Yohelui or "Jo", was such a warm, inviting person who took care of everything for us. Every day, after coming back from the beach, we found little surprises in our rooms, such as fruit trays, bubble baths, and chocolate, which was nice after a long day on the beach. He asked us what type of foods we liked to eat and booked each of our evening dinner meals for us. We also had a cell phone to contact "Jo", which surprisingly proved to be very useful when we wanted to schedule appointments in the Spa. 

Another perk of this resort is the staffing near the pools and beach. A beach supervisor, Francisco, always set towels out on the chairs and beds on the beach for us, then personally walked us down to our spot, when we were ready. He was very helpful and also gave us drink suggestions.

The resort in all was absolutely beautiful; however, it severely lacked entertainment, especially in the evening. We were at the resort for four nights and of those nights, there was only 1 night with a show that we were interested in. In other resorts that we have stayed at in Punta Cana, they have dance shows, family oriented shows, magic, shows, etc. At Paradisus Palma Real, they had Jazz music playing every night, which did not interest us. The 1 night they did have a show it was just ok. They banged random objects to make music and I was not overly impressed. During the day; however, they had dance classes, beach volleyball, blow-up pool obstacle course, etc.

We also were not overly impressed by the Breakfast and Lunch selection. The food was pretty mediocre and nothing to rave about; however, THE MANGO! It was delicious and I highly recommend eating as much of it as you can. On the other hand, dinner was always delicious! We ate at the Sushi, Hibachi, Mediterranean, and the Private Royal Service Dinner Restaurant. The waiter at the Sushi Restaurant was extremely helpful and basically ordered the food for us due to the language barrier. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THE MEDITERRANEAN RESTAURANT! Everything was so delicious we could not stop talking about it.

Overall, the trip was enjoyable; however, the lack of nightly entertainment really put a damper on the vacation. We did not understand what you were supposed to do without entertaining nightly shows. We would recommend to people who do not care about seeing a show every night.

reviews.author: Riaznyc
reviews.title: I was happy with the results of my trip.
reviews.text: Overall, a good experience, I enjoyed the beach service, pool service and the all inclusiveness. The food was enjoyable at all the restaurants. The staff was enjoyable as well. My concierge was very helpful but he lied about promising me that I would be receiving 20,000 points for my Melia account after we visited a presentation for their timeshare option. We spent over an hour of our time, with a toddler, to see what our options were. Miaker Ramirez, I'm disappointed in you. You came off as somebody that we could trust but you lied to me and I can't forgive that.

reviews.author: silveirabruno
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text:
Acho que foi a melhor experiência que já tive com um hotel. Todas as pessoas de lá são muito atenciosas e receptivas. As comidas do hotel (restaurante aberto) são fantásticas, e recomendo mais ele para todos os dias do que os restaurantes que precisam ser reservados (também inclusos no pacote). A piscinas é excelente, e a praia linda!
Quem ficar hospedado aqui também pode aproveitar o dia no "The Reserve", sem custo, comendo e bebendo, porém não o fiz.
p.s. Sobre o Club Meliá, fujam dessa furada. Não compensa! Se conseguir, fuja até da apresentação (90 minutos).

reviews.author: Nara S
reviews.title: Casamento em Punta Cana
reviews.text: Realizei meu casamento no Paradisus Punta Cana e foi uma experiência perfeita! A Beatriz, coordenadora de bodas, foi impecável, muito atenciosa e ficou do começo ao fim da cerimônia super envolvida! Foi uma turma ótima, restaurantes maravilhosos, praia linda, estrutura show! A recepção do casamento foi exatamente como imaginava, assim como a cerimônia! Recomendo que quem esteja interessado feche o pacote de bodas lá com a Beatriz que não vai se arrepender e terá uma experiência única! Amei!

reviews.author: Justin C
reviews.title: Amazing Visit, but staff could be more attentive
reviews.text: This resort came highly recommended, so we decided to give it a shot... And we are glad we did. Beautiful resort, amazing views.. But we had a broken mini bar that still wasn't fixed after 9x of asking. Even with that, we'll be back! The staff at the beach was great, Luis Santana went above and beyond.

reviews.author: Julien L
reviews.title: Bel Hôtel mais...
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé 11 jours dans cet hôtel fin juin 2015, les chambres sont très spacieuses, bien équipées et très propres. L'hôtel est très bien entretenu, très grand, les jardins sont magnifiques, l'all-inclusive très complet, la piscine et ses abords sont très agréables.
Au niveau de la cuisine on y mange très bien mais c'est très répétitif, tout les jours un peu la même chose et pas assez de spécialités locales. 
Ce qui est très dommage aussi c'est l'ambiance musicale très lounge et house, pas de merengue ! , on est quand même en République ! 
Nos enfants se sont éclatés au mini-club même si il y a très peu de francophones.

reviews.author: Eduardo U
reviews.title: Insuperable
reviews.text: Excelente el hotel, hay relación calidad precio. A pesar de la cantidad de gente que había, teníamos privacidad. Muy buena la comida de todos los restaurantes, ya que recorrimos casi todos. La playa muy limpia y la atención muy amable.

reviews.author: johnito
reviews.title: Nada como The Reserve
reviews.text: En estas vacaciones por cuestiones de logística, estuvimos 5 días en Paradisus Palma Real y 5 días en The Reserve.  Lastimosamente el Palma Real no lleno nuestras expectativas (habiendo estado el año pasado en The Reserve), estuvimos 2 días sin aire acondicionado, pero creo que doy calificación de muy bueno al hotel por el personal de servicio con el que cuentan, en la opinión que acabo de escribir sobre The Reserve creo que los menciono a todos y si se me quedo uno por fuera, disculpen.  El hotel cuenta con muy buenas habitaciones y las áreas de piscinas y de restaurante son fenomenales, el bufete es de hotel 5 estrellas y los bares tienen todo lo que puedas imaginarte en cuanto a tragos y bebidas y si no lo saben hacer, saben escuchar y preparan lo que pidas, esto es atención al cliente en su máxima expresión.  Este es un hotel más para parejas que para familias, si viajas en familia con niños, The Reserve es el lugar para estar.

reviews.author: Kimjbankerdj
reviews.title: Awesome amazing...will go back
reviews.text:
Bring small bills for tips; you can bring USD

Cab from airport was $35. 

Check in:
If you want a room near the beach, I suggest you ask as we would have liked one but we didn't ask.  You'll have a concierge assigned to you. Highly recommended you make a dinner reservation when you check in.  Get resort credits coupons when you check in. We got them a day later and wished we knew there was a room upgrade coupon, may have used it. 

Royal Service:
We paid for it but didn't feel it was worth it especially in the off season.

Room:
We were at the Reserve in building 41 second floor. It's quite far from the beach but you can take the shuttle there. Shuttle comes every 10 to 15 minutes. Room was very clean and lots of space for 2 adults. The shower was a bit lacking in water pressure and the doors slam when the shut. Air conditioning was excellent. 

People:
Awesome and very friendly. Love the DR people. Service was A+. Big shout out to Jeremy and Alex!!  

Beach:
Amazing!  Not much seaweed.  Bring sunscreen. 

It's been 90 degrees everyday. Doesn't get cool at night.

Restaurants:
LaPalapa was our favorite. The lobster tail was amazing!
Had fun at the Japanese Bana restaurant. Great food everywhere!!

Excursions:
We did a 5 hour excursion called Reef Expedition. Alex at the resort helped us book it. It's a reef snorkel trip, with paddle boards, kayaks, massage, food and lots more. 
We had a blast. I held a sting ray. Saw beautiful tropical fish, a nurse shark, sting rays and lobsters. It's a complete experience. I highly recommend it. 

Had massages on the beach which was amazing!  

Resort said to get to airport 3 hours early but didn't need anywhere nears as much time. Sat in airport for 3 hours. Not much to do there. 

Overall it was an awesome vacation!!!  We will go back.

reviews.author: Raquel G
reviews.title: FUE SOLO UNA VISITA DE INSPECCION PERO WOW QUE ME HUBIESE QUEDADO!!
reviews.text:
Solo estuve un día en este hotel y fue sin dormida pero las instalaciones son preciosas, así como el nivel de entretenimiento. Me gusta el trato del personal y que todo se concentra cerca. Conocí los salones para eventos y me parecieron espectaculares.

Pude probar el restaurante PALAZZO, sin duda una cena exquisita y los mejores postres que he probado en Punta Cana solo que es exclusivo para huéspedes royal.

La playa es lindísima y el juego de colores de luces durante las noches hacen que en verdad te sientas en un paraíso.

reviews.author: Danielle C
reviews.title: Estadia excelente
reviews.text: O hotel +e excelente, instalações limpas e aconchegantes. Funcionários educados e atenciosos, ninguém fica te pedindo gorjeta, se vc não der nada será igualmente bem tratado. Cheguei por volta da 01:00 da manhã e estavam a postos me esperando. Restaurantes são bons e fartos. Recomendo utilizar o serviço Royal Service para ter um tratamento diferenciado. O Hotel possui muitas piscinas, bares espalhados por toda a instalação, inclusive na praia, restaurantes de culinária internacional. Tem um mini shopping se vc quiser variar os ares. Recomendo!!!

reviews.author: elizathS04
reviews.title: One week stay
reviews.text:
Our stay was a very nice vacation. The staff was beyond amazing. Our stay included the Royal service. Our Butler, Elvis, was very sweet, attentive, and helpful. In the Royal service area, Carlos Rosario was there tending to us all every day and always had a smile on his face and made sure we were taken care of. He also had a great sense of humor! 
One afternoon we ate at the Blue Agave for lunch. We were a few minutes early before the area started serving Mexican. Jose, went out of his way to provide us with more than enough food. 
You must try the Dirty Monkey at the bar. You'll be hooked. 
The service and property were top notch. In my opinion, the food could use some improvement. The desserts were just ok and the bread was always hard. We did not like Rare at all. The Italian restaurant was amazing. The last night we had surf and turf at a private party and it was also amazing. 
All in all, we had a blast and felt very well taken care of.

reviews.author: elizathS04
reviews.title: Pedicure in the Reserve YHI Spa
reviews.text: Anny provided a wonderful Classic pedicure at the YHI Spa. She took her time, did a fantastic job, and was very sweet! And the price matched the service. The facility is very pretty and relaxing. I stayed in the main resort and the transfer over to the Reserve spa was very simple.

reviews.author: Claudio F
reviews.title: Hotel e funcionários
reviews.text: O hotel simplesmente é fantástico em todos os aspectos.Mas os funcionários fazem o lugar ter mais vida sendo muito receptivos. Agradecimentos especiais aos funcionários: GEORGE ALRICHE  , YANEIRA SALDANA  e WANDER DESPENO

reviews.author: Ludhad
reviews.title: A real Luxury resort that brings amazing experience
reviews.text:
The overall experience we had here was amazing; form the infrastructure to the high quality restaurants and food to a real professional staff.
An outstanding experience and one of the best option for an all inclusive luxury hotel

reviews.author: CGPaganini
reviews.title: Lua de mel dos sonhos!
reviews.text:
Sempre tive uma ideia em relação à lua de mel: conforto total, estadia de luxo, pernas para o ar e uma paisagem paradisíaca. Posso dizer, com convicção, que Punta Cana atendeu a todas as expectativas... e o resort Paradisus Palma Real foi a "cereja do bolo" para tornar a viagem muito mais do que especial! Toda a equipe do hotel, do check-in ao check-out, foi extremamente atenciosa - nos sentimos verdadeiros "marajás", isso que não usufruímos do Royal Service, oferecido na nossa chegada. 
Queremos destacar a simpatia do Garnier, nosso Family Concierge, que, do início ao fim, nos atendeu de maneira fantástica, ajustando horários de passeios e do Coco Bongo, lembrando também dos nossos amigos "mineiros de alma carioca", ou "Los Mineros",  Antonio Ramirez e Girberto Mesia, atendentes do bar da piscina, que sempre nos atenderam com muita alegria (e muita paciência diante das nossas indecisões em relação a "o que beber agora?"), do Luis Martinez e do Liony Familia, do Lobby Bar, que nos ofereceram drinks maravilhosos até no momento da saída do hotel, do Marcos Floryntino, da recepção, que nos ofereceu o paraíso ao colocar as pulseirinhas nos nossos pulsos (e causou uma dor tremenda ao cortá-las na saída) e, é claro, do nosso maleiro Ramon Calderon, que também do início ao fim foi muito simpático e atencioso, todos os dias de nossa estadia, perguntando se estávamos gostando da viagem... não estávamos gostando, mas, sim, AMANDO!!! 
Gostaria de salientar, também, as atrações do resort, todas incluídas na estadia, como os restaurantes além do buffet geral (fomos ao Bana Asian Bistro e Vento: ótimos!) a apresentação do grupo itinerante do musical "The Lion King" (muito lindo!!!) e a Barbacoa Caribeña - o que pensávamos, como bons gaúchos, que seria apenas uma "baita churrascada", foi, na verdade, um jantar paradisíaco na beira da praia, com um buffet maravilhoso e show com músicas locais... INDESCRITÍVEL!
Também salientamos o buffet geral do resort, repleto de tipos variados de comidas para agradar a todos os gostos, com muita qualidade e sabor e o lindo cartão postal que é o resort.
Então, para todos os casais que estão em busca de uma lua de mel perfeita (ou apenas uma viagem para não se pensar em nada), Punta Cana é o destino e o resort Paradisus Palma Real é o local para se hospedar!!!

reviews.author: eric g
reviews.title: Déçus
reviews.text:
Déçus dès notre arrivée. A 13H30, notre chambre était prête mais il ne nous a pas été possible de l'intégrer car une visite des lieux nous a été proposée. Très vite nous avons compris que cette visite était bien plus destinée à vendre des produits mélia que de nous faire découvrir le ressort. Dès que nous avons dit que nous ne serions pas intéressés par ces produits, la visite du ressort s'est arrêtée nette. Cela nous a rappelé les heures sombres du time share. L'employé qui nous dit que si l'on passe le lendemain du temps on va le valoriser... Le lendemain nouvelle tentative où nous avons fait savoir plus clairement que nous étions ici en vacances. Déçu aussi d'une bonne partie du personnel. où la courtoisie n'est pas toujours de mise. Beaucoup d'algues sargasses mais là l'hôtel n'y peu rien. Etonné aussi que l'hôtel nous fasse payer le solde lors du check in. Très déçu par les jus de fruit du petit déjeuner. A l'ibérostar nous avions du vrai jus de goyave, banane, ananas là rien de tout ça. Impossible d'accéder aux dessert, un employé doit vous servir. Problème il n'est pas toujours là et une vitre nous empêche de nous servir. Pour un 5* quelle déception. Hôtel sur dimensionné c'est à dire peu de touristes par rapport à l'infrastructure donc peu d'ambiance. pas de table de ping pong, les tennis en dehors du resort. Très peu d'animation sportives ou autres. C'était triste. C'est la première fois que j'ai l'impression de me tromper dans le choix d'un hôtel.   A chaque fois habituellement les notes trouvées sur tripadvisor correspondent aux hôtels et là j'avais plus l'impression que cet hôtel méritait bien moins que 4,5 (3?). Du coup, ce que je ne fais pas habituellement, J'ai regardé pendant mon séjour ce que j'avais raté à la lecture des critiques. J'ai été amusé de lire que des avis semblaient truqués. Je n'en ai pas été surpris. On finit toujours par être rattrapés par la vérité. Bravo à trip pour avoir depuis déclassé cet hôtel de la 7ème à la 30 ème puis maintenant la 47 ème place. Il est vrai qu'avec le recul et une relecture, on voit beaucoup d'avis laissés par des gens enregistrés en 2015 dont c'était le premier avis où l'on encense deux ou trois employés et où aucune réserve n'estprésente. Je pense avoir été trompé par cet hôtel . Très content de la réaction de trip. 
Pour être juste il existe des points positifs. Un décor grandiose, magnifique piscine des lits balinais agréables.

reviews.author: Mary B
reviews.title: Wonderful beautiful area w very nice people
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the beach but the pool was even better. The pool concierge, Jensy Rijo, was helpful, personable- he even helped us with our Spanish!! The hotel staff were friendly, courteous, and the accommodations wonderful!! Mary and Rita

reviews.author: Sergio G
reviews.title: Como en el Paraíso...
reviews.text:
Punta Cana es increíble, su gente, la hospitalidad y servicio de los trabajadores del Resort te hacen sentir en otro mundo. Todo ordenado, limpio y dispuesto para que te olvides de los problemas y disfrutes, en mi caso junto a la familia...
Cuentan con un Kid Zone, donde entretienen y se preocupan de cada detalle para que los niños lo pasen increíble y uno pueda hacer otras actividades. 
Sus restaurantes son de buena calidad.
Agradecimientos especiales a Fior Dáliza, Ricardo Acereto, del Club y Jorge y Luis, quienes siempre se mostraron muy dispuestos, con excelente voluntad y disposición a ayudar.

reviews.author: SolyMar365
reviews.title: Estellas por una semana
reviews.text: En nuestro octavo viaje a Punta Cana creíamos que nada nuevo nos sorprendería. Pero los trabajadores de este hotel Nos demostraron lo contrario. La diferencia la hace el servicio. Cada deseo es cumplido como Si fueras el único habitante del hotel. Nadie olvida tu apellido o tus gustos. El único inconveniente es tener que usarme golf cart para ir a la playa. Preferiria poder caminar, pero está muy cliente. Sin falta regresamos el próximo año.

reviews.author: aztoasia
reviews.title: Unbelievable property, cuisine and staff
reviews.text: We had a family of 4, ages 4.5 and 6 (birthday was celebrated during trip), and it was our first time in the DR!  Everything was magnificent upon arrival, from arranged airport transportation, luggage assistance and immediate check-in at The Reserve.  Our suite was just as pictured, with a view of the pools, and plenty of space for all of us.  We chose Family Concierge and was assigned to Elizabeth, who just adored the children, and likewise in return.  The beach is a short (10 min) walk or 3 minute shuttle ride away.  The beach attendants, Ramon and Luis, did a superb job of assuring all of our needs were met.  The sun was almost always shining and the sand was like soft, white powder.  After the beach, we would head to the family pool or the 'adult' pool so the kids could order 'Micky Mouse' drinks and enjoy the fountains.  The food at the restaurants and buffets was well above expectations and I cannot speak highly enough of Passion.  For the small up charge, it is certainly an experience to remember.  I can go on and on about the service rendered by Emilio, Charlie, Davey, Elizabeth, Monica and all of the staff...they truly do an awesome job of making you feel welcome!  On our daughters b-day, cake was brought at breakfast (with a song to boot) and at dinner.  When we returned to the room, the bathtub was filled with balloons and balloons were decorating the front door and hung from the ceiling, both kids were absolutely floored!  The kids zone was a safe and enjoyable for both children, again the service and smiles were just wonderful.  We sure hope to return soon to room 2402!

reviews.author: JoelJessica2011
reviews.title: Inolvidables vacaciones! GRACIAS al personal del hotel!
reviews.text:
Acabamos de pasar nuestras vacaciones de 7 dias en el Paradisus Palma Real, el hotel en si mismo es ejemplar. Pero sobre todo lo que hizo nuestra vacaciones inolvidables y perfectas fueron los empleados quienes nunca olvidaremos. El hotel es 5 estrellas pero los empleados lo hacen que sea de 10 estrellas. 
      Yo y mi esposa queremos dar reconocimieno especial a esas personas quien nos trataron como familia y quien nos hicierion sentir que tendremos amistades por vida. Ellos nos han dado una gran razon por querer regresar al Paradisus PR en el futuro. GRACIAS POR TODO: Johnfi Rivera (nuestro Mayordomo ejemplar), Miguel German (nuestro amigo por vida), Angelo Mercedes (Mayordomo), Miky Almonte ('Viva Mexico"), Wanda Correa (una bella persona), Marino Payans (la mejor Mamajuana!), Alexander Guzman (un mayordomo en el futuro), Pedro Cedano (siempre haciendo nos sonrei y atento),  Joel Valdez (las mejores batidas de fruta), Francisco Cabrera (siempre atento con nosotros), Alexis Francisco (Chef superior de primera clase en el Palazzo), Teodoro Gonzalez ("que lo que"), Drayi (el mejor mojito de la Rep. Dom.). 
GRACIAS, nos vemos pronto!

Joel y Jessica Gonzalez

reviews.author: Humberto N
reviews.title: Ótima estadia no Caribe
reviews.text: Hotel muito bom, estrutura fantástica e comida muito saborosa principalmente nos restaurantes Palazzo e Acqua. De uma maneira geral todos os funcionários são sempre alegres e cordiais, um destaque para o garçom George Alriche que nos atendeu muito bem enquanto estávamos na praia, sempre sorridente e prestativo. Apesar de um problema que tivemos com o ar condicionado no nosso quarto, a solução foi rápida e nos ofereceram o Royal Service para compensar o transtorno causado. As bebidas são muito boas e o hotel é tranquilo para relaxar, você não vê pessoas falando alto nos corredores. O cover do Michael Jackson é muito divertido.

reviews.author: bethde
reviews.title: A lovely Zen place to stay
reviews.text:
My family met three other families there for a week.  Could not find anything I didn't love about this pristine, quiet, beautiful oceanfront resort with a very Zen like atmosphere.  The food was exceptional and there was something for everyone's different tastes.  Even the evening entertainment was fun and worth attending.
We are divers and found the diving spots to be lacking and generally depleted with badly damaged coral reefs.  But we already knew before we went that we weren't going for the diving.  It has nothing to do with the resort.  It is known that the Dominican Republic is not a good spot for diving.  I give this resort an A plus.

reviews.author: ajayshah734
reviews.title: Good Resort in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Good Resort, walk to some rooms is too long, Service is very good, No Primium liquor included. Some restaurants are not included.Rooms are good.Room Service is 24/7 with smile. In all this is very good Resort

reviews.author: bancettydaihianaj
reviews.title: Un excelente hotel
reviews.text: excelente hotel, me gusto todo el trato que me dieron, el personal muy amable, en recepción no dieron un excelente trato. los felicito con gusto volvería a ese hotel.  No haba ido a un hotel con tan buen servicio en todos los aspectos. se voy a recomendar a todos mis allegados.

reviews.author: Arlene F
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel. Recommend for relaxing and unwinding.
The service was superb. Greeted with their signature drink Blue paradise.
Employees went above and beyond to please, especially Jermy Cabrera.
Not much entertainment in the evening but perhaps was due to low season (September).
You must utilize a golf cart to commute between the two hotels but they are available 24 hours.

reviews.author: CaroRuizGa
reviews.title: Muy recomendable
reviews.text:
Mi estadia en The Reserve fue excelente. fuimos en familia (29 personas) y habían dos chicas que estaba siempre al pendiente de nosotros (Diosmery y Stephanie), siempre atentas a nuestras necesidades y muy cooperadoras,  viajamos con mis hijas de 11 meses (mellizas). nunca nos pusieron un problema a nuestros requerimientos de comida y accesorios para las cunas. Nos quedamos en un lugar especial para familias que se llama Family Consierge, que esta adaptado para que estés cerca de tu familia y muy cerca también de la piscina y restaurant donde tomas desayuno.
para acercarte a la playa o a los restaurantes hay carritos que pasan cada 10 minutos y te llevan a donde quieras, sino puedes hacerlo caminando no son mas de 10 minutos y el paseo es muy lindo entre la vegetación y música ambiente, eso si...cuidado con los mosquitos! recomiendo llevar repelente sobre todo usarlo de noche. 

El Lugar es hermoso! Toda la gente que trabaja muy amable siempre, y puedes desandar que es lo mas implorante. las instalaciones en general son muy buenas, habitaciones amplias y limpias que al menos para mi es muy importante. 

ahh Wi-Fi en todas partes!!!

reviews.author: Mikybg
reviews.title: Tutto perfetto
reviews.text:
Il Paradisus è sempre una garanzia. 
Le camere sono molto belle spaziose e pulite. Gli svariati ristoranti sono molto buoni, consiglio il messicano piatti squisiti.
Il personale gentilissimo e sempre pronto ad aiutarti . La spiaggia è spettacolare, tenuta perfettamente l'unico neo erano le alghe che rendevano difficoltoso fare il bagno .

reviews.author: diggers222
reviews.title: Amazing family getaway!
reviews.text: We traveled with 4 adults and 2 toddlers and the reserve is perfect for families.  The reserve area was nice and secluded and the pool was very clean.  A little too far if you wanted to use the beach every day but we stayed by the pool and our reserved cabana every day which was perfect.  Rooms were big, even the regular suites had separate sleeping areas.  Cabinets etc. were a little dated, the fold out couch was uncomfortable for adults and we couldn't get a dvd player in our room for the kids.  Service was excellent.  We had one family concierge room and although they gave us a phone to contact our concierge at all times, we didn't really need it since they were always walking around making sure you were ok.  Our concierge was Elaine and she was extremely helpful, also Sofia helped us our first day.  Both were amazing to us and our kids.  Our kids never ended up using the kids club but we visited and they looked like they were doing some fun activities.  Our kids were disappointing that the playground was under construction but the kids pool was perfect for toddlers.  Overall a great trip, food was good, service was excellent and kid friendly atmosphere was perfect.  We would visit again!

reviews.author: DSMarti
reviews.title: Perfect Location for Milestone Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: We were looking for a luxurious, all-inclusive, Caribbean resort destination to celebrate my 60th birthday and 'The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana' did not disappoint! The master bedroom suite is spacious and nicely appointed. The concierge service was outstanding. A special shout-out to Elaine and Rosemary (Club Melia) for your thoughtfulness and attentiveness. The wait staff at the Gabi Club and Vento restaurants were superb. A special thank you goes to Catalino Ventura (Jose)for remembering how my husband likes his coffee :-). Julio, you're the best! And, the restaurant choices on property were varied and delicious. We look forward to our next vacation at The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana.

reviews.author: NedandStacey
reviews.title: Family Concierge Rocks!
reviews.text: This is our first all inclusive experience and the family concierge took it up another notch from great to awesome. We were met immediately after arrival and provided an introduction to this service called family concierge at the reserve.   Our primary concierge was named Elaine and she went above and beyond.  We were also helped by DiosMery and Sophia as part of the team to ensure the best possible experience.  They gave us a private cell phone with the numbers on speed dial and checked in throughout each day on how we were doing.  They would show up wherever we were on the resort to ensure that the activity leaders gave us the best the resort had to offer.  Upon returning to our room each day we found handwritten notes left to our children including cookies, milk, and bedtime stories.  Highlight was coming home to the bathroom filled with balloons and a bubble bath for the kids after a long day at the beach.  The Reserve is absolutely beautiful and their staff is fantastic, however the family concierge made it that much better and is highly recommended for anyone looking for a worry free vacation where someone else does all of the booking and logistics while you simply relax.

reviews.author: Ale0921
reviews.title: Nada como Gabi Beach
reviews.text: Debo decir que cuando llegue al hotel no tuve la mejor impresión, las habitaciones son muy cómodas y completas pero no es la habitación de hotel que esperaba y que nos gusta que es mas tipo loft, estas habitaciones son mas de estilo clásico, además están rodeadas de muchísima vegetación que es lindo pero no permite que corra la brisa, así que cuando estás llegando a las habitaciones se siente muchísimo calor, menos mal el aire acondicionado de las habitaciones enfría muchísimo y no hay problema cuando estás dentro de ellas. Con gran preocupación me encontré que no servían jugos naturales sino únicamente en la mañana, en este momento estoy embarazada y no consumo nada de bebidas artificiales ni gaseosas, el primer día no hubo ayuda por parte del personal; sin  embargo, el segundo día logramos hablar con el jefe de restaurantes y muy amables desde ese momento prepararon jugos naturales cuando los requerí; gracias a Dios me solucionaron pero si me parece un tema a mejorar pues este es un hotel familiar y los niños en mi familia no toman nada de bebidas artificiales. Lo mejor del hotel sin duda es la zona de Gabi Beach, la música, la gente atendiendo, debo decir que esta zona es un paraíso, la comodidad de la zona es genial y en la noche siempre hubo algún pequeño show por parte de los empleados. La playa tiene algunas algas pero no son molestas, el agua es cálida y el arena muy fina. Cocteles de todos los colores y sabores, yo no los probé obviamente pero mi esposo si los disfruto, algunos mas que otros, le encantó la caipiriña, pero dejo de tomarla pues se prepara con mucha azúcar y eso da mucho guayabo. Con respecto a los restaurantes hay muchísima  variedad en comida pero creo que le falta incluir en su menú cosas mas típicas de la región. Fuimos al centro comercial pero los precios son bastante altos, así que dejamos las compras para otro momento. Lo mejor del hotel el trato de sus empleados, la gente dispuesta a ayudarte pero con especial cariño debo resaltar el maravilloso trabajo de Kenia Chalas en el bar de Gabi Beach, siempre pendiente por consentirme con los jugos, nunca faltó una sonrisa y una impecable atención.

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.title: Paradise found!
reviews.text: It was perfect!  We went for 4 nights in mid-September, so it was not busy at all.  Very clean, room was great (1 bedroom suite), food was amazing, pool is great - with a great swim up bar, staff went above and beyond to be friendly and interact (playing volleyball with us, teaching dancing, swim aerobics, evening entertainment - and more).  Only downside to being off-season was that not all restaurants were open every day - but there were still more than enough - and they were all amazing!  We are already planning our return!  FYI - during busy season Reserve and/or Royal Service may be worth it, but during downtimes, I would just go with a standard room.

reviews.author: nmolinaveloso
reviews.title: excelente
reviews.text:
excelente resort all inclusive. muy cuidadosos de la atención a los pasajeros. 
cada uno de los trabajadores del hotel estan impregnados con la atencion de calidad 
por ahora puedo recordar los nombres de Andy bartender, Francisco Estrella el toallero, alberto del club melia
las mucamas y las chicas del yhi spa 
entregan una muy buena atencion, 100% recomendado

reviews.author: martin p
reviews.title: Servicio
reviews.text: Fuimos muy bien atendidos por el Sr. Lemue Santana en el restaurante Aqua y sobretodo por el Sr. George Alriche en la playa del hotel estando siempre bien predispuesto para servirnos mientras tomabamos sol.

reviews.author: abbycahill
reviews.title: I love this hotel
reviews.text: On our 5th day and we are loving every single minute. The food is lovely and so many hidden restaurants that are awesome. The reserve pool is one of the best I have ever been too . Along with the beach. The Staff are all very friendly and make you feel very welcome, including Wandel Roa and Emilio Valdez. Do not want to go home on the 28th ! Abby and Damien room no 2415

reviews.author: Derryl D
reviews.title: Tropical Paradise
reviews.text: The resort was awesome. It was truly a tropical paradise. I have been a time share owner for sixteen years and this was about the best resort I have visited. The staff was courteous, professional and extremely nice. Mr. Juan Jose Rosa and Mr. Eliezel Ruiz delivered impeccable service. I will return in the future. The resorts ambience is truly remarkable.

reviews.author: hzuri92
reviews.title: The people make all the difference.
reviews.text: This trip was by far my best trip yet! I loved everything about the resort, but the most important thing was the people and how they made you feel. They catered to our every need and more. Some of the best people you will ever meet are at this resort. There are so many great people here that have made it such a great trip we will be returning next year. Here is a list of people who made our week vacation the absolute best.Juan de Dios, Steulis Bayu, Manuel Saldanr, Jennika Ortega, Miguel Germon, Henry Romero (one of my families favorite), Randoff Van de C'isle, Santo Ozuna, Martum, & Andy at the Aqua kitchen.

reviews.author: Yanira
reviews.title: Primera vez en Punta Cana ... feliz!
reviews.text: Siendo la primera vez que viajamos a Punta Cana, fue increíble. El recibimiento, la gente dominicana es increíble. Y finalmente llegamos a Paradisus Punta Cana que es realmente "el paraíso". La gente demasiado amable, la comida rica (con solo el comentario que los buffet no son muy amplios), las piscinas increíbles y para que decir la habitación.
