Especiales agradecimientos a Leo y Alicia de Club Melia, Junior en The Reserve siempre atento con nosotros, Maria en la recepción de los distintos restaurant y especifcamente en Gabi Club a Rosmety Acevedo, Yesica, Frank Andres y Julio Reyes por la atención cada dia que fuimos. Incluso la cercanía con mis niños lo cual no es típico de ellos. Gracias y ojala volver cuanto antes!

reviews.author: Steph L
reviews.title: Superbe mer turquoise
reviews.text: Superbes caraïbe ,véritable déconnexion vrai vacances dépaysantes dans un cadre très caliente .Chambres moyennes et pas très propre mais largement compensée par la plage et ses cocotiers. Le côté exclusif avec piscine spéciale est conseille pour fuir le monde .

reviews.author: Qiao Chan G
reviews.title: Punta Cana 9/2015
reviews.text: I probably won't come back to this place, didn't have a great experience at all.  Check-in and dinner reservations were horrible. The resort ground is nice but the hotel rooms are out dated and needs a lot of repairs.

reviews.author: Natalie P
reviews.title: Fantastic experience, amazing people.
reviews.text: The Hotel itself is absolutely beautiful, with a lot of attention on details such as flower arrangements, decoration in general, soft music pretty much everywhere you walk around, makes you feel like you're living in a paradise vacation commercial, but it's real life!! The food was delicious everywhere, from the buffet dinner to the varied included restaurants. The entertaining activities are non-stop, so you can choose between resting near the pool/beach or dancing, playing sports, dancing, painting, dancing and more! But I must highlight that the very best of all is the people that works here. Everybody is super atent and friendly, making our big chilean family vacation unforgettable, especially thanks to those we spent most of our time with: Happy face, Jazz, Angel, Minimi, Caramelo, Shaky shaky from the entertainment department, Miguel the magician and Juan bartenders at Gabi beach, Barón Justo, Juan Suárez and Joehandy Gavilán at the restaurants!! Cant´t wait to come back to meet them again! I recommend this place very much for all kinds of vacation, for I think it's a very versatile place for such (business, couples, family, friends and solo).

reviews.author: ronaldomdias
reviews.title: Ferias 2015
reviews.text:
Hotel muito bom! 

Agradeco hospitalidade de todos em especial aos funcionarios: Jose de los santos, Emilio Valdez,  Ciriaco Jimenez.

Recomendo a ida.

Apenas deixo como ressalva os pontos: Wifi instavel, apenas um tipo de vinho em todos os 7 restaurantes e tentativa de venda do clube Melia.

reviews.author: Ricardo B
reviews.title: Lugar incrível, staff muito cordial
reviews.text: Resort com um serviço ótimo, culinária muito boa, muito bem decorado e conservado. O staff é muito cordial, disponível e simpático. Na nossa estadia, em especial Geremias, Andres, hostess do Gabi Club e sete do check in/out.

reviews.author: Tapeator
reviews.title: De lujo
reviews.text:
Este hotel es el mejor hotel en el que he estado. Es ciertos que tiene matices. Ya que para que el lujo sea completo tienes que seguir algunos consejos según mi opinión. 

Obligatorio alojarse en "the reserve" y si es posible pagar un suplemento para disponer de una habitación swim up que tienen acceso a piscina y hacen la estancia sea un Pinazo.

Las habitaciones son un auténtico espectáculo, grandes, limpias, con todo tipo de lujos y detalles. 
El servicio 24 horas de habitaciones es también impresionante. 

Las instalaciones del hotel son maravillosas, piscinas, jardines, carros de golf para moverte por el complejo...

En cuanto a las actividades gastronómicas mas lujo aun. Los restaurantes temáticos son muy buenos y luego el Gabi beach, Gabi club y el restaurante pasión de berasategui un lujo lujo lujo. 

Ojalá algún día pueda volver a ir.

reviews.author: Darnele61
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Tuvimos la oportunidad de visitar por primera vez Punta Cana en el mes de julio de este año, el hotel es espectacular, la estadía fue buenísima, la atención, actividades y la atención de primera. Nada que agregar solo felicitaciones.

reviews.author: knturbo
reviews.title: Excellent family vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Reserve for a full week. The resort is beautiful and the staff is amazing.  We chose to go with the family concierge as our son is 3 and we wanted some child friendly options. Our family concierge Andy was excellent. He was very helpfully booking all restaurants and checking on our son at the Kid Zone. He made our son feel extra special with gifts in the room and a final night with a bubbly bath with balloons. It has been almost a week home and our son still talks about Mr. Andy. Andy made sure we were always settled and that our son had milk and juice anytime we needed.

The Kid Zone was great. We didn't know what to expect but our son couldn't wait to visit each day for a few hours. Samantha, Diasarys, Nica, Irene, and Francisca were amazing. I might be missing a few names but all the teachers were excellent and our son was always well taken care of, happy when we picked him up and ready to go back the next day. This was huge as we were able to enjoy some adult time at the pool or spa. 

The bar staff was always very pleasant and offered to concoct fun drinks. Estafan at the reserve pool bar was very nice and would surprise us with amazing drinks as well as cater to our son with some virgin options that he was able to enjoy at the pools. The beach bars are also great especially the margarita bar. The staff was very attentive and even started to remember us by name and what cocktails we enjoyed. 

The food was nice. Each restaurant had something different to offer. The food wasn't always perfect but the staff was always willing to accommodate and bring more food if need be, especially for our son. Most breakfasts we spent talking with Angela who took great care of us. Our son created a few messes and she was always willing to help us out. At the steak house, not only was the food amazing but our waiter Jhonny was very attentive and great with our son. He made sure our little guy was okay with the menu options and that our food and drinks were always capped off. 

The night shows were decent. Our son enjoyed the Lion King and there were a few nights of music. We would have enjoyed a little more action for the evening but it was all still very pleasant. I had the opportunity to paint by the pool one day with teachers Carlos and Alexandro. It was a lot of fun and my painting actually looked pretty good, full credit to the teachers. 

The pools were all great and different with ample towels. The beach is beautiful and the staff was helpful with reserving a seat and bringing out water. There are people trying to sell items on the beach or have you sign up for water sports but no one was ever aggressive and after a simple no thank you they would move on. The seaweed is a small issue but not enough to keep us out of the water. 

Overall we had a beautiful trip. The resort has a lot to offer with lots of pools, food and activity options. The staff was amazing and very nice and made us feel at home. On our last day Junior walked over and heard we were leaving and came to say good-bye and give our son a fist pump. Just shows how nice the trip was and nice and attentive the staff was.

reviews.author: Liz S
reviews.title: Destination Wedding!
reviews.text: My 3rd visit to Paradisus Punta Cana! This time for a friends destination wedding! The wedding was amazing!!! To top it off, wonderful service by all staff members! Outstanding services by the swim up bar staff! Santos Polanco, Juan Cruz, Jensy, Argenis, Charlie, Verdieu,(cocinero)! Gotta love them!

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.title: Espectacular!
reviews.text: Es un hotel impecable. La habitación grande, con un baño espacioso, hidromasaje, ducha escocesa, muy luminosas y totalmente pulcras. Los espacios comunes muy amplios y siempre con gente a tu disposición para ayudarte en lo que necesites. Todo tipo de actividades: deportivas,creativas,culturales,recreativas. El gym está muy completo y ni hablar del spa"una pasada" en fin....si uno quiere relajarse y olvidarse por unos días del mundo este hotel es un paraíso. Lo que no quiero dejar de comentar es sobre los restauranes,en general la comida es muy buena. Pero recomiendo el MiZu, restaurante de comida asiática"riquísima". Y hay un chef "Victor Zuzuki" que es buenísimo😜.Cocina en vivo!

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Paradise.
reviews.text:
Luis santana. 
This resort was beautiful, rooms were awesome, food was both exotic and simple and the scenery was better than I could've imagined. There are always activities to do on the beach and the service is very good. This place really is paradise, i highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Dean D
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go
reviews.text:
How can you go wrong when you get to the breath taking view upon arrival of the Paradisus Palma Real hotel? You can see through the beautiful and massive lobby area to the pool and beach beyond it. Spectacular, really.

My friends and I opted for the Royal Service, which has it's own lounge in which the guests are checked into. Here is where you are introduced to the property, as well as your butler for your stay.  We were lucky enough to be have been paired with Juan de Leon.  He was amazing to our small group.  The attention that he provided in helping us with reservations, sorting out an excursion, helping to plan a birthday surprise, and setting up some golf time was nothing less than professional, while also showing a personal investment in our happiness with our vacation.

All the staff that we dealt with were just as great, though.  Particularly on our first night, when the air conditioning went out for the whole property.  We were fortunate enough to be placed for the evening in the The Reserve property for the evening, which was not having the same issue.  Francesco, back at our Royal Service beach was wonderful enough to save us our same spot each day of our trip so that we didn't have to wander the beach looking for a place to settle.

The restaurants were also fantastic and provided such different dining experiences. During the day, we mostly stayed with the Palazzo, which is only available to Royal Service clients. This made our daytime meals peaceful and un-rushed.  Among the restaurants that we tried were Mizo, over at The Reserve, Passion, Blue Agave, Rare, and Vento.  

The room was large and beautiful, if a little dated.  My complaint was that the bathroom was fairly open to the rest of the room.  I'm sure it's fine for some couples, but when traveling with friends, it is very awkward to not have privacy.

The property itself is expansive and gorgeous. The sand on the beach is fantastically soft and wasn't too hot to walk on.  The temperature of the ocean and pools was perfect.  They weren't too cold or too warm, respectively.

By the end of our stay, we were all contemplating a return visit, which is rare for our group.

reviews.author: Grace M
reviews.title: Our first night had been a dream
reviews.text: We are in paradise.  We were upgraded the "the reserve" upon arrival.  Our personal concierge, Junior, has been exceptional.  He gave us a private tour of the property in a golf cart and arranged for our dinner at Vento on the Reserve side of the property.  Jessica, the hostess, greeted us gracefully.  Our server, Jose, gave excellent recommendations.  Our dinner was wonderful but the all-star of the evening was desert-chocolate soufflé! I'm in heaven!

reviews.author: arlesl2015
reviews.title: Wedding fun
reviews.text: Great place. Several excellent restaurants but that made it hard to choose. Wedding on the beach was  fantastic. Royal Service and butler was well worth the additional cost. One thing I liked was that I'm a heavier woman and thought I'd feel bad about body image but no. Women of every size, shape and age. Not a factor. No bad time at all! Loved it.

reviews.author: Bianca C
reviews.title: Famila marin
reviews.text: Muy lindo el lugar!!! Lo hemos pasado super bien!!! Muy recomendado ! Las estructuras, el servicio y las playas. Las actividades muy divertidas en especial las realizadas por Josias inirio , es imposible aburrirse.waaaaaoooooo me quiero quedar es fantastico sin duda vorvere

reviews.author: tatianajaramelo j
reviews.title: ideal vacaciones en familia
reviews.text:
es un hotel distinto a los visitados, su diferencia radica en el concepto de Family Concerge, que consiste en la asistencia que te otorga un mayor, quien se encarga de esos valiosos detalles (sorpresas para tus hijos, reserva de restorant y otros, con atención 24 / 7 para lo cual te hacen entrega de un celular..., lo cual hace mas fácil cualquier solución a un inconveniente que puedes tener. Mi experiencia fue muy grata y Diosmery, nos facilito todo!, sólo disfrutamos 
Además es una buena alternativa si vas en familia, con niños ..., pues tu habitación está muy cerca de la piscina de niños, y del Club donde ellos pueden asistir , pudiendo descansar cómoda y tranquilamente, junto a tu bebida favorita, que te ofrecen en tu reposera!!...

reviews.author: Marcelo F
reviews.title: Excelente resort, mas os vendedores do club meliá são muito chatos, não caiam nessa!
reviews.text:
Hotel espaçoso, super luxuoso, quartos confortáveis e gastronomia excepcional. Excelente local para viagem romântica, ou familiar, se o que se busca é relaxar em um ambiente confortável. 
No entanto, tentam a todo custo vender um contrato de time sharing que é uma VERDADEIRA FURADA!!! A rede Meliá deveria rever seus conceitos e prezar pelo respeito aos hóspedes, em vez de tentar empurrar uma FRIA que é o maldito club meliá.
Resumindo: O resort é excelente, luxuoso, com ótimo atendimento, funcionários bem treinados, limpeza impecável e comida excelentes, mas, se te convidarem para um café da manhã vip não aceitem, pois vão lhe tomar todo o dia tentando lhe vender uma arapuca caríssima e da qual você não conseguirá sair, a não ser entrando com uma ação judicial.

reviews.author: juanfranciscom541
reviews.title: Descanso Total
reviews.text: conseguimos descanasar, olvidarnos del ajetreo diario y disfrutar a tope en un gran ambiente,, fuimos recibidos de manera agradable, y atendidos de igual manera durante toda nuestra estancia, sólo una pega en cuanto al servicio en la cafetería, el personal un poco ausente

reviews.author: roopeshrajamani
reviews.title: Best vacation till date, will return
reviews.text: We were at the Reserve last month. We arrived past mid night and there were people at the front desk and to take us to our room. No delay at all. Stayed here for about 6 days and enjoyed every minute of it.Ms.Frances took good care of us and the kids. She made sure we had dinner reservations everyday.  The kids enjoyed her daily surprise especially the bubble bath in the jacuzzi. We went to the italian, Mexican, grill and MEditerranean restaurants. We repeated Italian especially for the Pizza. The chef making Pizza was very friendly with the kids too. Kids pool was great and even my one year old could stand and walk in it. not deep at all. we didnt spend much time at the beach. The water had weeds and couldnt get in.  Food at the buffet was good too. We ended up there for breakfast and lunch and also tried the buffet at the main hotel which had more variety. They have golf carts shuttling between hotels and even when it rains they have it properly covered and also have vans to shuttle. We dropped the kids at the kids zone couple of times and this is the first time ever for my one year old. She did pretty well. Our 3 year old didnt want to leave. Gisselle was very kind and engaged the kids with craft work. Samantha was great with the kids too. People all around took good care and whenever we wanted something, it got taken care. So as you can see the kids enjoyed the trip and happy kids make happy parents :). Best trip we ever had and We will be back for sure.

reviews.author: gcarlone
reviews.title: Vivi l'esperienza di essere un REALE
reviews.text:
Prenotando al Royal Service si potrà vivere un'esperienza fantastica.
E' già il secondo anno che ritorno in questa struttura.
In questa area esistono solo SUITE, tutte con Maggiordomo dedicato
AL ceckin danno in dotazione un cellualre per poterlo chiamare
Organizzare la cena, escursioni, il servizio in spiaggia, qualsiasi desiderio viene esaudito.
Questa ultima volta mi hanno assegnato CANDIDA, è stata davvero molto preziosa.
Davvero ogni esigenza ha saputo soddisfare, molto gentile e premurosa.
Se avete la possibilità di sceglierla chiedete di lei

reviews.author: Alberto C
reviews.title: Gracias
reviews.text: Gracias por tomarse el tiempo de respoder nuestros comentarios, es que resulta que cuando encontramos algo que nos parece bueno,creemos que debe conservarse y mejorar a partir de lo bueno que existe. Tal ves en este sentido algunas cosas pudieran mejorar, de acuerdo a sus posibilidades y acercarnos asi, a la plenitud. Esto es un legado cultural,logrado por ustedes y eso merece ser protegido. Muchas gracias.

reviews.author: juanlb
reviews.title: Actually a step above average
reviews.text:
The hotel facilities are nice, beautiful landscaping, plenty of space, good pools. The decor is unususal in certain areas, but overall mostly pleasant.

Service is inconsistent, ocassionally great but just as often mediocre.

The food options were very limited, out of the 5 options supposedly available for lunch, only the 2 buffets were open, both of which had very similar offerings. In the evenings there were several restaurant options, but the hotel seemed to make an effort to prevent you from dining where you wanted by requiring reservations, and severly limiting availability; all this while the hotel was mostly empty.

reviews.author: valentina c
reviews.title: Excelente!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Hola! El hotel me encanto, la infraestructura es increible! La atencion de todo el personal, la limpieza, las habitaciones, realmente todo!!!!! Tambien quiero destacar al equipo de animacion y deporte por su profesionalismo, energia en especial a Daniel Espinal, Anthony COntreras, Luis Florian, Favio MEna, RAinold TAmayo, Jordan Rosario!!  Josias Irino, JOse FErnandez. Dj  Henrry!!! Ellos dan una energia especial al hotel! Tambien agradecer la atencion de los garzones en Gaby club!!

reviews.author: Celeste P
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia!
reviews.text:
Personal muyy amable, muy buenas personas, excelentes especialmente  josias inirio(obama)y daniel ! me gusta mucho la interaccion del personal con los huespedes.
Muy buen ambiente en los shows, buena comida! Excelente lugar para pasar las vacaciones! Sin duda regresare.

reviews.author: draregina
reviews.title: Descanso e tranquilidade
reviews.text:
Hotel muito bom, cumpriu as expectativas! Atendentes simpáticos e prestativos, gastronomia diversificada de média qualidade, restaurantes a lá carte bons! 
Restaurantes Lá Passion experiência que valeu muito a pena. 
Passeios lindos com segurança!

reviews.author: abcrosby
reviews.title: The people make all the difference..
reviews.text: This was our honeymoon. We staying in a junior luxury suite. Our TV barely worked but the room was quite nice with a comfy bed for sound sleep. The master suite connected to our room had a screaming crying baby the entire 7-night stay. We assumed we would be put in a room according to the fact they knew it was our honeymoon. Also, be advised that if you are told that you will receive a $1300 in resort credits/vouchers, do not be deceived. The coupon books mostly consist of coupons for essentially 5-10% off purchases of certain dollar amounts (mostly $100.00 or more). Nonetheless, Wander Porquin must hold several different positions there, but every day we saw him he had a beaming smile and was extremely friendly and kind. Throughout our stay most of the staff was friendly, but he definitely stood out among the rest. If we were ever to come back, I think it would be based on the staff there. The hotel is beautiful but it is nothing without its workers. Thank you all for making it a better experience despite the accommodations pitfalls!

reviews.author: L6p2h
reviews.title: Good place for a family vacation
reviews.text: Our family of 4 traveled to this resort in July. The grounds are beautiful and well maintained. The staff was usually helpful however language barriers did exist.  Check in took along time due to our room not being ready. The rooms were nice and had good views. At first didn't have enough towels and had to constantly ask for towels.  The mini bar was empty on check in but filled a few hours later.  Kind of hit and miss on having it refilled.  The process for making reservations at the restaurants was very difficult and stressful. Supposedly if you purchase the "Royal" Package it's not a problem. We were only allowed to make one reservation at the time and wouldn't find out until 3 to 4 o'clock if we got the reservation for that night.  The food was good and they had quite a variety for picky eaters.  The entertainment shows were fair geared for young kids. The casino was very small and usually empty. The beach was very nice. The waiters didn't come around very often. Again if you got the royal package you were waited on much more..  The pools were great.  Overall a very good experience. I think they need to improve how they treat the guest that don't sign up for Royal Package. We have spent a lot of money coming to your resort and to see the big difference in treatment is concerning.

reviews.author: David P
reviews.title: O paraíso começa pelas pessoas...
reviews.text:
O atendimento é algo incrível, do inicio ao fim das férias tudo foi especial.
Uma referencia especial aos amigos que nos atenderam na piscina... Melvin Brizon (Chef Hydro Grill)  e ao Ranelly Polanco (camareiro)... Que foram demasiadamente gentis e hospitaleiros... Alem de uma comida fantástica (provem o camarão na chapa com limão...)

Deixamos esse lugar com a sensação de que voltaremos em breve!!

reviews.author: VAFamilyof5
reviews.title: Great trip to the DR
reviews.text: The Reserve is worth the extra cost.  We did not get the concierge room, but we really didn't need one.  The resort is beautiful and the grounds are meticulously maintained.  The Reserve is a little quieter and less crowded.  We did not mind being off the beach a little.  We had a 2-bedroom suite with a great view of the pool.  The staff was very friendly and service was good for the most part.  The food was excellent.  We did tire of the buffets for breakfast and lunch, but the al a carte restaurants served very good food.  Drinks were plentiful but light on alcohol.  The beach is great, especially the Reserve section. This is a fairly quiet resort with not a lot of party life, but it was great for our family.  We felt very safe.  Our kids roamed the property even at night.  We had a tremendous vacation.

reviews.author: Nicole A
reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text:
Tudo, tudo absolutamente perfeito comida divina , atendimento, serviço de quarto, a limpeza tudo esplendoroso.. Assim que chegar o bacana é já fazer as reservas dos jantares que podemos também
Desfrutar no The reserve que nossa tem os melhores pratos! NÃO
DEIXEM DE IR NO RESTAURANTE ACQUA QUE FICA NO THE RESERVE... Tive que fazer repeteco de tanto que gostei! 
Fui apenas com meus avós e me diverti muito porque tem os monitores não sei se é bem assim que o chamam....faziam das suas manhãs, tardes, noites as mais divertidas e gostosas possíveis e não posso deixar de citar ( Shaky-Shaky,Caramelo e o Minimi)  
O único probleminha que foi ao meu ver minúsculo, são
As algas nessa época do ano mais não impediu de eu entrar nenhum dia naquele mar maravilhoso.

reviews.author: Juliana Mendes
reviews.title: Lua de Mel em grande estilo!
reviews.text:
Passei lua de mel com meu esposo nesse hotel, em julho de 2015 e gostamos bastante! A estrutura do hotel é impressionante! Além de ser gigante, cada ambiente é mais bonito que o outro, você se sente num palácio a beira mar! O atendimento dos funcionários é espetacular!!!! Ao chegarmos, a Doralytz nos atendeu e nos deu um "up grade" no quarto quando soube que estávamos de lua de mel. O Emanuel foi nosso amigo durante a estadia, nos tratava sempre com muita educação e foi um querido! 
Quanto à comida, preciso falar que como brasileira senti muita falta de água de coco e de um bom suco de laranja (o suco de laranja deles parece cebion). Mas em compensação, os jantares eram maravilhosos! Reservamos cada noite em um restaurante diferente (passamos 6 noites lá) e gostei de TODOS! São impecáveis! E os eventos noturnos então nem se fala, muito bons! Olha que estávamos em clima de romance, mas mesmo assim não resistimos às festinhas na beira da praia que o hotel fornece. Eram bem animadas, pra quem quiser dá pra conhecer gente, beber e se divertir! Assistimos a uma apresentação de circo no hotel surpreendente também, muito legal!
Uma dica: compensa muito pagar um pouco a mais e ficar no The Reserve, pois tivemos uma piscina mais vazia, bem mais tranquila e especialmente o café da manhã era muito melhor para os hóspedes do The Reserve, muito menos cheio de gente e mais agradável. 
Em resumo, recomendo demais o hotel!!!! Tivemos uma experiência ótima e voltaria com certeza!

reviews.author: shayshay825
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: So far, this property is the best location that I visited in DR (approx. 6). It has the upscale, modernized look and feel that I prefer to have when I'm spending my hard earned cash to travel. There's one buffet area which is the best I've ever seen for an all-inclusive property there are lots of options. Although, it one location it was never overcrowded and did not lack service. You have to make reservations for a la carte by 9am. The pool area lacks a lot of shade but there are several huts on the beach which is steps away from the pool. The gym, the beach and hotel are very clean.

reviews.author: Marcelo R
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Un muy lindo hotel muy bien ambientado, la atención del personal excelente y comida de calidad. 
Personal muy bien calificado con atención personalizada al maximo y excelente preocupación.
Habitaciones confortables y espaciosas con todo lo necesario para unas excelentes vacaciones.

reviews.author: Sheila T
reviews.title: Best trip ever
reviews.text: Location perfect.  Hotel is top quality, beautifully designed, very well maintained with great attention to detail and truly 5 star service. The swim up master suite is absolutely a must splurge if you crave space and privacy. Norberto made sure We had all the reservations and tour arrangements we wanted. Food is wonderful, 5 days and never a bad meal thanks to my favorite waiters Felix and Estaban. Make sure to go see Annie in the salon for braids. Will definitely go back next year.

reviews.author: patrick e
reviews.title: Would never come back
reviews.text: Came here for a five day stay and wound up in the hospital immediately after returning to the U.S. Appendix had to come out swollen colon, 3 day stay.  The restaurants are terrible. The food is inedible. You actually have to ask yourself where can we eat? Not where should we eat. The safe in our room was broken so they upgraded us which was very nice. Our butler was great for dinner reservations but that's really all he did. The spa was very nice however very expensive for what you get. If you return to use the water spa they do not give you a locker the next day. Let me be specific we spent 1,000$ the day before and gave a 200$ tip and couldn't use a locker? Give me a break. Don't .. DO NOT go to passion this was was the worst dining experience I've ever had. The island is beautiful but the mounds of seaweed make the water unapproachable. Don't stay here, don't go to the DR. You could go to Aruba for the same price. Will never return.

reviews.author: Silvana H
reviews.title: Inolvidables vacaciones
reviews.text: Mi marido y yo hemos estado diez días y desde el primer momento hasta el último han sido maravillosos.El hotel es espectacular, grandioso con muchos atractivos, la zona de piscina preciosa, con acceso a la playa.Los restaurantes a cual más bonito, las zonas ajardinadas maravillosas. Nosotros estuvimos en una suite junior de lujo con jacuzzi , espaciosa y muy cerca de todas las zonas .La comida del buffet variada y de calidad ,en fin todos los detalles cuidados al límite,  pero sin duda lo mejor de todo es el personal que trabaja en el hotel en cualquiera de sus servicios, recepción, camareros super atentos , serviciales al máximo, agradables, educados , mencionar especialmente  a Antonio y a Gilberto  del bar de las piscina,personal de limpieza, personal que atiende los servicios de la piscina,pero  sobre todo quiero mencionar a los chicos de animación , Minimi, Caramelo, Angel, Shaky Shaky,Happy Face, Pamela, La Negra ... son lo más, buenísimos en todo lo que hacen, divertidos, simpatiquísimos, super cariñosos,  cualquier actividad que organizan es divertida y consiguen que la gente participe,y además bailan fenomenal , a mi me han enseñado bachata, merengue,salsa y sobre todo nos hemos reído muchísimo con ellos sobre todo con Mínimi y Caramelo, en definitiva  lo hemos pasado mucho mejor gracias a ellos.Volveremos.Hasta el año que viene.

reviews.author: anaclaudiacalvo
reviews.title: Melhor da vida!!!
reviews.text: QUE HOTEL!!! Só isso que posso dizer. Esse hotel é maravilhoso. Além da excelente comida, bebidas, quartos, vista, praia, etc, ele ainda tem os melhores atendentes que já tivemos na vida!!! TODOS os funcionários são felizes, sorridentes, simpáticos, atenciosos, etc. Só falta te carregar no colo. ESPETACULAR. Ficar no "the reserve" foi realmente uma experiência incrível, sem contar que o restaurante de uso exclusivo para os hóspedes de lá é o melhor da vida!!! Não vão se arrepender de ir nesse lugar!

reviews.author: paul0mel0
reviews.title: FABULASTICO,MAS???
reviews.text: Como digo no titulo a estadia no "The Reserve" foi simplesmente fabulosa e fantástica,a começar pelo cuidado tido com a família,passando pelas instalações,pela comida e a variedade e muito boa qualidade das mesmas.Tenho como menos positivo(mas não negativo) o facto de a animação ser, diria eu ,um pouco discreta.Quanto aos valores da estadia não são os mais baratos do mercado,mas com um pouco de sorte e talvez nas temporadas mais baixas os preços sejam mais agradáveis.Para terminar se puder optar pelo "The Reserve" em vez do "Paradisus" não hesite.Finalmente se puder escolher este hotel não hesite.

reviews.author: Fran R
reviews.title: A beautiful resort with a very attentive staff
reviews.text: First time staying at an all inclusive (July 7 - 14) with my husband and daughters (17 and 18 yrs). Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort was not only beautiful, but the service was excellent. Staff members were constantly cleaning and maintaining the grounds. All the employees greeted us each day and were very attentive to all of our requests. By the second day, staff at the Buffet had remembered how we liked our coffee/espresso, our preferred table in the center of seating area, and that my husband loved the mangos. Although a little predictable/repetitive, the buffet did have a large enough selection of items to choose from. Reservations at the restaurants had to be booked at the lobby days ahead, unfortunately the available time slots not always ideal (example: dinner at 9:30pm at Vento). Food is not gourmet, but presented very nicely and quite edible -- Rare (steakhouse) was very good. Bartenders in the main lobby and Gabi Beach were excellent. Maid service was consistent and we really enjoyed the nightly turn down and chocolates. Our mini bar was always stocked. Rooms are nice, clean and large, but bathroom is semi-private, which could be a problem if you are bathroom "shy".  We took advantage of the various activities (painting, cigar rolling, sushi demonstration, Zumba classes, dance lessons, kayak, water aerobics/cycling) hosted by the energetic Shaky-Shaky and his awesome entertainment crew, However, not much going on at this resort after the evening shows / beach party ends, unless you go outside of the resort to one of the clubs (recommend Coco Bongo). Pool is very nice and large. Beach was relaxing, but too much seaweed to be able to go into the water to swim which was probably ok since the locals wait at waters-edge trying to sell excursions / want you to go to their shops.Waiters will bring drinks / chips to the beach, but no food. Casino was very disappointing - too small, nobody went in, and it takes 3 people, 30 minutes and several signed documents just to get $25 in winnings. The guys at the excursion/tour desk are a little pushy (especially Victor). We worked with Led at the towel cabana -- he was a gentleman, punctual, available and very accommodating. The gym is very nice and well-equipped. They offer 24-hour room service which was a nice plus after coming back to hotel at 2am from disco.  OTHER: Found that being able to speak Spanish was a big plus, small tips went a long way in getting superior service, only need 5 - 6 days at this all-inclusive, upon arrival you will get royal treatment (complimentary upgrades, quick check in, reservations at the better restaurants) in hopes of scoring a time-share client, but once you say "no interest in time-share" you are on your own.

reviews.author: reteach36
reviews.title: Beautiful wedding site for family
reviews.text: The rooms were large and comfortable. The grounds were well maintained and the food was outstanding. We had 24 hr. room service and that was nice also. Although we didn't have small children with us, there were many children of all ages there. The pools were well maintained and clean. The wedding and reception was organized and beautiful. Although we were there in August, there was a nice breeze blowing and it was very comfortable. One negative was that there was much seaweed in the water near the beach and the drinks varied in quality from place to place. I would recommend this resort.

reviews.author: RaulOlvera
reviews.title: Excelente servicio, gente muy cordial, instalaciones de muy buena categoría y la comida acorde al lugar
reviews.text: Las habitaciones muy grandes y cuentan con todo para que la estancia sea de primera, cuenta con mayordomo y en la alberca no tienes que estar apartando los camastros ya que todo esta preparado para que tu estancia sea especial, las bebidas de buen nivel y gran variedad

reviews.author: Lilian617
reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text:
My fiance and I visited the resort as a possible location for our upcoming wedding. We took advantage of the "Love at First Site" which included meeting with the vendors as well as the Romance team. Our experience was great! We got a wonderful room upgrade which was perfect since we travelled with our infant son and my maid of honor. The room was large and airy and clean! We had a nice balcony as well as jacuzzi in the room which we did not use but it was nice to have the option. 

The staff was awesome and very accomodating! We had reservations at three restaurants but only took advatage of one since the schedule was a little tough with the baby. Unfortunately, we did not enjoy the food at Vento. Our waiter however was awesome! Unfortunately I don't remember his name but his last name was Lopez. He brought out various items for us to try but none were to our liking. My fiance is Dominican and being in the Dominican Republic would have liked to enjoy some authentic Dominican food. Mr. Lopez went the extra mile and arranged a special meal for us the next day. We were so excited and greatful for this wonderful gesture!

We travelled Monday through Wednesday so there wasn't much going on at the resort. The first night they had live music which was nice. The casino is more like a tiny room which was disappointing especially since my fiance is a HUGE poker fan/player. I would have liked to have seen more entertainment but again maybe the day of the week had something to do with it. 

The beach was nice but there was tons of seaweed. We made it to the beach later in the day and maybe it had been cleaned earlier in the day. I have read in other reviews that they rake the beach but I did not witness this. We have decided to have our wedding at this resort and I'm hoping the seaweed will not be any issue in our wedding pictures. 

To summarize, the hotel is great and the service is wonderful!!

reviews.author: mikanparu
reviews.title: 綺麗なリゾート
reviews.text:
ホテルの部屋は綺麗でプールに近く、快適。
ビーチは少し遠いが、カートが頻繁に通っているため不便することもない。
スタッフも皆フレンドリーで気持ちがいい。
しかし寝室の隣が風呂だからか、寝室の扉である透けガラス全面に水垢がたまりものすごく汚れていた。
そこが改善されればよりよくなると思う。

reviews.author: Fer V
reviews.title: Faz jus ao nome - Paraíso!
reviews.text: Resort de luxo com esquema all inclusive em praia caribenha de mar verde transparente. The Reserve é um mini resort de maior gabarito dentro do Paradisus Palma Real. Situado na praia de Bávaro, perde, como ponto de praia, para o Barcelo, onde achamos a praia mais bonita e mar idem, mas de resto tudo impressiona! A começar pelo elegante lobby, com atendimento exclusivo para os hóspedes após o check-in, com funcionários bem treinados passando um briefing das atividades do local, providenciando as reservas dos restaurantes e, é claro, tentando vender alguns passeios (não fizemos nenhum, por não nos interessar envolvimento com grupos maiores ou ajuntamento de pessoas, mas alugamos no canto da praia de Bávaro um barco particular, daqueles com fundo de vidro, por um preço bem módico). Fiz questão de reservar o quarto swim up, com saída direta para a piscina, o que fortemente aconselho. Espaçoso, completo, vale a diferença de preço. Minha esposa ponderou que, apesar dos excelentes quartos e espetacular estrutura do Reserve, contaria muito mais pontos ter um charmoso bangalô pé na areia. De fato, não entendemos o porque de não terem conseguido colocar o Reserve de frente para o mar ao invés de enfiado para dentro da enorme área do resort (e que ainda engloba um terceiro Meliá no complexo). Seria a perfeição! Todavia a distância não é grande, e a frequência dos carrinhos de transporte dos hóspedes é frenética. O serviço como um todo é pra lá de eficiente, na verdade há um exército de funcionários à disposição dos clientes, em alguns momentos até um tanto over. O paisagismo do enorme complexo é de cair o queixo, extremamente bem cuidado. A academia, pequena mas honesta, cumpre com o seu objetivo. Destaque para o spa IHY; já viajei muito e para lugares bem exclusivos, tanto no oriente quanto no ocidente, e esse certamente foi o spa mais bonito que já estive! A gastronomia dos buffets é muito boa e variada (prefira a do Reserve), mas os restaurantes me decepcionaram um tanto, sendo talvez o ponto fraco, para quem vai com expectativa alta. A oferta de bebidas é impecável - imagine tudo do bom e do melhor e acrescente mais um tanto ainda.. Enfim, voltaria mil vezes, um verdadeiro pedaço de paraíso no mar do Caribe.

reviews.author: Saurman
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: On June 27,2015 My wife and I took a four night Jet Blue vacation to The Paradisus Punta Cana. We chose Paradisus because we had another wonderful vacation at another Paradisus resort in Cancun Mexico. The food was great. We did have some problems with reservation at the restaurants but the problems were solved in an easy manor. I would like to give much deserved THANK YOU, THANK YOU to Ine's Ruiz and katia Marinees at the customer service desk for helping us with our transfer back to the airport, (No help from the rep "Dolly"  at Travel in Style) and to Amable Sugeivi on the front desk for adding to our wonderful time. These three ladies always greeted us with a smile and solved our problems. They just made our trip that much better. I hope I spelled their names correctly

reviews.author: Timpolicia
reviews.title: TIM policia
reviews.text:
Em visita ao hotel resort paradisus punta cana tivemos a oportunidade de conhecer pessoas muito alegres e muito atenciosas e que nos faziam sentir bem à vontade 
Assim só tenho que parabenizá-los principalmente os que trabalham no NORTH BAR excelentes profissionais que a cada visita a este lugar mais nos faziam sentir à vontade tais como: EDUARD CAMINERO, DANILO ROSANO, MIGUELINA,  nota 1000 esse pessoal

reviews.author: dynik
reviews.title: Elegant but weary
reviews.text: No, not happy.  The safe had to be replaced, we have a room in the back, the pools of water are stagnant and smell bad and the great restaurants are charging a premium above what we are paying which is high. Loved the buffet, the music was excellent but too repetiitive, and we are somewhat disappointed.  Staff is friendly..

reviews.author: Getaway72877
reviews.title: Maravillosa estadía!
reviews.text:
Estuvimos una semana en este encantador hotel, las instalaciones, la comida y la atención de su gente es impecable. Agradecemos especialmente a Elaine Rodríguez, que fue nuestra ayuda en todo momento, nos hizo sentir como en casa, pendiente de cada detalle. 
El personal muy atento y cariñoso con nuestro pequeño hijo. Diosmery y Sofía también lindas personas, dispuesta a brindar su ayuda. 
Recomiendo este hotel, fueron una hermosas vacaciones en familia.

reviews.author: Damián A
reviews.title: Excelente servicio y atención personalizada.
reviews.text:
Las instalaciones son excelentes, la comida de muy buena calidad y el personal muy atento, sobre todo Elaine Rodriguez, nuestra Family Consierge que estuvo siempre pendiente para que no nos falte nada en nuestra estadía.
Se destaca la limpieza general de todo el complejo y habitaciones. La comida es variada y el servicio de pedidos al cuarto funciona muy bien.

reviews.author: Gerald R
reviews.title: Best vacation ever 2 years in the row 2014-2015 and we are going back in nov. 2015
reviews.text:
We have been going there for 9 years but the last 2 years have been outstanding with very friendly staff. Many people made such a difference. Wanger at Vento, Juan de Dios outstanding manager. Dionisios Rodrigues that makes sure everything is OK. We will now go twice a year, 2 weeks in the springs and 2 weeks in the fall. It is officialy our second home. Restaurants are just outsatnding. we are wiyh Club Melia Vacation Club and loving it.
Let me summarise it this way. YOU HAVE FRIENDS AND YOU HAVE FAMILY... SOMETIMES FRIENDS BECOME FAMILY.

reviews.author: Fran A
reviews.title: Aniversario
reviews.text: Mi estadia en resort fue inorvidable. El servico fue excelente. El personal te recibe con mucha armonia y una sonrisa en todo mento. Elaidy y Jose Manuel fueron excelente brindadonos un servicio de check in. Despues Nicia hiso todo muy facil en facilitarnos lo necesario para mi desde reservaciones en restaurant, spa y otros objectos necesario. Y por ultimo Xiomara Vasquez siepre nos mantuvo nuestra avitacion con un abiente limpio y agradable, se esmero en la decoracion y todos los detalles en mi abitacion. En la salidad nos asistio Isabel con una amabilidad y nos asistio en todo lo necesario para el check out. Es un Resort que lo recomiendo a todas  persona desde , estadia familiar o romanse. Fue la mejor  experiencia que e tenido. Todo fue expectacular. Lo recomiendo mejor que otros Resort.

reviews.author: AnneGreg1
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort, great restaurants, and beautiful beach!
reviews.text: The Reserve Paradisus at Punta Cana is a large resort with three options: The Reserve, Family Concierge, and Royal Service. All are beautiful and the grounds are very well kept. The Royal Service is your adults only section with a butler. The Family concierge is the equivalent to Royal Service but for families. There are like 7 specailty resteraunts that are very good. The Grill-steakhouse, Bana-Japaneas hibachi, Vento-mediterranian (my favorite), Mole-Mexican (best margaritas), Aqua-Italian, and of course the buffets. The only area I could see any significant need for improvement would be their deserts...they were hit or miss...The Beach: The beach was beautiful and we'll kept. Yes, there was grass, but not so bad that you couldn't enjoy the beach.Overnight they would run tractors down the beach and rake it.  We were there 7 days and there was a constant breeze. At night the beach was absolutely beautiful! The beach had hammocks, cabanas, chairs, ect...We chose to go with Royal Service (adults only). With Royal Service we had our own sectioned off part of the beach, but could use all of the beach if we wanted. We also had our own pool with swim up bar, exclusive resteraunt (Lapa Lapa) overlooking the beach, and the Royal Service rooms are located on or closer to beach than The Reserve rooms. Our butler was Rafael V. And he was great! We wanted to go deep sea fishing and he made a call and was able to get us a trip for the next day with Blue Sky Fishing...excellent excursion btw! Also George at Royal Services was amazing...friendly staff!

reviews.author: cmcolonm
reviews.title: Excellent Place!!! Excellent People!!! Part II Premium Customer Service
reviews.text:
My second day at the Reserve...
Wake up around 8am and went to the gym for a 3 mile run. The treadmills are like new. Then to Gabi Club for a the breakfast buffet, Jose & a beautiful young lady called Yesica helped us.
From there to a walked to see the beautiful landscape they have all around the hotels.
We found Nicia in the lobby and ask us at what time we wanted to eat dinner. She RSVP us at Aqua. 
Went to the pool and have some drinks at the Swim Up Bar (ask for Jose de los Santos) and we were so relax I fell as sleep in a poolseat.

We went to Gabi's again to have lunch and for our surprise they did not have shrimps at the buffet... Simply asked the first employee we saw and, like magic, my wife had a dozen shrimps for her enjoyment. Me?, I'm a meat lover and they have all the good stuff.

Had to take a nap after that great lunch.

In the afternoon we went to Aqua ( italian dine) and neither of us wanted seafood so we asked the nice lady (didn't caught her name) for something that was not in the menu, and once again, like magic, we have our great pasta with chicken breast. 
From Aqua to Gabi Beach to watch a Fashion Show with beautiful local young girls and dancers too. Great time there!!!
And it's only Friday, the weekend is just starting!
Thanks Nicia, Jose, YESICA & Jose de los Santos.

reviews.author: Ron M
reviews.title: Family vacation of a lifetime at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana!
reviews.text: Our family had a wonderful week's stay at the Paradisus in Punta Cana! The property at the resort was incredible! Lots of flowers and scenery throughout every inch of the resort. The concierge staff at the Reserve were a huge help and really made our stay over the top enjoyable! A very special thanks to Estephania for all her hard work in planning our dinners and activities! The kindness and hard working effort she displayed was wonderful, we were all very grateful to have her help! Overall we had an amazing vacation and will definately return again sometime!

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: Overall, our vacation at Paradisus, Punta Cana was superb. The staff was great, the food was excellent and the resort itself was beautiful. The only thing that I thought was missing was music. I felt that the resort needed to play more cultural music throughout the day, especially at night. If you chose to vacation here you will love it. I also highly  recommend for you to ask for Edward Caminero Bello at the North Bar, and Alvin Martinez at Gabi beach bar!! Both these bartenders were superb! They both provided us with nothing but top notch service!

reviews.author: kgarcia9695
reviews.title: family vacation
reviews.text: the resort was real great, my room was amazing everything was great except for the weather. check in was a lilttle hected because we where a gorup of 20 front desk help us as fast as they could, we where treated with some coactail while we were waiting for our keys, bell person were on point and of course housekeeping were pleasent. mini bar person was really helpful. thanks to the staff my vaction was good

reviews.author: lady_bella
reviews.title: Lovely trip with review of kids club
reviews.text:
I truly do not have anything bad to say about this resort.This was the 4th time we have been to Punta cana, previously staying at Melia Caribe, Bavaro Beach palace and Dreams. This was definitely the nicest. Because we have 3 small children (ages 7, 4 and 2), we have to seek out a resort that has a kids club that accomodates children as young as ours. You will find most resorts only accept kids age 4 and up.

We had a 2 bedroom master suite on the 2nd floor (building 4200). I purposely brought just a light umbrella stroller for ease of getting around; no need to even fold it shut when taking the golf carts around the resort, the driver would just place it next to his seat.

House keeping was very good, they typically came before noon most days. There are seperate people that restock the fridge, just let them know what you like, they bring oreos, Lays potato chips and plantain chips every day too. They left us entire cases of water as well, so there was never a shortage.

The Reserve section has so many secluded Bali beds, this would be a fantastic place if you needed to breast feed or keep a napping child while you relaxed.

We got room service practically every morning, and was delivered in about 30 minutes. The coffee is very strong though, so be warned! Of course I am American and used to more of a breakfast blend :)

So the kids club has 2 rooms, both air conditioned: one for children ages 4 and younger and the other room is for kids aged 5 and up, where they do more out going activities like going to the pool. They are open from 9 a.m. till 7pm. They will serve lunch there between noon and 2pm, with snack served around 3-4pm. Because my 7 and 4 year old were not supposed to be in the same group, they allowed my sweet tempered 7 year old to stay in the younger class with her sisters.

 They did a craft most days, like painting a clay figure, and they had face painting on a few of the days too.They were very kind to my fussy 2 year old, but her diaper was quite wet on a few of the pick ups, so I am not sure if it was just my timing of arrival. But I am sure if you gave them a schedule of diaper changing, they would oblige.She also did not eat very well one of the days, so they asked me if there was anything special they could order for her. They ordered plain buttered pasta for her so that was reassuring that she was eating something while I was away.

We did hire 2 different daycare workers for baby sitting in the evening and were content with their care.

The kid's pool is perfect for new swimmers. Bring float rafts and such, most children had inner tubes or some sort of floatie, plus it give peace of mind if you have to turn your back for a second. We had brought life vest for my 4 year old and even forgot it by the pool once, and it was still left by the pool when we returned the next morning :)

The main pool at Paradisus is gorgeous. We went with our kids many times and there were also children there too. It felt like a very family friendly place.

Passions: I really hate to say this, but the food was not good at all. The service was impeccable, and the atmosphere lovely, but I did not realize the food was so , um, extreme, like liquified salad. I am from the NY area and grew up in New Orleans so I believe I know good food. Just be forewarned before booking, check the menu!

The only let down on our trip was that when booking, my travel agent told us that the "VIP" or family concierge package, was included when staying at the Reserve. We had previously stayed at the Melia Caribe with Royal Service and assumed we were getting the similar package, but that was not the case. It is $40 per person per day. So simply booking at the Reserve does not include it.
It was truly fine though, we were able to book our dinner reservations with no issues, and anytime we called for anything, we were able to get assistance.

I would also point out that despite this resort being so huge, the golf carts are pretty efficient. It seemed mid-day there would be some delay, but it was only a handful of times during the trip. Initially we felt pretty lost though, the map of the resort that is given at check in is quite small, and it took a few days to feel lilke you had a grasp of where everything was. 

Gift shop: as expected, was over priced, so be sure to bring everything you can think of! I usually buy my kids a small stuffed animal, but they cost $28 and $32 each! I told them I would them 4 Beanie baby stuffed animals when we got home for that price. I also brought snack bags of cheetos amd crackers for my kids, they seemed to only have pringles and nuts in the snack section. The airport is also quite high, $7 for a bag of cheetos! Obviously I know you are not going on vacation to eat snacks, but you know how it goes with young kids...

All  in all, the trip went perfectly, it was indeed so beautiful.  You will not regret coming here!

reviews.author: sheltricp2015
reviews.title: Memorable 25th Wedding Anniversary
reviews.text: I didn't really know what to expect but I believe they were exceeded. We went through Our Hilton Timeshare and booked through RCI  and we did the All Inclusive option which includes Food, Drinks and Activities. We upgraded to the Royal Service to get the Butler, private pool, private beach, and lounge with top shelf drinks...Well Worth It. All of the Melia resorts are in the same area, The Reserve, Paradisus Punta Cana ect. We were here for 7 days and we enjoyed every minute and I don't really have anything negative to say.. I went on a free Scuba Diving trip paid by the resort where they train you and take you out. I am Cert but I went with wife and some friends. The resort has free Wifi which covers the entire resort even on the beach. Parties at the bar every night and live shows. It has a shopping mall and the resort is beautiful the pictures on the website are real. Very safe environment and the resort is Family friendly and has a family concierge. Great vacation and a Very Memorable 25th Wedding Anniversary which is going to be hard to top for our 30th. If we did not own a Hilton Timeshare we would have bought here. The food was great maybe a little cold at times but still great. A Great Experience

reviews.author: Leo L
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones del año!!
reviews.text: Excelente estadia, la comida y el servicio de 5 estrellas sobre todo la atencion del personal Gabbi Club entre ellos Rosmery Acevedo, Yesica, Julio Reyes, Cristian, Andres, Juan Luis y Luigi el cocinero del desayuno y el almuerzo... a todos muchas gracias.

reviews.author: Joao O
reviews.title: Nunca mais
reviews.text:
Observem que não
 há respostas em relação ao ocorrido...simplesmente ignoram sendo complacentes com o ocorrido...reitero que não é uma resort confiável em relação a segurança....São 8 meses sem nenhuma resposta oficial...sem respeito aos  hóspedes.

reviews.author: cmcolon
reviews.title: Excellent place!!! Excellent people!!!
reviews.text:
Ask for Nicia!! 
Great time at the Vento Rest.. Jose, Christian & Jose said Hi!!!!
Best barttender Danilo 
We are here until monday... So far so good!!!!
Gaby Beach great oriental buffet and tonight maybe an international gala buffet.
Can't wait!!!

reviews.author: Randy T
reviews.title: Excellent service (Jose, Luis Bello y Yesica) But 1 thing
reviews.text: Vento Restaurant is great. The red tuna was good (order it medium). Other food good. All the food could use some more adventurous seasonings for a Mediterranean restaurant.  One thing that could improve is dessert.  The souffle was just ok and could be a little more moist. Please revisit your desserts to make it more memorable.   Thank you!

reviews.author: JorgeSoria33
reviews.title: Excelentes Vacaciones!!
reviews.text:
Pasamos unas excelentes vacaciones por nuestra Luna de Miel, el hotel impecable, el servicio de igual manera, un especial saludo para nuestro Concierge Mike! Nos recibió el primer dia, nos explico todo lo que tiene el hotel y nos agendo nuestras cenas, nos sorprendieron con nuestra habitación decorada con petalos, el jacuzzi con burbujas y champagne y frutas con chocolates para una noche inolvidable. Las personas de los bares igual excelentes y en especial a Ramón y Jose Luis de la playa de The Reserve!. 
La comida espectacular en los restaurantes y es bastante, así que a los que les gusta comer, sera buenísimo!
De seguro volveremos!

reviews.author: Michael B
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation
reviews.text:
What a great resort.  It was better than I imagined and my family loved it.  Everything was smooth from check in to the check out.  Numerous restaurants to choose from and our concierge Jose' Mateo was the best.  He gave us a great orientation and told us to call him with any requests.  We booked a family concierge room so they give you a cell phone.  Call if you need anything. Definitely the way to go, especially if you have children.  He would also find/call us everyday to make sure everything was ok.  Great personal service from the concierge from booking snorkeling trips to dinner reservations.  As a matter of fact all of our servers and helpers were great.  Domingo in the Gabbi restaurant was the best.  A smile every time we saw him and fantastic service. He would give us tips on what to do, tell us what was good at the resort. The gentlemen who stock our room asked what we would prefer in our fridge.  Juan Jose Rosa personally made sure we never ran out of El Presidente, Coke, or cookies. (To many cookies ;-)) He also popped for some Corrona's on the last night and brought wine.  I have to give a shout out to Chocolatte.  Definitely made the trip better and always with a smile.  The food at Fuego was the best, we ate there twice.  The buffet's were huge with a great selection.  Our trip was at the same time Tropical Storm Erika came through.  It caused a lot of seaweed to wash up on the shore.  No problem, we went to the pool everyday and took long walks on the beach.  The built in pool recliners are unique and the bar is never a more than a few steps away.  We took a snorkeling trip, the "shark adventure" and Visual Reef got us some amazing pictures. Swam with the sharks and stingrays.  Very enjoyable.   The golfing was complimentary and the course was in good shape, very nice layout.  The shows at night were better than I expected.  Caramelo, Jazzyboo, Shaky shaky, Happyface, and Pamela gave it their best. 
All in all it was a very memorable trip.  The entire staff was courteous and always helpful.  I strongly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Gisela A
reviews.title: Vacaciones excelentes
reviews.text: Hemos pasado una hermosa estadía ,las instalaciones muy buenas ,el personal excelente ,siempre con muy buena predisposición para todo ,uno pide algo y siempre recibe un si como respuesta ,estamos muy agradecidos por la atención en especial con Rosmery Acevedo ,Yesica ,Andres, luis bello y Luigi!!!

reviews.author: Albert P
reviews.title: "Heaven can Wait"
reviews.text:
My stay was for our God son's wedding.I cannot begin to explain the graciousness that was given to me and my party of 60+.....Starting from breakfast all through the day.... and beyond.This is,in my opinion...".HEAVEN"

There was not one time I had to ask for anything.The staff is extreamly responsive,polite,and more than happy to make your stay one of the finast in the Dominican Republic .My host Angela is one of the hardest working people I have ever come across in the hospitality business.She was as vibrant greeting you at the breakfast table as she was at dinner showing no fatigue what so ever.

She is blessed.

Stop looking around for a resort in Punta Cana....You have just arrived!!!

See you soon.

Albert J.Pascale

reviews.author: Ben S
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: We loved this place. It's in a beautiful location and the food was a cut above the food we've had at other all-inclusive resorts. The staff was warm and friendly (a special shout out to Gregorio!). One day of our vacation was rained out by Tropical Storm Erika, but the staff did such a great job of laying on extra entertainment that we didn't mind at all.

reviews.author: Sanaz Armstrong
reviews.title: Return to the wedding spot!
reviews.text:
We were married at this magical resort in Aug 2013 with near 60 guests.  We returned in Aug 2015 with our 1 year old son and the experience was magical both times. 
Masiel organised a perfect wedding in 2013. Francisco Ortiz instructed perfect work outs in 2015  Kenny de Jesus went out of his way to make my perfect champagne drink daily.  Abraham Torrez was the most pleasant server at the steak house rare. Gisel took excellent care of our son at the kids club. Hector set up our beach spot daily which really helped with the baby.

Everyone did a great job making our trip fun and special.

The location is stunning.  The food is 5 star. THE rooms are amazing  The staff are hard working and kind. They work up to 12 hour shifts up to 10 days and then get 3 days off.  Never the less they always aim to please with a smile on their face.

My one tip is that although tipping is included, it is a very kind gesture that will make your 5 star stay a 7 star trip.  Tip when you first arrive it is ver appreciated and well earned.  Trust me I HAVE STAYED AT THE ONLY 7 STAR hotel in the world the BURJ!

reviews.author: mpaula84
reviews.title: Best Resort
reviews.text: This resort was just beautiful. The Reserve part is a lot better than Paradisus so we stayed here most of the time. Beach was nice, my son was disappointed that he didn't find any sea shells :-). The food was better at the buffet by the beach, for dinner. The buffet at the Reserve has small variety but it's more select and better taste than the once by the beach.

reviews.author: gamers57980
reviews.title: Séjour et complexe exceptionnel
reviews.text:
Tout est parfait le complexe est superbe les chambres sont aux top, les restaurants ont un choix trés varié de nourriture avec bien sur la qualitée qui va avec.
Que dire de plus que c'était un séjour magnifique.

reviews.author: Lenin G
reviews.title: La mejor estadía!
reviews.text: Bueno la pase súper,la playa es súper linda y el personal es súper amables.  La comida es muy buena y las bebidas de primera pero lo que mas me gusto fue el encanto de los chicos de actividades tienen una súper energía especialmente francis medina(happy face)' josias inirio,Luis florian etc. Me encanto de verdad que recomiendo este resorts al 100%.

reviews.author: MJDC55
reviews.title: 3er año consecutivo y sigo enamorada de este Paraiso y su gente...
reviews.text: Nuevamente decidí pasar una semana de vacaciones por tercer año consecutivo en Paradisus Punta Cana del 17/08/2015 al 23/08/2015, mi decisión demasiado acertada gracias a lo bien que la pasamos, lo hermoso de las instalaciones, su limpieza, su energia, su diversión pero sobre todo la gente, no he visitado otro sitio donde me hayan tratado como una reina, que carisma tan especial caracteriza a todo el personal, te hacen sentir en tu casa, agradecemos muchísimo a todas las personas que de una u otra forma nos atendieron y nos hicieron la estadía inolvidable, Vianka, Hilario, Juan, Ramón Ramírez (Mi gente) y sobre todo a Junior (Junior Manuel Segura) quien se encargó de consentirnos hasta en los más mínimos detalles, fuera de serie la verdad, a todo el personal de Gabi Club nos brindaron una cena super especial con Yesica de la Cruz y Cesar Arreche, gracias a todos y nos veremos nuevamente se los aseguro!!!!

reviews.author: Yulia Y
reviews.title: Красиво и профессионально
reviews.text: Самый красивый отель в этой части пляжа Баваро. Огромная территория, похожая на ботанический сад. Красивый пляж и бассейн в части Paradisus, хотя и в обычной части отеля тоже красиво. Не все рестораны понравились, но с учетом их количества питание получается разноообразным.  В принципе нам все очень понравилось кроме спа центра. Это конечно очень индивидуально, но я лично не рекомендую. Воспоминания в целом самые положительные.

reviews.author: Lisa E
reviews.title: Never going there again!
reviews.text:
Would never recommend anyone go there. The service was the worst I've experienced. No such thing as 'service with a smile'. The staff are woeful, unpleasant.  They loved closing the bar early even when people were there drinking.  
Room service was a joke as I never got what I ordered, and sometimes it never even came!!
The beach was beautiful, however, a few days it was covered in seaweed and not cleared till the next day! 
They have a massive problem with mosquitoes, I wonder if they are treating the place enough?They gave us spray at the restaurant for them.
Last but not least, the food was AWFUL!!!!

reviews.author: Suzyqnaptown
reviews.title: Fell short in many ways
reviews.text:
This place was very good, but they have the potential to be much better. I had very high expectations since the other reviews were so high, but the first day and half were ROUGH. I traveled here in August on my honeymoon, using my mother-in-law's "points" from REI to book the all-inclusive trip. I had read that upon check-in, the staff strong arms you into a sales presentation, but we experienced NONE of that. We were very relieved! The check in process was relatively smooth. Our luggage was in our room when we arrived to our beautiful first-floor suite. The only issue I noticed was there was a dirty paper plate in one of the wet bar cupboards, leading me to assume the maids had not done such a great job cleaning our room before our arrival. It was a bit unnerving to find the last guests' trash in our honeymoon suite, but I digress. We were supposedly assigned a concierge who would make all of our dinner resos. You have to have reservations at all of the non buffet-style places, which nobody told us our first day. I strongly recommend to management to have an Orientation class/meeting upon check-in that explains all of this to the guests. It was frustrating and left me almost in tears the first couple of days. We just felt lost! This is a huge resort and they kind of throw you to the wolves if you don't ask for help. After going to a restaurant on the No-No list the first night, and feeling a bit confused we sought out our concierge named Jirimy. He said he would make our dinner reservations for us each night, trying to get us in a variety of places so we could try all of them during our 6 night stay. He made the dinner reservation for that evening, but we had to hunt him down on the rest of the days to get reservations. It seemed like he would automatically do this, but that was not the case. The food was mostly delicious, but as others have stated, you may want to take some Immodium as we were "sick" just about every day. I couldn't go on the Catamaran excursion one of the last days because of the diahhrea. And that could be from the water. Only drink BOTTLED WATER and NO ICE! I thought it was odd they didn't ever offer ice in the drinks, but now I get it. The water there is no bueno. 

The other huge concern that stifled our trip was the LACK OF service at the swim up bar at the pool at the Reserve. We brought $500 cash to spend on tipping, and we ALWAYS tipped. For the first few days, there was only one bartender at that bar and we would wait 20 minutes to get drinks. This is unacceptable. There was a sweet woman who worked there wearing a white outfit and a colored belt. I hailed her over and told her the bar service was way too slow. She said she would look into it.

The next few days as we became more accustomed to the staff and such, the service improved. We had our favorite bartenders and they were so much fun and treated us like royalty! There is a bartender that worked at the beach pool and sometimes at the beach bar, named Danger Fully. HE WAS THE BEST. Made us lots of great drinks...try the Danger Vacation, Danger Relax, Danger Blue, Danger White, etc etc LOL. He had a great personality and we pretty much followed him to whichever bar he was working because he was so fantastic. 

They arranged a special Honeymooners Dinner for us at the exclusive restaurant. It was 9 couples who were all on their honeymoon. The server walked up to our table with a bottle of sauvingnon blanc, which is my favorite wine. I had ordered a glass the day before at lunch and I think they made note...he smirked when I asked him "How did you know?" It was cute. 

We went on a dolphin excursion which was definitely a highlight of the trip. They have a station at the Reserve that sets up the excursions for you. You must swim with dolphins!

I have seen many complaints about having to take a trolly to the beach from the Reserve and that there were long wait times. We never waited longer than 5-10 minutes. It wasn't a problem for us. If you find that you are waiting longer than that, tell the concierge and he will make a call.

We ordered room service one night, and they never showed. We also requested more beer in our fridge and they stocked it a couple of times. That was great. The Presidente local beer was good.

Take bug spray, the mosquitoes are really bad there. This is not the resorts fault!!

I also recommend to management to note that the pool water is TOO HOT!!! When it's 90 degrees out and the water is 91, it's gross. We spoke to one of the employees who was on break about this and he made a comment about "too much pee" in the pool. That's what if felt like on certain days. Cool off that water somehow. It's not refreshing.

The only other issue I have, which I would like to be contacted by management, is were were supposed to receive a credit because we arrive a day later that we were supposed to. They took my credit card info and the credit was something like $260. It has now been almost 3 weeks and I have not received any credit.

I wanted to LOVE LOVE LOVE this place, but they fell short in many ways. When you pay for all-inclusive and it's your honeymoon, you want to feel pampered at every turn. At least we had each other and ended up having  a great trip, but I don't know if we would go back.

PS. The ocean water is not clear blue in the slightest. It's full of algae and brown. You have to travel to some other island areas to get that pacific blue experience. This is not the Resort's fault (they clean it up periodically, this is just the nature of the DR). But if you are expecting clean beaches with sparkling water, you won't see that off the resort's coast.

reviews.author: GABRIELA S
reviews.title: SU NOMBRE LO DICE TODO!
reviews.text:
LUNA DE MIEL HERMOSISIMA!

Fuimos de luna de miel del 02 al 07 de septiembre, nos encontramos con un paraíso en la tierra, el hotel hermoso, su personal mis felicitaciones eternas por tan buen servicio, nos hicieron sentir consentidos y mimados a cada paso. Un agradecimiento especial a Mickey Mike por su entusiasmo diario, en la playa a Ramon y Jose Luis por siempre estar atentos a nosotros, en todo el hotel y sus alrededores existe WIFI por doquier. Recomiendo este lugar mil veces! Espero visitarlos el próximo año. Saludos y mis agradecimientos eternos.

reviews.author: Giovanna C
reviews.title: Férias em família
reviews.text:
Acabo de voltar de Punta Cana, onde eu marido e filho de 2 anos ficamos por 7 dias. 
Tivemos umas experiência fantástica. O hotel faz jus ao nome Paradise, pra onde vc olha vê um lindo paisagismo, uma bela decoração e tudo sempre com muitos detalhes! 

Um lugar calmo, que por mais q acomode bastante gente parece q não está cheio pois o hotel é gigante!!!

O complexo é dividido em 3 áreas: Paradisus, The Reserve e Royal. O The Reserve é um upgrade, vc tem uma piscina separada que costuma sempre estar mais vazia, além de mais bonita, restaurantes exclusivos e o melhor é a estrutura da praia com camas e cabana de palha....! Vale a pena pesquisar sobre as diferenças e vale o preço a mais que se paga! 
O Royal é a área reservada só para adultos!

No The Reserve nós ficamos em uma parte que se chama Family Concierge. Eu super recomendo pois vc tem váaarias regalias e mimos, além de uma assistente que fica a sua disposição para oq precisar! Ela reserva seus restaurantes e resolve absolutamente tudo pra vc como ligar e reservar o transfer, conseguir um adaptador, etc....  As nossas foram as queridas Diosmary e Elaine que foram muito atenciosas e carinhosas! Tudo que precisamos durante a estadia foi resolvido prontamente! 

Em geral toda equipe nos recebeu com muito carinho, por onde meu filho passava escutava seu nome sendo chamado! Matteo ficou famoso e adorou isso rs..

A equipe do bar na praia incluindo Ramon, Luiz etc, sempre presentes e dispostos a atender nossos pedidos, com mta boa vontade e simpatia! Você não precisa nem levantar pra pegar uma bebida pois eles estão sempre passando por você e oferecendo!

Não poderia esquecer de mencionar sobre a Kidzone, que pra nossa alegria, fomos achando que só crianças a partir de 3 anos poderiam ficar sem os pais, e chegando lá descobrimos que poderia deixar nosso filho Matteo de 2 anos!! Então até na academia conseguimos ir!
A equipe da Kidzone também foi excelente, sempre atenciosos com cada criança, recebendo-os pelo nome, e com muito carinho e alegria!

A Comida também é muito boa! Estou voltando com alguns kilos a mais de lembrança!!!

Obs.: um ponto importante que aconteceu, foi que um dia esqueci meu celular e óculos de sol na mesa do restaurante e quando percebi depois que já estava no quarto, falei com a nossa assistente Elaine que ligou pro restaurante na mesma hora e pra minha alegria imediatamente um segurança veio até o quarto trazer! 

Os pontos que sugerimos para serem melhorados:
Tem muitas bicicletas pelo hotel para que vc se locomova, pois como é muito grande dependendo de onde estiver precisa pegar um carrinho para ir a praia, etc, 
Porém as vezes se perde muito tempo esperando por eles. Gostaríamos de ter usado as bicicletas mas elas não tem cadeirinha para transportar crianças pequenas, de 1...2 anos.

reviews.author: Andre J
