reviews.author: Kristie S
reviews.title: Amazing Destination Wedding during hurricane season
reviews.text:
Warning: This will be lengthy but informational for future brides who are looking to have their wedding at the Paradisus Palma Real.

We chose the Palma Real location over the Punta Cana resort as our travel agent stated it was a little grander and busier; however, we chose it over the Hard Rock as it wasn't as big and not as busy!

Planning began immediately through our USA coordinator, Jinayada.  She handled all questions and fee transactions regarding the wedding packages, catering/food, photography, DJ, and decor.   All vendors are given to you and communication is handled by email which was so simple.  I never had any issues with getting a prompt response.  We chose the Chill Out Chic package, because it was a package that included all the basics we needed-ceremony, chairs, linens, tables, 3 hour reception.  We opted out of a package for a cocktail hour, because our travel agent got the resort to provide a private cocktail hour the day before the wedding which we used as a welcome party, and quite honestly, our guests enjoyed the lobby bar in between our ceremony and reception. I also brought a few decorations of my own that really made the COC package look very elaborate, and you have the option to upgrade or change much of the decor of this package which can actually be cheaper than choosing a large package.  We also extended the DJ and the reception by one extra hour for a 4 hour reception.
The decor company, Caribbean Celebrations do a great job recreating anything you ask.  I used a lot of pictures from Pinterest and the decor company gave me a quote on everything before I confirmed.

About a 45 days prior to the wedding we were then set up in communication with our onsite Romance coordinator.  By this time, much of the planning was done, so not much communication by email was needed during this time.  I was to meet the Romance team, DJ, photographer, and decor team a couple of days prior to the event.  

We were greeted with champagne and roses by our shuttle driver to the resort.  Upon arriving to the resort, we were greeted by a member of the Romance department who took us to the check in desk to make sure we were accommodated immediately.  They had already made reservations for our us and the amount of our guests that were also coming in that day to two of the restaurants that night.  The view of the lobby is amazing. Everything is very open and the lobby overlooks the pool and the beach.

We were then escorted to our suite which we were upgraded to without fee.  They offered the Royal Service but we declined as we knew were wouldn't be spending much time in our room or with need of a butler. The suite was huge with a full kitchen, full living room, and large bathroom with a separate room with a large bathtub connected to our bedroom.  This worked perfectly during the day of the wedding, as I had the photographers and my wedding party and family come take pictures prior to the ceremony here. Immediately room service came in with complimentary champagne and a fruit platter.

The resort itself is very nice.  Our guests spent much of their time on the beach or at the pool by the pool swim up bar.  We did sign up for one group excursion, a catamaran trip through Hispanola Punta Cana adventures; however, the weather was very rainy that day, so Fernando the owner refunded us immediately.  We did do a smaller group excursion with speed boats and snorkeling which was cheaper than the catamaran, but not as long of an excursion.

Wedding day was a breeze. My wedding coordinator onsite, Natalia, was awesome! She tended to every need.  i had met with her, the DJ, photographer and decor team 2 days prior to the wedding to confirm everything.  I handed off all the decorations I brought with me, and Natalia made sure she took notes on how I wanted everything to look-which it looked exactly the way I had asked. I had my hair and make up as well as the moms and bridesmaids done at the salon which is actually located at the sister resort, The Reserve.  They did a great job with hair and make up. Definitely plan for longer than you anticipate as we were almost late for our pictures. Hurricane Danny (turned into tropical storm) didn't bother us during our stay, but Hurricane Erika (turned into tropical storm as well) had led to the prediction of a high chance of rain that night. At the time, our ceremony was in the garden, BESIDE the garden gazebo (we didn't use the gazebo for the ceremony because the chair placement was very odd), and our reception was scheduled to be on the Olympic terrace outside.  Natalia came to me about 6 hours before and offered to move the reception into an inside venue.  She showed me one of the ballrooms which was very nice, and also upgraded our bistro lights to LED lights throughout the room and provided a dance floor!  The ballroom actually worked better for our guests because of the heat and because of the rain that did come.  

The staff during the reception was awesome.  They were on the dance floor handing people refills on their drinks.  The DJ played every song we requested.  The MC was awesome too.  The food was great and PLENTIFUL.  And our wedding cake was designed exactly the way I asked and tasted amazing.  We kept the 2 tiered cake included in the package which was made to fit the size of our party.  Everything went without a hitch, and Natalia stayed throughout the entire time to make sure I had everything I needed.  At the end of the ceremony, she packed up all the decor I had brought and made sure they were given back to me the following day.  Our photographers with Tropic One Studio were also great! We received about 500 pictures for a period of 5 hours including some of the bride/groom pre ceremony and bride/groom after ceremony pictures which were amazing.  
Make sure you tip the wait staff, DJ, and wedding staff-they truly deserve it!

reviews.author: Miguel M
reviews.title: Terrible Service....
reviews.text: I recently visited this resort from September 4 thru September 7, 2015. The resort is in fact beautiful and very clean I must say. However, my experience and guests experience upon arrival to departure was terrible. My guests which were a party of 13 people including myself and two children were treated really poorly. I decided to stay at this resort because me and another guest visited The Level at Melia this past May 2015 also located in Punta Cana which are in deed affiliated to Paradisus The Reserve. We expected that if we go further in category the service would be just as good or will surpass our expectations, but that was not the case. I must state however that the service at The Level at Melia was extremely beyond my expectations and staff was amazing. We were treated as top priority in all areas of the resort. Many staff members even became our friends throughout the stay, they would greet us by our names and immediately asked how they can be of assistance. Furthermore, the staff at this resort would guide us so that we can get to were we need to timely when in need. Also the staff members would periodically give us updates on what events are going on that specific day and also throughout the stay approached us warmly and friendly and to top it off they welcomed themselves with our preferred cocktails many times. This is just some of the many beautiful and memorable things that took place at The Level at Melia. On the other hand, The Reserve at Paradisus really let me down with the service and attention they poorly provided to my party of 13 people. I never met the family concierge who was assigned to each of our rooms (total of 4) one of the rooms had a damaged phone which didn't get repaired. In one instance I called to inquire about another restaurant other than the Gabi Club to go have breakfast to and the staff member advised us of one called Nao, upon arrival we asked one of the staff members we saw around and they told us that the restaurant is currently under construction. Think about it trying to coordinate with 13 people how hard it is to know were to go have breakfast now... Instead of the staff member being more proactive when we inquired and be more respectful to us and our time they instead gave us inaccurate information. Another similar case in which we experienced from a staff member was lack of knowledge and providing accurate information to one of my guests. My guest wanted to take professional pictures which were offered at the resort, my guest inquired and the staff member advised that she will need to be there no later than 5pm. Finally after everyone spent time getting dressed and transporting to another area of the resort were these pictures are taken the staff member at the desk asked my guest if we did a reservation. Here is the problem we were never given that information the only thing that was given to us as information was we needed to be there no later than 5pm. So with this said the staff members at this resort are very careless and not in no way considering the time and efforts being put from its guests. A lot of our time was wasted because of carelessness and misinformation. Furthermore, in the common areas and pool area (including swim up bar) there was no waiter in sight, I only interacted with one waiter who I would see every 45 to an hour, and at the swim up bar not one sole in sight. Beach area was nice, however same thing here no waiters, maybe one person who was nice every 45 minutes to an hour. All of us would ask one an other what is going on.... We did notice that the resort was not fully occupied and with that said you would think the staff would be just as much available but sadly that was not the case. Also I was confused and concerned throughout my stay when many times we were questioned by staff members if we are guests who are attending a wedding...When they asked me that I kind of said to myself is this why no one is around?? Another incident all of us had was at breakfast time one morning were we had found a table for all 13 of us but time kept passing by and not one of the many waiters there approached us for water and coffee. I had to approach someone and point out we need water and coffee, even with me pointing it out he still took long to get us started. I was so upset already and embarrassed with all of my guests whom I invited to experience a memorable and loving experience, this turned out to be the worst choice I have ever made. Another incident we experienced was during the beach party once again not one waiter in sight for cocktails, and what had me and all of guests shocked was they had a drag queen doing a show. Nevertheless, after the poor beach party we were told at sometime of a club we can attend since the beach party was not very appealing or fun to us. When we went to the club it was completely empty and again a staff member there said they were closed that night. More and more time wasted!  Another incident we had was we reported that the baby crib given was damaged and never got replaced or repaired. I finally went to the front desk and reported all of this and with that said I was really stressed because I just couldn't find a way to explain or correct and even go around and explain otherwise to my guests of what is going on.... The staff at the front desk were understanding including the assistant manager I believe. Sadly it was my last night. With that said I came back home with nothing good to say other than I am completely embarrassed and speechless with regards to the horrific treatment and extremely poor staff who made my guests and my experience unsatisfactory. I do want to however take a moment and thank the following staff member who on my last night there made it a bit better, Juan [--], Andres [--], Jana [--] at Gabi club for our last dinner thank you for your kindess and making yourself available throught our last dinner. I know that I will never stay at this resort ever again. Sad but I had to vent because I spent a lot of money on this horrible vacation and in turn all I got was a lot of time wasted and poor customer service.

reviews.author: wenceslaop90
reviews.title: SI EL PARAISO EXISTE DEBE SER COMO LA RESERVE DEL  PARADISUS PUNTA CANA

Estuve  alojado en la Reserve del Paradisus Punta Cana desde el 1ro hasta el 8 de Septiembre de 2015, la experiencia fue espectacular, Considero que ha sido el dinero mejor gastado, ya que recibes muchisimo mas de lo gastao. reviews.author: kristing70287
reviews.title: amazing time amazing resort
reviews.text: i have to say before coming here i read the reviews and there were some bad ones. me and my fiance reaad them again while on the trip and couldnt believe how untrue they were. we are from brooklyn we are italian and an overly spoiled culture as is. any all inclusive trip i have ever gone on prior to this the food sucked along with the service and the watered down liquor. this is not the case at this resort. food is good liquor is def not watered down. the beaches and pools are truely paradise. it is beautiful and so clean. we kept commenting on how not once did i see the slightest bit of garbage anywhere not once nothing! super clean and we are super picky. we got assigned a private concierge Dianna and words can not express how grateful we are to her! she was the best such a sweet girl so helpful. my boyfriend asked me to marry him on this vaca she helped him plan it get a photographer she decorated our room without us even knowing she taped balloons to the ceiling rose pedals candles everything. she is at your every beckon call and really helped him tremendously. she drove us around anywhere on the golf cart we needed to be. i still can not thank her enough! paradisus palma real really has a great employee and she should be recognized for how wonderful she really is! we can not put into words how beautiful this trip was and how beautiful the resort is. thank you to the hotel staff and esp to dianna. we will always remember you for being there for us on our special day and week!!! we will def be back!! love kristin and nick maring!! xoxoxo

reviews.author: Sheila W
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
My family and I spent 2 weeks at the reserve at paradissus punta Cana. Let me start by saying that the reserve is beautiful, well maintained with lots of restaurants with decent food. The beach is just gorgeous, they did a good job of managing the sea weed issues. Ramon at the beach was good, David the spin instructor at the gym was terrific!
On the negative side, customer service was appalling to say the least. I have been to many resorts and have never experienced anything like this. I would go as far as to say that the customer service experience was on the verge of being rude. We learnt pretty quick that to get reasonable service you had to tip beforehand rather than after the service as is customary. The mini bar was never restocked, I filled out the form asking to restock the mini bar I called requesting water and the response I got was " I will see what I can do" needless to say the water did not show up. My husband did not find the bed comfortable and the sound the ceiling fan made kept him awake. Room service was extremely slow and it was a challenge to get them to answer the phone. My nephews would place their breakfast orders and sometimes the food would not show up and then when we would call to find out what the delay was we were met with a disgruntled response that the order was never placed basically calling us liars!! The Mj show was really good but the bars were very dull , a couple of times they would shut early regardless of the number of people there it was really bad. I could go on and on but as for me and my family we would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Redbudian
reviews.title: Follow-up review from a second stay
reviews.text: We originally gave this hotel high marks due to the great stay we had a few years back.  However, when we returned we noticed a huge difference from our first stay.  First of all, the property was not maintained well.  Our room had many things that were out of order, crumbling or missing.  Secondly, the hotel also seemed to be  less clean.  Not only from lack of cleaning, but the wait staff didn't seem to care (or know) about proper hygiene or sanitary practices.  Flies covered the food on the buffet, food was left out too long (e.g. raw sushi grade fish that was unrefrigerated and the guy who plunged your toilet could be seen behind the buffet within minutes of his service visit.  Next, the "vibe" of the hotel has changed.  We watched a European tourist passed out on the couch after what I am assuming is a rough night out.  No one checked on the man, no one escorted him to his room - he just stayed there sleeping (passed out) as we ate our meal.  What seemed like a great family resort has gravitated towards the party crowd, which had to be hard to watch for those with young children.  Many of the people in our large group (300+ who were there for a short business trip turned vacation) left with enteritis and other intestinal issues. We had a few who were hospitalized due to dehydration.  Not sure if the water filtration was working or if it was due to the lack of cleanliness (I suspect it was a combination).  The hotel would not acknowledge any issues and told us we must have arrived sick.  Seeing the number of people in our group, who traveled from all over the U.S. and Canada, I'd say that is highly unlikely.  Bottom line: we will never set foot on this property again.

reviews.author: Jubin J
reviews.title: "Fantastic Vacation Resort and Excellent Family Concierge Service"
reviews.text:
My family and I spent the first week of September at the magnificent "Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana" this year  (2015) and today is our last day at this beautiful resort. And yes it's really hard to let go...
First of all I shall give credit to trip advisor for the genuine reviews as before booking our vacation thru Westjet Vacations i read the reviews of different resorts and I came to conclusion that Paradisus was the right resort for us. People who had left the reviews had highly recommended the Reserve part of this resort and being a good listener, we followed their recommendation and found it absolutely right with only one difference that we upgraded that even to a higher tier, The Family Concierge service.
I shall say that our first experience in Punta Cana was not that good as we were ripped-off at the Punta Cana Airport by "Globo Cambio Foregn Exchange Services" located in the Arrivals hall. I knew that the exchange rate should be around 45DOP a CAD however the agent told my wife that they were offering the best rate in town and hotel's rates would be 20% less than theirs and guess what? It was exactly the other way round as our hotel was offering 44DOP a CAD while the airport sold it to us at 38.2DOP a CAD. So my 5 cents for you: Do not change our money at the airport at all.
After that everything went pretty smooth as our Westjet representatives were expecting us in a very organized way. They dropped us at the Reserve lobby from where we were warmly welcomed by the Paradisus Guest services staff. What a pleasant feeling it was that we had made the right choice for the hotel.
In about 15mins we were introduced to our Family Concierge "Elaine" where she warmly welcomed us and made our journey to Punta Cana worth our while for every single moment as she made reservations for the dinner at different restaurants of our choice, organized and made reservations for our activities such as Tennis, snorkelling and Catamaran which were all complementary of the Resort for the Family Concierge or may be even the Reserve guests. 
One credit that I should give to the Paradisus, Melia Club, management is that their resort is so organized and safe with most friendly and accommodating staff. On different days and occasions we lost things such as sun glasses etc. but either the staff would find us and deliver them to us or as we went to the security they would search their "lost and founds" and give it back to us with a description of where it was found, who had found it and at what time. Isn't that great? Oh man this resort is really safe! Thanks to Ramon Ramirez and Benita Mercedes who had found and delivered my sun glasses at the Reserve Beach!
We were also approached by the Melia Club for a presentation for the Melia Club membership. It was rather long and my daughter and wife lost their patience but in exchange the Melia Club has given us 20,000 Melia Points that is supposed to be transferred to my my Melia account after I check out today. I will sure write a review when it's done to inform whether it was delivered or not. We did not find Melia membership right fit for us for now, may be in a year or so after we have checked a couple of their other resort destinations. BTW you must check their website as they have a huge network of top notch hotels throughout the world. We are planning on trying the CanCun next year. Also the Melia Club complimented our last night's dinner with a fine bottle of wine from their wine cellar. Thank you!
During our stay we went on a Buggy Tour organized by HOLA tours offered by Westjet. We also went golfing at the other magnificent Pardisus Palma Real Golf course with 3 beautiful 9 holes courses. It was really worth it.
All and all it was a great trip, magnificent resort and superb Family Concierge Service which is highly recommended. If you are going to any resorts in the world, check for Paradisus or Melia and if you find one in that location, go for it as you won't go wrong.

reviews.author: Brian C
reviews.title: Unbelievable experience
reviews.text: My family and I had the luxury of visiting The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and stayed in a Family Concierge suite. We were greeted warmly by an extremely friendly staff. The  grounds were impeccable and the suite was more than I could have imagined. Our Family Concierge,  Elaine Rodriguez catered to our every need and anticipated our wants. She was extremely helpful,  friendly and service oriented.  I am sure we would have enjoyed the vacation in a regular suite, but Elaine made the trip that much more enjoyable.  She is a class act and a consummate professional.  This has been an unbelievable experience and I am looking forward to scheduling my next trip to The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Joanne C
reviews.title: The Best Experience Ever
reviews.text: Today is our last day at the resort and we do not want to leave. This was the best vacation ever. We had a family concierge room that was big enough to accommodate my family of4. We had our own personal concierge and Elaine Rodriguez was the absolutely the best person. Her attention to detail made the trip that much better. She made sure that daily we had a cabana at the pool/ beach, that my girls were sent when they stayed at the kids zone. It so much more but I would be writing a book.  This hotel is great for families,  couples and singles. There is something for everyone.

reviews.author: Thomas-Bx
reviews.title: Was just ok
reviews.text: Staff excellent, property excellent. We encountered a few in room hicups which we informed the staff about but it continued every day for the remainder of our stay. Other than that, great hotel and great staff. A big thank you to Sofia. Even though she was not our concierge she wa always courteous and willing to help. Yarol, Ovidio, Geremis, Luis Vasquez from Gabi Club and huge shout out to Alexander (Alex) from Gabi Beach, this guy is amazing.

reviews.author: liza_ny_city
reviews.title: Magnificent Trip
reviews.text: Wonderful trip to Paradisus Palma Real the property is beautiful, the Punta Cana Beach is breath taking and the all the staff is extremely professional and sweet, a young man by the name of Fernando Geronimo was especially accommodating when you order in-room dining service, he will bring you a 5 star meal to the suite, where you can eat on the balcony in a tropical paradise.

reviews.author: Antonio D
reviews.title: Epectativas se quedan en el camino
reviews.text:
Error en la Reserva, la hice 3 meses antes y ni siquiera sé quien tiene la culpa, posiblemente mía. No la comprobé hasta que me entregaron el formulario en el avión de inmigración.
Solicité el cambio y el Jefe de Recepción D. Silvio Lantigua, me mintió diciendo que el Hotel The Reserve Palma Real estaba lleno. Y resulta que estaba vacío. Hasta cerraron el Gabi Club en The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real por las noches por no haber gente. 
Por lo demás todo bien.
Aclarar a la dirección de TripAdvisor, que me han borrado este comentario argumentando lo siguiente:
"Aunque sin duda agradecemos tu contribución, ha llegado a nuestra atención que tu opinión incluye puntuaciones de características del establecimiento que no llegaste a probar durante esta visita, como por ejemplo la calidad del sueño cuando no pasaste allí la noche, o la calidad de la comida, cuando no llegaste a probarla. Siguiendo nuestra política, hemos eliminado tu opinión al descubrir esta inconsistencia".

Precisamente he calificado de magnífica la calidad del sueño, ya que estuve 3 días de los 10 de mis vacaciones viviendo en The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana y los otros 7 conseguí el cambio en Servicio real y con el Club Melia a The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real.
Por lo tanto he dormido y comido, no como dicen como excusa para borrar una crítica que ni he dormido ni comido en este lugar.
Si hay un sitio donde se publican experiencias, hay que aguantar las buenas y las malas. Dichas por supuesto con educación y veracidad.
Si me llegan a borrar esta opinión de nuevo, no me quedará otra opción que publicar en todos los foros la política de TripAdvisor, que ya se está cuestionando de favorecer a algunos establecimientos en perjuicio de otros.
Un saludo

reviews.author: GM-HSD
reviews.title: Simply outstanding!
reviews.text:
This is by far the best of the upscale all inclusive properties in the area of Bavaro. The hotel offers excellent and very ample  public areas, a very large central swimming pool and sits on the spectacular Bavaro Beach for beachwalking lovers.
Food is superb in all outlets, but Passion is a must for gourmets for a very reasonable price account taken of the exquisite taste of the food and the wide wine selection (at extra charge).Food in the buffet is very varied and tasty, and evening themes are a lot of fun. 
If you would rather go for a more intimate experience, Royal Service is an excellent option with a separate, dedicated check in, a private butler who will take care of all your reservations during your stay and a dedicated area both in the beach,  pool and bar.
But the definite plus of the hotel is the staff. Thank you Fernanda, Wanda and Francisco and our apologies to those whose names we do not remember.

reviews.author: MissyS4
reviews.title: HORRIBLE!!! Don't waste your money here!
reviews.text: We just showed up and we had been to the Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen. The rooms were beautiful well we get here and the room is so gross. It's old, dingy & smells of must, NOTHING like the Playa deal Carmen! I called he manager and he was rude and of course no help. I'm so irritated I will NEVER EVER stay here again. I wouldn't waste your money. They also convinced us to stay longer and we would get $500 credit to use towards excursion and the spa. Well of course that was a lie and you can only use the money towards what they say. It's a scam and they are rude! I will not be back and I would not recommend it

reviews.author: Suzanne D
reviews.title: 4 day getaway
reviews.text:
Wonderful elegant resort.
Service amazing-activity director Shaky Shaky or Osvald was so friendly!
Antonio server in the buffet could not have been kinder.
The palapas around the pool are so comfortable.  Normally do Adults only but the children here did not interfer with a romantic time!  Air conditioning was amazing --lots of hot water.  Maid service exceptional.  Location was great as only about 20 minutes from airport so once you arrive it is not long before you can be in the pool.

reviews.author: Susan W
reviews.title: Middle of the Road
reviews.text: Spent 7 days at this resort.  Though very beautiful,  it sits on the rough Atlantic Ocean with mass amounts of seaweed...not what one is expecting traveling to "paradise!" The resort is an "armband resort." This ment that everyone didn't have access to all pools, quality liquor, and restaurants. This idea doesn't sit well with me.  Too much money was spent to feel like an outcast. The service was hit or miss.  I am blaming the lack of minimal service on upper management.  These people are willing to help just not properly trained.

reviews.author: Angela A
reviews.title: Our second trip exceeded our expectations!
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic and again it exceeded our expectations! This time we spent a full week and still did not want to leave! One of the managers, Domingo Beltre represents the resort in the most professional way. Thank you Senor Beltre!
During this trip, we took advantage of the Royal Service which was awesome! We definitely recommend this option! Our personal butler, Ariel Benzo could not have been more attentive to our needs. Several times during the day Sr. Benzo checked to ensure that our dinner reservations were taken care of, daily in room snacks delivered and nightly pillows with aromatherapy and bubble baths drawn! The resort provided us a cell phone to use in case we wanted to reach Sr. Benzo. Every morning, Francisco Gil, (in our opinion, the best beach server at the resort) ensured that we had a “bali bed” reserved and delivered drinks just in time! 
The resort offers spa treatments which are fabulous! I had two separate massages and a facial by Aracel Columna at the Oriental Gardens. The services are in gorgeous, peaceful outside huts and are incredibly relaxing. Senora Columna has magic hands and delivered one of the best massages I have ever experienced!
The Paradisus is an incredibly beautiful, immaculate and relaxing resort. The restaurants are top notch and the workers are friendly and so very accommodating. One of the waiters at the Palazzo, Richard (I can't recall his last name) was wonderful and we kept going back for his service!
 You won’t go wrong selecting this resort for a vacation! We plan on returning and bringing our 5 adult sons next time as we are certain they will enjoy the resort as well!

reviews.author: Lex M
reviews.title: Great all inclusive
reviews.text: We visited Palma Real in April for a week for a wedding.  Beautiful setting and plenty of activities on offer, the staff were very attentive and the food was great.  Amazing pools and well worth a visit to the Reserve for the day, would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: SouthernGurl02
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real is paradise
reviews.text:
Just spent 4 days at this resort in a Royal Service Ocean front room - like being in paradise! Great service, beautiful accommodations (room 6110, above the Gabi Beach Club), lovely beach, fantastic food, and more! You never have to leave the resort. Huge resort, but not many ocean front rooms - definitely worth the extra price for the view. Would definitely stay here again when in the DR. Special thanks to our butler Jueri - who anticipated our every need!
PROS: 
-great restaurants, note: you need dinner reservations for most restaurant, except NAOS. But NAOS was my favorite, with great breakfast, lunch, and dinner selections throughout the day (great fresh fish, pizza, pasta, breads, sushi, etc. Although it is a buffet, the food is presented in small dishes and refreshed frequently, also lots of grill stations to prepare food while you wait (if you choose), and lots of servers.
-great bartenders and drinks - Gerinaldo Ubiero makes the best strawberry coladas!
-great service and people - everyone has a smile and willing to assist
-great facilities, very clean and well kept (note: renovated rooms are above the Gabi Beach Club)
-lovely pools and beach. very large pool and a few smaller ones
-great nightly entertainment (DJ at Gabi Beach Club, Musical & dance shows at the theatre)
CONS:
-the water pressure in the shower was a little low and hot water may not be available after midnight 
-Not sure if the resort has elevators. Our room was two flights up, which was okay. But beware if you don't like walking up/down steps
-the $500 in resort credits was a joke. Not really worth anything as they have lots of restrictions on how to use
-YHI spa is very expensive, and nothing special ($150 for a 60 minute massage, used $50 spa credit, after taxes, fees and tip, total came to $155). Locker room had 8 lockers and was big enough for 2 people.Used both the Reserve and Palma Real spa services. Wouldn't bother with the spa the next time.

All in all it was a great stay. Played golf at the Cocotal Golf Club, very nice course. Zip lined with Canopy adventures (awesome experience), and just relaxed the remaining time.

reviews.author: Kristimarie713
reviews.title: Palma Real Royal Service
reviews.text: The resort and Royal Service were great, the food was less than acceptable at all restaurants except the Palazzo, Royal Service only restaurant was AMAZING! I would steer clear of the buffet as my boyfriend and I ate there the last day prior to flying home and he got E Coli from the food, which resulted in appendicitis and we needed to rush to the emergency room upon returning home and he ended up needing an emergency surgery appendectomy as a result!

reviews.author: cicitonton
reviews.title: Excellent memory
reviews.text:
In August I went with my family and mom for 1 week vacation all what I have to say about the hotel that they were all perfect amazing even do weather wasn't good but they made us feel so comfortable I have to say special thanks to  Josefina abreu & Domingo beltre & Vladimir Rodriguez & Carlos de la Cruz & Estrella Garcia you guys made us feel so happy I have no word to use for me to thank you all for the perfect help you gave us during are stay . you guys are the best it was pleasure knowing you all & you all made me & my family & mom so happy . Your hotel is so clean so good I have to say the best I will be going again for sure specially to see you all for another vacation thank you all again .    

Chaaya family 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 👍👍👍

reviews.author: Jamilcade
reviews.title: Excursão a Isla Saona pela Blue
reviews.text: Comprei pelo Hotel a excursão e sou avisado de acordar as 06:30 am, porém já são 08:20 e nada deles chegarem. Total desrespeito com horário !! Péssimo negócio acordar cedo de férias por um serviço mal prestado !!! Nota 3 pro hotel que trabalha com empresas incompetentes !!

reviews.author: Jesus T
reviews.title: EXCELENTE Y MARAVILLOSO
reviews.text:
Soy una persona en silla de ruedas y mi experiencia fue maravillosa, en estas facilidades pude moverme a todos lados y el trato fue increhible. La limpieza y organización extraordinaria y el personal super excelente.  Reconosco el agradable y excelente trato de todo el personal y quiero destacar  parte del personal que calaron muy hondo dentro de nuestros corazones, estos son entre otros: Ender Lara, Francisco, Gregorio Guillen Frias, Kelvin, Darleny Gil, Juan De Dios, Yesenia Farias, ect.

   Gracias y muchas pero muchas Bendiciones para todos...

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Incredible Service from Luis Polo
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the people are very nice. The food was hit or miss. Olio (Italian) and Misu (hibachi grill) are excellent. Seaweed on the beach was disappointing, but something impacting most of the Carribean. Entertainment and activities were good and lively.  The highlight of it all was the royal service team they have. All of them were very nice, but Luis Polo was incredible. He took care of every request we had and with the best attitude.  I unfortunately had an incident that required me to go to the hospital for 2 days and Luis went above and beyond. On his way home from work he came to the hospital to drop off items I needed, he helped me get setup and communicate with the doctors, he called multiple times to check how I was doing, he called my wife to make sure she and my 2 daughters were ok, he picked me up from the hospital to bring me back, he brought me to the pharmacy to get the medication I needed, and so much more.  He made me feel like I had a friend or relative on the island and thank him so much for the extra effort he put in. Santos was also very helpful and great to work with.

reviews.author: angelaQ2632KD
reviews.title: Muy padre, excelente.........😀😀😀😀😀😀😀
reviews.text: Muy lindo hotel, fue una experiencia muy Waaaoooo, la pase muy lindo, tienen muy buena atención sobre todo en el área de los niños, hay una chica muy buena onda que cuida y anima a los niños se llama Gissel Ramírez,súper niña, felicidades, lo recomiendo....

reviews.author: Carol P
reviews.title: S-E-N-S-A-C-I-O-N-A-L
reviews.text: Minha lua de mel foi no Paradisus Palma Real de Punta Cana. Escolhi o hotel pelo site que tinha fotos maravilhosas, e ainda consegui me surpreender. O resort é lindíssimo, do lobby principal dá pra ver a praia e a praça com fontes do hotel. A vista é de tirar o fôlego. O quarto que ficamos era maravilhoso, muito espaçoso, com banheiro enorme (com amenidades Thierry Mugler), banheira enorme, cama enorme, mesinha de apoio, bancada, frigobar, e varanda, tudo impecável. Escolhemos o quarto com o Royal Service a vale muito a pena. Nosso mordomo, Ariel Benzo, era extremamente prestativo, querido, atencioso e com certeza melhorou muito nossa estadia. Nos ajudou em tudo que precisamos, com reservas para jantar, transfer, enfim, recomendo. Outras vantagens do royal service é a praia privativa, piscina com bar privativa, acesso ao restaurante Palazzo (exclusivo), lobby para check-in exclusivo, menu de travesseiros, etc. Os restaurantes são bem bons, e apenas o Passion não está incluído, mas recomendo muito o Palazzo, de cozinha italiana e exclusivo para o Royal Service. Quem nos atendeu no jantar e café da manhã que tinha até caviar) foi o Richard Ortiz, e ele foi sensacional, atendimento impecável e muito muito solícito. Outro restaurante muito bom, e que está incluso para todos é o Rare, steak house. Carnes muito boas. Em geral os menus são muito bons, inclusive no "bandeijão" do almoço, com peixes e carnes grelhados na hora. Os bares a noite ficam um pouco desanimados, mas para quem está curtindo a lua-de-mel, como eu, vai ser uma experiência memorável!

reviews.author: sixfamilytraveler
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
We loved our vacation at the reserve,the service was excellent, we would like to thank Elaine our concierge, all of the waiters at each of the restaurants: Anthony Cid, Christian Fernando, Cerco Peralta and Willis Pascual from the Gabi Club they took care of our every need especially my mom in law who had daily request. Again, my vacation at the reserve was excellent with all of the dedicated service. And we will definitely be back without a thought.

Sanchez Family

reviews.author: Pepi T
reviews.title: Madrid mi gente!!!!!
reviews.text: Este ańo es la segunda vez que voy con mi familia y genial,gracias a Ambiorix Mesa,Daniel de Leon,del Club Melia Daniela Castillo,del Gabi Beach Jessica y Cristian y Anthony y como no los chicos de la playa the reserve Ramon y Luis gracias a todos

reviews.author: Kymberly J
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: We had a girlfriends weekend and the resort was very nice. The food, drinks and nightly shows/entertainment made this a very enjoyable trip. Had a massage at the spa that was amazing as well. Would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Shadow927
reviews.title: Amazing again!!!... Erika who?
reviews.text: This was our second time staying at resort, we brought along my parents and they loved it as well the service was amazing.  The staff will do what ever they can to make you happy, for example my 4 year old wanted Doritos but they did not have any... went up to our room that afternoon and found all kinds of snacks on the counter for her, another day she wanted Nutella at lunch buffet had it at breakfast time... I told her they did not have anymore they asked why she was upset and I told them she wanted Nutella staff went to the kitchen and found her Nutella.  Aroni was one of our  waiters he was so great always made sure we had what we needed, especially my parents he knew exactly what my mom and dad needed before they could even ask.  I can not say enough about this resort.  It was also very nice to see a lot of the same staff from our first visit.

reviews.author: Melli22631
reviews.title: Fantastic family concierge service!
reviews.text: We were at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for a week and friends of ours had suggested the family concierge service when we were booking. So glad that we did! We were assigned a concierge (Nikel) at check-in who was available to us the whole week. Nikel made our stay very memorable with his nightly treats delivered to the room including champagne, chocolate covered strawberries, cookies, wine, gifts for the kids including a balloon bubble bath that was ready one late afternoon when we came back from the pool. Nikel checked on us several times during each day to make sure we had everything we needed and arranged all of our activities. I would highly recommend the family concierge service and requesting Nikel if you are considering a vacation here. Wonderful stay!

reviews.author: Henry L
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Beautiful Country
reviews.text: We first flew into Punta Cana airport from a JFK connecting flight and went through customs very quickly. Our transportation was previously arranged with the hotel, which is much recommended due to the fact that there are many people who say they will bring you somewhere but really won't. We arrived at the Reserve and we're shown to our beautiful room in Family Concierge building 40, overlooking the pool. If you are on the fence about putting in the extra money for a Family Concierge, I highly recommend doing it. Our lovely Concierge, Elaine, was so accommodating and nice and truly made our vacation special. I would truly return just to see Elaine as well as some of the other staff, including Mario and Anthony at the Reserve Pool and Marcelo at the Gabi Beach Bar, who are always friendly and extremely helpful and kind. Speaking of the restaurants here, they are not to be overlooked. We ate at Vento, Bana, which is not recommended, Molé, and, of course, both Gabi Beach and Gabi Club, my two favorites. There are so many options and the food is always fresh and different. Spend lots of time in the pool, always take the tram, only drink bottled water, and most of all, have lots of fun at this resort that fully lives up to the name.

reviews.author: Mike L
reviews.title: Fabulous Place!
reviews.text:
We loved it. We have our two boys, 11 and 14 with us and we absolutely had a perfect week. As others have said, the Family Concierge is worth it. But I would also add we were spoiled by Elaine. The entire staff is exceptional at this property, but Elaine was so genuine and sweet to my family I was blown away. She was always just a phone call away on the house-provided cell phone. She made all our dinner reservations, reserved palapas for us, and helped arrange transportation, and gave us peace of mind for all the little questions that came up. 

If we did it again...we would not eat at Bana. Just boring hibachi. We enjoyed the Gabi Beach buffet the best by far. The Reserve buffet is good, and private, but there is a wider selection and the great beach view at Gabi. 

The beach - yes, there is seaweed. And the surf is super sandy so no visibility. But beyond the break, the water is good for swimming and not very deep. The pools are beautiful and huge. 

The property is gorgeous. Our room was huge and very modern. We were very happy here. 

And a special shout out to Anthony who made pool time a blast.

reviews.author: j k
reviews.title: Excellente!!!!
reviews.text: My visit was short but excellent, thanks to Domingo Beltre the Guest services manager.  I basically was a walk in, and he welcomed me like I had a reservation!!  He sealed the deal for my to definitely reserve a room for next year with Royal Service.  Thanks Domi

reviews.author: Virginia  R
reviews.title: Son increíbles
reviews.text:
LLevamos dos años seguidos alojándonos en este hotel. El trato por los empleados es sublime, mucho más que bien. Desde los maleteros (Ambiorix, Dani de León y Eddy Wilson) que no han podido hacer mejor nuestra estancia, enseñandono más allá de lo que es un todo incluído. Les doy las gracias de todo corazón porque me llevo no sólo el recuerdo de unas bonitas vacaciones, sino a mucha gente que echaré de menos, sin duda en España. Los chicos de la playa (Ramón y Luis), que gracias a ellos el bajar a la playa era mucho más que tomar el sol; era disfrutar de su buen humor, su alegría y su amabilidad por los cuatro costados, además de enseñarme que con música todo es mejor. Los camareros de Gaby Beach ( Anthony, Jessica y Cristian) por su inmensa sonrisa a la hora del desayuno y la comida y su gran amabilidad y su capacidad de resolución para cualquier problema que tuviésemos. 
Muchisimas gracias a todos por hacer de unas vacaciones un sueño. El año que viene allí estaremos!

reviews.author: larryneall
reviews.title: Thank you!
reviews.text:
YHI Spa client rep Ruth was most exceptional in addressing my New York style obnoxious being.

She articulated, pursuaded and educated me on an experience that was on the money...as if she sold me, then delivered the service herself.

reviews.author: mwosis
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: The property and resort are beautiful! The rooms are also very nice. Restaurants on the property are very good and the hotel staff are very attentive and accommodating. The ONLY issue we had was the beach -- the overgrowth of seaweed in the DR makes the beach unusable. But this seems to be a problem on most of the island.

reviews.author: Barbara Queen
reviews.title: INCREIBLE
reviews.text: servicio inmejorable, trabajadores super agradables, todo a tu disposicion, calidad de comida, bebida y servicio fantastico, prefiero pagar un poco más y tomarme unos buenos cocolocos o una buena comida con comida buena y alcohol de calidad, trato increible. de verdad un 10 y mi mayordomo Narciso impolutamente bueno! no os gasteis 800€ en ir a punta cana! vale la pena gastarse mas y alucinar como reyes, el mejor resort de punta cana, sale en muchos videoclips por lo bonito e increible que es tanto de dia como de noche

reviews.author: JenSlack
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text:
Overall Experience was absolutely wonderful. 
We had a private butler which was great and the overall staff made the whole resort feel like home by day two.
JOSE SALVADOR provided a nice amenity each evening (wine/cheese, hot
 bath).  He would check in daily to see how we were doing.  He appeared
 to get busier as the week went on due to some big groups/events
 staying at the hotel, but still got back to us and assisted with
 anything we needed.  Helped us out with arranging Golf, Tennis, daily
 bucket of ice, hotel info, bali-beds, restaurant reservations, ironed
 a shirt, excursion info.  If nothing else, he was a good comfort line
 of support should we have needed it, which gives a nice little peace
 of mind.  He is a good guy and seemed to sincerely want us to relax
 and have a good time.  We appreciated that.
-ANGEL (FIOS?) did a great job all week of providing us
 drinks/assistance when lounging in the Royal Service area, either by
 one of the pools or on the beach.  He kept a great, hospitable
 attitude all week and tried to reinforce the “let me do it for you.
 You can work when you go back home, but now you’re on vacation”-type
 mindset.  While it is somewhat uncomfortable for us to be waited
 on/catered too, we really appreciated his approach, attitude, and
 great service.
-Dance instructors did a great job.  Was impressed to see them teach
 the dances, hold other jobs at the resort (saw main female dance
 instructor working towel desk), and then put on a well choreographed
 dance show at night.
-Security did a pretty good job of preserving the Royal Service pools
 as adults only… on occasion little children would come in with their
 parents and after a few minutes would get spotted and asked to leave.
-Enjoyed the Hot Pool Spa area
 -Lots of restaurants to choose from/no shortage of food… They were all
 pretty decent.   Actually thought the Steak at the Italian restaurant
 was better than the steak at the Steak restaurant.  And when in doubt,
 can’t really go wrong with Nios due to the shear quantity/variety of
 foods.
-DIONAL SANTANA and ESTEBAN did goodjobs as waiters.  Dional appeared
 to go out of his way to ensure we had everything we wanted/needed and
 even assisted in remedying  an issue we had at Blue Guava when the
 cook was unhelpful.
 -Everyone was or seemed very courteous/hospitable during our stay with
 exception to one cook at the Blue Guava.  He was a little rude and
 dismissive when queried about a food item, and then actually walked
 away with a “stupid tourist” type look.  Basically, the cheese which
 had been pretty good on the previous 2-days was watered down
 tremendously making it water more than cheese.  LEO at the Royal
 Service Bar also did a good job.
-The Weather was absolutely awesome… we were a bit nervous because
 forecast called for thunderstorms each day, but only rained once
 during our stay and that was later in the day/into evening to where it
 did not affect any fun-in-the-sun type stuff.
-Temperature was very good, especially if in shaded area of bali-bed (May).
 -Liked the convenience of the Room Service but they had about a 20%
 success rate on our orders.  Also, if you order after 11pm (when most
 of the hotel shuts down… at least food places), expect to wait around
 an hour for food due to the volume of orders they get.
 -Nice beach… clear/pretty waters but had lots of seaweed and ran into
 one tinfoil fish.  Soft sands, and lots of water activities to partake
 should you want to for a price or just watch/enjoy the scenery for
 free.
-Tennis courts were nice… they provided racquets, balls, and even had
 a peacock on site cheering us on… or heckling us… one of the two.
 -The hotel will provide trans to Tennis/The Reserve, but in reality,
 its only about ¼ mile if that/5-minute walk away.
 -Airport shuttle service was nice…. Just make sure you get to the
 airport well in advance (2-3 hours) because the lines are long or be a
 priority/business/first class flyer.  And then it appears that once
 you finally make it through the ticketing line you’ll get stuck in the
 security screening line, which feeds into the customs/immigration
 line, but will be held up until about 30-minutes prior to your flight…
 freaked & frustrated a lot of folks out but ended up working out for
 us.  Not sure if someone showed up late though… think a few folks
 missed their flights.
-Kind of need to plan ahead, meaning had to map out dinner
 reservations at specified restaurants for a few days in advance; had
 to reserve pillows day or morning prior; had to reserve Royal Service
 Bali Beds at least 1-day prior.  This threw us off a bit because we
 wanted to get away from the set schedules and just have the options to
 do whatever we wanted whenever we wanted, based on how we were feeling
 at that moment… didn’t necessarily feel that there was much
 flexibility in that regarding the restaurants/bali beds.
 -The “no kids area” of the Royal Service rooms seemed to have kids
 there… showed up 4 of the 7-days and encountered kids in our “no kids”
 building.
 -Upgraded to the Royal Service to get away from the families/kids and
 have a bit more privacy/seclusion with the option to “intermingle” if
 we wanted.  So, it actually bothered us a bit when we kept running
 into small children in the adults only area and contradicted what was
 advertised.
 -The 1,500 coupon book, which they said we would get at check-in to
 possibly use towards a room upgrade and that they really built up as a
 major benefit when booking was basically of no benefit to us and was
 not provided until the second day… provided coupons to the mall stores
 for about a 10% discount on average but with a minimum purchase.  Then
 the hotel coupons were similar in that they did not cover the cost of
 anything, but were supposed to provide enough discount to entice
 someone to pay more for an upgrade/wine/etc.  The casino coupons
 actually seemed like a pretty good deal (i.e. free play money) as long
 as you matched your bet, but the thing that got us was that we saved
 the casino for the last 2-nights and were only allowed to use
 2-coupons per person per night, which left us with about 7-unused
 coupons… Had we known, we would have gone to the casino earlier but
 they didn’t provide that fine print until actually redeeming the
 coupons at the casino.
 -Alcoholic drinks didn’t seem very strong even when getting a double…
 so, by a few days in, started ordering the drink as is and then
 ordering a glass of the primary liquor that went into the drink (i.e.
 ordered margarita and then a glass of tequila on ice)… basically an
 extra 1-2 shots… this made it better and actually seemed more like a
 normal drink. and really hit the spot… and I don’t even have that high
 a tolerance.
-Tipping… This was an issue of awkwardness with us… although the rate
 says tipping already included in the rates, it also says if someone
 does an exceptional job, feel free to reward them more.   But as a
 result, it seemed as some expected or were fishing for tips.  What
 this created was an atmosphere of competition for service with some
 routinely tipping/some tipping at the end of the trip/and some not
 tipping at all.  This appeared to affect the level of service some
 folks received.  After a couple days, we started carrying around a few
 dollars to give out following an order of drinks, stay at a restaurant
 or ride somewhere, but nothing crazy.   For the most part, we decided
 to tip at the end… had no idea what was appropriate but gave what we
 had and thought was fair.

reviews.author: Lore O
reviews.title: Excelente lugar
reviews.text:
Fue una estadía maravillosa y sin dudas la repetiremos y la recomendamos!!
El ingreso al hotel es impecable, son muy amables en el recibimiento, el check in lo hicimos con Ovidio y todo fue perfecto, muchas gracias a él pq su atención fue increíble.  Las instalaciones son muy buenas y confortables.  La suite es realmente muy cómoda, nosotros fuimos con 2 chicos chiquitos y estábamos perfecto.  La decoración es moderna, sobria y cálida.  La limpieza es impecable.  La comida en general es muy buena, el desayuno en Gabi (que está en The Reserve) es muy variado, rico y todo fresco.  Hay muy buenas opciones si te gusta comer saludable.  La atención de los chicos es impecable, son muy amables están pendientes de todo.  Queremos destacar la atención de Aroni Crisntamo, que siempre atiende con una sonrisa y estaba muy atento de cualquier cosa que necesitábamos.  El Gabi Beach es una muy buena opción para almorzar.  Para la comida de la noche, hay algunos problemitas.  El Gabi de The Reserve tiene algunos problemas de tiempos en la cocina, la verdad es que no dan abasto.  La comida es muy rica y los chicos que atienden son muy amables, pero los platos se demoran muchísimo y si vas con chicos es un problema.  Una noche fuimos de The Grill, pero la verdad es que nos fuimos porque hace muchísimo calor, fuimos en pleno agosto y no corría una gota de aire, hay ventiladores, pero no dan a basto.  También fuimos a Naos, pero tiene el mismo tema con la temperatura, hace muchísimo calor.  La mejor opción que encontramos a la noche es Gabi Beach que la comida es muy variada y como está cerca de la playa corre aire y el clima es mucho más amigable!
Las piscinas son las 2 muy buenas y espaciosas.  Muy lindo diseño, las reposeras y el servicio de bar es muy bueno.  Igual que el servicio y la comodidad en la playa, impecable.
El gimnasio es muy completo, tiene de todo y es espacioso.
La playa es cierto que tiene algas, pero es un tema de la naturaleza y todos los días pasan a limpiarlas, no generan un gran inconveniente.
En general todo es excelente, servicio, instalaciones, comidas, decoración.
Como sugerencia para el hotel: faltan actividades para los chicos en la playa, creo que para ser un lugar pensado para la familia, deberían incluir alguna animación diaria por la mañana en la playa y algo por la tarde en la piscina.  Es como que todas las actividades para los chicos pasan dentro del Kid Zone, pero es un lugar cerrado, faltan actividades y juegos al aire libre.
Vale la pena la experiencia.

reviews.author: Gisela M
reviews.title: Paraíso
reviews.text: Lugar perfeito p estar com a familia, em casal... Hospitalidade indescritível.  Conforto nota 1000. Acomodações impecáveis.  Comida espetacular, além de um roteiro gastronômico dentro do próprio hotel com 9 restaurantes. Um paraíso sem sombra de dúvidas.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: This place is true Paradise, set the bar high...
reviews.text: I was there in June 2012, yes 2012 for a wedding.  Our group was just over 80 people.  I never had the opportunity to write a review or felt the need until now.  We are now planning our next All Inclusive group vacation and I realized how high the bar was set for us after staying at this resort.  From the moment we stepped onto the property we were greeted with smiles and warm hellos.  We get to the desk and here come the Pina Coladas that were superior.  Check in went seamless.  We were a few hours earlier than the check in time of 3 PM but our rooms were ready and they gave us our keys.  Off to the buffet we went because it was lunch time.  The food was amazing, the staff was amazing!  We went to the beach next.  No fighting for seats or towels, there were plenty.  Finally we arrive at our rooms and they were cooled off, clean room, great space, stocked frig and great view.  We enjoyed drinks that were all premium.  The bride and groom were on the Reserve side and we went over there as well.  Both sides were amazing.  The pool was always clean, staff were always nice.  Angel and Jose did an excellent job with activities and just greeting you as the ran into you.  I have just as many pics with staff as I do my friends.  I cannot say enough about the great service amnd atmosphere.  I would return again and again and I plan too.

reviews.author: 1oraine
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: We attended a wedding at this resort. We were so happy with the service throughout the stay.  Entertainment was spectacular.  We loved the dance lessons with Daniel. He was a pleasure to see around the resort. We really relaxed and had such a pleasurable time with the help of Leidy Guerrero. We will return when we visit the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Anita_Salamanca
reviews.title: "Luna de miel, increíble"
reviews.text: Después de patear Nueva York, que mejor destino que Punta Cana para descansar. Lo que no sabíamos era que nos íbamos a encontrar con un hotel impresionante!! Desde que pisamos las instalaciones hasta que las dejamos (una pena), nos trataron genial, los empleados de 10!! Dar las gracias a todos ellos y mencionar en especial a José Fernández (piscina), Luis (camarero playa), Rafael López (barman playa), Jasson y Sandra (recepcionistas). Las instalaciones increíbles y un mantenimiento insuperable. Ojala en unos años nos podamos volver a permitirnos el lujo de volver.

reviews.author: Analia P
reviews.title: Excente hotel!!!!
reviews.text: Es un hotel de excelente categoria, con una excelente atencion de los mozos en los desayunos, los cuales son muy abundantes, el servicio de limpieza de habitaciones esplendido, solamente a mejorar el servicio de bar en la playa y el Wifi en las habitaciones.

reviews.author: Holger
reviews.title: Ich habe den Vergleich
reviews.text:
Die Erwartungen waren groß. 
Leider deutlich untererfüllt.
Zunächst die schönen Dinge dieses Hotels:
Strand und Poolanlage, auch die al a carte Restaurants sowie die Zimmer sind schön und luxuriös gestaltet. Getränkeauswahl ebenfalls sehr gut.
Das wars dann auch schon.
Check in dauerte 50 min, und nur vier Paare waren vor uns. Man zeigte mit dem Finger in die Richtung in die wir laufen sollen um aufs Zimmer zu gelangen. Keiner begleitete uns, sodass wir uns in den Anbauten verliefen. Koffer dauerten 60 weitere Minuten.
Das Buffetrestaurant ist eine Frechheit. Klein, steril und gefliest wie eine Kantine. Die Sitzplätze außerhalb sind allerdings schön.
In den a al carte Restaurants war das Essen gut. Zugleich erwarte ich einen deutlich!! besseren Service. Wir wollten 4 Gänge Essen und bestellten als Gang zwei ein Gericht mit Garnelen und als Hauptgericht ein Rinderfiletsetak. Beides war gut, doch trotz deutlicher Bestellung kamen beide Gerichte gleichzeitig. Da saßen wir nun, zu zwei an einem kleinen Tisch und hatten vier große Teller auf dem Tisch. Die Konsequenz: nix passte zusammen und ein Gericht wurde natürlich kalt.
Wäre das nur ein Mal passiert, nun gut. Es ist drei Mal passiert und kann nicht sein.
Wir besuchen regelmäßig das Hotel Iberostar Bavaro, Iberostar Grand Bavaro und Secrets Royal Beach; alle auch am Bavarostrand. Alle drei kann ich deutlich mehr empfehlen!

reviews.author: brianwstan
reviews.title: 5 night stay
reviews.text: I wished we could have stayed longer. This is a very big resort. We traveled September 13th-20th and had the place to ourselves.  The room was comfortable.  The food was fine.  The beach and pool were awesome. We didn't book the Royal Service or stay at the Reserve. The Reserve looked nice.  The service overall was good. Luis at the main pool was the best.

reviews.author: Veronica C
reviews.title: buena atenciòn personal de bar de piscina
reviews.text: quiero destacar la excelente atenciòn de Antonio Ramirez , Luis y Manuel Torres la cordialidad calidez y sobre todo el profesionalismo con el que trabajan, yo soy agente de viajes de Turismo Cocha de chile y uno piensa en como se siente el pasajero , sobre todo cuando va a descansar y encuentra eficiencia y sobre todo alegria que caracteriza al Dominicano...gracias por hacer que mis vacaciones fueran las mejores....los felicito.

reviews.author: Wagih M
reviews.title: Best Place to stay
reviews.text: My wife and I spent best vacation at the Reserve - Paradisus Punta Cana. Great service, friendly people, very good food, very clean, and everyone at the resort is trying his/her best to make you happy.

reviews.author: Meria G
reviews.title: Nos sentimos cómo reeyes!
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, excelente la atención de todos y cada una de las personas que trabajan alli. La comida riquisima, volvimos con unos kg de mas ! mis padres ya habian viajado con uno de mis hermanos, pero mi otro hermano y yo no conociamos y nos quedamos enamorados! volveriamos a ir a Punta Cana y al hotel Paradisus Palma Real ! . quiero agradecer especialmente a Reina que es una divina nos hizo divertir muchisimo y es muy simpatica, muy cálida snetiamos que la conociamos, una genia!, a Luis que nos atendía siempre de maravillas y cada vez que podia nos alcanzaba a todos lados con el carrito, a Luis de la barra de la pileta que nos preparaba unos tragos super ricos igual que Juan del bar donde se armaba toda la fiesta en el patio interno, tambien a Angel del lugar de toallas siempre tan simpatico y calido, al igual que Jhonarys y Yasmin que son unas mujeres divinas y espero volver a verlas la próxima vez que viajemos !, a las chicas de limpieza y a los mozos que siempre estaban para ofrecerte lo que necesitaras. La verdad impecable. saludos a todos !

reviews.author: josemanuelpastorsant
reviews.title: Maravilloso recuerdo
reviews.text:
Quisiera aprovechar la ocasión para felicitar a todas y cada una de las personas que nos atendieron desde nuestra llegada hasta la salida.Ha sido una experiencia para toda nuestra familia difícil de superar, seguimos con el recuerdo vivo de unas maravillosas vacaciones. Dificil de olvidar la amabilidad de todo el personal desde los jardineros hasta los camareros, las animadoras, a los cocineros,  a los camareros , a los acomodadores, masajistas , de  corazón a Miguel Ángel de Palma, y nuestro amigo el camarero JORGE!!
Suspiramos por volver pronto y volver a disfrutar de tantísimas emociones!!!
HASTA PRONTO,!!!

reviews.author: Rafael_Lovatti
reviews.title: Paraiso
reviews.text:
Logo na chegada já impressiona a atenção e cordialidade dos funcionários. Excelente atendimento, gastronomia sensasional e quartos amplos, arejados e silenciosos. Excelente para lua de mel ou mesmo para descansar.  Vale a pena pagar ou pedir upgrade para o Royal Service. O serviço de mordomo auxilia nas reservas dos restaurantes, de passeios e tudo que precisar durante sua estadia. Tudo muito luxuoso. Todos os restaurantes são muito bons mas alguns agradaram mais. Para almoço e Jantar o Palazo e o Gabi Beach foram os que mais gostamos. Para café da manhã o palazzo e o Bana são excelentes. Para café da tarde recomendamos pedir no quarto, pois pode pedir o que mais lhe agradar.
Não podemos deixar de falar do nosso mordomo Nicolas que nos ajudou durante nossa estadia e foi muito solicito e atencioso quando precisamos. Recomendamos e certamente retornaremos.

reviews.author: RodilM
reviews.title: Dream Vacation!!
reviews.text:
Amazing Resort!!! My wife and I stayed here last week.  Awesome service, great food, very cleaned rooms. This stay was the most amazing experience.  Outstanding staff, specially our server at the beach, Ramón Ramírez.  Drinks were always great and on time.  The bartender did a great job mixing the drinks.  Our bell boy, Hazael Reyes went out of his way to help us as well.   There are a lot of daily activities.  We highly recommend this resort.  We hope to be back soon.
Mondragón

reviews.author: PekyMorales
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: Es un hotel explendido!!!, con una infractuctura muy buena, excelente espacios libres entre los edificios, el Spa totalmente recomendable, incluido dentro de la estadia, solamente a mejorar la senal de Wifi en los lugares comunes de los hoteles.

reviews.author: Della H
reviews.title: Not for us but amazing place if you like that sort of thing!
reviews.text:
Stayed 5 nights here.Can't fault the place for cleanliness,service and food but my husband and I felt trapped as soon as we entered.Resort holidays are not for us but we gave it a go.We were in the royal service area which was fine,room was big and clean.Not sure about the openness of the bathroom,like a bit more privacy!!!Not sure the butler service is really needed,he was next to useless(not going to name name's as he might of been having an off week!!)Food was very good,especially Gabi Beach.The best bit was the friendliness and helpfulness of FRANSISCO CABRERA,royal service pool/beach man.Could not fault his service at all.Everyday a cheerful wave and hello Mr & Mrs Harris,always got us a great spot on the beach,infact reserving a place before we were even there.Brought us our favourite drinks always at the right moment.This man deserves
 a raise!!!
All in all a very impressive resort,we enjoyed ourselves but will not be returning.Once again nothing against the resort just not our cup of tea!!

reviews.author: shelby s
reviews.title: Nicolas Maracallo / Butler extraordinaire
reviews.text: What a wonderful honeymoon.....and we have Nicolas Maracallo and all of the amazing staff to thank!!  Royal service will make your vacation so extra special, if you are traveling from far, it is worth it!

reviews.author: Mauricio R
reviews.title: Lugar perfeito.
reviews.text:
Muito obrigado,  Augustin. Super atencioso, simpático e agradável.
A comida é excelente (abrcos fernando camareiro do roal service)Local limpo, alegre, cheio de gente bonita.
A praia é paradisíaca...
Enfim, recomendo a todos.

reviews.author: alicea97
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We just returned from spending 6 beautiful days at this resort.  It is about the 4th time we go there.  Last time was 5 years ago.  We had a wonderful, wonderful time.  The place is sooo beautifual and clean!  Food was excellent but what caught our attention was the service.  Those workers went out of their way to please everybody with grace.  We would like to thank all of them but specially Mr. Jose Rivera, Supervisor at Naos Restaurant who after 1 day, knew what we wanted and liked and had it ready for us when he saw us.   All the staff is good, service was better and we were impressed by how clean they keep that huge place.  The pools are beautiful and clean.  We also want to thank Omar Hernandez who went out of his way to help and please us.  We love this place, had a wonderful time and can't wait to go back soon.

reviews.author: bramsey89
reviews.title: Awesome spot
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at the resort. some of the best service in the Caribbean. Emilio valdez aka drinky drinky and Ramon Ramirez are great servers. Will for sure be returning. The food was good and the property is huge! Lots to do and see

reviews.author: Catherine T
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Wow we had an amazing time at this resort.   Not only was it beautiful but service was outstanding.
We were assigned our own Butler.  Nicolas Maracallo took care of us like we were family in his own home.   He was amazing.  Taking care of our every need.  He introduced to other staff members and they were as welcoming as Nicolas.   Leonardo Motta was one of the excellent bartenders.  Leo was one of the best mixologist and remembered every guest and their favorite drink.  Every employee was very well trained and welcoming.    

Some restaurants were better than others, but all did an excellent job.  They were over eight choices on the grounds.   Plenty of choices, activities, food, alcohol and excellent service.

reviews.author: ValentinaMoya
reviews.title: Realmente un servicio Real
reviews.text:
La atención en el Hotel es excepcional. Queremos agradecer a nuestro mayordomo Sami, el cual estuvo con nosotros durante toda la estadía preocupado de todas las reservas en los restaurantes y cualquier otra cosa que necesitábamos. También quiero destacar la atención en la playa, especialmente a Omar quien nos tenía todos los días las reposeras impecables y listas para usar independiente la hora que fuese, también a Jorge Acevedo que además de los ricos jugos estuvo atento a cualquier necesidad con una gran simpatía. En la piscina de Royal Service Leo nos deleitaba todo los días con cocteles riquísimos y mucha alegría.

El restaurant Palazzo nos encantó ya sea para el desayuno, almuerzo o comida. Muchas gracias a tosos los meseros, cocineros, y especialemente a Stefanía quién nos recibía con una sonrisa cada vez que íbamos al restaurant.Finalmente muchas felicitaciones y agradecimientos a Luisa en el launch de royal service!!!!

El unico detalle que podría mencionar es que deben cambiar las sábanas de las habitaciones ya que están muy viejas, y arreglar el wiifi que se caía constantemente.

Tuvimos unas excelentes vacaciones!!!

reviews.author: Gustavo Tomasi
reviews.title: Elegância e conforto
reviews.text: A chegada já impressiona, as pessoas são muito atenciosas sempre com sorriso no rosto, felizes! Fazem de tudo para agradar. O Royal service (com Fernando Lafontaine servindo no lobby) faz toda diferença...proporciona ainda mais comodidade, ainda tivemos a sorte de ter o Agostin no Royal service, sempre solicito. Mas além da beleza natural que é de tirar o fôlego, este hotel possui restaurantes que torna um roteiro gastronômico de deixar com água na boca. Enfim recomendo e em breve voltarei!

reviews.author: JustGinaMartin
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: We came here based on a good friend's recommendation. And we really had a relaxing honeymoon here.  The service was great. Our butler, Nicholas, was so helpful and thoughtful. Highly recommend.  The pools, spa, food, shows, everything was amazing!  Definitely worth it to do the royal service and try the Palazzo restaurant.

reviews.author: JustinBollen
reviews.title: Excellent Food & Service
reviews.text: Royal service is definitely worth it.    Nickolas will take care of you.  Food at Palatazzo was amazing.  The Beach was very relaxing.  Pool was nice and private in many areas.  The shows were some better one.

reviews.author: Shannon R
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: This is a great resort. The staff was friendly and accommodating. The rooms were spacious and clean. The food was good which can be difficult to find at some all inclusive resorts. I went for my cousins wedding and the services that were provided were excellent. It was a perfect event! Mariela, the on site wedding coordinator was so professional and really good at her job. She's the best!!!

reviews.author: Luis Gatica
reviews.title: De Lujo
reviews.text:
Por una casualidad caímos en este hotel y fue una experiencia inolvidable, desde la gran atención de su personal pasando por sus exquisitas comidas hasta su excelente ubicación, todo fue una maravillosa sorpresa.
Viaje solo con mis dos hijos de 13 y 5 años y la preocupación de todo el personal por facilitarme mi estadía y la gran atención a mis hijos me dejo con una deuda de agradecimiento. 
muy lindas instalaciones ayudan a completar el cuadro, con una hermosa piscina especialmente diseñada para niños bordeando el kid zone con monitoras encargadas de realizar actividades ayudo a que cada día fuera inolvidable.
lo recomiendo a ojos cerrados sobretodo si viajas en familia.

reviews.author: yariscell70
reviews.title: Excelent staff!
reviews.text: My family went to the reserve in may,and we had the family convierge two bedroom master suite, my concierge was Estefania Ruiz she gave us a cell phone to call her for anything we needed. She was always available for us. My kids loved her. The hotel have a beautiful pool and have cabanas all around it. The entire staff is excelent. I suggest this hotel 100 porcent.

reviews.author: jori2503
reviews.title: The reserve woderful!
reviews.text: This is an excelent hotel to stay! I hope I could have stayed longer. There are a fee people I would like to thanks for their incredible service. All the Family concierge staff. My personal concierge was Estefania!she does an amazing job. Also leidy and sofia are wonderful. We are already making plans for our next trip.

reviews.author: Renata552
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text:
Utilizamos o serviço Royal Service. Excelente! Já incluso o transfer de ida e volta, além do check-in ser em uma área reservada junto à área destinada a este serviço. Você não precisa se preocupar com nada. O concierge ao te recepcionar já explica tudo e tira todas as suas duvidas. Também há um "mordomo" que providencia tudo o que vc precisar, desde reservas em restaurantes e spa, como preparação do banho no horário desejado. Ele também faz um pequeno tour em todo o complexo para mostrar as demais áreas e restaurantes do hotel bem como horários de funcionamento. Os quartos são bem silenciosos, mesmo os que são de frente para a piscina, pois como o Royal Service é exclusivo para casais não há muito barulho. A área da piscina dispõe de um bar e a área da praia de um bar de sucos. Mas vc pode se servir de drinks enquanto na praia sem problemas. Há também um restaurante exclusivo, Palácio, onde é servido o café da manhã. Achei o Royal Service perfeito para casais. A area é tão reservada que nem parece que vc está em um grande resort. É ideal para descansar. E os quartos são bem perto da praia e da piscina e espaçosos. A cama é enorme e você pode pedir travesseiros aromáticos todas as noites.Apenas algumas considerações quanto ao quarto, o frigobar não estava muito bem abastecido quando chegamos. Foi preciso solicitar que colocassem outros tipos de bebidas. Mas foi feito prontamente. O Wi-Fi do nosso quarto também estava péssimo, mas prontamente foi colocado um roteador que resolveu o problema. Achei o mobiliário um pouco antigo e de madeira escura, precisa de uma repaginação par ficar um pouco mais leve e moderno. A TV ainda nem é de LCD. Os Quartos mais cuidados ficam na área do The Reserve, que é reformada frequentemente, visto que recebem os sócios do club melia.
Atençao: no momento do check-in o concierge vai te perguntar se você teria um tempo durante o café da manhã do dia seguinte para explicar melhor sobre a rede melia e os serviços, e que depois daria os vouchers de descontos para passeios e spa. Como seria durante o café da manhã e falaram que seriam 90 minutos nós topamos. No entanto você perde a manhã inteira. Ficamos livres já era quase meio dia. É um vai e vem de representantes e apresentações no intuito de vender cota de membro do Club Melia. Se vc tem pouco tempo e não pretende se associar ao clube, sugiro declinar do tal convite para o café da manhã. Contudo, eles dão depois diversos vouchers de descontos em passeios, spa e restaurantes. Seria uma compensação. É preciso avaliar se vale a pena...

reviews.author: GuieAna
reviews.title: Muito bom!
reviews.text: O check in é um pouco demorado. Levamos quase 1 hora e meia para entrarmos no quarto. Recebemos um upgrade para o Royal Service (haviamos reservado quarto no The Reserve) e ficamos muito contentes na hora. Depois percebemos que havia diferença na qualidade das instalações, produtos nos bares, etc, então ficamos um pouco desencatados com isso... Mas de uma maneira geral foi uma delícia! É impressionante como todos os funcionários são simpáticos, prestativos e solícitos. Nós, no Brasil, que estamos acostumados com serviço geralmente medíocre, ficamos encantados com o nível de atendimento de todos!

reviews.author: Yan2J
reviews.title: ALL IN ALL, A GREAT TRIP AND FUN RESORT!
reviews.text:
My fiance and I arrived at Paradisus Palma Real for the Love at First Sight program, in search of our destination wedding venue for next year.  We had already visited about 9 other all inclusive resorts in Cancun prior to coming to Punta Cana, and had 3 other resorts lined up to visit during our stay.  We were a bit skeptical because we visited Paradisus Cancun, and did not have the best experience there.  I have to admit, Paradisus Palma Real came through!  We loved it there and have decided to book our wedding date!  I am really looking forward to having our wedding here next year with all of our friends and family. 

Check In:
We checked in and got upgraded right away to the Royal Service.  We were brought over to the Royal Service area and introduced to our Romance Specialist Racquel and our Butler Faustino.  They were both wonderful.  Racquel gave us our schedule of events for our site inspection and let us know to meet her the next day.  Faustino showed us the grounds and to our rooms, he also gave us a cell phone so that we can contact him any time.  He helped us place a reservation for dinner at the Palazzo, the Royal Service Italian restaurant.  
Our only hiccup was that the bellboy didn't bring our bags up to our room till right away.  We were in our travel attire from colder weather, so we were very uncomfortable and just wanted to change into our beach wear badly.
