Even after touring the grounds with Faustino, we waited about another hour before getting our luggage brought to our room.  We had to call Faustino to help us locate our bags, which thankfully he did rather quickly.

Food/Restaurants:
Dinner at Palazzo was decent but not the best, and we had breakfast there the next day as well.  The plating looked great but some of the food was very dry, like they were baking under the heat lamp for too long.   Faustino helped us reserve the Japanese restaurant that night, and we found out that during the slow season, they alternate between the Hibachi section and the Sushi/Fusion section.  We had the hibachi that night, which was just like normal hibachi restaurants.  The third day, we had breakfast buffet at the Market Grill.  It was pretty good, no complaints.  We ate at the Palazzo for lunch, which was decent.  We had dinner at the Market Grill, which was our FAVORITE.  Faustino recommended it for us, and we were so glad we tried it.  The fourth day we had breakfast buffet at the Japanese restaurant.  We weren't too impressed with the selection, and the hash browns were also dry.  We ate lunch at the Market Grill Buffet, which was not as good as dinner, but it did the job.  We ate dinner at the Gabi, and it was really good too.  So, all in all, Market Grill dinner and Gabi dinner were our favorite.  We are excited for the 3 new restaurants that will be opening in December. 

Wedding/Love at First Site:
Racquel was great!  She was very sweet and patient, she answered all of our questions and wrote everything down.  She was detailed and showed us everything.  Our menu tasting was great and was held at the Gabbi.  We loved the way the Gabbi restaurant, terrace, and beach looked.  We are pretty happy with all of the venue options, only wish there was an indoor ceremoy option besides the ballroom, but this isn't too big a deal.  We then met with the decor and photography company representatives.  They were both nice, especially the photography company.  

Nighttime entertainment:
This was one of our favorite parts.  Other times you visit all inclusive resorts, you can run out of things to do at night.  Here, there was singing and dancing, shows, a small casino, a bar/lounge.  All in all, the atmosphere was great and we had a lot of fun. 

Others:
 -  Wifi coverage is not great, but works well in certain locations like the Royal Service Lounge. 
 -  All staff were very friendly and helpful.  Some didn't speak English too well, but at the restaurants/bar/spa you won't really experience this problem.
-  The rooms are a little bit dated, but it's not bad enough to complain.
-  There is some construction going on right now, but that should all be over in December.  3 new restaurants and a family concierge section will be open for use then, which is exciting.
-  Pools are nice and there is a lot of space.
-  It rained 2 of the 5 days we were there. The storms are strong but pass by really quickly.  We had a whole day that was kind of gloomy, but the next day was bright and beautiful again.  

SPECIAL SHOUT OUT TO Racquel and Faustino!  Thanks for making our experience wonderful!

reviews.author: Rjsexton
reviews.title: Beautiful property and excellent service!
reviews.text:
We were treated like royalty upon arrival. Almost all the staff were friendly, professional and very helpful.  I have to especially call out the excellent service we received from our butler Yohelvi Aracena.  He made everything so easy and I would definitely recommend the Royal Service upgrade which includes the butler service.  The smaller, intimate settings at the exclusive pool, beach and restaurants really put the Royal Service over the top.  The cabana beds by the pool--awesome!

At the pool bar, Leonardo Mota and Jorge could not have taken better care of us.  We started each morning with fresh coconut waters.  From there we had delicious dirty bananas, coco locos, pina coladas and more.  I loved the Presidente beer as well.

The room was nice and clean.  We had a large balcony overlooking the garden.  The other side of the property was under construction, though it did not impact our stay.

The spa facility is very pretty and the entire experience is very tranquil.  Go early and take advantage of the hydrotherapy baths.  I loved the body scrub (with outdoor shower) and facial.  

The property is a nice size and all the restaurants, bars and shops are easily accessible.  Take sunscreen and bug spray--outrageously priced at the gift shop.  I would suggest taking small U.S. bills.  They are easily accepted everywhere for tips or purchases.

reviews.author: Beachgirl1226
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with great service!
reviews.text:
I am giving this 5 star rating considering this is an all inclusive resort and we had the upgraded stay. You really feel like you are walking into Paradise when you enter the resort. The entry view is breath taking. We stayed in the adults only Royal Service section of the Paradius Palma De Real. We were pretty close to the beach and had a glimpse through the trees of the ocean although we had an "ocean view" room. The trees could use some trimming. 

Food

The food was really good! I was surprised and the high quality of the restaurants. You can expect Caribbean Lobster (not Maine and make sure you tell them not to over cook it), steak, shrimp and lamb. Make sure you visit the restaurants in the Reserve side. They are very nice and food is good. The room service was very good. I would highly recommend the grilled fish. We enjoyed dinner at the Palazzo as well. 

Service

The service was top quality and beats much of the service in the US. The royal service is the only way to go for access and special treatment. 

Drinks
They have mid to top brands in alcohol selection. Absolut, Remi, Jim Bean, Hennessy and only El Presidente for Beer. Loved the service Pedro (drink service on the beach) and Leonardo on the Royal Beach provided!! Drinks kept coming and they were good. Go to the bars at the Reserve for even more top quality drinks. 

You must see the Michael Jackson show on Saturday nights! Wow!! We thought Michael was in the building!!

Advice

Resort Credits: Do not worry about the resort credits. These have a lot of restrictions... one per service, one per day, partial credit, match only. We barely used ours.

Tips

This is hard. If you tip everybody all the time, it becomes somewhat stressful. Do you have change? Was it enough? Was it too much? What about someone that had great service but normally would not receive tips (hostess or chef)? My advice here is tip when you feel it is appropriate but don't stress if you miss someone or it is not convenient for you. Tough part is in the US often gratuity is included and the service is sub par. Here the service is almost always excellent. So it's hard. 

Butler

This was our first time having the personalized butler service. We arrived on our actual anniversary around 3 pm. I was kind of hoping for a perfect evening since I had the butler but I knew it might not be. My butler booked us at the Market Grille (least favorite, just ok). Our room was not turned down for the evening (this is nightly service were they turn your bed down, straighten up, dim lights and turn music on) and we were not able to turn off the TV (this was fixed the next day). So our first night was mediocre as far as what I was expecting with the butler service and the remainder of the trip with the butler was ok but definitely could have been better. I had to request a few things multiple times and we were told we had a reservation to a restaurant which was closed. We did not receive a tour and we were not told about all the things we had access to (water sports, restaurants, tennis etc)  Our butler was fairly new to the industry and very nice but probably needs a little more training. I heard great things about the other butlers. We still left a nice tip but it could have been more.

Overall we loved this vacation. The off season is quiet and not as many people. The weather was great. Beautiful resort! Excellent service. Book it!

reviews.author: Linds-Blaine D
reviews.title: Best Honeymoon Ever!
reviews.text:
Wow!  Where to even begin?  My husband and I got married August 30th, and stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real September 1st - 6th, 2014.  We booked a luxury vacation package through United Vacations, which included First Class Tickets, transportation to/from the hotel, and the Royal Service at the hotel.  Our honeymoon was top notch from start to finish.  As soon as we arrived at the hotel, someone took our luggage, escorted us to the royal service check-in area, and immediately brought us two mimosas.  I swear - they are the best mimosas I've ever had!!  We arrived before check-in, around 2pm, so after we were given our wrist bands, etc. they took our bags, and showed us right downstairs to eat lunch at the Palazzo.  When we finished lunch, we met our butler Augustin Nunez, who gave us a tour of the entire property (while he carried my bag for me!), and promptly took us to our room.  

Augustin took phenomenal care of us!  We were so impressed!  He made our honeymoon unforgettable.  From making our reservations (we didn't know what restaurants to select, so he surprised us every day, and just told when and where to show up!  No thinking involved.); to making sure we were well taken care of on the beach and at the pool (thanks Pedro!), bringing us drinks, and even learning our patterns.  We asked for ice on the first day, and from then on, he brought us ice every afternoon at 4pm!  He reserved a Bali bed for us by the pool one day too! He even surprised us with a romantic bubble bath twice!    

Nelson, our man at the bar!  On the first day, I didn't know what to order, so I just asked him to surprise me.  I swear - it was the best drink I have ever had!  He called it La Creme de la Creme.  Order it!  You won't regret it!  From then on - every time I showed up at the bar, he started making one for me, I didn't even have to ask.  On the third day, they switched bar tenders at the Royal Service Bar - Leonardo who was just as amazing and so friendly, but he didn't know what Nelson put in the drink!  We tracked Nelson down at a bar all the way across the resort, and he continued to take care of us!  Again - we would walk up, and he would start making our drinks for us!  It was pure heaven!  I will have to say that Leonardo was wonderful, and he makes a mean pina colada and margarita!

We stayed at the resort for 5 days, and every day was beyond amazing!  We would wake up late, eat breakfast, and head to the beach where Pedro would take great care of us!  He would either have a Palapa Bed, or a beach lounge chair all ready to go for us, and then bring us a drink!  We would get in the ocean, lounge, read books, and even napped!  Pure paradise!

The food itself was decent, but not knock-your-socks-off.  I saw a LOT of negative reviews about the food...  It's truly not that bad!  I don't know what people expect from an all-inclusive - everything was included and you can get as much as you want, so for that I have no complaints.  If you're only going for the food, you may want to choose somewhere else.  We went for a relaxing honeymoon, and our expectations were surpassed!  Our best meal, by far, was Vento.  But we really enjoyed Bana as well as Gabi Beach bar.

Our only complaint was the hot water.  There were a few days where we had to take cold showers...  Not a huge deal, because the weather was warm, but kind of a bummer after long days of sun, salt, and sand.  

As far as the complaints about the employees at the hotel not speaking English well....  You went to a Spanish-speaking country... why don't you try to learn their language!!  Every employee that we came across at that hotel was amazing.  Their English was great, and even if you tried to speak Spanish to them, they were so appreciative!  

Overall, we couldn't have asked for a better honeymoon!  It was an amazing 5 days, and our only regret was that it wasn't longer!  We came back relaxed, rejuvenated, and ready for our next trip!  Thanks Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Aletha S
reviews.title: Ooooolaaalaaa
reviews.text:
Not knowing what to expect, I found myself overly pampered...even spoiled!   The clean, friendly and gracious resort and staff made the Royal Service a "must have".   There were many activities and entertainment on the resort as well as off of the property.  (Although we were able to fill our days and evenings for seven days and only left the resort twice for a fun buggy tour and shopping.)
September was an excellent time to visit; the resort was active with people and excitement without the lines as restaurants and cabanas were  available with Fermin's reservation.    Besides our butler Fermin, we relied on Francisco Cabrera at pool side.   He made us feel as tho he had been ready and waiting for our arrival as our cabana or lounge chairs we personally prepared and ready for our use.   He would go above his duties with gracious conversation, extra towels, drinks and offer suggestions as needed.  
Sr. Johnfi Rivera and Leonardo visited us often to make sure that all of our needs were met and that we were comfortable.   A friendly face is always a comfort. :)
The beach is cleaned daily and Beautiful!   Even with some September rain, the (periodic) rain was extremely short-lived and a non-bothersome event.  An umbrella is available in the room if need be.    Two suggestions for visitors; new sunblock and a hat!  They do have beautiful designer hats and cute baseball hats at reasonable prices at the resort as well.    Other than that, no worries as the Paradisus staff will definitely care for your every need!

reviews.author: Clarissa
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!
reviews.text: Ótima estadia! Passei minha lua de mel no hotel e foi maravilhoso! Atendimento nota mil! Pagamos pelo Royal Service com nosso mordomo Johnfi Rivera e foi execelente! Vale muito a pena! Indico a todos!

reviews.author: Rafael G
reviews.title: Excelente lua de mel
reviews.text:
Estive em minha lua de mel no hotel e, altamente indico!!! Comida e bebidas excelentes. Usei o royal service.... vale muito apena. Nosso mordomo, Johnfi Rivera foi um achado na viagem.... muito simpatico, prestativo e solicito. 
Restaurante pallazo eh o melhor de todos. Quem pudee, use o serviço real! Vale a pena!!

reviews.author: Michiflan
reviews.title: Mission Accomplished!!
reviews.text: This was exactly the luxurious getaway we were looking for!  We had a beach front room with Royal service--a must have!  Our butler, Fermin, was very efficient, helpful, and thoughtful. He took care of all the reservations to restaurants, cabanas, and transportation, etc, allowing us to have a worry free and pampered experience. He also had extra nice surprises awaiting our return to our room; fruit plates, cheese trays, and romantic jacuzzi preparation.  Francisco Cabrera was awesome in making our mornings and afternoons on the beach and at the pool everything we wanted and more, Muchas gracias, Fransisco! Leonardo, our expert bartender, was attentive and very joyful, and Johnfi Rivera checked on us frequently as well even though he was not our butler.  Everyone, throughout the resort, was so very friendly and helpful and it was obvious that their mission was to make our experience a very relaxing and memorable one.  Mission accomplished!!

reviews.author: Louisa L
reviews.title: Royal service bartender!
reviews.text: Leonardo is an amazing bartender! Was attentive to our every need, and never left our drinks empty!!!! Try the coco loco they are amazing. The entire royal service staff has been beyond our expectations, and have made our honeymoon so special!

reviews.author: Juan C
reviews.title: Del Paradisus al Paraíso
reviews.text: Es la segunda vez que no hospedamos en este resort y lo hemos hemos disfrutado aún más que la primera si cabe. Las instalaciones son estupendas y se van actualizando,entre otras cosas han incorporado nuevos servicios de spa y nuevos restaurantes de los que destacaría el Palazzo y el Passion. Este último es especialmente recomendable tanto por la comida por el personal que gustosamente presenta y comenta cada uno de los platos con nosotros estuvieron Julio Cesar y Héctor que lo hicieron estupendamente.De lo que más disfrutamos fue de la  playa privada del hotel  con bebidas y aperitivos durante todo el día servidos por un personal de lo más amable y servicial destacar a Pedro y Jorge Acevedo que estuvieron muy atentos de nosotros.Y como no agradecerle a nuestro mayordomo Yohelvi que cordinó y se anticipó a todas nuestras necesidades para que nuestra estancia fuera una autentica gozada.

reviews.author: Caalbrecht
reviews.title: Ótima estrutura com funcionários que deixam a desejar
reviews.text:
Ótimo hotel, estrutura gigantesca. Ótimas piscinas, Restaurantes bem estruturados, menos o bana Sushi, que não tem condições de atender a quantidade de mesas que disponibiliza, só vá la se não tiver fome e quiser esperar uma hora para começar a comer.
Recomendo o Royal service, pois tem varias vantagens e tem um mordomo que lhe facilita as coisas. Nao espere ser paparicado, pois o mordomo somente é para lhe facilitar um pouco das coisas do hotel.
Achei um pouco constrangedora a situação de ter que pagar gorjeta para tudo. Se você não paga, nao ganha nada. Vai pra praia e nao tem cadeira, não tem bebida, nao tem preferencia, ou seja. Se nao pagar gorjeta, vale a pena você ficar num quarto barato para pelo menos economizar e aproveitar a mesma estrutura que os outros.
Tem um atendente de praia, na área do Royal service, se nao me engano o nome é martin. Um meio gordinho. Se você nao pagar gorjeta, ele nao lhe da nem bom dia, imagine so se voce vai arrumar cadeira e bebida. Esse funcionario tira a qualidade do hotel. Alem do mais, na praia e na piscina, nao tem petisco, isso sao regras do hotel. So batatinha em saco.
Recomendo os quartos do segundo andar, com vista para o Melia. Pois pegam sol pela manha. A umidade do ar é muito alta, entao quartos no nivel do chao alem de escutar os funcionários trabalhando, sofrem uma ação de mofo muito forte.
No mais, recomendo o hotel, pois fica numa posição muito privilegiada da praia e tem uma estrutura muito confortável.
Recomendo agendar os restaurantes do the reserve, pois sao mais novos e melhores, caso nao consiga, o vento é o melhor, pois o melhor atendimento é la.

reviews.author: JennStlar
reviews.title: Best vacation we've ever taken
reviews.text: Leonardo at the sunset bar is the best! He has the best service. Johnfi was also so great. I'll come back to the Paradisus Palma resort Dominican Republic for Leonardo's service Royal Service is totally worth it.

reviews.author: Xrijs466
reviews.title: Perfekter Urlaub
reviews.text:
Perfekter Urlaub mit exzellentem Essen und Service. Leonardo macht die besten Cocktails an der Royal Service Poolbar! Faustinio unser Buttler hat uns alle Wünsche erfüllt. Erwähnenswert ebenfalls das Essen im Palazzo!
Jorge an der Strandbar macht frische Fruchtsmoothies! 
Wir kommen auf jeden fall wieder!
Danke auch an Johnfi für die Unterhaltung!

reviews.author: Usmcbmw
reviews.title: Amazing time!
reviews.text: Leonardo mota and Johnfi riveria at the sunset bar are the best! Awesome coco locos Made in a fresh picked young coconut...yum!!! Was worried coming in September with hurricane season but the weathers perfect, ocean is beautiful and resort is very relaxing especially without the summer crowd👌

reviews.author: K G
reviews.title: Royal Service Great Exp
reviews.text:
When we first arrived Piterson Francois took care of us in the VIP lounge area he was very pleasant and helpful.  Then we were excorted to our room by our butler  was Feimin Motta he took very good care of us for 5 days.  He went over and beyond for our group. I will be requesting Feimin every time I stay at this resort he gave us the best service ever no matter how many times we called he always arrived with a smile.

rm# 2086

reviews.author: anrenav
reviews.title: La tercera vez y volveremos...
reviews.text:
La tercera vez en el Paradisus Palma Real, y como hacía algo más de tres años de nuestra última visita y mi última crítica al resort, bien merece una actualización con las nuevas impresiones y todos los cambios.

Nuevamente volvimos a alojarnos en Royal Service, si viajas en pareja y sin hijos es la mejor opción. A destacar que la mayor parte de los cambios producidos en el hotel han sido en esta área. 

En primer lugar han creado una nueva recepción exclusiva para los clientes de Royal Service, que aunque se encuentra más alejada del lobby principal que la anterior (ahora en su lugar hay una discoteca), destacar su amplitud y las maravillosas vistas a la piscina principal y el mar. La nueva recepción se encuentra encima del nuevo restaurante exclusivo para clientes de Royal Service y a su vez junto al antiguo Spa del resort, ahora exclusivo también para Royal Service. Esta nueva zona, cuenta con sofás y bebidas premium (Brugal Siglo de Oro, Unhiq XO…), 6 iMac para uso de los clientes y la atención personalizada de Piterson Francois que, con mucho gusto, se encargará de hacerte sentir un cliente VIP y especial.

Desde antes de la llegada, el hotel contacta con el cliente y le envía un cuestionario con las preferencias con respecto al tipo de habitación (planta baja, primera planta, segunda, cama doble o dos camas…), tipo de almohada, tipo de bebida preferida…, en nuestro caso solicitamos la misma habitación en la que habíamos estado alojados la última vez y “deseo concedido”. Sin embargo con el tema de la almohada y la bebida se les olvidó, la almohada tuvimos que pedirla (la tuvimos las dos últimas noches de toda la semana) y la botella de bienvenida nunca nos llegó. No obstante tampoco fue un problema, estamos en un todo incluido :-).

El check in se realiza cómodamente mientras te ofrecen un cóctel de bienvenida y una toalla refrescante. Te ponen los brazaletes y esperas a tu mayordomo que te acompañará a la habitación. En nuestro caso tuvimos la gran suerte de contar con la profesionalidad y buen hacer de Jonhfit Rivera, que se ocupó absolutamente de todo lo que necesitamos, nos hizo las reservas en todos los restaurantes, nos preparó el jacuzzy y nos dejó quesos y dulces en la habitación, todo con una absoluta discreción y dedicación para hacernos sentir únicos. Gracias Jonhfit por todos los detalles y por estar pendiente de que todo fuera perfecto. 

Otra de las cosas que han cambiado en el resort es que se han incluido más habitaciones al concepto Servicio Real, aun así si viajas en temporada baja (el verano español) no notarás la zona especialmente masificada.

Con respecto a las habitaciones nos ha sorprendido muy gratamente el increíble esfuerzo de mantenimiento y conservación que han hecho, la habitación parecía más nueva que la última vez que estuvimos. A destacar la limpieza, absolutamente perfecta (y somos un tanto especiales para ese tema). El funcionamiento del aire acondicionado sigue siendo el mejor de todos los resorts de la zona que hemos visitado, puedes tenerlo toda la noche sin escucharlo y sin coger un resfriado, es realmente muy bueno. 

La reposición tanto del mueble bar como de las amenidades del baño perfecta, todos los días eran repuestos. Únicamente señalar que la descubierta de cama nos la hicieron solo las dos últimas noches, pensábamos que era un servicio que habían eliminado. Nos dijeron que no lo habían hecho el resto de días porque teníamos el cartel de “no molestar” en la puerta (evidentemente lo poníamos hasta que nos íbamos a cenar a las 8:30, pero a partir de esa hora no), entendemos que debieron venir muy pronto y luego ya no volvían para comprobar que ya no había cartel. No obstante los últimos días lo hicieron y es de agradecer llegar a la habitación y encontrarte con la cama abierta, bombones e incluso una botella de agua y un vaso en la mesilla. Todo un detalle que marca la diferencia entre el lujo y el gran lujo.

La zona de piscina sigue exactamente como siempre y el cambio se ha producido en la zona de playa que se ha ampliado (ahora será como el doble de lo que había antes) y además hay un bar de frutas.

En esta zona destacar el increíble servicio de los mayordomos de la playa, su profesionalidad, simpatía y buen hacer al preparar las tumbonas y estar pendientes de todo lo que quieras tomar. Gracias Martín Tineo, gracias Francisco Cabrera (que incluso se acordaba de nosotros de la última vez), gracias Pedro, no puede existir persona más alegre, siempre regalándonos su simpatía, gracias por vuestra amabilidad y sonrisa cada día.

Otra de las novedades del resort es el exclusivo restaurante Palazzo para clientes de Royal Service, el mismo se puede usar para desayunar, comer y cenar. Habiendo probado todos los restaurantes del resort, incluso el antiguo bufet Naos, actualmente en reforma debido a un incendio que provocó su destrucción y que ha motivado una amplia reforma (están construyendo un nuevo restaurante y una zona de recepción exclusiva para el Family además de habitaciones nuevas), o el antiguo Vento (exclusivo para desayunos y comidas para el Royal), tenemos que dar nuestra felicitaciones al resort por el excelente trabajo que han hecho con el restaurante Palazzo. La calidad de la comida es tan buena como de costumbre y el servicio es atento, profesional y muy rápido. Destacar la labor de Jeferson Conde que todos los días nos recibía con nuestros zumos y bebidas sin ni siquiera pedirlas, o el nuevo gerente del Palazzo, siempre atento a que no nos faltara de nada. Nos han hecho sentir como auténticos reyes.

Como mejora para el hotel nos permitimos el lujo de sugerir incluir en la carta del Palazzo “el plato del día”, un plato diferente cada día cocinado en base a la disponibilidad del mercado y que permitiría a los huéspedes una variedad que en el actual momento se nos antojó un tanto limitada (si te alojas más de una semana se puede hacer un tanto tedioso comer todos los días de la misma carta y la calidad del resto de restaurantes del resort a la hora del almuerzo está un tanto alejada de la del restaurante Palazzo).

En esta ocasión tuvimos la ocasión de disfrutar del resto de restaurantes del resort para la cena, Vento, Bana Tempanyaki, Market Grill, Gabi Beach (siguen tan buenos como siempre), e incluso el nuevo restaurante Passion del que merece la pena una mención especial. Nos decidimos por el menú degustación y el maridaje de vinos (aquí tenemos que dar las gracias a la Gerente del restaurante, la Sra. Meritxell que nos ofreció el maridaje antiguo a pesar de no tenerlo ya en la carta y que nos trató excelentemente, nuestras más sinceras felicitaciones por el servicio y el buen trabajo que está haciendo). Con respecto a la comida, nos encantó, el guiño a la fusión de la comida autóctona con la comida española absolutamente genial. Sinceramente ha sido una grata sorpresa y un verdadero placer contar con una opción de tanta calidad. Un 10 para todos, desde la cocina al servicio, como el sumiller y su gerente.

Con respecto a la animación por las noches, indicar que la misma está más enfocada al turismo americano (la mayoría del hotel) y que actualmente ya no es tan “tranquila” como lo era antaño, también hemos notado que la clientela antes era de una edad más elevada que la actual, algo que en ocasiones se puede tornar incómodo ya que algunos “jóvenes” tienen la horrible costumbre de llevar su música allá por donde van y que por ello tengas que soportar el ruido de su altavoz en la playa o en la piscina (que si a todos nos diera por hacer lo mismo, el hotel sería una jaula de locos). En este sentido no estaría de más algún cartel que prohiba tales conductas incivilizadas dentro del hotel por respeto a los clientes que quieren descansar y que escogen este hotel y no otros en los que la música alta en piscinas y playa es lo habitual.

Otro de los aspectos que nos gustaría comentar es la labor de los tan comentados vendedores del Club de Vacaciones de Meliá. Nos decidimos por asistir a su presentación e informarnos y aunque debido a nuestros actuales compromisos profesionales no es una opción en este momento para nosotros, nos trataron muy bien y Jacqueline fue profesional, amable y nos expuso el programa con total claridad. 

Finalmente no queríamos cerrar nuestra opinión sin destacar la labor y profesionalidad de Nathalie Green, todos los días pendiente de que nuestra estancia fuera perfecta, genial su simpatía y amabilidad. Nos hizo sentir especiales.

Sr. Torres, nuestras mas sinceras felicitaciones por el excelente trabajo que ha hecho y está haciendo como director del Palma Real, ha conseguido lo imposible, que el hotel se vea más nuevo que hace tres años, que sea mejor de lo que ya era, que sus empleados sean más eficientes y tan amables y entrañables como siempre se han caracterizado, uno de los principales motivos por los que volver, volver y volver a la República Dominicana y en concreto al Paradisus Palma Real. No hace ni tres días que nos hemos ido y ya estamos planeando cuando regresar.

reviews.author: ivo234
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: Let me start by saying that this is the third time I come to this resort. I'm a Melia member and go to a lot of their resorts. You will always get excellent service and attention. On this trip, Michelet Loase from Sunrise Bar was amazing. My husband would ask the man that cuts down coconuts  for coconuts and Michelet would prepare wonderful coconut drinks with the fresh coconuts. Always willing to please! The food is good quality varied and fresh.The only complain I have about this stay is that we were not made aware that they were rebuilding the Building next to the Members buildings and private pool and the construction was 24/7 with very annoying jack hammering starting at 7 AM. It is scheduled to be completed for December. So if you are booking and are not a member make sure you ask for rooms the furthest from the construction. If you are a member and don't mind the noise then you are good to go. They other thing is that at this time, wifi only worked in the lobby area, which was a little bit annoying because you had to go there for reception and the grounds are large so it was a walk. The good hing is , it cuts down your internet-work dependancy, remember, you're suppose to be on vacation. LOL Because other than that, everything else was great.

reviews.author: TheEwings2014
reviews.title: Service was spectacular
reviews.text: My wife and I honeymooned at this resort, the best service I have ever had, Johnfi absolutely made our trip exactly what we needed, he always tended to us and went above and beyond. He even took our pictures, basically a mini photo shoot, he is an excellent photographer. And he always kept fresh Coco Locos in our hands.  To be continued...

reviews.author: Luiz05
reviews.title: Lua de mel perfeita!
reviews.text:
Hotel lindo, praia maravilhosa, comida fantastica e otimas bebidas!
Leonardo Mota é o melhor bartender na piscina. Johnfi e Omar Motta o melhores mordomos!
As atividades sao muito boas. O bar no royal service tem cerceja gelada e otimos drinks!

reviews.author: lucasmodolo
reviews.title: Muito bom
reviews.text: Estamos tendo uma ótima lua de mel. Os quarto é muito legal. Praia muito bonita e boa comida. O bar da piscina  (sunset) é muito bom com Leonardo Mota e Johnfi Rivera e o chopp é gelado. Recomendamos o hotel!!!

reviews.author: Licey7
reviews.title: A real 5 star service. Luxury inclusive. Personnel best asset!
reviews.text:
This is a real 5 star luxury service hotel. Very different from the all inclusive concept in Punta Cana and Bavaro. The best asset is the personnel. All of them are amazing, very integrated with the clients. 
All my family really enjoy the staying in this hotel.
Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Briannawrist
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: The staff was unbelievable! Truly paradise on earth! Leonardo and Johnfi made each and every day feel like the most incredible day of my life. This is my first time to Paradisus Palma Real but it certainly won't be the last time I come here!

reviews.author: ThiagoSampaio
reviews.title: Melhor Hotel
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palmareal Muy Bueno!!!! Serviço muito bom!
Leonardo Mota, Johnifi Rivera, Pedro Cedano e Omar (Mordomo), são excelelentes!!!
ROYAL SERVICE, serviço diferenciado!!!
Praia com águas quentes e cristalinas!
O serviço de praia não é igual ao do Brasil, não tem petiscos!

reviews.author: jaa0136
reviews.title: Awesome honeymoon!
reviews.text: Everything was beautiful! Service was great and the people were friendly and super attentive. Recommend getting the Royal Service! Thank you to Leonardo Mota and Johnfi Rivera! They were absolutely great and provided awesome service! The beaches were beautiful! The Sunset bar was the best! Ask for a baby maker!

reviews.author: Jorge Lazo Arias
reviews.title: Vacaciones espectaculares
reviews.text:
El hotel es espectacular. Las habitaciones son súper amplias, la atención es de primera. 
La comida a la hora del almuerzo no es tan variada, por eso estuve más en el grill, sin embargo los restaurtantes de la noche son geniales.
Tuve la oportunidad de quedarme seis días y pude ir a 5 restaurantes, incluyendo el que tenía 7 estrellas michelin...simplemente vale lo que cuesta!
Definitivamente volvería a ir.

reviews.author: Lesley B
reviews.title: An amazing stay with only a couple hiccups
reviews.text: Everything wasn't PERFECT, but it was near close to it.  We're picky when it comes to how we spend our money, and we feel like this trip was money well spent.  We had the Royal Service and yes, it was worth the extra.  Only had one food disappointment the whole trip and that was at an open air food bar late int he afternoon not really during a meal time frame.  Other than that, food was great, drinks were okay (but we're not drinkers so it's hard to give an opinion).  Resort vouchers were barely worth it, but they were included with a stay of 5+ nights.  Overall, would even consider returning for another vacation.

reviews.author: Victoria L
reviews.title: excelente servicio y cordialidad
reviews.text:
en general estuvo excelente nuestra estadía, nos atendieron muy cordialmente, las instalaciones son preciosas y muy limpias.
solo dos detalles, internet (Wi Fi) no llegaba a las habitaciones (3636) y si llegaba era un momento muy corto y se caía o si uno se alejaba del hall también se perdía.
Lo otro fue la descordinación total de las reservas en los restoranes para la cena, nunca nos respetaron las hora reservada y  a veces ni siquiera estábamos anotados, debíamos exigir (no sin insistencia) que nos atendieran igual ya que andábamos con 4 niños (debían cenar)...ahí pasamos unos malos momentos.

reviews.author: Fred E
reviews.title: Best Customer Service EVER!!!
reviews.text:
My fiancee and I just returned from a 6 night stay in the Dominican Republic for my birthday. Im a huge baseball fan and had never been to DR so it was definitely on my bucket list and Paradisus Punta Cana did not let me down. From the time we got off the shuttle we were thoroughly impressed with the quality of service and the amenities. We stayed at "The Reserve" section of the resort which was phenomenal their employees including Yeison Tejada, Yadilky Mercedes, Anabel, and Silvio the Guest Services Manager provided a first class service.
Yeison should run for President. He is one of the most attentive and detailed oriented people i have encountered. He really set the bar VERY high for quality customer service. Yadliky Mercedes is one of the sweetest girls you can ever meet like most of the staff they work very hard to provide effortless quality service and we loved it. 
The facility is gorgeous. The suites are gorgeous and exceptionally well maintained (On a sidenote: to keep the mesquitos away at night keep the room temp set on the temp they set it at 64 just use blankets) The pool and the beach areas could you some updating, minor cosmetics, it is all made up for by the service. The classes are cool i really enjoyed the cigar rolling. The maids always found creative ways to make our bed and they come in twice a day big plus. For my birthday they put ran the tub (hot when i arrived) put rose petals in the tub had champagne on ice and chocolate covered strawberries. My fiancee was thoroughly impressed needless to say. 
Lastly, the reason this place did not get a excellent is because of the Melia sales people. They are way too pushy. Even after you tell them No they send another sales person then another sales person then another!! They're going to start at like $50,000 then by the end asking for $2,000. If i wasnt so cheap and wanted the BOGO adventure boogie trip i would not have went and i regretted every minute of it. Even though this is not a review of Adventure Boogie the trip was awesome and worth paying full price for FYI.

reviews.author: Alexandre C
reviews.title: MARAVILHOSO
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso! Instalações perfeitas, entretenimento todas as noites, piscinas muito boas, comida maravilhosa, funcionários atenciosos e alto astral em todas atividades. Área da praia muito bem servida, bares de apoio também excelentes. Recomendo muito

reviews.author: Barb1021
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience! The staff was so great! Everyone was helpful and friendly at all times! We had a minor situation with another guest and the hotel staff was quick to help and fix the issue. The food was good. The rooms were nice! The staff at the Hydro Grill was beyond amazing! They truly went above and beyond to give our family an extraordinary experience! I'd LOVE to go back sooner than later. I'd recommend this resort to anyone!

reviews.author: GolfGA
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation - Our pool bartender "Fuego" made the trip!
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful vacation.  the staff was incredible; however, "Fuego" was over the top and just made our trip great.  Every morning he would get us set up with drinks, popcorn for our girls and made our trip real special.  The food, the resort, the accomodation's were all great.

reviews.author: nati858
reviews.title: super vacaciones
reviews.text: Primera vez en paradisus palma real pero no la ultima sin dudas volveremos principalmente para ver de nuevo al personal del servicio por que nos an tratado marivillosamente en el bar Leonardo mota y el mayordomo Johnfi Rivera y Jose Salvador y martin Tine pedro Cedano son personas sumamente profesionales muy cinpaticos y sin duda volveros la comida en todos los restaurantesa sido estupendas y en palazzo gracias a smerlyn olea  gracias Johnfi Leonardo por hacer nuestra estadia in olvidable......

reviews.author: BeeJ864
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text:
Pros: We really liked the Yhi Spa, Aqua restaurant, Casino and shuttles. Service was excellent. Staff were very friendly. The resort was clean and in order. It has a wonderful tropical theme and was not overcrowded.

Cons: As with most resorts, the rooms could be dusted better (dust free). We asked, they came right away and dusted every surface. The Meila TimeShare spiel was unwelcome, but if you tell them you are not interested, they do not push. Smoking should not be allowed in the casino. The cigar smoke ran most of the non-smokers out. It was sickening. And the mosquitos are abundant.

Location: There is a mall within walking distance, but they have a shuttle to take you. Excursions are available. Water sports are included at the beach.
This resort was amazing. Service was great in all aspects. The moment you arrive you are treated like a welcome guest. Every detail is accounted for from the scented wet wash cloths and fruit infused water in the lobby, to the availability of 24 hour shuttles to take you all over the resort. We were celebrating our anniversary so the resort surprised us with champagne and a rose petal jacuzzi waiting for us when we came back to our room one evening. Our personal concierge, Dalliance, was an added plus. He was very professional and helpful, trying to make sure that every thing we could ask for was taken care of. The resort itself...amazing. Everywhere you look there were covered cabanas and little nooks where you could be alone and just relax. It was not an adult only resort, but it could have been. The pool was set up so that you could almost feel like you had the whole thing to yourself. The Spa is an experience. We had a couples massage that we never wanted to end. The various restaurants in the resort served great quality food, from steaks to lobster tail. They even have exercise classes and other workshops. It was great being able to use both resorts (The Reserve and Palma Real) equally. Overall we had a really lovely vacation.

reviews.author: Nicholas Adam S
reviews.title: Our wonderful honeymoon trip! Place was absolutely amazing
reviews.text: We were very excited about traveling to Punta Cana for our honeymoon. Upon our arrival at Royal Services at Paradisius Palma Real we were treated like kings and queens. The resort and grounds are absolutely stunning. Out butler Yohel was amazing and made all our dinner reservations. He even ran bubble baths for us and surprised us with cheese platters, chocolate covered strawberries. The restaurants were stunning and the food and service was phenomenal. The staff on the beach and around the pool were  awesome as well. Everyone was very friendly and went out of their way to make our honeymoon special. The scuba diving instructor  on the resort at scubaquatic was great and helped us earn our Open Water diving certification while we were there. The beach was wonderful and cleaned daily. This place is a must visit and  we will return time and time again!!! Thank you for helping make our honeymoon spectacular!!!!

reviews.author: Marcelo B
reviews.title: 100% recomendavel!
reviews.text: Um dos noteis mais incríveis em que tive o prazer de conhecer na minha vida! Tem atracões de todo tipo (balada, teatro, restaurantes), e nao tive necessidade quase de sair conhecer a cidade! Podemos passar 1 semana dentro do hotel sem repetir atracões! Recomendo muito!

reviews.author: Ellen S
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text:
The staff always treated you like royalty. We had great service and a great time. Thanks especially  to Raynaldo, Luis, Dionisi, and Franklin for all the great service and fun
There were a lot of dinner choices though lunch was similar had both restaurants
My only complaint would be that there is construction that you had to walk around throughout stay

reviews.author: Angela B
reviews.title: Service at Paradisus
reviews.text: My wife and I went to the Paradisus Palma Real in the summer of 2014.  We absolutely loved the hotel, the food, and most of all the employees.  Dominicans are among the most fun-loving people I've ever met.  Our room service employee, Maria, was amazing.  The pool-bartenders are tons of fun and make great drinks.  And the servers at the restaurants were always timely and friendly.  That said, there are two individuals who stick out the most.  The first was our server, Gregorio Guillen, in the breakfast restaurant.  Hands down the best waiter I've ever had anywhere.  Next was our "butler" or hotel host, or whatever they call the guys assigned to you when you first arrive to help you make reservations and provide info.  Our host's name was "AC" and while he was nice, he was very shady in the way that he conned us into going through the time-share presentation.  You do not need to go to this presentation, even though the host will tell you that you need to.  They get commissions on getting people to attend the presentations, so they'll tell you anything to get you to go.  AC told us that he wouldn't get paid unless we went, and he needed to get paid to buy food for his kids (a true bleeding heart argument). AC also promised us "free" tickets to the dolphin tour--which ended up costing us $100 anyway (the free ticket was for a child ticket, and didn't allow for interacting with the dolphins).  Also, AC said that we could listen to the presentation for 15 minutes and then leave-- but we were quickly taken to a back room and held hostage for almost 3 hours while the resort staff tried to get us to buy into their resort program.  We actually didn't attend the presentation until the 3rd or 4th day, and in the meantime, AC's promises/responsibility to make reservations at the restaurants for the first few nights never materialized--and he always had an excuse.  In reality, you don't even need reservations for the restaurants, just show up and they'll seat you anyway.  The "reservation" strategy is just a way for the hosts to keep in contact with you.  That said, the hotel was amazing and the only single complaint is about AC.  We didn't meet any other hosts, but just be aware that regardless of how nice they are, you don't need to go to the presentation.   Go to this hotel--just avoid AC and the long winded sales pitch.

reviews.author: Matt C
reviews.text: Very beautiful facility. Very nice Beach as well. Beach security does not do a good job w/ keeping locals from soliciting you while you are trying to relax. Waiting staff does not come around very often in beach/pool areas to take orders. Food in resort is average at best. For a Resort in 2014 not to have wifi anywhere but the lobby is unacceptable.

reviews.author: TFCintra
reviews.title: Um sonho de viagem...
reviews.text: O hotel é maravilhoso, a praia é magnifica, o serviço royal dervixe onde é permitido só adultos é o ideal para casais que buscam sossego e tranqüilidade.... Além do disso tem o mordomo a nossa disposição pra quebrar aquele galho a todo momento! O nosso foi o Johnfi, muito atencioso, educado e sempre sorrindo...nos preparou surpresas românticas, fez as reservas dos restaurantes, nos trazia bebidas na piscina, enfim...nos mimou muito! Sem palavras! Experiência que recomendo a todos!!

reviews.author: Danilomelani
reviews.title: Lua de mel dos sonhos!!!!
reviews.text: Lugar paradisíaco. Optamos pelo sistema royal service que ainda mais elevou nossa qualidade de estadia e luxo. Nosso mordomo Johnfi Rivera definitivamente entrou para família, sendo muito atencioso, divertido e prestativo. Nosso jantar no mar foi lindo graças a ele!! Enfim recomendo a todos este lugar magnífico na qual encontramos muita hospitalidade, novas amizades e que deixa muitas saudades.

reviews.author: S Brodrick P
reviews.title: Great staff at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: My wife Kim and I just returned from our fourth visit to Paradisus Palma Real.  We stay in Royal Service and our butler, Johnfi was simply the best! Pedro Cedano was great as was Francisco Gil. Nelson was also terrific!  We hung out at the pool and were sure to stay close to the bar!  Everyone was friendly and the guests were mostly very sociable.  We always enjoy meeting new people.  If you choose Royal Service, I think Johnfi was the best butler we have ever had.  He was very attentive yet not intrusive.  When we left, we had a delay in our transportation and he stayed with us the entire time and followed up with our transportation company to make sure we were taken care of.  There is also a great beach with beverage service.  We did take an excursion to swim with the dolphins.  Glad we did it once but no need to repeat it.

reviews.author: Claudio A
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text:
Hemos estado 10 días junto a otras parejas de amigos, todos con hijos pequeños y es totalmente recomendable. Estuvimos en The Reserve y el área para los niños tanto la piscina como el Kids Club es de lo mejor que hayamos visto.
Es destacable la atención y amabilidad del personal y el servicio de playa excelente, un poco lejos donde se requiere caminar unos 15 minutos o tomar unos carros que te acercan continuamente.

reviews.author: GLWTravels
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Vacation
reviews.text: The wife and I went with some friends to this resort for 6 nights. The atmosphere is perfect for a relaxing vacation. The food was tasty and there were ample options (only under the Royal Service upgrade...do this!). Palazzo was the best restaurant for all meals. Generally the staff was helpful, but our butler, Johnfi Rivera, was exceptional. Get him if you have a choice. He looked for us all the time. Got us drinks while we were in the pool or on the beach. His service made the experience superb. The other butlers were generally not friendly. They would pass you straight without a glance or an "hola" like you didn't exist. That lack of friendliness and the noisy maids were the only real issues we had. It was definitely worth the money.

reviews.author: Gomes1113
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Hotel excelente, restaurantes também. Ficamos no Royal Service, atendimento com mordomo, nota 10. Café da manhã exclusivo, de qualidade insuperável. Perfeito! Os ambientes das piscinas, muito bons. No Royal Service você tem piscina e praia exclusivas!!

reviews.author: Jean K
reviews.title: Outstanding Service!
reviews.text: I stayed at The Reserve at the Paradisus for my first trip to Punta Cana and had a wonderful experience.  The hotel was beautiful, clean and very quiet (Sept 13 - 20th).  There were plenty of restaurants to choose from and a variety of excellent food.  The best part of the trip was the staff, so friendly and helpful.  They were truly what made the experience a great one.  Luis Santana and Santos Polanco took care of us poolside every day.  Once they learned our schedule they anticipated our every need. They were both so pleasant and we had many great discussions about the DR. Next there was our tireless fitness / activity director, Ruben Castillo....what a blast we had with him.  His energy is infectious.  And last, but not least....Yadilky Mercedes....the sweetest, most pleasant person, who greeted us each day with a hug and a smile and made sure we had everything we needed. There were many other great staff...too many to name...who made our entire week one of the most relaxing and enjoyable vacations ever!

reviews.author: Mayamaite
reviews.title: Cumplimos los 25 años de casado en el Palma Real.
reviews.text:
Hemos estado una semana en este hotel, la palabra para definir el hotel es: MARAVILLOSO.
Era nuestra primera vez en República Dominicana y nos hemos ido con ganas de volver en cuanto podamos.
Cuando llegamos al hotel nos atendió en la recepción Johan Cabrera muy atento y agradable a su vez nos presento a Franklin de la Cruz la persona que ha velado por hacer nuestra estancia cómoda y agradable, se ha preocupado de reservarnos los restaurantes para las cenas, de contactar con nuestra agencia de viajes por una consulta que tuvimos que hacer, y en general para todo lo que hemos necesitado, servicial al máximo, gracias Franklin, no nos pudimos despedir.
Los desayunos en el restaurante Naos son amplios y buenos y especial mención a José Rivera por su amabilidad y profesionalidad.
La playa es espectacular, solo que hemos tenido mala suerte y había muchas algas, pero con las piscinas del hotel no hay problema son estupendas, las toallas me las proporcionaba Ángel Araujo con el que podía hablar algunas palabras en catalán es un sol de chico simpático y con muchas ganas de aprender cosas nuevas, se que te gustara que hable de ti, un beso.
El bar de la piscina estupendo con unos cocteles maravillosos que nos preparaba Antonio Ramirez y Luis.
Las actividades en la piscina, muy divertidas con Reyna de Paula, la niña mas simpática y dulce que me he encontrado allí, hacia las mañanas muy divertidas con sus clases.
Los restaurantes son muy buenos mi preferido Vento, pero muy bien desde luego Passion Tean donde nos atendieron de maravilla especialmente : Julio Cesar y Héctor, muy bien también Misu donde te amenizan la cena con un pequeño espectáculo a cargo del propio cocinero.
Ya veis que hasta hora todo genial, cosas para mejorar el wifi, que en la habitación , piscina, playa y algún sitio mas no siempre había, aunque me consta que lo están solucionando, otra cosa que no me gusto fue un mercadillo que hicieron en el hotel ,para celebrar la noche Dominicana, la cena especial, los bailes , ect....muy bien, pero en las compras(que son ajenas al hotel las personas que venden sus productos,pero creo que el hotel debería controlar un poco,ya que el negocio lo hacen su casa.) nos engañaron a base de bien, te piden unos precios abusivos por una botella de ron por ejemplo, luego te van bajando el precio, y cuando sales del hotel alguna excursión y miras los precios fuera se te queda una cara de tonto y una impoténcia de sentirte estafado, que dices porque me tengo que ir , si no a este chico le decía cuatro cosas, de acuerdo que son un país pobre que vive del turismo, pero nosotros colaboramos con nuestra visita al país y nuestras compras, y que te tomen el pelo no le gusta a nadie, en definitiva que tengáis cuidado con las compras y que el  hotel MARAVILLOSO, cuando vuelva a Punta Cana desde luego volveré a Paradisus Palma Real, se me olvidaba la habitación preciosa y muy limpia y los jardines y rincones del hotel preciosos, incluida la familia de flamencos que hay en el jardín,

reviews.author: Craig M
reviews.title: Very spacious room, clean, exotic location
reviews.text:
Utilized this facility thru time share affiliation with RCI.  All inclusive. 
Pluses: Very Clean room, lobby and grounds, bright, beachfront, spacious, pleasant staff, beautiful large  pool, beach swimming, attentive waiters in restaurants and poolside, free beach activities include hobicat, 
Negatives: Large facility and room was a bit of a walk to beach and pool, fire destroyed main restaurant night before our arrival -made for a little inconvenience but resort handled it very well with alternative accommodations. was to have reopened by July 2014. Wifi was very unreliable in room.  Fine in main lobby and poolside. 
Food in restaurants was average in taste but well presented. I would go back but I would also be open to another resort to compare.

reviews.author: Pirata1934
reviews.title: One of our favorite vacations ever
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at Paradisus Punta Cana the reserve. We checked in with Elaidy Montero who helped us with all our questions and when we weren't fully satisfied with our initial room (  no one had stayed in it for a while and it was dusty) she accommodated us right away and moved us to another beautiful room. Adalgisa who is one on the friendliest concierge ever escorted us to our room and was always there if we needed help or advice on what to do or where to go. We ended up getting a family concierge, Hairol was super friendly and helpful setting up activities and reservations at all the restaurants as well as checking in with us constantly to see if there was anything we needed he would get our daughter a nice treat each evening which scored major brownie points with her. The concierge in our building Iris Soriano was always very friendly greeting us with a big smile and helping us with any questions we had. The hostess at Gabi Rosalba Columna and Daniella Castillo were always very friendly and always got us a table close to the pool were we would get a nice breeze while we ate. The waiters at Gabi Ramon Simbert, Jose Reinoso, Adalberto Herrera & our buddy Anthony Cid who took care of anything and everything we needed were great Anthony went out of his way to make us feel welcome. If you need anything while you're by the pool the guy at the grill Melvin  is always ready to whip something up quick and with a smile. While you're sitting by the pool make sure to see Emilo Valdes who is awesome! He treated us like gold and never let my "Emilio Special" run dry. His smile and great attitude made my day everyday. We had a great meal at Mole thanks to Leidy Rodrigues who was very pleasant. The hostess at Vento Katherine Sanchez was also very helpful and accommodating even when we were a "couple " of minutes late for dinner. We also had a great massage at the Yhi spa. Roselina  Del Rosario was great in helping us select what we wanted and scheduling my wife and I for the best reflexology and full body message ever given by Olga Perez. Berlis at kid zone was great with making our daughter feel right at home and relaxed. Isidra de Oca from club Melia was great and was very helpful with all our questions and any needs we had. We also had the pleasure of meeting Juan the club Melia driver who was just a phone call away whenever we needed  to get around the resort.  Overall we had a very pleasant experience and will be back. The beach is amazing with with white powder sand and you can't go wrong getting a drink and laying out in the sun. Thanks for everything everyone. The Mencia family

reviews.author: Dominion K
reviews.title: The vacation to measure all future vacations against.
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed in the Paradisus Palma Real for 7 nights and loved every minute of it. It was so beautiful and relaxing that we had trouble convincing ourselves to leave the resort and go out on a trip. In fact, we only went on one. But I digress. The resort itself is beautiful. There is a great beach with soft white sand. Some days the seaweed gets a bit thick but it is cleaned from the shore every morning. There is a great garden area that was very well designed with great shade and plenty of quiet places to sit and relax. And the pools are amazing with great bars that helped keep our liquid diet at the right levels. All the pools had plenty of chairs as well as tiki huts if we wanted some shade. 

In addition, the staff was amazing. Everyone was extremely helpful, polite, and spoke English. From the moment we checked in, to the moment we checked out, they went above and beyond to ensure we had what we needed and were very quick with answers to any questions we had. We had purchased the “Royal Service” package so we had a butler (Angelo) as well. Angelo was such a help to us in everything from making sure we had plans for dinner at one of their many restaurants every night to ensuring that we had scheduled our ride back to the airport. We didn’t even need to call him for him to come to us. He was always walking around and would come find us several times a day. I even called him one night on his cell phone after he had left for the night because I couldn't remember where we had scheduled to eat dinner that evening and he was just as friendly and helpful as if he was working. When we return in a year or so, we will definitely be asking for him as our butler again. As well as Angelo, I would also like to give a shout out to Nelson, one of the pool bar tenders. He was very fast with the drinks and always had a smile on his face. We worked him hard.

When we booked our trip, there was a special going on where if you stayed 7 or more nights, you got $1,500 worth of “Resort Credit”. From the website it says “Resort Credit to be used towards Room upgrade, Spa treatments, and Premium wine list, among other services.” Their phrasing isn't wrong, but it sure as heck is misleading at best. Yes, we got $1,500 worth, but they were coupons for different things that were mostly useless. Things like the “premium wine list” coupons we did use though there were only about 5 of those, and we used the three Spa coupons, as well as the Gabi Beach dinner coupons. However, easily $500 of the coupons were for their shopping plaza, and it wasn't even like $X off of whatever you buy, it was $10 here and $20 there and only for specific things. Final gripe about the coupons, is about the casino coupons. There was one coupon for $150 match play in their casino. When you try to use the coupon though, they give you a book of $150 worth of $10 match play coupons that can only be used two per night. Even if I was to go there every night, it would take 8 nights to use them all. So, fair warning, don't think you are getting a killer deal because of the “Resort Credit”.

One of the buildings was under construction while we were there but it was surprisingly quiet. It was very rare that we heard anything at all even though we could see them working. They did a great job of muffling the noises and were always cleaning up after themselves. Thinking about it now, I am extremely surprised at how little dust I saw.

Without a doubt, we had a great time there and will be sure to go again. Everyone there from the staff to the other vacationers (Hi Rick and Kim), helped us have an amazing, very relaxing, and memorable vacation.

reviews.author: jose0101
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text: estoy aquí en paradisus palma real pasando las mejores vacaciones que eh tenido en mi vida y con las mejores personas del mundo Leonardo mota en el bar johnfi rivera excelente martín tineo y faustino ramos la comida en palazzo. Super bien la playa y el mejor de todos los bares sunset. Bar las actividades bien nos sentimos muy alagado en este hotel gracias johnfi Leonardo y martin

reviews.author: Judy S
reviews.title: Recent all inclusive trip to Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
From the country's beautiful landscape and beaches to the people at Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana, we had a great and memorable experience.
Our resort concierge, Franklin De La Cruz was extremely friendly, professional and attentive to our needs.  He went above and beyond standard customer service to provide support that made our stay excellent.
Our tour guide to Saona Island, Manuel was outstanding.  He made us laugh, helped us learned and kept our touring family together!  
Bravo, excellenta!

reviews.author: excelent2014
reviews.title: great place
reviews.text:
My husband and I had a wonderful stay at the resort we stay at the club Melia section on building 35 which is closed to the beach, pool and restaurants.
The staff was very helpful and friendly specially Mr Hipolito Sedano he always make sure to assist us on all we needed thank you Hipolito for all your help  also Ms Malvis Garcia at the Melina club welcome center she was very friendly and helpful, thank you Mavis for all your help.
We will come back

reviews.author: Camaguey G
reviews.title: Experiencia en el Hotel Palma Real
reviews.text: Habia una construccion en el Hotel que molestaba vastante  y el servicio de internet era Pesimo realmente no fue lo que me vendieron ademas todas las actividades recreativas son en ingles y la comida  si no tenias reservacion te quedabas sin comer porque de noche solo habia buffet martes y jueves la limpieza es Buena y el trato del personal tambien

reviews.author: Rosalia O
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: Excellent resort at the pool ask for Santo Polanco or Luis Santana the best bartender makes very good cocktails!! And at the lobby Jorge very sympathique guy you feel like home the service prety fast!!! The beach gorgeous.comming back for sure!!😀

reviews.author: Angie C
reviews.title: Trip to Paradise
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with another couple. We both had a wonderful experience. We stayed in the Royal service with an ocean view room. Johnfi Rivera was our butler. Johnfi is very professional and did an outstanding job making our stay extra special and feel like we were the only ones he was serving. Johnfi prepared a bubble bath with flowers and candles one evening. The property was beautiful, clean and well maintained. We enjoyed all the meals we had. 
The negative was that our room a/c was not working properly but the staff worked until it was resolved. Very graciously. Also, thank you to Astrid at check in. 
The photos on their website are very accurate and  is even more beautiful in person.

reviews.author: James Edward S
reviews.title: Our trip to paradise
reviews.text: We had an amazing time staying at this hotel. The activities committee made our stay fun and eventful. Thanks Angel for leading the many social activities.  We also loved the service from Jose',  Genival, and the Gabi Beach Restaurant staff. Thanks for the superior service and delicious meals. We will be back.

reviews.author: Abbyshap
reviews.title: Best resort, best staff!
reviews.text: You haven't seen a great resort until you've stayed at the reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana! The pool, the entertainment, and the restaurants are all incredible, but the beach is unbeatable. The reserve side of the beach was the perfect amount of relaxation and entertainment. The people that work there are so personable and fun to be around. There's never a dull moment at the beach! Be sure to request Luis Santana to be your server. He's the absolute best! You'll LOVE this place!

reviews.author: Verónica F
reviews.title: un 10
reviews.text: Ha sido un viaje fabuloso y el trato de la gente del hotel todavia mejor nunca nos habian tratado tan bien destacar a jonehelli, alexander, julio flores, martin, el animador carlos gomez,los chef francisco y zigor un encanto de personas y ojala algun dia vuelva me habeis echo sentirme como en casa

reviews.author: Kkonatours
reviews.title: Excelente para Lunas de Miel
reviews.text: Viaje en Marzo del año 2013 la habitación super cómoda y lo mejor que todo queda cerca esta muy bien distribuido, la comida es excelente, recomiendo el restaurant teppanyaquyi Bana  los bares también son buenos y si te gusta apostar el hotel tiene un casino buenísismo, la atención del personal es muy amable, la playa es espectacular, lo único que hay lugares en los que solo puedes ir si estas hospedado en la parte mas cara, si no te molesta mucho esto es una excelente opción

reviews.author: Derek M
reviews.title: Wonderful family vacation spot
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at the Reserve portion of this resort.  Our concierge, Andy Constante, was phenomenal, and the service, facilities, food and amenities were top-notch.  Only complaint was our Wi-Fi service was sketchy in various areas which was a bit annoying.  Andy really went above and beyond the call of duty, and we lacked for no comfort we desired.  We hope to return.

reviews.author: maryguz
reviews.title: Unos de los mejores para vacacionar
reviews.text:
En este hotel me sentí de maravilla desde mi llegada, excelentes servicios del personal ambiorix, azael.
La cálida sonrisa de Daniela castillo y sus atensiones que nos hizo sentir como en casa
Amé el lugar, los restaurantes en especial vento se los recomiendo buen servicio de johairo y yadilki. Fuimos tratados como verdaderos reyes

reviews.author: enriqueagustin
reviews.title: Dream Vacation
reviews.text: This hotel feels like home. Anabel, Anuvi, Aura, Joanna go out of their way to make you feel at home and pampered. Miker, Ramón and Jose Luis are awesome bar tenders at the private beach area. Very friendly and beautiful. Highly recommend this hotel. It has been my favorite hotel so far. I will definitely return.

reviews.author: janet h
reviews.title: Wonderful Getaway
reviews.text: We had a fabulous week at Paradisus Palma Real.  The resort and grounds were top notch.  We upgraded to Royal Service with a Regal Ocean view.  We thought the upgrade services and room were great.  Johnfi Rivera was our butler for the week.  He anticipated our every need including a special birthday dinner and candlelit bath.  If you want to be totally pampered in a beautiful scenic resort this is a great place to be.  Our only recommendation for the resort is that some of the restaurants were not up to the quality of the other amenities.  Bana and Palazzo were our favorite restaurants. We would not hesitate to go back again.

reviews.author: Julie D
reviews.title: `outstanding experience
reviews.text: The lush grounds and buildings facilitate as much R and R as your heart desires.  The staff is available and accommodating and the entire resort is clean and groomed at all times.  Sleep in or get up early, there is always food and staff around to assist in whatever you may need.

reviews.author: TravelingAxel
reviews.title: It was a top shelf exquisite experience!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. Johnfi made our experience perfect. Get the Royal Service. The butler service was great. All the staff worked hard to make sure we were having a great time. The food was fantastic. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Danielle Y
reviews.title: Atendimento diferenciado
reviews.text: Além da grande infra-estrutura do Resort, todos os funcionários são muito simpáticos e atenciosos. Ficamos no serviço real onde tivemos um mordomo exclusivo, o Ângelo Mercedes, muito atento e simpático, tornou nossas estadias mais tranqüilas e com serviços que nem imaginávamos como encontrar uma banheira toda preparada com pétalas de rosas e Champagne geladinho para um banho super romântico. Tivemos também um ótimo atendimento nos bares e restaurante como a querida Esperanza e o Alexander do Palazzo ( para nós o melhor restaurante do Resort). Na recepção do Royal Service, além de ser um ambiente super agradável, fomos muito bem recepcionados pelo Piterson Francois com seus drinks ao gosto do freguês..... Se forem para um resort recomendo pagar um pouco mais e ficar no Royal Service.

reviews.author: Maiker R
reviews.title: The Reserve Lo Mejor En Todo El Caribe "Ramon Ramirez y Luis Santana The Best((
reviews.text:
Estuve en The Reserve el fin de semana pasada y puedo decir que pase el mejor tiempo de mi vida!!

Desde mi llegada hasta mi salida el servicio fue maravilloso....el check in fue muy rapido y eficaz,  las habitaciones excelente, los restaurantes de calidad 1A...la comida excelente y las instalaciones del hotel en general son a otro nivel!!!

Quiero agradecer en especial los chicos de la playa The Reserve Ramon Ramirez "The Best", Luis Santana y Oneida Zorrilla!!! A los chicos de la piscina the reserve Jose Luis de Los Santos, Santos Polanco, Emilio y Santos Frías!!

Y los chicos dea piscina Deibe Esquea, Juan Cruz y Pamela Arias!!! Asi como también Christelle Luchini y Silvio Lantigua Managers at

reviews.author: Katie F
reviews.title: Great for couples!
reviews.text:
We just returned from our honeymoon at the Paradisus Palma Real. The hotel is absolutely beautiful! The staff was courteous and really went above and beyond to be accommodating. Our butler, Evian Rodriguez was available by the cellphone provided by the resort. Evian made our restaurant reservations, drew us a bath when requested, provided the scented pillows when requested and was very accommodating to any of our questions or requests. The room was very clean and our refrigerator was always stocked. We paid for Royal Service which gave us access to an additional restaurant Palazzo, a private area by the pool with Bali beds, a lounge with premium liquor and snacks, a hydrotherapy spa and a bar right near the beach. Our bartender there, Leo Mota, was my favorite! Leo was a great bartender with a wonderful personality. 
We really enjoyed our stay but I would recommend this hotel for couples more than I would for a group of friends or for a family vacation. I would definitely upgrade to the Royal Service too since it sounds like getting a restaurant reservation would be hard otherwise.

reviews.author: Michel M
reviews.title: Magnífica estadía y servicios
reviews.text: Gentileza y atención muy especial y muy grata por parte de todo el personal y especialmente del sr. Jose, encargado de la gerencia de la recepción..La arquitectura del hotel es particularmente acogedora .La comida muy buena; sólo mejoraría la pastelería.

reviews.author: Michelle D
reviews.title: Amazing resort Amazing service Amazing employees !!
reviews.text: My husband and I travel yearly on a luxury vacation . This year we chose Punta Cana as a new destination and The Reserve did not disappoint ! The service at this hotel was superior ! The employees were so kind, helpful , and friendly . Our room was amazing and very comfortable . We had a garden room and it was very large , with great amenities . I've been to many spas throughout the us, Hawaii and Canada and this was the best one ever !! The nightly shows and entertainment were fun and entertaining . My favorite things included : Gabi Beach restaurant , Pool activities , room , hydro Grill , spa and the employees !Sky Bar and the Avenue Bar were fun too !

reviews.author: N B
reviews.title: Vacation at The Reserve
reviews.text: Excellent service. Overall a great vacation. We were highly impressed by the team at Gabi's Beach specially Hugo and the entire staff. I highly recommend this hotel and plan to go back in the future. Norberto De La Rosa, our concierge was exceptional. The restaurant choices are variety of food is impressive. One day for lunch we inquire about a typical Dominican lunch and the next day the Chef prepared a special lunch for us.

reviews.author: André Luiz de A
reviews.title: Fantástico !!
reviews.text: Melhor resort que já estivemos. Localizado na melhor parte da praia de Bávaro, o hotel possui estrutura fantástica para proporcionar uma experiência maravilhosa. Optamos pelo Royal Service, o que elevou ainda mais o nível do serviço oferecido. Agradecemos ao nosso mordomo Juan, sempre prestativo. O Royal Service oferece ainda uma área de piscina reservada, onde fomos sempre bem atendidos pelo atencioso e bem humorado barman Leonardo Mota, além de uma praia particular para os hóspedes, onde podemos realmente descansar em um ambiente agradável e tranquilo. Os restaurantes internacionais do Hotel são fantásticos, um melhor que o outro. Um agradecimento especial ao Concierge Franklin de La Cruz, sempre atencioso e disposto a nos proporcionar uma experiência única que esperamos repetir em breve.

reviews.author: TigranDina
reviews.title: Целый комплекс удовольствия
reviews.text:
Номера большие и чистые. Еда разнообразная, американская. 
Если еще не были в Америке, советую попробовать еду. Она иная, чем в старом свете. Совершенно другие вкусовые ощущения! Это для тех, кто любит новые ощущения. Хотя пугали комарами в Доминикане, я их не заметил вообще. Взял против комаров специальный фумигатор и практически (только один раз употребил, да и то впустую) не использовал. Главное ночью не открывать окна.
Рекомендую экскурсии на море. В море у отеля постоянно какая-то тина, но она чистая!!!
Я безразличен к азартным играм, но для любителей - прекрасное казино. Для таких как я - прекрасное кино наяву - особенно, когда кто-то выигрывает крупную сумму и думает как бы тихо смыться. И ему позволяют! 
Много американцев, и они каждый вечер гуляют, потому всегда весело.
Прекрасный СПА комплекс, с великолепными массажистками и за смешные цены, ведь каждому гостю дается куча подарков. 
Отель прекрасный. Доминиканцы еще не испорчены многолетним туризмом. Потому все чисто и все вежливы.

reviews.author: Lily
reviews.title: Be aware that is under construction!! (until Jan. 2015)
reviews.text: Our second time in this resort and our seventh in the DR. We came back because of the great experience we had four years ago and a huge drop in the price. During our check-in, we heard some people complaining of dirty sheets and mold in the bathroom, so, fingers crossed, we headed to our room. Everything was the same, which means lovely and tasteful decoration, spacious and comfortable spaces, but a little run-down. We went for a walk and get something to eat after a long trip, and OMG!!! there was a construction taking place were the main restaurant used to be, right beside the pool area and the beach!! They are under serious renovations. The buffet restaurant which was for breakfast, lunch and dinner was completely burned recently and a new one is being built in it's place, also they are making two more restaurants and rooms on the second floor. Because of this situation, food options for dinner were limited to the Italian, Japanese or open grill restaurants, and they switched the places were breakfast and lunch were served depending on the number of guests in the resort, (it was very awkward to see people in dripping swimming suits and beach towels inside the upscale interiors of the huge theatre or the Japanese restaurant, filling their plates in the improvised buffet tables),  besides the downside of the construction itself. This hotel is on the best beach, which is Bávaro, and has the most beautiful gardens, besides a reserve of wildlife and a mall right next to it. The spa has a beautiful Bali-inspired atmosphere and is the most lovely place were you can take different treatments or just enjoy the pools and do what they call ''water circuit''. The resort is going to be ready January 2015, so either you go now with these setbacks, but paying cheap or wait to enjoy the renovated Paradisus Palma Real... but with updated fares!!

reviews.author: Kristie B
reviews.title: Husband's 40th Birthday
reviews.text: I researched for months prior to selecting a hotel for my husband's 40th birthday in the Dominican Republic.  All I can say is you will not be disappointed one bit with this property! Royal Service is the way to go!! Sandy was our Butler and I cannot say enough things about his tremendous service. He took on our entire group of 13 and went above and beyond to make sure that our stay was impeccable.  He arranged the most romantic and perfect evening with dinner on the beach privately. Every detail was handled with the utmost care!! The table was adorned with lanterns, shells, and the menu was delicious! The entire staff, including the chef, joined our celebration with personal service and bright smiles that evening.  Sandy even had our area on the beach decorated with hand painted signs saying Happy Birthday and a cooler full of iced down beer, champagne, and other liquors that we had been enjoying thus far. The entire group was extremely impressed! He made our stay not only memorable, but has now set a new bar for the rest of our vacations! I also have to give major Kudos to Caesar the Room Service Manager for turning a stormy evening into one of the most memorable moments of my trip!  13 people having dinner in our suite, which was handled flawlessly! He personally walked to each of my friends and families rooms with me to take their orders. He personally delivered it all to my room and I cannot believe it was so well organized and delivered!   I would highly recommend this property. Everyone is more than happy to do anything to make your stay as perfect as possible!  My best reguards to the Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: Greg D
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Awesome. Definitely going back again. It was paradise. Beautiful sites and the food was delicious. The flamingos were awesome. The gym was small but very nice overall. A lot of walking to drain all the alcohol. Huge pool for great fun. The service was just amazing.

reviews.author: Sami M
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text:
It was a great experience full of energy! There are great activities throughout the day that the hotel provides from painting, zumba, water aerobics, etc. The service and the people that work there are what really make it special. We felt a great bond with them and they made it hard to leave when the trip was over. Roberto at Avenue Bar, Oxnard, the dance company, Manuel at the swim up bar, etc were all so amazing. A very special thank you to Angel and Maria Cepeda that really made the trip exceptional. The view and restaurants are great. Just note there are different "packages" when you book your trip. 

The only negative thing was that there was construction at the resort and we weren't told about it. I believe it will be done in October or November 2014.
