The staff at every level was professional, courteous, friendly and all went out of their way to make sure we were made welcome and well served.

A few staff stood out for us:

Augustin Nunez  our butler.  Always went out of his way to make sure we had what we needed
Alexander Guzman at Palazzo.  Very professional and pleasant
Martin Tineo   Made sure we had all the refreshments we needed and organized for us a great Palapa every day!

The beach has very nice sand and water was very nice to swim in despite some kelp and seaweed. No need for shoes to go swimming, its all white sand at the bottom too
The accommodations were very comfortable and spacious!
The whole property invites to rest and relaxation in a beautiful setting and everything is well maintained and spotless.

If you play golf, the Cocotal golf is very nice.  Make sure you take advantage of the  afternoon specials and if you plan on golfing more than once, it is worth bringing your clubs.  Also bring insect repellent if mosquitos have a tendency to FIND you!! 
However,  No mosquitos at the hotel!

We have returned home now and we miss all the special attention!
We have no problem recommending this property to any of our friends.  We had a great holiday, and we would return in a heart beat.

reviews.author: MARIBEL D
reviews.title: Se destaca
reviews.text: Se destaca la excelencia en todos sus aspectos, sobre todas las cosas la atención y esmero de su cálida gente.- Son ellos y no quiero dejar de mencionarlos Fermin y Juan de Leon, nuestros mayordomos; Pedro, Francisco I y Francisco II, Martin quienes  hicieron de nuestra estancia en la playa el mejor descanso.-Richard, Miguel, Estefanía y Carlos el master Chef , quienes nos deleitaron con su exquisiteces en el restaurante Palazzo. Adenawar Perez, Heidy Rivera, Malvis Garcia, quienes lograron con su dedicación personalizada que nuestro descanso sea inolvidable.- Gracias a todos y cada uno de ellos.- Geraldy gracias!!! nos vermos

reviews.author: NBB607
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort great service
reviews.text: Thanks so much to the staff of Paradisus Palma Real! Our experience was excellent here! It was the most beautiful resort I've ever visited. The rooms in the Royal service portion are fabulous. Our Butler Juan De Leon was the best in the business! He was extremely attentive and made our trip even better by arranging the perfect excursions for us! He set everything up and made sure we were going to have a good time! Thanks to Juan De Leon!!! Also the best drinks are made by Antonio at the pool bar! Martin also provided great Royal beach service as our cocktail waiter. I also thought our housekeeping staff was excellent. I had a fabulous experience at all of the resteraunts, all the service was top notch and so eas the food! Even the maintainance staff in the green hats were always so friendly! Thanks to all who made our stay great!

reviews.author: André F
reviews.title: Local único e belíssimo.
reviews.text: Estamos em lua de mel, além do local ser maravilhoso, tivemos uma excelente recepção. Local tranquilo para relaxar e aproveitar as férias! Recebemos um excelente tratamento, principalmente do Piterson Francois, Juan Castillo e Stephania Auguste. Esperamos voltar em breve para desfrutar desse paraíso. Recomendamos o serviço de Royal Service.

reviews.author: josecarlosmd
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones
reviews.text: Hermoso hotel, excelente servicio y comida, algo muy bueno es el Kids Zone, mis niños la pasaron de maravilla, se acuerdan mucho de Estefania, pero todo el personal del kids zone es muy bueno y dedicado con los niños, la infraestructura impresionante, hermosa estadía, esperamos volver pronto!

reviews.author: Angelica A
reviews.title: Amazing family vacation
reviews.text: The stay at The Reserve was really an amazing experience! The hotel is beautiful, the staff excellent, the amenities amazing! We really plan to come back with more friends and family. The only problem we had was with the internet wifi in our room which almost never worked. Other than that this is a luxury hotel experience and was worth every penny:)

reviews.author: Stacey N
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation. Would highly recommend paradisus palma real, royal service.
reviews.text: Excellent service! Wonderful staff throughout the resort.our Butler Augustin Nunez was absolutely wonderful,  took care of all our needs, with a smile :-) def recommend asking for him when you come visit!!!

reviews.author: toddwynn45
reviews.title: Cigar any one? Talk to Antonio Valdez.He is great
reviews.text: My wife and I loved the knowledge that Antonio Valdez has on cigars. We really had a great time talking with him and smoking cigars while on our 1 year anniversary trip and stay at Paradisus.Antonio has a very friendly smile and welcomed anyone to talk to about cigars or any topic. We plan on returning to Paradisus, and we smoke great cigars and look forward to seeing Antonio Valdez.He is awesome

reviews.author: Leticia P
reviews.title: Excelente!! Repetiria
reviews.text:
Estuvimos del 5 al 7 de septiembre en Palma Real. Excelente servicio. El personal muy dispuesto a consentir a los huespedes. Especialmente Rene García chef en Market Grill junto con Jose Mateo, Willi y Jhonny Acevedo. En el Restaurant Gabi Beach Milquiades. 
La comida y la bebida excelente y las habitaciones las mejores camas!!!!!

reviews.author: Marcelo S
reviews.title: Excelente resort!
reviews.text: O hotel é excelente! Desde a chegada na recepção até o final de nossa estadia fomos muito bem atendidos. Os restaurantes servem ótima comida e o avenue bar conta com bartenders muito animados. Todas as noites são apresentados algum tipo de espetáculo. Fora do hotel não existem muitas opções de entretenimento.

reviews.author: DaniPoA
reviews.title: Uma experiência inesquecível!
reviews.text:
Um hotel inesquecível, por sua infraestrutura, alimentação, conforto das habitações,e especialmente pelo atendimento, excepcional! Estivemos no The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana em julho de 2014, e optamos pelo Family Concièrge, uma alternativa de atendimento personalizada, quando contamos com a atenção dedicada e excepcional de Sofia, uma funcionária especialmente designada para atender de forma individualizada as necessidades das familias de hóspedes, desde cortesias de boas-vindas, reserva de tenda na praia ou piscina, escolha e reserva de restaurantes para o jantar, até pequenos "mimos", especialmente para nosso filho, surpresinhas no retorno ao apartamento, lanchinhos especiais, bilhetinhos carinhosos...Contamos também com o atendimento especial de Ovídio, gerente do The Reserve, que sempre nos atendeu com a mais absoluta dedicação e gentileza.
É um hotel realmente diferenciado, para descansar e curtir férias agradáveis e inesquecíveis.
Recomendo sem dúvida!

reviews.author: FranklyTravel
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: Great vacation with great food as long as you subscribe to the butler thing so you have access to the better restaurants while there.  The butler service did favor us so we could sit it that section on the beach and have our chairs reserved by the pool guys that waited on that area.  Our butler was worthless and would never pay the additional $$ if we had access to the other restaurants for the same $$.  Will definitely return but read reviews before we do to request a butler that is competent!

reviews.author: Zak A
reviews.title: Excellent Place, impressive service.
reviews.text:
Impressive Service, Excellent Place and Hotel. This is my 3rd time @ Melia hotels ( 2 times in Punta Cana & 1 time in Mexico)  The concierge Laura Castilo was very good, very helpful, very impressive from day one to last day. 
Thank you Melia and I promise you God willing i will come back. i will also pass the word to my friend which i already did.

reviews.author: Angela S
reviews.title: Wristband color makes a difference
reviews.text: We went on our honeymoon the end of July in August 2014.  We felt like our service was subpar and chalked it up to our wrist band color, we booked through a third party timeshare and did not upgrade to Royal Service.  We had green wrist bands and felt like certain parts of the resort did not want to serve us.  The Sky Bar by the market grill was AWESOME!! Ramone and Starky took amazing care of us and were the only bar tenders who were truly friendly.  The food was okay, we have experienced better food at other resorts (different countries as well).  We did make reservations for the restaurants for dinner at night and requested times that ranged from 6:00-7:30 and always ended up with 9pm until our last night.  That reservation system needs to be perfected.  The best restaurant was the hibachi grill.  We were never able to try restaurants with extra fees, what's the point at an all inclusive, we already paid a pretty penny and then to have a nice dinner we have to pay extra???  We did not see much service on the beach, one day we saw one server in a 5 hour period, probably because we didn't upgrade to royal service.  We were also not pleased about the construction but I guess they should be given credit for upgrades to the property.  The shopping mall was nice on a rainy day, we were hoping for a few more local shops though.

reviews.author: F Montes
reviews.title: Buen hotel
reviews.text:
El Paradisus Palma Real es un muy buen hotel en Playa Bávaro, está muy bien conservado, tiene un alto nivel en la restauración y no presenta un tan alto número de habitaciones como otros hoteles de la zona, lo que lo hace bastante mas tranquilo y de atención mas personalizada.

En nuestro caso, el servicio Royal bien, dejan a cada cliente el espacio que demandan y atienden de forma eficiente cualquier necesidad que pueda surgir.

Excelente la zona de playa privada y las camas balinesas.

A destacar una serie de profesionales que han hecho tremendamente agradable la estancia y por los que merece la pena volver, Jorge Acevedo, un crack en el kiosco de zumos naturales, siempre derrochando simpatía y buen hacer, Miguel Jiménez, un gran profesional en el restaurante Palazzo, siempre pendiente de todo y con la mejor de las sonrisas y Alexander Guzman, un 10 en todos los sentidos, responsabilidad, atención, simpatía, es de las personas que transmiten el verdadero carácter de un hotel y por las que merece la pena volver.

Un fuerte abrazo a todos ellos y muchas gracias por hacernos disfrutar de ese pedazo del paraiso.

reviews.author: EMILY T
reviews.title: The best of all is their people, escpecially Johanna!
reviews.text:
Dominican Republic was our second destination in the Caribbean Sea last August. Our first destination was Turks & Caicos where most of the local people we met at the reception of the  hotel (Alexandra Hotel) were not friendly. They were 'cold' people. On the contrary when we arrived at The Reserve at Paradisus at Punta Cana, we were impressed by the warm welcoming and the smiling faces of the personel. Always willing to help, whatever the problem was. However we were extremely impressed with Johanna Heredia Guillen with her kindness and willingness to help us with inquiries we had and made our stay at the hotel extremely pleasant. 
The hotel is excellent for families since there are many activities to suit everbody's taste. Very clean, you fill safe, variety of restaurants, huge swimming pool, but the best value is their  people!
Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Lynda B
reviews.title: Great Anniversary Escape
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently went to Punta Cana for our Anniversary & 60th Birthday celebration for my husband.  It is a magnificent hotel with beautiful grounds and of course right on the beach.  The staff was always very helpful and accommodating for our visit.  Our personal concierge, Franklin De la Cruz was delightful to have available for us, especially with our limited Spanish skills.  He made suggestions as well as reservations for everything we wanted to do the entire week.  He also arranged to have champagne & fresh fruit sent to our room for our Anniversary!  He was courteous and very kind during our entire stay.  He resolved any small issues we encountered very quickly and professionally.  All the waiters were very professional & always ready to respond to all our requests.  I wish I knew their names but only remember Gregory.  (Probably because it's my brother's name!)
A couple of negatives included the internet service only worked in the lobby, somewhat frustrating.  The other problem was the food.  Though it was beautifully presented, there was nothing I would consider 5* quality.  The buffet was plentiful but I prefer freshly cooked, meats lose a lot of flavor & texture in a steamer.  The Hibachi dinner was very nice at Bana and the fresh omelets were also delicious.  The restaurants were beautiful and we did have a very nice dinner at Aqua.  I think the fresh fish were the best meals we had.  The fresh fruit was delicious, desserts extremely sweet.  Ahh & I wish they understood what 1/2 & 1/2 is!  
Overall we had a wonderful, luxurious trip in Paradise.  Very memorable.

reviews.author: emilia p
reviews.title: Esperiencia Real
reviews.text: Siamo stati in vacanza in luglio e volevamo fuggire dallo stress delle nostre giornate di lavoro..... Non potevamo scegliere posto migliore e non mi riferisco solo al mare e alla bellissima spiaggia ma soprattutto alla riservatezza e gentilezza del personale, all'esclusività dei ristoranti, in particolare Il Palazzo, alla solerzia nell'accontentare le nostre richieste, grazie anche a Jose, il nostri butler, e le coccole in spiaggia, grazie alla sollecitudine di Francisco. Lo consiglio a tutti... Noi sicuramente ci ritorneremo.

reviews.author: Ileana169
reviews.title: Sun & fun at the Palma Real
reviews.text: This was my first trip to Punta Cana & the Paradisus Palma Real was wonderful. The hotel is very nice, beautiful beach & pools, most importantly the staff was very attentive & service was great. Estrella Garcia, guest services was very kind & helpful. Our concierge, Franklin was great too. Overall it was a wonderful time and looking forward to going back.

reviews.author: LiAussa
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise!
reviews.text: LOVED IT! My friend had her wedding here this summer and it was absolutely amazing. Nuria was the sweetest and most helpful person there! She arranged the dinner reservations at the different restaurants each night, and made sure the wedding (and the rest of the trip) went according to plan. I would love to go back and stay again. We walked along the beautiful beaches (which was connected to resort) and saw several other resorts, but Paradisus looked like it was by far the best around. No need to exchange any money when you go. The food was delicious and all inclusive, so really the only money you would need would be for tipping the staff or if you want to go off on any excursions. The entire resort is kept clean and in order and was very relaxing with calm music and the smell of incense. I was also impressed with the rooms. The bed in my room was MASSIVE! It was the size of two king beds to make one. The maids would usually come to turn your sheets and clean about twice a day, but I am convinced they must be ninjas because I never saw anyone around. If you are thinking about upgrading to royal suites and butler service, that would be your call. Some of my friends went all out, but I kept it simple. The rooms were the same either way. But if you get the butler service they give you a cell phone to use. This would come in handy if you wanted something hand delivered to you while you were on the beach, but otherwise it isn't hard to get what you want. There was always someone nearby ready to help. And don't worry if your Spanish skills are lacking, almost everyone there spoke English. Everyone I passed would greet you with an "Hola!" and seemed genuinely friendly. The pools were never crowded, and the shows at night were fun to watch! I would definitely recommend this resort to anyone traveling to the DR.

reviews.author: Sunil K
reviews.title: Great vacation... Superb beaches, great food and service !
reviews.text:
Had a very good experience at this resort ! The service was superb, the food options were great !! Compared to my stay at other all-inclusive resorts.. I felt the sales pressure was VERY high - I was convinced (against my wife's wishes) to have an upgraded room and rightfully so - we hardly used the extra room. Similarly, while our Family concierge was great.. I don't think that it was worth the extra money to get the fine dining reservations and the cabana's. The cabana's were available even after 10 am without any reservation (may less occupancy due to the trip timing - Aug end).

Overall it was a great vacation.. except for the extra ~800$ that I paid for the upgrade :-(.

reviews.author: SheilaJean2014
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our visit to the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. We stayed in the Royal Service section of the resort. There were many people who made our visit very enjoyable including our butler Omar, Pedro Cedano who set up our hut on the beach every morning, Richard Ortiz who provided great service at the Palazz restaurant and many other staff members.

There was a great variety of food selection and all of it was delicious. The passion fruit drinks at the bar were just wonderful! 

We recommend this resort to anyone celebrating a special occasion and we would go back in a minute.

reviews.author: Maribellan
reviews.title: Excelente Luna De Miel.
reviews.text: Atencion optima y servicio excelente. Augustin Nunez nuestro mayordomo nos trato de maravilla y hizo todo lo posible para que nuestra luna de miel fuera perfecta. Profesional y muy servicial, excelente mayordomo. Experiencia optima!!

reviews.author: Jackquito
reviews.title: Great Service - Average Grounds - Great Beach -
reviews.text:
We travelled the week before labor day hoping to avoid the crowds and that worked out fine (except the day before we left when most people were arriving for the weekend). The hotel has a lot of potential and could become what it once was when it was opened. We stayed in the Royal Service side of the hotel and it was definitely worth the extra money in my opinion.
I will divide the review into PROs and CONs, but the main reason I only gave this resort 3 stars is because we have been to another sister resort in Mexico and I am comparing this resort with that one.

Lets start with the CONs first;

- Property: The grounds are kept clean, but the property feels and looks old. A lot of maintenance is required (fixing, painting and in general maintaining of buildings) to get this property looking and feeling like new. I know that with age nothing can be kept 100% as when it was new, but in the hotel business how you present your property is always one of the biggest factor if guests will return or not. Also, they are doing some constructions which were never informed through their website (we booked directly with Melia.com), or even at least some mention of remodeling at the time of booking. To me this is a big negative. Yes there are websites as TA which I always view to see the property before booking, but this should not be the case for something the HOTEL has control over and determines when to start such large scale renovations/constructions. This is not a cheap hotel, therefore in my opinion the customer should be informed of anything that is being done by the hotel that might interfere with the enjoyment of the vacation that is being promised. The hotel has made efforts to avoid the construction from interfering with the guests experience, but it is still an eye sore, ear sore, and in general irritating. The hotel expects this to be done before the November rush, but still I would have liked some information from the hotel ahead of time so that I know what I am getting myself into.
-Under-staffed: Though the staff currently present does an excellent job (which will be explained further down this review), it felt like they needed more staff especially in the beach side. When this resort is full to capacity I hope they hire more staff, but in our experience a few more in the royal service beach side would help. Obviously there is a reason why guests pay more for this service and we are expecting more service because of the extra up-charge.
-Rooms: The negative for us was the bed. It seems like they put two queen beds together and have made this huge bed. Though for some the bed might be a huge plus being so big, for us it wasn't. I had to literally role a few times to get out of bed. This was fun the first night, but it became annoying every time I had to wake-up to go to the bathroom in the middle of the night. Another negative is the toilet. The toilet is divided by a frosted glass. Sorry, but I prefer a door and this could be an easy fix, but do not see many people complain on TA about this, so I guess I am one of the few who do. Also for some reason our phone kept ringing uncontrollably during the night. We informed several people about this issue but apparently it is a glitch in the system. We did not let this ruin our trip, we just unplugged the phones, problem solved. Sometimes you do need to be proactive. 

If you made it this far, keep going, I saved the best for last. 

PROs:
- BEACH: Yes there was a lot of seaweeds, but this is to be expected due to the time of year. This is something the hotel cannot control and because of that I do not think this is a negative. We knew this ahead of time (thanks to TA) and mentally prepared for this. The hotel does make an effort and there is a crew which picks up the seaweed washed ashore every other day. My only recommendation is they should be picking up this seaweed every day, but again this did not something the hotel can control. The beach is beautiful! we loved the beach and because of it this hotel has so much potential. There are a lot of boats going past offshore, and this creates a lot of waves, but again we knew about it and this was not a negative for us. If you really want to enjoy the beach you should go early in the morning (between 8AM to 11AM) as this is the best time when the least amount of seaweed is present, least amount of boats going by and the water has cleared up enough you can see the bottom of your feet! We did not find rocks, or anything (except for the seaweed) that made us get out. Also the staff here tries their best to accommodate you in either a Bali-bed or one of those recline able beds. A big hello to Francisco Cabrera! Thank you for all the drinks, for your help getting us setup at the beach, and always checking-up on us even though you had a lot of drinks for other guest.
-Service: This is where the hotel shines as well. The service, the staff in general were great. Thanks to Alexander in the Royal Service restaurant Palazzo for making every breakfast a great experience. A big thanks to our butler Edgar! He went the extra mile for us and truly made this experience the best it could be. He speaks English fluently so if you need a butler that understands English, this is the guy! Thanks to Edgar our private dinner was planned perfectly and so was our spa appointments. This guy even picked up the phone when he was off-work. Now that is awesome service! That is why this hotel has the potential to be the best because the service is phenomenal. At the Royal Service Lounge, Luisa (who works for Club Melia) was always willing to help us even though we are not club Melia members. She was even willing to show us around the property since it is a large property and the resort also has some shops just a few minutes to the south of the resort.
-Royal Service: Even though we did not use all of the amenities provided by the Royal Service we still believe it is worth getting it. Having your own butler (which you see and talk to every day), 24-7 room service, mini-bar included, the lounge, and so on. For us the best thing was having someone like Edgar help us plan our vacation and solve any issues with it. The only negative is the size of the Royal Service pool, but this was not an issue for us as we spent most of our time at the beach.
-Spa: We used some resort coupons with a spa service. We usually do not believe in "resort coupons" but thanks to that coupon we had a couples massage for $200 US. That turned out to be $200 US less than compared to Mexico sister resort (La Perla). Now $200 I am willing to pay, not $400! This resort has two spa locations (The Oriental and the YHI spa). We choose the Yhi spa because it is larger, definitely more relaxing, and larger rooms for couples. The Oriental is next to the Palazzo restaurant. Though the Oriental is conveniently located we found this to be small and not really what we were looking for to relax in a spa. The spa wants to get your business so they are pricing accordingly to try and get the business from all guests (those that travel alone, as a couple or with family).
-Rooms: Even though the rooms have a few negatives, I do have to say the rooms are spacious, kept cleaned by the cleaning service all the time. Just be careful when selecting the type of room. Ocean-view does not mean you will get a clear view of the Ocean. This is a partial view (and by partial it is almost nothing). If you really want a clear view of the beach and ocean then choose Ocean front rooms. If not, just select a Garden view, but be sure to get a room facing the interior of the resort and not the exterior as there are side roads where vehicles and maintenance vehicles travel through.
-Lobby: The lobby area was impressive, it gives the hotel a "boutique" feel and raises your expectations in general. This area is well distributed and has several bars and restaurants within this area.
-Food: Amazingly the food was good (especially from a-la-cart restaurants). Though keep in mind they cook the food low in seasons because guests come from all around the world and it is very hard to cater to all. As Americans sweets were not too sweet, and salty food were not too salty (required a little bit of salt). In general this is resort type of food and was good enough for us. We do not eat seafood therefore we only ate meat (well cooked of course). Presentation of food was Ok. If you are a foodie though you might want to stick to the a-la-cart restaurant only, the buffet was pretty straight forward, nothing "WAO" about it.
-Restaurants a-la-cart: We liked the Bana, Vento, and the Palazzo. We had no issues with our reservations, but my only advice is please have some patience because usually your table will not be ready exactly on the reservation time. Have a drink and enjoy your time. If you do have a large party, it is best to be early so that they start reserving tables. Food here was good, above average so no complaints there.
-Bars: We are not heavy drinkers, but the few drinks we did order were not watered down and top-shelf liquor did taste and smell like it.
-Romantic Dinner: We decided to do this thanks to the resort coupon which cut-down the price to a reasonable $100 (which you pay anyways going out in the states). Since the beach is so beautiful and large this is something I would recommend if you want to have a different dinner experience. We did it really early while it was still bright outside as the sun was setting and that allowed us to view our dinners, have a conversation, and even take some pictures with the sunset light which turned out to be great!. Food was very good and we even ordered a bottle of wine (though they do include a champagne).

Well I guess I hit all the main points. To sum-up, the hotel has a lot of potential if they get the maintenance crew painting and restoring a lot of the areas of the hotel back to new-like standards. The beach and service is what makes this resort the best and if this is the most important factor for you, then by all means go for it. We would recommend this resort to our friends and family, but only after they are done with the renovations. We would not return to this property just because it really did not sweep us off our feet. Nothing major is wrong, but too many small points added up together to make this a repeat hotel. We are going to try other resorts next vacation season in the area because the beach is the type of beach we are looking for (palm trees, sandy beaches, no rocks).

reviews.author: Jonathan G
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Great service from Juan de leon. Great butler. Beautiful scenery from the royal service ocean front view. The food from all the restaurant was good. When we didn't eat out the room service was fast and very polite.

reviews.author: Departure443548
reviews.title: enjoyable, courteous, relaxing, clean, good food, great energy
reviews.text: thank you to the staff at paradises who was ALWAYS friendly, accommodating, courteous. they work really hard while smiling and greeting you along the way. the nighttime entertain (The Lion King and a Michael Jackson shows) was outstanding. quite impressive and perfect for our family (2 adults, 2 children-10, 6).

reviews.author: kendra m
reviews.title: The people make it wonderful!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Royal Services with Juan de Leon as our butler. Juan did a great job of keeping track of what we liked and wanted. He ironed our clothes, set up a parasailing excursion, and tracked down a copy of the menu from the Passion as a keepsake of our dinner there (so I coudl remember all the wonderful things we ate!). He did the MOST amazing job of preparing the Jacuzzi with candles and bubble bath and rose petals. Juan was always preparing little treats of fresh fruit and chocolates and wine with pretty glasses....we were hoping to be pampered and that's exactly what the RS staff at Paradisus delivers! Both Francisco Gil and Francisco Leo at the Royal Series bar were exceptional. They always greeted us with a smile and had plenty of towels ready. They made us feel like it was their sincere pleasure to bring us drinks and special treats. There's nothing like a CocoLoco served in a fresh coconut garnished with a cheery red hibiscus flower! Jorge Rivera who manned the fresh fruit stand was ALWAYS in a good mood, smiling and singing, and ready to make you any concoction you could imagine. All the staff at the Palazo were fantastic: smiling, alert, attentive, going the extra mile to get exactly what we wanted. And my goodness they remembered all our preferences, like were were beloved family. Our butler Juan worked very hard to get us dinner reservations every where we wanted to go, when we wanted go, even contacting a good friend (Rafael Jimenez) to take good care of us at the Aqua....it was so incredible that we went back there again on our last night. The Aqua is a restaurant at The Reserve (and as such permits children--the only drawback to this beautiful and wonderful restaurant). The service was unparalleled, (both the waiters that took care of us were OUTSTANDING people and excellent at what they do) and the food was fantastic. My all time favorite was the chocolate tart with passion fruit ice cream desert. I am telling you....SWOONingly delicious! And on our last night we didnt even have to order, Rafael and his co-worker brought both of us a double portion! Made me get up and hug them both!!!

reviews.author: Stormy9873
reviews.title: Dire need of repairs and quality control.
reviews.text: We visited in 2011 and then 08/30/14 to 08/4/14. The hotel is in dire need of repairs. All lights are on a timer hooked to a sensor that turns off all light when the front door to room is opened and closed. The motion sensors do not work properly. I was in the shower when my wife left for the lobby. The lights went out as I stepped out of the shower. I slipped on the wet tile floor and hit my head on the floor. I know the put the motion sensors in to save on power with good intentions but you would expect to see this in a cheap Motel not a five star Hotel. At this point I am only sore with a very bad headache.We asked the Management deactivate the motion sensors for the safety of everyone. They disabled our bathroom for us the night before we left. This is a very beautiful Hotel set on the beach with white sand and turquoise water. The staff were wonderful but I think there may be a Management problem. Many things in the room needed repairs or did not work all together. Here is a partial list. 1.At night the A/C would go off and the room would warm up dramatically. We would have to get up 1 1/2 hours to turn the A/C on. 2.The Ceiling fans did not work and smoked when you turned them on. 3. The in room wi-fi never worked but we were told it would be fixed in a few hours every time we asked. 4.The balcony had a 3 inch gap at the bottom that allowed the biting insects to get in the room. 5.The furniture in the room smelled badly and was worn out. 6. The mattress had springs coming thru it.7. I needed to see a Doctor but was told there was not one close and it would cost several hundred dollars to visit one. 8. Everything on the grounds looked nice on the surface but if you looked a little better you could see damage or a bad repair job. As a traveler I expect to see some of these things because of the number of guest but when you pay $4000.00 for a 6 nights you expect the best. I will come back but not until the begin to make repairs on badly needed things. I was never contacted by Management to help resolve the problems.

reviews.author: MikeVeloso
reviews.title: An Incredible Experience: Relaxing, Fun, Entertaining, and Friendly
reviews.text: This place was amazing!  The service, restaurants, rooms, and the all-inclusive services were incredible.  The art/drawing class and activities by the pool area were great.  The instructor Jose Luis was excellent.  He actually taught my friends and I how to draw. He was very patient and helpful as I kept asking for assistance since I am not a good painter. I never imagined myself sitting along the pool in an art class. My friends and I will definitely go back. As a matter of fact, we are already planning something for March 2015.

reviews.author: Aliuska M
reviews.title: GREAT RESORT AND SERVICE...
reviews.text:
We are Travel Agents and we returned from the hotel just a week ago.

Our stay was fantastic, they did not know we were Travel Agents and we got an excellent service all the way.
The room was lovely and comfy, The food was extremely delicious and they offer a huge variety.
The service all over the resort was outstanding, I have to mention special recognition to BARON JUSTO at the VENTO Restaurant, also JULIO RODRIGUEZ at the AVENUE Bar, Gerardo and the guys from the Lobby Bar and the Rep of the Front Desk I believe his name is Javier, he provided an exceptional service and all needed information i got it from him.

I truly recommend this Resort!!!!!

reviews.author: rick c
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
We stayed at the reserve for one week in September, 
The hotel wasn't very busy so the level of service was very high.  anything you needed or wanted was available at a moments notice, we would l

especially give thanks to Luis santana our server on the beach, he was especially helpful and always kept our drinks fresh and full,our glasses were never empty, also all the staff at the Gabi club. At the reserve who. Would always be smiling And Ready to take care of us.thank you for a great vacation and a wonderful experience

reviews.author: Ingrid S
reviews.title: Excellent service and beautiful resort
reviews.text: We went to the Palma Real for our friends' destination wedding and it was absolutely gorgeous! The resort was extremely clean and well kept. The service was probably the best we ever received. Our butler Nicolas Maracallo was extraordinary! I can't say enough good things about him. The rest of the staff was extremely friendly as well. Including Baron Justo. Everyone went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. We will definitely go back.

reviews.author: Tiagobignoto
reviews.title: Novo conceito de férias!
reviews.text:
Vou iniciar pela experiência da chegada ao hotel: Fantástica! Recebido por funcionários extremamente atenciosos que me levaram ao hall de checkin. Eu havia contratado o serviço Royal Service, mas por algum motivo eles não tinham isso nos dados deles. Assim que perceberam esse "deslize" me levaram para outro hall e já me ofereceram espumante. Uma staff passa a ser responsável por você a partir desse momento e lhe é designado um mordomo que ficará a seu serviço. Você é levado a seu quarto e lá já estão suas malas. A partir dae só alegria… Para quem quer viajar em casal e quer um tratamento diferenciado, não abra mão de pagar um pouco a mais pelo Royal Service. Isso lhe oferece restaurante exclusivo, café da manhã exclusivo (Caviar liberado!), área de praia privativa, o mordomo com todas as regalias que ele pode lhe oferecer como Jacuzzi produzida diariamente para casal com garrafa de espumante em seu quarto… Morangos com chocolate, tábuas de queijos finos, entre outros mimos. Vc recebe um celular na chegada com contato direto com seu mordomo e no que precisar é só ligar para ele que prontamente é resolvido. São 8 restaurantes com tudo liberado (lagosta, camarão, lula, black angus, hamburguer, risoto, comida japonesa…….), exceto algumas bebidas de rótulo mais caro, como blue label, ciroc… mas tem as mesmas bebidas com rótulos mais em conta liberadas (black label…) Spa com circuito das águas liberado (paga-se apenas as massagens caso queiram). Uma academia de musculação muito boa mesmo. Aparelhos e estrutura que lhe permitem malhar, caso consigam tempo para isso lá rssr.
Agora separo um parágrafo para falar dos funcionários:
Em toda a minha vida nunca vi um povo como o dominicano. Atencioso, extremamente feliz, solícito. Nunca fui tão bem tratado assim em minha vida. Em especial aos funcionários Jorge Acevedo que é uma pessoa excepcional. Cortez, educado e simpático ao extremo! Se o staff do hotel acompanha nossos relatos, deixo a dica para promovê-lo o quanto antes a mordomo. Será um grande diferencial para o grupo Meliá. Quando eu retornar, não tenha dúvidas que o quero como mordomo! Outro é o Pedro Cedano, responsável pela área privativa na praia. Nunca vi uma pessoa tão de bem com a vida. Prestativo, educado, simpático e muito mais. Fantástico profissional. No restaurante exclusivo (Palazzo), chamo atenção para o sr. Miguel Jimenez que tornou minha experiência única nesse restaurante. Trato fino com o cliente com um humor peculiar tendendo ao sarcasmo delicado! Sensacional… Me apresentou a famosa mamajuana (bebida típica da Rep. Dominicana). Indivíduo também de talento único para tratar clientes. Deveria ser promovido a mordomo também, pois é diferenciado.
Se estão a procura de um resort para casal como toda a elegância possível, esse é o ideal em Punta Cana. Foram 5 noites que gostariam que fossem 30.
Se posso falar de algo que não foi perfeito, talvez tenha sido aos produtos que oferecem na suíte. Pelo nível do resort esperava produtos melhores, mas isso não consegue tirar nem sequer um pouco do brilho desse local.
Perfeito!

reviews.author: junioradc
reviews.title: Inesquecível
reviews.text:
Sem dúvida este é o lugar ideal para casais que querem se sentir ! O resort é enorme, muito organizado e luxuoso.Tudo que pesquisei a respeito bateu certinho com as descrições.Os funcionários são educados e bem humorados, principalmente os que ficam no bar da piscina exclusiva para hospedes do Royal Service. Neste serviço, você tem um mordomo a sua disposição e um celular para chamá-lo quando necessário, por exemplo, ele  reserva os restaurantes para o jantar e prepara a jacuzzi para o seu banho. Tem alguns restaurantes exclusivos para o Royal Service com ótimos cardápios, mesmo nos restaurantes mais simples a comida e bebida são de ótima qualidade. Gostamos do tepanhaki  no Bana, já o sushi-bar deste restaurante está muito longe das expectativas de quem conhece os restaurantes japoneses de  São Paulo, mas também é muito bom. O Master Grill foi o restaurante onde almoçamos mais vezes, agradou nosso paladar. O jantar no restaurante Vento foi maravilhoso, tudo impecável e champanhe de primeira qualidade. No geral nosso período de hospedagem foi maravilhoso. Fizemos dois passeios: para ilha Saona (do Filme Lagoa Azul) e Dolphin explorer (golfinhos), achamos os passeios muito caros e talvez desnecessários já que o resort lhe oferece lazer e tranquilidade suficientes para boas férias, sem gastos adicionais. O passeio para a ilha Saona, dura o dia todo, fica a mais de 100km de Punta Cana, mas a vista para o mar  azul do caribe é sensacional. Nunca vi uma praia com águas tão cristalinas.
Gostaria de deixar meus sinceros agradecimentos ao Jorge Acevedo e Leonardo Mota por toda atenção que tiveram conosco em nossa estadia... são pessoas sensacionais!!! Grande abraço.

reviews.author: Bob T
reviews.title: Amazing - Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana !!
reviews.text:
Just spent an amazing few days at this hotel......  spectacular ocean front room meant starting our day with coffee on the balcony and expansive view of the Caribbean.    An attentive, but not intrusive Butler, firstly unpacked/packed our luggage, but also set up pool cabanas and arranged spa appointments, so the days unfolded without a hitch.    To top it all off.... really excellent meals.....  and an over-the-top dining experience at Passion, perhaps the best restaurant in the Dominican Republic.  We booked a "Royal Service" room, which is a private no-kids section, so perfect for us for really peaceful days and quiet naps by the pool.  

We can't wait to go back.   If you are going to Punta Cana, Paradisus is your destination, no question!

reviews.author: Amber B
reviews.title: Destination Wedding August 30, 2014
reviews.text:
Just getting home from our wedding/honeymoon at Paradisus Palma real. The reviews on here are a mix of truth, emotion and expectations. The resort is not perfect. It's not. But it's fantastic, beautiful and I will go back again. No question. Our butler Juan De Leon was fantastic. Royal Service is the way to go. Juan helped us and served us in the most kind and  professional manner. If you want help...he will help and wants to help. 

Our wedding was more expensive than what we wanted to spend but it was perfect. The resort took care of us. Tropic One photography was excellent too...kudos to Jonathan. 

Nightlife was fun here. We stayed at a different high end resort in punta Cana in December and it had no nightlife. 

Paradisus Palma real was top notch.   I would be up for an anniversary trip discount in 2015!  ;)

reviews.author: luvthecarribean!
reviews.title: Huge, Fantastic pool!
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 4 nights over the 4th of July as part of a wedding party.  

Pool:  absolutely huge, clean, and the water temperature was perfect.  And I mean perfect.  Waitors at the swim-up bar were very friendly and prompt with service.

Rooms:  we had connecting rooms with garden view.  rooms were very nice, beds comfy.  ashtrays on balcony tables.  however, sitting on your balcony was somewhat agonizing because the music that played from the landscaping speakers was awful awful awful.  i think it was the spa music and it was the same horrible tune over and over.  eeeek!  there were window shutters that separated the beds and the bathroom.  housekeeping sometimes didn't get around to the room til 4pm.  all rooms are good walking distance to the pool/beach since the hotel isn't spread out like other larger properties.  
Beach:  sand was beautiful and not hot.  had beach volleyball but only saw people playing once.  waiters did come down to the beach a couple times to see about drink orders, but honestly I don't know how often they do that cos we weren't there a whole ton.
Restaurants:  evening meals at the specialty restaurants were all excellent the three times we ate there.  even the desserts were good - i usually think they are tasteless at most AI resorts.  we always did the lunch buffet with our 4 kids and i was NOT impressed with it at all!!  flies were all over the fresh fruit and if you wanted a hamburger there was always a line.  once i had to stand there for at least 15 minutes to get a burger.  then if you want ketchup you have to cut  in line every time at the salad bar to get to the condiments.  the set-up was backwards and a pain.  plus, the food was poor.  i am not a picky eater and it was  a constant struggle with the lunch buffet.  And of course since it's the island, getting a drink (and sometimes even water) takes a looooooong time at the buffet.
front desk:  very helpful but difficult to understand
fitness room:  very nice!!  has everything you could want, really.  including a towel and bottled water.
we went over to the sister property via courtesy van (came back on golf cart) so the kids could check out their pool and it was a lot of fun for the kids (ages 9,8,6,4).  a couple kiddie slides;  the work staff put a ton of water balloons in the kids pool at one point - seemed like they had a neat kids activity facility.  Everything (pool wise, bathrooms, lounge chairs, etc) was real nice except you had to pay for the drinks.  it wasn't too long before we had to head back to our main resort :)
Activities:  I didn't see any activities during the day except water aerobics one time.
Staff:  Everyone was friendly and almost always said "hi" in passing.

reviews.author: boofjp
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Excellent Time
reviews.text:
We had an excellent time, Royal service is definitely worth the extra money to have a butler, ours was Evian Rodriguez. He was outstanding! He took care of anything we needed, so we could relax and not worry about details. He brought us Melon scented pillows and remembered when we told him we were celebrating our anniversary and he surprised us with a cake that said Happy Anniversary. We cant say enough about him, he looked for us several times a day to see if we needed anything and if we enjoying ourselves and even reminded us of our dinner reservation.
The food was fantastic especially Palazzo which is royal club guests only restaurant. We met several staff members there as well that couldn't be more accommodating to our needs. Especially Stephania Auguste, Alexander Cnuzman, Fria Pasquel, Americo Paulino, Smevlin and Nerrero. 
The Buffet was really good also they serve breakfast, lunch and dinner. The Market Grill is good for a fast lunch, not much of a variety.
Gabi Beach Restaurant our dinner was delicious  
Mizu Show Teppanyaki at the Reserve was lots of fun and so good.
There is a hydro spa at the Paradisus but the Yhi Spa at The Reserve was so relaxing, and we found that if you belong with the Royal Club you can use the hydrotherapy area free of charge.  
After that we ate lunch at the Gabi Beach Club at The Reserve which was great too.
Room Service at the Paradisus comes hot and fast! Delicious too!
The beach and pool staff was friendly and catered to us especially Francisco Gil, and Francisco Cabrerea.
The entertainment was fun too!
Overall this was a perfect trip. Weather was great and met some new friends.

reviews.author: keith j
reviews.title: Beware Of Franklin
reviews.text: Ill start by saying  im a 5' 11  200 lb bodybuilder police officer who is not  a punk at all. My fiance and myself came to the Palma Real on 8/28/14 for a 5 day stay. When we arrived we were assigned a male and female to welcome us and give us a brief tour of the property. As soon as we were seated i observed the male concierge whose name is Franklin staring obsessively at my fiance to the point where it became uncomfortable. granted she is a good looking woman and im used to stares however this was borderline obsession. As we toured the properety i noticed Franklin was conversing with another male employee as they continually looked over at my fiance smiling. Im pretty thick skinned and I let this pass, however 2 days later as we were conversing with franklin about dinner reservations at a property hotel franklin turned to me and stated that i have to wear long pants and shoes to the restaurant of which i was aware, he then turned to my fiance to state " you should show up NAKED" !!  i walked mty fiance away and came back to let him know in not so friendly terms what i would do to him if i werent in a foreign country. Bottom Line     the property is great, the food is good , the staff is wonderful, BUT stay away from FRANKLIN the Concierge  , he is classless , disrespectful and doesnt need to be in the postion he s in if he cant control himself around beautufl women,

reviews.author: Dash38
reviews.title: Less good this year (Aug 2014) than last year (Aug 2014)
reviews.text:
Maybe going a second time two years in a row, one will always find it not as good.  Not sure.  However:

1.  In 2013, had very little to complain about (other than lack of wireless internet).

2.  This year (2014), the main reason I am giving it three stars is I feel that this hotel is misleading on their website, wherein they state that one of the restaurants is:

"NAOS  

DESCRIPTION: Magnificent international buffet, enjoy a journey through the world’s different cuisines
ATMOSPHERE: Located next to the hotel pool and also with stunning sea views
OPENING TIMES: Open all day
DRESS CODE: Resort Informal"

Yes, in 2013, NAOS was our favorite buffet.  Very big, open all the time, tons of variety (esp. for my 6 year old..pizza, chix nuggets, etc.), near the beach, etc..  Generally, a beautiful, big, buffet. 

However, though their website today still lists it as one of the main restaurants, IT BURNED TO THE GROUND in April of 2014 or so.  THERE IS NO NAOS anymore (they are in process of trying to rebuild, but by looks of it, that will be a 6-8 month process).  Instead, for the main property Buffet, they have turned the main banquet/concert hall into the buffet.  And, while they try their best I think, compared to NAOS last year, it is about 1/4th as good, WAY less variety, nothing for kids, not open at times, and the food was not as good.  

I could probably have handled all that, had they been honest about it on their website.  Please, take down NAOS as a restaurant and mention that it burned down and there is an ad hoc buffet in the crappy banquet hall?  Also, all of the shows they have each night are now in the buffet room...so there are not enough seats (since it is now a dining room), and it creates other issues.  I think they have less shows too, because of the use of this room as a buffet.  All in all, very unhappy on this score.  

2.  The "Member Center" also burned down.  This is where the Time Share Members get to go.  I am not one of those, but I think it has impacted the "guides" who help out guests during the week they are there.  Without Member Center, I think many less Time Share salespeople around, a lot less time share presentations going on, etc.  And, since the "guides" (the hotel employee who is assigned to each family when you show up and helps you all week) get a commission if their family attends a time share presentation, the lack of these presentations seems to have given the guides less reason to be as attentive to the families.  We just did not see as much (from ours and with other families) attention by the guides.  I think part reason guides give attention is if they do a real good job and work hard, families feel duty bound to go to the three hour presentation, b/c the guides tell them "I get a commission".  That is what we did in 2013.  Now with the Member Center gone, where all the presentations were done, the floor models, etc., it seems their whole Time Share business in toilet, and with that, so are the guides (in my opinion).

3.  The property seems to be getting run down.  There are parts in the pools (esp. railings going down steps into pools) that are not there or very rickety.  Fix the easy stuff guys.  

4.  Internet.  Yes, I know, I am on vaca and should get off the internet.  Whatever.  They claim wireless internet in the rooms.  Please.  Does not work.  Does not work anywhere but main buffet area in Reserve and in reserve office.  I then asked for a Cat 5 cable for my room THREE times and they promised to deliver and they never did (did not have at office...had to be delivered from IT for some reason). So.............basically no internet. 

5.  Yes, there was a DVD in our room, but it was not connected, and could not be connected.  

6.  The rooms smell musty or have some other odd smell.

7.   On the good side, the staff are very nice and helpful.  The beach is generally beautiful.  Most of the property is very nice and the pools are very nice.  A lot of reasons to go.  I am just venting, b/c I feel they deserve it over the misleading NAOS issue.

reviews.author: Barbara S
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: my family had an amazing time.  my family conceige was Luisa, she was amazing. it was a little confusion with check out, i didnt realized we were offered credits for the spa and gift shop.  when we checked in we were not told.  when we were checking out the person at the front desk asked why didnt we use the credits.  but other then that my family had an amazing vacation.

reviews.author: Tyra J
reviews.title: Great service from Ramon Fuego
reviews.text: We had a great stay at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The room was fantastic, the pool was beautiful and the service was great.  Our favorite spot to stop for a drink was the Sky Bar.   Ramon took excellent care of us.  He not only greeted us by name, but remembered our drink of choice.  Definitely would visit again!

reviews.author: Roldan29
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text: This is the second time that I have stayed in one of the Paradisus resorts.  For both stays I paid for the royal services. My experience with our butler Samuel Rodriguez was great.  He was excellent in providing us great service with a great personality. I loved that he would look for  us thorough out the resort to ensure that we did not need anything. Great birthday vacation

reviews.author: Rex S
reviews.title: Great R&R location in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Punta Cana was just a shot in the dark but all the reviews convinced us we should come here. This was an excellent hotel, well appointed, and with all the amenities you need. The Royal Service is the only way to go. Augustin Nunez our butler took excellent care of us. When ever we called him with the hotel provided cell phone he would come to talk to us in person to make sure we had everything we needed. He is an asset to this resort. 

At the beach the water was very pleasant. Although there were some seaweed the water was warm and the weather was perfect. Our drink server Martin the concierge was the best. 

The Restaurants served food which was excellent. The waiters went out of their way to make sure you were served professionally, attentively and they made the dining experience memorable. The house wine was a good quality and plentiful!

Our only concern was that the Wi-Fi in the room did not work or was very sporadic. If you plan on calling the country you came from at home to check on your family make sure you have calling cards. Long-distance calls can be expensive.

We would definitely come again to this hotel. We look forward to our next Melia resort stay.

reviews.author: cazzburgler
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: We had a fabulous trip to PPR in September 2014. The service was outstanding especially from Ramon at the Sky Bar who was absolutely wonderful! The cocktails at the pool bar were amazing, the bartenders can make absolutely anything. An absolute piece of paradise :-)

reviews.author: maiafnp
reviews.title: Fun and relaxing
reviews.text:
I was invited by my girlfriend as she is a Melia member. Amazing hotel with outstanding all-around service. Many thanks to Jesse or Jenna for booking our dinner every night. Luis for always being there and ready to help (thank you for the soap we were able to wash our clothes before heading back to NYC!)To Michelete and Junior Ramirez, thank you both for making our pool and beach time truly fun and for letting us pick which cabana   suits us best for the day! Thank you Paradisus Palma 
Real for an amazing 8 days with you!

reviews.author: Paula W
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!
reviews.text:
Passei a lua de mel no Paradisus Palma Real Bavaro Beach e foi excelente, recomendo muitissimo.  O resort é lindo, enorme, espaçoso, muito limpo e organizado, com atendimento excelente em todos os lugares (check in, bares, restaurantes ) e é realmente o resort mais luxuoso da região.

Optamos pelo Royal Service e recomendo fortemente, pois é um custo adicional pouco expressivo e que representa muito: piscinas exclusivas, restaurantes exclusivos, um mordomo à disposição para agendar jantares (nosso mordomo Juan Casillo foi muito atencioso durante toda a viagem, sem incomodar), área exclusiva na praia, áreas de descanso excluvias pelo hotel, cilindro de mergulho incluso, quartos luxuosos, enfim, é um ótimo negócio.

As comidas e bebidas do hotel são um espetáculo, open bar ao longo de todo o dia e das refeiçoes, com drinks e bebidas de alto nível e restaurantes a la carte para café da manhã almoço e jantar de padrão internacional, comidas realmente excelentes.
Uma dica importante: O Check-in do hotel só começa as 15h, então se você quiser entrar antes disso, vale a pena pagar a taxa de early check-in.

É a viagem ideal para quem quer curtir uma praia linda, limpa, silenciosa, com um atendimento impecável e sem se preocupar com absolutamente nada. Um destino perfeito para uma lua de mel tranquila e inesquecível.

reviews.author: Jasonbeck
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Amazing resort. We had Juan De Leon as our butler and he went above and beyond to insure our every need was met.  Will recommend this resort for sure!  Wide variety of food and entertainment.  Pools and beaches are great!  Everyone on the staff was friendly and always smiling.

reviews.author: Tennis8640
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Amazing resort Juan de Leon was our butler and he did an excellent job. Went above and beyond our expectations. The beach was great and the restaurants superb. I would recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Cynthia R
reviews.title: Great hotel but not worth so much money
reviews.text: Good hotel, but not worth so much money. Great location, beach is beautiful. Staff is very slow, trolley service is slow, no exhaust fan in the bathroom, soap they provide is terrible, and the toothpaste is the size of a tic-tac, and my bed was hard like a rock. The in room service sucks,I called for a cup of tea and it took them 45 minutes to bring it. On another night, I called for a comforter, it took an hour to come and when it came it smelled awful.. i complained and they sent me another in 10 minutes. Personally I feel for all they charge they sjould provide better service.

reviews.author: Monica M
reviews.title: vacaciones increibles
reviews.text: recomendable 100% excelente comida, limpieza, habitaciones, increible zona infantil para niños, ya tengo reservado para volver en diciembre. dispone de centro comercial dentro del complejo y la zona spa es de ensueño , recomiendo 100% un buen masaje y un paseo por el circuito .

reviews.author: tunesia s
reviews.title: Satisfaction Granted
reviews.text:
I celebrated my 45th Birthday my husband and his brother and girlfriend in Punta Cana and we stayed at the Paradisus for 7 days.  A Dream come true. The people are amazing the resort is gorgeous and I would thank everyone who helped make the 1st time I left the country Priceless:
A Special Thank You to: Mr. Manuel A. Richardson, Mr. Francisco Estrella(a true gentleman)Mr. Michelet Loase(we love u), Mr. Hugo Alberto Mora(working everywhere at the same time), Mr. Wandy Castillo, Mr. Freddy Lopez (for your Freddy Specials), Mr. Jhonny Acevedo,  Mr. Jose Ramos, Mr. Wily Mercado(Willy Wonka we will miss you), Mr. Geraldo Palacio(the "King" of hospitality), and to a young lady who was very graceful, kind and warm: Ruquermin, Yeylin, Mery, and Aracels(Ladies at the Spa).

I pray your employer sees this post and give you all a raise or bonus.  I hope he realizes all of the hard work you all do everyday as you put your jobs and the people who visit first.  This place was nothing short of a dream come true and I thank God that he allowed me to visit this place.  this was a humbling experience for me leaving New York and traveling to such a beautiful place.  God bless you all.

reviews.author: Maggie V
reviews.title: Royal Service definitely paid off!
reviews.text:
My husband and I decided to return to Punta Cana for our 2nd honeymoon/1-year anniversary. We decided to choose a Melia hotel because of their reputation and because we stayed at a neighboring hotel before. 
And this was definitely a great choice! The royal service is definitely a must when staying here...I mean you have your own personal butler and a cell phone specifically for calling him/her at any time of the day or night. Anything from dinner reservations, spa reservations, excursion reservations, jacuzzi set-up, etc. is all at your fingertips thanks to the personal butler. We even had our butler set up a private dinner for 2 on the beach for us - definitely an unforgettable experience.
We enjoyed many adult-only specials (e.g. beach, pool, restaurants), which was great for us.
Our butler Nicolas Maracallo was exceptional. Would definitely stay there again for him. And our waiter at the Palazzo restaurant, Hosse Sylvain, was equally great.

reviews.author: Armando E
reviews.title: Bonito hotel muy buena atención
reviews.text:
Estamos alojados en el Paradisus Palma Real.
Nos vamos el viernes pero mientras estoy en el lobby disfrutando de un barcelo imperial con cocacola escribo estas líneas para destacar lo bien que lo hemos pasado y seguro seguiremos pasando en este maravilloso lugar.
La habitación enorme muy comoda perfecta para una familia con 2 hijos de 14 y 12 años. 
Las instalaciones,  piscina, playa y restaurantes espectacular la calidad de las comidas y bebidas de gran nivel.
Es tercera vez que vengo a un Paradisus y me voy muy conforme.
Mención especial merece la atencion en los bares un saludo a Ramon Fuego del Sky Bar que al 3er día sabía perfectamente que me gustaba beber y me preparaba los tragos con mucha amabilidad casi leyendo la mente a mi y a mi mujer. 
Una semana que se hace muuuuuy corta.
Saludos.
Armando Espinoza B.

reviews.author: BETSY T
reviews.title: ORIENTAL  GARDEN SPA
reviews.text:
It was a wonderful experience.  Ruth Tejada  explained everything to me.  I felt like I made a
friend.   I ended up getting 2 massages.  Wendy was unbelievable.  I had her both times.  I travel alone and I feel completely safe at this hotel.  May 2014 was my 3rd visit 
to the Paradisus Palma Real. Having an employee like Ruth is one of the reasons I enjoy  this hotel.  I never feel alone.  The atmosphere is awesome.  My service was excellent.   Above and  beyond.

reviews.author: mykewll
reviews.title: One of these is not like the others...
reviews.text:
A couple of years ago, I stayed at Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen and I was blown away by the service, even though it had small beach. For my honeymoon, I chose Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana based on my experience at Playa del Carmen. And I learned that not all Melia properties are the same. 

When we arrived to the property, there was a lot of confusion in the front of the building. Even though we signed up for Royal Service, no one greeted us or directed us to the right area. The bell boys and “managers” seemed to be more interested in the people leaving and were looking to receive a tip from them. We walked passed about 5 different front desk people before someone asked if we were checking in. And once they realized that we were Royal Service, then all of sudden we were important and had everyone wanting to carry our bags. Once we got to Royal Service area and began the check in process, we were told that our room wasn’t ready. We were early (arrived about 1:30pm), so no big deal and we went to have lunch while everything was getting ready. We toured the property and came back a little after 3:00pm (check in time) and our room still wasn’t ready. We waited another hour and a half (4:30pm) just to get in our room. And there still seemed to be some confusion as to who our butler would be or even if he was on duty at the time. 

Once we got to the room, I will admit, I was surprised by how nice it was and how large it was. The bed was HUGE. I believe that may have put two queen sized bed together. The room itself was pretty clean, no residual sand or anything like that. You can tell that it is an older property with some wear and tear, but it was still really nice. 
The beach is really nice, lots of space. The seaweed may be a seasonal thing, but the grounds crew did their best to control it. Every morning there was a crew racking up the seaweed that washed ashore overnight, but it did not take long for it to accumulate again.

The Bad: 

One thing that I noticed and it just may be a cultural thing. When asking for help or directions, we found that the staff was more receptive if you spoke Spanish. For example, I speak mainly English and called the front desk to ask for ice and I got the run around. My wife speaks fluent Spanish and called the front desk, we received ice in a matter of minutes. I guess the saying “when in Rome”, applies. 

There’s one guy, I believe he was a manager for the bell boys and his name was Carlos, wore glasses and gold uniform. He was the rudest person we encountered on the whole property. My wife and I had an excursion planned and was told to meet in the front at 11am. We showed up to the designated area at 10:50am. We walked up to Carlos and asked if we were in the right spot for pickup. Instead of verifying anything, he told us that the transport had already come, looked at his watch, and then said that we should have arrived earlier. He didn’t ask what company we were waiting for or who our contact was. Instead of taking his word, I went to the excursion desk and found out that our transport had never arrived and we would be rescheduled. No apology was offered from Carlos. Not only that, but whenever we needed help from him or had a question about anything, he treated us as if we were a bother, like we were forcing him to do his job. 

Our transportation and excursions were through HotelBeds.com. This company has a few issues. Our biggest complaint was that the Paradisus reservation specialist booked our transportation for us through HotelBeds.com, but there seemed to be zero communication between the 2 companies once you arrive to the property. For example, the night before we left, we expected some kind of confirmation or email for our transport back to the airport, but we didn’t get one. We went to the Royal Service lounge to ask if there was a specific check out time for us or what time we needed to be ready for transport, no one knew. We ended up calling a representative with HotelBeds after hours to get a confirmation and they did not know. It took us waiting until the next morning and hunting down the rep on property to figure things out. Warning: If you use HotelBeds.com, make sure you get all of your confirmations ahead of time, ask questions, and do not assume anything. 

Our butler set reservations for us at Bana Bistro. Of all the restaurants on the property, this was the worst one. We walked in and it was total chaos. Servers were running around like there was a fire in the kitchen, the hostess was overwhelmed, like the number of guests were not expected. Once we sat down, we waited 10 minutes before we got a server. As we sat, there were guests hunting down anyone to pour water, clean tables…we saw two couples walk out without ordering anything. I’m not sure if it was just a bad night, but it was totally disorganized and chaotic. The food was good though.

The website states that there is high speed internet in the rooms and throughout the property. This is untrue. We were there Sunday to Friday and the only time we were able to connect to the internet consistently was in the Royal Service lounge. Once we walked out, it was like searching for diamond in the sand. And it wasn’t isolated. All other guests we ran into had the same complaint. When we asked about it, we were told that the engineer was working on it...the whole time we were there. True enough, you’re on vacation and should be disconnected…but it’s advertised. 

We went to the Royal Service lounge to report a clogged drain because our butler was off duty at the time and the phone we received to call him did not work(worked one day, became a paperweight the rest of trip) and to ask the lady that checked us in, Luisiada, about a discount she promised to get us for excursions and to get clarification for the hotel credits. She offered that we have a seat and get a drink while they contacted our butler. Unfortunately for us, this was a set up for a time share presentation of Club Melia. So if anyone from the staff offers you discounts or “free” money, it’s a time share pitch. As for the hotel credits, they are not like a gift card where you can use it throughout the property. It basically amounts to 5-10% discounts on specific items or services that have extreme price inflation. For example, we got a $10 discount on a bottle of wine that cost $40 there, but cost $13 here in the US. Basically, it’s smoke and mirrors & should be better explained on the website as to what you are really getting. 

The good: 

Our butler, Eduard, was awesome. Even after the confusion of getting us checked in, he did his best to smooth over the situation. He made us dinner reservations on the spot and then walked us to the restaurant to make sure there were no problems. Another thing I thought was awesome and creepy all at the same time was that no matter where we were, how often we moved around, he always found us just to check up on us and to see if we needed anything. Even if he was going to be off the following morning or the rest of the day, he took care of our reservations or any miscellaneous thing before he left for the day. By the end of our trip, I named him the “Paradisus Ninja” because he would pop up out of nowhere, with his notebook in hand, ready to see what he could do to make our day enjoyable. On our last night, he had a bubble bath with candles and flowers waiting for us after our dinner…something we didn’t ask for, but it was a perfect touch!

The Gabi Beach Restaurant was our favorite! The staff there was awesome, from the hostess, Kimberley,  to the guys walking around with rolls, Milkiado and Luciano. They were friendly, knowledgeable, and made our dining experience special each time we visited(3 times). But our waiter, Samuel Calcano…bent over backwards for us. Not once did we have to ask to have water refilled or have our wine glasses refreshed. And even though he had a section full of other guests, he made us feel as if we were his only guest. He made time to talk to us, get to know our likes and dislikes, and didn’t treat us like just another table. And when we told him that it was our honeymoon, he did even more to add to our special occasion. And that’s why we requested him each time we went. 

As we walked around the property, there was one guy that stood out that worked in the front of the property, Franklin Caraballo. A couple of times, we had the look of being lost and he would drop what he was doing just to come check on us to see if we needed anything or directions. He wasn’t our butler, didn’t work in Royal Service, didn’t carry any of our bags, and we didn’t give him one tip…but he always made us feel like we were “at home” and calling us by name, after just asking one time. This guy should be the first person new guests talk to when arriving. His friendliness and warm personality really made a big difference in our stay. 

The staff in Pallazzo was the friendliest people we ran into. We ate there every morning and were always greeted with a huge smile and friendly conversation by Stephania Auguste as we walked in. The rest of the wait staff were extremely professional and welcoming, like our meal with them was their most important meal to serve. The food there is ok…not the best, but good resort food. Breakfast and lunch are done as tapas, with a couple of grill options. The best part was that the chef (can’t remember his name), that worked the mornings of July 28-31, was nice enough to make us an off the menu egg sandwich every morning. It really made for a great start of each day. And on our last day, Stephania stopped what she was doing just to personally say “goodbye” and how much she enjoyed us and that it was a pleasure. Maybe she says this to everyone, but I think she really means it every time she says it. 

Though we had issues with HotelBeds.com, their representative, Francis, did take care of us. When our excursion transport failed to pick us up, he hustled to get us rescheduled and threw in parasailing for our inconveniences. After that, he made sure that we didn’t have any issues with other excursions. And when we had issues with transportation back to the airport, once again, he resolved the situation and personally came to check on us to make sure all was well. 

And our beach attendant, Francisco Cabrera, went above and beyond. There were a couple of morning that we would run into him and he would ask if we planned to visit the beach. He asked this so that we could pick out our cabana even though we were heading to breakfast. Even though there was a beach full of people with different demands and desires, he was very efficient and quick to get us refills on drinks or bring towels. And he did it with a smile. It got to the point that we chose to go to the beach just because he was there and we knew that we would be well taken care of.  

As I said in the beginning, not all Melia properties are the same. Maybe it’s cultural, maybe it’s the clientele…I just expected a lot more and not just highlights from a handful of people.  All in all, Paradisus Palma is a nice resort but it has some issues that I believe, if addressed, could have happier guests.  If it wasn’t for the staff I mentioned above, I truly believe that this would have been a disappointing trip.

reviews.author: atmpbryan
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text: Our stay was everything we hoped for.  We were married on the beach in a private ceramony. Sahoni and Meriella in the romance department were on top of everything coordinating our ceramony. Service was excellent! We highly recommend the Royal Service upgrade. Our Butler Fermin Mota was fantastic booking our dinner reservations for the week and suprising us with extras daily in the room from fresh cut fruit, champagne chilled and waiting, chocolate dipped strawberries and rose petals on bed and arround a nice bubble bath. There was only one restaurant not included in the all-inclusive package even with Royal Service. My advice...spend the $60 each and enjoy Passion. The service was outstanding (2 waiters per table) and food both a la carte and 6 course tour were fantastic in presentation, taste and quality!

reviews.author: Rosana D
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Estivemos em Mai/2014 eu, meu marido e meu filho de 4 anos, aproveitamos muito excelentes restaurantes, 11 no total que precisam ser agendada com concierge do hotel, pessoal de atendimento muito simpático  a praia tem um pouco de algas  mas o azul do mar compensa tudo, quartos agradáveis mas a decoração talvez precise ser atualizada mas sao confortáveis piscinas fantásticas faltam atrativos para crianças pois somente nas piscinas do The reserve encontramos um kids Club mas meu filho curtiu muito e nós também.  Na parte de lazer verifique pois o hotel possui alguns itens inclusos tais como snorkell catamarã  e etc . Os passeios externos são poucos pra quem nunca viu golfinhos existe um passeio para ve-los e tambem um passeio a uma gruta que se chama Olho Azul um dos lugares mis lindos que já vi em viagens pelo mundo uma gruta com uma lagoa de agua transparente porem azul turquesa pode se mergulhar mas é bem gelado Ufa!!! O passeio que leva de barco a uma ilha não gostei bem fraquinho e o almoço que está incluso é bem fraquinho  aqui no Brasil temos passeios do tipo á piscinas naturais muito mais bonitos e gostosos. O  Hotel Paradisus  é muito bom o lugar é mágico vale a pena conhecer adoramos e voltaremos com certeza o ano que vem! Destaques para a  concierge Sugellis eficiente e muito simpática e abraços a Berna gerente do Hotel todos maravilhosos Recomendo

reviews.author: Emma B
reviews.title: Amazing Experience!
reviews.text: This place is amazing!  This was our first all inclusive experience and we were not disappointed.  We were looking for a vacation where we could take out 17 month old daughter and also relax - The Reserve definitely delivered on this.  We stayed in the Family Master Suite which is definitely worth the extra money if you have kids as it provides a lot of room to spread out, a separate bedroom from the living area where we could put our daughter to bed and stay up and chat.  The family concierge was Louisa was wonderful and she made sure that our time there was as stress free as possible.  She booked all our dinners, provided special treats such as a bubble bath filled with balloons for our daughter each night when we got back to the room and booked a cabana on the beach for us each morning.  We couldn't have asked for better.

reviews.author: se2121
reviews.title: Look no further...
reviews.text:
We took the free transportation that Melia gave us which was provided by Hotelbeds.  Their reps were very easy to find at the airport and left as soon as they loaded up the van.  Only had to stop at 1 other hotel so it was about a 40 minute experience to the resort.

Check-in was a mess.  We booked directly through Melia's website and when we got there, the resort didn't have our reservation.  The staff, however; was amazing.  They took our 15 month old boy and played with him while we attempted to sort everything out.  It was a 3 hour process but we were able to eat at The Reserve's buffet, Gabi Club.  

The room was extremely nice for the caribbean but for us, the layout was just odd and cramped.  And that was only with 2 adults and a 15 month old.  If you are traveling with more, you need to get the bigger room.  

Our concierge was Leidy who was just fantastic.  I can't say enough that all the employees were genuinely friendly and amazing.  Nothing is too big or too small to ask for.  We originally didn't want the Concierge service but did upgrade before we left for the trip and glad that we did.  You don't have to worry about a thing but, I would say between our requests and other things such a room service, it got done right about 50% of the time.  Nothing major, and nothing bad, just expect little things to be off.

Staying in The Reserve allows you to have a private area of the beach with towel service and their own bar.  It wasn't busy on either side of the beach but it was nice to have the same cabanna reserved for us every morning and the beach bar was by far the best.  I can't remember the bartenders name but he was amazing.  Had our drinks made as we were walking up to him.
