Our favorite place to eat was the Hydro Grill at The Reserve's pool.  Jose Reinoso and cook Ramon Simbert were awesome.  From the salads to the pizzas to the chicken phillys everything was always perfect.  

The rest of the restaurants were all fine.  Don't come here expecting 5 star food but you will be surprised by the freshness and quality of the food.  Always a good selection where ever you ate.  

The resort is huge and so well kept.  I can't believe that it's as cheap to stay here as it is.  I could go on and on but if you're looking for a resort in Punta Cana, look no farther.  You wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: Marcy S
reviews.title: WONDERFUL VACATION!
reviews.text:
Just go back from an amazing 5 night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana. This trip was for some very long overdue R&R and that is exactly what I got. We had Royal Service which definitely makes your stay carefree. Our butler Johnfi is without a doubt EXCEPTIONAL! He has to be one of the most pleasant, professional gentlemen that I have ever met. We are very easy going travelers and as long as we have the essentials (clean room, good food, great surroundings etc.) that is all we need. He was very eager to do whatever we needed and never failed to take extra steps to provide us with daily surprises to surpass our expectations. He is truly an asset to the Paradisus Palma Real, DR and ultimately Melia! Thank you Johnfi for making our vacation wonderful and carefree!
 
We had absolutely perfect weather and spent all of our time at the Royal Service pool where Leonardo the bar tender greeted us at every chance by name and with a huge smile. Always ready to serve. As if the beautiful surroundings and peacefulness aren't enough to start your day off right, Leonardo just puts "the icing on the cake"! Thank you Leonardo for keeping us hydrated all day with the most delicious concoctions!
 
I'm a true foodie, but have to say though the food was good, it definitely isn't the best, but you won't go hungry. I found several items at different restaurants that were quite delicious. Breakfast at the Palazzo daily was fabulous. We ate dinner at Palazzo, Gabi Beach, Market Grill, Vento and Banal (Tepenyaki). Some items missed the mark, but all in all we enjoyed. There is certainly something for everyone! The only slight issue is that their is definitely a bit of a language barrier in the restaurants with the waitstaff. It took a few tries in some instances to see the "light bulb" go on! You just have to be patient, but this is something that they can try to work on.
 
The entire resort is so clean and everyone is so pleasant. I wouldn't hesitate for a moment to consider returning for another vacation.
 
Great job Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana!

reviews.author: NCTravelAgent
reviews.title: Beautiful resort + terrific service = One Amazing Vacation!
reviews.text:
My husband and I vacationed at Paradisus Palma Real for five days in August 2014. However, because of the amazing time we had, we've come to the conclusion that five days simply isn't long enough! 

From the moment you enter the open lobby, which provides stunning views of the main pool and the Atlantic Ocean, you know that this is going to be one great vacation! 

Rooms: 

Our room was nicely decorated with dark colored, wooden furniture; a sitting area with a sofa, a small table with two chairs, perfect for in-room dining; a beautiful garden view; and conveniently located near the main lobby. The very spacious, open-bathroom included a separate shower, private toilet area and an awesome whirlpool! For increased privacy, the shutters separating the room and the bathroom can be closed. 

Restaurants:

I've visited quite a few all-inclusive resorts. I can honestly say that the food here was much better than many of the resorts I've visited. The food was always served at the appropriate temperature, the presentation was great, and the servers were constantly replenishing. The facility, in which the buffet is normally served, is under renovation. However, in my opinion this did not disrupt the level of service provided in any way. Typically when you think buffet, you think of so-so food placed in inexpensive chafers, surrounded by food that has been dropped by the patrons, etc. But, not at Paradisus Palma Real! Even the buffet was elegantly displayed. 

Two of our favorite servers were Franklin S. and Wandy C. They both were extremely attentive and possessed bubbly personalities. Franklin S. even took the time to teach my husband and I a few Spanish words we didn't know! He takes great pride in his position and wanted to ensure that all of his guests felt at home. 

On our final night, we dined at The Market Grill. Again, the food was awesome, as was the service. Unfortunately, we were so exhausted that we slept through dinner on two nights and didn't get to experience any of the remaining a la carte restaurants. 

WiFi:

Complimentary WiFi connection is offered in the rooms and most common areas. Because this is included, I did not contact my cell phone carrier to adjust my calling plan. My plan was to use Viber throughout my stay. Viber is an internet-based app which allows you to call and text others with the app, over a Wi-Fi connection free of charge. The WiFi connection in the room was great. However, I did have issues connecting in the main lobby at times and was never able to connect in any of the common areas outside of the main lobby. While this did cause some inconvenience, it definitely wasn't a large enough inconvenience to ruin my vacation. 

Service: 

Each staff member we encountered was friendly and very helpful. All of our questions were adequately answered and guidance provided when needed. 

During our second day, we experienced a slow-draining sink in the bathroom. The issue was literally corrected within 15 minutes of informing the staff. 

I could go on and on. However, I'll stop here and sum it up... Paradisus Palma Real is a 'Must-Visit' resort! When possible, plan a full week because anything shorter simply won't do. We are already planning our return visit for next summer.

reviews.author: Richard H
reviews.title: Excellant Club Melia Vacation
reviews.text: Back in July of this year I took my wife and 3 children (22 years old) for a 8 night graduation present. The food was excellant, the suites were clean and roomy, the beach & pool clean, no sales pitches, and security was good, as no one bothered you at the pool or on the beach. Can't wait to go back next year.

reviews.author: QueenAkua
reviews.title: Wow! We were very pleased
reviews.text: There is nothing bad to say about our stay, the service is second to none and the food is very good, their attention to detail is on point. We choose the Reserve to celebrate our anniversary and Anabel Gonzalez and Adalgisa Morla  made it so special for us. We will be back. Come you won't be disappointed

reviews.author: Yarly F
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
what a disappointment! I don't even know where to start, 
food: Terrible, no taste at all and in top of it, there were flies, yes, flies flying all over the food, the plates, the silverware, it made me so nauseous. 

service: S L O W, we had the royal service, what a waste of money, we got the most slow and uniformed butler, he never knew anything, his answer was... "I have to ask " anything from the activities (which there were none) to were we could eat better food, there was not Dominican culture anywhere.

Beach and pool: Great if you want to go sleep, for which I rather use a room, there was no people, or activities in either. the drinks were terrible and again the service, slow and bad

Rooms: the only good thing that this resort had, with the exception of the phone ringing every 30 minutes for no reason.

this trip has been the worst trip I had, really bad because it left me with the sensation of never returning not only to the hotel but to Dominican Republic all together.
 I will never recommend this hotel or the destination.

reviews.author: Kefs2014
reviews.title: Great experience... only the food
reviews.text:
I truly enjoyed my stay at Paradisus Palma Real, very nice hotel, very good service, impecable rooms and nice beach, although there were lots of seaweed when we visit in august, not the best for those who love to swim in the ocean.

What I really didn´t enjoy was food, the worst: the bread at breakfast, the desserts and all lunch meals they offer at the buffet. What I enjoyed the most: Paella at The Grill, salads and most of the restaurants you have to reserve.

Overall it was a nice experience, relaxing, not boring at all.

reviews.author: Taramarievan22
reviews.title: 3 star at best, would never go back
reviews.text:
i went to Paradisus in Dominican for a weekend with my husband and we took my sister for a graduation gift.  I would never go back for many reasons...

1. The Service is too slow and "carefree", but this is typical of Islands
2. The Royal Service provided by the hotel is a joke....there is no Royal Service, more like a Royal Pain in the you know what.  The catch is you have your own "butler"...I mean, come on, it's a joke. Example: when I want to make a dinner reservation at a hotel, I like to dial '0", tell the operator I want a dinner reservation and get a confirmation.  No...you have to contact your Butler on some Old school Nokia Phone and have him do it...It's ridiculous.
3.  We arrived at the hotel at 2:00pm, had to sit in the waiting area for an hour and a hotel employee explained the resort for about a half hour and then around 3:30 - 4:00pm, our rooms were not ready and one out of the two rooms were not even an ocean view which we requested.  By the way, I don;t need a 30 minute explanation of a resort...I like to walk around and figure it out myself.

I could go on and on about the service...Sub Par at Best.  The rooms were dated and the temperatures in the room were wacky, basically the humidity outside and the temperature inside was all wrong and the sheets would feel not clean.  

The food overall was good and people seemed to have a nice time.  I prefer a more luxurious hotel and this was far from it.

reviews.author: airbaker
reviews.title: Staff was great
reviews.text: The resort is nice and the staff was great.  Ramon Fuego & Jose Campecharro were awesome at the Sky Bar.  There were several people at the indoor buffet who were great as well including Gregorio. Initially, we had an upgraded room, which was nice, but needed an adjoining room to family members so had to switch to a smaller non-upgraded room because apparently upgraded rooms do not adjoin (?).  The room was somewhat dated, musty, and the electricity would randomly go out.  We couldn't get a television to work either. All in all it worked though.

reviews.author: E_from_Cali
reviews.title: Outstanding location, facilities, and beach
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed in the club melia side of the Paradisus Palma Real to celebrate our marriage anniversary.  Currently they are undergoing construction at their Naos restaurant facility, but even so the facilities and view towards the beach from the lobby is unbeatable.  It's one of the few places where the pictures on their website truly capture how magnificent the facility really is.  The gym is nice and the accessibility of the beach and palapas for the guest are top notch.

We spent a lot of time at the Sky bar (24 hr service bar).  The two bartenders during our stay, Rosa Abreu and Nector Dilone, were consistently the nicest and most helpful people at the resort.  Rosa does not speak fluent English but she was more than willing to hold basic spanish/english conversations with us.  Nector spoke a little more english so they were a perfect combo to practice our spanish with.  They were both engaging, extremely friendly to us and everyone who came to the bar, and they made great drinks which made it our favorite drinking location on the entire facility.  Also, the bartender during the evenings at the Gabi Beach bar (9 PM on 8/26) was great to interact with (sorry I can't remember his name).

The majority of the workers were very welcoming and friendly but on a few occasions we had or witnessed some interactions that were less then pleasant.  In comparison to the Paradisus Playa Del Carmen where 95 - 100% of the working population spoke English, a smaller population of the staff spoke english which caused some problems.  Even with our very basic grasp of the spanish language we sometimes ran in to staff who seemed perturbed that we couldn't speak it fluently.  In one case, they even complained about us in spanish because they didn't think we could understand but we could get the gist of what they were saying.  (Part of the reason we kept going back to Rosa and Nector.)  We also witnessed a few guests who were equally stubborn with the staff because they didn't speak english, so there is blame to be shared by all.  In general if you try to speak spanish and they can tell you are not fluent they will speak to you in english (if they can) or at least the whole interaction is more pleasant as you try to communicate because you tried.

In short (with things I hadn't mentioned above) -
Pros:
- Great facility and rooms
- In general, very friendly staff at restaurants and bars
- Beautiful view and locations

Cons:
- Extremely spotty wireless service in the rooms.  Don't expect to stream netflix, HBO, etc
- Unpolished staff.  While friendly they don't have the complete customer service part down.
- There are mosquitos and other bugs in the room that bite you when you sleep.

Tips:
- If you plan to tip occasionally bring your own small bills.  The lobby staff are hit or miss on whether they decide to change your larger bills.  Seems like a no brainer that they would have tons of change to provide since their staff would benefit but it seems like quite the burden for them when you ask.

reviews.author: msfoofy1236
reviews.title: Honeymoon Heaven
reviews.text:
We loves this resort! IT was beautiful and relaxing.  The staff was very friendly and helpful at all times.  

We had the Royal Service and it was amazing.  Our Butler Jose was great!  He helped plan out our reservations for the week for dinner and any other things we wanted to do.  He would always check in to see if there was anything else we needed and he was always a phone call away.  Several nights before dinner he brought a snack to our room, so when we returned form the pool we had something to eat and he also filled our hot tub for us and put chocolate covered strawberries out.

The weather said rain everyday but it rarely rained and we had warm sunny weather everyday of our week long trip.  The resort is kept extremely clean, there was always staff around keeping things in order.  The room was beautiful and was kept stocked everyday with soda and chips that we had eaten from the day before.  The beach was very clean and had plenty of cabanas and lounge chairs to set up on and the staff on the beach was always there to help set you up in a perfect spot or get you a drink.  

The food was excellent and especially with the royal service there were always a few choices for each meal.  Dinner was the best, we ate in a different restaurant every night we were there and never had a bad meal.  They were also very generous with the food.  Although some of the plates were smaller portions, you could order two entrees to try.  We liked being able to order multiple things off the menu to try everything.  One night the waiter saw us switching plates so that we could try each others dish and asked if we would rather just have a second dish of each!

We would definately return here for a relaxing sun filled vacation. We spent all of our days at the beautiful beaches or pools relaxing drinking and eating! We love you Jose!

reviews.author: Javiquel
reviews.title: Un complejo
reviews.text: Un complejo excelente, un servicio completo, y sobre todo los Mojitos, combinados y copteles que prepara RAMON FUEGO, un barman espectacular. Escrito desde España, La Rioja. Si.alguna vez regreso a la Republica, que espero que si, volvere a Palma Paradisus para tomarme esos mogitos que prepara el grandisimo RAMON FUEGO..................................

reviews.author: stanvard
reviews.title: Terrific Property - Not quite luxury, but almost
reviews.text:
I just got back from 5 nights at Paradisus Palma Real.  I needed a getaway to a beautiful, high-end resort where it was warm and I could just relax, and I got exactly what I was looking for.

If you are a true luxury traveler, a big all-inclusive isn't going to do it for you.  A huge resort just can't feel exclusive and completely, even if areas of it are devoted to being such (which this one had).  For some reason, I hadn't processed that before I arrived.  But once I accepted that fact (and hearing/reading about many of the other resorts in Punta Cana), I realized that the Paradisus is probably the best place to stay in Punta Cana, its staff does a great job at creating as luxurious an environment as possible, and I had a really great time.

In order to be helpful to future travelers, I'll focus my review on a few specifics:

1.  The Reserve vs. Paradisus Royal Service
2.  Royal Service vs. No Royal Service
3.  A few good things
4.  The resort's challenges to expect
5.  Things the resort can improve on

1.  The Reserve vs. Paradisus Royal Service

I was originally booked to stay at The Reserve, the newer, fancier, smaller, and more exclusive property of the Palma Real situated behind the main hotel (away from the beach).  I was really looking forward to my swim-up room, an outdoor jacuzzi, private garden, and private Bali Bed (The Reserve comes with full access to everything at the main resort).  When I arrived, I was told that they had a room at the main resort in the Royal Service section, which is the adults-only luxury section of the main resort - right on the beach, with a butler - that they could upgrade me to for free.  I wasn't sure what to do, as I had been really looking forward to the room at the Reserve, but they convinced me to go to Royal Service as my room was right on the beach with a balcony overlooking the beach.  

It was a tradeoff that I think was ultimately worth it.  When I booked, I didn't mind that the Reserve was 1/2 mile from the beach, but it ended up being a huge plus to be right there, since I enjoy sitting by a beach more than sitting by a pool, and the Royal Service comes with butler service (including a cell phone to contact him), which is not offered for folks without kids at the Reserve.  My butler (Yohel) was great, made all of my on-property restaurant reservations for me, and helped me out with anything I needed.  Royal Service also comes with its own large section of the beach with lots of big cushioned lounge chairs as well as bali-beds on a beautiful stretch of beach where you are not disturbed by folks trying to sell you things.  My room was also lovely and spacious and again - right on the beach.

What I did give up was what I think would have been a nicer room experience at The Reserve and a more exclusive feel, as well as a much more tranquil atmosphere overall.  The private pool for Royal Service guests was the size of a postage stamp and always crowded, whereas the pools at The Reserve and even the main pool at the resort felt fairly empty and peaceful.  If you want to spend the day sitting by the pool (or in your own private garden!), choose The Reserve.  If you have a family, choose The Reserve (lots of kids activities).  If you are looking for privacy, choose The Reserve.  If you prefer to be on the beach, choose Royal Service to be close to the beach and go to The Reserve whenever you want quiet pools.

2.  Royal Service vs. No Royal Service

If you can swing the added cost (or you are offered a free upgrade like I was ;) and you are not with kids, Royal Service is the way to go.  You have access to 4 restaurants on the property that the main resort guests do not have (for free), and priority booking at all of the restaurants (and these restaurants are MUCH better than the rest).  You have an exclusive beach area with lots of staff and great lounging options.  You have a great indoor lounge, very close to your room with internet access and food & drink throughout the day.  You have a butler devoted to you to help you with anything you need.  I never thought I would want that, but it came in handy and made my stay easier.  All that being said, the rest of the resort is beautiful as well, the main pool is huge, and there are plenty of great seats on the main beach.

3.  A few good things

- The service was really excellent, even outside of a great butler.  Sure there was a glitch here and there, but there were tons of staff and everyone was extremely professional and tried very hard to accommodate and help you relax.  I have heard it's the best service in Punta Cana, and I don't doubt that.
- The food was really quite good in the exclusive restaurants (and all of The Reserve restaurants), and they also have 24-hour room service.
- The property is really beautiful - well-landscaped and well kept.
- The beach is really beautiful - lots of white sand that they manicure every morning, with amazing beach chairs/bali beds and great staffing.
- Really easy/fast to get from The Reserve to the main resort.

4.  The resort's challenges to expect

- There is The Reserve, Royal Service, Melia Subscribers, Family Concierge, and other distinctions which have different privileges, areas, and benefits.  It all gets a little confusing.  Some of the amenities are at the main resort, while others (like exercise classes) are at The Reserve.  There is a huge book of options/services in the room It can feel like too much thinking (vacation-thinking that is!) to parse out everything.  But I guess that's just the way they cater to the broadest clientele they can.  Just know that it feels like a big resort, even if you stay to just your 'exclusive' area - for good or for bad.
- The food at the non-exclusive restaurants really isn't as good as the food at the exclusive restaurants.
- Many of the resort's restaurants require long pants and closed shoes for men for dinner.  I didn't know this ahead of time and brought one pair of each, but found it irritating to have to put them on every night.  I don't think it would detract from the atmosphere to have men wear a nice polo and shorts and sandals.  Who cares?  Get dressed up only if you want to.
- While the beach is gorgeous, the water is not great.  It's not the resort's fault at all.  But there is really tons of seaweed which you have to walk over and swim with.  I spent a lot less time in the ocean than I expected to.  But I guess that's Bavaro Beach.  And it's not crystal clear like Turks & Caicos - really because of the seaweed.
-  While the service is great, it is very in-your-face.  I have found that service at really top-notch places is largely invisible and more subtle.  But I think that's The Melia's (company who owns the resort) style and I am confident all of the employees were fulfilling their expectations very well.

5.  Things the resort can improve on

These are good to know (and did not ruin my trip at all), and things I think management can improve on to make this an even better experience in the future:
- The main buffet is really sub-par.  Anyone used to buffets at resorts or cruises will be disappointed (so I'm told).
- The reservation system is weird.  It was easy for me, because my butler set everything up via Royal Service, but I heard a lot of griping, since folks sometimes could not get reservations or we were told we had to make them, and the restaurants were often fairly empty.
- Neither the Spa at the main resort nor the Royal Service reception had a spa menu from the Reserve (bigger spa) with prices.  So I had to go all the way to The Reserve to look at prices and book (or I could have called, but still - silly).
- The spa treatments were so-so and indistinguishable from one another.
- The Yoga class I took was laughable.  It did not resemble Yoga in any way.  It was a combination of vogueing, sleeping, and stretching.  I left after 25 mins.  Anyone expecting real Yoga should stay away.
- Keys get demagnetized easily/often.  Pain to keep going back to get them re-magnetized.

Those are some details I hope will be helpful to future vacationers/management.  On the whole, I really had a terrific time.  I am not sure I would go back to Punta Cana because of the so-so ocean and not great access to great excursions, but as a stand-alone resort/beach, it was pretty terrific and just what the doctor ordered.

reviews.author: tharealist
reviews.title: First time at an all-inclusive....SOLD!
reviews.text:
A beautiful resort. I am glad that I have started my all-inclusive exploration with an excellent hotel like the Paradisus Palma Real.

I paid for the basic all inclusive package (i.e no royal service, reserve, etc) and I don't think I would if I returned. I was extremely happy with all the basic services offered and took advantage of many of them. 

Pros (no particular order):

1. Many facilities (including restaurants) are shared between the Reserve and Palma Real. For example, I frequently went to the wellness centre during my stay.  You can use facilities at the reserve (I took spinning classes in the morning, tennis in the afternoon). 

We booked reservations for dinner at Aqua (located at the reserve) even though we stayed at the palma real and there were no issues.

2. rooms are spacious, clean, comfortable, kinda chilly though with high AC. nice jacuzzi.

3. food selection was wonderful and I am a pescatarian. My favourite place to eat was the Market Grill.  They are open 24hrs. Vento was great.

4. Extremely warm, friendly staff. Lovely people all around.

5. STUNNING views and beachfront. White sand was magnificent and I would spent entire days laid up in a cabana just marveling at the site of it all.

6. Very classy.  I highly recommend this place for newlyweds, families, young professionals.  Not too much of a "young college kid" crowd which was great. Low key, elegant.

7.  Very courteous staff.  I felt pampered.  Be sure to tip  generously as they clearly work extremely hard to make your stay enjoyable.

Cons

1. Had to call a few times to finally get the wifi to work in my room.  Hotel needs to get on top of this.  Its annoying.

2. I got sick on my last evening at the hotel. I hope the hotel is making ice for their drinks with filtered water. I have a feeling that not doing so may have been the culprit possibly along with what i ate.  Plenty of wedding guests got sick too. My stomach turns when I think of the last meal I had at the resort (pad thai at the bistro).

3. Making dinner reservations is a bit frustrating.  We never got the time slot that we wanted. However, food was good.

4. Unfortunately, I found that the quality and serving size of plated dinners for private events were simply not as good as the a la carte restaurants or buffet for that matter.  I attended two private events at the Palma Real and was not impressed.  Our group literally went to the market grill afterward and ate.  Just a note to those people thinking about holding private events certain dishes are not made in the traditional way (e.g. vegetable lasagna was not made with "normal" lasagna noodles.

Tips:

1.  I got a nice post-workout massage from fitness instructors at the resort.  Tip handsomely. No need for me to use the spa...it was that good. Just ask.

2. Take advantage of the included activities (e.g. kickboxing, tennis, basketball, etc).  The instructors will work with you to meet fitness goals and go above and beyond to educate you and provide you with extra/extended services that may not be included in 1 hour lessons.  Just talk to them, everyone there is relaxed and friendly.

3. I hated the sweet "dominican" style ketchup served at buffets.  I just got some mini heinz bottles from room service and would bring that with me to lunch for burgers, hotdogs, fries, etc.

4. Don't waste your money at the gift shop. When approaching the beachfront from the main pool area, make a left and walk all the way down the beach (pass the melia, gabi beach, etc) until you hit an indoor market (10 minute walk).  Haggle all you want for sourvenirs, jewellery, alcohol, etc. Its fun, you directly assist local business and you will save a tonne of cash.  Bring money and some patience.

5. Check out the evening shows, they are worth it.

6. Ask one of the groundskeepers outside wearing green to get you a fresh coconut to drink from off the trees. Tip well!!  Not sure if they are actually allowed to do this but money talks people!

Classy environment and wonderful experience overall.   WILL DEFINITELY RETURN !

reviews.author: Catherine P
reviews.title: All I can say is LUIS SANTANA is the best!
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, Luis Santana the waiter on the beach was excellent! He was super attentive, sweet and always welcoming! He helped with everything from getting drinks, towels and providing great conversation and service. He is truly one of a kind! If you come to this resort, make sure to ask for Luis...you won't be disappointed!

reviews.author: ToniMaroni999
reviews.title: Amazingly beautiful!!!! Did not want to leave!
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with the most helpful, attentive, and friendly staff. The resort is absolutely beautiful, with perfectly manicured grounds and breathtaking views of the ocean. The resort has plenty of activites to keep you busy, and tons of restaurants to choose from. The highlight of my trip, would be Luis Santana. He was our beach boy, and he took great care of us our entire stay. We didnt have to want for anything. He was extremely attentive, helpful, and super friendly. Everyday at the beach was a total joy because of him. We laughed and talked all day long. By the end of our 
trip, we had become fast friends. It also doesnt hurt, that he's easy on the eyes too ;-). If you visit this resort, you will not be disappointed. And dont forget to look for Luis!

reviews.author: Kurt S
reviews.title: Would not return
reviews.text: 1) The food was not worth the additional money spent for all-inclusive. 2). There are several restaurants on the property that require a reservation.  First, it is difficult to obtain a reservation, you have to go to the concierge in the morning, stand in line, and the wait until they get the reservation department on the phone (~20 minute wait).  However, there are 3 restaurants that never had availability, which was frustrating.  We ate at the Japanese steakhouse, Thai restaurant, and sushi restaurant.  The food at the Thai restaurant was decent.  The other two restaurants did not provide good food.  And the service at the sushi restaurant was terrible.  It was an approximately 2.5 hour meal. 3) the property is undergoing a major renovation and we experienced the sounds of jack hammering throughout the day. 4) the wifi service is awful, so if you need to check email or other work related items, this is problematic.

reviews.author: MARIA CECILIA S
reviews.title: Excelente Fin de Semana
reviews.text: Estuvimos alojados solo tres días que se nos hicieron muy poco. La atencion te hace sentir mejor que en casa. Todos los empleados son maravillosos, son amables, agradables. Es un hotel de sueños. El area infantil es muy completa y las personas que cuidan a los niños son especiales y cariñosas. La Comida divina, las habitaciones super comodas, las instalaciones con un diseño unico y precioso, cada detalle es acogedor.   Es un hotel con todo lo que necesitan, adultos, jovenes y niños.

reviews.author: Lourdesbosch
reviews.title: Un encanto de hotel
reviews.text: Precioso y muy tranquilo, no hay mucha gente. Los jardines muy bien cuidados, la piscina perfecta sin agobios de gente. La comida realmente exquisita. Lo único que no nos gustó es que en la habitación solo hay un armario de 0'50 cm. de ancho, super pequeño para este tipo de habitaciones, tuvimos que dejar la ropa en cajones, y nunca hacían las habitaciones antes de las 6 de la tarde. La playa en esta zona siempre está movida, no se aprecia un color precioso del mar, las actividades que ofrece el hotel para realizar en la playa están super bien.

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: Overall resort was beautiful and clean
reviews.text: My bf and I went here on a relaxing vacation and yes, it was relaxing. When you arrive they give you these vouchers for wine and the casino, personally I think they were stupid and it should just be included. Certain wines at the restaurant were not included which you would use your voucher. We stayed at the main hotel not the reserve, most of the restaurants were tasty with the exception of Vento which gilded the Lilly with their dishes. There aren't too many options for lunch.The staff overall was very pleasant. My favorite staff was the pool/beach attendant Francisco Cabrera , the hostess Stephanie Auguste  and waiter Alexander Guzman at the palazzo. They always had a smile on their face and we're very accommodating. The beach was beautiful, clean with sparkling turquoise water. Personally our butler wasn't much help but other couples really benefited from their butlers and the help they could offer them. As neither my bf or I speak spanish communicating was difficult at times. The royal service center didn't seem to really know too much of what's going on. My complaint of the room was the shower. For some reason we didn't always get hot water from the main upper shower head which didn't have much pressure. Cleaning service was always around to clean your room. Overall would I revisit? Yes. Will you enjoy your stay? Yes it's a low key hotel quiet with some music and activities going on near the main lobby. At night near the rooms at 9:00 it's completely quiet.

reviews.author: Clint R
reviews.title: Fantastico
reviews.text:
This review is long overdue. We stayed at the paradisus reserve   In April of 2014 during the spring break ,and to clarify, it was the section with family concierge.  Our concierge was Hairol   He was excellent, and highly attentive to our family needs , and our children specifically.   It was our daughter's birthday during the trip, we dined at Fuego.  Hairol made it very special for her , the entire staff in restaurant sang happy birthday, and made a fantastic cake.  Also, when we returned to room there were balloons everywhere in the room and in the tub!  This was all Hairol's doing for sure. It was magical for 9 yr old girl.  Franklin was our room service host mostly. He wAs so kind, and very good looking !just a super sweet disposition     My only regret, and I sincerely hope the hotel gets this review:  I wish I had the copy of music playlist cd !!!!!! I love lounge and house music, so it was on point.  Seriously good.  The bathroom, the eating areas were fabulous! Replete with good music.  Seriously guys. Send me a copy please'!!!!!!!!!!  One caveat: Mosquitos ! Horrible after 3 days. Seriously big bites.  Don't wear fragrance and bring lots of repellent. As in old fashioned OFF bug spray      Food was excellent.  Something for everyone.   The kids camp good. 

Yes , they try to sell you vacation club aka timeshare.  But go for the 90 min.  It may be worth it for you. It's not for my family , but might be for yours.    I had a great time at this place.. Rooms very large , clean, up to date and comfy.   Reserve your cabana early.  It's a wonderful place for families.  Gym was adequate.  Nothing weird or wonderful.  Take advantage of the bikes around property.   The property is enormous, after 7 days we STILL didn't see it all.   Hairol, Franlklin, Nestor,Yahira, Belkis. Hola!! Xoxo. Gracias,  from mr and mrs lee Rosenzweig from ny

reviews.author: Eric D
reviews.title: Butler service
reviews.text:
We were pleased to have Jose Salvador assigned to us... He was continuously looking out for our reservations on our big group. Also making sure our accommodation were good.

Strongly recommend the royal service upgrade.

The hotel was very good, although the internet was weak in the rooms.

reviews.author: Thiago F
reviews.title: Ótimos dias
reviews.text:
Reservamos o The Reserve, mas no local tivemos um upgrade para o Royal Service e podemos frequentar todas as áreas do Hotel. Realmente para quem vai em casal não compensa ficar no The Reserve, uma área bem familiar com muitas crianças e os restaurantes são bem parecidos aos do Paradisus.
O Royal Service foi excelente, fomos atendidos pelo concierge Samuel que se comunicava em Português conosco, além de falar inglês, francês e espanhol, ou seja, não passamos nenhuma dificuldade com a comunicação.
Os destaques do Hotel são as piscinas, quartos espaçosos com hidro e alguns restaurantes: Gabi Beach e Palazzo na minha oipinião são os melhores, tanto no almoço quanto no jantar.
Foram ótimos dias e certamente voltaria a me hospedar lá.

reviews.author: Danielle Elizab... P
reviews.title: It was ok
reviews.text: There was no wow factor to the resort. It was eh. My biggest complaint was lack of Spanish food. Expected to have Dominican food and nope, none. The staff was difficult to communicate with because of the language barrier. The room was nice. Room service was a nice touch and there were sodas and waters in your room. The pool was great but there was always a shortage of beach towels.

reviews.author: jandyr
reviews.title: Paradisus yes...  Family Concierge  NO
reviews.text: This was our fourth trip to a Paradisus resort. The resort is beautiful and we'll maintained. The  food is what's to be expected from an all inclusive,  decent,  but not great.  Overall the staff can use some training and polish,  but they are all very nice. We booked the Family Concierge  for the first and definitely the last time. Our "concierge"  was little more than an information booth attendant.  There was ZERO  personal service or pampering.  We're very self sufficient people,  our kids are a little older (9 & 10) and we speak the language,  so we were able to enjoy the trip without the benefits one wou expect when paying for a concierge. Don't waste your money..

reviews.author: Isabel V
reviews.title: Vacaciones fantásticas
reviews.text:
The Reserve, el hotel boutique dentro del complejo de Paradisus Punta Cana, es un lugar excelente para pasar unas vacaciones de descanso. 

El ambiente es agradable y pudimos gozar de la tranquilidad e intimidad que estábamos buscando durante toda la estancia

La arquitectura del resort es bonita, dispone de grandes espacios de los que hacer uso: la gran piscina con barras húmedas, multitud de restaurantes que les hacen disponer de una gsatronomía muy variada (cocina dominicana, internacional, grill, asiático, alta cocina, mexicano,etc), los preciosos jardines, etc 

La suite tenía un diseño adecuado y era muy cómoda. 

Y aunque no fuimos con niños pudimos ver que existe la posibilidad de acudir con la familia al completo (incluso los más chiquititos!), ya que disponen de un servicio de cuidado de niños muy bueno. Con instalaciones muy completas a parte, cuidadores, actividades especiales, etc

Lo mejor de nuestro viaje sin duda alguna fue el servicio, fantástico. Cuenta con personal encantador, complaciente, cuidadoso y muy respetuoso con el descanso.

Habría que hacer una mención especial a nuestra concierge Leidy Guerrero, atendió nuestras solicitudes siempre con predisposición, amabilidad y un gran sentido del humor. También María Lantigua.

Además, quedamos muy satisfechos con Amado García, supervisor de camareros que encontró el café expreso, tan importante para mi marido. Así como con algunos camareros como Eusebio en el que coincidimos en el Fuego y la Palapa, Amalia del Grill, el sumiller del Passion…y como no contamos con Elvis (que nos ayudó con el equipaje y otras tantas cosas!).

Recomendaremos sin duda el hotel y volveremos  con la familia!

reviews.author: mtbrowder
reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.text:
Our plans in the near future is to go back to Punta Cana and stay at The Reserve again!  The management is the best that I have dealt with in business!  The guest service manager is Silvio he is phenomenal!  He provides best guest service of anywhere we have ever been.  We travel the country.  Our Butler Nikel was soooooo helpful.  The Passion restaurant is no doubt one of the best experiences that I have had at  any restaurant!  The waiter Anyelo is amazing!  He explained detail about our food and did his best to serve us.  The staff there is kind hearted and it shows in there service.  The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana is a must in your travels.  Wow!
.

reviews.author: FCarmenr
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text:
Just got back from staying at this hotel.  It was an amazing time.  The service was superb!  Special Thanks to Ires Ruiz service desk.   I also want to take this time to also acknowledge Jose Domingo for his outstanding time on the courts.  Also to all the staff at the Reserve Hotel  thumbs up!!! 

Thank you looking forward to seeing you all next time.

reviews.author: Tanya W
reviews.title: Best Resort!
reviews.text: Loved this resort!  Every little detail was comparable to other resorts we've been to, even the bracelet to identify which hotel you're staying at was an actual bracelet, not a cheap plastic band.  We had the family concierge package and our family concierge Leidy Guerrero not only took care of us and all the little details, but she made our experience so memorable for our kids.  She remembered to periodically bring milk to our room for our kids, she had our room decorated for a birthday celebration with all their favorite cartoon characters and she remembered our usual dinner hour and manged to squeeze us in a restaurant that was already full at our usual time. We were treated like VIPs with VIP service!  If there wasn't a ride to the beach available, it was made available to us within minutes.  At the beach, we had impeccable service from the bartender and servers Maiker Ramirez, Ramon Ramirez, Luis Santana and Adorfo Portes.  They remembered our name and greeted us by our name.  They made sure we always had a drink in hand and were always roaming to check on us.  Loved how our beach and pool cabana was reserved; felt like VIPs with our name tagged "reserved".  Everyone was so kind and courteous, service was awesome!  Definitely will be back!

reviews.author: Christine P
reviews.title: Relaxation at it's finest :)
reviews.text: This is my second experience with a Paradisus resort and they are amazing resorts, the service is next to none, the grounds are always amazing and the entertainment top notch as far as resort entertainment goes they exceed expectations. The a la carte restaurants are great and the buffets offer variety, however you need to be "careful" of undercooked meat when the buffet is busy. We were served chicken that was only brown on the outside off of the grill, pay attention to what you eat or sickness ensues quickly. Lock up valuables, when you are in an amazing resort where the staff is always willing to assist in everyway you get comfortable and leave things around the room, we had cell chargers go missing from the wall and quite frankly once there gone you can kiss them goodbye so use the safe for anything you don't want to lose. If you are looking for a great beach and fantastic service, this resort nails it.

reviews.author: Aliwonderlandz
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: The rooms could have been cleaned earlier instead of at 5 o'clock in the afternoon. Other than that our overall stay was amazing. The service was outstanding, and the location was fabulous. Everyone was very helpful when helping us find our way through public transportation to the City. We had a beautiful time.

reviews.author: Steph-Mike_Porcelli
reviews.title: Wow, our new second home
reviews.text:
After spending a magical week at the Paradisus Punta Cana, here are my thoughts

This will be a bit long, so bear with me, but if you want in depth details, keep reading

The service & staff, Wow is all I can say.	

This has to be mentioned first and foremost! From the second our bus dropped us off at the Reserve section check in we were treated like royalty.  My husband and I along with our 2 and half year old toddler were quickly whisked away into the air conditioned check in lounge where we were greeted by Anthony Sosa who was taking care of us as our assigned family concierge Leidy, had finished for the night (we arrived pretty late).  He quickly brought us fantastic iced drinks, snacks, cool towels etc.  Check in was a breeze and took all of 5 minutes.  Very nice when you have a rambunctious toddler in tow.  
As we were escorted to our room, Anthony walked with us and answered all our questions, and then showed us our room (more on that later) and handed us our own personal cell phone so our concierge can call us anytime or we can call her with requests anytime we like from wherever we are on the resort, very nice!  After our room tour ended we requested a crib and Anthony saw to it that It was there waiting for us by the time we returned from our late dinner. Fantastic!, even though he wasn’t our assigned concierge, whenever we ran into him on the resort he would come up to us and ask how our stay was and if we needed anything at all don’t hesitate to ask, he even gave us a private tour of the Royal service section should we choose to come back alone next time (it’s 18+)

The next morning we met our Family concierge Leidy Guerrero, All I Can say about her is WOW, she greeted us with smiles, hugs and kisses, our toddler fell in love with her, we hadn’t even met her yet and she had taken care of all our restaurant reservations for the week, and took the liberty of making sure our beach palapa was booked for us all week as well! Leidy was truly amazing and saw that we had everything we needed and more, it was almost embarrassing to be fawned over to this extent! All week long she was leaving little surprises for our son in the room, cupcakes, milk & cookies, she left him a handmade Spiderman card next to a full bubble bath with a plate of cupcakes on one of the nights! 
We can’t thank Leidy enough for making our first vacation as a family as magical as it was.  She was beyond intuitive of our needs and truly went out of her way to make every moment of our vacation as comfortable and memorable as possible.  
If you’re going to be traveling to this resort, and especially if you’re bringing your kids I would highly recommend that you to send an email requesting building 40 - 41 where you will be treated like family by Leidy and Sandra. (Sandra was the other family concierge for our building, but assisted us when Leidy was not at her desk)
The amazing service didn’t end with our family concierge, we brought our son to the Kids club during the day as he is still a little small for all that sun, the girls at the kids club are truly amazing, genuinely warm and welcoming, Berlis, Yajaira, Medina, kilvania and Nataly took great care of him during the day, so much so in fact he didn’t want to leave when we came to pick him up! They played with him, fed him, changed him, basically a full service daycare included with our package!, it was truly a godsend to have a safe place to leave him at and have some alone time.  Berlis was also our babysitter at night, a service that is well worth every penny!, by the end of the week our son loved her! (see pic)
Then we had our beach crew (Ramon, Luis, Adolfo….and Maiker..drinky drinky!)
Maiker and Ramon were assigned to our section of the reserve beach, they would come by very often to check on our drink levels, they made some wonderful drink recommendations (mango passion!) after a few days, when they saw us coming to the beach, our drinks would already be arriving as we were setting down the towels at our palapa! Amazing service! These guys are super friendly and liven up the atmosphere at the beach.
And a special thanks to the entertainment staff for putting on great shows in the lobby and the theater at night, amazingly talented dancers!
And a final shout out to all the waiters and hostesses that served us throughout our stay, there truly wasn’t a single person who didn’t greet us with a warm genuine smile and an OLA!
The entire staff worked tirelessly all week, and communication really wasn’t an issue at all, they all made enormous efforts to speak English (we spoke a bit of Spanish).
so tip well, they deserve it! And smiles are free.

The Beach and grounds

Pictures don’t do it justice, the beach in front of the resort is truly one of the nicest we’ve seen in our travels, we’ve been all over Punta Cana, and Mexico and the beaches just don’t compare, no seaweed, no rocks, just pure white and pink sand for as far as the eye can see, so leave your beach shoes at home, you don’t need them here.  The grounds of the hotel were immaculate, everything was picture perfect and even the grounds keepers would give you a nice smile and an OLA as you walked passed them.  The property is quite large and some people have made a fuss about the train rides to the beach, but it really wasn’t that bad at all, we basically walked all the time, ok maybe towards the end we hopped the train a little more often, but the grounds are so beautiful, you won’t mind the walk.

The Food.

All the restaurants we visited offered great food, the main buffet always had plenty of delicious variety, our son mostly ate from the Hydro grill and room service as they offered less “exotic” fare such as papas fritas (fries).  The a la carte restaurants we tried were all great, we ate at Aqua, Vento, Fuego, the Grill and Mole, The Grill being my husband’s favorite, and Vento being my Favorite, all the A la carte restaurants offered an haute cuisine dining experience.  Mole however felt more like a good old fashion family restaurant. But no matter where we ate for dinner, they had a nice and creative kids menu for the little one. I have to mention one thing about the buffet because it’s a personal favorite of mine, the ENDLESS amount of fresh passion fruit available for consumption was amazing!!

We didn’t do any excursions as we were there more to relax, the only thing extra we paid for was a 1 hour family photo shoot with Juan Carlo Solano (JC), his desk is in the main lobby.  We did some shots on the grounds and at the beach, he was amazing, our son NEVER stops moving, it was a pay per photo session so I wasn’t too stressed about not getting good photos, but out of the 100 he shot, we purchased 87 of them!, he truly has an amazing eye.

Over all this was the best vacation we’ve ever been on, and were already planning our return this spring.
So if you’re traveling with young kids, you won’t be disappointed as they really cater to families on the reserve section, mom and dad will have plenty of alone time should you desire.  

Gracias to the whole staff for making our first FAMILY vacation so wonderful

reviews.author: J0see2013
reviews.title: Memorable vacation!
reviews.text:
Just came back from our one week vacation at Paradisus Punta Cana (The Reserve). WOWWWWW! I've been numerous times to all-inclusive in the Carabeans and by far, this is the best place I've been!  Everyone working at Paradisus Punta Cana provides you with excellent customer service, always happy to see you and to help you out. Food was excellent; both at the buffets or the À la carte restaurants. 

Was there with my sister and mom and the 3 of us enjoyed the daily activities at the beach, the pool, the night shows and the evening animation.

Very special thanks to these people who made this vacation so great:two thumbs up for the great experience!
- Romeo Batista, Alexander Manteco Lopez, Jose Checo, Ruben Figero, Vevelin, Marionel from the animation team: you guys are amazing! We truly enjoyed the fun aqua gym classes, the daily activities we joined, the night shows and dancing at the North Avenue Bar. Romeo: you're a real great salsa teacher. 
- Roberto Espinal, our favorite barman from North Avenue Bar; enjoyed so much your entertainment "show" when making cocktails, high class service and the cocktails, of course!
- Nelson Hidalgo from the Yhi Gym: thanks a ton for the step and body building sessions. My sister and I are in better shape leaving from here than at our arrival.
- Yeuri Beltro, our conciegre at building 37: thanks a lot for booking all our à la carte restaurant reservation and the daily help for any of our questions

We'd definitely go back without any hesitation!

Josée, Andréa & Mary la Mammy

reviews.author: Mjoho
reviews.title: Amazing trip! Sevice excellence
reviews.text:
From the moment you walk in until the moment you leave the service was amazing! The grounds are beautiful and the food was wonderful. All the staff were warm friendly and caring Thank you to Julio (bartender in the reserve section) Nanyi Liriano, Alexander (I believe he was a performer) and Romeo (Francis)!

We will be back!

reviews.author: PabloMines
reviews.title: Descubrimos el paraiso terrenal en Punta Cana!!!
reviews.text: Estuvimos con mi esposa en un viaje de aniversario de casados. El lugar es sorprendente por su arquitectura y cuidado de la decoracion. Los parques son extremadamente cuiudados y frondosos. La habitaciones muy amplias y siempre limpias. Las opciones de restaurantes son muy variadas y todas atractivas. El servicio reservado de playa es optimo con palapas y camastros siempre disponibles y en muy buenas condiciones. Los shows nocturnos y la animacion despues del show son muy entretenidas. Una mencion especial es para la personal consierge Rosemary quien nos cuido y nos atendio como reyes durante toda la estadía. Tambien Ines y Alexandra como consierge del edificio 42 donde estuvimos alojados. No vemos la hora de poder repetir una experiencia como esta!!.

reviews.author: Luizebm2013
reviews.title: Hotel Maravilhoso
reviews.text:
Os restaurantes são bons, comida maravilhosa e os funcionários muito atenciosos, muita diversão, todas as noites com eventos musicais, Cassino, bares e a boite funciona até tarde com musicas internacionais.
O hotel dispõe também de serviço de praia tem um excelente SPA e um parque aquático muito bonito

reviews.author: Josem1585
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text: En realidad es uno de los mejores destinos turisticos del pais y el trato es espectacular... Los tragos del los bares muy buenos los restauranes y los servicios de las habitacioned exelente quede encantado...

reviews.author: Francisco12341234
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Muy bien atendido por Alexandra, Inés [--] y Sandra, siempre con una linda sonrisa dispuestas a ayudar su amabilidad los destaca aquí te vas a sentir como en casa le recomiendo a todo el que quiera venir k lo haga no se van a arrepentir

reviews.author: Francisco M
reviews.title: Verdadero Paraiso
reviews.text:
Con mi hijo menor de edad, estuvimos 7 noches y desde que llegamos nuestra experiencia fue fabulosa y Paradisiaca. En cuanto a su gran calidad de servicio al cliente y profesionalismo; de manera muy destacada podemos mencionar a Adriana en la recepcion del lobby principal. A su vez tambien; felicitamos y les damos las gracias a Maria, Felipe y Jose del Bar Gabi Beach. Muy atentos y serviciales en todo momento y circunstancias.
Las unicas recomendaciones serian re-diseñar los Restaurantes a la carta, ya que son todos muy similares en su tamaño, decoracion y caracteristicas. Tambien el menu deberia evaluarse. Son porciones extemadamente pequeñas. Tuve la oportunidad de conocer el "Paradisus Varadero" y este, seria un buen ejemplo a seguir en las recomendaciones realizadas.

reviews.author: Rolando1959
reviews.title: EL PARAISO EN LA TIERRA!!!!
reviews.text: Somos argentinos y nuestra estadía en el hotel fue desde el 08 hasta el 17-07-2013. No lo conocíamos ni habíamos tenido la experiencia del Royal Service. Realmente la experiencia fue increíble y ni hablar de la atención recibida desde nuestra llegada al hotel. Atención personalizada y un trato preferente que nos hizo sentir realmente muy bien. Desde nuestro arribo nos fue asignada una persona como mayordomo, el Sr. Manuel Marte, que estuvo atento a todas nuestras necesidades durante todo el tiempo que duró nuestra estadía. Excelente en el trato y siempre predispuesto para lo que necesitáramos, realmente una persona extraordinaria. En la playa, que era muy bella, nos atendía normalmente Willy, siempre atento a lo que deseáramos, ya sea comer o beber durante todo el tiempo que permaneciéramos allí. En ausencia de Willy estaba Francisco Cabrera, también siempre atento a lo que quisiéramos. Todos los restaurantes eran fabulosos, y la atención también. En este caso particular es muy importante agradecer a Anthony (Sub Chef Ejecutivo), Fredi Chi (Chef Ejecutivo), Wander (A cargo del restaurante Vento), Sara Agramonte (Gerente Royal Service) y otros tantos que mostraron su predisposición y esmero para la atención de Mónica, quien es celíaca y se preocuparon por cubrir todas sus necesidades. También debemos mencionar la atención preferencial recibida en el restaurante Passion a cargo de Julio César Pérez, Laura Castillo y Héctor. En realidad en todos los restaurantes del hotel recibimos un atención preferencial y personalizada que no habíamos recibido en ningún otro lugar de los que hemos visitado. No queremos tampoco olvidarnos de Guillermo Avila (alias Superman) quien nos atendió en el restaurant principal y fue muy atento y predispuesto a lo que necesitáramos. Toda nuestra experiencia en el hotel fue maravillosa y el servicio del hotel es excelente. No tiene, a nuestro entender, nada que pueda criticársele, salvo que tuvimos que volvernos al terminar nuestra estadía. Pedimos disculpas si nos olvidamos de alguien, pues todos hicieron que nuestras vacaciones fueran especiales y las mejores que hemos tenido en muchos años. Gracias por todo y esperamos volver pronto para seguir disfrutando de los servicios de este excelente hotel. Mónica y Rolando

reviews.author: LLMalone
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for a business function, but arrived a few days early to enjoy paradise.  Upon check-in we upgraded to Royal Service.  What a wonderful experience!  We truly were treated royally by all we came in contact with, especially our butler, Juan Castillo.  Our favorite waiter, Wisly Fortune, was so helpful and made us feel welcome from the first day forward.  We opted for morning room service and Cesar Lafl was terrific at calling us ahead and delivering our breakfast exactly when we anticipated it!  The grounds were lovely, the beach was heavenly.  We walked the property every morning and felt extremely safe.  We enjoyed all of our meals.  The attention to detail from table service to food presentation was incredible.  I would recommend this resort to anyone considering a vacation in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Roy H
reviews.title: Club Melia returnee
reviews.text:
I am a long term Club Melia member and frequent visitor to Palma Real.  My wife and I usually take an annual trip to the resort, but skipped it last year in favor of the new property in Mexico.  

I was pleased to see that the property is being excellently maintained.  Everything is clean and ongoing maintenance is keeping things looking crisp and new.  I am also pleased to report that both the service and food quality has improved greatly since my last trip.  We were told there were new chefs supervising the kitchens and all of the offerings at the restaurants were excellent.  We did not use the extra charge restaurant, at Passions and, as we were not in Royal Service, did not use the new Italian restaurant; however other guests said they were both excellent.  I want to single out Pedro Pafedos (I hope I have spelled the last name correctly) a supervisor in Bana for the excellent work done by him and his staff and also his efforts in teaching my wife some of his techniques for folding napkins.  Estaban at Bana et al was also very attentive and friendly. 

We almost consider Palma Real a home away from home and hope to be visiting for years to come.

reviews.author: Rox021
reviews.title: AMAZING... best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
This was by far the best vacation I've been on. Great people, great atmosphere, hard working staff, fun activity staff that showed you how to have a good time! Fell in love with the staff members, nicest people you'll ever meet. They had the best personalities and were so down to earth to name a few, Francisco, Fabio, Angel, Gina (activity staff), Gloria, Carlito (amazing bartender) and Patricia. All of them made me feel welcomed to be there and made the whole trip 10 times better, I never wanted to leave. Made some amazing friendships with the staff and can't wait to see them all next year. 

There's always activities going on at this hotel throughout the day. Beach is beautiful and so is the pool. Safe to say I'll be coming back to this hotel next year. I fell in love at this resort, can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Wendy O
reviews.title: Coming for visit
reviews.text: Excited about trip. Few concerns based on reviews. Want to know what we CANNOT do by not staying at the reserve; 2 restaurants and a pool but what else? Through my time share the Reserve was not available for time frame we could go. I want to make sure that my kids wont feel like they are missing out if I book at Palma Real.

reviews.author: amanda b
reviews.title: Excellent Service.
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I stayed at the Paradisus for a week and fell in love with this resort.  It is such a beautiful property with friendly employees.  I would definitely stay at this resort again.  The bartenders Danny Romero, Julio Garcia, Kelvin Devora, Mindri Sanchez were amazing.  They were so accommodating and tentative.  They took the extra time to talk to us and engage in conversation (both is Spanish and English). The drinks and food were delicious.  

-always- Amanda & Danny

reviews.author: Carl P
reviews.title: Wow!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve for 7 days. We have previously been in 2 other 5-star resorts in Punta Cana and this one is the best. The grounds are beautifully kept.The room was wonderful, very large as it was a suite. The food and restaurants were all very good. Yris, our concierge, made our restaurant reservations for the week. Each morning Yris would ask about our evening, if there was anything else she could do to make our stay more enjoyable. The beach is wonderful: our only complaint would be that the Reserve beach is small and crowded  (even in the off-season). It was impossible to get umbrellas in the front, as the first row would always be reserved for the family concierge guests. We tried sitting in the Royal Service area (which was not busy or crowded as a large stretch of the beach in this area is empty and completely wasted) but were asked to move to the Reserve beach. All in all it was a wonderful experience and we would recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Thomas M
reviews.title: Great service from all employees.
reviews.text:
We received royal service from all.  
Alexandra Martinez couldn't be more helpful. The bar tenders  were great and the food. We loved this place!!!!!! We will be back for sure!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Precise reviews
reviews.title: Super clean, top notch food and plenty of activities!!
reviews.text: What I loved about paradisus was the cleanliness of the whole resort. The groundsmen always offered a friendly "hola" while the cleaners particularly ARISLEYDA kept the rooms fully stocked with drinks, towel's, and tolitoties! Food was top notch! Literally, fillet steaks for dinner, rib eyes for lunch and endless pastas, salads, seafood! Fresh meats cooked on request by the friendly chefs! You will never be bored in para, with free activities at the magnificent beach like snorkeling, kayaking, windsurfing. I advise getting the friendly and energetic MICKEY MICKEY drinky drinky as your beach waiter as he'll never leave thirsty and bring you a variety of exotic drinks! If you want a little time away from the beach visit JOSE DELA CRUZ at the adventure park! He'll be sure to keep you entertained with rock climbing, table tennis, trampolines and archery! Not forgetting our friendly and helpful  concierges Alexandra and Inez who were friendly and helpful always on their toes booking our dinner reservations. Our favorite restaurant was fuego, the grill and passion!

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: Excellent but...
reviews.text:
I had trouble writting this review because I can say I experienced two very different things along my stay and I think it was mainly because I went in low season. First the good, the place is amazing, full of palm trees and green areas, everything is absolutely taken cared of. The pools are great, clean, and there are bars everywhere so you can drink whatever you want almost in every corner of the hotel. And trist me...it is a big hotel!! Food is also good. There are a la carte and buffets restaurants; in these last ones the type of food changed also day to day so you didn't have to eat always the same things. Cannot complain at all there. Service was also outstanding. Everyone says hello with a big smile and asks how are you and if you need anything. I know that it must be part of their job but they really make you feel confortable and at home. So hotel decoration, food and staff...they receive my 5 points hands down.
So now the bad...for starter I wanted to be in their "reserve" area (a sort of vip place within the hotel) so I payed about 500dls extra for the week. Aparently since it is low season everybody was upgraded for free to this area of the hotel (not their fault not my fault...I understand that) but they didn't gave me any upgrade or what so ever so it was quite frustrating to hear that people received upgrades and you didn't. Second, activities program. The hand you a copy of the week activities and where those will happen. In more than one ocassion the activitiy was either suspended or happening at another area of the hotel or replaced for another activity. And they were not sharp with starting/ending times either; in the making cocktails workshop the salsa teacher approached to ask for how long would they continue because he needed to start. Don't missunderstand this, the people that takes part of the entretaining is amazing but is really not well organized. It looks really amateur. Then there is the lenght of the hotel. The reserve is buily next to the highway and although it has it's own pool area if you want to go to the beach you need to take a transportation. Not the worst but not confortable either. Because it was low season they had 5 restaurants closed which not even my travel agent knew about. And there were doing lots of remodelation so you could see people working, painting, fixing....not exactly what I want to see during my holidays. And now really the worst part of it....everyone is trying to get money from you. Beggining with a 90 minutes talk about the "club melia" wich ends in 3 hours of them wanting you to buy a 39000usd program to use their hotels for the next 50 years (after paying 20% up front of course). Then if you need something from their medical service you have to pay 110usd before they can even touch you or tell you what is wrong with your.  Gym clases were not done (yoga, pilates, etc..) if there were less than 4 people unless you were willing to pay a fee of 20usd to the teacher (fyi....the teacher was already there because the class was prearranged in the gym program) and the front desk would even call you at your room at 8am to ask you if you want to take some extra excursions!! And it doesn't end there, everyone suggests you to try their best restaurant that costs 5usd extra per person (I asked many times and they all said 5) only to find out that it was 45usd per person. Lovely place, lovely food, worth the 45usd but there was no need to lie.

I'd say that the very best way to spend a great time here is to pretend you don't speak spanish/english/french/nederlands/russian (oh yeah...their personel can do very good with languages) and just ignore all the extra things they push you to buy. And of course....come in low season. Even if the hotel is huge and they are in 20% occupancy at the moment I don't want to imagine what it is like to eat/drink or move around with a 90% occupancy.  It just seems impossible.

Special thanks to my concierges Laidy and Sandra and my very favorite waiter Carlos from Gabi Club...he really made my day every night.

Don't miss coming here!!!!

reviews.author: Helen T
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text:
My family and I travelled to this hotel from Sept 20th - Sept 27th and we had a wonderful time.  The grounds are beautiful and immaculate.  The Sandra and Laidy at the family concierge were excellent and accommodating , they had all sorts of little surprises for our 15 month old twin boys and for my husband and I.
The food was great and there was a lot of selection at the Gabi Restaurant for all meals.  The beach is pristine and very well kept.
All in all we had a wonderful vacation because of the staff  :)

reviews.author: Deneslucho
reviews.title: Verdadeiro Paraiso!!!!
reviews.text: Lugar agradavel, funcionarios atenciosos e carinhosos, em especial Alexandra Martinez ,Juan e Nilvio, que tao gentilmente nos deu as primeiras orientacoes, nos conduzindo a Isidra e Alicia, do Clube Melia, assim nos tornando socios.

reviews.author: Armando Neto
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: Restaurantes impecáveis, grande variedade de cozinhas e pratos fantásticos. Muitas opções de lazer. Atendimento de excelência. Típica praia caribenha, quente, transparente e linda. Todas as noites tem algum show ou atividade oferecida pelo hotel. Ótimos drinks no bar da piscina.

reviews.author: DANYLO ALCÂNTARA
reviews.title: Excelente opção para lua de mel
reviews.text:
Passei juntamente com minha noiva a nossa lua de mel no Paradisus Palma Real e adoramos, os funcionários são bem atenciosos e buscam ao máximo lhe atender da melhor forma possível.
A estrutura do hotel é muito boa possuindo excelentes piscinas, muitos restaurantes e bons bares, possui um bar que é aberto 24 horas.
Durante o almoço possui os restaurantes que lhe atendem normalmente nos referidos horarios informados pelo hotel já durante o jantar necessita realizar a reserva nos restaurante onde cada tem um ambiente e especialidades diferentes.
A praia é muito boa sendo o mar calmo e a agua morna. Voltaria novamente.

reviews.author: LAGirl18
reviews.title: A great family experience
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort in September 2013 and are already looking forward to returning to Punta Cana.  I took mental notes the entire time during our stay as it pertains to this property and I hope that my review can help you make the right decision as to what hotel to choose.  

The Positives:
-My two standouts are SIlvio in the front office and Arturo who works as server in several restaurants.  Silvio was extremely attentive to our needs and listened to our suggestions.  Arturo was the best waiter ever and had a wonderful cheery personality.  
-The rooms at the reserve are comfortable and some are very large.  They consist of a living area, a bedroom and a two part bathroom with a jetted tub.
-The check in service makes you feel like a VIP.  They take the liberty to make your dinner reservations for the entire week and also provide you with a reserved cabana on the beach.
-However, if you didn't have reservations for a cabana, there were plenty of empty chairs and cabana seating on the beach.
-The beach and the pool are beautiful.  The ocean water is warm and clear and the sand "melts" under your feet.  No one bothers you on the property or at the beach when it comes down to time share sales or vendors.  
-Not many children
-Take advantage of the free one hour snorkeling excursion
-Most restaurants have good food.  Here is my brief breakdown.
Naos is a buffet style dining where you don't need reservations.  Vento is the restaurant on the Reserve property and was our least favorite dining experience because the food wasn't good and it took an hour for it to come out.  La Palapa is located on the beach and is considered fine dining .  It was our favorite and featured delicious coffee and lip smacking lobster tail.  Mole was also good and would be considered Mexican food.  The Grill features a la carte entrees while the appetizers and desserts are buffet style.  Fuego was our 2nd favorite dining experience and very beautiful inside.  

The Negative:
-Spotty wi-fi service
-Housekeeping varies day by day and sometimes it wasn't done until 5pm.  Also they didn't refill the fridge or the toiletries.
-Some staff does not speak any English and is not equally personable as others. 
-The Reserve is not directly on the beach.  You have to take a shuttle that circles the resort every 15 minutes to get to it.

Tips:
-Premium alcohol is not included in all inclusive.  It costs $8 per drink.  Only house wine is included in the price.
-Some restaurant on property have an additional charge.  Passion is one of them.  Not all restaurants are open during non-peak season.
-The resort has nightly shows at 10pm and they are decent.
-No party atmosphere so if thats what you are looking for, go elsewhere.
-This is not really a hotel designed for kids.  Other hotels in PC have better activities and are more kids focused.
-The combined two resorts are huge so rent a bike to get around.  You can keep it for 3 days. 
-Tip if you like the service. They deserve it.
-You don't have to exchange your money to pesos.  They take dollars everywhere.
-If you go outside your resort be prepared to be hustled by vendors and people from the surrounding town.  They try to sell you anything and everything.  They will put banana leaf hats on you head, put flowers in your hair and pull your luggage without you asking and then expect a tip.  
-The Palma Real mall is totally overpriced and not a good place to get souveniers.  Don't waste your time.
-Book your excursions when you first arrive because they only have them on certain days.  There is no snorkeling on the weekends at all.  Check with more than one company to compare prices.  And negotiate....Our favorite exursion was the cultural all day tour to Higuey where you learn how Dominicans live.  

Overall we loved our experience in Punta Cana and at the Reserve.  I am impressed with the cleanliness of the resort and the friendly service.  We can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: San1477
reviews.title: Excelente playa, servicio y atención
reviews.text:
Viajamos el 14 de Julio de este año y fueron las vacaciones más lindas q tuvimos. Estuvimos en la Reserve y desde q llegamos nos trataron tan lindo como en casa. Tuvimos una atención personalizada gracias a Sandrita, búsquenla es lo máximo. Nos ayudo en todo, nos hizo la reserva para cada día en cada restaurante q queríamos, coordino para q nos preparan el jacuzzi, en realidad nos engrió un montón!! Gracias Sandrita...pero en si todos don súper atentos
En cuanto al hotel es muy limpio, tiene una infraestructura muy linda con amplios jardines, tiene de todo, restaurantes, gym, teatro, disco, bares, tiene una piscina súper grande y la playa es muy limpia, hay para hacer deportes creo q se paga algo, también en el mismo hotel encuentras a operadores para q puedan hacer diversos paseos y excursiones, nosotros fuimos a la isla saona y fue lindo pero les aconsejo a lleven zapatillas para nadar porq la playa es de piedras
Otra cos q me gusto del hotel es q los bares tengan variedad de tragos para escoger tenían una lista amplia, contrario a otras cadenas q he visitado
Hay un restaurante q funciona las 24 horas, es excelente di te quedas  juergueando en la disco hasta la madrugada porq despues da hambre y eso te salva jaja además el barman q atiende al lado tambien fue súper cordial y divertido 
Todos los restaurantes son buenos, me gusto mucho el de carnes(grill). Uno de los restaurantes dentro del hotel es de un chef reconocido, se paga aprox. 40 dólares para cenar pero vale la pena, la comida gourmet es deliciosa. 
Si se animan en la reserve punta cana no se arrepentirán

reviews.author: susanKWSouthlake13
reviews.title: A piece of heaven on earth
reviews.text:
The most beautiful, peaceful place to vacation that we have experienced. Breathtaking elegant location facing ocean. We were in the Royal Service and there for our nieces wedding on the beach Sept 20, 2013. It was perfect!  Reception was set up inside due to rain and was fabulous, music dancing, great food.  Being in the Royal Service, we had a butler to arrange things for us always, private pool, separated from huge winding gorgeous pool for other patrons staying there.
Food was always available, eating in elegant places with Flamingos in the water around us. Gorgeous landscape and beaches. Parasailing was a blast, seeing to the bottom of the blue ocean, boogie boarding on the waives, so many options available. Service was excellent. Rondon was our favorite butler, ask for him specifically! Others that took excellent care of us through out day at pool and beach were Matiel and Jose Reyes, Jeremiah Matos and Benita Mercedez at bar.   Thank you all so much and hope to see you again!!!  Best Restaraunt was Aqua and The Grill for steaks.  Go and enjoy!!!

reviews.author: GaGirlJenn
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation - w/out Royal Service!
reviews.text:
This place is beautiful...it's just like the pictures! We vacationed 9/18 - 9/22, 2013. We had Deluxe Garden View Suites - and the only downfall is that our rooms (3031 & 3033) seemed to be 1/2 mile from the lobby area, but that's ok - just more stunning view to take in along the way! Seriously, every time you turn around, it's picturesque and you think it will change but it simply doesn't - it's beautiful. 

Our Conceirge, Nebo, was fantastic - he got us reservations every night & the restaurants were excellent. We ate at Bana (Asian Fusion), Vento (Italian), Grill Steakhouse & Gabi Beach (seafood). We had Naos, the buffet for. Breakfast & lunch most days & it was great, the lunch was different daily & very international. All of the food was really good - the Asian Fusion was our favorite of all the restaurants.

While we were there, the resort was not crowded @ all - we never waited for anything really. It was fantastic. Definitely not a party place, there were only families & couples there as far as we could tell. The resort separates the levels of service you receive by the color of your arm band. You can tell that those with the 'Reserve' band definitely get preferential treatment, but hey, they paid for it so let them have it - I'd expect it if I paid for it too!

This resort far exceeds our last all-inclusive experience and you can definitely tell that they put a lot of effort into everything they do. We travel all over the caribbean, and these were some of the nicest people and most accommodating we've ever met. We never wanted for anything, if we asked for it, they found a way to accommodate. 

Yhi Spa - IS A MUST...we did a 50 min couples Orchid Biomassage & it began with hydrotherapy...there are no words...
