As far as excursions, we did the Ocean Park 1/2 day snorkel tour - on the tour we stopped the 1st time to snorkel kind of just out in the ocean it seemed, but there was actually a reef there, then 2nd we got to swim w/sharks & stingrays, and then 3rd headed to a swimming beach - it was great!
But definitely make sure you book your trips thru the hotel!

This place is a true paradise - enjoy!!

A quick tip - brush up on your Spanish before you go & at least know the basics!

reviews.author: javier c
reviews.title: Excelencia a toda prueba
reviews.text: En una privilegiada ubicación, claro que estuve en Royal Service ocean view, que es lo mejor. Sólo tengo felicitaciones por la atención, servicio, comidas, servicio Real y nuestra Consergie Carmen, la tranquilidad del lugar y la disposición de todos para solucionar cualquier problema. El único traspié es que tratan de vender la sección Club, con su interminable charla de siempre, pero uno toma la opción de escucharla o no.

reviews.author: Adrienne E
reviews.title: Magical family holiday
reviews.text:
We just returned from a magical 12 days at this lovely resort.

Some of the highlights:
- The rooms were spacious and roomy and having access to a fully stocked fridge made life easy. The balcony was great for relaxing and also drying off swim gear at the end of each day.Wifi was free and available around the resort though definitely patchy on many of the days.
-We did the family concierge option and it was a wonderful way to relax and have all bookings done for you. We had 2 concierges while we were there: Ovideo Pavilis and Yeuri Beltre and they were both wonderful. Kind, caring and awesome with our son as well as organzing everything to every small detail. They made sure there was food available at each restaurant for my fussy son and this was done graciously every time
- The wait staff were great where ever we were but some standouts for us included Lilian Jimenez and Franklin Ortega - really lovely, warm and fun and ensured that mealtimes were exceptional
- The pool and beach were exceptional and the family concierge system meant we didn't have to stress about having our preferred cabana and lounger everyday. The pool concierges, Santo and Louis kept us primed with our beverages of choice and had fun with non alcoholic versions for our son
- the Kids zone is exceptional and I can't say enough about them. They are hugely flexible and by that I mean you can put your little ones in and out as many times as suits you in any one day and the activities they have organized are varied and fun - the facility is top notch with a great outdoor area for outdoor fun. There is a separate kids pool which is safe for all ages and easily accessed from the kids zone and resort alike.The staff included Kiwy,Yassira,Bella,Nathaly,and Berlis - they are a wonderful team and so kind and caring to the little ones.

Overall, this is a great resort and we had a marvellous time. A few things that I would mention as being slightly annoying:
- Be sure to bring enough cash with you for tips in smaller denominations - pesos come out of the ATM in large denominations and the front office staff make it very difficult to change in to smaller chunks which was frustrating
-The restaurants were of a high standard but you had to be pretty persistabnt to get in as their preference is to send you to one of the 2 buffet restaurants. The stand out restaurants for us were Mole, the Grill and Aqua. Fuego was Ok and Vento was just awful - many other guests were of this opinion also. Another thing to check is which restaurants are actually open - the Japanese style was closed while we were there and many of the restaurants closed for the low season in our last couple of days there meaning options were pretty limited.
- The gift store pricing is utterly outrageous so be sure to bring plenty of sunscreen  / snacks and personal items with you - we had to purchase sunscreen and the cheapest option was $35 USD for a small tube. 

Overall, we had a wonderful time and would definitely return to the Reserve based on the terrific staff and amazing facilities.

reviews.author: Ana S
reviews.title: LO MAXIMO!!! QUE EXCELENTE ATENCION! QUE PARAISO!!!
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado unos días maravilloso, Lo mejor del hotel LA GENTE, que excelente servicio. Cuidan cada detalle para que de verdad te sientas en el PARAISO, Las instalaciones son muy buenas, la comida de excelente calidad, variedad,.  Los restaurantes Deliciosos El Passion  y la palapa,,,,que excelente experiencia gastronómica
IRIS SORIANO, ha sido la mejor madrina de nuestra luna de la miel, nos ha consentido y sorprendido cada día con sus lindos detalles, con su calidez y su EXCELENTE ATENCION, Definitivamente   volveremos acá a disfrutar este paraiso.

reviews.author: Fgdreis
reviews.title: Excelente!!!
reviews.text: Ficamos somente 5 noites no The Reserve PARADISUS Punta Cana e fomos muito bem recebidos pela concierge Alexandra. Recomendamos a todos! Ótimo serviços nos restaurantes e bares. Comida excelente, muitos camarões, peixes, lagosta, além de uma grande variedade de carnes e frango!

reviews.author: Kevdarcy999
reviews.title: Lived up to expectations
reviews.text:
Short and sweet, 
Grounds immaculate,
Rooms very nice,
Service very good but disliked the whole reservations thing,
Food actually very good! Steaks at dinner were great and Marina was a very friendly hostess at practically every restaurant we went to!..passion is very nice and Charles keeps the standard high..disliked the sales pitch but went to it to avail of a discount on the dolphin island excursion!all in all an enjoyable holiday! But watch out for the mossies at night!!!

reviews.author: Manuel N
reviews.title: Una semana increible
reviews.text:
Hace una semana tuve la dicha de hospedarme en el paradisus palma real royal service. Puedo decir que mi estadia fue maravillosa, muchisimas gracias a nuestro pool concierge que nos hice los dias mas simples y nos trato como unos reyes. Obviamente no puedo olvidar a nuestro gran mayordomo Luis que nos consintio y siempre con una sonrisa y actitud positiva hizo sentirnos en nuestra estadia como un rey y a mi esposa como una reina. Siempre disponible y para lo que necesitaramos, sin duda alguna cuando volvamos pedire que  Luis sea nuestro mayordomo. Muchisimas gracias al personal de royal services por que siempre solucionaron todos los problemas y nos brindaron un servico clase aparte.
Sobre el hotel, pues les recomiendo el royal sevices, es mas para parejas, sin van con ninos es mejor que vayan a the reserve. Es super exclusivo, no se como sera en temporada alta pero ahorita en septiembre fue increible. E todos los restaurantes se come muy bien pero sin que me quede alguna duda Passion de Martin Berasategui fue el mejor de mi experiencia gastronomica, es 100% recomendado vale la pena pedir un buen vino aunque se tenga que pagar algo extra. El avenue bar es  super comodo y ameno para difrutar de unas bebidas en la noche.

En verdad es un hotel que complio mis expectativas, muchisimas gracias por todo y espero volver pronto muchos saludos.

Manuel Navarro

reviews.author: davidmM3371YS
reviews.title: Wonderful Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: I normally do not write reviews...but I read them before making a personal travel decision, thus I felt compelled to say how awesome our recent anniversary get-away was.  The staff was very hospitipal, the grounds were magnificent, the food great, and so on and so on.  We have the Royal Service.  If you can afford it, I would do so.  The personal butler (Hey Jose') was always on top of things, and made the vacation one of our best.

reviews.author: Anaugusta
reviews.title: E um PARAISO DE TUDO QUE SE PODE IMAGINAR.
reviews.text: Um hotel onde todas as pessoas nos atendem muito bem,com carinho ,educacao e muito amor no q fazem.una pessoa em especial q nos deu muita atencao foi IRIS SORIANO um amor de pessoa muita atenciosa e gosta muito do q faz.

reviews.author: Carlo_Duarte
reviews.title: Vip
reviews.text: Adoramos o hotel. Os funcionários são muito atenciosos, os restaurantes são muito bons, uns são pagos mas valem a pena. Todas as noites tem algum show ou atividade oferecida pelo hotel. O quarto era grande e bem confortável. Desejo retornar em breve, uma experiência de bem estar.

reviews.author: Kay B
reviews.title: Best All inclusive experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Reserve at Punta Cana Dominican republic with a group of friends for a wedding. It was a very memorable experience. The grounds are idyllic, green, tropical, with little ponds and pools surrounded with flowers and fauna. Beautiful peacocks roam the grounds. The decor is very creative, tasteful and resort ready.

The competition for the various restaurants is keen so one must book well in advance.
The only draw back was the musky smell in the room but we changed our room the odor was gone.
The spa facilities are thoughtful with choices for a sauna depending on your level of tolerance to heat!
The bathrooms throughout the resort are clean and decorated with class and taste. There are many spots to lounge or sit and relax.
I was absolutely impressed with this hotel and will certainly recommend it .5 stars!!
 I traveled a few years ago so I selected the earliest date allowed!

reviews.author: Daniel B
reviews.title: Another perfect vacation
reviews.text:
The whole family was at the reserve in June of this year, my wife and two kids decided to go back for 2 weeks in july seeing that we had so much fun before and we finally booked another week and got there on sept 13th.The start of that review shows you how much we are delighted with this great hotel.

Upon arrival my wife was greated by all the staff so warmly it was touching, they all remebered her by her name. We got through check in in a few minutes and were taken to our magnificient room, a 1 bedroom master suite in a flash.

They aleready made réservations for us at a restaurant. The next day we were greated by Mr. Perera Castro the general manager to make sure everuthing was to our liking, This hotel is beautiful, the rooms are big (almost 1000sq feet) and very clean. The grounds are immaculate. The a la carte restaurants we tried were very good( the grill especially), the pool area of the reserve is beautiful, lots of little private huts and the service around the pool is perfect. What we liked the most food Wise was the Gabi club, it is a buffet but with so much variety you can`t get tired, and let me tell you food Wise my wife is very demanding she is a caterer....

Lots of bars all around with very friendly staff, we did not go see the shows as we have Young children we were up at dawn and were in bed by 10h30.We had the cahnce to meet Vincenzo Napolitano the chef of the grill and Aqua, an extrememly friendly gentelaman that went out of his way to make sure we ate perfectly, thanks Vincenzo for your professionalism and your great prociutto!!!

This is my second review of this hotel, i wanted to mention to you all that i took the time to write a second time about the same hotel as i am 110% satisfied Customer. We are planning to go back to DR in 2014 and we will for sure go back to this magnificent hotel, with the friendliest staff in DR and the best service. Would love to have some negative stuff to say about the reserve but in total honesty i can't find any....

Here is a list of the people that impressed us the most during that stay, i feel they deserve to be mentionned in this review:

reviews.author: Jo Lucas
reviews.title: Puro Encanto!
reviews.text:
Pasé junto a mi familia 4 días en The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana, excelente hotel, muy buenas atenciones, la pasamos genial la verdad, como fuimos en temporada baja el hotel tenía poco ambiente en las noches.

Las habitaciones muy modernas, siempre impolutas y con una decoración interior bien cuidada, no te sientes en un hotel de playa.

La única pega, te asedian por todos lados para que te hagas socio del Club Meliá, un poco pesados la verdad, la otra pega es que hice la reserva a través de la página del Meliá y me hubiera gustado que comunicaran que no todos los 11 restaurantes promocionados por ellos en su página están abiertos, asumo que por ser temporada baja no los abren todo, pero lo deben comunicar

A pesar de todo, no deja de ser buen hotel

reviews.author: ricdaniel
reviews.title: Estadia no Paraíso!!
reviews.text: Passamos uma semana fantástica no The Reserve do Paradisus Punta Cana. Todo o Staff foi inexcedível e super atencioso!! Sei que me vou esquecer de alguém, mas um agradecimento muito especial as Concierges Alexandra e Rosemary pela simpatia e atenção e ao Luís Amparo pela forma como nos recebeu no primeiro dia! Recomendo sem qualquer duvida este hotel e voltaremos num futuro próximo!

reviews.author: mari_bd
reviews.title: Paraíso!
reviews.text: Fui em julho de 2012 com minha familia. Nos encantamos com o lugar e o hotel..todos muito atenciosos e simpaticos! Restaurantes maravilhosos e serviço de concierge muito bom, reservava tudo que queriamos e nao tinhamos trabalho algum. Iria de novo com certeza!!

reviews.author: evem77
reviews.title: Fantastic Time
reviews.text: I had an amazing time at the Reserve Paradisus. The service was excellent.  The entire staff was exceptional. Espescially Ines one of the hostesses, she is a gem. She helped make the trip one I will never forget.

reviews.author: MAOMOPE17
reviews.title: Excelente Fin de Semana at The Reserve!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Excelente fin de semana en The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana!!!!! Maravilloso el servicio y la comida espectacular!!! Saludos y especial agradecimiento al Sr. Silvio Lantigua (guest service manager) por su dedicacion y excelente actitud. Grandioso el staff, muy amigables y serviciales.

reviews.author: 1AMC1
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and location. The food was great and we did the VIP and enjoyed the private beach and spa. All of the workers and bartenders were great. Ramon at the main pool was the best. He took care of the kids the whole week. Take lots of dollars. If you tip them 2-3 dollars it will be worth it for you. It is optional and everyone is very helpful but like anywhere it always helps.  The rooms were ok, some are better than others but we were rarely there so not a deal breaker for us. We had a great time and my son kept saying he was in paradise.

reviews.author: suntanned1
reviews.title: Think about another resort
reviews.text:
I am here presently as I write this.  This is my 2nd time here and Must say I am not returning.  The resort is beautiful,  the employees are beautiful people.  Their service is top notch. That is as far as a good review,

The food has gone downhill since I was last here.  The entertainment does not exist.  There is nothing to do in the evening.  

The guest that smoke their cheap cigars are inconsiderate of other guests.  They smoke anywhere they want and the smell just lingers in a hot humid environment.  

The royal service at this time of year is a waste of money. The restaurants are not busy to make your own reservations.  The other services it offers is not worth the hundreds of dollars it cost.

For the amount of money I spent I am sure there were better places to go.

reviews.author: KUJO2013
reviews.title: BEST CARRIBEAN ALL INCLUSIVE !!
reviews.text: We just celebrated our 15 year anniversay and it was far better than we could have imagined.  I researced alot of places and I am so glad we chose this one!  I am not a beach person but I was changed after coming here! The turqoise waters, white sand, awesome cabanas with towels provided and the servers on the beach with WIFI made this beach-time exceptional.  They offer so much and the reserve guests are treated so well you can get free catamaran rides or whatever you want!  The waves are not big but add fun to swim in and the water temp was perfect. Make sure you get up to watch the sunrise on the horizon, it is priceless.  The resort goes out of its way to make your stay special every day.  We had a special dinner at the Passion resteraunt.......UNBELIEVABLE. The courses were all designed by a 6 star chef and you will be amazed. It is not part of the all inlcusive but if you want to eat world class creations go here for a small charge for what you get. Also the service at the Passion was Perfect. Nicolas Merceds Mejia and Jose Mansuet were awesome and know how to deliver service in a 6 star resteraunt.  The Reserve upgraded us since it was our Anniversary to a Master Suite- WOW and included Nikkel as our concierge.  He was great setting up dinner resvs. and the extras in the room including the pillow menu....We had room service breakfasts delivered twice and they are included at no charge.  We want to thank Gladys Jiminez for cleaning our room so perfectly and designing the towel configurations  with fresh flowers.  We will go back now that we have found paradise!  I want to mention we did listen to the sales pitch for Melia club and they were not pushy at all and told us at anytime we could choose not to listen to the presentation. I did just to see what it is about and for someone with older kids or retired it would be great.  Carl was the one we talked to and he was understanding and very kind to listen to our side and not try to push anything on us.  You wont be dissapointed in this place, and you dont have to sit on a towel on the beach like alot of places, they provide comfortable chairs, beds,towels everything.  The food always had many choices and the soup was great. AQUA,VENTO, and FUEGO were all very good and Passion was the best.   I did tip because of how outstanding the service was and they all work hard to keep you very happy at the whole resort!

reviews.author: SD B
reviews.title: Perfection!
reviews.text: Upon arrival to PARADISE August 31st -September 3rd, the reception of Juan and Josefina at the front desk was absolutely amazing as they welcomed me with open arms!l! An exceptional In Room Service experience from waiters Juan Gonzalez and Nicolas de la Rosa made our stay incredible! They ensure that we had the best of the best in a timely manner.  Eating at Bano and Bento with Fausto Valdez as our personal waiter was true perfection! Our parents and  I enjoyed an awesome spa session at The Reserve. Evelyn Rodriguez greeted us with a smile and Wendy Tararez, Wendy de Garcia, Carmen and Milagros were amazing! Ask for either of them and you won't be disappointed! We can't wait to return to receive the best spa treatments ever, as well as the warm smile and hospitality from Evelyn!  Eating dinner on our last day at GABI Beach was the BEST!  Our waiter Santos Salazar, made our parents anniverary dinner very special! He brought out a special chocolate cake with strawberries, which was arranged by their extraordinary butler, Manuel Silvestre! He made my parents anniversary and stay superb!!  We are planning to make Paradisus Palma Real a family vacation every year, starting with a reservation for next year. We really don't have the words to express how great our stay was at this beautiful paradise! You definitely can't go wrong with staying in PARADISE @ PARADISUS PALMA REAL!!! P.S. The rooms are very IMMACULATE!

reviews.author: Tgifcool
reviews.title: Recommend to anyone
reviews.text: We stayed there with 1 yr old baby,teenager,and grandparents,and everyone  had a very good time. nice, clean rooms, friendly Staff. Specially. Francisco estrella at gabi beach and Diego gonzales at pool bar treated us like royalty. Thanks every one

reviews.author: Debbie A
reviews.title: The best honeymoon ever!!
reviews.text: We went to Punta Cana for our honeymoon.  We got there on Sept 8th and stayed until Sept 14th. The weather was awesome. We just missed a soon to be hurricane and thought that maybe it would keep raining, but it rained one day for about 20 minutes then the sun was shining. The weather was HOT!!! The staff was wonderful. Everyone was so pleasant. Everyone said "Hola" every where you went.  Most of the staff spoke good English so that was good for people that did not understand Spanish. They had live entertainment every night. So you did not get bored at all. The casino was small but it was still fun. We stayed in the Reserved area, in bldg 42. That bldg was close to everything. The Gabi Lounge (the bar area, pool, buffet & lobby) Which was better than the lower paid resort rooms. We had excess to both Gabi Lounge and the Gabi Beach area. We had purple wrist bands. That determines what area you are allowed to go in.  I would recommend staying in the Reserve or higher paying rooms. The regular rooms weren't as nice nor were they as big.  The pools were quiet during the morning because everyone was at the beach. The beach was quite amazing. I was kind of scared when I read that the food was not that great. But the food was delicious! I had 2nds almost every time. We singed up for the restuarants the very next morning.  "Passion" was amazing. 7 course meal. That was not included in the all inclusive. We paid $45.00 pp and it was well worth every cent.  The restuarant alone just had me in WOW mode.  That was the best restaurant there.  We went swimming with the dolphins and that was worth the money. We also went snorkeling which was a blast.  I got to feed the fish in the middle of the ocean. That was awesome. The resort is huge.  The walk ways are beautiful. Something you would see in the movies.  We did get to see different resorts when picking up other people for the excursions and they were no where near as nice as Paradisus Punta Cana.  I really thought it was Paradise.  The bar tenders were great!! Lorenzo a/ka/ Mini Mike, Juan Diego & Kevlin Devora were all great!! They knew us by our first name.  They all made us laugh and never kept an empty glass.  We exchanged $250.00 US and received $9,100.00 Dominican pesos.  Everything is kind of expensive there compared to other Resorts in the US.  I would recommend to only exchange a little bit of money and just take alot of US single bills to tip the bar tenders and waiters. But you really don't need alot of money while there. You can use your charge card for all of the excursions. While we were there our US $1.00  bill is worth $43.00 Dominican pesos.  We were trying to find stuff to do in order to spend the rest of our Dominican pesos. Or we could have exchanged it back to American and lose out on some of it. I don't think it's necessary to exchange that much to start off.  There is a currency exchange place at the Airport as well as your resort. So don't panic if you don't think you exchanged enough at the airport.  The reception areas would break US $20.00 for us in order to give us singles. So keep that in mind.  Make sure you use the massage coupons if given any. We ended up paying $60.00 pp for a 50 min massage because we used the coupons. They have a photographer there that will take pictures of you at the garden and on the beach. We ended up buying 26 pictures that all turned out awesome! That cost us $200.00, US, but the quality of the pictures was well worth it. We loved the resort over all and plan on going back next year with the rest of our family and we will be staying at the same resort. I have not one complaint about the resort.   Hope you enjoyed it as much as we did!!!

reviews.author: ibalexa
reviews.title: Wedding paradise bliss at Paradisus
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently got married in Punta Cana at the Jellyfish and had our guest stay with us at Paradisus Punta Cana. Needless to say we had an amazing time! All of our guest were upgraded to stay in the Reserve section with us so we were all close together. The resort is absolutely beautiful and the service is simply amazing! Everyone is so friendly and accommodating. The food is great and there was a lot of variety. I have absolutely no complaints about this resort!
All our guest and myself included booked our vacations with Jaimi at Beach Bum Vacations and we can not find the words to describe just how AMAZING they were to work with!! Jaimi was so knowledgable and really went out of her way to help each and every guest book their vacations. Everyone felt safe and worry free thanks to Jaimi at Beach Bum Vacations. 5 starts for Paradisus Punta Cana and 5 stars for Beach Bum Vacations!!

reviews.author: LC B
reviews.title: Ok Resort
reviews.text: This was a ok resort.  The grounds, pool and beach were great.  The rooms left a lot to be desired-they are in need if refurbishing.  There were three of us in the room and it was a little tight so upgrading to a suite may be the way to go.  We were also told that wifi would be available in the room but that was not the case so we had to walk to common areas to get wifi.  This was my first foray into the all inclusive world and I was disappointed in the food choices.  It was lo a pain to make reservations at the various restaurants, so if you can o so before you get there that would be helpful-it always seem to b a half hour job.  I loved the various activities they had throughout the day and night-dance classes, 80s dance party-absolutely fun!  The staff were wonderful! Especially those who ran the various classes and the night time entertainment--outstanding!  Just wish the rooms were better appointed...

reviews.author: nunez1010
reviews.title: Un verdadero paraiso
reviews.text:
Gracias a Francisco Estrella y a Melvin Lagua
quqienes nos hicieron sentir como reyes del Paraiso
Francisco en la piscina dándonos un verdadero servicio, y melvin en recepción con una sonrisa siempre presente y dándonos un trato afable, y sin excusas a la hora de respondernos cualquier pregunta.
Lo mejor de este hotel, no es la ubicación, ni su estructura, son los empleados, que cada día ponen su granito de arena para que todo salga bien
 Lastima que solo fueron 3 días, pero trataremos de volver algún día
Todo estuvo bien..En room service disfrutamos de un buen desayuno que cada día Soesi nos traia, lo unico que en la noche no hay mucha variación, pero la comida es buena, y el servicio es eficaz, a tiempo y los camareros son muy profesionales y atento
Soesi , melvin y francisco estrella, gracias por todo.-

reviews.author: Justined0414
reviews.title: Wonderful Trip
reviews.text: We stayed here for our honeymoon earlier in the month and I'm so happy we did! The resort was clean and beautiful and the staff was very friendly. Upon arrival we were offered to upgrade to a suite in the Reserve area and because the price was almost 1/6 of what it would normally cost to upgrade, we opted in and we're glad we did. The Reserve offers a private pool, buffet, bigger rooms and a poolside bar and grill. We seemed to have arrived at the beginning of the off season because there were not many people at the resort. We were able to get a cabana every day at the beach and at the pool by arriving before 12 noon. The man on the beach, "Mikey", was awesome and would come around every few minutes to bring you a fresh drink. The included water activities were really nice and the food was pretty good. However, all the restaurants are open and can be very warm in the summer months. The only real issue that we had were that the walls between the rooms were really thin and you could hear everything in the room above us and in the hallways. The maid did arrive quite late to our room and sometimes was not done cleaning the room until 5pm. The staff is quite friendly and if you tip the bartenders, they remember you and offer you even better service. I would recommend this property to just about anyone!

reviews.author: Vanessa C
reviews.title: Awesome vacation
reviews.text: Our Paradisus Reserve family vacation, early September, was awesome (3 adults). The accommodations and resort were beautiful. Bed and pillows sooo comfortable. Our concierge Iris was WONDERFUL, making our birthday celebration very special. EVERY employee treated us with kindness and greeted us with huge smiles and "Hola"s, from the groundskeepers, maid service, wait staff, bartenders, beach guards, Mikey Mikey, with his drinky drinkies, etc.! A special shout out also goes to Maria, Alexander Lopez the Best, and Marionell for adding fun and camaraderie while at the pool and in the nighttime shows! The beaches were beautiful and scenery spectacular. Cigar making was a treat, hat making was interesting (but you can't take the hat through customs). The restaurants were good, we tried almost every one, the buffets were also good. The burgers at Gabi Grill were delicious! Hilario was our kind Travelocity ambassador and we really appreciated his presence and advice. We para-sailed and it was worth it! We also took an excursion on a party pirate ship to meet stingrays, swim with nurse sharks and snorkel a coral reef and it was great! I'm really hard pressed to add any negatives... ok, mosquitoes at night. Time-share pressure in the beginning but we simply said "NO." Check in/out was smooth, though watch for upgrade prices. Are other places nicer or better? I probably won't find out because we had such a terrific experience that we will remain loyal to Paradisus. A friend has returned 3 times so far, and our son and daughter-in-law went for their honeymoon, that's 5 trips in the past 10 years to the same place, all with great reviews each time!!!

reviews.author: nandovegas
reviews.title: Excelente personal
reviews.text: Ya hemos visitado en 2 oportunidades este Resort, la primera solo los 2 con mi señora y la segunda con los niños.  En ambas oportunidades lo pasamos increíble, las instalaciones de primer nivel, especialmente en The Reserve, buenos servicios, The Kid Zone excelente, los shows en el teatro Nova con una muy buena producción y preparación.  Especial mención a todo su personal, en especial a Kelvin "daddy yankee" Devora del bar del lobby principal, muy atento y entretenido, Francis Romeo de las actividades, siempre muy cordial y preocupado, y Mikey Mike, de la playa, muy atento y  servicial.  Lo recomendamos 100% ya sea en pareja o familia.

reviews.author: Todd B
reviews.title: White sands, green tropical seas, and incredible service!!
reviews.text: Each year the family picks a different vacation the week before school starts. We had never been to DR and researched several sites including this one and decided on The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We were greeted with exceptional hospitality from the bell staff. Once we checked-in we were introduced to our concierge, Ovidio, whom showed us around the property. Having chose the family concierge package, Ovidio handled all of our needs, i.e. dinner reservations, excursions, daily beach cabana reservations, and host of non solicited extras in our room each night for the kids (9,7) and Mom and Dad. He was always 2 steps ahead of us in planning our days and nights. Also, included was our own cell phone to reach him with any questions and/or request. He was incredible!  Adolfo was the bartender at the beach bar and was always pouring great drinks and quick to offer suggestions for new ones. All of the Gabi bar crew and restaurant service was very good not to mention the other restaurants each evening. Our room was about an 8 min walk to the beach each morning or you could chose to take the tram service and be there in 1 min. The walk was pleasant and beautiful. The grounds were so well maintained and even the grounds crew were very polite as they worked steadily each day. This family will be back!

reviews.author: sayaneth2518
reviews.title: Excelente en todo
reviews.text: En el hotel Paradisus PuntaCana Resort su atención, las instalaciones, el trato, la recreación es expectacular, allá se siente uno muy bien por que hay muchas personas que lo hacen de tu estancia muy divertida y amena, siempre estan con una sonrisa como Chocolate en la parte de actividades y de otro chico con  brackets que nos buscaba en la parte del restaurante Gaby para realizar las actividades del dia , Cristina al entrar a la zona de cuartos nos preguntaba como nos fue y se preocupaba por que la pasaramos bien, Johana la niña que nos asi el aseo, y ni se diga de los shows donde se lucian con sus presentaciones y se notaba el trabajo del coreografo , por eso recomiendo y asi como yo,,, llegue feliz y contenta..

reviews.author: Loum613
reviews.title: Excellent Experience!
reviews.text:
Once again we have made a return trip to "Palma" to celebrate our anniversary.
My wife and I, daughter and son in law enjoyed a glorious stay at Palma Real. It is
all about the experience and the hotel staff make sure you truly enjoy your stay.
We took advantage of the Royal Service section, an adults only area with private beach
and pool area. The pool/beach staff work hard to please and it shows. Thank you to Pedro, Francisco, Francisquito, Ramon and Billy. The bartenders are great and Winkin and "Crema" do a great job. As does Ramon Fuego in the main pool area. 
If you stay in Royal Service you have access to the Palazzo restaurant which is excellent. Great service from Smerlyn, Richard, Hoose, Americo and Nelson. Bienvenido at the grill and Carlos the chef prepare excellent meals. Whether it be Eggs Benedict for Breakfast to Rib Eye for dinner. They work very hard to please and accomodate your palate.
There is a new bar area called "avenue bar" and this is a small bar that services the open plaza, a great area to have a drink under the stars and people watch, Esteban and Roy make great drinks here.
At the small casino we stop in to enjoy the a/c area and the good drinks made by Antonio Castillo. Do not miss Vento Restauran for its great meals. Wander, Jose and Domingo make sure you enjoy  a wonderful meal. We particularly enjoy the Ossobucco.
We also ate at the Aqua restaurant in the reserve area and enjoyed the meal there. Thank you Eddy.
Our anniversary meal was reserved for Passion Restaurant, and I would not call this a meal but more like an event. Delicious tasting menu and wine flights perfectly paired. Don't miss this experience. Thank you to all for once again reminding us as to why we keep coming back to this wonderful hotel in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Thierry_O
reviews.title: Good service, food and activities
reviews.text:
We stayed in a 1 bedroom apartment. The room was clean but in need of some refurbishments.
The choice of restaurants was great and the food and staff were excellent. AI fee wasn't cheap, but worth it. The grounds and beaches are well maintained. We really enjoyed our stay. Participated at some activities and attended some of the shows. We would say special thanks in particular to Rachel, Francisco and Jonathan from the activities team, Nelson  the bar tender who hosted the the cocktail class for the commitment. We had dinner at most of the restaurants and would like to thank Androqui (Vento / Naos / Market Grill), Pedro (Bana / Market Grill), Wily Mercado (Market / Grill) and Wrander (Illy station / Naos) for their excellent service provided during our stay.
We enjoyed cocktails at the Swim Up bar, special thanks to Ramon for his cheerfulness and acrobatic skills.

reviews.author: mountains_of_fun
reviews.title: just 'meh'
reviews.text:
My Mom and I recently spent some time at Paradisus Palma Real. I have kind of an overall 'meh' feeling about our stay. It was great because we got to do exactly what we wanted to do, and that was relax by the pool and beach, but I felt there were a few snags in our visit. My mom got us the Royal Service package for our stay, which meant we had a private pool, bar, beach, lounge, and butler. We didn’t do any excursions so this review isn’t going to help with any of that. 

First, the positives: the grounds were beautiful! So very well kept and overall the resort was decorated very well and had a very good feel to it. The staff was also very nice. Even though it was obvious they didn't understand English very well, they really did try and were very nice. Wilikin took great care of my mom and definitely didn't skimp on the alcohol in her pina coladas. I am not much of a drinker, not even water, so I didn't really have anything from the bar.  The room was also very nice. A few reviews mentioned how there wasn't a lot of privacy, and granted there wasn't but I didn't feel like it was too bad. We also didn't have any musty smell and we had a pretty decent garden view.

Now the not so positives: Our main complaints were about the food, and the reservation process. *Please if you aren’t interested in reading in depth about the food or reservations stop now because this has turned into a lot longer review than I intended. If you are please continue.* 

All we kept saying the whole time was "where were these people eating that had such great food?" because the vast majority of our food experiences were not good at all. We had breakfast every morning at Palazzo, which was good. There were these little slices of corn bread that we loved (with some coconut jam on top, so good), but whenever we ordered something from the menu and didn't just eat from the buffet it was just ok. You're just better off having the super busy chef make you an omelette to order. Lunch we had room service a couple times and the big buffet once. Room service had me laughing because I ordered a club sandwich with out tomato. I received a sandwich with 1 thin slice of turkey, a hefty portion of cheese and some lettuce. They did leave off the tomato but also forgot the bacon and really, 1 super thin slice of turkey! It was not an adequate sandwich. Another time we got pizzas, which were just ok. My mom wasn't overly excited so she smothered ceviche all over her Hawaiian pizza. I was ok with the pepperoni one, but I think it's because I like thin crispy crust. We also got, what they call, margarita (sp) pizza, yeah it's just a cheese pizza. My mom ate the crust and left all the middle part. The buffet was just ok. There was nothing spectacular about it. For dinner we tried Gabi Beach, weren't impressed. Venti, was ok but still not impressed. The Mexican place, very unimpressed. At Palazzo, my mom had good lamb and dessert (though tiny) but everything else we were not impressed. We also tried Bano but our food was taking so long we ended up just leaving. Our biggest complaint about the food wasn't so much the flavors but the temperature. Everything that was supposed to be hot was cold and everything that was supposed to be cold wasn't. All of the desserts at the buffet were room temp at best and that was very scary because a lot contained dairy, which shouldn't really get warm. Maybe it was all fake dairy… We were given chicken fingers as an app at Gabi beach and they were cold and fried food usually isn't very good cold. The one food they consistently got right was the ceviche. It was delicious every time. We also had a problem with alcohol. When we were in the Royal Service area there was no problem but every night at dinner there was an issue. My mom asked for a beer and they always wanted to give her the Presidente beer, which she didn't like, but our second night at Bano the waiter got her a Corona, but every other night when she asked for a Corona (because we now knew they had them) they would never give her one. They would say they'd go check, but by our last night we felt like they weren't trying and just disappearing for a while until they would come back and say no. We were under the impression that we could get any alcohol whenever we wanted to, wherever we wanted to. That was not the case. We felt like they didn't want to give my mom a Corona because then other people would see it and they'd then start asking for them. You also only had one choice of red wine (Black Cat), which my mom also didn't love but drank it anyways because it was too much of a hassle to get anything else. Ok, enough about the food. Sorry for such a long rant but that was our big complaint. 

Reservations were also a not so pleasant experience. Within 10 minutes of us being there we were expected to choose where we wanted to eat for dinner every night we were there. We hardly knew anything about the restaurants let alone whether they were good or not. We thought we wanted to eat every night around 7 but then our first night we realized that no one was around at 7 so we wanted to change our remaining reservations for a later time. That brings me to my next issue, and I hate to say it but it was our butler. He was very nice but it didn't seem like he wanted to accommodate us at all. We asked for 7:00 reservations and got an "oh, I will try but that is a very hard time to get", which we found was not true because there wasn't anyone in the restaurants at 7:00. Then we asked to change to a later time and got "well it's really hard to change, so you can just try to go later and they'll hopefully seat you." Really?! (we did go later and they sat us but we'd have liked to have been assured that we would be able to have dinner every night). The next thing was when it came to reserving a cabana by the royal service pool. You'd have thought we'd asked for his next child! He gave us the scoop as to how to get one without a reservation and that was to stop by at 11am and see if someone hadn’t claimed there's for the day. So, one day we did that and it worked, but we didn't want to have to do that again so we asked if we could reserve one. We got "well you typically need to reserve them 1-2 days in advance" so we said ok lets reserve one but he wouldn't do it. We got the run around by our butler saying we had to reserve it with the guys by the pool and the guys by the pool saying we had to get our butler to reserve it. The next day we weren’t so lucky and one of the guys overheard us talking not so happily about this and next thing you know here is our butler, "ok, I reserved you a cabana for tomorrow and maybe the next day." My motto then turned into, the squeaky wheel gets the grease because that seemed to be the only way we got things. Last and finally we wanted to change our reservations for our last dinner to Palazzo because we didn't want to go to Gabi beach again. We said this on our fourth day but it was never switched and then our last day we asked if it had be changed and it hadn't so we asked to change it and got the same "Oh, it's really hard because they're busy" speech. Of course, we ended up getting the change, and it’s a good thing because when we walked in there were only 6 people in the restaurant. We could not understand why it was so hard to get and change reservations when no one was even there.

I chose not to include our butlers name because as I said he was very nice and I don't want him to get a bad reputation from this review. I'm sure he will be much different to other guests. I don't know if I just had complicated requests (cabanas and reservations) or what but there was definitely a bad taste left in my mouth after this experience.

I don’t want this to come off as a horrible review because this resort was very nice and we had a good time, but the few things we didn’t like, we really didn’t like. Our experience wouldn’t stop me from recommending others to the resort, but I don’t think I’d come back.

reviews.author: luvtoplay10
reviews.title: A True "Paradise of Palms"
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Dominican Republic and it was to celebrate a birthday.   We had a Royal Service ocean view suite at the Paradisus and could not have been more pleased or impressed.  The property is spectacular, with a white sandy beach, beautiful palm trees, blue ocean.  The rooms are gorgeous, spacious, and clean with marble floors and a beautiful spa bathroom.  We especially liked the Royal Service treatment.  The private beach, pool, restaurant and staff were superb.  If you stay in Royal Service rooms, which I highly recommend, asked for Dionel Mendez for your personal butler.  He was very helpful, yet not intrusive.  He made my birthday the best ever with special dinner arrangements at a restaurant, and chilled champagne, flower petals, and balloons in the room.  We also want to thank Liliana de Leon, the Palazzo hostess, who also went out of her way to make the birthday very special.  You must visit Nelson, the creme de la creme bartender, at the outdoor "tiki" bar.  Thanks to all the staff on the beach, in the restaurants and bars, room service, maid service, theater members for making the vacation very special. To sum it up, it's THE place to go.

reviews.author: Silvio M
reviews.title: NUEVAMENTE EN EL PARAISO
reviews.text:
Volvimos a reincidir con una segunda visita en el 2013, segunda quincena de agosto, a donde para nosotros es nuestro paraìso y nos hospedamos como en el mes de marzo 2013 en el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real, maravilloso hotel que tan bien nos hace sentir con la generosisdad y amabilidad de su personal y aprovecho para citar a alguno de ellos:Felipe Morla, Francisco Mendoza (barma M bar) , no tengo presente su nombre ahora a la mucama que tanto esmero ponìa en mantenernos todos los dìas impecable nuestra habitaciòn, a Yajaira la mucama del turno tarde,  Yolanda Kery  jefa de mucamas una encantadora mujer, Victor Cohen camarero del restaurant Vento.
 Debido a un serio inconveniente que tuve en un dedo de la mano por un anillo,tuve que visitar el centro mèdico del hotel, allì conocì a dos maravillosas personas que colaboraron a solucionar mi problema, la enfermera Yanira de la Rosa y la Dra. Candelaria Muitte, quienes pidieron ayuda al sector mantenimiento y fue el Sr. Manuel Enriquez Pache quien libero mi anillo y soluciono el problema, mil gracias a ellos!!!
Quiero hacer un reconocimiento para todo el personal que contactamos en el Club Melia y en especial a los Señores Carlos San Jose y Julio Moreno, dos Señores con Mayùsculas!!! Quienes nos trataron con sumo profesionalismo, seriedad, respeto y enorme paciencia, y sobrada simpatìa , como dicen en España 2 gallegos de la hostia!!!  Muchas gracias a todos y Felicitaciones al Hotel Paradisus Palma Real de Punta Cana por tener un staf de personal tan calificado y que tan bien lo hacen sentir a uno en este bello lugar.

reviews.author: Cristina V
reviews.title: Unos días inolvidables
reviews.text:
comienzo agradeciendo a todos los que hicieron que nuestra estadía, recomendados por María Mercedes Suárez Fuera algo absolutamente inolvidable para ,mi mama y mis hermanos, el motivo de nuestras vacaciones era celebrar los 80 años de nuestra mama quien paso los días más maravillosos comenzando con la calidez de todos los dominicanos, el cariño con el que nos atendieron llegamos el 9 de agosto hasta el 16 de agosto . El 10 cumplía mi mama y al desayuno nos han recibido como dicen en mi tierra con bombos y platillos que momento más especial Juan De Dios quien era encargado de todo se lució en recomendarnos y hacer que todo hubiese sido tan suprema menté especial y mágico para mi mama y todos nosotros , las personas que nos atendieron en diferentes restaurantes como Ángel no recuerdo su apellido de verdad un ángel ,Pedro paredes, Esteban Bora ,José Ramos , Los de el bar en la piscina Luis y Mariela si se me queda alguno perdonen pero de verdad gracias que comidas tan maravillosas todavía nos saboreamos el sushi algo espectacular y la langosta . El lugar de los chorros fue algo muy agradable y especial para todos . De nuevo triste mente no pudimos despedirnos de Juan De Dios quien hizo algo demasiado especial de nuestra estadía .Esperamos muy pronta mente poder visitarlos de nuevo que atenciones ,detalles,arreglos,música,Comidas,bueno me despido y de nuevo MIL Y UN MILLÓN DE GRACIASSSS
Cristina Vargas

reviews.author: laveramd
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort on the Beach
reviews.text:
The restaurant choices were all very good, but we especially enjoyed Bana for Asian Fusion; the food and service were excellent.  The Mexican restaurant was not open when we visited, but I don't think it is permanently closed.
We enjoyed the activities provided and the variety of evening entertainment.  While golf course was not in good condition, it was a fun outing and we went out in a kayak one afternoon.  Beach is very well maintained and there are servers available.
Overall it was a relaxing vacation in a beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Clay L
reviews.title: Grand service, food and overall experience
reviews.text: First we want to thank Francisco Estrella for his AMAZING service all week.  His great attitude and wonderful smile were a blessing every day of our vacation.  The overall resort was beautiful, great service, and the food was fabulous in every restaurant.  The Cirque show and Michael Jackson show were both great.   Clay n Deb

reviews.author: luv2travel1986
reviews.title: Paradise in Punta Cana
reviews.text: We just returned for the resort after spending a week and cold not have been more pleased with our choice.  We traded through RCI and stayed in a one bedroom.  The room, resort, pools, beaches, food and service staff were all excellent.  Everyone was very friendly, the all inclusive fee while not cheap was well worth it.  The restaurant staff and food were all great and we were surprised at the quality of the food. We enjoyed the Sushi restaurant so much we went a second time and the Sushi was excellent.  Our one bedroom was large with a full working kitchen, dinning area along with a living room and large bedroom.  The AC kept the temps in the room cool as the weather was very hot and humid so AC is a must.   The beaches are very clean, the ocean water is warm and caribbean blue with plenty of seating, but find a hut on the beach as the sun is super strong and you will need shade.  Th pools were great and we had a pool side cabana assigned to us each day so finding seating near the pool was not an issue.  We booked 2 excursions through Blue travel at the resort and had to cancel 1 the morning of the excursion and Ivan from Blue travel refunded the cost of the excursion, thanks Ivan.  The staff on the beach and at the pool were very active and always made sure your drink was full.  We an not say enough good things about this resort all of which they earned by providing a tremendously relaxing vacation.  Ownership and management at the resort should be proud of their staff as they take great pride in providing for the guests.  We would definitely recommended this resort as we can honestly say we have nothing negative to report after our relaxing week on the beaches of Punta Cana.  The security on the beaches keep the locals from pestering the guests to shop or sell excursions. The resort has in house vendors to tend to all your needs when it comes to excursions.  If you are considering visiting Punta Cana...choose this resort, you will not be sorry.

reviews.author: Michelle172
reviews.title: Almost the perfect vacation
reviews.text:
Our party of three well traveled adults took a cab from the airport for $30. There are drivers who come to the baggage claim and try to charge you more money however, once you get outside to the taxi stand there is a huge board with the set prices...all lower than the asking prices of the people who come inside. 
The entrance/foyer to the resort is breathtaking. Angel at the front desk was wonderful and helped us through the process. We were introduced to our concierge Mindy. Mindy was the one negative aspect of the entire experience which prevented me from giving it a 5/5 rating. She asked us to wait so she could give us a tour. After we waited about 15 minutes I approached her and she looked at her watch and stated her shift was almost over. She said she would meet us the next morning after a "welcome" breakfast at Naos and she would give us the grand tour. There is no "welcome" breakfast. I made it clear to her that we were not going to sit through a time share presentation. She smiled and said "oh no, you come to the welcome breakfast then I will give you a tour." She happened to be at the podium at Naos when we were headed into breakfast. I asked her for a tour prior to breakfast. She looked at her watch again and said she would meet us after breakfast. She never showed. Later that afternoon after lunch and after seeing her give many people a grand tour of the property I approached her at the concierge desk to ask about making a dinner reservation. I specifically told her we do not like buffet type restaurants for dinner. She made a reservation at a restaurant at the Reserve. I then asked her again for a tour. She flat our said "no". Obviously this did not set well with me, I then approached a group of three concierges and asked one of them for a tour. They asked if I was not yet assigned one, I informed them that Mindy had refused to give me one. One of the concierges ran over to her to speak with her. She came over and said she would give us a tour. The "tour" consisted of her walking down the staircase and pointing to things. I let her know that I was not happy and that I had seen her walking around the property with other people. She just smiled. When we went to the Reserve for the dinner reservation she made we were greeted by the friendly Nilsa Espino. We sat, ordered our drinks and were informed by our waiter that we were free to go to the buffet. Mindy had made a reservation for a buffet restaurant after I had specifically told her that we did not want that. I walked over to Nilsa and asked her if I could call the concierge desk because I was very unhappy. Nilsa took it upon herself to rectify the situation. She went out of her way to secure us a reservation at another restaurant. She kept checking on us and giving us an estimated time that our table would be ready. While we were waiting at the Asian restaurant, she checked on us again and kept apologizing for the wait. When we got seated she came over again to make sure everything was okay. She went above and beyond! When we returned, I informed Christian at the concierge desk about my negative experience with Mindy and asked to be assigned to another concierge. The next day I informed her again of my feelings about her awful service. That evening I asked Estrella Garcia to book my dinner reservations and she was an ultimate joy to work with. She did not make me feel like I was bothering her.
Now for the positives: Angel at the clubhouse was a joy! He was so friendly and informative. Paulinho was amazing, he would come to the beach many times to check on us and our drink orders. He would go above and beyond everyday with a smile on his face. The waitstaff at Naod, the breakfast and lunch restaurant were amazing. They literally would climb over ropes to get you whatever you needed. The food in all of the restaurants were great. Making dinner reservations was inconvenient but Estrella eased the pain. The grounds were beautiful, immaculately kept. There were several fun shows. We did not do the royal service and frankly I do not see the need. 
We did do an excursion to Santo Domingo. It was a very LONG day. The tour guide was brilliantly informative. He had so much knowledge and spoke 8 languages. It is important to realize that more than likely you will miss your dinner reservation.  
One note about the room. We stayed in room 3035. The wall between the main bedroom and bathroom has shutters. The shutters on the ends don't close so there is a little bit of privacy lost, however, we simply draped a towel over it. The housekeeping staff worked incredibly hard and were so sweet and helpful. I must also say that Ricardo one of the bellhops was such a joy! He made us smile everyday! The hardest working people were the lowest on the totem pole.

reviews.author: Blackmouse
reviews.title: El mejor hotel
reviews.text: La reserva en manos de Sílvio a la cabeza de nuestro grupito dentro del grupo ha sido lol mejor. no teniamos reserva la primera noche y nos puso en contacto con Edwin de restaurantes. firme un gesto bonito ya que ambos nos hicieron sentir especial. Fernando nuestro concierge nos ha tratado como turista. Ambioris y Silverio gracias por el trato. Gracias Jafra ppr elegir buen hotel.

reviews.author: Sara H
reviews.title: Back for a second time around:)
reviews.text:
We just came back from the Paradisus and had the best time again!!
We were down there this April and we loved it so much that we decided to return. We brought my in-laws as well, they were just as amazed as we were.
Did the royal package again, worth every penny:)
The resort was beautiful, the staff extremely friendly, food delicious...really not one bad thing to say.
They were a few guys I would like to give a shutout: Richard Ortiz from the Palazzo by far the nicest person, did not mind taking extra measures to make  sure we were extra  happy:)
Luis at the pool bar was great as well, our butler Jose Salvador was very attentive and made sure our stay was top notch. Domingo from guest services was amazing, he went above and beyond helping us out.
Great vacation again and we will be back...AGAIN!!!:)

reviews.author: Glenna D
reviews.title: Very nice property
reviews.text:
Great Service!  The guest Manager, Silvio Lantigua was very helpful and kind.   Santo Palanco was an excellent waiter as well as Bianka.   We had very nice greetings from Rosemary who works for Club Melia. 

The resort was very nice...  the pools are wonderful for adults and kids and never crowded or loud.  The  restaurants were all very good.  The japanese one was closed while we there so check ahead...  The mexican restaurant was surprisingly good and sometimes open for ala carte at lunch if you want a break from the Gabi buffet.   The service is very friendly, my only complaint is that the concierge staff should do some extra training to offer up more info. and ideas when you check in.  We didn't realize how easy to use the "kids zone/club" (It was great, flexible in + out anytime, no obligation to sign up your child for certain hours) also  that the bikes were included (no extra cost) but require prebooking, 1-2 days advance) and the ala carte lunch options until our 4th day.  Also, no ATM or change in reserve lobby, you have to go to the larger Paradisis lobby for money and the staff doesn't have capability to give singles/dollars.  Bring your own US dollars for tipping them!

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Muchísimo más que un all inclusive
reviews.text: Paradisus fue una gran sorpresa en mi vida. Habiendo conocido casi 10 all inclusive diferentes, uno cree que mas o menos conoce de que se trata. Hasta que llegue a este lugar con mi esposo. Es una experiencia que vale la pena vivir. Todo es perfecto, el lugar, la cordialidad y actitud de servicio bien brindado de los empleados,  la ambientación, la calidad de los muebles, los detalles. La cocina es un capitulo aparte, cada restaurant temático tiene especialidades de chef. Nos alojamos en el área de Royal Service, uno de los grandes beneficios que tiene el servicio real, a mi consideración es el acceso exclusivo a la Gabbi Beach, que realmente es una playa de lujo: el servicio, los camastros para tomar sol cómodamente, telas que se mueven con la brisa y sobre todo una playa con poca gente  (y fuimos en temporada alta) ya que no tiene acceso todo el hotel. Es super tranquila. También destaco la amabilidad de la gente, todos absolutamente con una sonrisa y con ganas de hacernos sentir bien, se notan altamente motivados, eso no siempre se ve en un all inclusive. Lo recomiendo 100%

reviews.author: Jerian
reviews.title: The reserve Punta Caña
reviews.text: No tengo tiempo de expresarme, así que seré breve.... En recepción busquen a Doralix, Diosmery o Alexis y serán atendidos como reyes. Restaurantes conocimos a Edwin Saladin a quien sólo le falto entrar al mar y buscarnos lo que queríamos. En el área de The Reserve el señor Silvio Lantigua nos trato como reyes. Ovidio y Níquel gracias por hacernos sentir de otro país, el macizo fue un toque especial. Al nuestra niña le gusto mucho. Sr. Lantigua usted y su equipo merecen un gran aplauso. Nos vemos en mi boda.

reviews.author: Agnes N
reviews.title: Honeymoon in PARADISE!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Me and my husband stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for 8 days for our honeymoon in August! What we experienced there was just phenomenal!!! The food was amazing, the drinks were awesome, the pool and the GABI bar at the reserve were excellent! The BEST THING about this resort, however, was the SERVICE!!! By day 2 or 3, all of the bartenders knew our names and greeted us from afar! Not only did they mix drinks for us, but they entertained us, they took the time to find out where we are from, what we do, etc... One especially great bartender was Danny Romero, whom we talked to every single day either at GABI bar at the reserve or at north avenue bar! He made good drinks but he also told us about his life, took the time to find out about our lives, he gave us advice on what to do and where to go...it felt like we had a friend! Norkys, Juan, and Calvin were also great bartenders! We went to shows every single night...there was live music and great performances by very talented dancers. We also got to know the professional dancers and one of them even danced the Merengue with me! I was so happy because I love to dance and especially love learning new dances! On Saturday, we had fun at the FIRE show and Disco party on the beach...dancing barefoot in the sand was awesome! We had soooo much fun as a new bride and groom that we DID NOT WANT TO LEAVE....the resort is TRUE PARADISE ON EARTH!!! We are considering coming back here for one of our wedding anniversaries somewhere down the line just to re-live the memories of our honeymoon, which we WILL NEVER FORGET!!!

reviews.author: Freshcognac
reviews.title: Great great
reviews.text: Good time with the family, great !!!!! Great !!!!!! Great great !!!!!!!!! All food is great !!!! Rooms are Great !!! And the shows were great !!!!!! Alexander Lopez the best!!!!!!! Everything was Fantastic!!!!!!

reviews.author: Juan G
reviews.title: Considering going back in 2 weeks
reviews.text:
I have stay in at least 15 all inclusive resorts and this one by far is the best !!! The people who work there are incredible, the Units are amazing and the resort it self is a breathtaking, with children and no children is the best place to go, plenty of security around the resort, great inside transportation and again !!! The people who work there are incredible like Elvis the bellman, diomeris and Zuleika on the front desk and many more, the general manager is always walking around making sure everything is perfect . 

As a father and husband I recommend this resort 100%

reviews.author: Marcie M
reviews.title: Fantastic!!!
reviews.text:
When we checked in we thought we were going to just have a standard room but we were upgraded to a 1 bedroom master suite in the Reserve. Thank you Adrianna! OMG. Loved it. The beach at this resort is so nice, beautiful white sand and if you're staying at the Reserve you get special seating at the beach with a bartender just for us.
The Reserve has it's own pool and you can use the main pool as well. This resort was first class all the way. Everyone on the resort was so nice, always saying hola and asking if we needed anything.
You can use the spa facilities for no charge, only charges for massages etc.
The family concierge  was amazing. Thank you Fernando! 
The beds were so comfortable, we slept like babies every night.

reviews.author: Cmanzi
reviews.title: "Home away from home".........
reviews.text:
Our vacation in May,2013 was our 16th visit to Paradisus Punta Cana!!!! We always stayed at the Reserve,but this past visit we stayed at the Royal Service for the first time.  It was marvelous!  There are many staff that we wish to acknowledge for their friendly, accommodating and wonderful service.....JOSE Valverde, our butler, who couldn't do enough for us, we thank you and so appreciate your service;Eduardo Perera Castro,General manager, it was our pleasure meeting you and making our visit the very best;Jorge Saez, Food and Beverage Director and Carlos Valdez,Food and Beverage Assistant Manager, accolades to you both for the delicious and wonderful meals.... we must say that the food on this trip was the best that we've had since our many visits to Paradisus Punt Cana.... you are doing a great job!!! There were many other staff that we would want to extend our sincere thanks for their smiling faces and terrific services....Lillian who always greeted us with a smile and accommodated us at dinner, she's the best!!!! Marlena who also greeted us with a smile and served us well at breakfast; at the La Palapo restaurant(our very first time eating there) Yahaira Rosa and Juan Schillaci were wonderful and excellent staff and we so enjoyed the dinners there!! Thanks go to Neida and Mateil Reyes at the Royal Service for their great services too!  Last but not least, applause applause and our deepest thanks and appreciation goes to Carolina Sacristan who we are most happy to have met and made a new friend!!!
By the way, we'll be coming back the end of the month, September,2013,.... we couldn't stay away too long!!!! See everyone in two weeks!!!!
                                                        Sincerely, J and C Manzi

reviews.author: Sandy L
reviews.title: Fantastic Place!!!
reviews.text:
We traveled with friends here and it was the best all inclusive place we have stayed at!  We were treated like royalty!  The place is spotless, and they are cleaning constantly.  Our bed was super comfortable and the room nice and cool.  Food was good with many choices available.  Lots of lounge chairs on the beach, we never had a hard time finding one.  The wait staff is excellent and super friendly!  Especially Androqui Colon, Luiz De Aza, and Jose Ramos.  They were our favorites, taking such good care of us!  Thank you so much!!!   This vacation was so great we cant wait to come back to this hotel.
Sandy & Frank  :)

reviews.author: CH27516
reviews.title: Paradise Found
reviews.text: We had a phenomenal stay, I would highly recommend the Royal Service. We have amazing service 95% of our stay, Martin Tineo took exceptional care of us on the beach and Pasquel Rodriguez was an awesome waiter!  We had great food, a wonderful room (except for the glass door in front of the toilet) and the grounds were breathtaking. The only part we didn’t care for was the butler service. We rarely used it and when we did we were always let down. We would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Frank S
reviews.title: Wedding site visit
reviews.text:
The hotel was very impressive.  It had a great vibe.  The ocean water was fabulous and clean.  The staff was so friendly and competent.  They made sure we were always happy.  From the gardeners giving us fresh coconut milk they just cut out of a tree, to Luis and Pedro at the pool bar, they all made sure we were never at a lack of thirst!  Pedro-Paredes at (Resturant Bana and Naos) was a terrific Captain.  He ensured our service experience was top notch.  Marcial, the wedding coordinator, spent several hours with us and set up all day appointments for us to go through every detail of our upcoming wedding in April.  We are so much more comfortable after going through this "site visit".  At first we were 50% confident because you leave messages, you go through another person who is in Floridia, and it gives you an uneasy feeling, but..... they know what they are doing here and it all works out fine.  whew......
Two other characters who provided unbeleivable service at Gabi Beach (where we are having our wedding) were Jose and Santo.  They both were so conversational and friendly.  It was a pleasure having them wait on us.  
Somehow, a cool guy named Angel Alverez seemed to have worked 24 hours a day, 7 days a week!  It looked like every where we were, so was he!  We played volleyball in the pouring rain on the beach (which was a blast) then at night he is MC'ing the Michael Jackson tribute musical, then the next morning, (like a creature of habit) we are going to the pool bar for an early Mambo #5 (Luis coined this drink) and there Angel was again!  Funny, always telling jokes and helpful all at the same time.  
My only negative comments are from the airport to the shuttle service to get you to the hotel, it was kind of annoying because they were trying to rope you into doing excursions.  If I want an excursion, I will look ubti it on my own time. Also, bring plenty of cash.  I wanted to take out money from the bank in the hotel and they wanted to charge $24 for every hundred borrowed!  That is rediculous.  I would have been in the casino more if that was not so outrageous! If you go to the flee market which is about a mile down the beach to the right, be prepared to be mentally drained.  There are some good deals you can make and some cool stuff to buy, but the sales people try to pull you in 10 different directions and made me feel a little uncomfortable, although it was safe for us (4 adults and 2 kids). 
Two last items, I wish hotel check in was quicker.  It takes a little too long for my liking and kind of ruins the fun of arriving in a beautiful hotel.  You want to go run outside and enjoy the weather.  Maybe that can be sped up.  Also, I went to the included free sports area.  I went Kayacking.  It was great.  Then I wanted to do free snorkling with my son when we finished.  The guy there said I needed a $20 cash refundable deposit for each set.  Who carries cash around an all inslusive resort when you are going in the ocean? I said, take my room number down, they said no.  The walk back to the room to get $40 was about 10 minutes each way.  So walking 20 minutes seemed crazy.  There should be NO DEPOSIT for these things.  That ticked me off the most out of anything at this resort.  So all in all, if that was my biggest complaint, it is minor compared to the great food, great hospitality and great property.  
Recommend....YES

reviews.author: evasquezcuevas
reviews.title: Mi inolvidable luna de miel
reviews.text:
Mi esposa Carolina Sánchez y yo Edward Vásquez, nos casamos el día 7 de septiembre de este año, me preguntaba en que resort  pudiera hacer que mi esposa disfrutara y pasara una inolvidable luna de miel, en la cual se pudiera sentir como una  verdadera Reyna como lo es ella para mí, un lugar donde  simplemente observando los detalles y del mismo, expresara todos los sentimientos puros y bellos que tengo por ella, sin necesitar ninguna palabra.   Por lo cual investigué con mis amistades diferentes opciones, dentro de las cuales estuvo the reserve of Paradisus punta cana, por la descripción que me dieron y los datos referenciales del mismo, me llevaron a  reservar en este grandioso paraíso.
Sí,  porque para mi esposa  y yo fue como vivir en el paraíso aquí en la tierra, disfrutando de una acogedora habitación con preciosos detalles que satisficieron  todas nuestras necesidades y exigencias como huéspedes. Con una excelente e inolvidable atención de todo el equipo, en especial la del señor Luis Amparo que en poco tiempo nos brindó toda la atención e información que todo nuevo visitante necesita para poder disfrutar al máximo la instancia de este fabuloso resort. 
  Disfrutamos al máximo la exclusividad de la flora que destaca la majestuosidad de la creación del Dios viviente, que nos hacia reflexionar y sentirnos en una plena armonía con la misma. Así como también los restaurantes con una atención única y eficiente, comida exquisita  y detalles que no dejan de ser únicos y especiales en nuestro sentir.
En pocas palabras este resort es merecedor de su Nombre…….

reviews.author: Javier H
reviews.title: Fabuloso Hotel
reviews.text: Estuvimos alojados en este Fantastico Hotel en el mes de Agosto. La atencion del personal es increible, tenemos que destacar por no mencionar a todos o a otros muchos que no recordamos sus nombres a Gabriel y a Sulenny del Reserve que se esforzaron muchisimo para que nuestra estancia fuese perfecta, tambien a Juana Ramirez, Diego Gonzalez, Gabriel Dalusma, Wilfredo Vazquez y tantos otros. A la Direccion decirles que el complejo es extraordinario, realmente un paraiso, destacar los restaurantes, sobre todo el Passion (Pablo y Miguel excelentes profesionales, un 10), los espectaculos, el ambiente, la playa, las piscinas, las comidas y bebidas todo de primerisima calidad, como en todos los Hoteles de esta magnifica Cadena Hotelera. Volveremos seguro a este Hotel y lo recomendamos a todos los que visiten Punta Cana. Muchas gracias de nuevo por hacer nuestra estancia maravillosa e iinolvidable.

reviews.author: ChakaW
reviews.title: Punta Cana babysitting
reviews.text: We will always come back with our daughter.  Kilvania Encarnacion Mejia and Yahaira Mota Gomez at the kid zone are outstanding. Our 21 month old daughter still says their name from time to time.  Absolutely the best daycare we've been to on vacation.

reviews.author: Dharma D
reviews.title: Il meglio dell' All inclusive
reviews.text: La nota dolente, a mio parere della Repubblica Domenicana, e' la grande diffusione di All inclusive che ha sicuramente fatto aumentare il turismo in questo meraviglioso paese caraibico, ma un turismo di massa, di classe medio bassa che ha reso le spiagge e i palmizi di Punta Cana, Bavaro e Baya Hibe come  Rimini (con tutto il rispetto per Rimini) e non piu delle incredibili spiagge incontaminate come in altre isole vicine che non hanno fatto questa scelta, ma hanno privilegiato la natura il territorio quei beni preziosi che rendono queste isole un paradiso. Il Palma Real e' il meglio di quello che puo offrire un All inclusive con una struttura elegante, curata, un servizio eccellente, ristoranti diversificati con una cucina di un alto livello, cosa rara in All inclusive. I costi sono alti, ma adeguati a quello che viene offerto.

reviews.author: Arlene0527
reviews.title: Excellent resort for families!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the the Reserve from July 18 to July 23 in Villa 41 with Family Concierge.  We are a a family of 5 and I booked the 2 bedroom deluxe master suite consisting of 2 interconnected rooms (1 bedroom with king size bed for my husband and I) and a second suite with dining room area living room with queen sofa bed, a bedroom with 2 full size beds for the kids.   We definetely had a lot of space an plenty of privacy.  The check in was quick and painless and Luis at the concierge desk was helpful and extremely nice and welcoming.  Fill free to enjoy the mini or d'ovres by the concierge area while u wait for your room to be ready.   I should say that our flight arrived and hour early therefore we arrived at the hotel much earlier than the anticipated time. Despite that, our room was ready within 45 minutes.   The Reserve area was definetely the best choice for us.   The pool area was never crowded since its just for reserve guests.   The hydrogrill carne churrascas and margarita pizzas were out of this world.   Mr. Drinky drinky! He was the best making sure he kept those drinks coming.   What a great staff always going out of their way to make you feel relaxed and happy.   The gabi club at the reserve had the best food at the resort in my opinion.   We did visit other restaurants bit the gabi club and the grill were definetely our favorites.    Celso became our favorite server so we took a liking to him and we tlipped him welll.   He was very kind with the kinds and a lot of fun to be around.   The
Food was delicious and breakfast spreads were to die for.   The kids enjoyed the pool alot more than shuttling to the beach. They even took to the pool a couple of late nights for fun.   They were quite but no one made a fuss and the staff didnt make a big deal either.   It was fun.   We loved the grounds, which are very well maintained and our concierge sandra was extremely nice and courteous.  All the pics i took came out looking like post cards so i was very happy.   We didnt get to do excursions only one.   And the kids didnt like it.   Next time i would want to do parasailing and the banana boat.   We went to 2 shows at nova theater and late night dancing by the main lounge.   Loved taking the shuttle back and forth to the beach at night.   We saw he beach fireshow and dance show and that was awesome.   We had every drink imaginable, so stay away from the mama juana's you've been warned.    All in all, i want to go again, because a six day stay was just not long enough.    I definetely want to go back!  I cant wait!   I recommend the reserve to every family interested in vacationing to punta cana.   Can't wait to go back!!!:)

reviews.author: 1938Roberto
reviews.title: Dissapointment
reviews.text:
We Went to Paradisus Reserve Punta Cana  we are a member of Melia Caribe Tropical they dont have anything available for that week so I call the Network and we do the reserve 1 week we are very dissapoint because we pay more money for the all inclusive. 2 nights they don fix and change the towels we always stay in the Royal Service at Caribe Tropical. The bathroom they have a very hot water that we have to call to fix that I went to claim what we thought I have the right since we belong to the Member Club. In  other word we don't go back to that hotel, the only thing we really enjoy was the staff, Jose at the Gabi beach excellent person very "complaciente" and always in a very good mood and Juan Cruz at the bar pool
very nice too Rafael Evangelista at the pool bar that men is a such nice person very complaciente too. If for some reason I have to go back I go for the staff in general.
 
I HAVE TO GO BACK IS FOR THE STAFF.

reviews.author: Yolanda H
reviews.title: Amazing luxury resort
reviews.text: We went for a wedding as well as our anniversary and it's my first time outside if the United States. Everyone was helpful, kind, and hard- working. The hotel was beautiful, but very slippery when wet. I had the royal service, which would ave been more beneficial in the peak seasons. Since t was a low season, we received exceptional service from everyone everywhere, including informative Ali's about the country, which wouldn't have otherwise been able to happen. When we can save enough to come back, we definitely will stay at this same resort! We felt very safe, as well, and having a police officer as a spouse, safety is very important.

reviews.author: Lisa T.
reviews.title: Beautiful Property - Upper Mgmt Needs to Learn Hospitality
reviews.text:
As a well-seasoned traveler, in the hospitality industry and an avid Trip Adviser reader, my friend and I selected the Paradisus after much deliberation for a girl's getaway. Also, 2 friends of ours had also gone there and raved about the resort. We booked it through RCI and were excited for our first trip to the Dominican Republic. Normally, I take the negative reviews with a grain of salt but after our week there (August 24 - 31, 2013) I am compelled to write my first TA review ever. Also, after talking with other guests during that week, we weren't the only ones with these experiences. I'll break it down to the good and the not-so-good. 

Good: The grounds are stunning and well maintained. There are some fantastic workers at this resort. People who work really hard to do their job well, efficiently and make sure that their level of hospitality are on par. Edgar and Yetsy from the guest services/conceirge, Pascal and Osenia from Palazzo restaurant, Francisco and Nelson from the Royal Services pool, Pedro at Bana restaurant, Cesar who brought us tea & coffee every morning, and Kimberly from Gabi Beach restaurant made sure we had a good stay. The YHI Spa was absolutely amazing and probably the most redeeming thing about this resort. It was simply amazing and Maria and Altagracia were the best masseuses. Do yourself a favor and get the water ritual before your massage, you won't be disappointed.
