A note, however, the prices on the spa menu do NOT include tax, and their tax is a whopping 18%, so take that into account when trying to book. They have specials throughout the week that offer discounts on their spa services, so look for those. A special note and I would be sorely remiss to not point it out - we met one of the waiters there, Jensey at Market Grill on Wednesday during our week. We chatted and had fun and found out he'd be working at his normal restaurant, Vento, the next night. Well we were lucky because we had reservations for Vento on Thursday too. Jensey went out of his way to make me and my friend feel like royalty that night! Him and his partner that night, Victor, reserved us a special table, put beautiful flowers all over it, gave us fantastic wine, special wine glasses and even a special dessert. They truly went above and beyond and made our trip memorable! We will never forget that night at Vento thanks to Jensey and Victor. Ohh and the food at the resort is fantastic! We are foodies and pretty much enjoyed mostly everything we ate. Palazzo was fantastic!! 

Not-So-Good: Prior to arriving, I emailed Martina Gabriel, the reservations manager several times regarding pre-paying for the all inclusive as it was less costly to do so in advance. Also, in those emails I said "to confirm we have reserved a 1 bedroom ocean view suite with 2 double beds". She never returned the first emails with all my credit card info and I forwarded it to her again (with the bed requests) and she said she received it. When we got there, we upgraded to the Royal Service. We didn't get the full RS because we would have to downgrade our room type and then pay MORE money. A smaller room, not as nice and pay more money? So we opted to stay in our room (w/out butler service), which we were then told only the Royal Service rooms offered an ocean view. Okay, no big deal. We get to our room and there is a king sized bed when we requested 2 dbl beds. We call the front desk and speak to Antonio (who checked us in and upgraded us to RS) and he keeps going and speaking to his manager, who never once called us to handle the situation. I forwarded them all my emails from Martina Gabriel and I said, if 2 dbl beds were a problem - she should have told me prior. It was in ALL my emails. Good customer service requires honesty. Tell me it's not available, no problem. But when your hotel is at 46% occupancy and the hotel tells me in order to get double beds, I would have to downgrade my room OR pay more money! They made it seem like this was my fault when the hotel never told me it was a problem prior to arriving. Nope - they wanted me to pay more money or downgrade my room (when I paid $ for the better room and they weren't going to refund me that $ or tell RCI either of a lower valued (points) room switch). So we kept our room but not even an apology for the mistake on their end.Then the shower in our room flooded the bathroom every time we took a shower. I told 4 different people about this problem at the beginning of our stay, and it was never fixed. We used all of our towels to clean it up...and then the maid re-hung our dirty floor towels back up when she came to clean instead of changing them. We went to Gabi Beach, which was included in our RS upgrade. We wanted to eat a snack on the beach but were told that wasn't included. You had to pay $ to eat on the beach, but if you went and walked into the restaurant (200 feet away) it was included. This made no sense. The next day, instead of being upset the whole week I decided to address what had happened with the Manager. Just to clear the air. In my line of work, I'd want someone to tell me. The manager wasn't available but we spoke to the Manager's assistant, Camillo. I was very calm and explained all that happened. He was visibly shocked and said that A) Martina should have told us B) Gabi Beach food was included BOTH on the beach AND at the restaurant and C) He would have our shower fixed. Feeling much better we went to go relax at Gabi beach. Well guess what? Camillo was wrong. We spoke to Kimberly, the manager of the restaurant and after many back and forth calls to the hotel and the restaurant they said that the beach is not included and they couldn't get Camillo on the phone. Why doesn't management know this? Why don't they tell you this when you pay to upgrade for it , that it's not included? I've stayed at hotels all across Mexico and the Caribbean and have NEVER encountered a place where food on the beach (for the same restaurant) is not included. Also what was disappointing is at the Royal Services pool, there were only 8 covered cabanas which you had to reserve. Us, having no butler, could not do this even though we were told we could reserve them there when we upgraded to Royal Service. When we went to the pool to inquire about reserving one, we were told they were reserved all week. The other beds were in direct sunlight without even umbrellas. My friend and I were typically at the pool from 11 AM - 6 PM every day. Usually about 90% of the day those beds were reserved and completely unoccupied. They need a better reservation system for this. I understand them reserving them, however, when they go unused the entire day - no one is at the pool except the 2 of us and we don't have the option of cooling off in one of them, it leaves a sour taste in your mouth. Perhaps they should do 1/2 day reservations or if it's unoccupied for more than 2 hrs then it can go to someone else. Lastly, upon arriving we made reservations for Passions ($50/person) for our last night there, Friday night. After having such an amazing experience at Vento and looking over the Passions menu, we felt we would have not been happy and left disappointed. So we went to cancel our reservation that afternoon at 3 PM (reservations were at 7:30 PM). Yetsey at the conceirge told us that we could not cancel and had to have done so by 12 PM that day, which no one told us when we made the original reservation. She had to go to considerable length, calling/emailing, etc in order to TRY and cancel our reservation, which she could not guarantee and even if we didn't go were told we would have to pay for regardless. To her credit, she was able to cancel our reservation at no charge. However, something as simple as cancelling a reservation several hours in advance should not have been as big as an ordeal as it was. It should have been a simple, no problem! Of course, whatever you'd like to do! Also their restaurant reservation system does need improving, as they have a very limited number of "reservations per night", yet the restaurants are empty. Perhaps they go based on a certain amount of food/person and that's how they do their reservations, but it should be simpler. A tip - make all your reservations as soon as you arrive.

Overall, I think the upper management needs to learn hospitality and how to treat guests like their employees in the rest of their hotel. They need to be able to communicate with their guests what services they offer and what you're paying for them. Overall we did have a nice stay but too many small blips. Things that should have not been a problem, turned into big productions trying to get it rectified and usually never were fixed (I didn't even bother listing everything). It's even more upsetting as having tried to rectify the situation and inform upper management, and they still provided incorrect information and did not help to solve any of the problems. My friend and I may try another Melia property, but never a Paradisus again, which is sad because the resort is beautiful. But a beautiful resort cannot make up for mismanagement.

reviews.author: Adriana B
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones!!!!
reviews.text:
Estuvimos con mi esposo una semana , divino el hotel !!!A nuestro arribo fuimos atendidos por la señora Diakara Berroa persona  muy profesional y educada ,El Royal Service ,espectacular !!Nos atendio muy profesionalmente el señor Yohelvi Aracena , persona detallista ,siempre atento .

Felicito al hotel por todo su staff , personas maravillosas !!! No terminaria de mencionarlos a todos , Miguel bar  , Pedro en la playa , chefs etc etc , la discoteca divina !! como su gente , siempre felices !

ADRI .

reviews.author: Noe
reviews.title: Uno de los mejores!
reviews.text: En dos oportunidades me aloje en ese resort las dos veces me pareció muy bueno, aunque ahora el nivel de todo es menor, con el paso de los años las villas mas antiguas se notan con falta de mantenimiento interior, problemas con los baños, humedad, pero en general es muy confortable.Estuve 5 dias en una Villa cerca de la playa, de la piscina y de los restaurantes muy comoda pero despues nos cambiaron a una parte nueva que se llama La Reserva porque nuestra habitación estaba reservada para unos socios que tienen membresia. Los que venden estas membresias son insoportables como los que hace unos años te vendian tiempos compartidos el concepto es muy similar y los costos son altisimos, nosotros accedimos a la charla y como no nos interesó se ofendieron y a partir de ese momento nos empezaron a tratar mal. Bueno este aspecto deplorable. Volviendo a la Reserva este lugar es realmente lujoso, muy nuevo, muy muy confortable, el restaurante principal donde tambien se desayuna es precioso, la variedad de comidas es muy buena, el resto de los restaurantes muy variados, los espectaculos por las noches no son Las Vegas pero son buenos. En general recomendable, La Reserva para ir con niños es especial.

reviews.author: Sevetri M
reviews.title: wonderful vacation
reviews.text: we spent a week at this resort and by far it was on eof our favorites. the resort was clean, spacious, and well maintained. The food was excellent with great variety. room service was excellent especially our server Cesar Lefle who went out of his way to accomodate us. We loved the pool and the beaches. Servers ere present to bring drinks if we didnt want to go to the bar. we will definitely return!!

reviews.author: jferreira1222
reviews.title: MY EXPERIENCE AT THE RESERVE
reviews.text: We had a phenomenal time!!! the rooms are beautiful and most importantly CLEAN. Room service was a short wait. My favorite guy was Yuires. He was the sweetest person to talk to and nothing was impossible for him. Overall the employees were very respectful. They made our vacation a better experience. We definitely consider going back!!!

reviews.author: Arul R
reviews.title: Best vacation ever.... superb service!
reviews.text:
My family (wife and 2 kids) spent a week at the Reserve in August. My wife and kids have unanimously declared this the best vacation ever. The facilities were excellent.... the large well maintained suite, the food, the beautiful pool, the private beach, entertainment!!!!

We have been on lots of Carribean vacations in the past, I have to say that while the facilities at the Reserve were better than most, its their Client Service that made this the best vacation ever. 
We had the pleasure of meeting Silvio Lantigua, and he exemplifies client service!!!! He always had a smile, was very attentive to our needs, was patient with all our requests, and ensured that his team made this the best vacation ever by exceeding our expectations! 

We also had the pleasure of meeting Eduardo Perera (General Manager for the resort), and it was easy for us to see that he is leading his team by example.... he was humble, spent the time to meet my family and listened to our feedback, and seemed genuinely interested in ensuring we had the best vacation. He is a real Madrid fan, and I am a Barcelona fan, so we had a nice conversation about soccer also.

I also have to call our Raymon and Mikey, who attended to all our needs at the Beach.

To net it out, we have never gone back to the same resort twice yet, but we are quite sure we will return to the Reserve in the very near future, primariliy because of the client service of Silvio and his team!

reviews.author: lovetravelling87
reviews.title: Un paradis!!!!
reviews.text:
Wow! Quelle expérience ce fut. Un petit 4 jours durant un long week end. Paradisus est le haut de gamme de Melia et sans aucun doute, c'était tout à fait merveilleux! Le Resort est splendide, beaucoup de marbre un peu partout. Un bon service du concierge et de la réceptrion. Les chambres sont des suites, donc spacieuses et très bien. 

Côté plage, c'est Bavaro donc c'est parfait. On peut marcher des km à perte de vue! L'eau est belle, évidemment :)

Côté restos, que du positif. On a bien aimé le H2O situé dans la section Réserve. Le japonais, steakhouse et français sont aussi excellent. Le buffet est varié et très bon..

Je n'ai que du positif à dire de cette propriété!!!!

reviews.author: Ron D
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Review
reviews.text:
Wow- what a great place.  Service could not have been any better or any friendlier.  Vladimir Rodriguez was our contact, and set everything up perfectly for our return. 

Food was plentiful, awesome, and available. Great restaurants, casino is fun, pool spectacular.

Great trip for boys golf, couples, or family.

reviews.author: ufcchick2014
reviews.title: My stay at The Reserve
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I had a great time at the resort. The staff were very friendly and attentive to all of our needs. Plenty of activities to do for all ages. We went scuba diving and zip lining and had a blast. It is literally paradise , beautiful ocean and a really nice pool. Can not wait to come back for my annual visit to DR and will definitely be staying at the Reserve.

reviews.author: Tresanonymous
reviews.title: This was the most wonderful vacation ever!
reviews.text: Francisco Reynaso taught the dancing classes. He was so much fun! He was very patient with our lack of skills and really made us feel comfortable. He made us laugh a lot! He made us want to come back to the classes everyday and that's exactly what we did! We even got to try some of the dances we learned at the hotel parties with him! He has helped make this trip very relaxing and fun!

reviews.author: Lentara71
reviews.title: Family Facts
reviews.text:
Visited here end of August 2013.  First family trip to the Dominican Republic.  Here are some points you need to know before visiting this resort:

1) "The Reserve" is a sub resort within the bigger Paradisus Punta Cana resort.  The Reserve at this place is geared mostly for families/kids.  If you are honeymooning, or have no kids, then this is not really the place for you.  Perhaps staying at the main Paradisus, The Real, or the Paradisus Golf may be better.
2)  The beach is a ten minute walk.  Surprise, surprise.  We went to this resort thinking it was on the beach.  There is a property shuttle that runs every 5-30 minutes (depending on the time of day), but it is a hassle if you want to leave your room and go straight to the beach.  The path to the beach is a loooooonnnnnnngggg non-eventful road.
3)  Beach is gorgeous.  Beautiful white sand and clear water.
4)  Restaurants:  We were told there were 11 restaurants on the property.  Since the last week of August was the start of the off-season, only seven of them were open.  The seventh restaurant was NOT included in the all-inclusive.  The restaurant is called "Passion," and it is extra $$.  We decided to try it, and were quite impressed with the 7-course tasting menu.  It is worth the money if you decide to try it.
5)  Food:  The buffets were good, but limited.  We've been to other resorts in the Caribbean with much more variety than was offered at Paradisus.  We were quite impressed with their seafood dishes.  Fish was always perfect, and the lobster was awesome.
6)  Service:  For the most part, was excellent.  Friendly staff.
7)  Entertainment:  The night shows started at 10pm.  My only complaint here is that it's too late for the kids.  After finishing dinner around 8pm, there is nothing to do until the show starts.  This property does not have poolside entertainment like other resorts we have been to.  The pool areas may have background music playing, but that's about it.
8)  Room:  We had a family suite.  Very nice.  Housekeepers do a great job.
9)  Solicitations:  Just letting you know they try to sell you a membership for their other hotels in other places.  Just politely say no, and they will not bother you.  They sincerely tell you that it isn't time share...     lol.
10)  Incidentals:  Upon check-in, they are going to run your credit card for $500.00 USD, that they say cancels upon check-out.  I checked my credit card statement when I got home, and didn't see the $500.00 USD charge.  I dunno why they really have to do this, but it's hotel policy. I still wish they did not, because it is a hassle.  Who really wants their credit card charged, and a foreign transaction fee placed??
11)  Off-Resort activities:  Every resort I have been to, we try to do 2-3 activities off the resort.  We did a dune buggy excursion and a stingray/shark excursion through the hotel.  These two excursions did not blow me away.
12)  Grounds:  Well kept.  Nice palm trees.
13)  Evening Shows:  The circus show is really good.
14)  There is a casino, disco, gym, spa, bikes, bungee bounce,  and rock climbing on the property for your use.
15)  Shopping:  There are several free shuttles from the hotel.  

My overall impression is great place, & will come back if we make it back to Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Jenny L
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, attentive staff
reviews.text:
We went to Punta Cana over labor day and had a wonderful experience.  Property was beautiful and very well maintained.  Staff was very attentive.  I will caution, however, it was off season and resort was not crowded- so it was very easy to be attentive.

We got our room upgraded (for free) on arrival to a huge suite.  Pools and beach were amazing.  Drinks were very strong.  Suggest making dinner reservations prior to arrival.  Also, take a taxi to and from resort, do not use their transportation.  It is $35 each way via taxi.

reviews.author: Gerald S
reviews.title: Pretty property but very empty
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from this resort. We went there to celebrate our anniversary. The property was very nice, but was very empty. There were a lot of activities that we wanted to do where the hotel guide never appeared - pilates, water aerobics, even though the session was listed on the daily guide. The food was good, but the restaurants served small portions. We wised up during the trip and either ordered multiple dishes or pre-gamed at the buffets. The rooms also only had a smattering of drinks in the refrig, no snacks - surprising compared to other all-inclusives.
  We also sat through a resort sales pitch that was supposed to be 1 1/2 hours, but ran to 3 hours. We not have been polite and just left - big mistake. Then they offered us a special "deal" where there was an 18% sales tax and 15% annual interest if we didn't pay the entire sum that day. When we got up to leave, the interest and sales tax magically were not required????

Finally, when I mentioned to the resort concierge that this was our annivsersay celebration he said that they would do something "special", but nothing ever happened.

Overall - nice property, good food, but lacking on the personal touches of an upscale "all-inclusive."

reviews.author: Sole
reviews.title: Experiencia para repetir
reviews.text:
Hoy volvimos de pasar una semana en The Reserve en el Hotel Paradisus Punta Cana. Un lugar soñado, por el paisaje del lugar como tambien por el diseño que tiene el hotel que lo acompaña. La decoracion es preciosa, en especial The Reserve.
Quiero mencionar 3 aspectos a destacar del Hotel:
1. Limpieza: las habitaciones estan siempre limpias, gracias a Rosa Yan que ademas de hacer un gran trabajo, fue muy amable y simpatica con nosotros
2. Comida: hemos recorrido casi todos los Restaurants del Hotel. Los que no fuimos fue porque estaban cerrados al ser temporada baja. Todos muy bien ambientados, pero la comida en si fue regular. Comenzamos con "The Grill" que la verdad fue un fiasco total. No se si es porque somos argentinos, que el restaurant "argentino" nos parecio con poca variedad, la carne no estaba cocida como queriamos y la variedad de postre era muy limitada (no habia frutas en PUNTA CANA!!). El resto de los lugares estuvieron muy bien pero la carta es limitada entre 3-5 opciones. Cabe destacar el Gaby Club y el Gaby Beach que tenian un buffet excelente con mucha variedad.
3. Servicio: Consideramos que lo que hace linda e inolvidable esta experiencia es la atencion de todo el personal de este Hotel. Todos los dominicanos han sido muy amables y serviciales con nosotros como nunca en otro pais. Comenzando con el Sr. Marino que nos recibio en el Lobby, ha hecho las reservas de los restaurants, nos explico el manejo del hotel y siempre estuvo atento a nuestras necesidad. La Sra Isidra de Oca, del club Meliá que formamos una amistad, compartiendo una cena en Passion. La Sra Alicia del Club, Rosa yan de limpieza, los chicos que atendian el Gaby, todos hicieron de este viaje recomendable y repetible.

Otros: Wifi anda en toda The Reserve, los transportes son excelente en el trencito como en los autitos particulares, recepcion del lobby tambien siempre a disposicion

reviews.author: Frequita
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: I went there for about 4 days to a friend wedding, and this hotel was amazing all inclusive....too expensive but you get what you pay for....food was excellent, service was great...room was fenomenal...I def recommend this place

reviews.author: Moleska
reviews.title: Einfach gut !
reviews.text: Der Service dieses Hotels in erstklassiger Lage ist ausgezeichnet. Das Personal ist freundlich, die Bewirtung sehr angenehm. Der Chef des Bana, Pedro Paredes, ist besonders hervorzuheben. Er ist sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und um das Wohl seiner Gäste, die er hofiert, sehr bemüht. Zudem ist er sehr liebenswürdig und sprachgewandt. Wir kommen gerne wieder und haben den Aufenthalt sehr genossen.  Familie Z aus Köln

reviews.author: Patricia P
reviews.title: Exceptional service performed with a thoughtful heart
reviews.text: The resort was all that we has hoped for, and more! It was a true paradise. The food was fabulous, the surroundings most beautiful, and our butler Elvis Hidalgo provided exceptional service. He made arrangements for our incredible restaurant experiences each evening, and added special surprise treats, like a fresh cheese platter waiting in our room when we returned from shopping one day, and a drawn bubble bath complete with strewn flower petals, candles and a bottle of wine that followed a perfect romantic dinner my husband and I enjoyed. The perfect balance of exceptional service and respect for our privacy - truly service with a heart!

reviews.author: Leonor_2013
reviews.title: Nuestras bacaciones
reviews.text: Nuestras bacaciones somos una familia de 6 formada por mis cuatro hijos de 11, 7 , 2 y un año mi esposo y mi persona, nuestra semana fue fabulosa todas las personas súper amables no podría decir que en algún momento nos sentimos mal por que les mentiría. Todas las mañana desayunaba con frutas todas súper fresca les recomiendo el mango. Hay nos atendía el Sr. Rafael Melenciano que todos los días nos llenada de alegría con sus comentarios. Los restaurantes todos son exquisitos una noche me la tomé para mi esposo y para mi fuimos a cenar donde pedí una comida que no fue de mi agrado enseguida vino el encargado de mesoneros el Sr. Pedro Paredez con mucha educación me retiro el plato y lleno de sugerencias donde termine comiendo delicioso por sierto el postre crema catalana con piña y coco la mejor😛 . Todas las noches fuimos al show súper lindos me encantaron todos sobré todo la noche de Michael  el chicos baila fabuloso . Conversando con alguien me presentaron a la srt Liliana Martínez donde nos dedico parte de su tiempo en explicarnos como organizaban los show fue súper linda y explícita para que los niños entendieran. Todos los días nos sentábamos en la piscina grande serca del bar ja ja hay nos atendía el Sr. Luis que sin importarle siempre complacía a los niños con sus juguitos de piña. Luegos tomábamos el almuerzo donde nos atendió el Sr. Elvins que siempre estaba a su disposición la última noche nos quisimos tomar un traguito y nos sentamos como en la plaza principal donde el Sr. Luis Martínez nos preparo la mejor piña colada. Y les preparó bebidas a los niños adecuadas para ellos fue muy lindo de su parte y los niños se sintieron súper especial Bueno amigos con todo esto sólo me queda decirle que les recomiendo este Lugar es increíble para descansar y sentirte consentido

reviews.author: JGalpe
reviews.title: Habitaciones con Royal Service ofrecen un servicio de Calidad y con Calidez como en pocos lugares
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en el sector Golf and Spa con Royal Service. Sin lugar a dudas vale la pena el costo adicional por el servicio Royal. Todas las comidas à la carta, servidas en un restaurant exclusivo.
Excelente nivel de limpieza, mantenimiento de las instalaciones, calidad de colchones, almohadas, sabanas, toallas, etc etc.
Muy buena calidad de comida. Carne muy tierna y gustosa. El servicio Royal en la playa es excelente.
A mejorar: conexion a internet en areas abiertas y en especial en la habitacion. El estar conectados a nuestras oficinas, y tener un excelente wi-fi en la habitacion, asi como en las areas comunes, me permitiria tomar mas facil la decision de volver en cualquier momento del año, y poder tomar unas vacaciones sin descuidar de mi trabajo. Estuve en la habitacion 3110 y no tenia ni Wi Fi ni internet pot cable. Tenia que trasladarme al lounge con el notebook, Unico detalle a mejorar. Gracias por el excelente servicio.

reviews.author: Saruj N
reviews.title: AMAZING AT PARIDISUS !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: I loved the reserve at Paradisus  Punta Cana the service is exceptional.  We know it going to be a memorable trip since our check in. I would like to say a special thank to our guest service manager Mr. Silvio Lantigua and all of the best in class employees at the resort.  The property is so well maintain and clean. Wow! for the private reserve beach. Everyone seemed so nice, and my whole family loved it even my daughter due to the family concierge program that gave her own little beach set.  The family concierge Asia Matee was the best she left daily pleasant surprises on our dinner table such as, snacks and cupcakes.  The restaurants  are out of this world with great service and food I like to give a shout out to Cesar Eastro for being one of the happiest guys there and entertaining my family as we  mourn over sadness on the last day. Two tums up for all the  bartender at the Cabi club (at the reserve). They all remember my drink by the second day.  We took an one week vacation. If  you want to have a super great time in paradise go to The reserve at Paridisus with family concierge service and you wont regret it.

reviews.author: Christian R
reviews.title: muy buen hotel y servicio
reviews.text: Quiero hacer una mencion especial a Ricardo Canela una persona que nos atendio a mi esposa y a mi de manera especial, se esforzo inclusive en ir a comprar medicina en la farmacia que distaba del hotel considerablemente. Una persona atenta feliz y buena persona, como estoy seguro que es el resto de personal. Fuimos en noviembre del 2012 y estoy seguro de volver con toda mi familia, en realidad un excelente hotel. Comida servicio, bebidas y espectaculos de maravilla!!!

reviews.author: I-LoveToTravelNY
reviews.title: The perfect getaway sanctuary
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful! The resturants were very good. Every night they made our dinner reservations for us. We visted the gym the whole week (I guess because we felt gulity eating so much LOL). If you like spin class you won't like their old spin bikes.... BUT the cardio classes were great. The Reserve section has it's on pool and beach section. Even though, the Reserve is a little farther from the beach the trolly ride was short and sweet.Our biggest decisions during the stay was beach vs pool and what time to eat. If you want to relax an bask in the sun this is the place. The service was great and the concierge was so helpful. Along, the way Ines helped answer our questions. Super Mario was full of energy and had us dancing by the pool. I wish I was still there!!!!

reviews.author: Rafael A
reviews.title: Uma experiência inesquecível
reviews.text:
O hotel tem uma estrutura fantástica e cuida de cada detalhe para que a experiência de seus clientes seja impar. 
Pros: quartos amplos e confortáveis, sistema all inclusive com comida e bebida de altíssima qualidade incluída, restaurantes muito bons, estrutura na praia com conforto e cheia de mordomias, mergulho (todos os dias!!!), veleiros e caiaques incluídos, piscinas amplas, limpas e tb com bares e serviços ao redor.
Optamos pelo Royal Service e a mordomia foi incrível. Até mordomo tinha. Alias, quem for para lá e optar pelo Royal Service, tente ser atendido pelo mordomo Agustin Nunez. Serviço fantástico, discreto e muito atencioso.
Contras: (1)quarto levemente úmido em função do clima local. Eu não tenho alergia mas para quem tem pode ser um desconforto, (2) rede de vôlei de praia amarrada em coqueiros. Fica charmoso mas pode machucar como aconteceu comigo que ralei o joelho ao bater no coqueiro e por pouco não acabou com minhas ferias e (3) abordagem insistente para venda do clube melia. Acho que deveria ser mais suave e focado em quem buscar a informação.

reviews.author: RoamingAmbassador
reviews.title: Amazing week in paradise!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real - this place truly lives up to its name. It looked and felt like we were in paradise!! Our room was spacious and comfortable. We loved the 24hr room service, which came in handy after several late nights out! The pools and beach area were well-maintained, with plenty of comfortable seating. The swim-up bar was definitely a nice touch, had the best daiquiris there!  A big shout out to the activities staff, Angel & Yurbi. They were a lot of fun!

All restaurants were good, including the buffet restaurant Naos, which offered a wide variety of fresh fruit, desserts, and salads.  Vento was by far the best for both food and service.   I very much enjoyed my meal there! Teppenyaki at Bana restaurant was a lot of fun, especially with our chef Manuel.

Tip: If you have a garden view room, make sure you shut the inner curtains because you can see straight through to the bathroom from outside.

reviews.author: fopcat238
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I recently experienced a second vacation stay at the Dominican Republic Punta Cana Paradisus Palma Real, and I left with positive feelings and a desire to return. So, what keeps bringing me back to Palma Real?:  The beach is large and clean, with creamy white sand; the food is varied and tasty; the ambience is relaxing and accommodating. .  But what stands out for me is the staff. The bus waiters, the restaurant captains, and the supervisors all strived to make sure that our needs were superbly met. Among them, the following staff members stand out: Juan De Dios, the restaurant supervisor, took time to interact with us and customers at other tables, constantly checking to make sure that everything was satisfactory.   Paola – from Food and Beverages – is very courteous and personable.  She was excellent in providing answers to all our questions in connection to reservations and other dining needs.  Juan De Dios and Paola form part of a fantastic service team. Sergio, the Chef at the Gabi Restaurant, stands out among all the chefs.  We dined in all the restaurants and we noticed that Sergio was the only Chef who would come out of the kitchen to chat with us and other customers. He engaged in conversation about food preparation, and was always ready to prepare any special dish from the menu to our liking. I asked for fresh grilled tuna with spinach and asparagus. Delicious!  I found his personable and attentive care to details to be that of a 5 star restaurant, topped with a very unique beach environment. Fantastic!

reviews.author: CaribeNyc
reviews.title: Bliss
reviews.text:
Bliss
We were there May 27-30th.  Yes, 3 months later and I still smile at the thought.  Our experience was awesome…total  BLISS!!  The resort is beautiful and well maintained. The beach was incredible and so was the staff.      There is Juan De Dios, supervisor in all restaurants.  We dined in; Vento ,Nao, Gabi Beach and the Buffet.    He always interacted with us always seeking our comfort and satisfaction.  Paola, Food and Beverages, so sweet and always ready to be of assistance.   Sergio, chef @ Gabi Beach, loved it ! He took pride in his work , special care to make sure all our dishes were prepared to our liking  and always open to special requests.   We had fresh grilled tuna, paella, shrimp caussoulet/plantains and good  soups. Some of the dishes had some latin/Mexican fusion.  Yumm!   At Gabi Beach, our favorite spot, there was also the mixologist, Hecto U..  He kept us “happy” and Santo M., the beach attendant, made sure we were hydrated as we sunbathed on those comfy beds.  YES!!!!!
Thanks to all. Plan to return for the 3rd time and have since recommended to friends.

reviews.author: Danulo
reviews.title: Paradisus, un Paraíso, realmente !
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en Agosto de 2013 con mi mujer y no queríamos irnos, no queríamos que se termine nunca nuestra Estadía en este Paraíso.
Escogimos el Royal Service, súper recomendable, servicio exclusivo para Adultos. 
Es un espacio exclusivo en el Hotel, espectacular, pero además se pueden usar todas las Instalaciones del Complejo.
La pileta y la playa son excelentes y ni hablar de la atención de todo el personal, realmente, se esmeran a cada momento por hacerte sentir "royal", un "rey".
Desde nuestro Mayordomo Ramón, en la Playa Martín, Billy y Francisco, son "de diez", Pedro en la Pileta y Playa, un GENIOOOO !!!!, Wilkins en la barra de la Pile, todos hacen de la Estadía que sea un placer !
En Palazzo, el restaurante en que más a gusto nos hemos sentido, Richard, Pasquel y Miguel, nos han atendido de lujo.
Pero todo el personal, realmente, se esmeran por hacerte sentir de la mejor manera. 
La comida es un lujo, los tragos, de primera. En la playa, jugos y frutas. Todo de primera !
Sin lugar a dudas, si quieren pasar unos días de ensueño y lujo, no duden en elegir este Hotel, absolutamente recomendable !

reviews.author: Lissette Q
reviews.title: best vacations
reviews.text:
My niece and I just got back in August from Punta Cana We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real, we had the best vacation ever. The Hotel is beatiful, clean and very well kept, the staff was incredilble they really go out of their way to make you have a great time, the Food, the Shows very good, the Rooms are beautiful, quiet and impecable clean. Visited July 2013
 
 Value Atmosphere Service

reviews.author: mike a
reviews.title: Perfect for Honeymoon!
reviews.text:
After researching tons of places on the internet my wife and I chose the Paradisus Palma Real in the DR. On paper (and as it turned out in reality), you got the most value for your dollar. We opted for the royal service, which included many amenities that were not included in the other packages. And after about 5 min. we both agreed that it was worth the extra few hundred. I was a bit concerned at first when we did not receive the 'pre arrival check list' and any time you call you get someone who hardly speaks english. However, about a week prior to our trip I called/emailed and was able to connect with the royal service concierge and they arranged private transportation from the airport (they will comp this for royal service but you have to push them a little bit). There was a man standing at baggage with a sign that had our names on it and off we went (and be prepared to tip everyone). Upon arrival to the resort, we were escorted to the royal service lounge to check in. They sat us down and handed us a mimosa and a few snacks. We had read about the sales pitch that they give you (which they gave to other people), but they did not put us through it. Perhaps because we informed them it was our honeymoon. After they ran my cc, and paid the room in full (which they run in the local currency, and also put a $500 hold on your account for incidentals, that i wasn't aware of) we were introduced to a butler who escorted and carried our luggage to our room. He gave us the run down on everything, we asked many questions on our walk to the room. In addition (and be sure to do this) we had him arrange our dinner reservations for the week. We asked his opinion of different restaurants and he was able to set us up. Additionally, prior to arrival I asked the concierge to have a bottle of champaign and strawberries waiting for us in the room and they did! After that, its your paradise to do what you please.  We explored a bit to see where everything was check the place out etc. Theres a private area with a pool and bali beds on the beach just for the royal service. I didnt know this prior to arrival, but you have to have your butler reserve a cabana around the pool a day in advance if you want to use one. They also have bali beds out in the sun for your use on a first come first serve bases. Our butler also informed us to talk  to the the cabana boys (guys in white shorts) to reserve a bali bed on the beach.

So the next morning I woke up early and talked to one of them, the gentleman I talked to is  named Ramon. I told him that I was there on my honeymoon, gave him 10 bucks. And set up/ reserved bali beds on the beach for us, and he told me that everyday we would have the same one reserved. Ramon did an excellant job, couldnt ask for more. He put us in the front row! and every morning when we came back from breakfast he came up to us and informed us that he prepared our cabana for us, and could he get us a drink. Always a smile on his face, called us by our first names, and was always there with a drink if we needed one. Although its all inclusive, it is courteous to tip these folks as they are waiting on you and ready to meet your every need. Ask for Ramon and he will make sure you are well taken care of on the beach/ royal service pool. 

This leads me to the royal service pool area bar. On the first day, I went up to the bar to get a drink and ordered a strawberry daiquiri for my wife and told the tender to just make me something. And the bar tender Nelson, made me his signature drink (which is not on any of the menus but should be) he calls it a 'make me happy.'  Typically I am a scotch and beer drinker, but wanted something to drink by the pool that was more soothing. I ordered this drink on the first day, and drank at least 6 per day everyday after. They were AMAZING, I couldnt drink enough of them. Nelson is great at what he does always has a smile on his face. Its folks like him who leave a lasting impression and I will remember when I am booking in the future. Anyone can make a drink, but Nelson goes above and beyond to take care of people and make you feel welcome. 

We went in late August, which is a bit of a gamble with hurricane season. But we lucked out and it rained maybe a total of 30 min. in the 7 days we were there. 

Food: with the royal service you have exclusive access to a restaurant called Palazzo, great food. Breakfast was amazing, we went there the first day for bfest and didnt bother going anywhere else for the rest of our trip. They have a menu that you can order off, a buffet, and made to order french toast (which was out of this world), crepes, and pancakes. I was a bit nervous about drinking the tap water, and asked for bottles. However I was ok with them bringing the big bottle over to fill my water glass. So long as I saw them pour the water directly from the bottle in to my cup I was ok. Then we went for dinner at Palazzo and met a waiter who I will certainly return to see, his name is Hossay and took great care of us. Another person who is great at his job, and made our experience very personal and truly exceptional. He always greeted us by first name, and with a smile. Throughout dinner he made sure that my wife always had a full glass of wine (and you can order wine by the glass and its included, you dont need to buy a bottle). As i mentioned Im a scotch drinker, and like a particular brand of scotch that they did not have to offer in this particular restaurant, but they had it in the lobby bar. He asked me what kind of scotch I was drinking, and went to the lobby bar to get it for me...over the top! We got to know him well, great person. As it was our honeymoon, on our last full day we saw him at breakfast, and he told us to make sure we come to see him for dinner as he was going to have the chef make us something special. So we canceled our reservations at the other restaurant to come see Hossay at Palazzo (without a reservation). That night, he greeted us and sat us. A few min. later the Chef came out to inform us that he was personally going to prepare a special dinner for us that was off the menu. And he did, he prepared lobster tails and filet mignon for our main course. Truely a great way to end our trip. 

The beach was great, be prepared for local vendors. They will try to sell you anything and everything and try to lure you back to their shops. There was a shop about 5 min walk on the beach that we went to its pink. to the right if your looking out at the ocean, that we went to to get all our gifts for people. Half the price as the lobby gift shop.
There was not too many people at the resort as a whole, as it was off season for them. So we had a very personal and intimate experience.

Our butler Sandy was amazing, he did everything we could have hoped for. He even got us an underwater camera for our snorkeling trip when the gift shop was out of them! Made us 2 bubble baths champaign and fruit without us even asking! Great job Sandy you will not be forgotten, One of the reasons for our return will be because of your hospitality!

There are a few things that I wish I knew prior to arrival, such as: The the reserve/main Yhi spa is included in the royal service (not the services, but full access to the hot tubs, showers, steam rooms, showers etc etc. which is a must do)- be sure to have them put you through the aqua theory its amazing and free you wont regret it, Snorkeling is included, sailing is included (we did both and worth it), lunch at Gabi beach is included for royal service. bring tons of 1's and 5's for tips. I brought about 400 in cash, big bills and was constantly asking for change (which most of the time they didnt have). I spent about 250 usd in tips over the course of 7 days. 4 days would definitely not be enough time with travel etc. theirs no need for an oceanview room, as you can sit on the actual beach anytime youd like. be prepared to deal with local salesman on the beach. I knew this but wanted to throw it in as a reminder, make sure to use the safe, only keep necessary valuables on your person otherwise lock it up in the safe. housekeeping will knock at 9am if you dont have the 'do not disturb' sign up. if you dont speak a lick of spanish it is going to be difficult to communicate with staff at times. Pools close around 7 as well as the pool bars. They serve gray goose/ belvedere in the royal service lounge, but no where else, glenfiddich is served in the lobby bar but no where else. Theres one swim up bar in the main pool, its overrated we went once and there was one bar tender serving both the 'land' front and the pool front. so we left after about 20 min w/o a drink at the swim up side. There is no music turned on around the royal pool area but I asked guest services to turn it on and there was music the next day. bring your own sun screen from home (even though it says included), women- you have to ask for hair conditioner as its not provided standard (but they will give it to you if you request). dont drink or use tap water for teeth brushing. they provide toothbrush/paste, razor/creme. The $1500 resort credtis are a complete waste, coupons to get you to spend more cash, dont have that be a deciding factor when booking. Wine by the glass is included, dont need to buy bottles. Cigars are not included but there is an overpriced cigar shop in the lobby. $500 hold on your cc at check in.

Of course every experience is unique, we went in late august which is off season so its very quiet and romantic. but I figured I would share mine with you as I was in your shoes a few months back, reading reviews for a bunch of resorts. I must say though that it was the staff that made it such a wonderful experience they truly know how to take care of their guests. Sorry for the long review, but I figured its better to be as detailed as possible because your about to spend good money on a vacation!

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.title: Punta Cana Paradise
reviews.text: The room was absolutely spectacular.  Large, well laid out.  Refrigerator is stocked, per your preferences, every day.  We had the Master Suite and felt it was well worth it.  Property is beautiful and we have returned three times now.  Love it.  They always do something special for us as we always travel over our anniversary (39 years now).  Still romantic and in love and this is the place to be.

reviews.author: Lissette Q

reviews.author: Terri D
reviews.title: AMAZING!!
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful with the friendliest staff I have ever seen on the DR. A special thanks to Dhoralix Polanco and Fernando Mango- they need a raise!! The food is great - get the grilled lobster in mushroom sauce at Gabi Club. Drinks are strong enough to make you "smile and relax". Oh and the Mamajuana - the best in the DR!! I would recommend this hotel to families and couples. The dance team is fun - with a special shout out to Mario! A little far from the beach but steps from the pool which is just as great.

reviews.author: KaInCanada
reviews.title: Relaxing week in Punta Cana
reviews.text: We spent a week at Paradisus Palma Real last July. I travelled with my husband and 2 kids. It was very relaxing. The resort property is a really nice one. My 9-yr-old son had a blast in the swimming pool and playing tennis, and 6-yr-old daughter loved the kids club, where she felt welcome despite being quite shy. The restaurants, if not amazing, had decent food, except for the desserts which were much below expectations. Only complaint is the system used for making reservations at the restaurants. It was incredibly messy and I heard many other guests complaining about it. Time to move from telephone to an automated system.

reviews.author: M_Alenia2013
reviews.title: Fantastic All Round Experience
reviews.text:
I have never come home from a vacation with nothing to complain about - but this time, its totally true.  I had a SUPER visit.  The location was magical, the accommodations luxurious, the food delectable and the staff so friendly and helpful that I couldn't even imagine how to express my appreciation fully.
I do want to make special mention of Angela Guzman who was my Valet at the Spa and who was particularly warm, helpful and attentive.

reviews.author: Fergoson
reviews.title: Amazing beach, great value, a few problems
reviews.text: The area is beautiful and the beach is one of the best we've visited. Restaurants are very good for the most part. Service was good although our concierge service was a little disappointing (our lady quit during our stay, hopefully not because of us...). The Reserve area is farther away from the beach and restaurants, which requires constant transporation using the shuttles, which is a pain. We had a terrible mosquito problem and couldn't get away from them. Wasn't perfect, but we had a great time.

reviews.author: familytraveler11
reviews.title: Almost perfect family vacation
reviews.text:
We have a large family vacation every year (12 of us) and this year decided on The Reserve at Paradisus.  There were a lot more pro's than cons, so I will start with the cons.
  CONS - we arranged transportation to/from the airport with the help of the hotel concierge through "luxury tours/transfer company".   They were reasonably priced and responsive in emails.  However, thats where the good ended.   For my brother they were 30 minutes late and then, even after confirming the drop off, brought him to the wrong location (main lobby instead of The Reserve).  For us, it was almost the same.  It was terribly hot and a horrific process for immigration where you just wait in an endless line after paying your tax to enter the country.  We couldn't wait to get to the resort where the rest of the family was waiting.
   Alas, wait we did.   There was no driver.  We called, my sister called, nothing.  Finally after 30 minutes, he showed up.  We were not amused.  Skipping ahead, we had the same problem leaving the hotel and were in danger of missing our flight home.  Worst transfer service ever goint to/from worst managed airport -nothing but long lines everywhere.
  Next Con was the daily cleaning.  Our room was skipped entirely one day and when it wasn't the job was so/so.  There was somethign in the jacuzzi tub (sticky something) so it never got cleaned and we never used it..  The mini bar (the only 'bar item is beer) did not get refilled daily as advertised.
  The food at times was really good, but at times it was edible at best. We had high hopes for the hibachi - another guest said it was 'hot'.  We took that to mean 'happening', but it was literally very hot.  The only places with a/c were the rooms.  Between the grill and the heat, it was just plain hot.  They also had a lot of trouble with who ate what.  
  On to the Pro's.   The rooms (we all had master suites) were extremely spacious and comfortable, though we were not in them much.  The shower worked very well and lots of space in the bathroom.  We liked the flow.  It was an easy walk to the gym which was adequately equipped and pleasant atmosphere, all in good working order.
  The pools at the Reserve were fabulous.   The little ones (my three nieces - 4 and nephew 6) mostly played in the kid pool area and really loved the kids club during the hottest hours.  The older kids (my daughters 19, 22), enjoyed the big pool and we all enjoyed the swim up bar, and loungers under the water.  There was spotty service for food/drink orders, but generally it was ample and always friendly.   Being an all-inclusive, the drinks were plentiful, though I suspect a bit watered down.
  At night my sister's nanny stayed with the little ones and the adults would go out to dinner and enjoy cigars in comfortable locations where we wouldn't bother anyone.   As non-smokers otherwise, we enjoyed that most indoor places were non-smoking (except the casino) and at the Reserve there did not seem to be an abundance of smokers.
  We took advantage of coupons and all booked massages.  The spa was terrific and we all thorougly enjoyed our services.
  From the Reserve, it is a bit of a walk to the beach, so you have to wait for a tram.  The come often enough but can be crowded.   The beach was beautiful though rougher than we expected.  There are plenty of comfortable loungers and canopies to go around at the Reserve section of the beach.  We did have trouble on Saturday night getting a tram back to the Reserve from restaurants near the main lobby.  It is not a bad walk once you know the shortcut, but even that was too much for my elderly parents, so we waited a while and then finally crowded into one.
  The service staff were extremely helpful and friendly with a couple of sour exceptions.    We really enjoyed The Reserve and were satisfied with our choice and selection.  We contemplated returning there (something we have never done, we always find a new place), but I believe the harrowing experience of arrival and departure at Punta Cana have sufficiently discouraged us from a return, but we are glad we went this time.
  We intentionally stayed at the Reserve which is family/kid oriented.  The regular part seemed more appropriate for young people/couples, so for us, it was the right choice.

reviews.author: SugaP
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise!
reviews.text: This all-inclusive resort was absolute paradise!  However, stay away from KB Store in Palma Real Shopping Mall.  The cashier has a very bad attitude, unwilling to help and unfriendly.  Don't waste your time and money in KB Store!!! Otherwise, its a very luxurious resort with modern furnishings and good food.  Ariel welcomed us by delivering a fruit platter and champagne to our room. I enjoyed the best meal at Vento Restaurant and the service was exceptional by Hector and Victor.  The food at Vento was AWESOME from beginning to end!  I also recommend the food at Market Grill Restaurant and our waiter Yoheli was truly attentive.  The dance lessons offered by Miguel, Angel and Franciso was so much fun.  They made it easy to learn bachata and salsa.  Thanks guys for all the laughs and fun in the sun.  The highlight of my trip was the YHI Spa.  This spa was totally relaxing with beautiful fountains, sauna and Jacuzzis.  My masseuse Quintana was excellent and pampered my aching muscles.  Alexandra Moto attended to all of our needs while at the spa.  Special thanks to Maria for her help while instructing me in Pilates, Yoga and Body Balance.  The beach and pool were always clean and staff was consistent with greetings to check if I needed anything. I highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real!!!

reviews.author: Blake P
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!!!
reviews.text: We had the best vacation here. We've been to a lot of resorts in different areas in the Caribbean and this is by far the best! We wanted to book our next one to the same place before we even left. The food was amazing and our butler, tony, was so nice and helped us with everything! Do the royal service....... It's worth it!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Tina B
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for our first anniversary 4/29-5/3. We had high expectations since we had a fabulous stay in an all inclusive in Cancun for our honeymoon. Upon arrival, we were quickly greeted with mimosas and cold towels. My travel agent was able to get us the VIP member pass which allowed for additional amenities such as a private check in. 

Our personal concierge went ahead and booked our dinners for the week at the more popular restaurants - Bana, Vento, Gabby Beach, and the Market Grill. We always had Naos for breakfast and lunch. Then, if we needed a snack, stopped by Market Grill. The food was pretty good at all but keep in mind this is a foreign country and they are catering to thousands of people. You will find things you think are great and some not so much. With all the options, you are bound to find something you like. I think my least favorite was Market Grill's lunches. Everything else was either very good or just okay. I had a curried fish at Bana with a seafood soup. The fish was spicy! Then, I had lamb shank at Vento which was very good! Surf and turf at Gabby Beach which was also pretty good. Finally, a steak at Market Grill. It was okay not bad though. You cannot go wrong at Naos for breakfast and lunch. It is a large buffet so there is something for everyone. I will say skip the scrambled eggs. I stuck to boiled egg or omelet. There fruit, breads, and spreads were great. I really liked the smoked salmon and cream cheese on toast or bagel. 

The room was nice and it did take me flooding the bathroom floor to figure out the jets in the shower. I'd skip them as they create more of mess in the bathroom. There are sections not fully sealed so water will leak out. The bed was comfy but I did feel like the sheets may be slightly damp. I really think it is due to the high humidity there not because the linens were damp. It was super hot and humid. Walking to breakfast can break you out in a sweat. Other than that the rooms were nice and the cleaning staff always did a good job. 

We also used the Spa services. We ended up at the neighboring Reserve spa. I had a facial and my husband had a massage. It was his first and he enjoyed it. If you can splurge, I would definitely take a trip to the spa.

Now, the negative. The only downfall is the push to Melia Club. Do not get suckered into this unless you make big bank and plan to travel to these resorts multiple times a year. It will not be worth it. It was promised to be a 45 min presentation and ended up being more like 2.5 hrs. They were very nice but they need to be upfront with the cost instead of wasting your time. 

Other than that, our experience was great and we enjoyed this resort.

reviews.author: will v
reviews.title: So good we'd go back there.
reviews.text:
Our family break from June 28 - July 5 at Paradisus Palma Real was awesome. Here are a listing of our high points / pros, and digging deep I tried to list low points/cons as well.

Pro's:
1. We booked the trip with Sunwing Vacations. All of this went smoothly and as promised.
2. The resort is a short bus trip from the airport. Well organized representatives makes the transfer smooth
3. The room (we had 1BD GARDEN VIEW MASTER SUITE) was well equipped and spacious. It was also close enough to all the amenities and the beach and far enough to have some peace when needed.
4. The resort grounds are very well kept and in pristine condition. The on resort shopping was adequate and not unreasonably priced. A 5-10 minute up or down the beach also provides shopping at the local beach "malls".
5. All the staff is very friendly, helpful and accommodating.
6. The buffet restaurant (NAOS) is great. Some evenings we questioned why we booked at the a la carte restaurants. Speak of which - the restaurant selections were very good. We really enjoyed the Market Grill for lunch and snacks during the day.
7. The pool areas and bars are great. Good service from the bar staff who quickly knew our favorites. The alcohol served are name brands and never watered down.
8.The beach area is really big and spacious with lots of chairs and palm umbrellas. Lots of space for the kids to run and swim. We were fortunate enough to be able to access the club members section.
9. The water sports centre was well equipped and the staff very helpful. I arranged a sailing lesson on the catamaran and the guys got me going in less than 20 minutes. Reservations for the cat's need to be made in advance.
10. The entertainment in the evenings (especially the circus) was very good
11. There is a good selection of excursions.
12. The gym is well equipped and spacious enough for a nice work-out

Con's: and again we had to dig deep to list these.

1. Be aware that there are "Melia vacation club" sales personnel on duty, and they could approach you for the no obligation tour. We went through it, - informative, considered it for a while and made a call not to buy. No harm done.
2. The DVD player in the room required an AV cable to connect and it took some time to get the  maintenance team to remedy the matter. A few trips up and down sorted it out. We still had to swap cable between the TV feed and DVD as needed.
3. The kitchen in the 1BD room unit is not equipped with any plates, cutlery or appliances (not that you needed anything) so if you book this room with the intention to use the kitchen for more than just taking drinks out the stocked fridge - be prepared.
4. The water to fill the massive Jacuzzi tub takes long to fill and and at times were not super warm. A call to maintenance seemed to sort that out. 
5. We ate at GABI beach restaurant one evening (using our dinner voucher provided after listening to the the "vacation club" pitch). It was good, but I would not go out my way to reserve a table there and pay for a meal there based on the selection at the main resort.
5. If you are an advanced snorkeler - the resort snorkeling trip to the reef at 3pm each day may  not satisfy your needs. Its good for beginners. 

One suggestion to the resort is to have an orientation person assigned for new guests - just to go over where every thing is and what the program for the week is.

reviews.author: Edward M
reviews.title: Innolvidable estadia!!
reviews.text: Estuve de vacaciones el mes pasado y quede encantado, maravilloso hotel muy lindo exelente servicio del departamento de room service y su encargado walter Ibáñez en la recepcion carlos y en la recepcion principal nancy tivabizco q sus informaciones fueron de gran ayuda

reviews.author: LCBN
reviews.title: Bom mas pode e deve melhorar
reviews.text:
Ficamos 7 dias numa suíte maravilhosa ampla e espaçosa, a qualidade do atendimento deixa a desejar chegando a ser confuso nos restaurantes e bares. Tivemos constrangimentos diversos  para acesso aos restaurantes uma vez que as reservas nunca estavam confirmadas, embora realizadas pelo concierge.
Falta treinamento para os atendentes, a comida é muito boa, as frutas são sensacionais, o visual é impecável.
Praticamente inexiste atividade para as crianças maiores de seis anos, não havendo sequer monitoria para as mesmas, a qualidade do serviço está intimamente ligada a propina que você distribui.

reviews.author: Derrick F
reviews.title: REGULAR SERVICE VS. ROYAL SERVICE AND YOUR CHARACTER
reviews.text: I just got back from my vacation on September 1st. my brother and I spent a week here because we had a family event next-door at the Melia tropical. I am respectful royal client it RCI and the book this resort for me. I was very astonished when I entered the lobby and it provided me with a gorgeous oceanview. The architect and the structure of the layout was phenomenal and I was very impressed. Because of the language barrier, at the beginning there were some difficult transactions and it took them almost 2 hours to check me in. My first location was far away from the main lobby area with that beautiful view and structure. My location was surrounded by construction and a ridiculous distance from the main core of the resort. My first room needed to be upgraded... And I am not talking about to a royal service, I am referring to the condition of this particular room in such a lavish resort. This is where my character played an important part because I was not going to stay in this beautiful resort, with furnishings that were worn! I immediately contacted the front desk and a representative named Juan did extraordinary job at providing me that same room in  the core of the resort. Keep in mind that same room should've been offered to me from the start! My brother and I missed dinner and on Sunday the only restaurants available required reservations. Juan took care of that for us! What are the managers name Daniel offered me and my brother Royal Services in our new room without being in the Royal service area which he gave us that choice also. Those two services were like night and day. We had to pay an extra fee and it was not small at all! What prompt royal service was the simple fact that a Butler from royal service was so incredibly nice to us just passing. His name is Tony and I was extremely impressed with the way that he talked to me and his greeting even though we were and weren't really service, was extraordinary! So we requested that he be our Butler with our  upgraded  to Royal Services. Tony provided everything to us that we requested. He could fluently speak English and his comprehension of the hotel services and the entire town recommendations were impeccable. I read many reviews about this hotel and all the ratings that were amazing, excellent, and had that wow  factor work on point and 150% accurate. Tony made us feel like "FAMILY" he comprehended and was able to relate with us  totally, and we really appreciated him! This is a top-of-the-line and high-quality resort from foundation to exquisite foods so the service should always match! I can understand guess not having visitors overnight, but a true promotion can come from selective visitors with a day pass that should not cost $100. How can you possibly promote different forms of business. I had a relative who wanted to take a look into with the place, but I was told that I couldn't have any outside guest without paying $100. That was one thing we absolutely did not agree with or like at all. You have guards that check the bands constantly and they are everywhere... What's the big deal?  Moreover, my overall experiences were out of this world and after proactively being involved in settling the dust and moving some mountains, my vacation was beyond "absolutely amazing" the beauty of it is I will be returning and I will be telling everyone what an extraordinary place the Paradisus Palma Real is and to request royal service with Tony because he will make thousands of people tell others by the thousands and they will return just because of his service. I just won't recommend that you upgrade those buildings outside of the main core of the resort, and always give your first time  guest royal treatment even without Royal Service. If I was in the person of high standards, I would have left that resort with a bad experience and complaints! This review was straight from the heart and it had to be published. Life is about being happy, loving each other, and providing joy!

reviews.author: Letycia L
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones de mi vida.
reviews.text:
Me encantó el hotel y todas sus instalaciones, sus jardines maravillosos, gracias Ives, Liliam del Club Meliá, a las chicas del Kids Zone, el Spa lo máximo, mi hija encantadísima con todos los shows.
Me encantó la comida del Mole, Aqua, The Grill (la mejor carne que he probado), sobre todo a los cheff del Hydro Grill y Gabi Club que me prepararon una langosta deliciosa, gracias chicos.
Lo he recomendado a todos mis amigos, es una de las mejores experiencias que he tenido, felicidades.

reviews.author: Jorge P
reviews.title: Happy Family
reviews.text:
Just wanted to say our resort stay was awesome...  The resort is absolutely beautiful! Everything about the Paradisus Palma Real was excellent.  From the our suite, to the restaurants, to the beautiful beach surrounding it, we loved it all!

I can say we had the best bar tenders at Gabi beach Bar. Thank you Victor and Nelson for making my drink without me asking.  They must be friends of Jack (Daniels)!!!  They made my stay great.  One of the best restaurants at Paradisus is at Gabi beach.  Make sure you ask for a table with Santo, he is the best waiter at the hotel.  Thank you to Georges for being so attentive and accomodating us on the beach.  

At the main pool, I have to stay a special thanks to Ramon.  He took care of my kids while we were at the beach...  Always filling up their virgin pina coladas and giving them potato chips!!!

Alejandro and Mr. Madrid at the front desk were both awesome!!! Thank you again and VIP was the way to go!!!!

We will Definitely be back!

reviews.author: David R
reviews.title: Near Perfect!
reviews.text:
Facilities;Pool; Beach; Spa; Gym; Restaurants; Golf all 1st rate.
But what seperates this facility from others is the staff who made our family feel as if we were part of thier family right from the start.  Execptional in this regard were Pedro & Francisco Cabrera who were always there to insure every day was perfect.

reviews.author: Erika G
reviews.title: Amazing, but...
reviews.text: My sister chose this place for her destination wedding and I can't deny the fact that this place is absolutely amazing. The resort itself is breathtaking and very clean. From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, the service was outstanding. And even though this resort is to die for, there are a few things that must be addressed. Every room has a safe box. USE IT!!! I had a few cousins tell me they read the reviews prior to the trip and the one thing everybody suggested was to use the safe. I personally put my wallet, passport, phone, iPad, and anything of value in the safe. Housekeeping only took a pair of cheap forever 21 earrings I planned on wearing for my sisters wedding, but since they were only worth $10 I didn't care. My brother said he left out his phone and iPad and that wasn't taken from him, so I guess he got lucky. My sister on the other hand left her wallet out for a few hours and housekeeping happened to be cleaning her room during that time and $300 were taken from her. Other than that, the staff was very friendly and fun. The whole family had such an amazing time and we plan on definitely going back.

reviews.author: Claudia H
reviews.title: Paradisus Punta Cana, El Mejor!!!
reviews.text:
Es realmente mi Paraiso, es la quinta vez que con mi familia vamos y cada ano esta mejor!!! 
Sus jardines son Bellisimos, sus locaciones bien mantenidas,la comida es variada y deliciosa, las habitaciones son muy confortables y limpias, la playa es lindisima  pero lo Mejor de todo es su gente, amable,servicial, siempre alegres y listos para  ayudarte. especialmente Sandra  nuestra concierge en The Reserve, Jose Bengal, Celso Peralta en el Gabi, Las chicas  del Lobby de la Reserve,Las Marias: nuestras amas de llaves, Francisco Gonzalez, Juan en la piscina de abajo, Mickel el bartender de la playa, la gente de seguridad: Jose Luis, Bienvenido, Evaristo, Bersnardo. siempre amables,los jardineros complaciendonos con la aguita de coco. Muchas Gracias Paradisus!!!!!

reviews.author: Chaser45
reviews.title: Honeymoon in Paradise
reviews.text: Me and my wife stayed here in the beginning of August.  The place was amazing.  The room was fantastic.  The bed was comfortable.  At a lot of all inclusive resorts the food is just so-so.  Not here.  We tried every restaurant before we went to the same place twice.  It was hard to decide which place we wanted to go back to because every restaurant was delicious.  Room service was great.  They were always prompt with your order and if there was ever a delay on your food they would call your room to give you an update.  The beach was kept nice and clean.  The pool was great and the swim up bar was excellent.  The service here was spectacular.  A few people in particular were very helpful and always remembered what we were drinking.  At the swim up bar Ramon and Louis were excellent.  They were always quick with a drink recommendation.  They always remembered what you were drinking and occasionally would leave the bar to bring us a drink at our chairs without us having to go order.  Fabio at the club house was also very helpful.  When you eat at Bana be sure to go a little early and stop by the Toji bar.  Deyanira the bartender makes the best rum punch and manhattans in the whole resort.  All in all an excellent resort.  We can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Jocelyne A
reviews.title: Awesome vacation
reviews.text: We could not have dreamed of a better vacation. The beach, food, service and weather were incredible. We enjoyed meeting Gabriel Dalusma who helped us with every single need while at the beach. Restaurants and entertainment were very good. This is the second time we stay at a Melia in Punta Cana and look forward to a third time!!

reviews.author: Rudolf Woisetschlaeger
reviews.title: Traumstrand mit 3-klassen-gesellschaft
reviews.text:
Wunderschöne Hotelanlage, karibischer Traumstrand. In der Anlage gibt es eine 3-klassen-gesellschaft, was in einem 5-Sterne Hotel außergewöhnlich ist: normales Resortpublikum, The Reserve (wunderschöne Suiten, eigener Strandbereich), Melia Club Publikum. 
Die Hotelanlage und der Strand waren wunderschön. Namentlich erwähnen möchte ich Luis Amparo als besonders hilfreichen Angestellten, der jede Frage sofort beantwortet hat und auch immer sofort zur Hilfe stand. 
Sehr störend war das aggressive Werben des Club Melia und dass man insbesondere am Strand ständig Trinkgeld geben musste, um seine Wünsche erfüllt zu bekommen. Das Servicepersonal entspricht nicht einem gewohnten Standard ist aber sehr freundlich.

reviews.author: nluengo
reviews.title: Gran resort!!!
reviews.text:
Estuve con mi familia de vacaciones en el paradisus palma real y lo pasamos excelente! muy bonito el hotel, los restaurantes, la comida, la playa, y sus instalaciones en general son fabulosas. El personal muy atento y en su mayoria muy simpáticos. En especial a Gloria Rodriguez del bar, Altagracia Pio del pub cerca del lobby, Lucia Rodriguez de los masajes en la playa, Francisco Reynoso de actividades y Canaenia Garcia del buffet general, todos ellos grandisimas personas y muy preocupados que uno se sienta bien y lo pase bien en la estadía. 
El resort lo recomiendo de todas maneras, de verdad vale la pena conocerlo. Espero poder regresar pronto. Hasta la proxima!

reviews.author: GrisbellS
reviews.title: Wow!! Best Vacation ver
reviews.text:
I got back from my vacation about a week ago and my experience at this resort has brought me to write my first review EVER!. I stayed a total of 8 nights/9days, husband and two children 10and 5 years old. I have traveled to many places and this was in-fact my 4th trip to Punta Cana and first at Paradisus Palma Real  AND best trip ever.

Everything and everyone with the exception of management (Spaniard gentleman w/poor management skills) was amazing. I am a native of the Dominican Republic (Born in Nagua) but living overseas and going back to my native land is something I tried to do every so often. However, after visiting this resort, I have no doubt in my mind that I will be going back each summer.

What impressed me the most was the Kid's Club, in all my years vacationing, I had never felt comfortable leaving my children in any kid's club. It was so well organized, clean and dedication of the staff to keep the children engaged in activities as well as comfortable. On behalf of than and Noah, I will like to thank  Nicaurys, Cinthia and Alejandra (they are awesome), my children were very sad to leave.

There were also a few workers that made our stay and experience a marvelous one, they were: Gregorin Arias (got the chef to make me Mofongo), excellent gentleman and excellent attention to detail. Miguel Calcaño (Outside terrace by the bar), also a very polite gentleman and provided excellent service, a special thanks to his supervisor Ms. Patricia Burgos for doing such a fine job in training the staff. Mr. Luis, supervisor at the Japanese restaurant in Palma real, we also saw him in the NAOS restaurant....he's just awesome and I'm sorry I don't remember your last name but you are just a fine gentleman and I appreciate your Mangu recipe, also, thanks to Luis from the pool bar at Palma real and Alfredo from Naos. A very special thanks to these two gentlemen who made our stay an even better one and received us with a warm smile each morning at NAOS: Felipe Morla and Luis Severino Martes Bono :) ....You guys are just excellent gentlemen and the service you gave us and our children was amazing...I really hope to see you guys again when we go back.  One last gentleman I would like to thank is Luis Martinez from the Lobby bar, very gentle soul, great memory and exceptional service. 

I also had the experience of dining at Aqua (@the reserve) and although I did not like the food offered in this restaurant, the service provided was the most impressive. The workers were just more than willing to make our experience memorable and went above and beyond to please our palates, even if that meant making a dish that was not on the menu (tostones).

Gosh, I came in contact with so many great people that made my stay indescribable but unfortunately I don't remember their names. Anyhow, everyone in this resort is looking to make your stay the best you've ever had and that's exactly what happened to us. Our arrival day was a bit bumpy but these guys made every negative moment go away....I really just can't wait to go back. Oops, I almost forgot to give a special thanks to Nebo (concierge), you were ever so helpful and we appreciated your attention to detail and follow-through. If it had not been for you, we had never become members of Club Melia...THANK YOU!!!!

reviews.author: Denise H
reviews.title: Perfect Getaway
reviews.text:
We picked this resort by a simple Google search and was impressed by the reviews, pictures and everything the resort had to offer.  We opted for the royal service as a treat to ourselves and it was worth every penny plus some!  Check in was wonderful, especially the green-apple scented cold towels.  It was such a convenience to be taken on a tour of the resort by our Butler Tony, and he was able to answer all the questions we had.  We stayed 5 nights and the service from all the staff was exceptional.  Tony made sure all our dinners were reserved and set up a romantic Jacuzzi bath for us the first night we were there (complete with wine and flowers).  Tony checked on us each day and easily set up an excursion for us to parasail within minutes of us asking.  I cannot forget to mention the service by the pool and beach, particularly Francisco and Billy.  Talk about service with a smile, and never made us feel like we were imposing.  Both of them set up bali beds for us on the beach and brought drinks when we needed them...and if we needed a picture taken they were ready to do it! All staff that we came in contact with were friendly and accommodating with everything.  We especially enjoyed our dinner at Passion.  This was an extra charge ($100 per couple) and it was worth it.  The food was amazing and plentiful and the staff did a great job with the presentation.  One of the best meals I have ever had.  There are activities at the resort to participate in, we chose to relax and keep it simple.  Each night there was live entertainment of some sort and the environment was relaxed.  Our room was comfortable and beautiful...and might I mention the scented toilet paper.  All those little touches make it so good! We also enjoyed massages at Yhi Spa.  The hydrotherapy pools were quite an experience and the staff guided us through the techniques...I highly recommend it.

Bottom line, this resort is an experience and I plan to go back...many times.  And I hope in those future visits I get to see some of the wonderful staff again, because they made that trip exceptional.  When we arrived, we were told "Welcome to Paradise".  I am now convinced that it is paradise:) 

Thank you Paradisus Palma Real!

reviews.author: joanazeredo
reviews.title: Bom mas com ressalvas...
reviews.text: Ficamos por 6 noites neste hotel que é extremamente limpo e lindo. Funcionários muito simpáticos e disponíveis! Serviço de quarto e comida muito bons! Pontos negativos (mesmo ficando no Royal Service): não existe serviço de praia/piscina. Os garçons aparecem esporadicamente... A cerveja é ruim e quente, e os drinks fracos, com exceção do tique tique. Todos servidos em copo de papel!  Não há nada para comer nas piscinas e praia, apenas batata e banana chips!!! Enfim, para um hotel luxuoso como este, coisas importantes precisam melhorar!

reviews.author: Rafaet R
reviews.title: Muito bom!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Fui para Punta Cana do dia 19 a 26 de agosto em lua de mel e fiquei hospedado no Royal Service!
Nao há nada do que reclamar!!! foi tudo simplesmente perfeito...
Todos os restaurantes, com excessao do Vento, sao muito bons e com atendimento maravilhoso... vale lembrar que o melhor de todos é o Palazzo com seu chefe Carlos e seus camaroes duo!!!

Nosso mordomo tambem foi muito prestativo...... se forem, escolham o Jose Martinez pois alem de ser simpatico, é muito prestativo!!!!!
