Nao podemos esquecer o sempre simpatico Ramon que nos serviu todos os dia na praia e também o Nelson, que faz as melhores batidas no bar do royal service!!!!

O hotel é muito bom e recomendo!!!!!!

reviews.author: Anazen
reviews.title: Como su nombre indica,el Paraiso
reviews.text:
Volvemos hoy de nuestras vacaciones en Punta Cana y no podemos hablar mejor de este hotel y de la amabilidad y el encanto de la gente que alli trabaja, sin duda se merecen un 10.

Fuimos a pasar unos dias de relax y realmente nos volvemos nuevos.

Besos a todos,Ramon del bar de la piscina,Maria de Illy que ricos cafes nos preparo y a las terapeutas del Yhi Spa, son todos maravillos@s.

reviews.author: Cindy C
reviews.title: Experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text: Primera vez q vengo a punta cana y la experiencia q me he llevado a sido excelente desde q llegas a paradisus tienes un trato impecable por todos sus empleados desde la persona q cargo nuestras maletas hasta los chicos de los bares fueron muy atentos, la comida exquisitas y una atención genial si tienen all access a todo el complejo no dejen de visitar el Aqua cuya comida y servicio en el bar es muy buenooo! No dejen de tomar martini del sol, no se arrepentirán fuimos atendidos por David Mendoza quien se encargo de hacernos pasar una noche muy amena! 100% recomendados!

reviews.author: rromero5
reviews.title: Todo perfecto excepto determinadas cosas....
reviews.text:
En mi opinión un hotel de esta categoría no se puede permitir tener todos los restaurantes cerrados para comer en temporada baja, ni aun con poca ocupación. Todos pagan lo mismo, incluso en temporada ba, comer del mismo bufet una semana, vamos....ESTO ES PARADISUS??? 
Otra cosa que no se puede permitir son los incidentes del fin de semana 22-24 sept 2012, con la convención de una petrolera (eso es intolerable y no se tenía que haber permitido) INTOLERABLE. No es un hotel para estos eventos y gente. 
Igualmente en el tema de comidas y bebidas, mas calidad y mas variedad, tanto en comidas como en bebidas. Sabemos que la cerveza Presidente esta buena, pero solo esa??? Estamos, repito en un hotel muy caro y debería haber otras marca y mas calidad....

reviews.author: Julia T
reviews.title: absolute luxury but...
reviews.text: i can give a reliable opinion about the hotel as i've been to many different six and five star resorts/hotels not only in the carribean but all around the world. The hotel is designed by an amazing architect Alvaro Sans Canada who did an incredible job, giving guests a feeling of elegance and privacy. There's a variety of evening restaurants with nice design and good service although the breakfast buffet offers a four star service, there's a very limited choice of food at the buffet and most of the time everything is finished including plates and spoons, Service doesnt give you any attention and we wouldnt survive if not a fantastic proffesional waiter, LUIS SEVERINO, observing him we realised that he loved his job giving everything to his maximum, to everybody. Our wonderful time fullfilled our lunches at Gabi Beach where listening to lounge music and drinking rose wine made us feel like in luxury and a six star hotel. thanks to educated ,well behaved waiters such as JUAN CARLOS and RAFAEL DE LA CRUZ and FELIX DE LA CRUZ who also made our stay very pleasant during the day. The two negatives of this hotel which have to change immediately are the extremely long check-in done in a very unproffesional way even though we had a VIP check-in, the staff kept us waiting all of the time, and the second negative is that there are many young female employees in white uniforms like from the beauty salon walking around the hotel area especially around the swimming pool, are they selling something ? if yes, this is done in a very not proffesional way. They behave in an ignoring and disturbing manner towards all the guests we had a feeling they were superior to us, someone told us they were from the Melia Club they should maybe walk on the cat walk since they behave like this. GIRLS SMILE MORE!!. Despite of these negatives we are coming back in Christmas because its a very good hotel in Dominican Republic and not to see the negatives  we'll put our black shades on.

reviews.author: Caitlin S
reviews.title: Perfect Honeymoon!
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Paradisus Palma Real for our honeymoon and loved it. The service was very good. There were a variety of different places to eat and a butler made all of our dinner reservations for us! We enjoyed our time by the main pool and liked the different bars everywhere. The spa was amazing and their facilities were very nice. We would recommend it if you are looking for a nice place to relax. I don't think that we personally would return, just because we are active and like a little more activity. Very nice resort!

reviews.author: Pilar T
reviews.title: maravilloso
reviews.text: hola, la verdad que este hotel(paradisus palma real babaro ) es la mejor opción si quieres pasarla bien en familia, aunque recomiendo días de semana si quieres tranquilidad  o si buscas diversión el fin de semana, estuve a mitad de semana y fin de semana por lo que puedo notar la diferencia, la comida buenísima y variada los muchachos de los vares todos muy atentos y siempre alegre, la habitación excelente, bueno todo en gral estuvo perfecto, lo único que deberían corregir es un fuerte olor no se a que pero que era desagradable y justo frente a la habitación # 3033 por ciertas hrs de la tarde y noche no se podía pasar, por lo demás felicidades estupendo hotel.

reviews.author: capavamo v
reviews.title: poolside
reviews.text:
I was very pleased with the service at this hotel.  Everyone would greet you with a smile and were always ready to help and make you feel at home.

Special thanks to Ramon Fuego, the bartender at the Main Pool at Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa.... Best service ever, full of entertainment and always with a smile!

Gracias Ramon por tus atenciones y por mi vinito blanco que me traías siempre sin falta!
C.

reviews.author: capavamo v
reviews.title: paradise and amazing service
reviews.text: My cousin had his wedding at the Paradisus Palma Real and it was the best experience ever.  My husband and I felt as if we were on a second honeymoon! The property was big enough for us to have some time alone away from the other guest.  The main pool was the meeting point for the wedding party during early afternoons until dinner.  Ramon, the bar tender, made it exceptionally fun and entertaining for us to be there...  he was very attentive  and made sure our cups were always full!!  Overall the service was on point, the place was well kept and the view just breath taking.  It was like Paradise!

reviews.author: Fuentesjl
reviews.title: ES UN HOTEL PARA EL RELAX TOTAL
reviews.text: Es simplemente excelente, la comida, las instalaciones, las habitaciones, buena disco, buena diversión, buena playa y deportes acuaticos, la atencion y las bebidas pudieran mejorar, pero de verdad es un hotel excelente para el descanso...

reviews.author: jorge paez
reviews.title: ramon fuego y iris
reviews.text: Este es un Excelente hotel para pasar vacaciones en familia o simplemente relajarte, la atención del personal en general es magnifica, la amabilidad y el trato que te ofrecen te hacen sentir como reyes. En el área de la piscina encontramos al Sr. Ramón Fuego con un excelente carisma, lleno de humor pero sobre todo de simpatía, presta una atención especial y con su "Fuego Fuego" te hace pasar un rato ameno. Se los recomiendo.y en especial en el restaurant gabi de la reserve a la garzona iris es un 7 como persona y lo inico malo es que no tenien tanto trago ya que me quede en el royal service y un 7 al mayordomo marcelo

reviews.author: Lmiss
reviews.title: Couples paradise
reviews.text:
I can describe the Paradisus Palma Real as a wonderful place to stay for a romantic getaway, beautiful sandy beach, excellent food, huge pool. The place to be for a honeymoon or even family with small kids. There is also one of the most famous malls connected to the resort, walking distance, where you can find the hard rock cafe punta cana and several international and national shop.
I loved the illy cafe place by the pool where you can enjoy a lovely expresso or a frosen illy creme !!

Would visit again!!

reviews.author: PitalugaCosta
reviews.title: GABI BEACH
reviews.text: Pela segunda vez me surpreende o Paradisus Palma Real. Desde a recepção até a saída uma palavra pode descrever tudo: perfeito. Os restaurantes são ótimos, todos! O restaurante Gabi Beach do Paradisus Palma Real é especial. Nele, os atendentes superam a palavra atendimento. Ótima comida, bebida, sobremesa, tudo muito bem preparado, apresentado e servido. O atendimento na piscina dos membros do Club Meliá também se supera. Abraços para Joel, Maikel, e toda a equipe Gabi Beach e ao Freddy, Francisco e Medina do Bar Sunrise.

reviews.author: Maria Elena E
reviews.title: Decayendo
reviews.text:
Vengo llegando de una estadia de 1 semana con toda mi familia en el Paradisus,si bién todo estuvo muy bueno debo reconocer que la calidad del servicio y de las comidas han ido decayendo con los años,me alojo en este hotel desde el año 2004 y con mucha pena debo decir que cada año veo que la calidad del servicio empeora,hasta su gente que era tan alegre y amable esta vez los encontré más apagados,menos atentos,las piñas coladas de aquellos años nada tienen que ver con el juguito de piña que te sirven ahora,restaurantes cerrados,varias reposeras en mal estado,toallas de playa deshilachadas,poca variedad en las comidas,en la ducha el agua sale caliente,el baño sin aire acondicionado,las toallas de cara pequeñas (que antes ponian 3) hay ahora que pedirlas y te ponen solo 1,ya no más apetizer de playa en Royal Service,cero aire acondicionado en los restaurantes,lo que hace a veces insufrible comer ahí...en fin para mi próximo viaje a Punta Cana escogeré con toda seguridad otro hotel...porque este dejó de ser un hotel de lujo y de las 5 estrellas ya va en 4.
Lo que no cambia es la alegría y atención de Pedro en Royal Service de la playa..solo por él volveríamos, un encanto de persona que a lo largo de todos estos años sigue igual.
Si no haces reserva antes de las 5 de la tarde para cenar en algún restaurant tienes que ir al Gaby de la Reserva donde es imposible soportar el calor y la humedad de ese lugar con ventiladores en el techo que de NADA sirven ante la humedad del lugar...y si llegas después de las 20 hrs la comida escasea y la variedad es mínima...una mala experiencia La Reserva.
Bueno espero que el Gerente del Paradisus lea este comentario y se ponga las pilas para retomar lo que un día FUÉ ese maravilloso hotel y recupere todo lo que se ha perdido con los años.

reviews.author: George C
reviews.title: Only takes one to spoil a vacation
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at this resort September 5-11 based on recommendations from our friends. Our overall stay was superb - Excellent facilities, bar service and food variety. Beach safe and secure - Pool huge and fun.  It's a perfect place with just the right balance of fun and privacy.  The local excursions are in abundance and you can book everything from the resort.  There is a shuttle to a shopping mall that is close by – not the biggest mall, but there are enough stores to get gifts and even has a Hard Rock Café.  We would say we will return, but with so many other places to choose from, it is unlikely.

The reason we doubt our return is we were shocked that despite the overall friendly and courteous staff, there was one particular staff member that put a damper on our stay.   At first we thought nothing of it, but this employee called "Juan" in the restaurants who was dark skinned with glasses, reeked of liquor and had the worse attitude we have experienced in a while.  I don't know if he was going through personal problems, but the whole idea of getting away is to relax and stay at a positive place. It is surprising that this resort would employ such a person - drinking a cocktail is ok – but not to the point that you smell of it – especially if you are a matradee of sorts and there to set an example to other employees.

Paradisus Management should do a better job of screening employees - especially those who greet and interact with guests.  It is sad how it only takes one bad apple to ruin an otherwise excellent stay.

reviews.author: Baronalfbau
reviews.title: Baronalfbau
reviews.text:
Have been to many fine beach resorts - the Paradisus Palma Real exceeds all competition. I opted for the Royal Services upgrade and it was well worth it. The facility is beautiful and very well maintained. But truly it is the key staff members that make the experience exceptional like Manuel my butler anticipate my every need and delivered extras every night a dinner reservation was made for me at my desired hour, my Cabana was arranged by the Royal pool, when my day was complete I would come back to my room and find a hot foam bath waiting, a fresh snack, a fresh bottle of wine, and incense lit. Anything I needed was only a quick mobile phone call away - never a problem always accommodating. Manuel guided my stay with charm and same professionalism from arrival to my departure. 
Then there is Yomalyn the treasure of the of the Royal Services private lounge. Yomalyn checked me in, explained all elements of my stay, amenities available, organized complimentary drinks (my favorites) whenever I dropped by to relax for a bit and take advantage of the free wifi access. She is so warm and personable nothing was ever a bother or inconvenience. She is the charming person that represents the premier Royal Services experience. 
Take advantage of the Palazzo Restaurant (exclusive to Royal Package customers) - the food is fresh and very well prepared by the chef....but the staff are so friendly and attentive....especially Señor Ortiz. Richard was so friendly and checked in frequently to make sure I had everything I needed. The Vento Mediterranean restaurant was also very good....but the treasure there was the young lady that greets you as you enter....once met never forgotten as she not only greets and seats you but checks in regularly to make sure your comfortable and assures all your dining needs have been met or exceeded. 
Feel kinda bad for those guests that say they had a less then perfect experience....but all I can share is my own experience and all I can say is this place is a little piece of paradise on earth. My stay was perfect in every way. And large part of this was related to the wonderful staff members I mentioned.

reviews.author: TOMAS
reviews.title: Exelente para descansar
reviews.text:
he estado dos veces en este hotel y no tengo quejas, como soy miembro del MVC nos quedamos en unos edificios cercanos a la playa, las habitaciones son exelentes, la playa hermosa, el servicio de primera, las atenciones del personal inigualable, la comida muy buena, cuenta con varios restaurantes especializados muy buenos.
Este hotel es ideal para pasar un buen momento con la familia, a la vez descansar o para realizar una boda en la playa, realmente es bueno para lo que usted necesite.

reviews.author: YanyaBl
reviews.title: El mejor servicio que me han brindado!
reviews.text: Este hotel es sumamente agradable y comodo. El personal es fantastico y la comida es buenísima, tanto lo salado como lo dulce. Son rápidos en el servicio y están constantemente pendiente a tus necesidades. Totalmente recomendado!.

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: After 6 visits, this resort continually goes downhill
reviews.text:
Save yourself money, exasperation and disappointment by avoiding this resort. When we first came here six years ago, it was a delight. The turnover of staff and their substandard training and focus will leave you wondering why you chose this resort for your vacation. 

Any all,inclusive hotel that charges luxury hotel rates should be prepared to deliver quality service which this resort does not. As an English speaking customer, I am offended when the waiter keeps interrupting me while I´m trying to order (yes, yes, yes.....) and the brings me exactly what I did not want, or trying to relax by the pool or ocean while someone is constantly trying to sell you something.

The food is substandard, the service extremely poor and the atmosphere one of high pressure sales tactics. I will never return.

reviews.author: Sue729
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: My husband and I just arrived home from a 4 night stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. We booked this hotel based on travelers reviews and the recommedation of a close friend and proceeded to upgrade to the Royal Service. From the moment we upgraded we were hounded non-stop to sit through the time-share sales pitch. We tried telling them to let us think about it but it became relentless...a sales person was waiting at the entrance to our building and at the entrances to the restaurants...wherever we went he was there. For a 5 day vacation I feel we lost so much time and had so much pressure we were unable to enjoy our trip until we finally sat down with the salesman. On our second day, our air conditioner stopped working, we called several times and each time they would send a maid or some other staff member to look at it and then tell us 10 minutes. Our room temperature never went below 78 degrees and all of my clothes took on a weird musty smell. On our second to last night they finally offered to switch our room and cover the $100 charge for the dinner on the beach. We said yes to the dinner but declined switching rooms at this point as it was 8:30pm and we hadn't even eaten yet. They still tried to assure us that someone was in the room at that minute working on the air. The next day we decided to to an excursion and were assured that it was only 4 hours and we would be back from our 1:30 departure in plenty of time for our 8:00 dinner on the beach. The bus ride alone to the buggies was over and hour and on the way back the driver forgot to drop people off at their hotel so needless to say, we didn't arrive back at the Paradisus until 8pm! We went to the buffet and never had dinner on the beach. Still trying to make the best of our trip, upon checkout we asked to have our $100 dinner credit applied to our spa visit. We were given the Royal Service managers card and I've called several times with no reply. At this point I'm sure I won't hear back. The hotel itself it absolutely beautiful, for the most part the staff was great, and Julio our personal butler was the best. Anyone on vacation would be lucky to have him as there concierge. The management staff is where my problem lies. There is truly no respect for the guest from them and no desire to make their wrongs right. Through only the fault of the people you rely on to make  your stay the best, we were incredibly disappointed. No wonder they keep them in offices away from the vacationers!

reviews.author: Rene H
reviews.title: Una experiencia inigualable
reviews.text: Si duda recomiendo este hotel. Es una experiencia increible. Hemos pasado una semana en el y hemos regresado con gana de volver a visitarlos. El servicio y amabilidad del personal lo hace sentir mimado de principio a fin. Las instalaciones tienen mucha categoría. Las habitaciones son comodas, limpias, lo que lo hace sentir como en casa. Los restaurante son increible. Le recomiendo Vento, Misu y Market Grill. No quiero dejar pasar la ocasión para agradecer la atención de Alejandro Maltre quien nos soluciono un inconveniente ocasionado por nuestro agente de reservas, a Penelope Santana y Domingo Beltre quien nos atendieron de una manera muy especial en el Guest Service, a Bruny Brunswick del Club Vacacional quien estuvo pendiente de nosotros en todo momento y velo por que tuviéramos una experiencia inolvidable y a Julio Moreno del Club Melia quien nos hizo sentir muy a gusto.

reviews.author: Boilermac
reviews.title: We enjoyed a relaxing celebratory vacation in paradise with friends.
reviews.text: This vacation was our first trip to D.R. We planned a group trip with six other couples in celebration of my wife's 40th.  We opted for the Royal Service upgrade and were all pleased with the choice. I highly recommend requesting Ramone as a butler - he provided our group excellent service throughout the week, including dinner reservations for our large group, rose petal baths with champagne on ice and handling on the logistics for our excursions. The crew at the sunset bar never let us go thirsty and kept the royal service pool and beach area in great order. The beaches were unreal - true white sand, groomed each morning.  Plenty of shade or sun available pool side or on the beach. The food was much better than we expected - definitely an upgrade from cruise food. This resort is amazing and we look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.author: Lenie S
reviews.title: First All Inclusive Resort Vacation
reviews.text: This was our first all inclusive resort trip and our first visit to DR.  The service is excellent and the entire staff is very friendly.  Angel from activities made our time at the resort so enjoyable and we created such beautiful lasting memories all because of his friendly and fun personality.  Bolivar our resort concierge was extremely helpful and made everything so easy and pleasant for us.  Bolivar made a special effort to meet us in the lobby on our last day to give us goodbye hugs, that was such a personable gesture.  We would definitely recommend this resort and visit again in the future.  Thank you to everyone!!!

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.title: Tout simplement incroyable !
reviews.text: Tout d'abord le check-in s'est fait très rapidement et nous avons eu un excellent service de Apolinar ainsi que Emmanuel . Les restaurants à la carte sont très bons et ne manquer pas d'aller au restaurant Passion étoilé 7 étoiles Michelin seulement pour 40 $ par personnes, pour la qualité cela vaut vraiment la peine. Je voudrais remercier David Perrez, Onir et Deyanira Isla au bar du lobby pour leur service tout au long de la semaine. Je retournerai les yeux fermés à cet hôtel et je le recommande à qui que ce soit !!! Belle plage, bon drinks, bonne bouffe !

reviews.author: Sandra R
reviews.title: FAB-U-LOUS
reviews.text:
This all inclusive resort was like paradise.  My husband and I were on our honeymoon and we were delighted to be at this 5 star resort and spa.  Not only did it meet our expectations, it exceeded them.  The staff and employees of the resort were outstanding, very friendly and personable.  It was always, their pleasure, to serve.  Beautiful people.  Everything you need is at this resort, the food was outstanding, as well as the service.  We had our very own concierge, Bolivar Guzman, who served us well.  He took care of all of out dinner reservations, tour of the facility, and was there to help when needed.  The entertainment at the resort was outstanding.  Maria Cecilia was the main choregrapher and every evening she and her support staff uplifted us in song and dance.  We enjoyed all of shows, somewhat like Las Vegas and would recommend all visitors to attend.  

Overall our experience was outstanding and I would recommend this resort to anyone travelling to Puna Cana.

reviews.author: manny e
reviews.title: Very dissapointed! Not the Same!  Please be carefull!
reviews.text:
We are a repeated client. 1st time i was there was in Septemper of 2010 and we had a great experience with Paradisus. After that we visited several more hotels witch where not at the same level as paradisus but adversited as a 5 star hotel ( fine we learned our lesson - you pay what you get ) I didn't want to take a chance on not having a GREAT experience again so i decided to go back to paradisus since we were very happy from our last visit. 

1st of all we did our reservations Direct with them with : Loremy Sanchez / Reservation Agent Groups & Local Market  Tel: +809.221.1111 Ext: 8433 | Fax: +809.552.0572
Mail: loremys@solmelia-caribe.com Paradisus Agent. I specificlly informed them this is our anyversary visit. Boy they disregarded that! they tried to make it right on check IN by giving us another room wich is bigger. ( they did but they put us in a room that you have to walk like a MILE to get to the bar - Beach or pool area --> that my freind SUCKS ) 

2nd- They advertise International Drinks ( johnny walker - Vodka Absolute & more ) Boy we where wrong - NO BARS had, when we requested why? they had to go to manager to obtain a bottle witch was already open. WTF? Even one of the bar personal told us this is the Slow time of the season so managers are cutting up Expenses ---- what the %^# do we care! we payd over $1150.00 for a 3 day stay. No champaign becouse they run out. Cheap drinks witch will leave you with a HANGOVER! guaranteed! 

3rd- They never have reservations for the restaurants they have available. the buffett is great as long as it inside the hotel in PARADISUS PALMA REAL. I say inside that resort since they have another sister hotel located next to them and they send us there instead due to they closed down their original buffett since there wasnt that many members! we went to have dinner there WOW that SUCKS! maybe 3 variaty of dishes and its just Sad to see how they have lacked in the preffesion.

This is one of the best hotels or was in my opinion, and they lost a customer that goes at least 1 a year. Very poor treatment when it comes on what they adversite. 

Staff is very freindly and allways available to help out. But the management sucks! I will not recommend this hotel even if they give me a free stay.

reviews.author: 123An0nim0
reviews.title: RELAX Y BUEN SERVICIO.
reviews.text: Hemos estado en el Hotel durante 15 días. Tiene buenas instalaciones, buena comunicación de transporte, buena gastronomía. Diferentes servicios según la necesidad del cliente. El personal es excelente; siempre tienen una palabra amable y una sonrisa. A destacar el Guest Service, con el inmejorable trato de Vladimir Rodríguez y Edgar González. También la simpatía de José y Eliezer, de actividades. la amabilidad y acrobacias de Ramón Fuego, del bar de la pisicna. Mención especial a José Méndez Sánchez, de Hotelbeds, el cual nos aconsejó y recomendó las mejores excursiones con un resultado excelente. El buen trato de Juan Jiménez, del Lobby Bar. Y todo el personal de Marinarium: Guadalupe, Ezequiel, Kardyn, Juan, Diger, Rey, David, Junio, Dalifer, etc. Muy recomendable la visita a Dolphin Explorer, con el programa Excellence. Inolvidable. Gracias por todo. Hasta siempre. (Sres. Roqueta).

reviews.author: bbfarm2012
reviews.title: No es un hotel gran lujo
reviews.text:
Acabamos de pasar siete dias en este hotel y hay cosas que no entiendo ocurran en un hotel calificado como "gran lujo" :
Toallas de la piscina con agujeros,hamacas de la playa manchadas de batido y no limpiadas,botellas de agua o vasos sin recoger en la piscina.
Limpieza de las habitaciones deficiente(protector salva slip de otra persona en cajón de mi mesilla,pie del wc lleno de pelos dia tras día,tapiceria de las sillas y sofá lleno de manchas).
No se recogian las bandejas del servicio de habitaciones puestas en el suelo de los pasillos hasta el día siguiente.
La atención del personal de los restaurantes deja mucho que desear por cosas como:pedir más de tres veces agua y que no te rellenen el vaso,no te ofrecian bebida siempre que te sentabas a comer,no recogian los platos que utilizabas a lo largo de la comida y los tenías que poner en la mesa de al lado a modo de torre(los veían y pasaban totalmente de recogerlos)
Los sillones azules del restaurante de la playa estan manchados de caca de pajaros en vez de limpiarlos les dan la vuelta.
Cenamos sólo en dos restaurantes a la carta y en ninguno pude tomar postre porque se habia acabado la opción que no tenía chocolate y nadie ofreció nada.
Pasividad total y absoluta del personal.
En la piscina nadie te ofrecia nada tenias que moverte tu a todos sitios buffet, bar...si querias una bebida o algo de comer.
Por todos estos detalles no es un hotel de gran lujo y la relación calidad-precio no es acorde.
Están más preocupados de venderte upgrade de habitación, royal service,resort credits...que de atender en condiciones al huesped.
He de decir que el personal de recepción es correcto así como los camareros del bar de la piscina.

reviews.author: Se M
reviews.title: Gracias República Dominicana
reviews.text: Fuimos de Convención un grupo de mas de cien personas, lo que más me gusto fue el grupo de animación liderado por María Cecilia y José, muy atentos en todo momento animandonos a disfrutar de todas las instalaciones disponibles y poniendonos en ambiente caribeño, como todos los hoteles;  pequeños detalles negativos al momento de solicitar bebidas a los meseros en el restaurante naos, buenas instalaciones, muy romántico por aquello de la luz tenue en todas partes, gente muy cálida y amable. El único detalle es que deberían alentar a los huespedes para poder comprar artesanía a las orillas de la playa donde evidentemente encuentras precios mucho más accesibles y con personas que de verdad necesitan las ventas para sobrevivir.

reviews.author: Angie P
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: My family and I really enjoyed this resort.  We had a great time and we especially enjoyed the pool thanks to Emilio who always served us our drinks and food with a smile and great enthusiasm.  He made us laugh and feel so important!!  He deserves a raise!!! We also liked the fact that we had so many restaurants to chose from and they were all pretty good.  Our room was spectacular and very clean.  The only thing we didn't like was the refrigerator in our room.  Our drinks were warm, never cold and I complained so they did gladly bring a new one, but that also was just as bad -  I'm not sure why.  I have to say the air conditioner was working really great so that was a big plus for my family!  We were never hot, actually I felt a little cold during the night but I prefer cold over feeling uncomfortable and hot.   This was one of the best vacations we ever had!  Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Demetrius H
reviews.title: A Great Place to Stay and Visit.
reviews.text:
This was my first trip out of the states, I was going the Paradisus Resort for my baby sisters wedding, which was this past Sat. Everyone in my family as well as our friends enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Resort. We have all said that we are planning on making a return trip back there and are inviting more friends and family to come back with us. Although everyone there at the resort was very friendly, polite and went out their way to make us feel welcomed. There was one representative who was such a big help to me, that I could have a good time and enjoy my vacation and not have to worry about my sisters wedding. Mr. Mario Samundy went beyond the call of duty, upon arriving in the DR, my tux for the wedding was fine but the rental company sent me the wrong shoes, it was basically a kids shoe. Mr. Samundy and myself went back and forth with the rental company and finally we worked it out and Mr. Samundy made sure I had the proper shoes for my sister weddig and I didn't have to stress about it at all. So Kudos Mr. Samundy and the great staff at the Paradisus Resort.

Sincerly 
Demetrius Hutchinson

reviews.author: Edu T
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Ótima recepção funcionários muito atenciosos, quartos magníficos, arquitetura muito bonita com excelente piscinas, restaurantes padrão internacional, com comida muito boa. O grill da piscina tem um hamburguer  delicioso. Relamente tivemos uma estadia maravilhosa no Palma Real. Com certeza está entre os tops de Punta Cana.

reviews.author: RicardoCG
reviews.title: UN EXCELENTE DESCANSO MUY BIEN ATENDIDOS
reviews.text: Estuvimos en un viaje de 5 días en el Hotel con el servicio Royal, obtuvimos un excelente servicio. Las áreas que más nos gustaron:  RESTAURANTE GABI BEACH, RESTAURANTE VENTO, particularmente nos gustó mucho la Disco... RED LOUNGE.  Debemos resaltar mucho el servicio prestado por la señora YEISY FELIX - HOSTESS quien nos atendió en diferentes restaurantes principalmente en el Gabi.  Adicionalmente el servicio de Mayordomía es muy bueno y queremos igualmente resaltar el servicio prestado por el Sr. AGUSTIN NUÑEZ, quien estuvo permanentemente pendiente de nuestro bienestar y nos prestó un excelente servicio.

reviews.author: Dani
reviews.title: Can't wait to return
reviews.text: The resort is absolutely beautiful!  The pictures don't show how the true beauty of the resort.  Each attendant was extremely helpful.  We were upgraded to VIP which I highly suggest you do if given the option.  It gives you the option to eat at a few more restaurants and bars.  I only have 2 issues with my stay:  Upon arrival we noticed that there were opened bottles in our refrigerator.  2nd issue is the rooms don't get cool enough.  Even with those issues, I will return!! The food at Gabi Beach was better than the other restaurants, my second favorite was Mizu.

reviews.author: Patacost
reviews.title: El servicio varia mucho
reviews.text:
Debieran garantizar atención standard. Había personal muy atento, otros no, las bebidas saben diferente, las habitación las acomodan a veces bien a veces mal así como la atención en el spa y en las instalaciones en las que varias veces se acababan bebidas o servicio de mesoneros y se nos indicaba que por tener baja ocupación no se disponían.

En momentos muy satisfecha, en otros no tanto

reviews.author: Mariela S
reviews.title: EL KIDS ZONE
reviews.text: El hotel me pareció excelente. Tiene buenas instalaciones y su personal es super agradable, siempre atentos a cualquier petición del huésped. Las habitaciones son muy cómodas y siempre pulcras. Me fascinó el KIDS ZONE que es un área para niños donde pueden quedarse desde la mañana hasta la noche y realizan actividades creativas así como disfrutan de la piscina, juegos y mucho mas. A mi hija de 5 años le encantó, aprendió a reciclar, hizo pizza, pintó una franela, jugó en la piscina, en la pared de escalar y mas. Es una opción que ayuda mucho a los padres que viajan solos con sus hijos, como en mi caso, ya que podemos disfrutar de un verdadero descanso mientras nuestros hijos están disfrutando y divirtiéndose en sus vacaciones. Su personal es muy atento y cariñoso con los niños. Agradezco de forma especial a MARTINA que estuvo compartiendo mucho con mi hija y me cuenta que es muy cariñosa y se que la atendió de maravilla, Para mi hija fueron 5 días estupendos y me dice que quiere regresar en sus próximas vacaciones para volver a compartir con ella y realizar más actividades en el KIDS ZONE. Los felicito por ese equipo tan maravilloso. Muchas gracias !!!

reviews.author: Amanda M
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: Estivemos durante 8 dias no resort e nos surpreedemos com tudo, do atendimento na recepcao, a atencao que tivemos no Royal Service, que ressalto, vale muito a pena. Mesmo com o preco significativamente maior, o ROyal Service faz toda a diferenca, principalmente pelas opcoes exclusivas de restaurantes e pela area privativa na piscina. Alem disso, o fato de termos um mordomo a nossa disposicao nos tira qualquer preocupacao com reservas de restaurantes e qualquer outra questao que tenhamos que resolver. Quem nos acompanhou foi o Ramon Avila e o Alberto, que fizeram um excelente trabalho. Tivemos tambem otimos momentos no restaurante Palazzo, sendo atendidos pelo Richard Ortiz, e no restaurante Gabi Beach, pelo Jacobo. Um servico a parte, mas que foi sensacional foi o jantar romantico que compramos, preparado na beira da praia. Fomos servidos pelo Rai e escolhemos como opcao de prato principal uma lagosta caribena que, com certeza, nunca mais esqueceremos. O ponto negativo e a rede wireless do hotel, que cai a cada 5 minutos ou menos, o que torna muito cansativo fazer qualquer coisa que  necessite da rede. A Enfim, recomendo o resort, pois todos os esforcos dos funcionarios sao para que nao sejamos frustrados em nenhum momento da estadia. Ah, e caso desejem fazer algum passeio, recomendo a HotelBeds, que atende muito bem os clientes, em especial o Jose, que fica no guiche da empresa no hall do hotel.

reviews.author: LY2MP
reviews.title: Best Service, Amazing View
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in July. Upgraded to Royal Services, had wonderful service but my ultimate favorite was the service I received at The Palazzo. Everyone was friendly but the best service received was from Richard Ortiz. He always had a pleasant demeanor, a smile on his face and was attentive to our every need, even before we realized we needed something. Richard always remembered our favorite food & drinks. When I go back, I will be requesting him personally and hope to bring him home with me, I love Richard Ortiz!

reviews.author: Tryan14
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text:
Beach is beatiful, but do not wonder to far from resort or you will be molested non stop by merchants selling there 5 and dime trinkets. Can not beat the swim up bar, give the man a few dollars in the morning and he will make sure your cup is never empty. Gabi Beach Resturant is not worth the extra money, stick to the included resturants as the food is the same.
Overall nice relaxing place to be, plenty of drink but the food is not the best.

reviews.author: NoemiL403
reviews.title: De ensueño
reviews.text:
Hace menos de un mes que llegué de República Dominicana y debo decir que es un hotel inolvidable. El trato excepcional, el personal súper servicial y siempre con una sonrisa en la cara. El hotel tal cual se ve en las fotos. Es impresionante. Los servicios de lujo. Cené el menú degustación, el cual recomiendo, en el restaurante Passion by Martín Berasategui y fue la mejor cena de mi vida. Sí, platos minimalistas pero exquisitos, al igual que el pan de distintas clases que ofrecen con la comida. 
Recomiendo totalmente este hotel. 
Tal y como su nombre indica, es lo más cerca que he estado del paraíso!

reviews.author: Nikita123-12
reviews.title: Servicio lamentable para su categoría, su precio y sus instalaciones.
reviews.text: No puede llevar la bandeja de la cena, toda la mañana delante de la puerta de la habitación y q nadie la haya retirado y eso que es zona de paso al restaurante Palazzo. No puede ser que en toda una mañana un camarero se haya acercado a las tumbonas de la playa a preguntar si necesitamos o queremos algo y lo único q le hemos pedido, un cenicero para no ensuciar la playa no lo haya traído. No puede ser que pidas un zumo natural y que nadie te lo pueda servir en la inmensa zona de la playa y piscina y que te indiquen que tienes que cogerlo tú del buffet del desayuno. No puede ser que a la hora de comer en ese mismo bufet pidas un zumo y te traigan un refresco de naranja. He estado y disfrutado en muchos resorts caribeños. Valoro habitualmente mucho las instalaciones y el el servicio! Muchos me han sorprendido gratamente en otros la decepción ha sido grande. LameNto que esta ocasión el caso haya sido el segundo a pesar de haber pagado mucho mas que en otros.

reviews.author: Victor J
reviews.title: El paraíso
reviews.text: viajado por muchos hoteles por todo el Caribe pero ninguno como este.supera las expectativas.te dan ganas de no hacer ninguna excursión solo disfrutar de este enorme resort.empleados muy amables y simpáticos.bebida y comida excelente.salen todos los dias excursiones gratis en la puerta del hotel a hacer snorquel en su propio arrecife

reviews.author: betsy a
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: I loved this place. My whole family went for my aunt's wedding and I can't think of any other place to compare it to. This resort is in a class of its own. What made it even special is the people that worked there...they were very friendly and ready to help you anyway they can. Even though their English was very limited, they did anything to make sure you were taken care of. I want to give a special shout out to Ricardo for taking care of us! He was a great sever and his English was very good so we can communicate better and he seemed like he wanted to learn more and asked us how he can serve us better. He was always excited to see us and made us feel welcome!

reviews.author: Danielle P
reviews.title: Paradisus is a True Paradise
reviews.text:
Having been all over the world from Morocco to Tahiti and proud to be a native New Yorker, I believe I can provide a fair and honest review of the Paradisus Palma Real.  It is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING.  It is by far one of the most opulent and luxurious resorts I have ever stayed at. The grounds are beautifully manicured.  There is not one corner, angle or area of this property that has not been given the utmost attention to detail.  The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable.  Every member of the staff was friendly and accommodating, always smiling and happy to help. Our personal concierge, 
Peter Frias, was like a long lost friend. We loved him. Also, the activities staff was very entertaining. We will never forget learning the bachata poolside with Angel "Oh My God!" Alcantara.  The food quality and quantity was fantastic. Your choice of fresh fish and meats grilled to order daily at the buffet. The specialty restaurants were good too but the buffet was great.  Overall, the Paradisus Palma Real is magnificent; it will exceed your expectations. We look forward to returning next year.

reviews.author: Fiore08585
reviews.title: Hospitalidad
reviews.text: Edgar nuestro concierge was the greatest, very pleasant and very nice.! He happened to be very helpful so was Angel Pacheco. Love the stay. Waiters were not very attentive but averall the stay was very pleasant. We'll be back next year!! see you guys!.

reviews.author: cispat
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds/service, but the food was just ok
reviews.text:
We just returned from a wedding here.  The grounds are beautiful, the beach and pools were gorgeous, and our room was amazing!  We chose the Royal Service and quickly realized this is the only way to go if you're planning to stay here.  All of our friends did the standard all inclusive package and they were stuck eating the bland food at the included restaurants.  We quickly realized that the only good food was located at Gabi beach and Palazzo, neither of which was included in the standard all inclusive package.  Plus the wonderful butler service included with the Royal service was what made the Royal service really stand out.  Our service was excellent when going through Jose, our butler.  Even if the phone wasn't immediately answered, he or another butler called the provided royal service cell phone back within 1 minute of hanging up the phone.  Jose handled all our questions and brought surprises to us at least once per day (fruit plate, cheese platter, chocolate covered strawberries, prepared Jacuzzi with pretty flower petals...two different days!).  He arranged our private dinner on the beach (excellent food, but definitely an extra cost) and made sure to introduce us to the covering butler since Jose was off that day before our dinner started.  He told us from the beginning that he didn't want a tip unless we felt he deserved it at the end of our stay.  He totally deserved it and we were more than happy to tip him on our last day because he is the reason why our stay was so great!
The other areas of the resort were mostly friendly and helpful.  Our first night in Bana was a little rough as we were part of a rehearsal dinner part.  The staff didn't bring me and my husband our drinks and in general were not helpful.  We went to the sushi bar after the dinner and the chefs seemed annoyed, but once they saw us tipping, then they were very attentive.  The rest of our stay the staff was very attentive and helpful.  Everyone said hello and almost everyone was more than happy to let me attempt my Spanish to communicate.  We spent a lot of time at the pool bar, Royal service bar, and lobby bar.  The bartenders got to know us and were always very good at keeping our drinks full.  Ramone at the pool bar was by far the most memorable!  He remembered what we were drinking the day prior and made sure to get us our drinks ASAP the following day.  He even put my husband's drink on his head and ran it all the way over to him in the Royal service cabana.  Whenever he'd see us walking by the pool bar he'd call us by name and offer to prepare our favorite drinks.  
The exercise room was great, open nice and early so I could get my work out done.  The spa at the Reserve was great as well as the water ritual at the Palma real.  I did prefer the reserve spa as the space was so pretty and the cabanas there were heavenly.  
We did have 1 day of no power for over 6 hours.  No blended drinks, no AC...it was annoying, but per the staff, this never has happened before...a generator was down?  It was a bit annoying and the pool wasn't filtering, but it kept us cool.  The ocean was actually very warm that day, so the pool was more refreshing.  
The room was beautiful, but humid at times.  Our bathing suites never dried the entire time we were there.  This is to be expected, given it's almost 100% humidity there this time of year.
The wi fi is pretty spotty, but I expected this, so it didn't bother me much.  Also, I could go to the Royal service lounge whenever I wanted to use their MACs to go online. 
Overall we enjoyed our stay, but I have to say that the food was a big disappointment.  I will not likely return because of this.  I feel that for the price we paid and our comfort with tipping, we would get the same service at any similar resort for the same price...and maybe the food would be better.  If you're not a foodie/food snob, this resort will be perfect for you!

reviews.author: Martaelba158
reviews.title: Viaje al "Paraiso".
reviews.text:
Fueron 5 dias maravillosos donde se conjugaron todos los factores para hacer nuestra estancia inolvidable y sera este calido recuerdo el que nos hara regresar.
La elegancia de las intalaciones (su arquitectura y diseno!!!); la belleza de los jardines; 
la amabilidad de los empleados!!! (de todos sin excepcion); la frescura y perfecta elaboracion de las comidas en cada uno de los restaurantes (inolvidable el menu de degustacion de "Passion"); los excelentes shows; la musica adecuada en todas las areas (incluyendo los jardines y spa); 
el perfume... en fin, unos dias perfectos en un ambiente exquisito. 
Solo algunos nombres siendo injustos con los que no recordamos: Pedro como guest service, Ramon y Danny en el pool bar y su esfuerzo por complacernos, Vitalia y Leidi en el spa, 
Carlos en el Club Melia, el cheff Pedro Mendoza, el fotografo Van Troy, Wendy en el gym, 
Jorge en "Naos", Trinidad en "Market Grill", el staff del "Passion"...
Nos prometimos recomendar este hotel a todos nuestros amigos y asi lo hemos hecho y seguiremos haciendo. Hasta la proxima!!

reviews.author: SILVIA F
reviews.title: Paraiso

reviews.author: laura a
reviews.title: Extraordinary Stay @ Paradissus Palma Real Aug 26 - Sept 4/12
reviews.text:
"Just returned from this absolutely incredible vacation at the Paradissus P.Real.
We travel often & always to 5 or 6 * resorts. This resort exceeded our expectations I really mean that with no exaggeration. If you are considering booking in Punta Cana book this resort because you & your family will not be disappointed!
I am in the hospitality & real estate business so I am extremely selective below are my positive comments from all those that travelled in my group:
1) Lighting & Candles in the evening extraordinary. If you go to this resort you'll know what I mean but it is exquisite! Everything is lit up & beautiful!
2) The food is amazing. We were told you will get sick from the food & water.
Don't drink the tap water ever. Ice & food from the restaurants & bars is fine because the water is pure & filtered. Drink bottled water & again the water served is totally fine.
3) The concierge - Janic is who helped us - she is incredible, beautiful, great personality, wonderful & always smiling, very knowledgeable & informative.
4) Loyalty program - we attended (something like a timeshare) we actually really enjoyed the presentation no pressure tactics at all...worth attending because you get a total understanding of the resort & they different types of accommodations.
5) Restaurants / Dining: ALL the restaurants & food are amazing.  Service is very quick & food plating / presentation is beautiful.
Teppanyaki have your concierge book this first along with Acqua in the Reserve. 
Vento is Italian excellent. Gabi fantastic & don't forget that Thursday night is lobster night at the buffet restaurant. Buffet is great at lunch - fantastic variety!
6) Entertainment day & night: We spent time painting with oil which was so much fun.
Oxnard Perez helped us with painting with watercolours & now we are all into painting on canvas. He was amazing & also helps with the candle lighting in the evening.
Night shows - Le Cirque & Michael Jackson Tribute were incredible. The dancers are great & they dance at the lobby bar with the guests. Retro party on the patio is my favourite!!!
7) VIP lounge - Penelope Santana, Marcos Florentino, Yessica Perez, Viddimir Rodriguez were incredibly helpful throughout our stay. They even helped me do my pre-check in for my return flight. Everyone wants to please & help. Even though there is sometimes a language barrier everything will be fine as long as there is mutual respect.
8) Cleaning Staff - this resort is spotless & I mean clean!!! Our maid service, additional requests for towels, water etc were quick, prompt & courteous.
9) Gabi Restaurant staff especially our server Nelkis were amazing. It was my husband's birthday & it was a beautiful time for us all especially having a very skilled and attentive server like Nelkis!
10) Guest Services: Emmanuel- he asked for feedback at the hotel while we were there & he listened to everything only 2 things we asked for (a birthday cake for my husband at the Gabi Beach & a later time for our dinner reservations at Acqua & Gabi - he working with Janic & the restaurants made both happen!
11) Check in with I think her name was Jennie? But she was ready & willing to please. Quick check in & very polite! She was great!
12) The beach is amazing. Ample towels,...no shortage ever. Pool is beautiful.
Bartenders are great!
*Only suggestion I would make based on my experience in hospitality - spend more money on the entertainment because they are great dancers, with more funding they could invest in better costumes - ones that fit better. They will look better, feel better & perform even better than they know possible. The stage - give it a facelift - better looking frame of the stage through upgrading the curtains, stairs, paint etc...if the stage looks more professional & rich looking with tassels etc...trust me the image of the shows will be significantly upgraded.
OK this is quite a bit of detail, but if I knew all this info before I booked it would have made my decision so much easier & of course FREE Wi-Fi & Internet access! "

reviews.author: Randall P
reviews.title: We had a great time!

reviews.author: Cedillo M
reviews.title: Inolvidable!

Nuestra familia siempre es recibida con muchísimo cariño por  JULIEN GOURIER , preocupado y pendiente de que nuestra estancia sea perfect y constantemente ayudándonos para aprovechar y utilizar adecuadamente nuestra membresia! En la piscina de socios nuestro querido Francisco ESTRELLA que nos sirve y consiente para sentirnos a gusto! Y esta vez queremos hacer un reconocimiento especial para FÉLIX DE LA CRUZ del restaurante Vento por todas sus atenciones! reviews.author: KimberlyHall
reviews.title: Pure Enjoyment
reviews.text: Last week, my father, uncle, husband and I stayed at the wonderful Paradisus Palma Real Resort.  We had an absolute wonderful time!  The food was magnificent (presentation) and delicious!  The service was impeccable!  We are looking forward to going back again next year.  We stayed in a Royal Service Garden Suite which was well worth it.  With the Royal Service, it is an adult only area and you are allowed to go to many other peoples than the guest without Royal Service can go.  Royal Service takes of half of the property if not more.  Our Butlers, Andres and Carlos were amazing and they were there to help us with literally anything we needed.  Carlos even set up a romantic bubble bath for my husband and I with out us requesting it.  We were so tired from all of the days activities we did not even get to enjoy it, but it was the thought that counted.  The nightly entertainment was good as well. Overall, I would not want to go anywhere else!

reviews.author: LGPR6666
reviews.title: My second stay in PARADISE on EARTH
reviews.text:
Ever since my last stay at that resort last November, the magic has continued to improve what was already the best, which leaves me speechless.
This time we stayed for a week, again at the Royal Service section. Among the surprises are brand new Royal Service Lounge, A new restaurant for Royal Service guests only, Palazos which is absolutely superb in every way possible, offering a small gourmet buffet as well as a most impressive a la carte menu, which is what we chose.
Royal Service guests ( a adult only concept ) have complimentary access to Gaby's Beach Restaurant, a Royal Reserve ( for families ) restaurant that is out of this world, changing dramatically from lunch to superb surf and turf, the freshest that exists on the island.
The new espreso machines in the Royal Service suites are more than welcomed as well as the daily call from the Royal Service Lounge to check of everything is all right.
In addition to Wifi everywhere, The Lounge has state of the art Apple/Mac computers with printers accessability. A complimentary private number cell phone is also delivered upon check in for internal and local communications. Your own private buttler is a phone call away even though he tours the property constantly and provides you with whatever you need.

What takes the cake since our last stay is the renovation of Passions restaurant, top of line gourmet with impeccable service under the direction of world acclaimed Chef Martin Berasategui a 7 Michelin Stars genius from Spain. The 7 course degustation dinner is a bargain at $ 40.00 including tax and tip per person in addition to a wine pairing experience at only $20.00 per person. That alone, would cost over $400.00 per person in Manhattan. Only the best local and freshest ingredients are utilized and the fresh foie gras is out of this world as well as anything else.

Daily entertainments from scuba diving to shows, casino, fingertip private shuttle to a lovely and safe shopping center are part of the dream. Not to forget the SPA which is better than those big names on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan!

But what always impresses me with that Paradise on Earth is to see hard working employees with a big smile, happily treated with dignity and respect and we all owe this to the visionarry leadership of Mr. Rafael Torres, The Managing Director of the dream resort.

Going home is the saddest part of all. But we shall return early next year so that will keep us going now that we are completely re-energized to face the high speed and complicated life of Manhattan.

Thank you Mr. Torres and to your entire team that makes Paradisus Palma Real a special secret garden everyone should experience.

With all the best,

Laurent

.

reviews.author: Gary K
reviews.title: Not as great if you're not a VIP or member...
reviews.text:
The short:  The property, beach, and pool at the Paradisus Palma Real were all very nice, but the service and guest treatment were a bit inconsistent. The quality and customer service at the "WBA Collection" gift shop was horrible.  Worst of all was the dreaded timeshare SALES PITCH. 

The long:  We travel a lot to these types of resorts, so this review comes with a fairly good understanding of what an all-inclusive should and shouldn't be (and we're not at all snobby demanding types that expect absolute perfection).  But we do expect good customer service though at a resort of this price range.  We didn't opt for the additional VIP upgrades as many other reviewers did.

The grounds are very pretty and well maintained. The pool is large, clean, and has nice in-water tile recliners which are great on hot days.  There are also several covered cabana-style seating areas. You have to get to the pool early to get a chair though, as it seems to be common practice to claim chairs with a towel and then disappear to the beach all day. We've found this to be the case at many resorts though.  The beach and water are picturesque  (although the sand fleas were relentless). There is a well-equipped gym, and room outlets are the standard American type. Wifi internet is included, but is very unreliable and slow in the rooms.  It did work better in the lobby though.  Although we were under the impression we'd have access to the whole property, we found that about half the resort was restricted to VIPs and members only.   This was not a terribly big deal but would have been nice to know in advance. 

The staff fell about 50/50 into two categories: the wonderful/friendly/accommodating and the angry/rude/inconvenienced.  As a result, the service about half the time wasn't that great.  This ranged from little things like the apparent interchangeability of coke and diet coke, to bigger things like sitting through an entire meal without drinks or a waiter (even after asking for one repeatedly).  Much of the staff didn't accurately answer resort-related questions like where to book excursions or where to find a spa price list, and many staff didn't follow through with requests like checking with housekeeping for a valuable lost item.  During our entire stay, we never had a waiter come to the pool or beach area to take a drink order, and most bartenders made it obvious that they didn't like making the drinks that required more work.  Nothing atrocious, but definitely a lot of detractors from what could easily have been a great experience.  Luckily, there WERE several fantastic staff members who did a great job (props to Samuel and Jendy at Bana restaurant and Juan at the Market Grille who treated us like gold).

TIP #1:  Avoid the "WBA Collection" gift shop !!!  It's way overpriced (which was expected), but the clothing is VERY poorly made, and despite having a receipt stating exchanges are allowed for 30 days, they absolutely WILL NOT accept an exchange (even if your shorts come completely unstitched in multiple places the first time they're worn).  The unbelievably rude manager Sabrine (think "Pretty Woman" snobby boutique owner) tried every trick in the book to avoid an exchange, including saying I had "improperly worn the shorts".  She finally pointed to a completely undamaged area of the shorts and accused me of "sitting while wearing the shorts" to cause a scuff.  Oddly enough there was no scuff... and I was unaware I couldn't SIT while wearing shorts!!!   I felt like a character in a poorly-written Twilight Zone episode.  Luckily there was a shopping center within walking distance that sold shorts that WERE designed to be sat in!  

TIP #2:  DO NOT agree to listen to the "quick" timeshare spiel !!  Not even for 5 minutes... it's a pandora's box of vacation-wasting time!! We were assigned a "personal concierge" who turned out to really be just a salesman for the resort's timeshare department. We were asked to participate in a 5-10 minute presentation as a "favor" to our concierge so he could get commission. We reluctantly agreed, but opted out after realizing it was actually a 2+ hour high-pressure sales pitch where you're handed off to multiple sales people who tell you how to fill out the forms in order to maximize their commissions.  Then they scold you like a child when you tell them you're not interested and they act as if you owe them two hours of your vacation time.  Of course we never saw or heard from our "personal concierge" again..  a little deceiving and a LOT annoying. This alone was enough reason for me not return to Paradisus. 

Although our stay wasn't terrible overall, I have to say we were a little disappointed in the resort and probably wouldn't recommend it to others.  There were just too many instances where we were treated poorly... something that really should never happen in a resort of this price range.  However, with some staff re-training and a few policy changes, it could be a fantastic place.  After lowering our expectations we managed to have a great time nonetheless.

reviews.author: Martha Lucia P
reviews.title: VACATION DELUX
reviews.text: Being in Paradisus Palma Real Resort was the most wonderful experience I had. We stayed for 10 days and every since the first moment we arrived in the hotel, the staff members were very attentive and polite. I loved the activities that was planned everyday, specially the dancing lessons given by Angel Alcantara, Jose Gonzalez, Eliezer Robles,Leonel Hernandez and Rachel. You laugh and have fun with the jokes they say just to make the tourist feel like they were home. Lets not forget the service in general including the pool bar staff giving the presentations about their drink specially the Mamajuana (Dominican Rom). Ramon who is known for his "Fuego" and Paulino Bomba, makes the experience 10 times better. The service in the Hotel is not the only one that gets an A+ experience, but the food specially the buffet brings family and friends including staff members together at the end of the day. The over all experience was great, but the staff members and the atmosphere is way better. Don't forget to pass by Maria Ortiz "the cappuccino lady" who makes the most wonderful and tastiest coffee in the hotel, also Yuderqui Javier whose service and kindness was excellent as well.  My husband being Italian and myself Colombian living in NY, with the overall feeling of the Resort, we would love to come back once again with our family and friends.

reviews.author: Consejera7

reviews.title: Excelente complejo hotelero con una insuperable atención personalizada al cliente, que lo convierte en el mejor resort , sin lug

reviews.author: Sergio Danesi

reviews.text:
Royal service reception is excelent . There are several good restaurants

reviews.author: TheAggieTravelers
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text:
We were married at the Paradisus Palma Real, we brought a group of 60 people, and it couldn't have been more beautiful.  We stayed a total of two weeks in The Reserve and Royal Service the staff treated us and our guest wonderfully, there were a few minor issues but I think that is to be expected, the staff handled it perfectly and even upgraded us for free to the Presidental Beach Front suite. 

Our only complaint was the food, it wasn't the best and left a lot to be desired, but we've had much worst elsewhere. 

All in all, it was an amazing experience and we will be going back.

reviews.author: Castro-coru
reviews.title: EL PARAISO EN PUNTA CANA
reviews.text:
Es la quinta vez que nos alojamos en este hotel y no deja de sorprendernos. Nuestra estancia en el servicio real fue inmejorable y todo el personal te hace sentir como si estuvieras en tu propia casa.
Nuestro mayordomo Agustín fue un ejemplo de saber estar, hizo todo lo posible para que nuestras vacaciones fueran increibles.
Hay una gran variedad de restaurantes a elegir, aunque para mi los mejores son el Vento (cocina mediterránea) y el Aqua.
En el restaurante Vento el chef Miguel Rodeiro nos sorprendía todos los días con sus especialidades culinarias y su exquisita repostería.
No puedo dejar de mencionar a Walter, el supervisor del restaurante Vento y el restaurante Passion, gran profesional donde los haya y mejor persona, y los camareros Rafael, José Luis, Juan y Yuderquis que siempre tienen una palabra amable.
El restaurante Aqua está situado en el área de la Reserva y es necesario desplazarse en un carrito, aunque eso no es un problema porque normalmente ya están en la puerta. La decoración es moderna, y lo que más sorprende son las mesas de espejo. La carta es muy variada y extensa y la comida de muy buena calidad. El servicio no estuvo muy bien la primera vez que fuimos a cenar, pero cuando volvimos a probar suerte una segunda vez fue totalmente diferente y la atención de los camareros fue muy buena.
En esta zona de la reserva también se sitúa el restaurante Gabi Club, y aunque su supervisor Eddie es de lo mejor, la comida no cumple las espectativas.
Lo mismo ocurre en el Gabi Beach, típico chiringuito Chill Out que es muy bonito y con unas vistas preciosas al mar, pero si vas por la noche, la falta de iluminación no te deja ni leer la carta, la comida es de baja calidad y la mayoría de los camareros son un poco déspotas.
La playa es muy bonita, y aunque se está deteriorando bastante por la falta de respeto de los turistas hacia el medio ambiente, limpian la orilla de algas todas las mañanas e intentan dejarla lo mejor posible.
El servicio real tiene su propio bar en la piscina que presta servicio a la playa. Sus camareros, los dos Franciscos y Pedro están siempre pendientes de los clientes y Nelson, el bar tender hace los mejores cockteles y batidos de frutas naturales.
Lo único malo que puedo destacar es la limpieza de las habitaciones, que deja mucho que desear.
En general, y gracias a la gestión de Veralucía, la directora del Servicio Real, vale la pena alojarse en esta parte del hotel y saber lo que es el lujo y la comodidad en tus vacaciones.

reviews.author: Gabriela_Flexa
reviews.title: We will never forget these holidays!
reviews.text:
Just arrived from a 01 week vacation with my hubby at Paradisus Palma Real!
Everything went just perfect from the moment we arrived ´till the moment we left.
The Royal Service is really good and it is worth. You don't have to worry with restaurants and activities reservations as you have a butler to help you out with all that!
One night when we got into the room, the jacuzzi was romantically prepared for us! Without asking!
Restaurants are very good, but not all of them! The bests are BANA (contemporary Asian fusion cuisine, sushi and Teppanyaki tables), GABI BEACH (sea food), VENTO (a la carte international specialties )!
Swimming pools are huge and delicious! They invite you for a splash all the time!
The sea is beatifull and the hotel offers sailing boats, scuba diving, snorkling, etc.! Great! Beside the others activities you can do during your stays, such as sushi class, tennis clinic, every caribbean rhythms class, etc.
The staff of activities were just great!
Thanks to Max, Gabriel, Santa, Ramón (out butler) for all the laughs, patience and kindness during my dream vacation in Caribe!!!!

reviews.author: IsabelA484
reviews.title: Destination Wedding DISASTER
reviews.text:
Went to my nieces wedding with 26 others in our party. Let me tell you that first impressions always count. When you have terrible management what can you expect from this hotel. Upon check in there were 3 buses full of college students all checking out at the same time. Now i would think there would have had a representatives checking the students out not all the students checking themselves out im talking about 300 people all at once. Once i saw that first thing that came to my mind was I came at the wrong time boy was i right. 2nd thought was going to another hotel however, we had a contract for 3 nights which meant if I didn't stay I would lose my money. So, it was downhill from that point on.

PROS - Beautiful beach and nice architecture and beautiful pool.

CONS - Mangement, i asked for manager never came out
              Staff - attended to you when it was convient to them. You would have to go get  someone to bring you a drink unless you just got up and got your own drink at the bar.
Food not bad but not hot. Now the reason to all of this is due to the management at the hotel they OVERWORK their staff so, of course they are too tired to help the guest. The hotel staff works 22 days on 8 days off. I wouldn't want to work either. 
You would think that a 4 DIAMOND property would have superb service they DON'T. I have been to 4 Diamond properties and 5 star resorts and I would give them 3 stars and that is alot for the service that was given.  The only time staff will acknowledge you is to sell you their time share.
The hall ways are poorly lit and they use 25 watt bulbs so, it's hard to see where your going at night. If your on the 3rd floor the water pressure is very low so, you might find that your toilet doesn't work properly nor does your shower or sink. BEWARE on picking up the phone to make a call i made the mistake and made a call within the same country and i spoke for 6 minutes and was hit with a $25.00 US phone bill thank goodness I didn't call to the U.S.
This hotel is OVERPRICED for the terrible service one recieves. Maybe at one time this hotel had great service but they do not now. I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone. Now, those of you that don't believe me go ahead give it a try and prove me wrong. 
I had to make the most of this for my niece and her special day but I will not be returning again. I have been to better resorts in Punta Cana,Puerto Plata,Sosua,Samana and Santo Domingo that have 0 diamonds. HOTELS STAFF SHOULDN'T  IGNORE GUEST.

reviews.author: Gleica
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: Paradisus é um resort perfeitooo... Ótima comida, ótimas instalações e perfeito lugar para passar a lua de mel... Amei tudo, inclusive o mar do caribe é lindo e o clima é perfeito, sol o dia inteiro.

reviews.author: vinylmeister
reviews.title: fantastic hotel resort with a superb staff
reviews.text:
A fantastic hotel resort with a superb staff , in our opinion this hotel meet's it's 5-star classifications. 
Strongly recommendad for a great time on the beaches of  Punta Cana.

Reception & Registrations:
The hotel had the reception prepared in advance to receive us as the customers. And registration took a minimum amount of time.. There was one  hotel concierge dedicated to us,  he took all the time needed to explain the various areas of the resort as well as making  the necessary restaurant reservations for us..

Rooms:
We had two different rooms one Junior Suite and one Luxus suite. Both had a balcony and were prett< large rooms. The suites had all the facilities one can expect and to our surpirse the suites had an inside private Jacuzzi.. 
One minor point maybe that the furnitures is starting to "sit through" the hotel management needs to pay attention that is will not detoriate.

Amenities: included everything you may expect from a 5-star class hotel.

Swimming Pool:
The hotel has a very large swimming pool, with an very nice and the unforgettable barman "Ramon Fuego"

Restaurants
Breakfast - the buffet breakfast  offers an overwhelming choice of bread, pastries, fruits, warm and cold dishes , all freshly cooked and all kinds of cut fruits. The buffet also had a choice of the typical American buffer, Englsih, Continental and Dominican breakfast dishes and obviously your choice of omelettes.

There is one buffet restaurants - which also offers an overwhelming choice of warm food and salads, the food we tried was all good quality and tasty.

The Buffet Restaura. There are several a  la carte restaurants offering a small choice of dishes, all of them well prepared and very quickly served..
The house-wine iare a very simple Spanish or French wine and the hotel's choice of house-wines will definitetely need to be improved. Better wines are availble but cost $$$

Activities and Entertainment
Through the day activities, like dancing lessons, wine tasting, sushi making and evening entertainment like Dinner Circus show, Michael Jackson Show, 80s Rettro diso, take place every day and evening.

Bar and Lounge:
There is a vary large lobby bar  and allows for cigar smoking, a wide choice of cocktails is available

Annoyances: they will be trying to sell that Melia Club Time Sharing, which takes about 90 minutes of your time but includes an a la carte breakfast and a dinner in the Gabi Beach a-la carte restaurant. 

Palma Real is the perfect hotel for a calm, relaxing time at the beach and/or swimming pool

reviews.author: LLERGOMOTA
reviews.title: VACACIONES DE ENSUEÑO
reviews.text:
Hola, llevamos 3 años viajando con frecuencia a Rep. Dominicana en familia y puedo asegurar que un buen hotel complementa la estancia en un lugar tan maravilloso como este. Lo hemos podido comprobar en este fantastico hotel, el pasado mes de agosto.
El personal del hotel es maravilloso, enseguida coges confianza con ellos y hacen que la estancia sea divertida y agradable.
Las instalaciones del hotel estan muy conservadas y puedes observar dia a dia como el personal del hotel esta pendiente de cualquier detalle, a todas horas los ves pendientes de cualquier pequeña anomalia, la decoración del hotel es preciosa... me enamoré de toooodos los espejos del exterior.
Las habitaciones estan super equipadas, el jacuzzi del baño es una pasada
La comida en cualquier restaurante tematico, esta exquisita..., y la animación por la noche muy variada, los animadores se desviven para que el cliente disfrute del baile caribeño. Quiero agradecer al Sr. Rafael Torres, Director del hotel su amabilidad y gran atención  y a todo su equipo... seguid así sois estupendos... hasta pronto!!!

reviews.author: joe_cast_g
reviews.title: SMVC - It's awesome
reviews.text: To those that want to goto Paradise go visit Paradisus Palma Real in DR.  The hotel and resturants are great.  I have heard complaints that staff ignores people, but honestly that is every hotel unless you are Donald Trump.  I would definately go and check out SMVC, my wife and I purchased one.  We bought it 2 years ago and almost got back 50% by taking vacations and RCI trade in to Disney and Europe.

reviews.author: Lucyvv
reviews.title: El mejor Resort de punta cana
reviews.text: He estado en varios hoteles en punta cana, pero ninguno como este, servicio excepcional, la comida fantástica y un lugar paradisiaco perfectamente cuidado al mínimo detalle y acondicionado para una estancia inmejorable.

reviews.author: tamara a
reviews.title: Mejor y mas tranquilidad imposible
reviews.text: el hotel fue recomendado por una amiga que habia estado alli, pero era imposible de creer todo lo que ella me decia, es magnifico, precioso y el trato excelente, vamos para repetir. Tambiém congeniamos muy bien con Ramon y Luis del bar de la piscina son dos excelentes personas y espero que cuando vuelvan sigan alli porque la verdad que se echa muy buenos ratos con ellos, gracias por su atencion

reviews.author: JessicaRH
reviews.title: Excelente Resort
reviews.text:
El hotel es absolutamente recomendable, especialmente la parte de La Reserva que es donde me alojé, La habitación es hermosa, con una vista lindisima y posee todas las comodidades. La comida es de muy buena calidad.y los restaurantes como Vento y Sakura son excelentes. El servicio es muy bueno y el equipo de animacion siempre predispuesto a hacernos pasar momentos entretenidos y divertidos. La gente del hotel es muy servicial y siempre con buena predisposición y con una sonrisa.
Jessica, Argentina

reviews.author: maria g
reviews.title: A self service 4 Diamond DUMP
reviews.text:
I have been in the travel industry for 22 years and this was the WORSE place I have stayed in  this place doesn't believe in customer service it does not exist. I got to the hotel little did i know there was a group of over 200 checking out. I arrived at 2:45pm for a 3pm check in I got my keyes to my room at 5:45pm got to the room got a room with a sofa bed. I stayed in the room since i didnt want to go back to reception and wait again. Went down for dinner at one of the restaurants (Asian) food was bad ended up going to the buffet which wasnt bad food is cold however. The waiters come to your table after 15 minutes to ask you what you would like a drink. After that I would just go to the bar and get my own drink since the waiters would either take long, forget or bring the wrong drink. mind you I would ask them in spanish so, they understood.
I always feel one should give everyone a chance but this place is RIDICULOUS no customer service i asked for the manager the first day I left and never saw the manager. The only thing this hotel has is its architecture nothing else. Its very dark they dont turn on the lights in the hall. Someone is getting a very good cutback cause this hotel is a self service hotel. Nothing works,it's overpriced and their is not one bit of customer service. GO ELSEWHERE. I guess that the persons that say this hotel is good must travel very little and has not gone to many hotels. I can't say all of the CONS to this hotel cause there is not enough space. And there are no PROS.

reviews.author: Natottawa
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Beautiful beautiful, all so beautiful...  Felt like a princess. Great suite, Gorgeous pool, not too crowed, great beach and loved the spa !  The only thing that wasn't top draw was the food in specialty restaurants.  French and italian were ok, Thai was awful.  Great selection at buffet.

reviews.author: Kylene P
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
Our stay was absolutely wonderful-even in hurricane season!  The grounds were incredible and our room was extremely nice even though we got the basic package.  You need to go see Louis and Ramon at the main pool.  Our stay wouldn't have been the same without their cheerful faces greeting us with drinks every day.

Bana was one of our favorites.  I beileve the bartenders name was Carlos-his signature drink was to die for!  He would also entertain us by flipping the bottles and creating different concoctions for us.

The food was to die for.  I would have never expected to be able to eat like that at an all inclusive resort.  Needless to say, I left 10 pounds heavier.

I would HIGHLY recommend this resort to couples.  If you're a family, you probably want to stay at the Reserve, as they have the kiddy pool and kids club on that side.  For us, the regular hotel was perfect.

Thank you! ~Kylene and Matthew Pippin

reviews.author: Sheena7121
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
My husband and I were on our honeymoon when we arrived in Punta Cana.  When leaving the airport, we were shuttled in a bus with a few other couples.  After seeing the resorts they were staying at I was thinking to myself I hope we didn't pay all that money to stay in something that looks like the resorts these other couples were dropped off at.  Upon arriving I was amazed at how well everything was kept up (grounds, flowers, fountains).  It was beautiful.  After checking in we met with our concierge who showed us around the resort and introduced us to some of the workers.  He was great and they call him Guzmon for future reference!
 
We got a garden view room which was kept very clean and up to date!  The maid service was amazing the whole week and our mini fridge was stocked up everyday! We didn't have any problems with towels like I had read with others.  Everything was great!

The resort in general was beautiful!  I felt like I was living in luxury after coming from a small town in West Virginia!  I had never met such polite and well mannered people willing to help you when needed!  We didn't expierence one negative encounter with any of the staff working at the resort!
