As you have read I'm sure, Ramon at the Aqua bar is amazing! He is very entertaining and his service is outstanding! 

The beach was beautiful! There was a lot of seaweed, but whose to complain about this when you are in the Carribean with crystal clear blue water! It's a part of nature! Every now and then one of the staff members would walk around the beach area to see if you needed anything, but I didn't see one everyday! 

Finally, the food was decent! Not anything spectacular but nothing I couldn't eat!  I am very particular with what I eat so it was a little harder on me than it was for my husband! Breakfast was amazing and lunch was pretty good as well!  The hibachi grill was probably our favorite place that we had ate at out of the restaurants!  I would recommend if you are particular at what you are eating pack some little snacks for yourself!  I would have given anything to have something simple like chex mix!  But if I wanted a bag of chips I would have had to pay like 6 dollars! The store in the resort is outrageous in pricing so make sure you pack everything you need! 

Overall, this place was an excellent choice and if we ever make our way back to Punta Cana this is definately where we would stay at without a doubt! It was amazing!

reviews.author: seneyda
reviews.title: wonderful time
reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel for a week. We really enjoyed our time there. Everyone was very warm and friendly. We received the very best attention from all those around us. There was a variety of activities that kept us entertained and relaxed at the same time.I would like to thanks to Max Ferreras for his help and dedication all the time . Also to Deyadira Disla and everyone around.  I would recommend this hotel to anyone and know that others would hac=ve as much fun as we did. I would definately return.

reviews.author: Samuel S
reviews.title: Meets all expectations and more
reviews.text: The hotel staff was courteous and very knowledgeable of everything we asked in the hotel and surrounding areas. We want to thank the staff of Aqua bar, the service was excellent especially Ramon Fuego who was always helpful and very entertaining. The staff at the Lobby Bar was also very quick to help us with all our needs all thanks to Deyadira, Eridania, Elvis, and Juan Estevan. The hotel and its amenities were very clean and well maintained. The food was delicious in all restaurants that we dined in. Thanks to all the staff at the reception and Elizabeth Santos in the billing department who recommended this hotel for its excellence.

reviews.author: MoeAndMig
reviews.title: Fuego! Fuego! Fuego!
reviews.text: Excellent service from Ramon Fuego at the Aqua pool bar.  Excellent service also from Luis and Bianca at the pool bar and Raquel at the lobby desk.  The rest of the employees at the hotel were very friendly and made us feel so welcomed.  We will return again and can't wait to see everybody.  Room very clean and food was excellent.

reviews.author: MRandMR
reviews.title: Fourth time and will return.
reviews.text: This was my fourth time at the location and I will return again and again.  The problems I encountered were minor.  I had to request bottled water and more towels for my room.  No big deal.  Expecting perfection is not realistic.  Food was ok to good.  Room and other areas of the hotel were beautiful.  Perfect location to completely relax.  The service we received from the employees was excellent especially from Ramon Fuego at the Aqua pool bar.

reviews.author: ManelSenes
reviews.title: Vacaciones de Reyes
reviews.text:
Hola, somos una pareja de 44 y 45 años  que disfrutemos de este maravilloso paraíso, realmente fue de las mejores estancias de las que hemos disfrutado en esta maravillosa isla.
Estuvimos en Servicio Real, todos los PROFESIONALES, lo pongo con mayúsculas por que es así, son maravillosos son personas que se dedican a hacerte la estancia confortable y se desviven para que la misma sea inmejorable, desde las personas de recepción, Srta. Daisy, Mayordomos, Ramon y Carlos y como no el equipo del bar de la piscina del Servicio Real, encabezado por Winkin Mejia todo un tipo genial siempre atento y servicial una gran persona y sin duda.... el rey de la Piña colada, Pedro otra gran persona, grande en todos los aspectos y los dos Franciscos, sin duda un gran equipo que hizo que nuestra estancia fuera maravillosa.
En cuanto a las instalaciones están muy bien conservadas  y muy limpias, la habitación grande ,espaciosa muy bien conservada y la limpieza inmejorable.
La comida muy bien, los restaurantes temáticos muy buenos todos excepto el Bama (oriental),.
En resumidas cuentas un lugar perfecto para poder disfrutar de unos días inmersos en un ambiente tranquilo de relax y con un grupo humano que se desvive por que la estancia sea inolvidable.
Desde aquí felicitar a la dirección del Ressort por estos días.
Muchas gracias y volveremos.......

reviews.author: JustECOSM
reviews.title: Keep your expectations low
reviews.text: This is a very large (maybe too large) property that looks good when you arrive. The lobby is spacious and attractive. It is also an all inclusive. I was there as part of a conference. There are many problems, especially for the experienced traveller. The front desk staff, including the manager, were very weak in terms of unserstanding English. This is true throughout the property. Getting an olive in a martini is a chore that takes several requests.The place was 30 per cent full and I was given a room very far from the lobby and the beach. The room was of decent size, but a bit tired. The floors in the halls and rooms are dangerously slippery when wet. The mattress was soft and not comfortable. One very strange thing is that in the standard room there is no solid wall separating the bathroom from the bed room, which limits priivacy .The food, except in the Vento restaurant, was very weak. The steak was horrible and the lobster tails were consistently overdone. The best is the breakfast. At night, look at the fresh fish offerings and have it grilled. Be careful, however, because they tend to overcook everything. I love to snorkel and it is very weak off the beach.  The beach is not bad, but the sand is gritty and there is so much seaweed they have to use a front end loader to remove it. On the plus side, the hotel does provide a  good number of covered chairs and beverage service on the beach. You are not permitted to go on your own to a reef which is in sight. There is a  "free" snorkel which is in a row boat for an hour where you better be good at climbing in and out of boats. There was no ladder. There are excursions that you can pay for. The one they push is for 76.00 on a small cat with no sun coverage. All in all, I was pretty disappointed with the experience.

reviews.author: paco f
reviews.title: Pensaba que habia estado en Hoteles buenos en Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Llevo 11 años yendo de vacaciones a la Republica Dominicana, y hemos estado en varias zonas y también en varios Hoteles, siempre de alto standing, entre ellos algunos de la cadena Iberostar, Barcelo, NH, Bahía Príncipe (Cayo Levantado y Ambar del que el año pasado, nos fuimos indignados por sus malas maneras del club de vacaciones) siempre en zona exclusiva para adultos y este año en el Paradisus Palma Real  “Servicio Real”.

Antes de ir  a este hotel, estuve mirando los comentarios en esta misma página web, tanto los buenos como los malos y ciertamente los malos daban la impresión de ser un despecho por algo. Finalmente nos decidimos a ir a este hotel al “Royal Service” y tengo que reconocer que es el mejor de los que he ido en Rep. Dominicana hasta el momento, La recepción del Royal Service es exclusiva con un mini bufet (solo debo criticar que el aire acondicionado esta extremadamente frio), El bufet normal en general bastante bien, los restaurantes de reserva en general bien excepto el Gabi Beach que tardaron una eternidad.
Las instalaciones del hotel muy bien (curiosamente no olía a humedad como en la mayoría de los hoteles) la playa en los dos primeros días tenia muchas algas, aunque no paraban de limpiarla, luego mejoro bastante después de una tormenta tropical que se llevo las algas de la orilla. La piscina del Royal Service pequeña pero suficiente para nuestra necesidad de descanso. Las hamacas y tumbonas en la playa y la piscina excelentes.
El Personal del hotel en general muy atento, si además eres generoso con ellos, como en todas partes del mundo, yo diría que entonces la atención y el agradecimiento de su parte son recíprocos y mejora sustancialmente.
La limpieza en general muy bien y nosotros tuvimos la suerte de conocer al director del Hotel Sr. Rabel Torres, a quien debo agradecer la atención que tuvo con nosotros y también hacerlo extensivo a todo su equipo.
Francamente no dudaría ni un instante en volver a este hotel ni tampoco en recomendarlo.

Paco Flores, Paloma Arroyo, Jose Maria Sanchez y Mari Carmen Gomez

reviews.author: Tara M
reviews.title: Overall an excellent resort
reviews.text:
My parents, husband, and I just returned home from a 7-day trip to Palma Real. My husband and I have been to several of the Paradisus Resorts in Puerto Rico, Costa Rica, and Punta Cana and always book the Royal Service Imperial Ocean Front package. Although we have enjoyed other Paradisus resorts, this one, by far, was the nicest, most romantic, had the best beaches, had the best Royal Service, had the best restaurants, etc. 

We did run into an issue during the first day and half of our trip, as our air was not working correctly in our room. The Royal Service Manager, Vera, and the Day Manager, Denise Ortiz, understood our concerns and promptly began working with maintanence to try to repair the air conditioner. Unfortunately, they could not fix it, and since there are only two ocean front rooms on each floor (and we were on the third floor, next door to my parents), we had to move down a floor. We were not too pleased about this so met with the Resort Manager, Eduardo, the next day. He immediately resolved the issue to our satisfaction and the rest of our stay was absolutely fantastic!!! We were very impressed with how well management was responsive to our concerns and in the way they conducted business. Everyone at Paradisus Palma Real goes above and beyond to ensure that your stay is perfect:)

I also wanted to mention that Carlos Pepen, our butler, was absolutely outstanding and so very attentive! He always had a smile on his face and was there in a minute if you needed something. Francisco Cabrera and Winkin Meija (Royal Service Pool bartender and attendant) were also fabulous! They both were so happy, friendly, hard-working, etc. We miss seeing their big smiles every morning as we walked by the Royal Service pool on our way to breakfast. Honestly, this is the best service we have received from any Paradisus resort thus far.

Everything about this resort was fantastic! The pools were spotless, the grounds were beautiful and well taken care of, the beaches were white and very clean, and the ocean was a beautiful green-blue color. 

The resort has 7 restaurants and we tried all of them. Vento was our overall favorite---large portions and excellent Italian and Mediterranean food! Our waiter at Vento, Jose Ramos, was excellent and really made our dining experience relaxing and enjoyable. Our next favorite restaurant was Gabby Beach, followed by the the Market Grill (on the beach), the Chinese restaurant and Passion.

Thank you to all of the hotel staff for making our trip so enjoyable and memorable:) We will be back for sure!!!!!

reviews.author: juancarlos2020
reviews.title: Buen hotel
reviews.text: Es un  hotel de lujo,  lleno  de vegetaciòn, apto para parejas que  quieren  relajarse y pasar tranquilos.

reviews.author: RosyJavi
reviews.title: Hotel totalmente recomendable. Volveremos.
reviews.text:
Mi marido y yo hemos pasado una semana de vacaciones en el Hotel en el mes de Agosto y ha sido fantástica. El hotel tenía mucha vida pero a la vez tranquilo si buscabas relajarte. Cada noche pudimos cenar en diferentes restaurantes, a mi marido que le encanta la carne le gustó mucho el Market Grill al lado de la playa, a mí el Bana con comida japonesa. Se encargaron de hacernos las reservas para cada noche pero incluso un día cambiamos porque quisimos ver el espectáculo de Michael Jackson y no supuso un problema. En la piscina pasaban frecuentemente tomandote nota de lo que querías beber. La verdad que hemos comido y bebido todo lo que quisimos y todo era de calidad. Te reponían el minibar cada día, y la cerveza Presidente (es de allí de Republica Dominicana) es buenísima. Los camareros y todo el personal es majísimo y muy servicial, siendo muy respetuosos pero siempre de buen humor. 
Hemos hecho varias excursiones, y no os tenéis que perder la de buggies por las dunas. Nos quedamos con ganas de probar el SPA que por cómo repartimos los días no lo visitamos hasta el último día y nos quedamos con las ganas..
Recomendamos totalmente este Hotel, nosotros intentamos cambiar de destino cada año, pero si tuviera que volver a la zona, sin duda sería al Palma Real.

reviews.author: Emily K
reviews.title: It was a home away from home.
reviews.text: Everyone was just wonderful. We met some great people and truly enjoyed our stay. There was one gentleman who went up and above the call do duties both at the pool and hydro bar, we stayed at the la reserve: Juan Bautista.  The weather was perfect and the entire stay was great. The only recommendation that I have is if you are traveling with a person who has a specific food diet to adhere to please check in with each host prior to ordering everytime. Have fun!!

reviews.author: TRJediKnight
reviews.title: Perfect Honeymoon
reviews.text:
It's VIP Concierge Service delivered a perfect service, since the booking of restaurants until the concern of an indication of best places to buy cigars, or which places to go, according to our likes and dislikes.
Excellent  service, dining, including our own beach concierge!
Hope I come back soon!

reviews.author: Pablo C
reviews.title: One of the Best in the World, defenetly going back
reviews.text: Starting from the services and the hospitality of the employees of the hotel was outstanding. The room and the facilities in the entire place were impeccable. Once again I would like to thank everyone there and we can't stop telling our friends about the dream vacation we had.

reviews.author: diana g
reviews.title: Es el mejor hotel en el cual me he alojado y el servicio es impecable
reviews.text: Tuvimos la oportunidad, con mi marido, de ir a este hotel. Pese a que el clima no nos acompañó del todo, las dependencias del hotel y por su puesto el servicio que brindan en realidad es de excelencia. De reyes. Sin duda si tenemos la posibilidad de regresar a Punta Cana nos alojaremos en él.

reviews.author: Pam
reviews.title: Paradisus Resort was nice but do not use Asm me about Luxury Weddings to book it
reviews.text:
Do not use Ask me about Luxury Weddings booking agent in Miami Florida to plan your wedding bookings.   They were horrible!  We booked our rooms for Paradisus through them and they charged more and would not let us alter our reservation on the same day that we made our reservation.  They were rude and dishonest.
The hotel itself, did a wonderful job on our nephews' wedding....Absolutely stunning beach wedding

reviews.author: le0nardit0elgrande
reviews.title: Our stay at  Paradisus Palma Real.
reviews.text:
We had  good time at the Paradisus Palma Real.
The service was very good. The staff were attentive to your needs.
The quality of the food is exceptional.
The restaurants were well appointed (if opened) and service wonderful.
They have entertainment everynight and activities during the day.
It is kid friendly. The beach is beautiful and well kept.
There are plenty of chaise lounge chairs and bali beds for everyone.
I would highly reccommend this resort for all of the above reasons.
Management not too experienced and lacking knowedge of operations
of this type of  hotel.
Hotel is overpriced , this is the reason we would not recommend to friends.

reviews.author: twilight03
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
We stayed at the reserve for 3 nights. A lot of people say this is the best part of the hotel and they were right. We had a room with a private pool. 2 jacuzzis, one outside of the room and one inside. The bedroom was very comfortable, it feels like you're in your own home. Buffet breakfast was always awesome. We sat at the same table all the time as one of the waiter, jose, always reserved it for us. Our coffe was always serve even before we sit down. Thank you jose for an excellent breakfast.
We ate at gabi beach restaurant, vento and they were all excellent. The buffet was not bad either compared to what other guests have said. We also ate at the small restaurant in the middle of the garden and pool. They have a small menu but still excellent. The grounds are amazingly well kept. I like to walk around the hotel where the spa is located every morning. Its very quiet and relaxing. The pools are clean. Always have beach beds available. Not crowded. The beach are amazing. Seeweeds didn't bother me or my fiance at all. We went for all activities possible. Went snorkelling, safari outback and horseback riding. If you do go try the safari outback. They will show you how locals live and truly understand how they survive. Free lunch with this excursion so its not bad.
Went to casino for five minutes and won $15 its not much but got extra money for souvenirs. Went outside of the resort to the market. We went with other people and I would advise you to do this if u plan on going outside. Its a lot cheapeR to buy souvenirs at the local market than inside of the hotel. U can bargain with the vendors and u can also trade ur own stuff. My fiance was wearing a yankees hat and one of the vendors tried to trade for a pack of cigars. He said no of course bcoz we don't smoke. There's also a little mall just outside of the resort, the shuttle bus can take u there but its also walking distance from the reserve. Its more expensive here than back in toronto so we didn't buy anything.
Overall, I loved my stay here at the reserve paradisus. I will recommend it to anyone. I would definitely come back but not anytime soon as I have other places in the world I would like to visit.

reviews.author: jsgViajero78
reviews.title: septiembre no debe ser buen mes
reviews.text:
Para empezar, como digo en el titular, septiembre no debe ser buen mez para ir a paradisus palma real. Yo comparto aqui mi experiencia en este hotel.

   Para empezar a la ducha de hidromasaje le falta una pieza, el buffet estaba cerrado casi tods las noches obligandonos a reservar en los restaurantes a horas tales como las 19:15, las 18:30 y caosas asi. Resulta que nos dicen que por temporada y ocupacion (30%) tienen cerrados 4 de los 7 restaurantes. Intentamos pedir un menu en español del room service hasta en 3 ocasiones y terminamos al final con 2 menus en igles/griego.
  Por la tarde/noche salimos a dar un paseo por la otra ala del hotel y vimos cucarachas correteando por los pasillos. Como es el mes que es (septiembre) pasaron algunas tormentillas por la zona y para nuestra sorpresa hasta 5 veces se fue la luz en todo el hotel, a todo esto añado, si habeis estado o teneis pensado visitarlo en algun futuro mirad en la parte baja de los armarios, tienen los cuadros electricos al aire.
 Mas cosas, se me ocurrió la feliz idea de ir a preguntar a recepcion los precios de la conexion a internet del hotel....atentos...12$ el cable de red sin reembolso + 15$ por dia de conexión....por una conexión de tan sólo 5 megas. Continuo diciendo que en la piscina no tienen otra cosa pa picar que no sean patatas fritas. Los vendedores de excursiones son tan tan tan pesados que nos vimos forzados a buscar otra manera de llegar a la habitacion que fuera por el lobby y encima son tan cutre que no te dejan quedarte con la pulserita.

Esta ha sido la experiencia que hemos tenido mi esposa y yo en una semana. Esperamos sinceramente que vosotros la disfruteis mejor que nosostros.

reviews.author: BeachBumLover
reviews.title: Does anyone know the name and email of the Royal Service Director and the General Manager?
reviews.text: I wanted to email the Royal Service Director and the General Manager to point out a few employees that made our stay particularly wonderful.

reviews.author: nubngoddess
reviews.title: The only review you need to read
reviews.text:
My husband and I just finished a one week stay at Paradisus Palma Real.  It was an awesome vacation and we would love to go back.

THE PROS:

The hotel is BEAUTIFUL.  We stayed in a regular king partial oceanview suite, not in the Reserve, or Royal Service.  The room was decorated nicely with marble finishes, and lovely mahogany furniture.   We took the "timeshare" presentation and saw the rooms at the reserve.  I wouldn't say they were nicer really, just decorated differently.  The regular rooms are more of what you'd expect at a caribbean resort.  The reserve rooms are more contemporary, as are the other features of the Reserve (Gabi restaurant, and Aqua Restaurant).  The reserve is also far from the beach, you have to take a golf cart, or walk about 10 minutes.  In that heat, 10 minutes is a long walk.  

Service is great.  Jonathan was our concierge.  It seemed he went out of his way to make sure we hade everything we needed on our trip and dropped whatever he was doing to take care of us.  99% of the other employees were just as friendly.  

Another employee, Jimmy, took me to the dance floor one evening and danced the dances he taught us in merengue class.  

Ramon at the pool bar, made sure you had a good time... Ask for "Fuego."  Also keep your eye on him.  You may catch him running to deliver a beer, with the cup on his head!

The pool.  It's huge, snakes through the middle of the property, and deeper than I thought it would be.  I'm just under 5'4, and had to be on very tip toes to keep my head above water without actually swimming or treading water.

The excursions are fun.  I'd recommend the speed boat.  If you have a heavy foot like me, this is the excursion for you.  You "drive" a small speed boat to a gorgeous snorkeling area, much better than the included snorkeling excursion.   Plus a trip to the "natural swimming pool," a sand bar about 1/2 a mile from shore where the water is waist deep, and the sand is soft and smooth, and very little current.

THE CONS:

Going to "the store."  Since there are many tourists, Dominican residents try to make their money as well, I don't blame them, but they can be a little annoying.  They're not allowed on the resort grounds, but when you walk along the beach, be prepared to be approached several times, by vendors who want you to visit their "store."  They all pretty much sell the same stuff, and don't seem willing to go too low on the prices considering the quality... For example, a T-shirt you could buy at Target for $10 they want to sell for $20.   

Excursion stores... local people know where the tourists go so they're set up at some spots on excurisions, like the cave swimming pool.  It seems my husband and I got approached more as African-Americans than others we were with.  We got the "hey my brother" or "hey my family" a lot.

Alcoholic beverages.  The drinks are included, but they don't have much alcohol. I'm a lightweight, (typically 2 glasses of Riesling and I'm drunk.) But I didn't even have a buzz after 3 or  4 drinks.  So... take a shot, or two, and sip the other drinks the rest of the day to maintain your buzz, or more!

No Jacuzzis: Our room had a whirlpool, but there were no REAL jacuzzis at the resort.  Not sure about Royal service.  There are about 4 or 5 "jacuzzis" in the main pool, but they're just a sectioned off part of the pool, with jets in them.  They're not hot, and they close when the pool does.  So if you're thinking about a late evening relaxing the in the hot tub, it'll be in your room.

RECOMMENDATIONS/CONS:
Take a waterproof watch.  This leads me to what is another con for me.  On vacation, I want to relax and do things at my leisure.  However, the excursions and most of the included activities require an appointment, at least a day ahead of time (and we went during the slow season).  Dinner also requires a reservation at the restaurants which again, forces you to "schedule" your day.  This may be a "pro" for some who like very organized vacations or those with families.  But for a couple who wants to relax and forget about the time, this can be a little less to be desired. ***Note Only 1 restaurant for breakfast, and 2 I think for lunch.  The others are only open for dinner.

Brush up on your spanish.  Spanish was my minor in college and it came in handy.  Most of the employees know a little english, their accents are heavy however, even with the ones who knew english pretty well.  I personally found for quick little things, like "what time is it?" (see above paragraph) it was easier to ask and get an answer in spanish.     

Check out the palapa behind the pool house.  Wi-fi is not included in the regular suites, but it is in Royal service.  There are a few palapas behind the pool house, (where you get towels) that are not IN Royal Service, but close enough, if you know what I mean :)

Go to the timeshare presentation.  It's actually different from a timeshare.   Had we been more prepared for something like this, and not actively trying to conceive our second child, and preparing for that financially, we may have signed up.  We met another couple from the US with 2 teenagers. They already have a timeshare but said, if they didn't, they would have joined the "vacation club" as the resort calls it, because it's much better than the timeshare they're part of now.

NOTES:
"Mamajuana" is a drink, also sold as a spice that's supposed to be an Aphrodisiac, it's not marijuana!

Before I went, I read complaints about brief power outages, and some finishes in the buildling.  This is the Dominican Republic, NOT the U.S.  We had a few brief power outages due to passing storms, but they were brief, and ALL happened at night when we were sleep.  They don't have the power grid like the U.S. but if it happens its back on soon.  As far as finishes, I saw a spot where the molding didn't go all the way to the wall.  It was between the door and the closet, about an inch wide.  If it were my house in the U.S. would I make the contractor fix it, of course.  Did I care about it in my hotel... no.   Again, this is the D.R. I would not expect that at a US hotel, but in a country with not even half the resources we have, I could let it pass.  Read the bad reviews with a grain of salt. Some people just can't be pleased.

You will have a bracelet you have to keep on to identify you as a resort guests, but every resort does this.  The ones here are actually pretty nice compared to some of the others we saw on excursions.

Use the safe.  We had no problems, but someone at the airport was complaining about having her purse stolen.  She wasn't at this resort, but the point is, should you be able to trust no one will steal your personal items? Yes.  Can you. No?  I use the safe in hotels in the US.  No exception for a country where many of the people are poor.

SUMMARY:
None of the cons will stop me from going back.  This is an incredibly beautiful resort, with just about all the amenities you want.  On some excursions we saw other resorts when the drivers picked up other guests... They weren't half as lovely as the Paradisus Palma Real.  It will be what you make of it... If you want a reason to complain, you'll find one.  If you want to have a great relaxing vacation, you will.

reviews.author: alfodaniel
reviews.title: un paraiso...espectacular .buen servicio...
reviews.text: somos de venezuela y decidimos tomar nuestras vacaciones en este hotel recomendado por rci y la verdad que nos parecio espectacular ,con dudas cuando nos fuimos por algunos malos comentarios que hacen personas que no se que se creen de verdad se quejan por cosas insignificantes como lo del brasalete eso es normal ,bueno en realidad para nosotros fue especial en el trato ,la comida para todos los gustos las instalaciones preciosas ,los restauranes exelente y la habitacion de maravilla de verdad que no me quejo lo recomiendo para aquellas personas que le gusta lo bueno.en fin unas vacaciones a todo dar ahora a planificar mis proximas vacaciones........

reviews.author: Patriciamax
reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text:
O hotel apesar de caro corresponde as expectativas, comida exelente e bebida variada em fartura.
Os quartos confortaveis ótimo para uma lua de mel.

reviews.author: wandav1108
reviews.title: Penosa
reviews.text:
Realmente penosa y decepcionante fue nuestra experiencia en Paradisus Palma Real, nos recibieron en el lobby con la amenaza de que si perdiamos el brazalete (1 cordon con pieza de coco) seriamos multados con $250.00 dolares, que debiamos cuidarlo mas que a nuestros documentos.
La habitacion olia a humedad, se daño el agua caliente. 

El servicio era pesimo, nadie te ofrecia nada, en el restaurante no te traian las bebidas, los mozos uno mandaba al otro y se hacian de la vista gorda.

Los bares quedan muy lejos de los lugares de estar, con la finalidad de que no consumas.  Los supervisores son odiosos y arrogantes.
Lamentable que tengamos personal asi en Republica Dominicana.

reviews.author: Luv2Travel_NM
reviews.title: Amazing Honeymoon!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus Palma for our honeymoon.  Everthing we needed was right there....restaurants, shows, water sports, exursions, the spa, bars everywhere, pool-side bar, the beach, and we LOVED our room!! We tried out all the restaurants, but I think we went to the Asian-fusion one at least 3 times :).  We also did a few of the included water activities and booked an exursion with Bavaro Road Runners.  We had a blast that week, and we plan to go back in a few years.

reviews.author: HaKim1024
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus Palma Real for our friend's wedding. Our stay there was really great!  Service was impeccable and everyone went out of their way to make sure you had a great stay; particularly the bartenders in the lobby. They make great drinks and try to keep you entertained.  

At night they offer small outdoor shows and during the day they have things like dance lessons.  The resort has a small casino and club. Both are nicely air conditioned.  There are several places to eat. You can eat at their buffet or make reservations to eat at their restaurants.  The asian/sushi restaurant I would not recommend. The sushi was rubbery and not fresh.  They have a great buffet and the room service is all inclusive as well.  

Rooms were spacious and clean. They have it fully stocked with shampoo, lotions, combs, qtips, etc.  The bathroom isn't all that private as they look right in to the sleeping area and the only thing that blocks the view are these shutters.  I guess if you are going with your significant other it doesn't matter but might be a tad awkward if you're rooming with a friend.  I would recommend to get a room on the 2nd or 3rd floor. We were on the ground floor and it seemed like we had more mosquitoes. FYI, the lobby is on the 2nd floor. Restaurants, casino, club, pool, and stores are on the ground floor.

The beach was clean but I remember it having a lot of seaweed.  We spent most of the time at the pool.  The pool is large but it’s not a fantastic pool.

I had two main complaints. The air conditioner did not work very well in our room. We always made sure to keep our doors shut and set at a nice temperature on auto. But the room was not consistently cool and almost always had a damp feeling to it.  Our other friends did not have this problem so it probably was just our room.  My other complaint was the food. While their food was good, it also made me sick. I was among others who felt this way but there were also others who felt fine. So just in case, make sure you bring Imodium! 

Overall, I would definitely recommend this resort to others. We had a fantastic time and service was really great. Make sure you try one of their signature drinks. I think one was called the Banana Mama and another called Chichi-kakaboka (?)....both delicious!

reviews.author: anrenav
reviews.title: Simplemente perfecto!
reviews.text:
Este año era la segunda vez que visitaba el Paradisus Palma Real. En la anterior ocasión me había alojado en una habitación estandar y en esta ocasión decidimos hacer un upgrade al Servicio Real.

Las habitaciones de Servicio Real se encuentran situadas en los dos edificios más próximos a la playa. Todas las habitaciones dan a un patio interior lleno de vegetación y con una fuente que nos regala con el sonido del agua durante el día. Toda la zona es perfumada y huele muy bien.

Las habitaciones son iguales en tamaño a las estandar, cambia la decoración y las atenciones que tienen. Amenities de lujo en el baño, mueble bar más completo, servicio de habitaciones con carta exclusiva..., son algunas de las diferencias. Además cuentas con un mayordomo que se encarga de perfumar la habitación, traerte almohadas perfumadas por la noche, fresas con chocolate, champán, preparar el jacuzzi, reservar los restaurantes y la palapa de la playa, y en definitiva cualquier servicio que puedas requerir del hotel.

La zona de SR cuenta con una zona privada en la playa con mayordomía que te acomoda en las palapas, te trae las toallas, bebidas y canapés, todo con un trato exquisito.

Además tiene piscina propia con bar propio. Los libros, revistas y bronceadores también están incluidos.

Al estar alojado en SR puedes hacer todas las comidas a la carta. El restaurante Vento se abre de modo exclusivo para los clientes de SR para el desayuno y la comida. Si se prefiere también se puede optar por ir al buffet, al market grill o al restaurante Gaby al mediodía (restaurante de pago para el resto de clientes).

Los desayunos a la carta son espectaculares. Zumos recién exprimidos servidos en copas heladas, excelente servicio de cafés (express, capuccino...), bollería recién hecha, y unos menús increibles, imposible acabarse tanta comida. 

Al medio día el mismo restaurante Vento es una opción estupenda para comer, únicamente están los clientes que se alojan en SR y eso hace que se esté muy bien. De los platos destaco los linguini arrabiata. Muy buenos. El servicio excelente, al tener muy pocos clientes a los que atender es muy personalizado e increiblemente rápido (tiempos muy europeos).

La otra opción al medio día es el Gaby beach, un restaurante de pago para el resto de clientes, y probablemente el restaurante donde mejor se come de todo el complejo. La única pega es que los clientes alojados en The Reserve y en el Family pueden acceder a él y está muy lleno por lo que el servicio es lento. 

Por último está el buffet y el market grill (restaurante para comer hamburguesas, fajitas y carnes a la brasa). 

En general la comida es muy buena. Conozco varios resorts de la zona y jamás había podido comer carne que fuera comestible en Punta Cana. Aquí la carne está muy rica y el pescado a la plancha excelente.

Las cenas se hacen todas a la carta, al igual que todos los clientes del complejo, con la única diferencia de que puedes cenar en el Gaby Beach. Es donde sirven langosta.

Los clientes de SR cuentan con un lobby privado que durante todo el día está abierto y tiene servicio de café, champán y bebidas alcohólicas premium y dependiendo de la hora aperitivos o pasteles. Increibles las vieras.  
También cuentan con tres ordenadores conectados a internet y de uso gratuito para los clientes del SR. En la habitación, piscina y playa hay wifi gratuita para el Royal Service.

Todo esto que os he contado son los servicios que ofrece el Servicio Real. Todo aderezado con el excelente trato que recibes por parte de todo el personal y que estás rodeado de parejas de más de 18 años que están tan encantados como tú, hace que el ambiente sea simplemente delicioso.

reviews.author: CapochaBuenosAires
reviews.title: Ojo no es un leading hotels of the world
reviews.text:
A pesar de que el Hotel pertenece a la cadena Leading Hotels of the World, esta muy lejos de ser un hotel de esta categorìa, seguramente pagan muchos dolares para estar en ese listado, cosa que no entiendo.
Me aloje desde el 22 al 29 de Agosto de 2010 fui con mi mujer y pase unas hermosas vacaciones, en infraestructurael hotel esta muy bien, hay detalles que muestran que esta un poco descuidado, nosotros nos alojamos en La reserva, lo recomiendo mas que en el hotel palma real ya que hay beneficios adicionales como 3 restaurantes en la Reserva y otro el Gabi Beach sobre la playa que quienes estan el Palma real, si quieren comer ahi deben pagar adicionalmente y cuesta unos 50 dolares por persona por comida, por lo que es una gran ventaja sino tienes que almorzar en el buffet que es casi lo mismo recalentado todos los dias
A quien l guste comer bien este hotel deja mucho mucho que desear, el el MUNDO DEL RECICLADO DE COMIDA, no se si es porque agosto es temporada baja y les sobra mucha comida de la que preparan, pero es evidente como te la reciclan y te vas encontrando la misma comida en diferentes restaurantes, por ejemplo en la recepcion de La Reserve todos los dias arman una mesa muy decoradite pero lo que sirven son las sobras de lo que quedaron en los restaurantes, por ejemplo ceviches, fiambres cortaditos en trozos muy pequeños, postres, etc.
Una noche fuimos a cenar a Passion que tiene un toque frances, pedimos un boulovant relleno de mariscos, y oh sorpresa, nos trajeron una medialuna del desayuno rellena con la misma cazuela de mariscos que habiamos almorzado en el gabi club, le dijimos al camarero, fue hablo con el cheff y dijo que uso eso proque se le terminaron los boulovants..
En toda la semana no hubo un solo camaron en el hotel, nos decian que por la eopca no se conseguian, al regreso en el avion hable con gente que se paso comiendo camarones en otro hotel
La habitacion tuvimos que cambiarla 3 veces porque sobre todo las de planta baja tienen un olor a humedad terrible, nos dieron una en el segundo piso ( no hay ascensor) que tenia un dispositivo plastico tras la cortina que absorvia la humedad
Hay una sala de juegos para niños abierta de 2 a 23 hs donde el olor a humedad es insoportable
Al llegar te asignan una persona que te hace las reservas de restaurantes que te presiona a sisitir a un almuerzo o desayuno de 90 minutos donde te quieren vender un Club Vacacional de Melia, si bien no te presionan la charla dura mas de 2 horas y si no quieres comprar no te recomiendoperder 3 hs de playa
En la playa no te ofrecen comida como en otros hoteles y el Market grill sobre la playa donde supestamente hacen hamburguesas, papas fritas estuvo cerrado toda la semana
Las clases de tenis son a las 10 y 17 hs luego tienes que pagarlas en otros horarios 30 dolares la hora
Nuestra habitacion tenia una gotera de agua en el aire acondicionado, lo arregalron pero luego sigui perdiendo agua en el living, los canales de tv se veian  mal como con lluvia
No te dejan programa de actividades impreso por lo que tienes que andar averiguando que ocurre cada dia
En la playa hay muchas algas marinas ( No es Mar Caribe ) en Bavaro es Oceano Altantico no te confundas
Lo peor fue la comida, me dijeron que el cheff principal es mexicano y tambien su asistente, en reciclaje y decoracion de la comida es un genio, en calidad, sabor les falta muchisimo!!
De postres no tienen idea son postres casi todos artificiales con gusto a nada, les falta reposteria, los helados solo eran de frutilla y chocolate muy artificiales, si te gustan los dulces este no es tu lugar
En conclusion es un buen Hotel pero no esperes un Leading of the Word deberian sacarlo de la lista

reviews.author: Orb
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text:
Hemos estado en Agosto de 2010 y encontramos el hotel un tanto decepcionante, no por las instalaciones en sí que son buenas pero algunas se pueden mejorar ,por ejemplo, el gimnasio es pequeño y poco cuidado tiene máquinas estropeadas y con óxido, las habitaciones tienen mucha humedad y hay muchos “desconchones” de pintura por todas paredes, el DVD de la habitación no funcionaba, la TV en muchas ocasiones, se oía pero no se veía nada, la psicina principal, un tanto sucia, sobre todo en la zona de piscina dónde está el bar dónde había vasos o bolsas de patatas en el agua...... si no eres socio del Vacation Club o está alojado en el  Reserve, no hay internet incluido, si lo quieres, lo pagas y muy caro, 8$ 15 minutos en una sala con dos viejos portátiles o por WIFI tampoco gratis, nuestra habitación, estaba muy lejos de las piscinas y de la recepción, había que caminar durante un buen rato por un pasillo tipo laberinto para llegar a las zonas comunes y eso fue lo 1º que nos dijo el chico de recepción para al mismo tiempo, ofrecernos una habitación más cercana pero por supuesto, más cara, la playa del hotel,está llena de algas, muchas hamacas de la piscina o de  la playa, están rotas o en mal estado, no se puede pasar a zonas comunes de hoteles de la misma cadena que están pegados, muchas lagartijas por las paredes de las zonas comunes para ir a las habitaciones, cosa normal porque están llenas de plantas y vegetación .......etc.

Por las noches, los espectáculos son de escasa calidad y dentro de las instalaciones, hay una discoteca ridícula, descuidada y sin ningún tipo de movimiento, en resumen, parece que el hotel no es para gente joven y que está enfocado a un turismo de edad avanzada o a familias con niños que prefieren tranquilidad y si llueve (llovió un día entero) no hay alternativas de ocio y ni siquiera el hotel las propone, el huésped se dedica a estar en la habitación o  deambular por las zonas comunes pero en ningún momento el personal del hotel incentiva o propone alternativas para pasar el rato, con lo cuál, el aburrimiento se llega a contagiar pues ves a todo el mundo sentado pasando las horas sin hacer nada ya que ni naipes tienen en el hotel.

Aunque lo peor de toda la semana, fue el "acoso" sufrido para que nos hiciéramos socios del Vacation Club de la cadena, nos hicieron perder 90 minutos de una estupenda mañana de sol para  vendernos este tema y la chica que nos atendió al final de la reunión, nos resultó un tanto borde e incluso maleducada cuándo le dijimos que no estábamos interesados en hacernos socios, dando lugar a una situación muy desagradable porque en todo momento te dicen que no tienes ningún compromiso pero parece todo lo contrario, te hablan como si te sobrase el dinero para esto y finalmente te hacen sentir muy incómodo por no estar interesado. Este tema y las formas de algunos agentes, directamente sobran en un hotel de esta supuesta categoría.

Otra cosa a destacar, es el servicio de camareros, es bueno pero muy lento (Sirva como ejemplo que en varias comidas en el buffet, nos trajeron la bebida cuándo ya habíamos terminado de comer y eso es porque no hay bebidas para que tú te sirvas, ellos te ponen agua al sentarte y si quieres otra cosa, se la pides en ese momento, luego vas a por tu comida y te deberían traer la bebida, pero tardan muchísimo cuándo había muchos camareros y poca gente). El servicio, tiene una actitud muy diferente ante los clientes que dejan propinas, es decir, ante los ojos de todo el mundo, se deshacen en servicios y en elogios de forma muy descarada con la gente que les deja propinas, teniendo con el resto de clientes una actitud correcta pero muy diferente y esto, no nos parece bien, pues el hotel, parece que dejara caer en manos del cliente la calidad de su atención según deje o no propinas y esto no debería ser así en un hotel de calidad superior y muy caro como es éste, esos detalles, se deberían cuidar mucho por parte de la dirección del hotel al igual que la actitud de los chicos/as que te reciben al llegar y te enseñan un poco las instalaciones, en todo momento te están insistiendo para que cada vez que reservas o quieres hacer algo dentro del hotel, digas que ha sido gracias a ellos o por recomendación de ellos, me imagino que será porque reciben incentivos y yo entiendo que se trata de un país con necesidades, pero también entiendo que no es lo más correcto en un hotel de esta categoría, haciendo sentir a la gente que tienen la obligación de dejar propinas a todo el mundo, cuándo ya has pagado una cantidad de dinero muy considerable por pasar allí una semana.

Los restaurantes y la comida, en general están bien, pero tienen unas normas un tanto "extremas", si quieres comer en cualquiera de los restaurantes que no sea el buffet, pero que también están incluidos en el precio, tienes que hacer la reserva en recepción, antes de las 16.00 Horas del mismo día, si estás en la piscina y te olvidas, pues cenas en el buffet porque en los restaurantes se necesita esa reserva y eso aunque haya mesas disponibles, que las hay ,pues son restaurantes grandes y hay varios por no decir que si llegas en punto a la hora, recogen toda la comida y no te dan opción para comer.

En resumen, nos imaginábamos un hotel de gran categoría y muy superior al resto de complejos  de los alrededores pero por lo que vimos y nos contó gente que se alojaba en otros complejos muchísimo más baratos que éste, creemos que no vale la pena pagar más porque ofrecen lo mismo. 

Un consejo sería que el que vaya a este hotel o a uno cercano, es que se cerciore bien antes de viajar a que aeropuerto llega o se va, pues el aeropuerto de Santo Domingo desde el hotel, se tardan 4 horas en autobús por unas carreteras comarcales dónde literalmente te juegas la vida circulando por las mismas pues la conducción en el país es realmente temeraria, no es broma pues lo llegas a pasar mal con las cosas que ves en la carretera. El aeropuerto más cercano, es el de Punta Cana, a 15 minutos.

A lo mejor, es porque en verano es la temporada baja y el servicio es peor pero lo consideramos un tanto flojo para el dinero pagado y es una opinión compartida por otros huéspedes con los que hablamos del tema y no es que seamos unos sibaritas, pero viajábamos con unas altas expectativas pues nos vendieron el hotel como el mejor y más exclusivo resort ( o por lo menos de los mejores) de la isla y no ha sido así.

reviews.author: Francisca S
reviews.title: paradisus
reviews.text: El lugar es hermoso. Las piezas impecables. El servicio muy bueno. Pudimos hacer snorkeling casi todos los días previa reserva. Lo malo, los tragos o bebidas alcohólicas. Todas eran tan artificiales que se hacían intomables, fue mi mayos desilusión. Uno espera poder beber buenos tragos en un lugar así y este no fue el caso. Las bebidas como son de máquina nunca tenían gas... muy malo.  De todos los restaurantes el más entretenido fue el mizu... pero no por eso la mejor comida. Creo que todos están parejos en su calidad de comida, no tan buena. El Gabi club tb fue uno con mejor aspecto en comida. Es un lugar para ir con la familia o ir a descansar.

reviews.author: ALehm90571
reviews.title: Don't miss it!
reviews.text:
It has been nearly a year now since our honeymoon and I have been meaning to write a review. We had been recommended this resort by a co-worker of mine as well as one of my husband's. We had high expectations but are fairly easy to please individuals. The resort is definitly the nicest on the stretch of beach that we were on, because we walked up and looked at others while we were there. 
~It was November and the weather was good. The locals thought it was terrible b/c it rained a couple of times, but you need to get out of the sun occasionally and have some food anyway. 
~We booked the lowest grade room and our expectations were exceeded. 
~The room, linens and bathroom were very clean. We were wondering if there was going to be a jaccuzi in the room and there was so we were pretty pumped about that. 
~The food was good/moderate- the dinners were nice but we did get slightly bored of eating the same things at lunch. The fruit was amazing though so we had lots of that. 
~The drinks were great and if you toss your waiter a couple of dollars here and there, they treat you very well. The belinis in the itallian restaurant were great and we went back several nights to the bar just for those. 
~The conceirge service was poor for us because we wouldnt rent a time share, but we expected that and didn't really need it anyway. 
~The nightlife was scarce but we didn't need it because they played music several nights in the courtyard and we danced it up and had a great time. 
~Rent the windsurfers- because when else in your life are you going to do that for free!? We rented kayaks too which was fun to cruise around. 
~We played golf close by and went on a dune buggy trip that was pretty fun - sketchy to drive off into the middle of no where in a stake bed truck, but it all went well and we got to see some of the true domincan
~The spa was AMAZING- get the hot stone massage and make sure you do the water ritual before hand so show up 45 min early. Well worth it. 
Overall we had a great time on the beach, in the pool and hanging out at night. I would highly recommend it to a friend.

reviews.author: WorldyImages
reviews.title: Accident at the Reserve
reviews.text:
I booked a trip for my father in law and his fiance to stay at the Reserve in June 2010 since they have not been on vacation for over 20 years. Everything was very good except that the glass on the coffee table in the room was broken. My father in law raised his foot and cut his entire foot on the broken glass table. He had to go to the doctor to get stiches and antibiotics. He was unable to swim and enjoy most of his vacation. I asked the hotel to give them a free week since they are clearly at fault. They said flat out that they would not give him anything. Even when I told them I would contact a lawyer, they apologized and said they could not offer him anything. 
I have been to this hotel and recommended friends and family. When I stayed at Melia next door they were giving out free vouchers for 1 week for viewing the Reserve time shares. But clearly they could not give my father in law the same offer after having the incident doumented from their doctor and pictures provided. Needless to say he did not have a good vacation being he was injured and unable to go swimming in the 90 degree.

reviews.author: benchwas
reviews.title: 5 star facility, 3 star management
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful, the management is clueless.  My favorite line was when we checked in.  The bell hop brought our luggage to our room.  When we entered, it was evident that the room had no power.  The bell hop checked the breakers and spent 2 minutes checking things out before using the phone to call the desk.  He spent about a minute talking to the desk (in Spanish) before requesting me to talk to the desk.  Keep in mind the room still had no power when I picked up the phone.  The first words out of the front desks mouth was "how can I help you?".  It seemed obvious to me I as I requested a room with power.  He then told me that the whole resort lost power and it would return shortly.  Electricity did return within a few minutes, but it did go out about once a day for a couple of minutes.  
Let me step back to checking in...  The front desk will ask you for a $600 credit card deposit when checking in and is reluctant to take AMEX.  We ended up giving them a mastercard and they seemed to have credited it back at the end of the stay.  As it turns out, other guests told us that they refused and were able to check in without a deposit.  Before I get into the initial issues, I want to point out that I tipped the front desk $5, the concierge $20 and the bell hop $5 upon arrival.  Your next step is meeting with a concierge before they take you to a room.  These people are worthless, in fact they are time share sales in disguise.  They want you to do a "no pressure" tour of the time shares.  I explained to him that I had no interest and we were on our honeymoon, but he continued to push.  I also had read other reviews and decided to make all of our restaurant reservations on day one to prevent any issues.  He was not willing to do this as he wanted a reason for us to need him so he could push the time share tour on a daily basis.  He was obnoxious, worthless, and had no place on a 5 star resort.  The Dominicans seem to think that pushy trashy people are part of their culture and par for the course.  We heard the excuse many times that we were in the Dominican when we brought a problem to management's attention (power outages, warm - no hot water, overly pushy vendors on site, a/c that kind of worked).   Getting back to the restaurant reservations...  I told him that I wanted to eat at Bana the following evening, he then said "ok, bana or venta".  I repeated no, I said Bana.  The next day when we met with him before breakfast, he told us bana was closed and we had reservations at venta.  It is a game they all play attempting to make simple tasks seem more difficult.  They know a week ahead of time what is open each day.  We met another couple who paid extra for a butler in royal service who tried to make simple tasks seem more difficult as well.  All you want to hear on your honeymoon is "yes sir, right away" or "I'll take care of it".  Not constant back and forth making a simple dinner reservation take 30 minutes.  These people are either dishonest or incompetent.  Back to the meeting with the concierge before breakfast...  After he told us that our reservation was at a different restaurant than we requested, he started the time share push again.  I told him that we wanted a room with cold a/c and hot water (water was warm at best) before we would even consider returning to the resort.  He sent a maintenance worker up to the room who didn't understand English at all.  He turned the shower and tub on and let them run for 10 minutes.  He then motioned to me to check the water.  I checked the water and told him that it was still just warm.  He apparently didn't understand and left thinking everything was ok.  At this point I was annoyed and left the room for the front desk.  I asked for a manager and explained that I was frustrated with the following in my first 20 hours at the resort.  Street vendors set-up inside the resort that physically stopped us and wouldn't let us pass, no hot water, a/c that kind of worked, an obnoxious concierge that wouldn't make dinner reservations and constantly pushed time share sales, and finally no recognition of our honeymoon when they advertise a free "glow" package for honeymooners who stay a minimum of 5 nights (they made a copy of our marriage license upon check-in).  She explained the overly pushy street vendors as "you are in the Domincan".  I told her it was unacceptable to thave that element in a resort of this caliber.  They have no clue to what 5 star service means.  She ended trying to send maintenance to the room again when I explained to her that it was time to put us in a room with hot water, not another failed attempt.  She finally returned to my room and offered to put me in a nearby room.  We checked 2 other rooms and they apparently shared the same hot water heater as the water was the same temp.  She told me that Dominicans don't like to shower with hot water and used 
the "you are in the Dominican" excuse.  It took everything I had to not tell her that "funny, there doesn't seem to be any Dominicans staying here.  maybe you should cater to guests that can afford $400 or more per night".  Funny thing is that the hot water finally started working on the third day as someone must have finally turned the temp up.  They also adjusted something that brought the a/c down from 76 to 72 (rumor has it that the front desk can control it and won't turn it down unless you complain).  The manager also offered to make my dinner reservations and had them delivered to the room written in a note.  I'm glad she wrote them down because the restaurants never got them and I had to show them the note each night.  Same thing happened when our friends asked their butler to put the 4 of us together for dinner.  He spent 30 minutes checking back with us 3 times at the pool telling us that he was working on it.  He finally told us that he took care of it, but the restaurant never received it.  The restaurant was accommodating and did take care of us.  
The buffets are adequate and the restaurants are ok.  Do steer clear of the steaks as they are terrible.  Bana is fun hibachi experience, but our cook added way too much salt and soy sauce (and we are salt lovers).  Felt a little sick afterwards...  As another reviewer said, all of the restaurants serve basically the same food.  We went to Bana, Venta, Aqua and Passions.  Gabi Beach is the restaurant you can only use if you are in the Reserve or Royal Service, but seems to be the same food.  The concierge will offer you a free dinner there valued at over $300 (his words) if you do the time share.  Don't get suckered...
I don't want people to think that this is not a nice resort.  I just want to give future guests a heads up.  So here is the good...  The resort is on a huge beach with white white sand.  They have beach security that keeps most of the locals away.  If you wander too far down Bavaro beach, the jet-ski/parasailing people will be all over you.  And every once in a while someone will try to sell you drugs or prostitutes.  The pools are huge with sunken lounge chairs and are really nice.  The pictures do not do the place justice.  We met several very friendly bartenders that were great.  One in Gabi Beach and another in the lobby bar that were awesome.  The room was 5 star except for a couple odd items.  The fan seemed to be 15 years old in a 4 year old resort and the mirror in the bathroom was damaged.  The bathroom has a huge 2 person jacuzzi tub.  The bed was firm and very comfortable.  The room seemed to have been cleaned 3 times per day.  The mini fridge is stocked with orange juice, soda, water and oddly one beer.  We never tried room service as we were never hungry.  If you want the room stocked with liquor, it is an extra charge.  The resort offers free excursion and activities.  We used the paddle boats, catamarans, went snorkeling and did the horseback riding.  Beware that horseback riding requires a 30 minute open air bus ride that I wouldn't do again given the choice.  It is free, but the "ranch" holds you hostage at the end for 30 minutes trying to get you to buy the pictures they took of you.  They put them on a CD and sold me the 35 pics for $30.  It was overpriced but figured it was ok since the excursion was free.  Besides, I figured they could use the money to care for the horses.  They also offer free scuba diving, but I didn't want to put my life in these peoples hands.  I would also skip the snorkeling as it is not that exciting.  If you do go snorkeling, bring plenty of bread and fruit to attract the fish.  If you want to spend the extra hundred bucks a day, the Reserve seems to be even nicer.  I would steer clear of the Royal Service, especially during the slow season when they are more of an annoyance.  Maybe it has value when the resort is full as lounge chairs and dinner reservations become more difficult.  We were concerned about staying in the Reserve as it wasn't on the beach.  We now know that it is only a couple minute golf cart ride and they are always available.  The Reserve pools are incredible and are surrounded by raked sand as opposed to tile.  You have to see it to appreciate it.  The website does a poor job of showing how amazing this place really is.  I did ask several of the staff and taxi cab drivers which was the nicest resort in Punta Cana and they all said that the Paradisus Palma Real was hands down.  We did walk down Bavaro Beach and check out a couple of the other resorts.  I think the place next door is called the Caribe Malina and seemed to be a good place for families.  They had more things for children.  
Lastly, night-life is minimal and the shows are not worth seeing.  They have a "disco", but we never saw anyone in it and kudos to them for having it open each night with no guests.  We spent every night in the casino after dinner.  I didn't have much luck at the blackjack tables and watch out for the dealers.  They are either all new or not very smart.  I constantly had to correct them as they tried to under pay myself and others at the table. Especially when they had to payout 1.5 times for blackjack...  
Trip Advisor's search engine seems to have the best rates, but make sure you add "otel.com" to the search.  For someone reason it doesn't search it unless you check it.  If you find a cheaper rate at one of the other major sites, see if they are on ebates.com before booking.  Ebates is "click-thru" that will give you a 1% - 3% cash rebate on your total purchase.  I use it all the time when I book through priceline and expedia.  I have earned an extra $118 this year just by logging into them first.
I would book this resort again, just be on the look-out for the time share sales and spotty service.

reviews.author: mcfields
reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent 6 nights at the PPR in late August.  We had a great stay.  There were a few gliches but when we're on vacation we try and go with the flow as much as possible.  To start, the grounds and hotel were STUNNING.  I would give them 5 stars.  The beach was goregous...turquoise warm water & soft white sand and we really enjoyed it.  The pools were a lot of fun too.  There was plenty of room if you wanted quiet but we also enjoyed late afternoon cocktails at the pool bar.  We found the other guests very metropolitan and friendly.  

The food was good.  I think it was as good as an all-inclusive can be.  It starts out great and by the end of the week everything starts tasting a little bit the same and you're ready for your own food. But overall we thought the variety at the lunch buffett was very good and we enjoyed each of the restaurants for dinner.  Our favorite was Gabi Beach.  Great atmosphere, open concept, right on the water and their food was probably the most sophisticated.   The restaurants do enforce the dress code so - guys, be sure to bring dress shoes and shirts. 

There is not much nightlife.  We enjoyed the casino but if you don't like to gamble, its definitely on the quiet side.  

Our biggest complaint was that our room was extremely musty.  I am not being overly critical and I realize we are in a warm, moist climate but the must smell in the room was overbearing and a little disappointing for an otherwise beauitful hotel.

I would definitely recommend PPR to friends. Its a great place to go, relax, and enjoy the sun...it just needs a few more tweaks until its absolute perfection.

reviews.author: NeetNewJersey
reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
My husband and I vacation with friends every year and we were really looking forward to staying at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The hotel is absolutely gorgeous.  Unfortunately, we got off to a poor start when we requested to have rooms on the same floor.  Clearly it was off season and the resort  was more than half empty, but we were hassled to no end and basically told that unless we upgraded our rooms for an additional $294, they would have to put us not just on different floors, but in different buildings.  We asked to speak to the manager but the guy checking us in indicated he was the manager and there was no one on duty higher than him.  As you can imagine, this is not the way to start a vacation, especially one was already considerably pricey.  With this as a start, we immediately regretted our choice and went from being excited to pretty bummed out.

Fortunately, during our seven day stay, he was the only employee we encountered who did not go above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.  The grounds and the beach were beautiful and the pool was lots of fun.  The lobby and the colonial plaza were even prettier than the pictures.  We took a tour of the Reserve, but it was isolated from the rest of the facilities and didn't seem to be worth the extra money, especially since all of the activity was in the main building.

Our concierge was Jonathan Francois and he was excellent.  He made all of our dinner reservations and checked in with us several times a day.  The room was very nice and housekeeping came two to three times a day to freshen it up.  Although spanish is the primary language, most of the employees spoke enough english that we could still communicate fairly well.

There are shows and performances every night but the nightlife is pretty non existent.  At night most guest upgraded from shorts and tee shirts to "resort casual", skirts and capris for women; nice pants and shirts for men.  The food was okay but enough choices that almost everyone could find something they liked.

Overall we still ended up having a great vacation but couldn't help but feeling as though the whole upgrade fiasco  was a bait and switch.

reviews.author: marin_antonio19
reviews.title: No volveria.....por lo menos a una royal service
reviews.text:
Contratamos una suite royal  service de las que están enfrente del mar.

La llegada fue una pesadilla. Tuvimos que esperar hasta las 5 o 6 de la tarde y para colmo de males, cuando entramos en la suite, FALTABAN la mitad de las amenites. Las botellas de agua y el café estaban abiertos.......sin comentarios. Pensábamos que era una broma de cámara oculta, hasta que al día siguiente nos trajeron una botella de ron, también abierta.

El servicio de habitaciones de coña. Desayunar en la habitación se podía convertir casi en comer, depende del siroco que le diese al que tenía que atenderte, podía tardar dos, tres horas......

Un día echamos ropa a lavar. La sorpresa fue mayúscula cuando ví que no llegaban dos camisas. Me decían que ya llegarán.......nunca llegaron. Puse una queja a a la responsable del club royal y la poco profesional de ella no me hizo ningún caso y todavía la energúmena mirando mal, en vez de disculparse.......

Al final, por muy bonita que fuese la habitación, el mal trato recibido y lo guarro que fue el servicio de habitaciones, hizo que el lujo desmereciese.

Fantástico el mayordomo, el servicio de playa y en general, el servicio de restauración.

Absolutamente lamentable y demencial el trato recibido por la responsable del club royal. No está a la altura de ese hotel

reviews.author: Junior101
reviews.title: Decent, but not worth the money
reviews.text: We traveled to this resort christmas week through new years last year. I am a 21 yr old guy with a 25 yr old sibling and we traveled there with our parents for just over a week. The facility was seriously incredible and beautiful, and the atmosphere was spectacular. Upon arrival, you enter an open lobby facing the ocean. It is filled with many places to hang your hat and have a drink every day. Growing up in a family that has visited many countries and various fine hotels, I was a bit shocked by a few aspects of this particular vacation. After checking into both rooms, we came across various issues. First off, my brother and i were not on our honeymoon so the "see through" bathroom wasnt so great for us. The room was humid as hell and the power went out every night when getting dressed to go out. I understand the whole going green thing, but come on no one should have to get stuck in the shower in the dark!!! The nightlife was ok, if not for the casino we would have killed ourselves. The facility was spectacular at night especially, and we made our way to the beach huts after eating dinner. I am a hospitality major and have never seen such terrible food, although this is all inclusive it does not mean your paying for low quality slop. Also, all the food for each restaurant is made in one kitchen, so running from one restaurant to another within the resort is just useless. Unfortunately, the hotel is just not reaching its potential. It is not feasible to ask people to upgrade to the "royal service" and than assign them a useless butler that ends up being a inconvenience that needs to be tipped when departing. It was impossible to get a bed at the Royal pool and the upgrade was a complete waste for my parents. The staff has good intentions, however, they simply cannot communicate with the tourists and therefore makes the service awful. I do not mean to be negative, however, we all know in this day and age that the economy has declined and we all want value for our dollar, this place really doesnt give that. My last and final complaint is the food, who goes on vacation and wants bad food? My family ended up trying most of the restaurants, however, we would make our way to the buffet every night to replenish ourselves after not eating. Passion was the best restaurant in retrospect, however, at least with the buffet you know what your getting. Despite what others say, the buffet is the only way  to get by we thought. The beach is incredible and there are various gardens and places to lay out and enjoy the sun. I will also say, from a young adults point of view, the water activities are difficult to come by. My brother and I chased around some vendors on the beach and finally were able to sign up for some fun activities, however, they are extremely expensive and not all that safe. Keep in mind, beach activities are not run by the hotel. I would recommend the ATV excursion, make sure to put 7 hours aside though. Overall, the biggest problem with Paradisus is the lack of communication between everyone , both staff and guests. The all inclusive alcohol is great and there is a good bar scene. Guests are generally very friendly and actually share the same complaints with each other during the stay. I think this hotel has so much potential, i just think for now I would not recommend it!

reviews.author: Toutpartout
reviews.title: Resort life at its best
reviews.text:
Travelled  to Punta Cana here for a conference . Stayed at the Pariadisus Palma Real which is one of 3 hotels on the compound. 

Resort is expansive, alot to do, no real need to venture outside. THere is literally everything onsite. 

There is even a mall near the exit but within the hotel compund to keep you shopping- good souvenir shops , even a cinema but the clothing stores are brand names which are much more expensive than in the USA- so don't bother buying brand names
Rooms are impeccable, food supply unending, staff very friendly, pool and beaches , gym and  landscaping  amazing.

Conference rooms  well-equipped. 

What more can I say except I never left the compound- there was literally everything on site. Had no experience of the local culture which was a bit sad but such is resort life!

Multiple restaurants, multiple pools, beware of the 15 USD charge to use the internet at the business centre and in your room.

Excellent hotel overall and the hotel photographer is excellent- really!

reviews.author: texas325
reviews.title: Totally Wonderfull
reviews.text:
I stayed at the reserve at paradisus palma real for 7 days and I spent a Wonderfull and unforgettable experience.
everything was perfect.
i was in my honey mom it was incredible this guys really know who to treat people
especially the concierges Gustavo and Genaro they were the whole week with us planning our dinner reservations and everything that we wanted.
Beach and Poll area very clean.food at restaurant Gabi Club and Aqua were really good.

I tiped the same day that I left the hotel and it did not make any diference in the 7 days during the stay

reviews.author: NatGon
reviews.title: THE RESERVE - Absolutamente fabuloso
reviews.text:
Al inicio de este año, mi pareja, los niños y yo hemos estado en The Reserve, en Punta Cana. Al principio estábamos en el hotel principal "Paradisus Palma Real" pero ya luego fuimos a The reserve y la verdad es que es una pasada. 
El lugar: es más que hermoso. Decorado muy moderno y acogedor. Todo de muy alta categoría. A diferencia del paradisus, the reserve tiene el lobby con aire acondicionado, en el cual se pueden degustar ricos aperitivos en el área de Family Consierge como lo llaman. También tienen tv plasma super gigantes y muy cómodos sofas para pasarla bien. El servicio de internet con las computadoras en una mesa gigante y muy elegante, con sillas muy cómodas, las cuales no es extraño que las personas del  front desk siempre las mantengan en orden y si necesitas algo, puedes preguntar a alguna de las chicas y con gusto te atenderán. El buffet Gabi es de lo mejor, pasamos casi todas las noches en este lugar tan hermoso mirando las hermosas luces que emergían desde el fondo de la piscina. El centro para los niños "The kid Zone" es uno de los lugares mas bellos para los niños que hemos visto en otro hoteles que hemos ido, no tiene punto de comparación.
Check-in: Al llegar, nos atendieron muy calurosamnete y con mucha elegancia. Los chicos maleteros fueron muy atentos con nosotros y siempre estaban presto. Recordamos al señor Luis con mucho cariño. El check in es sentados!!!!! De lo mas cómodo y personalizado. Nos dieron parte de las informaciones puesto que el resto le correspondía a nuestro conserge, el cual no vimos, sino hasta el otro día.
El servicio: Al otro día fuimos al front desk y nos hicieron llamar a quien sería nuestro conserge el cual, al parecer no estaba, pero en su lugar vino una chiquita "Gerardine".
Ella fue muy amable y nos explicó todas las informaciones del hotel, nos entregó unos telefonitos con números directos para llamarla en cualquier momento, como iba el tema de las reservas de los restaurantes, el servicio para los niños y otras cosas. La verdad es que quedamos impresionados con el trato tan personalizados. Los niños se pasaron la mayor parte del tiempo con ella. Los llevaba al kid zone, los acompañaba a la playita o a cualquier otro lugar que pidiéramos. Luego pedimos un babysitter y para nuestra suerte ella fue quien cuidó de nuestros pequeños. Durante nuestra estadía, ella tuvo días libres y los niños no paraban de preguntar por ella, tanto que cuando estuvo de regreso los niños no querían irse a la cama sin que ella los cubriera. Que monada!!
La comida: La comida estuvo mas que deliciosa. En especial en el restaurante "Vento" "Banna" "Aqua" y "Tepanyaki". En este ultimo hacen un cooking show y toda la cosa. Teníamos room service el cual era muy rico y rápido.

Las playas, el sol, el ambiente un poco tosco de respirar y todoooo fue fabuloso.
A la hora de salir nuestro vuelo tuvo problemas por el mal tiempo, yo hubiese querido quedarme mas tiempo por lo que fuera, pero bueno... Nos quedamos en la habitación del hotel sin ningún problema. Como nos ibamos en la  madrugada, gerardine vino a despedirse de los niños, pero la demoraron un montón porque ella ya estaba fuera de su horario de trabajo pero los niños comenzaron a llorar, abrazarla y hacerle fotos, en fin, fue un mar de llantos y todos nos sentimos muy tristes. La pobre chica tuvo que prometerle a los chicos que ella vendría hasta España el próximo año y así dejarlos tranquilos. En fin, aún mantenemos contacto con ella por teléfono.

Dominicana es una de las experiencias mas inolvidables que jamás hemos tenido. La calidad de la gente, las ganas de servir y el clima son impresionantes. Hemos estado en otros lugares como Islas Caimanes, Mexico Riviera maya y cancún, Las Bahamas y Baleares, pero vamos, como en Paradisus, ningún lugar. Es como en casa!!
No desaprovecheis la oportunidad.

reviews.author: mafeflorida
reviews.title: Perfect Small Destination Wedding
reviews.text: We all had a blast. I had a small destination wedding and we came back with so many wonderful pictures and memories. The resort is gorgeous. The beach is one of the most beautiful beach we had all seen. The music in the background all over the resort was perfect. We all spend alot of  time by the pool were there is a pool/bar. There is plenty of places to be under shade at this resort.It is very well layed out. We all enjoyed the food. Vento and Passions was one of our favorites but all the restaurants had very good food. If there is one recomendation I can give is you might want to consider doing it away from Hurricane season I was stressed out before the travel date but thankfully we had good weather. We basically said no to the sales talk.My brother wanted to do it. The sales people are nice; not to agressive. We were very happy with the way our wedding pictures came out but they were changing companies as we were leaving. The Wedding Dept was very professional and made me calm every time i felt a little anxious.Be aware there is taxes that will be added to the bill. One bad thing that happen in our trip was that at the beginning of our trip one side of the building the a/c wasnt working to well. Were the resataurants are located but by the end of the trip it was working fine.  My husband and I really enjoyed there Dinner/Show Circus Night (this was on a wed night) and we also enjoyed the Dominican Theme Day (this was on Mond night)  The drinks are top-notch. Our room-fridge was always nicely full.  I did hear some people complaining about having bugs in their rooms. They were on the 1st floor we were on the third. The people at the resort are very nice and try very hard to speak english. They charge you $30 each way to the airport in taxi. And the airport's food is super expensive*$5 for a slice of pizza. They do take american cash everywere. We had read on previous reviews about taking singles for tiping and that was a good advise. They dont ask you but it felt good to tip. Over all we were very pleased we had our wedding here and we all enjoyed the trip. Oh and by the way I got to go Diving it was my first time ever and it was included.

reviews.author: trysann
reviews.title: Un gran hotel
reviews.text:
Bueno decir que era la primera vez que iba a Republica Dominicana y que acerte con el hotel. Nosotros fuimos en luna de miel en servicio real y la verdad es que nos atendieron todos de maravilla y sin dar propina el camarero ( por poner un ejemplo) nos traia bebidas a la playa o la piscina y nos venia a preguntar si necesitabamos algo y como he dicho antes ni dimos propina solo dimos propina al ultimo dia  camarero que nos atendio, al maletero y al mayordomo. Lo de que te asaltan con lo de la multipropiedad no se que decir a nosotros nos lo dijeron dijimos que no lo queriamos y ya no nos dijeron mas al respecto, asi que no se.
Lo unico que no me iba mucho y esta es mi unica queja del hotel es la comida por la noche no se pero las cenas no me gustaban mucho con esto no quiero decir que estuviesen malas pero yo creo que demasiadas salsa o especies, la comida de calidad pero la preparacion no me gusto demasiado, eso si el desayuno excelente disfrutaba con el desayuno. Y los mayordomos geniales, envio saludos a Ana desde aqui y a todo el mundo que nos atendio de parte de los Perez.
Y bueno nada mas yo creo que ha este hotel de doy un 10 en atencion al cliente, un 10 en las instalaciones y un 8 en la comida. Vamos que si vuelvo a punta cana lo hare al Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Durwood0123
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, not activity-friendly
reviews.text:
My husband and I were given an all-inclusive trip to Paradisus.  We did not make the reservations nor had a choice of where to stay.
